words.translation: 平常的,普通的；普通的；平凡的；平常的；普通；平常的人（或事）

examples.en: It’s just an ordinary camera.
examples.zh: 这只是普通的相机。

examples.en: The book is about ordinary people.
examples.zh: 这本书描写的是普通人。

examples.en: Art should be part of ordinary life.
examples.zh: 艺术应该是日常生活的一部分。

words.definition: an example of a particular situation or of something happening; situation, circumstance, instance, thing, condition; invest, circumvent
words.translation: 事例,情形；情况；实例；箱；包围；把…装于容器中

examples.en: Tom’s career is a case in point (= a clear example of something that you are discussing or explaining ) .
examples.zh: 汤姆的事业就是个明证。

examples.en: a classic case (= typical example ) of poor design
examples.zh: 蹩脚设计的典型例子

words.definition: to write a piece of music; constitute, form, structure, calm; write, consist, make up
words.translation: 组成,写作；构成；写作；使平静；排…的版；组成；作曲；排字

examples.en: Barrington has composed the music for a new production of ‘A Midsummer Night’s Dream’.
examples.zh: 巴林顿为新版的《仲夏夜之梦》谱了曲。

words.translation: 罗马

examples.en: He passed one night in Rome.
examples.zh: 他在罗马过了一夜。

examples.en: We finally arrived in Rome.
examples.zh: 我们终于到达罗马。

examples.en: He sways the whole Rome.
examples.zh: 他统治着整个罗马帝国。

words.definition: to allow something to happen, especially by an official decision, rule, or law; to allow, make a promise; license, let, have, grant; license, patent
words.translation: 通行证,执照；许可,允许；许可；允许；许可证，执照

examples.en: Smoking is only permitted in the public lounge.
examples.zh: 只允许在公共休息室里抽烟。

examples.en: He had more than the permitted level of alcohol in his blood.
examples.zh: 他血液中的酒精含量超出了允许的水平。

words.definition: having the qualities or ability needed to do something; able, competent
words.translation: 有能力的,能干的；能干的，能胜任的；有才华的

examples.en: I don’t think he’s capable of murder.
examples.zh: 我认为他没有能力杀人。

examples.en: The company isn’t capable of handling an order that large.
examples.zh: 那家公司没有能力应付那么大的订单。

examples.en: I’m perfectly capable of looking after myself, thank you!
examples.zh: 我完全能够自己照顾自己，多谢了！

words.definition: completely; entirely, completely, totally, thoroughly, absolutely, strictly
words.translation: 充分地,完全地；充分地；完全地；彻底地

examples.en: The restaurant is fully booked this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚这家餐厅订满了。

examples.en: Elisa has not fully recovered from the incident.
examples.zh: 埃莉莎还没有完全从这个事件中恢复过来。

examples.en: I am fully aware of your problems.
examples.zh: 你的问题我全知道。

words.definition: based on facts or relating to facts; actual, sincere, true, real, positive
words.translation: 事实的,实际的；事实的；真实的

examples.en: Try to keep your account of events as factual as possible.
examples.zh: 你要尽量如实地说明情况。

words.definition: extremely small; micro, few, little, minute
words.translation: 很少的,微小的；微小的；很少的

examples.en: a tiny community in the Midwest
examples.zh: 中西部地区一个极小的社区

examples.en: The earrings were tiny.
examples.zh: 耳环很小。

examples.en: a tiny little baby
examples.zh: 丁点大的婴儿

words.definition: the part of your face which you put food into, or which you use for speaking; jaws, ostium; grumble
words.translation: 口,嘴；[解剖]口，嘴；河口；做作地说，装腔作势地说；喃喃地说出

examples.en: He lifted his glass to his mouth.
examples.zh: 他把玻璃杯举到嘴边。

examples.en: Liam was fast asleep with his mouth wide open.
examples.zh: 利亚姆大张着嘴，睡得很熟。

words.definition: the way in which two facts, ideas, events etc are related to each other, and one is affected or caused by the other; relationship, bearing, link, concern, junction
words.translation: 连接,关系；连接；关系；连接件

examples.en: Police have so far failed to establish a connection between the two murders.
examples.zh: 到目前为止警方尚未确定两宗凶杀案之间有关联。

examples.en: The evidence was there in the file but no one made the connection .
examples.zh: 证据就在档案里，但没有人把它们联系起来。

examples.en: Students often see little connection between school and the rest of their lives.
examples.zh: 学生往往看不到上学和今后生活的联系。

words.translation: 费城(美国宾西法尼亚州东南部港市)

examples.en: And I loved Philadelphia.
examples.zh: 而且，我喜欢费城。

words.definition: the physical power and energy that makes someone strong; force, might, excellence, muscle, power
words.translation: 力,力量；力量；力气；兵力；长处

examples.en: I’m trying to build up my strength .
examples.zh: 我在努力增强体力。

examples.en: Jo hit him with all her strength .
examples.zh: 乔用尽全力打他。

examples.en: He never ceased to be amazed by her physical strength .
examples.zh: 他一直对她的体力感到惊诧。

words.definition: showing that someone has been well trained and is good at their work; vocational, specialized, occupational; career man
words.translation: 专业的,职业的；专业的；职业的；职业性的；[管理]专业人员；职业运动员

examples.en: This business plan looks very professional.
examples.zh: 这个商业计划看上去很有专业水平。

examples.en: a more professional approach to work
examples.zh: 更专业的工作方法

words.definition: You can use virtually to indicate that something is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true; actually, really, almost, nearly, most
words.translation: 事实上,实质上；事实上，几乎；实质上

examples.en: Virtually all cooking was done over coal-fired ranges.
examples.zh: 事实上所有的烹饪都是在烧煤的炉灶上完成的。

words.definition: an official meeting to discuss political or church matters; eating, food and drink
words.translation: 通常所吃的食物,会议；[食品]饮食；食物；[医]规定饮食

examples.en: She doesn’t eat a very healthy diet .
examples.zh: 她的饮食不是很健康。

words.definition: something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand; wonder, miracle
words.translation: 现象；[物]现象；奇迹；杰出的人才

examples.en: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
examples.zh: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

words.definition: continuing to exist for a long time or for all the time in the future; eternal, constant, steady, lasting, perpetual
words.translation: 永久的,持久的；永久的，永恒的；不变的

examples.en: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
examples.zh: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

examples.en: a permanent change in your eating habits
examples.zh: 饮食习惯的永久改变

examples.en: The blindness that the disease causes will be permanent.
examples.zh: 这种疾病引起的失明是永久性的。

words.definition: a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a decoration; pillar, tier
words.translation: 圆柱,专栏；纵队，[数]列；专栏；圆柱，柱形物

examples.en: He writes a weekly column for ‘The Times’.
examples.zh: 他每周为《泰晤士报》写一篇专栏文章。

words.definition: heater, heating appliance
words.translation: 使热的人,温热装置；取暖器；加热器；加热工人

examples.en: a plate warmer
examples.zh: 暖盘器

words.definition: a period of time when you are not doing anything tiring and you can relax or sleep; relax; lay-up, stillness; relax, still
words.translation: 休息；使休息，使轻松；把…寄托于；休息，静止；休息时间；剩余部分；支架；静止；依赖；安置

examples.en: You look exhausted! Why don’t you take a rest?
examples.zh: 你看上去累坏了！ 为什么不休息一下呢？

words.definition: one of the long parts of your body that your feet are joined to, or a similar part on an animal or insect; to run in order to escape from someone or something; backbone, stay
words.translation: 腿；走,跑；[解剖]腿；支柱

examples.en: a young boy with skinny legs
examples.zh: 双腿干瘦的小男孩

examples.en: She fell and broke her leg.
examples.zh: 她摔断了腿。

words.definition: communication with a person, organization, country etc; touch, link; meet, to link
words.translation: 接触,联系；[电][电子]接触，联系；联系，[电][电子]接触

examples.en: The town is cut off from contact with the outside world.
examples.zh: 小镇与外界的联系被切断了。

words.definition: relating to the  stone age (= the period of time thousands of years ago when people used stone tools and weapons ); palaeolithic
words.translation: 旧石器时代的

examples.en: a paleolithic axe
examples.zh: 旧石器时代的石斧

words.definition: to know that a sound is being made, using your ears; sound, learn of; ear, hark
words.translation: 听到,听说；听到，听；听说；审理；听；听见

examples.en: Blanche heard a crash as the back door was flung open.
examples.zh: 布兰奇听见后门哗啦一声被推开。

examples.en: Did anyone see or hear anything last night?
examples.zh: 昨晚有没有人看见或听见什么？

examples.en: Old Zeke doesn’t hear too well any more.
examples.zh: 老齐克的耳朵已不灵了。

words.definition: a large shiny black bird with a loud cry; if a  cock  crows, it makes a loud high sound; corbie, wrecking bar
words.translation: 乌鸦；啼叫；[鸟]乌鸦；鸡鸣；撬棍

examples.en: The crows roosted in Fonsa's Tower.
examples.zh: 那些乌鸦栖息在风萨塔里。

words.definition: to use your money to pay for goods or services; invested, lose, cost, last; peter, consume; budget
words.translation: 花费,度过；度过，消磨（时光）；花费；浪费；用尽；花钱；用尽，耗尽；预算

examples.en: I can’t afford to spend any more money this week.
examples.zh: 这星期我没有能力花更多的钱了。

examples.en: The repairs cost a lot, but it’s money well spent (= a sensible way of spending money ) .
examples.zh: 修理费很高，但这是该花的钱。

words.definition: to do something as a reaction to something that has been said or done; reply, answer; answering
words.translation: 回答,响应,作出反应；回答；作出反应；承担责任；应答；唱和

examples.en: They are likely to respond positively to the president's request for aid.
examples.zh: 他们有可能积极地回应该总统的援助请求。

words.definition: a unit for measuring time. There are 60 minutes in one hour; cent, moments, note, while, penny; tiny, strict, micro, detailed, particular
words.translation: 分钟,片刻；[计量][数]分，分钟；片刻，一会儿；备忘录，笔记；会议记录；微小的，详细的

examples.en: It takes me ten minutes to walk to work.
examples.zh: 我步行上班要用十分钟。

examples.en: The train arrived at four minutes past eight.
examples.zh: 火车于八点零四分到达。

examples.en: He returned a few minutes later.
examples.zh: 几分钟后他回来了。

words.translation: 华盛顿

examples.en: What time does the train get into Washington?
examples.zh: 这趟火车什么时间到达华盛顿?

examples.en: The President departed from Washington today.
examples.zh: 总统今天从华盛顿出发。

examples.en: The library was modelled after the library of Congress of Washington.
examples.zh: 这个图书馆是按华盛顿国会图书馆的式样设计建造的。

words.definition: You can use machinery to refer to machines in general, or machines that are used in a factory or on a farm; organization, mechanism, house
words.translation: 机械,机器；机械；[机]机器；机构；机械装置

examples.en: ...quality tools and machinery.
examples.zh: …优质工具和机械。

words.definition: an amount of something used as a standard of measurement; device, apparatus, installation, components, parts
words.translation: 个体,(计量)单位；[计量]单位，单元；装置；[军]部队；[机]部件

examples.en: a Russian army unit
examples.zh: 俄罗斯陆军分队

words.definition: the act of improving something or the state of being improved; reforming, amendment, enrichment, amelioration
words.translation: 改进,进步；改进，改善

examples.en: Our results have shown some improvement this month.
examples.zh: 我们的成绩这个月有所提高。

words.definition: afford, allow, extend, deliver, part; manage, debate, cope with; policy, business, trade, truck
words.translation: 交易；处理,分配；处理；给予；分配；发牌；讨论；对待；做生意；[贸易]交易；（美）政策；待遇；份量

examples.en: They were burned by the phony stock deal.
examples.zh: 他们在那虚假的股票交易中遭受损失。

examples.en: He tried to profiteer from this dirty deal.
examples.zh: 他想在这笔肮脏的交易中捞一把。

words.definition: a substance containing atoms from two or more  elements; synthetise, mix together; make it up, make peace with someone; mixture, hybrid, mix; mixed, hybrid
words.translation: 混合物；合成；混合；和解妥协；搀合；和解；妥协；[化学]化合物；[生物]复合词；[生物]复合的；混合的

examples.en: man-made organic compounds
examples.zh: 人造有机化合物

words.definition: the feeling you get when you are afraid or worried that something bad is going to happen; to feel afraid or worried that something bad may happen; worry, afraid of; be nervous of, be afraid of
words.translation: 恐怖,害怕；害怕,畏惧；害怕；[心理]恐惧；敬畏；担心；为…担心

examples.en: She finally ran away for fear that he would kill her.
examples.zh: 她最后逃走了，唯恐他会杀她。

words.definition: one of the light soft things that cover a bird’s body; plume; fledge
words.translation: 羽毛,轻的东西；羽毛；用羽毛装饰；长羽毛

examples.en: an ostrich feather
examples.zh: 一根鸵鸟羽毛

words.definition: to limit all or most of your study, business etc to a particular subject or activity; specialise in, elaborate on; technicalize, elaborate on
words.translation: 专攻；专门从事；详细说明；特化；使专门化；使适应特殊情况

examples.en: "You must specialize, " he says.
examples.zh: “你必须做到专门化。” 他说。

examples.en: Rules govern how to specialize safely: Each new information type must map to an existing one, and new information types must be more restrictive than the existing one in the content that they allow.
examples.zh: 规则可以监管如何安全地专门化：每一新信息类型必须映射到现有的一种类型，而且新信息类型必须比它们所允许的内容中现成的更加有限制性。

examples.en: Or it may be made up solely of analysts who specialize in requirements gathering and use case development.
examples.zh: 或者，这个团队可以仅由那些专门进行需求收集和用例开发的分析人员组成。

words.definition: a piece of furniture that you sleep on; to fix something firmly and deeply into something else; elements, basis, foundation, base, sole; establish, put, station, plant, rear; spin in
words.translation: 床,基础；安置；[家具]床；基础；河底， 海底；使睡觉；安置，嵌入；栽种；上床；分层

examples.en: You should go to bed early.
examples.zh: 你应该早点上床。

examples.en: She got into bed and turned out the light.
examples.zh: 她上了床，关掉灯。

words.definition: happening at the beginning; premier, original
words.translation: 最初的,初始的；[数]最初的；字首的

examples.en: an initial investment of £5,000
examples.zh: 5,000英镑的初始投资

examples.en: The initial response has been encouraging.
examples.zh: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

words.definition: a unit for measuring length, equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot.; height, little, touch; worm
words.translation: 英寸；身高；少许；慢慢前进

examples.en: The curtains were an inch too short.
examples.zh: 窗帘短了一英寸。

examples.en: Rainfall here is under 15 inches a year.
examples.zh: 本地的年降雨量不到15英寸。

words.definition: if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas; vapor; disappear, blank
words.translation: (使)蒸发,消失；使……蒸发；使……脱水；使……消失；蒸发，挥发；消失，失踪

examples.en: Most of the water had evaporated.
examples.zh: 大部分的水都蒸发了。

examples.en: The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves.
examples.zh: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

words.definition: needing electricity to work, produced by electricity, or used for carrying electricity; dynamoelectric, motor-driven; electrified body
words.translation: 电的；[电]电的；电动的；发电的；导电的；令人震惊的；电；电气车辆；带电体

examples.en: an electric blanket
examples.zh: 电热毯

words.definition: the central part of an atom, made up of neutrons, protons, and other elementary particles; core, quick
words.translation: 核子；[核][天][生物]核，核心；原子核

examples.en: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
examples.zh: 在一个原子的核内，中子和质子聚合在一起。

words.definition: a scientist who studies ecology
words.translation: 生态学者

examples.en: Ecologists argue that the benefits of treating sewage with disinfectants are doubtful.
examples.zh: 生态学家们认为用消毒剂处理污水的好处是值得怀疑的。

words.definition: physical activities that you do in order to stay healthy and become stronger; movement, sport, ceremony, campaign, practice; make use of, fashion, occupy, alarm, employ; motion, do sport
words.translation: 运动,练习；运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼；锻炼；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐

examples.en: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
examples.zh: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

examples.en: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
examples.zh: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

words.definition: used to say that something happens or is true even though something else might have prevented it; in spite of, for all that; hate, hatred, contempt
words.translation: 尽管,不论；尽管，不管；轻视；憎恨；侮辱

examples.en: Despite all our efforts to save the school, the authorities decided to close it.
examples.zh: 尽管我们竭力想保住这所学校，当局还是决定把它关闭。

words.definition: someone from India; hindu; Injun, Red Indian
words.translation: 印度(人)；印度的；印第安人的；印第安语的；印第安人；印度人；印第安语

examples.en: Do you fancy going out for an Indian?
examples.zh: 你想出去吃印度菜吗？

words.definition: An independent is an independent politician; alone, free, isolated, separate, specialty
words.translation: 中立派,无党派者；独立的；单独的；无党派的；不受约束的

examples.en: Mr. Vassiliou, standing as an independent, succeeded in convincing a significant number of voters of his argument.
examples.zh: 瓦西里欧先生以无党派人士身份成功地说服了大量选民支持他的观点。

words.definition: joneses, vicinage; adjacent, nearby; on speaking terms; abut upon, abut against
words.translation: 邻居,邻国；邻居；邻近的；友好；毗邻而居；邻接

examples.en: I parked my baby at the neighbor's house.
examples.zh: 我把小孩寄放在邻居家里。

examples.en: It means you love Him with all your heart, and you love your neighbor as yourself.
examples.zh: 它意味着你全心全意的爱上帝并且像爱自己那样爱邻居。

examples.en: See, if you break any one of those commandments, you do not love your neighbor as yourself.
examples.zh: 看，如果你违反了其中任何一条戒律，你就没能像爱自己那样爱邻居。

words.definition: if birds or animals migrate, they travel regularly from one part of the world to another; to move, to shift; transplant
words.translation: 迁移,转移；移动；随季节而移居；移往；使移居；使移植

examples.en: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work.
examples.zh: 人们移居到雅加达这样的城市找工作。

words.definition: something that you give or do in order to help something be successful; subscription, contributing to
words.translation: 贡献；捐献；投稿

examples.en: All the money has been raised by voluntary contribution.
examples.zh: 所有这些钱都是靠自愿捐献筹集的。

words.definition: if something divides, or if you divide it, it separates into two or more parts; distribute, part; differ, come between; shed, watershed
words.translation: 分,划分；划分；除；分开；使产生分歧；意见分歧；[地理]分水岭，分水线

examples.en: The physical benefits of exercise can be divided into three factors.
examples.zh: 锻炼对身体的好处可以分成3个方面。

words.definition: A creature that preys on other creatures lives by catching and eating them; grind down, lie on; victim, predation
words.translation: 捕食,掠夺；捕食；掠夺；折磨；牺牲者；被捕食的动物

examples.en: The effect was to disrupt the food chain, starving many animals and those that preyed on them.
examples.zh: 后果是打断食物链，使许多动物和捕食它们的动物饿死。

words.definition: to think that something will happen because it seems likely or has been planned; promise oneself, guess, find, feel, make; look foward to, to look forward to
words.translation: 期待,预期；期望；指望；认为；预料；期待；预期

examples.en: He will be hard to beat. I fully expect (= am completely sure about ) that and I’m ready.
examples.zh: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

examples.en: ‘Who are you?’ he murmured, only half expecting (= thinking it was possible, but not likely ) her to answer.
examples.zh: “你是谁？”他低声问道，预计她可能不会回答。

examples.en: He didn’t get his expected pay rise.
examples.zh: 他没有得到他预想的加薪。

examples.zh: 而在这一点上，工业化的痕迹只在欧洲的沉积物中找到。

examples.en: With the industrialization of food production and the globalization of its marketing, efforts to ensure food safety likewise take on an international dimension.
examples.zh: 随着食品生产的工业化及其销售的全球化，努力确保食品安全的工作也同样具有了国际意义。

words.definition: having the right qualities for a particular person, purpose, or situation; appropriate, proper, adequate, becoming, matching
words.translation: 适当的,相配的；适当的；相配的

examples.en: We are hoping to find a suitable school.
examples.zh: 我们希望能找到一所合适的学校。

words.definition: to prepare and use land for growing crops and plants; rear, foster, plant, nurse
words.translation: 培养,耕作；培养；陶冶；耕作

examples.en: The land was too rocky to cultivate.
examples.zh: 这块地石头太多，无法耕作。

words.definition: to fasten things together or hold them in a particular position using a piece of string, rope etc; restrict, hold oneself in; knot; draw, necktie
words.translation: 扎,捆绑；系；约束；打结；与…成平局；不分胜负；被用带（或绳子等）系住；领带；平局；鞋带；领结

examples.en: I tie my hair back when I’m jogging.
examples.zh: 我慢跑时把头发扎在脑后。

words.definition: to get something, especially an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from something; to originate
words.translation: 获取,得自,起源；起源

examples.en: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
examples.zh: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

words.definition: to keep something or continue to have something; keep up, to keep
words.translation: 保持,保留；保持；雇；记住

examples.en: You have the right to retain possession of the goods.
examples.zh: 你有权保留这些物品。

examples.en: The state wants to retain control of food imports.
examples.zh: 政府想保留对食品进口的控制权。

words.definition: the possibility that something will happen, especially something you want; opportunity, possibility, probability, feasibility, opening; happen to; happen to do
words.translation: 机会；机会，际遇；运气，侥幸；可能性；偶然发生；冒……的险；碰巧；偶然被发现

examples.en: There’s always the chance that something will go wrong.
examples.zh: 总有可能会出现问题。

examples.en: If we did move to London, I’d stand a much better chance (= have a much better chance ) of getting a job.
examples.zh: 如果我们真的搬到伦敦去，我找到工作的机会就大多了。

examples.en: There is little chance of her being found alive.
examples.zh: 她生还的可能性很小。

words.definition: relating to the people who live in a country; folk, polite
words.translation: 公民的,文明的；公民的；民间的；文职的；有礼貌的；根据民法的

examples.en: They were married in a civil ceremony in May.
examples.zh: 他们在五月份举行了世俗婚礼。

words.definition: relating to the time in history before anything was written down; old, ogygian
words.translation: 史前的；陈旧的

examples.en: prehistoric burial grounds
examples.zh: 史前墓地

examples.en: prehistoric animals
examples.zh: 史前动物

words.definition: to show something in a public place so that people can go to see it; introduce, reveal, prove, make clear, prefer; proof, witness
words.translation: 展览,陈列,展示；展览；显示；提出（证据等）；[贸易]展览品；证据；展示会

examples.en: Her paintings have been exhibited all over the world.
examples.zh: 她的绘画作品在世界各地展出。

words.definition: many; many, multiple, hundred, plenty
words.translation: 众多的,许多的；许多的，很多的

examples.en: Numerous attempts have been made to hide the truth.
examples.zh: 为掩盖事实作了很多尝试。

examples.en: The two leaders have worked together on numerous occasions.
examples.zh: 那两位领导人已经多次合作。

words.definition: a person who hunts wild animals, or an animal that hunts other animals for food; shekarry, venerer
words.translation: 猎人；[林]猎人；猎犬；搜寻者

examples.en: The hunters stalked their prey.
examples.zh: 猎人们隐伏跟踪猎物。

words.translation: 佛罗里达(美国州名)

examples.en: Well, Florida, we are here to say, not this time.
examples.zh: 那么，佛罗里达，我们在这里说，这次不能如此。

examples.en: That was a very good day in my life, because no one in my family would ever have to live on the streets like I did as a young boy when running away from that abusive Florida orphanage.
examples.zh: 那是我生命中极其美好的一天，因为从此以后，我的家人决不会像童年的我那样住在大街上了——小时候，我逃离那个我备受虐待的佛罗里达孤儿院后，就住在大街上。

examples.en: I suggested he put an aircraft carrier or other large vessel off the coast of Florida and do the same kind of screening.
examples.zh: 我建议他在佛罗里达的海岸上安置一艘航空母舰或是一艘其它种类的大舰艇，进行同样的筛选。

words.definition: an official instruction that says how things must be done or what is allowed, especially in a game, organization, or job; to have the official power to control a country and the people who live there; king it over, reign over; governance, regulation, order; define, regulate, manage, state, conduct
words.translation: 规则,条例；支配,统治；统治；管辖；裁定；[数]规则；规定；管理；裁决；支配

examples.en: There are no hard and fast rules (= clear and definite rules ) about what to wear to classes.
examples.zh: 对于上课着装并没有硬性规定。

words.definition: how well someone plays a particular game or sport; competition, play, sport, tournament, match; brave, stronghearted; gamble, shake the elbows
words.translation: 比赛；游戏；勇敢的；赌博

examples.en: the strongest aspect of his game
examples.zh: 他比赛技巧中最强的一面

words.definition: a type of rock that looks like black glass
words.translation: [矿]黑曜石

examples.en: The Texas show includes an obsidian mask that likely traveled to Khara Khorum all the way from Egypt, Lessem says.
examples.zh: 德克萨斯州展出包括了一个黑曜石面具，可能是从埃及被带到哈喇和林来的，莱塞姆说。

words.definition: involved in or relating to migration; ragamuffinly, nomadic
words.translation: 迁移的,流浪的；[动]迁移的；流浪的

examples.en: migratory birds
examples.zh: 候鸟

words.definition: a very young bird that cannot leave its nest because it is not yet able to fly; baby, infant
words.translation: 尚未离巢的小鸟,婴孩；婴儿；未离巢的雏鸟

words.definition: someone who makes sculptures; structurer
words.translation: 雕刻家

examples.en: There was a great demand for engravings of his portrait, and his head was being modelled by an admiring sculptor.
examples.zh: 人们强烈要求要帮他做一个雕塑，一位有名的雕刻家正在把他的头像做成模型。

examples.en: We can take the mysterious， hazy future and carve out of it anything that we can imagine， just like a sculptor carves a statue from a shapeless stone.
examples.zh: 我们可以掌握神秘而不可知的未来，从中创出我们所能想象的任何东西，一如雕刻家可以将未成型的石头刻出雕像一样。

examples.en: This is what the sculptor must do.
examples.zh: 而雕塑家就必须做到这一点。

words.definition: aggravate, exacerbate
words.translation: (使)变复杂；使复杂化；使恶化；使卷入

examples.en: I think that is because we unnecessarily complicate it.
examples.zh: 我想这是因为我们不必要地将生活复杂化了。

examples.en: If the answer to all of these questions is no, a framework will only complicate matters.
examples.zh: 如果所有这些问题的答案都为否，那么使用框架只会把事情变复杂。

examples.en: The selection service is one of the more difficult services to implement correctly because it has some valuable features that complicate the implementation.
examples.zh: 选择服务是比较难以正确实现的服务之一，因为它具有一些使实现复杂化的有价值的功能。

words.definition: the process of getting better at doing something, or getting closer to finishing or achieving something; development, growth, making, advancement; wage, do, go ahead
words.translation: 前进,进步,发展；进步，发展；前进；前进，进步；进行

examples.en: We made good progress despite the snow.
examples.zh: 尽管下雪，我们的行程还是很顺利。

words.definition: someone who buys and uses products and services; user, customer, client, guest
words.translation: 消费者；[经][生态]消费者；用户，顾客

examples.en: Consumers will soon be paying higher airfares.
examples.zh: 不久消费者就要支付更高的机票价了。

examples.en: It will offer a wider choice of goods for the consumer (= consumers in general ) .
examples.zh: 它将为消费者提供更多的商品选择。

examples.en: Consumer demand led to higher imports of manufactured goods.
examples.zh: 消费者需求促使制造商品的进口量增加了。

words.definition: the border of a country; boundary, border; borderline
words.translation: 国境,边疆；前沿；[数]边界；国境；[数]边界的；开拓的

examples.en: a novel about a family’s struggle on the American frontier
examples.zh: 描写一家人在美国边远地区奋斗的小说

words.definition: to be acceptable, suitable, or  convenient  for a particular person or in a particular situation; become, condition, season, adapt to something; litigation, group, team, lawsuit, law; balance, be in order
words.translation: 合适,相配；适合；使适应；诉讼；组；套装；恳求；合适；相称

examples.en: Whatever your reason for borrowing, we have the loan that suits your needs .
examples.zh: 不管您因何贷款，我们都会有满足您需要的贷款。

examples.en: There’s a range of restaurants to suit all tastes .
examples.zh: 有各种各样的餐馆可以满足所有口味。

examples.en: There are countryside walks to suit everyone .
examples.zh: 有适合每个人的乡村步行路径。

words.definition: to make a person or animal die; drop, offset; strike down, push about; bloodshed; fatal, deadly, lethiferous
words.translation: 杀死,毁掉；杀死；扼杀；使终止；抵消；杀戮；屠杀；致命的；致死的

examples.en: Why did she kill her husband?
examples.zh: 她为什么杀死丈夫？

examples.en: Murray held a gun to his head and threatened to kill him.
examples.zh: 默里拿枪指着他的头并威胁要杀了他。

examples.en: Four people were killed when a train plunged into a flooded river.
examples.zh: 火车冲进洪水泛滥的河中，造成四人身亡。

words.definition: clearly different or belonging to a different type; obvious, visible, unique, evident, individual
words.translation: 清楚的,明显的,不同的；明显的；独特的；清楚的；有区别的

examples.en: two entirely distinct languages
examples.zh: 两种完全不同的语言

words.definition: if someone is responsible for an accident, mistake, crime etc, it is their fault or they can be blamed; honest, reliable, tried, safe, sure
words.translation: 有责任的,负责的；[法]负责的，可靠的；有责任的

examples.en: We are determined to bring the people responsible to justice.
examples.zh: 我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。

words.definition: pretty or attractive, but not always necessary or useful; ornamental
words.translation: 装饰的；装饰性的；装潢用的

examples.en: a decorative panel above the door
examples.zh: 门楣上的饰板

words.definition: the official leader of a country that does not have a king or queen; principal, prez
words.translation: 总统,会长；总统；董事长；校长

examples.en: President Bush
examples.zh: 布什总统

words.definition: a plant or animal that lives on or in another plant or animal and gets food from it; helminth, vermin
words.translation: 寄生虫；[生物][基医]寄生虫；食客

examples.en: Kangaroos harbour a vast range of parasites.
examples.zh: 袋鼠身上有各种各样的寄生虫。

words.definition: last in a series of actions, events, parts of a story etc; ultimate, crucial, critical, decisive; shoot-off, fight-off
words.translation: 最后的,最终的；最终的；决定性的；不可更改的；决赛；期末考试；当日报纸的末版

examples.en: The final episode will be shown tonight.
examples.zh: 最后一集将于今晚播出。

examples.en: students preparing for their final examinations
examples.zh: 正在准备期末考试的学生

examples.en: Stone is filming the final instalment of his Vietnam trilogy.
examples.zh: 斯通正在拍摄越战三部曲的最后一部。

words.definition: to make small changes to something in order to improve it and make it more suitable or effective; alter, dizen; alter, touch up
words.translation: 更改,修改；修改，修饰；更改；修改

examples.en: The feedback will be used to modify the course for next year.
examples.zh: 这些反馈意见将用于修改明年的课程。

examples.en: The regulations can only be modified by a special committee.
examples.zh: 这些法规只能由特别委员会来修改。

words.definition: to complete the last part of something that you are doing; accomplish, carry out, achieve, perform, complete; drop, determine; completion, achievement, execution, perfection, accomplishment
words.translation: 完成,结束；完成；结束；用完；结束，终止；终结；完美；磨光

examples.en: You can’t go anywhere until you’ve finished your homework.
examples.zh: 没完成家庭作业前你哪儿也不能去。

examples.en: Have you finished that book yet?
examples.zh: 那本书你看完了吗？

examples.en: ‘How’s the decorating going?’ ‘We’ve nearly finished.’
examples.zh: “装修进行得怎么样了？”“差不多快完成了。”

words.definition: the way your voice sounds, which shows how you are feeling or what you mean; mood, hues; enchance, to increase
words.translation: 音调；语气；[光]色调；[声]音调；音色；增强；用某种调子说

examples.en: Her tone was sharp with anger.
examples.zh: 她很气愤，语气尖刻。

examples.en: It was obvious from her tone of voice that she didn’t like me.
examples.zh: 从她的语气明显听得出来她不喜欢我。

words.definition: a large quantity of something; plenty, pregnancy, amplitude, enrichment
words.translation: 丰富,充裕；充裕，[地化]丰富

examples.en: This area of Mexico has an abundance of safe beaches and a pleasing climate.
examples.zh: 墨西哥的这个地区有大量的安全沙滩与宜人的气候。

words.definition: all the words that someone knows or uses; lexis
words.translation: 词汇,词表；[语]词汇；词表

examples.en: Teachers were impressed by his vocabulary.
examples.zh: 他的词汇量给老师们留下了深刻的印象。

words.definition: An alder is a species of tree or shrub that grows especially in cool, damp places and loses its leaves in winter
words.translation: [植]桤木

examples.en: A few scrubby trees, like red alder, have re-established themselves, and ants, frogs, meadowlarks, beavers and other species have moved in.
examples.zh: 一些矮灌木丛，像红桤木很快又长起来了，蚂蚁青蛙草地鸬海狸还有其他一些物种也都迁进来了。

examples.en: Groves of stunted red spruce, huckleberry, blueberry, mountain laurel, mountain holly, speckled alder, and cranberry bogs, show combinations of colors throughout the year.
examples.zh: 发育不良云杉的小树林、黑果木、蓝莓、山月桂、山冬青，斑点桤木和种越橘的沼泽地，显示着全年各种颜色的组合。

words.definition: the name given to a particular book, painting, play etc; When a writer, composer, or artist titles a work, they give it a name; rights, champion, honor, first, heading; repute; titular
words.translation: 标题；加标题于,赋予称；冠军；[计][图情]标题；头衔；权利；字幕；加标题于；赋予头衔；把…称为；冠军的；[计][图情]标题的；头衔的

examples.en: "Patience and Sarah" was first published in 1969 under the title "A Place for Us."
examples.zh: 《耐心与萨拉》于1969年以《我们的地方》为书名首次出版。

examples.en: Pirandello titled his play "Six Characters in Search of an Author."
examples.zh: 皮兰德娄将其戏剧命名为《六个寻找作者的剧中人》。

examples.en: The single is titled "White Love."
examples.zh: 这支单曲名为《白色之恋》。

words.definition: in addition – used to introduce information that adds to or supports what has previously been said; besides, again, also, then, additionally
words.translation: 此外,而且；而且；此外

examples.en: The rent is reasonable and, moreover, the location is perfect.
examples.zh: 租金合理，而且位置也非常好。

examples.en: The source of the information is irrelevant. Moreover, the information need not be confidential.
examples.zh: 信息来源无关紧要，而且也不一定必须是机密的。

words.definition: to suggest something as a plan or course of action; schedule, design, map, think, purpose; aim, offer
words.translation: 打算,向提议,求婚；建议；打算，计划；求婚；打算

examples.en: the changes currently proposed by the local planning authorities
examples.zh: 目前由地方规划局提议的改革

examples.en: the proposed budget cuts
examples.zh: 所提出的预算削减

words.definition: a public road in a city or town that has houses, shops etc on one or both sides; row, calle, treet, public thoroughfare
words.translation: 街道；[公路]街道

examples.en: We moved to Center Street when I was young.
examples.zh: 在我小时候，我们搬到了中心大街。

examples.en: She lives just a few streets away.
examples.zh: 她的住处就在几条街外。

examples.en: I walked on further down the street .
examples.zh: 我继续沿着马路走。

words.definition: the act of obtaining money that is owed to you; clustering, gather
words.translation: 收藏(品)；采集，聚集；[税收]征收；收藏品；募捐

examples.en: a debt collection agency
examples.zh: 收债服务机构

words.definition: the number 7; septenary; hepta; septimal
words.translation: 七,七个；七个，七；七的；七个的

examples.en: The women visited cities in seven states.
examples.zh: 这些女性访问了七个州的城市。

examples.en: We close the store at seven (= seven o’clock ) .
examples.zh: 我们商店七点关门。

examples.en: ‘How old’s Sam?’ ‘He’s seven (= seven years old ) .’
examples.zh: “萨姆多大了？”“他七岁。”

words.definition: expressed in a way that is very clear and direct; precise, decided, distinct, specific, express
words.translation: 明确的,清晰的；明确的；清楚的；直率的；详述的

examples.en: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
examples.zh: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

examples.en: explicit knowledge of grammar
examples.zh: 清楚易懂的语法知识

examples.en: The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
examples.zh: 绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。

words.definition: something that you feel or do because of something that has happened or been said; response, behavior, induction, reception
words.translation: 反应,反作用；[生理][化学][医]反应，感应；反动，复古；[力]反作用

examples.en: What was Jeff’s reaction when you told him about the job?
examples.zh: 你告诉杰夫这个工作时，他是什么反应？

words.definition: the smallest unit into which any substance can be divided without losing its own chemical nature, usually consisting of two or more atoms; numerator of a fraction, microne
words.translation: 分子；[化学]分子；微小颗粒，微粒

examples.en: The molecules of oxygen gas contain just two atoms.
examples.zh: 氧分子中只有两个原子。

words.definition: quickly, willingly, and without complaining; easily, lightly
words.translation: 乐意地,欣然；容易地；乐意地；无困难地

examples.en: Jack readily agreed to help.
examples.zh: 杰克爽快地答应帮忙。

words.definition: if you mix two or more substances or if they mix, they combine to become a single substance, and they cannot be easily separated; confuse with; participate, travel, company, sort; mixture, hybrid, chaos, disorder, confusion
words.translation: 使混和,混淆；配制；混淆；使混和；使结交；参与；相混合；交往；混合；混合物；混乱

examples.en: Oil and water don’t mix.
examples.zh: 油和水不相融。

words.definition: a piece of paper that has official information on it; to write about something, film it, or take photographs of it, in order to record information about it; file, paper
words.translation: 公文,文件；记载；文件，公文；[计]文档；[管理]证件

examples.en: She produces legal documents for a downtown Seattle law firm.
examples.zh: 她为西雅图市区的一家法律事务所撰写法律文件。

words.definition: when something such as money or skills are not used in a way that is effective, useful, or sensible; refuse, garbage, dissipation, wear; lose, spend, consume; trifle away, fiddle away; spare, unnecessary, redundant
words.translation: 浪费；废物；荒地；损耗；地面风化物；消耗；使荒芜；变消瘦；挥霍钱财；废弃的；多余的；荒芜的

examples.en: excessive waste in state spending
examples.zh: 政府支出方面的过度浪费

words.definition: a member of your family who lived a long time ago; father, root, grandfather
words.translation: 祖先,祖宗；始祖，[生物]祖先；被继承人

examples.en: My ancestors were French.
examples.zh: 我的祖先是法国人。

words.definition: an intelligent and well-educated person; student, academic
words.translation: 学者；奖学金获得者

examples.en: the great Dutch scholar Erasmus
examples.zh: 荷兰的大学问家伊拉斯谟

words.definition: to become a member of an organization, society, or group; participate in, become one, couple, take part in, go through; become one, couple, bond, participate in, combine; combination, connection, coupling, bond, wedding
words.translation: 参加,加入,连接；参加；结合；[计]连接；加入；接合点

examples.en: When did you join the Labour Party?
examples.zh: 你何时加入工党的？

examples.en: I decided to join the army.
examples.zh: 我决定去参军。

examples.en: You can enjoy a sport without joining a club or belonging to a team.
examples.zh: 不加盟俱乐部或球队也可以享受体育运动的乐趣。

words.definition: the way you use to enter a building or reach a place; make use of, fashion, employ, border, exercise; opening, admittance
words.translation: 入口,通道；进入；使用；[计]存取；接近；使用权；[电]通路

examples.en: Access is by means of a small door on the right.
examples.zh: 入口是右边的一扇小门。

examples.zh: 天文学家在距离地球不远处发现一颗与地球绕日轨道相同的小行星。

words.definition: to use your hands to make something or someone move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving; draw, snake; draw; tension, digging rope
words.translation: 拉,拖,拔；拉；拔；拖；拉，拖；拉，拉绳；拉力，[交]牵引力

examples.en: Mom! Davey’s pulling my hair!
examples.zh: 妈妈! 戴维拽我的头发！

words.definition: a large sea fish caught for food; tunny, bluefin
words.translation: 金枪鱼；[鱼]金枪鱼，鲔鱼

examples.en: ...a shoal of tuna.
examples.zh: …一群金枪鱼。

words.definition: to limit or control the size, amount, or range of something; block, set a limit to
words.translation: 限制,约束；限制；约束；限定

examples.en: The new law restricts the sale of hand guns.
examples.zh: 新法规限制手枪的销售。

examples.en: You may need to restrict access to certain files (= limit the number of people who can read them ) .
examples.zh: 某些档案可能需要限制查阅。

examples.en: The agreement will restrict competition.
examples.zh: 这个协议将限制竞争。

words.definition: the act of sharing things among a large group of people in a planned way; allocation, assignment
words.translation: 分发,分配,分布；[统计]分布；分配

examples.en: population distribution
examples.zh: 人口分布

words.definition: a film made to be shown at the cinema or on television; film, cinema, theater; motion-picture, cinematic
words.translation: 电影；[电影]电影；电影院；电影业；[电影]电影的

examples.en: It was like one of those old John Wayne movies.
examples.zh: 这部电影有点像约翰•韦恩演的一部老片子。

words.definition: the act of projecting a film or picture onto a screen; emission, theory, speculation, planning, sending
words.translation: 发射；[心理][数]投射；规划；突出；推测

examples.en: projection equipment
examples.zh: 投影设备

words.definition: to straighten your arms, legs, or body to full length
words.translation: 伸展,延伸

examples.en: Carl sat up in bed, yawned, and stretched.
examples.zh: 卡尔从床上坐起来，打了个呵欠，伸了伸懒 腰。

examples.en: Always stretch before exercising.
examples.zh: 锻炼之前都要做伸展运动。

words.definition: something that you hope to achieve in the future; target, object, destination, cause, aim
words.translation: 目的,目标；目标；球门，得分数；终点

examples.en: Your goal as a parent is to help your child become an independent adult.
examples.zh: 身为父母，你的目标就是要培养孩子成为独立的成年人。

words.definition: something that someone needs or asks for; do, necessity, desire, need, demand
words.translation: 需求,要求；要求；必要条件；必需品

examples.en: The refugees’ main requirements are food and shelter.
examples.zh: 难民的主要需求是食物和住所。

words.definition: if a system, process, or service operates, or if you operate it, it works; run, act; attract, keep, produce, work, handle
words.translation: 操作,运转；运转；动手术；起作用；操作；经营；引起；对…开刀

examples.en: The whole tax system is now operating more efficiently.
examples.zh: 现在整个税收制度运作效率更高了。

examples.en: The new law doesn’t operate in our favour.
examples.zh: 这项新法规对我们不利。

examples.en: The car parks operate a pay-as-you-leave system.
examples.zh: 这些停车场按“离开时付费”的模式运作。

words.definition: to trick someone so that you make them do or say something that they did not intend to; a clever trick that is used to catch someone or to make them do or say something that they did not intend to; ensnare; web, mesh, pit

examples.en: Twenty miners were trapped underground.
examples.zh: 20名矿工被困在地下。

words.definition: to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something; refuse, negative; inferior, degraded product
words.translation: 拒绝,退回；拒绝；排斥；抵制；丢弃；被弃之物或人；次品

examples.en: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
examples.zh: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

examples.en: Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
examples.zh: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

examples.en: His proposal was rejected outright (= completely rejected ) .
examples.zh: 他的建议被彻底否决了。

words.definition: most of the people or things in a group; plurality, multitude
words.translation: 大多数；多数；成年

examples.en: The Labour Party won a huge majority at the last general election.
examples.zh: 工党在上次大选中以巨大的票数优势获胜。

words.definition: a book that is part of a set, or one into which a very long book is divided; lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, bulk; massive, extensive, substantial, macro, much
words.translation: 卷,册；量；[物]体积；[计]卷；音量；大量；[图情]册；大量的

examples.en: The period from 1940 – 1945 is in volume 9.
examples.zh: 1940年至1945年这段时间在第9卷。

words.definition: if something floats, it moves slowly through the air or stays up in the air; execute, to put into practice; fan, swing; drift, caroche

examples.zh: 我仰望着天上的浮云。

examples.en: Leaves floated gently down from the trees.
examples.zh: 叶子从树上轻轻飘落。

words.definition: a large area that is different from other areas around it in some way; region, area, section, corner, quarter; environ, circle round
words.translation: 地域,地带；分成区；地区；[地理]地带；环绕；使分成地带

examples.en: San Francisco and Tokyo are both located in earthquake zones.
examples.zh: 旧金山和东京都位于地震带。

examples.en: The government has set up a special economic zone to promote private enterprise.
examples.zh: 政府设立了一个经济特区来推动私营企业的发展。

words.translation: 田园主义,牧歌体

words.definition: someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or depended on; responsible, tried, honest, safe, sure; true-blue
words.translation: 可靠的,可信赖的；可靠的；可信赖的；可靠的人

examples.en: a birth control method that is cheap and reliable
examples.zh: 既便宜又可靠的避孕方法

examples.en: Miller was a quiet and reliable man.
examples.zh: 米勒是个话不多且可靠的人。

words.definition: the number of times that something happens within a particular period of time or within a particular group of people; periodicity
words.translation: 频率,发生次数；[物]频率；频繁

examples.en: Side effects from prescribed drugs are being reported with increasing frequency (= more and more often ) .
examples.zh: 处方药的副作用正越来越频繁地被报道出来。

examples.en: The relative frequency of fraternal twins has halved since 1950.
examples.zh: 自1950年以来，异卵双胞胎的相对出生率下降了一半。

words.translation: 地质的

examples.zh: 我们最好的测量地震风险的办法是地质记录。

examples.en: If we have indeed entered a new epoch, then when exactly did it begin? When did human impacts rise to the level of geologic significance?
examples.zh: 如果我们确实迈进了新的世，那么是什么时候开始的，什么时候人类的影响会达到地质学重要意义的程度？

examples.en: Various reactors in this country are situated near geologic faults, in coastal areas reachable by tsunamis or in areas potentially vulnerable to flooding.
examples.zh: 美国有许多反应堆位于地质断层附近，海啸能够到达的沿海地区或是易受到洪水侵袭的区域。

words.definition: degree, boundary, region, length, spectrum, territory, area
words.translation: 范围,程度,广度；程度；范围；[计量]长度

words.definition: the Pleistocene epoch or rock series
words.translation: [地]更新世(的)(一段时期)

words.definition: to improve something; raise, cement, boost, muscle, gain
words.translation: 提高,增强；提高；加强；增加

examples.en: Good lighting will enhance any room.
examples.zh: 良好的照明能给房间增色不少。

examples.en: The publicity has enhanced his reputation.
examples.zh: 这次宣传提高了他的声誉。

words.definition: to go somewhere with someone; attend, keep company
words.translation: 陪伴,伴奏；陪伴，伴随；伴奏

examples.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.zh: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

examples.en: Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
examples.zh: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

words.definition: to believe that something someone does or something that happens has a particular meaning; say, bring sb to do sth; account, translate
words.translation: 解释,说明；说明；口译；解释；翻译

examples.en: Freud’s attempts to interpret the meaning of dreams
examples.zh: 弗洛伊德对梦的含义的解析

words.definition: an occasion when snow falls from the sky, or the amount that falls in a particular period of time
words.translation: 降雪,降雪量

examples.zh: 天气预报说将有大雪。

examples.en: an average snowfall of eight inches a year
examples.zh: 每年平均八英寸的降雪量

words.definition: a period of very bad weather when there is a lot of rain or snow, strong winds, and often  lightning; earthquake, rainstorm; be on the rampage; tear into, charge at

examples.en: The weather forecast is for severe storms tonight.
examples.zh: 天气预报说今晚有强暴风雨。

examples.en: Twenty people were killed when storms struck the Midwest.
examples.zh: 暴风雨袭击中西部，造成20人死亡。

words.definition: someone who plays a musical instrument, especially very well or as a job; eisteddfod
words.translation: 音乐家

examples.zh: 有天赋的年轻音乐家

words.definition: if you are critical, you criticize someone or something; dangerous, crucial, final, decisive, marginal

examples.en: He made some highly critical remarks.
examples.zh: 他发表了一些严厉的批判性言论。

examples.en: I want a mountain, a real one. In the Netherlands.
examples.zh: 我想要一个山峰，一个荷兰的真正的山。

examples.en: He rendered the landscapes of the Netherlands with great skill and artistry.
examples.zh: 他以高度技巧和艺术才能描绘了荷兰的风景。

examples.en: Weeks later it wiped out fields in the Netherlands, Germany, Denmark and England.
examples.zh: 几周以后它彻底横扫了荷兰、德国、丹麦和英格兰的田野。

words.definition: to decide which one of a number of things or people you want; condition, conclude; opt for, to make a choice
words.translation: 选择,选定；选择，决定；选择，挑选

examples.en: It took us ages to choose a new carpet.
examples.zh: 我们挑选新地毯花了很长时间。

examples.zh: 会由一个评判小组选出冠军。

examples.en: He chose his words carefully as he spoke.
examples.zh: 他说话时字斟句酌。

examples.zh: 随着地球气候逐渐变暖，极地的冰冠将开始融化。

examples.zh: 有毒污染物堆放场

words.translation: 不能的,不会的；不会的，不能的；[劳经]无能力的；不能胜任的

examples.zh: 军方可能觉得无法在明年把政权移交给一位民选总统。

examples.zh: 统治阶层内部的争权夺利

examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，满地都是大大小小的树枝。

examples.zh: 树梢上停满了鸟儿。

examples.zh: 他们的答案是把海水喷到云层上。

examples.zh: 其余的海水一接触到这条死亡冰柱就会马上冻结。

examples.zh: 在此前的推测中，每一升海水中可能会有大约100,000个微生物细胞，但现在科学家设想这一数字有可能达到十亿。

examples.zh: 他们希望在芝加哥定居。

examples.zh: 他乘火车去芝加哥。

examples.zh: 这条铁路连接两个城市，即纽约与芝加哥。

examples.zh: “你们是怎么来这里的？”“我们是步行来的。”

examples.zh: 医生说他再也不能行走了。

examples.en: He loved walking in the hills.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在山里散步。

words.translation: 健康；[医]健康；卫生；保健；兴旺

examples.zh: 茶含有咖啡因，对你的健康不利。

words.translation: 装饰；布置；授勋给

examples.zh: 浴室里是用绿色和黄色装潢的。

examples.zh: 我们计划用这个周末来装修。

words.definition: a part of something larger, especially a part that is different from the other parts; part, proportion, fate, percent, lot; part, to allocate
words.translation: 一部分；部分；一份；命运；分配；给…嫁妆

examples.zh: 城堡仅有一小部分受到了损坏。

words.translation: 结合,联合,合并；结合；[数]组合；联合；[化学]化合

examples.zh: 夜总会兼咖啡馆

words.translation: 积极的,活跃的,起作用的；积极的；[物化]活跃的；主动的；[电子]有效的；现役的；主动语态；积极分子

examples.zh: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

examples.zh: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

words.translation: 分开,分割,区分；师（军队）；[管理]部门；分割；[数]除法

examples.zh: 夫妻之间传统的分工

words.definition: a pure substance or material is not mixed with anything; stainless, whole, white, clean, net
words.translation: 纯的,纯粹的；纯的；纯粹的；纯洁的；清白的；纯理论的

examples.zh: 纯金制成的戒指

examples.en: Our beef patties are 100% pure .
examples.zh: 我们的牛肉饼是100%的纯牛肉。

words.definition: to be doing or to become involved in an activity; attract, absorb, draw, appropriate, budget; comply, wage
words.translation: 雇佣,从事,参加；吸引，占用；使参加；雇佣；使订婚；预定；从事；答应，保证；交战；啮合

examples.zh: 我从来没有从事过贩毒。

words.definition: to remain in a place rather than leave; visit, abide; tough, control, restrain; leg, visit, stop, backbone, stand
words.translation: 逗留,保持,延缓；停留；坚持；暂住；停下；抑制；逗留；停止；[建]支柱

examples.zh: 他们待了整个下午聊天。

examples.en: She stayed late to finish the report.
examples.zh: 为了完成报告，她工作到很晚。

words.definition: to control an activity or process, especially by rules; possess, define, contain, manage, state
words.translation: 管理,控制,调整；调节，规定；控制；校准；有系统的管理

examples.zh: 限制化学品在食物中使用的严格规定

words.definition: to arrange for something to go or be taken to another place, especially by post; beam, release, mission, project, let go; to post a letter; ascending motion, upward movement
words.translation: 发送,派遣；发送，寄；派遣；使进入；发射；派人；寄信；上升运动

examples.en: Lyn sent some pictures of the wedding.
examples.zh: 琳恩寄了几张婚礼照片。

words.definition: a soft reddish-brown metal that allows electricity and heat to pass through it easily, and is used to make electrical wires, water pipes etc. It is a chemical element: symbol Cu; police, pig; cupreous
words.translation: 铜,警察；[化学]铜；铜币；警察；铜的

examples.zh: 他说他来做这份工作，给他几个铜板就行。

words.definition: someone whose job is to design or build roads, bridges, machines etc; to design and plan the building of roads, bridges, machines, etc; gineer, sapper; design, style, project, frame, scheme; project, design
words.translation: 工程师；设计,建造；[经管]工程师；工兵；火车司机；设计；策划；精明地处理；建造

examples.zh: 他接受过土木工程师培训。

words.definition: someone whose job is to make judgments about the good and bad qualities of art, music, films etc; commenter, reviewer
words.translation: 批评家,评论家；批评家，评论家；爱挑剔的人

examples.zh: 马瑟做过多年的电影评论家。

words.definition: the use of money to get a profit or to make a business activity successful, or the money that is used; input, introjection
words.translation: 投资,可获利的东西；[经]投资；投入；封锁

examples.zh: 我们打算买些房地产作为投资。

words.translation: 机会主义者,投机取巧者；机会主义者；投机取巧者

examples.zh: 选民不喜欢机会主义分子——那些根据民意调查结果来改变方针的政客。

words.translation: 依靠的,依赖的；依靠的；从属的；取决于…的

examples.zh: 简的母亲要靠简来照顾。

examples.zh: 你有没有需要扶养的孩子？

words.translation: 星期,周；周，[天]星期

examples.zh: 我这星期不能见你。

examples.zh: 毒性很强的杀虫剂

words.definition: concerning or produced by  magnetism; geomagnetic
words.translation: 磁的,有吸引力的；地磁的；有磁性的；有吸引力的

examples.en: magnetic forces
examples.zh: 磁力

words.definition: to go and spend time in a place or with someone, especially for pleasure or interest; stay, call, stop, addressing; inspect, pay a call; stay, pay a call
words.translation: 拜访,访问；访问；参观；逗留；视察；暂住；闲谈

examples.en: Eric went to Seattle to visit his cousins.
examples.zh: 埃里克到西雅图去看望他的表兄弟。

examples.en: I was really pleased that they came to visit me.
examples.zh: 他们来看我，我真是高兴。

examples.en: Which cities did you visit in Spain?
examples.zh: 你在西班牙去了哪些城市？

words.definition: if things are apart, they are not close to each other or touching each other; If people or groups are a long way apart on a particular topic or issue, they have completely different views and disagree about it; unusual, different, distinctive, isolated, separating
words.translation: 相间隔,分离；分离(隔)的；分离的；与众不同的

examples.en: They have offices in countries as far apart as India and Peru.
examples.zh: 他们的办事处远至印度、秘鲁等国。

examples.en: The police try to keep rival supporters apart at all matches.
examples.zh: 警方在所有的比赛中都设法将双方的支持者分开。

examples.en: A couple of men started fighting and we had to pull them apart .
examples.zh: 几名男子打起架来，我们不得不将他们拉开。

words.definition: a large common black and white sea bird that lives near the sea; to fool, cheat, or hoax; simp, schmuck; hornswoggle, rip off
words.translation: 海鸥；欺骗；[鸟]鸥；笨人；易受骗之人；骗；欺诈

examples.en: You have to practice and see the real gull, the good in every one of them, and to help them see it in themselves.
examples.zh: 你应该通过练习去认识真正的海鸥，要看到每只海鸥的美德，并帮助他们去认识自己的美德。

words.definition: an animal that only eats plants; phytophagans, primary consumer
words.translation: 草食动物；[动]食草动物

examples.en: The meat of the herbivore is, in comparison, far more edible , smellwise.
examples.zh: 相对地，食草动物的肉闻起来要好些，更易食用。

examples.en: I only eat vegetables (scientists call me a herbivore) -- almost always leaves from the tops of trees.
examples.zh: 我只吃蔬菜(科学家称我为草食动物)—几乎常常是树梢的叶子。

examples.en: You probably would call me a vegetarian. But scientists call me a herbivore because I only eat leaves, grass and other plants.
examples.zh: 可能你会说我是素食者，但科学家称我为草食动物，因为我只吃叶子、草和其它植物。

words.definition: an upright post of wood with another crossing it near the top, that people in the past were fastened to with nails and left to die on as a punishment; if two or more roads, lines, etc cross, or if one crosses another, they go across each other; intersection, chiasm; intercross; bridge over; contrary, adverse, opposite, counter
words.translation: 十字,交叉；使交叉,横过；交叉，十字；十字架，十字形物；交叉；[遗][农学]杂交；横过；渡过；使相交；交叉的，相反的；乖戾的

examples.en: The by-pass crosses Wilton Lane shortly after a roundabout.
examples.zh: 这条旁道绕过环岛后不久就和威尔顿巷相交。

words.definition: an extremely violent storm consisting of air that spins very quickly and causes a lot of damage; cyclone, Tornado Jockey
words.translation: 龙卷风；[气象]龙卷风；旋风；暴风；大雷雨

examples.en: The tornado rubbished the whole village.
examples.zh: 龙卷风毁掉了整个村庄。

examples.en: The tornado disrupted broadcasting along the entire coast.
examples.zh: 龙卷风使整个沿海的广播都中断了。

examples.en: The tornado is coming, so we had better batten down the hatches here and get to the cellar.
examples.zh: 龙卷风即将来临，因此我们最好把这里的舱口封上，到地下室去。

words.definition: a metallic noise sounds like pieces of metal hitting each other; metal bearing
words.translation: 金属(性)的；金属的，含金属的

examples.en: The key turned in the lock with a loud metallic click.
examples.zh: 钥匙在锁里转动发出金属撞击的咔嗒声。

examples.en: The pans made a metallic clatter as they crashed to the floor.
examples.zh: 那些锅哐啷一声摔到地上。

words.definition: ceaseless, unceasing; aloud, ringingly
words.translation: 高声的,大声地；大声的，高声的；不断的；喧吵的；大声地，高声地，响亮地

words.definition: a pipe that carries water or waste liquids away; discharge of water; exhaust, use out; consumption, sewage
words.translation: 排水,消耗；排水；流干；喝光，耗尽；使流出；排掉水；下水道，[建]排水管；消耗

examples.en: The flood was caused by a blocked drain .
examples.zh: 溢水是由排水管堵塞引起的。

examples.en: There’s a problem with the drains .
examples.zh: 下水道有问题。

words.definition: to know and understand something, or suddenly begin to understand it; come true, accomplish, carry out, fulfill, implement
words.translation: 认识到,了解；实现；认识到；了解；将某物卖得

examples.en: It took us a while to realize the extent of the tragedy.
examples.zh: 我们过了一段时间才意识到这场悲剧有多严重。

examples.en: It was only later that I realized my mistake.
examples.zh: 我到后来才认识到自己的错误。

words.definition: measuring only a short distance from the top to the bottom; low, flat, surface; bank, ford, decharge, shoaliness; shoal
words.translation: 浅的；肤浅的；[地理]浅滩；使变浅；变浅

examples.en: a shallow river
examples.zh: 浅河

examples.en: The lake is quite shallow.
examples.zh: 这湖很浅。

examples.en: the shallow end of the pool
examples.zh: 游泳池的浅水区

words.definition: an amount of something that is more than what is needed or used; residual, spare; remaining, residual, odd
words.translation: 剩余,过剩；[数]剩余；[贸易]顺差；[会计]盈余；[电子][经]过剩；[数][电子]剩余的；[经]过剩的

examples.en: Any surplus can be trimmed away.
examples.zh: 多出来的部分可以修剪掉。

words.definition: to discuss or think about something carefully; detect, probe into; probe into, search after
words.translation: 探险,探测；探索；探测；探险

examples.en: Management need to explore ways of improving office security.
examples.zh: 管理层需要探讨如何加强办事处的安全措施。

examples.en: I’m going to explore the possibility of a part-time job.
examples.zh: 我要好好想想兼职工作的可能性。

words.definition: to decide what group something belongs to; categorize, sort through
words.translation: 分类,分等；分类；分等

examples.en: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
examples.zh: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

examples.en: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
examples.zh: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

words.definition: if there is a possibility that something is true or that something will happen, it might be true or it might happen; probability, feasibility, potential, maybe, chance
words.translation: 可能性；可能发生的事物

examples.en: There’s always a possibility that he might go back to Seattle.
examples.zh: 他也许会回到西雅图去，这种可能性一直存在。

examples.en: the possibility of an enemy attack
examples.zh: 敌人进攻的可能性

examples.en: There was no possibility of changing the voting procedure.
examples.zh: 改变投票程序是不可能的。

words.definition: a long written story in which the characters and events are usually imaginary; patent, exquisite; story, fiction
words.translation: 小说,长篇故事；新奇的；异常的；小说

examples.en: a novel by Jane Austen
examples.zh: 简·奥斯丁的小说

examples.en: It took Vikram Seth three years to write his 1,349-page novel ‘A Suitable Boy’.
examples.zh: 维克拉姆·塞斯花费三年时间写成了他那部1,349页的小说《如意郎君》。

words.definition: to provide something or allow something to happen; allow, deal, extend, deliver, tender
words.translation: 提供,给予；给予，提供；买得起

examples.en: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
examples.zh: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

examples.en: The new law will afford protection to employees.
examples.zh: 新法律将为雇员提供保障。

words.definition: the direction that is exactly between south and east
words.translation: 东南(的)

examples.en: It shook buildings as far away as Galveston, 90 miles to the southeast.
examples.zh: 它震动了东南方向90英里远的加尔维斯顿的建筑物。

words.definition: measuring only a small distance from one side to the other, especially in relation to the length; to make something narrower or to become narrower; nice, limited, finite, exact, precision; neck, channel, sound; straiten
words.translation: 狭窄(隘)的,勉强的；变窄,压缩；狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的；海峡；狭窄部分，隘路；变窄

examples.en: The stairs were very narrow.
examples.zh: 楼梯非常狭窄。

examples.en: a long, narrow band of cloud
examples.zh: 窄长的云带

words.definition: the direction that is exactly between north and west
words.translation: 西北方(的)

examples.en: ...four miles to the northwest.
examples.zh: …西北方向4英里。

words.definition: an accident in which two or more people or vehicles hit each other while moving in different directions; interference, conflict, war, crash, impact
words.translation: 碰撞,冲突；[物]碰撞；冲突

examples.en: Two people were killed in a head-on collision (= between two vehicles that are moving directly towards each other ) on highway 218.
examples.zh: 218号公路上有两辆汽车迎面相撞，两人死亡。

words.definition: one of the two organs in your body that you breathe with; breathing apparatus, respirator
words.translation: 肺,呼吸器；[解剖]肺；呼吸器

examples.en: Smoking can cause lung cancer.
examples.zh: 吸烟会引起肺癌。

words.definition: Diverse people or things are very different from each other; different, unlike, varying, another, dissimilar
words.translation: 不同的,变化多的；不同的；多种多样的；变化多的

examples.en: Albert Jones' new style will inevitably put him in touch with a much more diverse and perhaps younger audience.
examples.zh: 艾伯特·琼斯的新风格无疑将使他接触更多形形色色的、或许更年轻的观众。

words.definition: behaviour that is temperate is calm and sensible; pacific, moderate, gentle, soft, mild
words.translation: 温和的,适度的,有节制的；温和的；适度的；有节制的

examples.en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
examples.zh: 尼罗河流域全年气候温和。

words.definition: existing or happening in many places or situations, or among many people; extensive, universal, comprehensive, ruling, generalized
words.translation: 分布广泛的,普遍的；普遍的，广泛的；分布广的

examples.en: the widespread use of chemicals in agriculture
examples.zh: 化学品在农业中的广泛使用

words.definition: one of the possible different forms of an atom of a particular  element; isotopic element
words.translation: 同位素；[核]同位素

examples.en: ...tritium, a radioactive isotope of hydrogen.
examples.zh: ...氚，氢的一种放射性同位素。

words.definition: to notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear etc; explore, perceive
words.translation: 察觉,侦查,发现；察觉；发现；探测

examples.en: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
examples.zh: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

words.definition: in spite of a fact that you have just mentioned; though, natheless; whereas, however, while, but, yet
words.translation: 尽管如此；然而,不过；然而，不过；虽然如此

examples.en: What you said was true. It was, nevertheless, a little unkind.
examples.zh: 你说的都是实话，只不过有点刻薄。

words.definition: the grain that bread is made from, or the plant that it grows on; triticum aestivum, trigo
words.translation: 小麦；[作物]小麦；小麦色

examples.en: a field of wheat
examples.zh: 小麦地

words.definition: the time when something or someone is best, greatest, highest, most successful etc; height, sky, summit, mount, crown; cock; slim down; highest, supreme, maximum, top, tallest
words.translation: 山顶,顶点；山峰；最高点；顶点；[服装]帽舌；使达到最高点；使竖起；消瘦；到达最高点；变憔悴；最高的；最大值的

examples.en: Sales this month have reached a new peak .
examples.zh: 本月的销售额创了新高。

examples.en: Most athletes reach their peak in their mid 20s.
examples.zh: 大多数运动员在25岁左右达到巅峰状态。

examples.en: He’s past his peak as a tennis player.
examples.zh: 作为网球运动员他已过了巅峰期。

words.definition: drawing-room, foreroom
words.translation: 客厅,会客室；客厅；会客室；业务室

examples.en: I thought maybe Grandpa came over and sat around the den or parlor or whatever for years before he proposed.
examples.zh: 我以前以为奶奶来到爷爷家，坐在私室或客厅或什么地方几年，然后爷爷才求婚的。

words.definition: to sail along a river or other area of water; man, drive, guide; put, sail
words.translation: 航行,航海；驾驶，操纵；使通过；航行于；航行，航空

examples.en: The river is too dangerous to navigate.
examples.zh: 这河道太危险，不适宜航行。

words.definition: if someone or something has a tendency to do or become a particular thing, they are likely to do or become it; liability, trend, direction, tide, set
words.translation: 趋向,倾向；倾向，趋势；癖好

examples.en: children with aggressive or anti-social tendencies
examples.zh: 具有攻击性倾向或反社会倾向的儿童

words.definition: to develop well and be successful; health, display; air, sport; succeed, flower, thrive
words.translation: 繁荣,茂盛；兴旺；茂盛；挥舞；炫耀；华饰；夸耀；繁荣，兴旺；活跃；处于旺盛时期

examples.en: The economy is booming and small businesses are flourishing.
examples.zh: 经济繁荣，小企业蒸蒸日上。

words.definition: to see someone doing something that they did not want you to know they were doing; realize, affect, grasp, contract, communicate; get up to, make it to; haul
words.translation: 捕获,抓住；赶上；抓住；感染；了解；捕捉；捕获物；窗钩

examples.en: He was caught red-handed (= as he was doing something wrong ) taking money from the cash register.
examples.zh: 他从现金出纳机偷钱时被当场抓住。

words.definition: relating to the way in which plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time; growing, developmental, changing
words.translation: 进化的,发展的,演变的；进化的；发展的；渐进的

examples.en: the evolutionary development of birds
examples.zh: 鸟类的进化过程

examples.en: Some scientists have rejected evolutionary theory.
examples.zh: 有些科学家拒绝接受进化论。

words.definition: one of a set of small, usually round, pieces of glass, wood, plastic etc, that you can put on a string and wear as jewellery; drop, gutta; foam formation
words.translation: 珠子,水珠；珠子；滴；念珠；形成珠状，起泡

examples.en: She wore a string of green glass beads around her neck.
examples.zh: 她脖子上戴着一串绿色的玻璃珠子。

words.definition: adaptability, modifiability
words.translation: 可变性；[生物][数]可变性，变化性；变异性

examples.en: Operations and parameters variability—You can parameterize operations and parameters at the interface definition level.
examples.zh: 操作和参数可变性——您可以在接口定义级别参数化操作和参数。

examples.en: Therefore we need to provide variability in the data layer so we can store the nationality of the customer for one bank but not require it for the other.
examples.zh: 因此，我们需要在数据层中提供可变性，以便能够为一家银行存储客户国籍，但另一家银行却不需要如此。

words.definition: an engine or motor in which the pressure of a liquid or gas moves a special wheel around
words.translation: 涡轮

examples.en: The new ship will be powered by two gas turbines and four diesel engines.
examples.zh: 那艘新轮船将由2台燃气涡轮机和4台柴油机驱动。

words.definition: relatively high ground; height, raise, altitude, elevation, rise; upland
words.translation: 高地,丘陵地带；[地理]高地；丘陵地带；高原的；[地理]高地的

examples.en: Once an isolated highland, it has been the home shared by people of more than 10 nationalities, with pure blue sky, clear and beautiful lake as well as the legendary matriarchal community.
examples.zh: 这里曾是与世界隔离的地方，一个10多个民族混居的地方。 有高原上湛蓝纯净的天空，清澈美丽的湖水，还有传说中的母系社会。

examples.en: There are a number of Highland Games held through the highlands Scotland.
examples.zh: 有大量的高地游戏存在于苏格兰的丘陵地带。

words.definition: the flesh of animals and birds eaten as food; flesh, carne
words.translation: (食用)肉,肉类；[食品]肉，肉类（食用）

examples.zh: 我几个月以前开始不吃肉了。

examples.en: raw meat
examples.zh: 生肉

examples.en: a meat pie
examples.zh: 肉馅饼

words.definition: if one thing matches another, or if two things match, they look attractive together because they are a similar colour, pattern etc; equal, rival; suit, balance; competition, game, tournament, play, contest

examples.en: We painted the cabinets green to match the rug.
examples.zh: 我们把柜子刷成绿色，和地毯相配。

examples.en: Do you think this outfit matches?
examples.zh: 你认为这套衣服配吗？

examples.en: a beech dining table with four chairs to match (= chairs that match it )
examples.zh: 配有四把椅子的山毛榉餐桌

words.definition: a person, building, tree etc that is tall is a greater height than normal; high, excessive, ultra, long, lofty; large, big
words.translation: 高的,长的；高的；长的；过分的；夸大的；夸大地

examples.en: He was young and tall.
examples.zh: 他年轻，身材高大。

examples.en: a house surrounded by tall trees
examples.zh: 大树环绕的房子

examples.en: This bush grows tall very quickly.
examples.zh: 这种灌木很快就能长高。

words.definition: to exchange information or conversation with other people, using words, signs, writing etc; contract, intercommunicate; affect, catch, contract, convey
words.translation: 沟通,通信,传达；通讯，传达；相通；感染；传达；显露

examples.en: We communicated mostly by e-mail.
examples.zh: 我们主要是用电子邮件沟通。

words.definition: to share things among a group of people, especially in a planned way; portion, part, spread
words.translation: 分发,分配；分配；散布；分开；把…分类

examples.en: a man distributing leaflets to passers-by
examples.zh: 一个向路人派发传单的男子

words.definition: the comparative form of an adjective or adverb shows an increase in size, quality, degree etc when it is considered in relation to something else. For example, ‘bigger’ is the comparative form of ‘big’, and ‘more slowly’ is the comparative form of ‘slowly’.; corresponding, condign; equal, opponent, match, rival
words.translation: 比较的,相当的；比较的；相当的；比较级；对手

examples.en: After a lifetime of poverty, his last few years were spent in comparable comfort.
examples.zh: 他穷了一辈子，最后几年还算过得比较舒适。

words.definition: recently, of late, last
words.translation: 重新,最近；最近；重新；以新的方式

words.definition: to crush grain, pepper etc in a mill; factory, plant, work; mix round, churn up
words.translation: 碾磨,搅拌；[工经]工厂；磨坊；[化工][粮食][机]磨粉机；制造厂；压榨机；搅拌；[机]碾磨；磨细；使乱转

examples.en: All our flours are milled using traditional methods.
examples.zh: 我们所有的面粉全是用传统方法碾磨的。

examples.en: Add some freshly milled black pepper.
examples.zh: 加一些现磨的黑胡椒粉。

words.definition: not directly caused by something; circular, consequential
words.translation: 间接的,迂回的；[试验]间接的；迂回的；非直截了当的

examples.en: Losing weight is an indirect result of smoking cigarettes.
examples.zh: 吸烟间接导致体重减轻。

examples.en: The indirect effects of climate change may be profound.
examples.zh: 气候变化造成的间接影响可能是深远的。

words.definition: to prevent someone from doing something or something from happening; cheese, quit; remain, desist from; visit, bar, stay, obstacle, dam
words.translation: 停止,阻止；停止；堵塞；断绝；中止；逗留；被塞住；[交]车站；障碍

examples.en: The government tried to stop publication of the book.
examples.zh: 政府企图阻止这本书出版。

examples.en: I’m leaving now, and you can’t stop me.
examples.zh: 我现在就要走了，你阻止不了我。

words.definition: the act or process of destroying something or of being destroyed; breaking, death, blasting, disruption, demolition
words.translation: 破坏,毁灭；破坏，毁灭；摧毁

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["weapons of mass destruction"]}
examples.zh: 大规模杀伤性武器

examples.en: the environmental destruction caused by the road building programme
examples.zh: 筑路工程造成的环境破坏

examples.en: The floods brought death and destruction to the area.
examples.zh: 洪水给该地区带来了死亡和破坏。

words.definition: client, apple, consumer, fellow, egg
words.translation: 消费者；[贸易]顾客；家伙

words.definition: quickly and unexpectedly; sharp, abruptly
words.translation: 突然地；忽然

examples.en: I suddenly realized that there was someone following me.
examples.zh: 我突然意识到有人跟着我。

examples.en: George died very suddenly.
examples.zh: 乔治死得非常突然。
