words.translation: 确立,制定；确立，制定；公司；设施

words.definition: the leaves and branches of trees, that make a kind of roof in a forest; baldachin, marquee; blot out, overcurtain
words.translation: 天篷,遮篷；天篷；[建]华盖；遮篷；苍穹；用天蓬遮盖；遮盖

examples.en: the forest canopy
examples.zh: 森林的树冠层

words.definition: to move earth, snow etc, or to make a hole in the ground, using a  spade  or your hands; tunnel, pick; tap into; spine, thrust
words.translation: 挖；挖，掘；探究；挖掘；戳，刺；挖苦

examples.en: freshly dug carrots
examples.zh: 刚挖出来的胡萝卜

words.definition: the amount of energy, oil, electricity etc that is used; expense, depletion
words.translation: 消费；[经]消费；消耗；肺痨

examples.en: Vigorous exercise increases oxygen consumption.
examples.zh: 剧烈运动增加氧的消耗。

words.definition: a lake, especially an artificial one, where water is stored before it is supplied to people’s houses; artificial lake
words.translation: 水库,蓄水池；[水利]水库；蓄水池

examples.en: All these earthquakes happened when the water level in Zipingpu reservoir was low.
examples.zh: 所有这些地震都发生在紫坪铺水库水位很低的时候。

words.definition: a piece of writing or speech that gives details about what someone or something is like; presentation, type, style, characterization
words.translation: 描写,记述；描述，描写；类型；说明书

examples.en: The booklet gives a brief description of each place.
examples.zh: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

examples.en: Berlin sounds fascinating from your description.
examples.zh: 从你的描述来看，柏林是个迷人的城市。

words.definition: one of the small holes in your skin that liquid, especially  sweat  , can pass through, or a similar hole in the surface of a plant; consider, stare at; stomates, stigmata
words.translation: 小孔；细想；凝视；熟读；[陶瓷]气孔

examples.en: The size of your pores is determined by the amount of oil they produce.
examples.zh: 毛孔的大小取决于毛孔分泌油脂的多少。

words.definition: the way the parts of a machine or system work together, or the process of making a machine or system work; work, manipulation
words.translation: 运转,操作,实施；操作；[贸易]经营；[外科]手术；[数][计]运算

examples.en: The aircraft’s engine operation was normal.
examples.zh: 飞机引擎运转正常。

examples.en: The device has a single button, allowing for easy operation.
examples.zh: 这个装置只有一个按钮，操作简便。

examples.en: Careful checks must be made before the factory commences operation.
examples.zh: 工厂开始运营之前必须进行仔细检查。

words.definition: to make light or a shadow appear somewhere; throw, pitch, mould, figure; putting, throw; figure, shy
words.translation: 投, 抛；投，抛；计算；[印刷]浇铸；投射（光、影、视线等）；投掷，抛；[机]铸件，[古生]铸型；演员阵容；脱落物；投，抛垂钓鱼钩；计算，把几个数字加起来

examples.en: the shade cast by low-hanging branches
examples.zh: 低垂的树枝投下的阴影

words.definition: spoken, not written; spoken, verbal, word-of-mouth; viva voce
words.translation: 口头的；[药][解剖]口头的，口述的；口试

examples.en: oral history
examples.zh: 口述的历史

examples.en: an oral agreement
examples.zh: 口头协议

words.definition: the conditions that affect a situation, action, event etc; context, situation, setting, event, occurrence, thing, scene
words.translation: 环境,详情,境况；环境，情况；事件；境遇

examples.en: The Soviet Union had been forced by circumstances to sign a pact with Nazi Germany.
examples.zh: 苏联为形势所迫同纳粹德国签订了一项条约。

examples.en: I can’t imagine a circumstance in which I would be willing to steal.
examples.zh: 我无法想象我在什么情况下会愿意去偷东西。

words.definition: a type of potassium used especially in farming to make the soil better; potassium carbonate
words.translation: 碳酸钾,苛性钾；[无化]碳酸钾；草碱；苛性钾；钾化合物

words.definition: severe problems, injuries, illnesses etc are very bad or very serious; tight, hard, smart, harsh, rigorous
words.translation: 严厉的,剧烈的,严重的；严峻的；严厉的；剧烈的；苛刻的

examples.en: His injuries were quite severe.
examples.zh: 他的伤势很严重。

examples.en: She’s suffering from severe depression.
examples.zh: 她患有严重的抑郁症。

examples.en: The US faces severe economic problems.
examples.zh: 美国面临严重的经济问题。

words.definition: a machine that has been sent into space and goes around the Earth, moon etc, used for radio, television, and other electronic communication; moon, suite
words.translation: 人造卫星；[天]卫星；[航]人造卫星；随从；卫星国家

examples.en: the launch of a communications and weather satellite
examples.zh: 气象通信卫星的发射

words.definition: problems or difficulties; worry, fault, headache; harry, worry, tear; worry, bother about
words.translation: 烦恼,麻烦；麻烦；烦恼；故障；动乱；使烦恼；折磨；费心，烦恼

examples.en: Recent stock market losses point to trouble ahead.
examples.zh: 最近股市的下跌预示着未来将有麻烦。

words.definition: a strong thread made of several threads twisted together, used for tying or fastening things; to be spread out in a line; thread, linea; spread, pink
words.translation: 线；排成一列；线，细绳；一串，一行；扎，缚；使排成一列，串起；伸展，拉直

examples.en: Her key hung on a string around her neck.
examples.zh: 她的钥匙穿了根绳子挂在脖子上。

examples.en: a ball of string
examples.zh: 一团细绳

examples.en: I need a piece of string to tie this package.
examples.zh: 我需要一根绳子来捆这个包裹。

words.definition: someone whose job is to design buildings
words.translation: 建筑师

examples.en: But I am an architect.
examples.zh: 但是我是一名建筑师。

examples.en: They commissioned an architect to design the new library.
examples.zh: 他们委托一位建筑师设计这座新图书馆。

examples.en: The building was constructed from the design of that architect.
examples.zh: 这幢大楼是按那位建筑师的设计建造的。

words.definition: An exhibitor is a person or company whose work or products are being shown in an exhibition
words.translation: 展出者,显示者

examples.en: Schedules will be sent out to all exhibitors.
examples.zh: 日程安排将会发送给所有的参展者。

words.definition: belonging to a traditional style or set of ideas; traditional, conventional, royal; classic music
words.translation: 古典的,正统派的；古典的；经典的；传统的；第一流的；古典音乐

examples.en: the classical theory of relativity
examples.zh: 经典相对论

words.definition: to remove an object from somewhere, especially with difficulty; a short piece of writing, music etc taken from a particular book, piece of music etc; abstract, milk, pop; juice, succus
words.translation: 取出,提取；摘录；提取；取出；[图情]摘录；榨取；汁；[化学][药][化工]榨出物；选粹

examples.en: You’ll have to have that tooth extracted.
examples.zh: 你得把那颗牙拔掉。

words.definition: not any amount of something or not one of a group of people or things; lacking, void of; nothing, noway
words.translation: 决不,毫不；一个也没有；没有的，一点没有的；决不，一点也不

examples.en: I wish I could offer you some cake but there’s none left.
examples.zh: 我真想能请你吃些蛋糕，但一点也没剩的了。

examples.en: Although these were good students, none had a score above 60.
examples.zh: 虽然这些都是好学生，但是没有一个考到60分以上。

examples.en: She waited for a reply, but none came.
examples.zh: 她等着答复，可是什么也没等到。

words.definition: stipulation, covenant; close, brief
words.translation: 使坚实；契约；合同，契约；小粉盒；[数]紧凑的，紧密的；简洁的

words.definition: if you undergo a change, an unpleasant experience etc, it happens to you or is done to you; experience, stand, stomach, tough, abide
words.translation: 经历,遭受；经历，经受；忍受

examples.en: The country has undergone massive changes recently.
examples.zh: 这个国家最近经历了巨大的变化。

examples.en: He has been released from prison to undergo medical treatment in the United States.
examples.zh: 他获释出狱去美国接受治疗。

examples.en: She has been undergoing tests since Monday.
examples.zh: 她从星期一开始一直在接受各种检查。

words.definition: easily broken or damaged; delicate, crumbly
words.translation: 易碎的,脆的；脆的；易碎的

examples.en: Be careful with that vase – it’s very fragile.
examples.zh: 小心那只花瓶——很容易打碎的。

examples.en: fragile bones
examples.zh: 脆弱的骨头

words.definition: a duty to be in charge of someone or something, so that you make decisions and can be blamed if something bad happens
words.translation: 责任,职责

examples.en: Kelly’s promotion means more money and more responsibility.
examples.zh: 凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

words.definition: to make something seem better, larger, worse etc than it really is; enlarge, broaden; put it on, pile it on
words.translation: 夸大,夸张；使扩大；使增大；夸大；夸张

examples.en: I couldn’t sleep for three days – I’m not exaggerating.
examples.zh: 我三天没睡觉了——一点不夸张。

words.definition: the amount of goods or work produced by a person, machine, factory etc; export, crop, harvest, yield; export, bulk out
words.translation: 产量,输出；[计]输出，输出量；[经]产量；出产；[计]输出

examples.en: Output is up 30% on last year.
examples.zh: 产量比去年提高了30%。

words.definition: a very tall modern city building
words.translation: 摩天楼

examples.en: The skyscraper towers into the clouds.
examples.zh: 那幢摩天大楼高耸入云。

examples.en: The majesty of the skyscraper awed me .
examples.zh: 这幢摩天大厦的雄伟气势令我惊叹。

examples.en: Suddenly, a top needle of a skyscraper is pressing toward him. He fails to dodge and bumps heavily on the concrete needle.
examples.zh: 突然，一座摩天大厦的尖型顶柱朝他逼来，他躲避不及，重重地撞在混凝土顶柱上。

words.definition: one of the parts of a bird’s or insect’s body that it uses for flying; to fly somewhere; ala, faction; lift, air transportation; to fly, fly away
words.translation: 翅膀；飞过；[天]翼；[昆]翅膀；飞翔；派别；使飞；空运；增加…速度；装以翼；飞行

examples.en: a butterfly with beautiful markings on its wings
examples.zh: 翅膀上有美丽花纹的蝴蝶

examples.en: The pheasant flapped its wings vigorously.
examples.zh: 野鸡猛烈地拍打翅膀。

words.definition: an illness which affects a person, animal, or plant; illness, ill, sickness, complaint; to infect
words.translation: 疾病；[医]病，疾病；弊病；传染；使…有病

examples.en: His father died of heart disease.
examples.zh: 他父亲死于心脏病。

examples.en: She contracted the disease while she was abroad on holiday.
examples.zh: 她在国外度假时染上了这种疾病。

words.definition: to try to prevent a change from happening, or prevent yourself from being forced to do something; hit back, stick up to; tough, hit back; reserving agent
words.translation: 抵抗,反抗；抵抗，[法]抗拒；忍耐；抵抗；忍耐，忍住；[助剂]抗蚀剂；防染剂

examples.en: He resisted pressure to resign.
examples.zh: 他顶住压力，没辞职。

words.definition: to be the best or most successful in a competition, game, election etc; purchase, bear off; arrive, make good; victory, success
words.translation: (获)胜,赢得；赢得；在…中获胜；劝诱；赢；获胜；成功；胜利

examples.en: Who’s winning (= who is most successful at this point in the game )?
examples.zh: 现在谁领先？

words.definition: a change in a price, amount, level etc; wave, undulation
words.translation: 波动,起伏；[海洋]起伏，[电子][物]波动

examples.en: Prices are subject to fluctuation.
examples.zh: 价格可能会有波动。

words.definition: if a place, situation, or thing breeds a particular type of person, it produces that type; a type of animal that is kept as a pet or on a farm; increase, result; attract, keep, school, cause, mother; category, variety, manner, nature, description
words.translation: 教养,抚养；品种；繁殖；饲养；产生；养育，教育；引起；[生物]品种；种类，类型

examples.en: Society’s obsession with sex has bred a generation of unhappy children.
examples.zh: 纵欲的社会生养了一代不幸的儿童。

words.definition: one of the owners of a business; comrade, associate; joint stock, tie up; team
words.translation: 合伙人；伙伴；[法]合伙人；配偶；[法]合伙；合股；成为搭档；使合作；与…合伙

examples.en: She’s a partner in a law firm.
examples.zh: 她是一家律师事务所的合伙人。

examples.en: The senior partner has retired.
examples.zh: 高级合伙人退休了。

words.definition: a situation in which two or more people disagree, often angrily; brush, reasoning, dispute
words.translation: 争论；论证；论据；争吵；内容提要

examples.en: We need to provide a convincing argument as to why the system should be changed.
examples.zh: 我们得提出有说服力的论据，证明为何要改变体制。

words.definition: to find or provide a way of dealing with a problem; decide, settle, resolve, do, work out
words.translation: 解决,解答；解决；解答；溶解

examples.en: Charlie thinks money will solve all his problems.
examples.zh: 查理认为钱能解决他所有的问题。

examples.en: the best way of solving our dilemma
examples.zh: 解决我们两难处境的最佳办法

words.definition: a structure made of wires or bars in which birds or animals can be kept; prison, jail
words.translation: 笼；笼，兽笼；牢房，监狱

examples.en: I hate to see birds in cages.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢看到鸟在笼子里。

words.definition: a smooth soft rock which breaks easily into thin flat pieces; clayslate
words.translation: 页岩,泥板岩；[岩]页岩；泥板岩

words.definition: the rate at which goods are produced, and the amount produced, especially in relation to the work, time, and money needed to produce them; fertility, productive forces
words.translation: 生产力；[经]生产率；生产能力

examples.en: high productivity levels in manufacturing
examples.zh: 制造业中的高生产率

examples.en: It cost the country $4 million in lost productivity .
examples.zh: 它对该国造成了400万美元的生产力损失。

words.definition: large objects such as chairs, tables, beds, and cupboards; equipment, facility, plant, suite, fixture
words.translation: 家具,设备；[家具]家具；设备；储藏物

examples.en: I helped him choose the furniture for his house.
examples.zh: 我帮他挑选房子里用的家具。

examples.en: I can’t think of a single piece of furniture in my house that I bought new.
examples.zh: 我想不出家里有哪件家具是新买的。

examples.en: office furniture
examples.zh: 办公室家具

words.definition: organized carefully and done thoroughly; scientific, classified
words.translation: 系统的,体系的；系统的；体系的；有系统的；[图情]分类的

examples.en: What about all other systematic knowledge?
examples.zh: 对于所有其他系统的知识呢？

examples.en: We need a systematic training program. First, we should do some flexibility exercises, and then I will customize a training program for you.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个系统的训练计划.先要做些适应性训练.然后我会为你量身制定一份训练计划.

words.definition: a quality or feature, especially one that is considered to be good or useful; particularity, idiosyncracy; ascribe to
words.translation: 属性,品质,特征；属性；特质；归属；把…归于

examples.en: What attributes should a good manager possess?
examples.zh: 一名优秀的经理应该具备哪些素质？

words.definition: a person or company that makes a particular type of goods; Creator, fabricant
words.translation: 制造者；[经]制造者；造物主；出期票人

examples.en: a leading Japanese computer maker
examples.zh: 日本一家主要的计算机生产商

words.definition: likely to change often; something that may be different in different situations, so that you cannot be sure what will happen; mobile, liquid, unstable
words.translation: 多变的,可变的；变量；[生物][数][光]变量的；可变的；易变的，多变的；变异的，畸变的

examples.en: Expect variable cloudiness and fog tomorrow.
examples.zh: 预计明天多云有雾，天气多变。

examples.en: Interest rates can be highly variable.
examples.zh: 利率有时会大幅波动。

words.definition: when something is kept in its original state or in good condition; conservation, hold, retention, reservation
words.translation: 保存；保存，保留

examples.en: methods of food preservation
examples.zh: 保存食物的各种方法

words.definition: to arrange for something important to start, such as an official process or a new plan; institute, start in; beginning, threshold, opening, conception, fresh
words.translation: 开始,发起；开始，创始；发起；使初步了解；开始；新加入者，接受初步知识者

examples.en: They have decided to initiate legal proceedings against the newspaper.
examples.zh: 他们决定向该报提起法律诉讼。

examples.en: Intellectuals have initiated a debate on terrorism.
examples.zh: 知识分子就恐怖主义发起了辩论。

words.definition: the meal you have in the morning; brekker, dejeuner
words.translation: 早餐 vi进早餐；早餐；早饭

examples.en: We had bacon and eggs for breakfast .
examples.zh: 我们早餐吃了熏肉鸡蛋。

examples.en: I never eat breakfast .
examples.zh: 我从来不吃早饭。

examples.en: After a hearty breakfast (=  large breakfast  ) , we set out for a hike.
examples.zh: 我们吃了一顿丰盛的早餐，然后出发去远足了。

words.definition: to notice, see, or recognize something; detect, feel, absorb, see, read; to feel, come to realize
words.translation: 察觉,感知；察觉，感觉；理解；认知；感到，感知；认识到

examples.en: That morning, he perceived a change in Franca’s mood.
examples.zh: 那天早上，他注意到弗兰卡情绪的变化。

examples.en: Cats are not able to perceive colour.
examples.zh: 猫不能辨别颜色。

words.definition: to make someone feel certain that something is true; assure, reason, satisfy, argue
words.translation: 使确信, 使信服；说服；使确信，使信服

examples.en: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
examples.zh: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

words.definition: determined or trying very hard to be more successful than other people or businesses; played, rival
words.translation: 竞争的；比赛的；求胜心切的

examples.en: Some US industries are not as competitive as they have been in the past.
examples.zh: 美国有些行业不如以前有竞争力了。

examples.en: The team seems to have lost its competitive edge recently (= its ability to compete well ) .
examples.zh: 这支球队近来好像丧失了竞争优势。

words.definition: an object or piece of information that helps someone solve a crime or mystery; action, plot, scenario
words.translation: 线索；（故事等的）情节

examples.en: Police have found a vital clue .
examples.zh: 警方发现了至关重要的线索。

examples.en: Archaeological evidence will provide clues about what the building was used for.
examples.zh: 考古证据将为这幢建筑的用途提供线索。

examples.en: a desperate search for clues
examples.zh: 拼命寻找线索

words.definition: worried or frightened about something, and unable to relax; neural, jittery
words.translation: 紧张的,不安的；[解剖]神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的

examples.en: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
examples.zh: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

examples.en: By the time I got into the interview I was a nervous wreck (= was extremely nervous ).
examples.zh: 到了面试的时候，我紧张得要命。

words.definition: to calculate the total number of things or people in a group; figure, expect, guess, find, feel; calculation, computation, valuation
words.translation: 数,计算；计算；认为；[数]计数；伯爵

examples.en: I was amazed at the number of plants - I counted 147.
examples.zh: 我对植物的数量之多感到惊讶，我数了有147棵。

words.definition: to change or move something slightly to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose; regulate, coordinate, frame, restructure; correct, adapt to something
words.translation: 调整,校准；调整，使…适合；校准；调整，校准；适应

examples.en: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
examples.zh: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

examples.en: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning.
examples.zh: 尝尝汤的味道，然后调整佐料用量。

examples.en: If your employment status changes, your tax code will be adjusted accordingly.
examples.zh: 如果就业状况改变，你的免税代码也会作相应调整。

words.definition: something that tests strength, skill, or ability, especially in a way that is interesting; dare, doubt
words.translation: 挑战；怀疑

examples.en: They threw down the challenge that he couldn’t wash 40 cars in one hour (= invited him to try to do it ) .
examples.zh: 他们激将他，说他不可能在1小时内擦洗40辆汽车。

words.definition: extremely excited or nervous about something; high-strung; publicist
words.translation: 亢奋的,高度紧张的；亢奋的；高度紧张的；宣传人员

examples.en: No, don’t give Luke any candy - it’ll make him hyper.
examples.zh: 不，别给卢克糖果，不然他会起劲折腾的。

words.definition: to completely get rid of something that is unnecessary or unwanted; avoid, exclude
words.translation: 排除,除去；消除；排除

examples.en: Recent measures have not eliminated discrimination in employment.
examples.zh: 最近的举措还未能根除就业歧视。

words.definition: rabbitry

examples.zh: 正如一位当地居民在五月份对它的描述”白天有政府。

examples.zh: 一位居民说：“我觉得我们应该把遗嘱写在纸上或者告诉给自己的家人。

examples.zh: 她以前的同志，很少人能享受能这种舒适生活；不过另一个居民解释说，当局希望他们住在那以“进行宣传教育工作”。

words.definition: a hole or pipe through which gases, liquid etc can enter or escape from an enclosed space or container; to express feelings of anger, hatred etc, especially by doing something violent or harmful; exit, way out; relieve one's feelings; reel out, let off

words.definition: a long stick or post usually made of wood or metal, often set upright in the ground to support something; electrode, climax
words.translation: 柱,地极；[建]杆；极点；电极

examples.zh: 电话线杆

words.definition: the process of keeping or putting something in a special place while it is not being used; warehouse, repository
words.translation: 贮藏(量),存储；[计]存储；[建][经]仓库；[贸易]贮藏所

examples.zh: 高放射性材料的存放

words.definition: someone who gives money to a company, business, or bank in order to get a profit; moneyman
words.translation: 投资者；[经]投资者

examples.zh: 该项目的主要投资方是法国国民信贷银行。

words.definition: to make something unpleasant begin; weak, discursive; deliver, free, fire; fluff; emission, sending, shot, launch, projection
words.translation: 解放,放任；弄松, 释放；宽松的；散漫的；不牢固的；不精确的；释放；开船；放枪；变松；开火；放纵；放任；发射

examples.zh: 现在，玛吉所害怕的怒火发泄出来了。

words.translation: 过错；错过,遗漏；漏掉；错过；想念

examples.en: I don't want to miss seeing that film on television tonight.
examples.zh: 我不想错过今晚在电视上看那部影片的机会。

examples.en: I never miss a chance of playing football.
examples.zh: 我从来不错过踢足球的机会。

words.definition: increasing to a higher level; If someone moves or looks upward, they move or look up towards a higher place; upgrade, rising, up, climbing; up, zenithward
words.translation: 向上的；以上；上升的；向上

examples.zh: 针对银行利率的越来越大的压力

examples.zh: 他们沿着环绕村庄的陡峭悬崖向上爬。

examples.en: 'There,' said Jack, pointing upwards.
examples.zh: “那儿，”杰克往上指着说。

words.definition: related to language, words, or linguistics; glottic, philologic
words.translation: 语言(学)上的；语言的；语言学的

examples.en: a child’s linguistic development
examples.zh: 儿童的语言发展

words.definition: belonging to a simple way of life that existed in the past and does not have modern industries and machines; original, simple, crude, plain, rough; Euroman
words.translation: 原始的,远古的；[数][生物][地质]原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的；[数][生物][地质]原始人

examples.en: a primitive society
examples.zh: 原始社会

examples.en: a primitive nomadic tribe
examples.zh: 原始的游牧部落

examples.en: the tools used by primitive man
examples.zh: 原始人所用的工具

words.definition: a particular type of clothing worn by all the members of a group or organization such as the police, the army etc; united, consistent, corresponding, matching, same; monkey suit, livery
words.translation: 制服；使统一；统一的；一致的；相同的；均衡的；始终如一的；[服装]制服

examples.en: The police wear dark blue uniforms.
examples.zh: 警察穿深蓝色制服。

words.definition: the ability to see; sight, imagination, eye, seeing, eyesight; image, envision
words.translation: 幻想,视觉；[生理][眼科]视力；美景；眼力；幻象；想象力；想象；显现；梦见

examples.en: She suffered temporary loss of vision after being struck on the head.
examples.zh: 她头部受撞击以后出现暂时性失明。

examples.en: Tears blurred her vision (= made it difficult for her to see ).
examples.zh: 泪水模糊了她的视线。

words.definition: to touch something lightly while passing it, sometimes damaging it; grass, feed, raw, range; brush burn; pasturage

examples.zh: 一颗子弹擦过他的手臂。

words.translation: 黄瓜；[园艺]黄瓜；胡瓜

examples.zh: 黄瓜管"是他们的经典乐器之一,那是用掏空的黄瓜、辣椒和胡萝卜做的。

examples.en: The salmon was brought to the table whole, garnished with parsley and slices of tomato and cucumber.
examples.zh: 整条大麻哈鱼被端上了桌，并用欧芹、西红柿片和黄瓜片作为花色配菜。

words.definition: something or someone that is not included in a general statement or does not follow a rule or pattern; dissention, demurral
words.translation: 除外,例外；例外；异议

examples.en: It’s been cold, but today’s an exception.
examples.zh: 天气一直寒冷，但今天是个例外。

examples.en: The law applies to all EU countries; Britain is no exception.
examples.zh: 这项法律适用于所有欧盟国家，英国也不例外。

examples.en: We don’t usually accept checks, but for you we’ll make an exception (= not include you in this rule ).
examples.zh: 我们一般不接受支票，但对你我们就破个例。

words.definition: having a lot of small parts or details put together in a complicated way; to give more details or new information about something; detailed, full; tailor-make; thicken

examples.zh: 绣有精美图案的真丝衣服

words.definition: a lack of success in achieving or doing something; loss, defeat, losing, fault, trouble
words.translation: 失败；故障；失败者；[经]破产

examples.zh: 一帆风顺的人往往不太擅长应对失败。

words.definition: a situation that is secure is one that you can depend on because it is not likely to change; to make something safe from being attacked, harmed, or lost; safe, certain; invite, court, preserve, spell; call it quits, place out of service

examples.en: There are no secure jobs these days.
examples.zh: 如今已经没有铁饭碗了。

examples.en: We want a secure future for our children.
examples.zh: 我们希望我们的孩子未来生活无虞。

examples.en: United’s position at the top of the league seems relatively secure.
examples.zh: 联队在联赛中的头名位置似乎相对稳固。

words.definition: a hole or container that has been specially made and filled with water so that people can swim or play in it; billiard ball
words.translation: 池；联营；撞球；水塘；共同资金

examples.zh: 他们后院有个漂亮的游泳池。

examples.en: a shallow pool suitable for children
examples.zh: 适合儿童的浅水池

words.definition: an event, situation etc that people do not understand or cannot explain because they do not know enough about it; secret, privacy, confidence
words.translation: 神秘,神秘的事物；神秘，秘密；奥秘；神秘的事物

examples.en: Twenty years after the event, his death remains a mystery .
examples.zh: 事情过去二十年了，他的死仍然是个谜。

examples.en: The way her mind worked was always a mystery to him.
examples.zh: 她脑子里在想些什么对他来说始终是个谜。

examples.en: ‘Why did he do it?’ ‘I don’t know. It’s a complete mystery .’
examples.zh: “他为什么这么做？” “我不知道，这完全是个谜。”

words.translation: 外套；涂上,包上

examples.zh: 比利！穿上外套，外面很冷！

examples.en: The kids took off their coats and threw them on the floor.
examples.zh: 孩子们脱下外套扔在地板上。

examples.en: I need a new winter coat .
examples.zh: 我需要一件新的冬衣。

examples.zh: 相对她的年龄来说劳拉是很成熟的。

examples.zh: 我们都很成熟，尽管我们对此事意见不同，但还是彼此尊重。

words.translation: 支撑,维持；维持；支撑，承担；忍受；供养；证实

examples.zh: 她发现很难保持孩子们的兴趣。

examples.zh: 他无法和女人维持亲密关系。

examples.zh: 维持经济增长必需的政策

examples.zh: 这些鸟在北纬地区繁殖。

examples.zh: 她自己一个人要招呼两个孩子的衣食。

examples.zh: 抛硬币决定谁先来。

words.translation: 新闻,消息；新闻，消息；新闻报导

examples.zh: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

words.translation: 土器,陶器；[陶瓷]陶器；土器

examples.zh: ...五颜六色的意大利瓷器和陶器。

words.translation: 拒绝；垃圾；[环境]废物；不愿；抵制

examples.zh: 她叫他走，但他不肯。

examples.zh: 他愿意给那么多钱，我怎么可能拒绝呢？

examples.zh: 他们的房子建在可以俯视大海的小山上。

examples.zh: 一辆马车正在爬上山丘。

words.translation: 四轮马车,货车；货车，[车辆]四轮马车

examples.zh: 殡葬仪式

examples.zh: 古代的生殖崇拜仪式

examples.zh: 这些传统仪式只由村里的女人来进行。

words.translation: 成就,功绩；成就；完成；达到

examples.zh: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

words.translation: 居住于,栖息；栖息；居住于；占据；（古）居住

examples.zh: 很多野生动物栖居在这片森林里。

examples.zh: 有人居住的岛屿

words.translation: 蝗虫；[植保]蝗虫，[昆]蚱蜢

examples.zh: 一大群蝗虫

examples.zh: 瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

words.translation: 统治,支配,管理；管理；支配；统治；控制

examples.zh: 治理这个国家的领导人

examples.zh: 该党执政已经有七个月了。

words.definition: the study of the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil, etc; Weltbild, Anschauung
words.translation: 哲学；哲理；人生观

examples.zh: 埃玛在大学攻读哲学。

words.translation: 耐久,忍耐；忍耐；容忍；持续

examples.zh: 似乎谁都不可能忍受这样的疼痛。

words.translation: 儿女,子孙；[生物]后代，子孙；产物

examples.zh: 一个想管住自己孩子的年轻妈妈

examples.zh: 他们已坐飞机到夏威夷度假去了。

examples.zh: 每年夏天我们都到夏威夷的海滨去冲浪。

examples.zh: 他们一致决定今年暑假去夏威夷。

examples.zh: 砖墙

examples.en: a house made of brick
examples.zh: 砖房

examples.zh: 抗议者用石头和砖块袭击警察。

words.definition: to change something into a different form, or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way; transform, shift; idolater, proselytizer

examples.zh: 由19世纪谷仓改建的房子

words.translation: 鸽子

examples.zh: 除了平淡乏味的报道，这儿的新闻记者将一切通过鸽子传递出去。

examples.zh: 顾名思义，鸽子式是一个很棘手的姿势，它对于我来说是最有挑战性的。

examples.zh: 开始时缓慢的前倾伸展和小腿伸展，然后摆出鸽子的姿势再是犁头的姿势。

words.definition: a famous living person; personality, lion, fame
words.translation: 名声,名人；名人；名声

examples.en: a sporting celebrity
examples.zh: 体育明星

examples.en: He’s a national celebrity.
examples.zh: 他是全国有名的人物。

examples.en: We invited a number of minor celebrities (= people who are not very famous ) .
examples.zh: 我们邀请了一些小有名气的人物。

words.definition: to plan or invent a new way of doing something; design, engineer, style, project, frame; legacy, bequest
words.translation: 设计,发明；设计；想出；发明；图谋；遗赠给；遗赠

examples.zh: 她想出一种加快办公室之间通信联络的方法。

examples.zh: 你应当与你的同事友好相处。

examples.zh: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

examples.zh: 香港是中国的领土。

words.translation: 互相作用,互相影响；幕间剧；幕间休息

examples.zh: 当其他孩子们相互交往、一起玩耍时，泰德却不理他们。

words.definition: a large area of sea partly enclosed by land; bay, deep, variance; engulf, swallow

examples.zh: 墨西哥湾

examples.zh: 用喷胶枪使木头或瓷器牢固地黏合起来。

examples.zh: 群镶钻戒

examples.zh: 像纤维、钙可以和脂肪分子结合，帮助他们彻底的通过肠道。

words.translation: 原始人类；人科动物

examples.en: A hominid is really any extinct ape more closely related to us than the chimpanzee.
examples.zh: 原始人类中任何一个灭绝的猿物种和我们的关系都比黑猩猩更密切。

examples.en: From one perspective, the development of a very small penis could be considered the next step in male hominid evolution.
examples.zh: 从这一角度看，在原始男性进化中，非常小阴茎的男人在下一步可能优先考虑发展。

examples.en: H. erectus is generally believed to be the direct ancestor of modern humans and also the first hominid to live in caves and tame fire.
examples.zh: 人们通常认为直立人是现代人的直接祖先，也是第一个生活在洞穴中和学会用火的原始人类。

words.definition: a special room or building in which a scientist does tests or prepares substances; lab
words.translation: 实验室；[试验][临床]实验室，研究室

examples.en: a research laboratory
examples.zh: 研究实验室

examples.en: tests on laboratory animals
examples.zh: 在实验室动物身上做的试验

words.definition: a building in which films are shown; film, motion picture
words.translation: 电影院,电影；[电影]电影；电影院；电影业，电影制作术

examples.en: It’s on at the local cinema.
examples.zh: 此片正在当地影院上映。

words.definition: an instrument that shows directions and has a needle that always points north; calliper, divider; case, invest, circumvent, encircle, ring about
words.translation: 罗盘,指南针；指南针，[航][水运]罗盘；圆规；包围

examples.en: a map and compass
examples.zh: 地图和指南针

words.definition: either of two oceanic gulls of the genus Rissa, esp R; sea mew, sea-gull
words.translation: 三趾鸥；海鸥（产于北冰洋和北大西洋）

words.definition: a particular way or style of behaving, living or doing something; way of, manner, pattern, fashion, style
words.translation: 方式,模式；模式；方式；风格；时尚

examples.en: Set the monitor to 256 colour mode.
examples.zh: 把显示器调成256色彩模式。

words.definition: things such as films, television, performances etc that are intended to amuse or interest people; recreation, pleasure, sport, occupation, amusement
words.translation: 款待,娱乐；娱乐；消遣；款待

examples.en: The town provides a wide choice of entertainment.
examples.zh: 该镇提供各式各样的娱乐活动。

examples.en: There will be live entertainment (= performed then, not recorded ) throughout the day.
examples.zh: 现场表演将持续一整天。

examples.en: The dolphins give good entertainment value (= a lot of amusement and interest ).
examples.zh: 海豚具有很高的娱乐价值。

words.definition: each thing or all things
words.translation: 每件事物

examples.en: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
examples.zh: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

examples.en: I decided to tell her everything.
examples.zh: 我决定把一切都告诉她。

examples.en: Apart from the bus arriving late, everything else seemed to be going according to plan.
examples.zh: 除了公共汽车晚点之外，其他一切似乎都在按计划进行。

words.definition: to buy something; buy, grip; buy, win
words.translation: 购买；[贸易]购买；紧握；起重装置；赢得

examples.en: You can purchase insurance online.
examples.zh: 你可以在网上买保险。

examples.en: the growing demand to purchase goods on credit
examples.zh: 不断增长的赊账购物的需求

examples.en: Where did you purchase the car?
examples.zh: 你在哪里买的车？

words.definition: a peaceful place that is safe and provides protection, especially for people who are in danger; haven, home, harbor, shelter
words.translation: 避难所；至圣所；耶路撒冷的神殿

examples.en: His church became a sanctuary for thousands of people who fled the civil war.
examples.zh: 他的教堂成了数千逃避内战的人们的一个避难所。

words.definition: a large vehicle that people pay to travel on; motorcoach, autobus
words.translation: 公共汽车；[车辆][公路]公共汽车

examples.en: I took a bus to San Francisco.
examples.zh: 我乘公共汽车去旧金山。

examples.en: Buses run at 15 and 30 minutes past the hour.
examples.zh: 公共汽车在每小时的15分和30分时发车。

words.definition: relating to the performing of plays; affected, dramatic, scenic
words.translation: 戏剧性的；剧场的，戏剧的；夸张的；做作的

examples.en: a Polish theatrical company
examples.zh: 一家波兰剧团

words.definition: a job that needs a high level of education and training; employment, career, calling, pursuit, statement, occupation
words.translation: 职业,专业；职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白

examples.en: people who work in the professions
examples.zh: 从事专业性工作的人

examples.en: nurses, social workers, and other people in the caring professions
examples.zh: 护士、社工和其他从事护理行业的人

words.definition: the main subject or idea in a piece of writing, speech, film etc; topic, subject, titles, motive
words.translation: 主题；主旋律；题目

examples.en: The book’s theme is the conflict between love and duty.
examples.zh: 本书的主题是爱与责任之间的冲突。

examples.en: Nature is a recurrent theme (= a theme that appears repeatedly ) in Frost’s poetry.
examples.zh: 大自然是弗罗斯特诗作中反复出现的一个主题。

examples.en: Most of Kurt’s other pictures were variations on the same theme .
examples.zh: 库尔特的其他大部分画作都是同一主题的变奏。

words.definition: small stones, used to make a surface for paths, roads etc; rubble, crushed stone; confuse, perplex
words.translation: 砂砾(层)；碎石；砂砾；用碎石铺；使船搁浅在沙滩上；使困惑

examples.en: a gravel path
examples.zh: 石子小道

words.definition: worker, toiler
words.translation: 劳动者；工人

examples.en: Traditionally cut blue jeans carry a whiff of the laborer about them, so denim on a leader suggests a willingness to roll up the sleeves and dig in.
examples.zh: 传统剪裁的蓝色牛仔裤带有一种劳动者的气息，因此领导者穿着仔裤可以表达一种愿意卷起袖子大干一场的意思。

examples.en: It is no use offering the manual laborer, tired out with a hard week’s sweat and effort, the chance of playing a game of football or baseball on Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 对于那些体力劳动者来说，一周辛苦的工作使他们精疾力竭，因此在周六下午给他们提供踢足球或者打棒球的机会是没有意义的。

examples.en: Basically, in 2009, the life of a wage laborer has the same essential features in every corner of the globe.
examples.zh: 在2009年，工资劳动者的生活，其基本特征在全球的各个角落都是大致相同的。

words.definition: a very small piece of matter with a positive electrical  charge  that is in the central part of an atom; merron, uron
words.translation: 质子；[物]质子

examples.en: So we get at the number of neutrons indirectly because we know the proton number here.
examples.zh: 所以，我们可以间接得到中子数,因为我们知道质子数了。

examples.en: When a neutron inside an atom decays, it produces a proton, an electron, and a neutrino.
examples.zh: 原子内的一个中子衰变后会产生一个质子、一个电子和一个中微子。

examples.en: Hydrogen, the most common molecule in the universe, is just two atoms—each with one proton and one electron.
examples.zh: 是宇宙中最普通的分子，仅有两个原子构成，每个原子仅包含一个质子和一个电子。

words.definition: the buying and selling of goods and services; trade, traffic
words.translation: 商业；贸易，[贸易]商业

examples.en: measures promoting local commerce and industry
examples.zh: 促进地方工商业发展的措施

words.definition: to make a choice or judgment about something, especially after considering all the possibilities or arguments; settle, condition, conclude; will, determine to
words.translation: 决定,判决；决定；解决；判决；决定，下决心

examples.en: Has anything been decided yet?
examples.zh: 已经作出什么决定了吗？

examples.en: The trainees decide among themselves what programs to take.
examples.zh: 受训者自行选择课程。

examples.en: After a long discussion, they decided in favour of (= chose ) the older applicant.
examples.zh: 经过长时间的讨论，他们决定选那位较年长的求职者。

words.definition: a special place in the wall of a room, where you can make a fire; andiron, chimney place
words.translation: 壁炉；[建]壁炉

examples.en: In the evenings, we gathered around the fireplace and talked in hushed whispers.
examples.zh: 晚上，我们聚集在壁炉周围轻声交谈。

words.translation: 铝

examples.en: To make an aluminum can, that takes energy.
examples.zh: 为了制造一个铝罐，就得消耗能源。

examples.en: And she sat and sat on that aluminum throne ever since.
examples.zh: 自那以后，她就一直坐在那个铝制的宝座上。

examples.en: He says not only does arsenic belong under phosphorus, I predict that there is an element that lies below aluminum and above indium.
examples.zh: 他认为不仅砷属于在磷下面，我预言还有一个元素,是在铝之上和铟的下边的。

words.definition: a business or company, especially a small one; committed, strict, precise, rigid, confirmed; steady; steadily; corporation, establishment, company, incorporation
words.translation: 公司；坚定的；牢固的；严格的；结实的；使坚定；使牢固；稳固地；商号

examples.en: The firm's employees were expecting large bonuses.
examples.zh: 这家公司的雇员们正期待着大笔的奖金。

words.definition: to hit something or someone that is moving in a different direction from you; hit, impact on, crash
words.translation: 碰撞,抵触；碰撞；抵触，冲突

examples.en: A car and a van collided on the motorway.
examples.zh: 一辆汽车和一辆小型货车在高速公路上相撞了。

examples.en: Two trains collided head-on (= when they were moving directly towards each other ) .
examples.zh: 两辆火车迎头相撞。

words.definition: to take part in a war or battle; combat, war; struggle with; action, combat
words.translation: 战斗,打架,斗争；搏斗，斗争；打架；打仗；与…打仗，与…斗争；反对…提案；战斗，搏斗；斗志

examples.en: Neither country is capable of fighting a long war .
examples.zh: 两个国家都没有能力打持久战。

examples.en: Later the Indians fought the Anglo settlers.
examples.zh: 后来，印第安人跟英国殖民者打起了仗。

words.definition: something that is difficult to understand or explain; to confuse someone or make them feel slightly anxious because they do not understand something; baffle, discomfit; contemplate; enigma, difficult problem
words.translation: 难题；(使)迷惑；使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出；迷惑；冥思苦想；谜

examples.en: The meaning of the poem has always been a puzzle.
examples.zh: 那首诗的含义始终是个谜。

examples.en: He thought he had solved the puzzle .
examples.zh: 他认为他已经解开了那个谜。

words.definition: an actor, musician etc who performs to entertain people; player, executive
words.translation: 表演者；执行者；演奏者

examples.en: circus performers
examples.zh: 马戏演员

examples.en: He was a better songwriter than performer.
examples.zh: 他更擅长写歌，而不是演唱。

words.definition: to bend or turn something, such as wire, hair, or cloth, into a particular shape; screw, harry; distortion, strain; bend, double up
words.translation: 缠绕,拧,扭曲；捻；拧；扭伤；编织；使苦恼；[力]扭曲；扭动；弯曲

examples.en: Her hands began to twist the handles of the bag she carried.
examples.zh: 她的双手开始拧她拎着的那个包的拎柄。

words.definition: remarkably, markedly
words.translation: 戏剧地,引人注目地；戏剧地；引人注目地

words.definition: to pay attention to what someone is saying or to a sound that you can hear; hear, hark; ear
words.translation: 听；听，倾听；听从，听信

examples.en: Listen! There’s a strange noise in the engine.
examples.zh: 听！引擎发出奇怪的声音。

words.definition: when you depend on the help and support of someone or something else in order to exist or be successful; belief, faith, confidence, trust, credit
words.translation: 依靠,信任；[数][统计]依赖；依靠；信任；信赖

examples.en: ...the city's traditional dependence on tourism.
examples.zh: …这个城市对旅游业的传统依赖。

words.definition: to try extremely hard to achieve something, even though it is very difficult; apply oneself, labor; effort, competition, pain, trial, war
words.translation: 努力,奋斗,挣扎；奋斗，努力；挣扎；努力，奋斗；竞争

examples.en: The team has been struggling all season.
examples.zh: 整个赛季球队都打得很艰难。

words.definition: someone from Germany; relating to Germany, its people, or its language
words.translation: 德国人；德国的

examples.en: I heard a very angry man talking in German.
examples.zh: 我听到一个怒不可遏的人说着德语。

words.definition: having a shape, surface, pattern etc that is not even, smooth, or balanced; abnormal, orrow
words.translation: 不规则的,无规律的；[语]不规则的；无规律的；[数]非正规的；不合法的

examples.en: a jagged, irregular coastline
examples.zh: 锯齿状不规则的海岸线

examples.en: It has a highly irregular shape, covered in bumps and indentations.
examples.zh: 它的外形极不规则，满是凸起和凹陷的地方。

words.translation: 厘米

examples.en: Who guesses one centimeter?
examples.zh: 谁觉得是一厘米？

examples.en: In every square centimeter!
examples.zh: 每一平方厘米！

examples.en: With the profile of a dinosaur and the texture of a rose bush, a thorny devil in Alice Springs Desert Park looks like trouble, but this slow-moving, six-inch [15-centimeter] lizard eats only ants.
examples.zh: 长着恐龙的外形和一身的刺犹如一丛玫瑰，这样一个棘手的恶魔在阿丽斯春天的沙漠公园里看似麻烦，但他动作缓慢，六英寸[15厘米]蜥蜴只吃蚂蚁。

words.definition: settlement, plantation
words.translation: 殖民地化,殖民；殖民；殖民地化

examples.en: What is the process of colonization?
examples.zh: 殖民地化的过程又是怎样？

examples.en: They have known colonization, revolution and emigration.
examples.zh: 他们了解殖民、革命还有移民。

examples.en: We also substituted “settlement” for “colonization” in the title of the book.
examples.zh: 本书标题中原先使用的“殖民”一词，也用“移民”代替。

words.definition: an amount of money that is collected and kept for a particular purpose; to provide money for an activity, organization, event etc; capital, deposit, saving; invent money in, to invest
words.translation: 资金；支助,投资；[金融]基金；存款；投资；资助

examples.en: The fund was set up to try to save the cathedral.
examples.zh: 设立基金以挽救大教堂。

words.definition: A historian is a person who specializes in the study of history, and who writes books and articles about it
words.translation: 历史学家

examples.en: I am a historian, and I teach in an American university.
examples.zh: 我是一位历史学家，在美国一所大学任教。

examples.en: "There’s nothing I can tell you about how [this or] any other incidents were or are handled, " CIA historian David Robarge said.
examples.zh: “关于[这一或]或任何其他事故是如何处理的，我没有什么可以告诉你的，”中央情报局历史学家大卫·罗巴尔说。

examples.en: The historian drew a horizontal line on the date to remember it.
examples.zh: 历史学家在日期上画了一条水平线来记住这天。

words.definition: an animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs; delicate, feminine; she, jenny
words.translation: 女性；女性的；[生物]雌性的；柔弱的，柔和的；女人；[植][动]雌性动物

examples.en: As a group, females performed better on the test than males.
examples.zh: 整体来说，女性在这次测试中胜过男性。

words.definition: to send out gas, heat, light, sound etc; deliver, ray
words.translation: 发出,放射；发出，放射；发行；发表

examples.en: The kettle emitted a shrill whistle.
examples.zh: 水壶发出了刺耳的鸣笛声。

words.definition: to move away from the enemy after being defeated in battle; withdrawal, pullback; withdraw, bug out
words.translation: 撤退,退却；撤退；休息寓所；退避；向后倾

examples.en: The rebels retreated to the mountains.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子撤退到山区。

examples.en: They were attacked and forced to retreat.
examples.zh: 他们受到攻击，被迫撤退。

words.definition: a lack of something that is necessary; defect, shortage, vice, need, fault
words.translation: 缺乏,不足；缺陷，缺点；缺乏；不足的数额

examples.en: They did blood tests on him for signs of vitamin deficiency.
examples.zh: 他们给他做了血检看是否有缺乏维生素的迹象。

words.definition: to turn with a circular movement around a central point, or to make something do this; wheel, circle, spin; turn, spin, swing
words.translation: (使)旋转；旋转；循环；使旋转；使转动；使轮流

examples.en: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
examples.zh: 地球每24小时绕地轴自转一周。

examples.en: Rotate the pan halfway through the baking time.
examples.zh: 烘烤到一半时把盘子转一下。

words.definition: a living creature that does not have a  backbone; spineless; Invertebrate Zoology
words.translation: 无脊椎的,无骨气的人；[无脊椎]无脊椎的；无骨气的；[无脊椎]无脊椎动物；无骨气的人

examples.en: The site of the proposed airport is incredibly important for native invertebrate animals … St Helena has about 400 species that occur nowhere else in the world.
examples.zh: 提到机场的位置对于本国的无脊椎动物非常重要...圣赫勒拿大概有400个物种在世界其它地方是没有的。

examples.en: “ Smithers, don’t you think it’s ironic that your irregular night-time activities are in inverse proportion to your reputation as an expert in the area of invertebrate research?
examples.zh: “斯密德斯，难道你不认为自己无规律的夜生活与你作为无脊椎动物研究领域的专家的声望成反比是具有讽刺意味的吗？”

words.definition: a symbiotic relationship is one in which the people, organizations, or living things involved depend on each other; paragenetic
words.translation: 共生的；[生态]共生的；共栖的

examples.en: ...fungi that have a symbiotic relationship with the trees of these northwestern forests.
examples.zh: ...与这些位于西北部的森林里的树木存在共生关系的真菌。

words.definition: Alternative medicine uses traditional ways of curing people, such as medicines made from plants, massage, and acupuncture; selective, vicissitudinary
words.translation: 选择性的,二中择一的；供选择的；选择性的；交替的

examples.en: ...alternative health care.
examples.zh: …替代性保健。

words.definition: a structure built over a river, road etc that allows people or vehicles to cross from one side to the other; to build or form a bridge over something; ponte, pons; cross
words.translation: 桥；架桥,渡过；[交]桥；桥牌；[计][电]桥接器；船桥；架桥；渡过

examples.en: He walked back over the railway bridge.
examples.zh: 他从铁路桥上走了回去。

words.definition: pointing up in a line that forms an angle of 90˚ with a flat surface; standing, perpendicular; perpendicular plane, perpendicular line
words.translation: 垂直的,直立的；[测]垂直的，直立的；[解剖][天]头顶的，顶点的；[数]垂直线，垂直面

examples.en: a vertical line
examples.zh: 垂直线

examples.en: the vertical axis of a graph
examples.zh: 图的纵轴

examples.en: vertical window blinds
examples.zh: 垂直百叶窗

words.definition: a completely round shape, like the letter O; to move in the shape of a circle around something, especially in the air; cycle, revolution, rotation, round, recurrence; wheel, orbit, spin
words.translation: 圆(圈)；围着,盘旋；循环，周期；圆；圈子；圆形物；盘旋，旋转；环行

examples.en: Draw a circle 10cm in diameter.
examples.zh: 画一个直径10厘米的圆形。

examples.en: Cut the pastry into circles.
examples.zh: 将油酥面团切成圆形。

words.definition: one of four equal parts into which something can be divided; region, area, direction, orientation, aspect; room, stop at
words.translation: 四分之一,一刻钟；季度；[数]四分之一；地区；一刻钟；方向；两角五分；驻扎；住宿

examples.en: It’s about a page and a quarter.
examples.zh: 大概是一又四分之一页。

examples.en: Cut the cake into quarters.
examples.zh: 把蛋糕切成四等份。

words.definition: to repair something that is broken or not working properly; provide, fit, repair, doctor; watch, regard; difficulty, corner, dilemma, predicament
words.translation: 修理,安装,整理；使固定；修理；安装；准备；固定；注视；困境；方位；贿赂

examples.en: He’s outside fixing the brakes on the car.
examples.zh: 他在外面修理汽车的刹车。

examples.en: Ellis was able to quickly find and fix the problem.
examples.zh: 埃利斯马上就找到并解决了问题。

words.definition: a feeling of being not sure whether something is true or right; challenge, question, query, suspicion; suspect of, be suspicious of
words.translation: 怀疑,怀疑；[法]怀疑；疑问；疑惑；不信；恐怕；拿不准

examples.en: There was still one little nagging doubt at the back of his mind.
examples.zh: 他的心头仍有一丝挥之不去的疑虑。

words.translation: 田纳西州

examples.en: The study at the University of Tennessee selected 169 married couples under the age of 35 and asked them to fill in questionnaires every six months for four years.
examples.zh: 田纳西州大学的这项研究选取了169对35岁以下的已婚夫妇，在四年的时间里每隔6个月请他们填一份调查问卷。

examples.en: The next day, after Al and I went for a jog in Little Rock, we flew to his hometown, Carthage, Tennessee, for a rally and a visit with his parents, both of whom had a large influence on him.
examples.zh: 第二天，艾尔和我一起在小石城里慢跑了一下，然后我们飞到他的家乡田纳西州的迦太基，参加一个集会，并拜见他的父母。 他的父母对他影响非常大。

examples.en: Most of the other citizens in Tennessee disagreed with him. They decided to leave the Union.
examples.zh: 然而，在田纳西州，绝大多数人都反对他的决定，他们决定脱离合众国。

words.translation: 爆发,火山灰；[天]爆发，[地质]喷发；火山灰；出疹

examples.zh: 该火山上次爆发持续了一年，所以现在也不能排除这个可能性。

examples.zh: 假设一次火山爆发消灭了所有的普通老鼠，那么这个小岛将是斑纹鼠的天下。

words.definition: to behave towards someone or something in a particular way; cure, help; arrange, confer with; entertainment, delectation

words.translation: 政治家,政客；政治家，政客

examples.zh: 对中国政治很好的了解

examples.zh: 你不应该看别人的信件。

examples.en: He found a mountain of mail waiting for him.
examples.zh: 他发现有堆积如山的邮件等着他处理。

examples.en: She promised to forward my mail to my new address (= send it from your old home or office to your new one ) .
examples.zh: 她答应把我的邮件转寄到我的新地址。

words.definition: a quality that people, places, or things have that makes them very attractive to look at; fair, pulchritude

words.translation: 设计,格式

examples.zh: 我已经同他见过面，解释了这个节目的程式和我们的想法。

examples.zh: 你能确认我们商讨过的日期吗？

examples.zh: 现在是退潮还是涨潮？

examples.zh: 我们去散步，结果被潮水困住了。

examples.zh: 英国同意减少发电站氮氧化物的排放量。

examples.zh: 奥森•威尔斯使得许多美国人相信他们正遭到火星人的入侵。

words.translation: 蜜蜂；[蜂]蜜蜂，蜂；勤劳的人

examples.zh: 只要能赚一点钱，他什么都愿意做。

examples.zh: 大多数夫妻，不管关系多么僵化，都有一些共同的兴趣。

examples.zh: 半场时的比分是一比一。

examples.zh: 比分是多少？

examples.zh: 从美学角度看，这是个不错的设计。

examples.zh: ...几世纪的海堤建设及从沼泽地到干地的开垦。

examples.zh: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

words.translation: 确保,保证；保证，确保；使安全

examples.zh: 确保骑车人安全的设施

examples.zh: 光照不足，植物就生长不好。

examples.zh: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

examples.zh: 他该把炉子封起来了。

examples.zh: 禽类是由爬虫类进化而来，所以，第一只禽鸟肯定是从爬虫类孵化的蛋里出来的。

examples.zh: 这种身长只有10厘米小型爬行动物，可以在沙子中以最快每秒15厘米的速度游动。

words.definition: a large organization that has a particular kind of work or purpose; system, convention
words.translation: 公共机构,协会,制度；[管理]制度；建立；（社会或宗教等）公共机构；习俗

examples.zh: 她承担了监督选举的任务。

examples.zh: 我的双胞胎兄弟

words.definition: something that is crucial is extremely important, because everything else depends on it; important, considerable, material, critical, big
words.translation: 至关紧要的；重要的；决定性的；定局的；决断的

examples.en: The conservation of tropical forests is of crucial importance .
examples.zh: 保护热带雨林至关重要。

words.translation: 健忘症

examples.en: We tend to think that a person who is a complete victim of amnesia is still the same person as before.
examples.zh: 我们倾向于认为，一个彻底的健忘症患者，他与以前没有患病时仍然是同一个人。

words.definition: an object for children to play with; nick-nack, plaything; play fast and loose, trifle with
words.translation: 玩具；[轻]玩具；小装饰品；不值钱的东西；玩弄；调情；随随便便地对待

examples.en: some toys for the baby
examples.zh: 宝宝玩的一些玩具

examples.en: Annie was playing happily with her toys .
examples.zh: 安妮正高兴地玩着玩具。

words.definition: without any sound, or not making any sound; still, mum
words.translation: 寂静的, 沉默的；沉默的；寂静的；无记载的

examples.en: The large house was silent and lonely.
examples.zh: 这幢大房子寂静荒凉。

examples.en: At last the guns fell silent .
examples.zh: 枪声终于沉寂了下来。

examples.en: Julie offered up a silent prayer that she would pass her exam.
examples.zh: 朱莉默默地祈祷，希望能通过这次考试。

words.definition: relating to the substances in food that help you to stay healthy; trophic, alimentary
words.translation: 营养的,滋养的；营养的；滋养的

examples.en: Cooking vegetables for too long lessens their nutritional value.
examples.zh: 烹饪蔬菜时间过长有损其营养价值。

examples.en: the nutritional requirements of pregnant women
examples.zh: 孕妇的营养需求

examples.en: nutritional deficiencies
examples.zh: 营养缺乏

words.definition: to eat or drink a small amount of something to see what it is like; uner, aesthetic appreciation; experience, degustate
words.translation: 品尝, 体验；[食品]味道；品味；审美；尝；体验

examples.en: It’s always best to keep tasting the food while you’re cooking it.
examples.zh: 做菜的时候最好是边做边尝。

words.definition: if one statement, story etc contradicts another, the facts in it are different so that both statements cannot be true; negative, deny; deny, talk back
words.translation: 同矛盾, 同抵触；反驳；否定；与…矛盾；与…抵触；否认；发生矛盾

examples.en: The witness statements contradict each other and the facts remain unclear.
examples.zh: 目击者的说法互相矛盾，真相依然未明。

words.definition: spoken rather than written; oral, spoken
words.translation: 口头的；言语的；动词的；照字面的

examples.en: They were jostled and subjected to a torrent of verbal abuse.
examples.zh: 他们被推来搡去，并受到了潮水般的辱骂。

words.definition: stick on, piece on; to accompany, be with
words.translation: 缚上, 配属,隶属于；使依附；贴上；系上；使依恋；附加；附属；伴随

examples.en: It is possible to attach executable program files to e-mail.
examples.zh: 可以在电子邮件上附上可执行程序文件。

words.definition: something that you add to something else to improve it or make it complete; recruitment, renewal; to replenish, eke
words.translation: 补充, 附录；补充，[图情]补遗；补充物；附录；补充，增补

examples.en: vitamins and other dietary supplements
examples.zh: 各种维生素和其他膳食补充剂

words.definition: the act of bringing goods, letters etc to a particular person or place, or the things that are brought; labour, handing over
words.translation: 递送,交付,传输；[贸易]交付；[妇产]分娩；递送

examples.en: Most Indian restaurants offer free delivery.
examples.zh: 大多数印度餐馆提供免费外送服务。

examples.en: You can expect delivery in a week to ten days.
examples.zh: 你可以在一周至十天内收到货物。

examples.en: fresh milk deliveries
examples.zh: 新鲜牛奶递送

words.definition: extent, boundary, region, spectrum, territory, area; stride leap, last for
words.translation: 跨度v横越；[建]跨度，跨距；范围；跨越；持续；以手指测量

words.definition: similar to something else in size, number, quality etc, so that you can make a comparison
words.translation: 可比较的, 比得上的

examples.en: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
examples.zh: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。

words.definition: to make someone feel pleased by doing what they want; turn up trumps; meet, fulfill, fill, please, reason
words.translation: 满足,使满意；令人满意；令人满足；满足；说服，使相信；使满意，使高兴

examples.en: Nothing I did would ever satisfy my father.
examples.zh: 我做什么都不能让父亲满意。

words.definition: a board in a car, plane, boat etc that has the controls on it; fascia board, instrument board
words.translation: 面，板,专门小组；仪表板；[建]嵌板；座谈小组，全体陪审员

examples.en: He assembled a panel of scholars to advise him.
examples.zh: 他集结了一个学者小组为他出谋划策。

words.definition: to behave in a particular way or show a particular emotion because of something that has happened or been said; impact of, impact on, work on
words.translation: 起反应, 起作用；反应；影响；反抗；起反作用

examples.en: He reacted angrily to the suggestion that he had lied.
examples.zh: 说他撒谎，他非常生气。

examples.en: She reacted very badly (= was very upset ) when her parents split up.
examples.zh: 父母离婚的时候，她非常难过。

examples.en: You have to react quickly to circumstances.
examples.zh: 你必须对形势迅速作出反应。

words.definition: raw, limnetic; plain water, sweet water
words.translation: 淡水；淡水的；无经验的；内河；湖水

examples.en: There are bright prospects for freshwater fish farming.
examples.zh: 淡水养鱼大有可为。

examples.en: About half of the water emerges as freshwater on the other side.
examples.zh: 大约会有一半体积的淡水出现在另一边。

words.definition: coming or following one after the other; continuing, straight, endless, running, serial
words.translation: 连续的, 接连的；连续的；继承的；依次的；接替的

examples.en: The team has had five successive victories.
examples.zh: 这支球队已经连胜五场了。

examples.en: Successive governments have tried to deal with this issue.
examples.zh: 历届政府都试图解决这个问题。

words.definition: formal, state; nazir, office holder
words.translation: 官员；官方的,正式的；官方的；正式的；公务的；公务员

examples.en: You'd better declare the camera to the official.
examples.zh: 你最好把照相机向海关官员申报纳税。

examples.en: The reporter trapped the official into giving away a secret.
examples.zh: 记者用计诱使那个官员泄露了一个秘密。

examples.en: This passport has to be signed before the official can validate it.
examples.zh: 这个护照必须先行签署，官方才能确认其有效。

words.definition: to keep something so that you can use or enjoy it in the future; hold, economize on; economize on, spare no effort; succor
words.translation: 解救, 保存；节省；保存；储蓄；解救；挽救；救球；救球，救援

examples.en: We’ll save the rest of the food and have it later.
examples.zh: 我们把剩下的食物留着以后吃。

words.definition: used to thank someone in a polite way or to say that you are grateful for something they have done; enjoy, see, grasp; value added, rise in price
words.translation: 赏识, 感激；欣赏；感激；领会；鉴别；增值；涨价

examples.en: Thanks ever so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
examples.zh: 多谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

examples.en: I appreciate your concern , but honestly, I’m fine.
examples.zh: 谢谢你关心，不过说真的，我很好。

examples.en: I’d appreciate it if you let me get on with my job.
examples.zh: 如果你能让我继续工作，我会非常感激。

words.definition: someone who you know and like very much and enjoy spending time with; assistant, fellow, aid
words.translation: 朋友, 赞助者, 助手；朋友；助手；赞助者

examples.en: Jerry, this is my friend Sue.
examples.zh: 杰里，这是我的朋友休。

examples.en: She’s always out with her friends.
examples.zh: 她常同朋友们一起出去。

examples.en: One of her closest friends died at the weekend.
examples.zh: 她的一位密友周末过世了。

words.definition: the main ideas or facts about something, without the details; to show the edge of something, or draw around its edge, so that its shape is clear; profile, program, brief, contour; summarize, sum up
words.translation: 大纲；描画轮廓,略述；轮廓；概要；略图；概述；略述；描画…轮廓

examples.en: a research proposal outline
examples.zh: 研究计划梗概

words.definition: of or relating to the earth's crust; thecal
words.translation: 地壳的；壳的

examples.en: As geologic forces pulled the crustal plate apart, new volcanoes formed in parts of the rift.
examples.zh: 当地质作用力（试图）把地壳版块分开，版块开裂的一些地方就会形成新的火山。

examples.en: The study authors propose another, more radical, explanation: The crustal rock they analyzed, called ferroan anorthosite, is not linked to magma dynamics at all.
examples.zh: 这项研究的作者提出了一个更大胆的解释：他们分析了这种被称为铁斜长岩的月球地壳岩石，发现其并不与岩浆的运动相联系。

examples.en: Iceland is geology in action. A one-hour flight from Reykjavik skims over steaming geothermal areas, the great crustal rift and some of the country's most famous volcanoes.
examples.zh: 冰岛的国土一直处于地质活跃中。从雷克雅未克乘飞机飞行一个小时，途中尽是冒着蒸汽的地热区、巨大的地壳裂缝以及岛国最著名的几座火山。

words.definition: a statement in which you tell someone that you will cause them harm or trouble if they do not do what you want; danger, intimidation
words.translation: 恐吓, 凶兆, 威胁；威胁，恐吓；凶兆

examples.en: Your threats don’t scare me.
examples.zh: 你的那些威胁吓不倒我。

examples.en: threats made against his wife and children
examples.zh: 对他妻儿的威胁

examples.en: Nichols never carried out his threat to resign.
examples.zh: 尼科尔斯威胁过要辞职，但从未付诸行动。

words.definition: a substance that is in foods such as sugar, bread, and potatoes, which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of oxygen,  hydrogen  , and  carbon; glucide, saccharide
words.translation: 碳水化合物,醣类；[有化]碳水化合物；糖类

examples.en: Around one third of our meals should be based on carbohydrate, with roughly one half of these grains being whole.
examples.zh: 我们每餐食物应当差不多有三分之一是碳水化合物，大概有一半谷物食品为全麦的。

examples.en: There have been no studies of the effects of a low carbohydrate diet on pregnancy, so its effect on the fetus, if any, are unknown.
examples.zh: 目前为止还没有关于怀孕时低碳水化合物饮食影响的研究，因此如果对胎儿有什么影响也是不知道的。

examples.en: The reason for this is that carbohydrate consumption stimulates insulin production, which aids the production of muscle glycogen.
examples.zh: 这是因为是碳水化合物的消耗刺激了胰岛素的分泌，后者对于肌肉糖原产生有帮助。

words.definition: Periodical events or situations happen occasionally, at fairly regular intervals; regular, stated, time, cyclical; magazine, journal, serial
words.translation: 周期的, 定期的 n期刊, 杂志；[数]周期的；定期的；期刊；杂志

examples.en: She made periodical visits to her dentist.
examples.zh: 她定期去看牙医。

words.definition: the number 9
words.translation: 九,九个

examples.en: He’s only been in this job for nine months.
examples.zh: 他干这份工作才九个月。

examples.en: We open at nine (= nine o’clock ).
examples.zh: 我们9点开始营业。

examples.en: Kay was taught by her mother till she was nine (= nine years old ).
examples.zh: 凯一直由她妈妈教到九岁。

words.translation: 加强, 巩固；加强；巩固；变强；变坚挺

examples.zh: 我们的友谊逐年加深。

examples.en: Steve’s opposition only strengthened her resolve to go ahead.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫的反对反而坚定了她继续下去的决心。

examples.en: The company plans to strengthen its hand (= make itself more powerful ) in Europe by opening an office in Spain.
examples.zh: 该公司计划在西班牙设立办事处，以此增强在欧洲的实力。

words.definition: a hard mineral substance that is used in making electronic watches and clocks; crystalline silica
words.translation: 石英；[矿物]石英

examples.en: quartz crystals
examples.zh: 石英晶体

examples.en: a quartz watch
examples.zh: 石英表

words.translation: 社会学家

examples.en: The findings of this sociologist are very interesting because they illustrate once again the relationship that exists between what we do in the present and the results we obtain in the future.
examples.zh: 这个社会学家的发现是非常有趣的，因为他们在一次的说明我们现在做的和我们未来获得的结果有关系。

examples.en: Not only is social class supposed not to exist in America, it is almost a dirty word—“America's forbidden thought”, in the words of one sociologist.
examples.zh: 美国不仅不应该存在社会阶级，而且那几乎是一个肮脏的词——用一位社会学家的话来说就是“美国所禁忌的思想”。

words.definition: of excellent quality; traditional, conventional; chefdoeuvre, scriptures
words.translation: 最优秀的,标准的 n杰作；经典的；古典的，传统的；最优秀的；名著；经典著作；大艺术家

examples.zh: 罗伊在第90分钟时踢进了漂亮的一球。

words.definition: the total produced when you add two or more numbers or amounts together; total, gross; recapitulate, gather up; summarize, tally up
words.translation: 总数,总和；共计,概括；金额；[数]总数；概括；总结；合计

examples.en: You will have to pay the sum of the two sets of costs.
examples.zh: 你得支付那两笔费用的总和。

words.definition: made skilfully and with attention to the smallest details; subtle, female, refined, fine, fragile
words.translation: 精巧的, 精致的；微妙的；精美的，雅致的；柔和的；易碎的；纤弱的；清淡可口的

examples.zh: 有精致树叶图案的碟子

words.translation: 领导能力,领导阶层

examples.zh: 美国现在必须扮演一个强有力的领导人角色。

examples.en: the Conservative leadership contest
examples.zh: 保守党的领导人角逐

examples.en: The next leadership election is due in November.
examples.zh: 下一届领导人选举将在十一月举行。

words.definition: a man who rules a country because he is from a royal family; wanax, Rex; to rule, reign over; enthrone
words.translation: 国王；最有势力者；王棋；统治；做国王；立…为王

examples.zh: 12月2日，亨利六世加冕为王。

words.definition: someone you work with – used especially by professional people; brother, fellow, associate
words.translation: 同事, 同僚；同事，同僚

examples.zh: 我在银行的一位同事

examples.en: She discussed the idea with some of her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她和几位同事讨论了这个想法。

words.translation: 海底

examples.zh: 海胆在海峡群岛附近的海底挥舞着它们的棘突。

examples.zh: 日本计划测试开采方法，以从东京西南的海底获得甲烷水合物。

examples.en: No new rights are given over fish or other creatures in the water column, but living creatures on or below the seafloor that are immobile “at the harvestable stage” are treated like minerals.
examples.zh: 对于水层的鱼和其他生物，现在还没有新的规定，但是对于那些生长在海底上面或下面的生物，在“丰收季节”是不会移动的，它们也是一种矿藏。

words.definition: a hard metal that is a mixture of  copper  and  tin; gunmetal; aeneous
words.translation: 青铜；[材]青铜；古铜色；青铜制品；青铜色的；青铜制的

examples.en: a bell cast in bronze
examples.zh: 青铜浇铸的一口钟

words.definition: a way of expressing your ideas, especially as a writer or an artist; of middle size, level, or amount; mid, intermediary, middle, secondary, moderate; method, approach, way, system, how
words.translation: 媒体,方法；中间的；中间的，中等的；半生熟的；方法；媒体；媒介；中间物

examples.en: the visual media
examples.zh: 视觉媒介

words.definition: a round roof on a building; cupola
words.translation: 圆屋顶；[建]圆屋顶

examples.en: ...the dome of the Capitol.
examples.zh: …国会大厦的穹顶。

words.definition: writing done by hand; play book
words.translation: 手稿, 手迹；脚本；[图情]手迹；书写用的字母

examples.en: a diary entry written in neat black script
examples.zh: 用工整的黑色字写下的一则日记

words.definition: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals; restaurant, inn
words.translation: 旅馆, 客栈,；旅馆，[经]饭店；客栈

examples.zh: 这个旅馆现在已向客人开放。

examples.en: He was told to have out of the hotel.
examples.zh: 有人通知他，让他离开他所住宿的旅馆。

examples.en: What's he sucking around the hotel for?
examples.zh: 他老在旅馆这儿转悠，想要干什么?

words.definition: to start something such as an organization, company, school, or city, often by providing the necessary money; establish, build, construct, institute, father
words.translation: 建立, 创办；创立，建立；创办

examples.zh: 嗜酒者互诫协会1935年创立于俄亥俄州，现在是一个世界性的组织。

examples.en: Eton College was founded by Henry VI in 1440.
examples.zh: 伊顿公学于1440年由亨利六世创办。

words.definition: two times
words.translation: 两次, 两倍

examples.en: He was questioned by police twice yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天被警察审问了两次。

examples.en: None of our dinner menus are exactly the same twice over .
examples.zh: 我们的晚餐菜单从没有完全重样的。

words.definition: the written information that tells you how to do or use something; direction, order, bidding, word, charge
words.translation: 命令,指示,用法说明；指令，命令；指示；教导；用法说明

examples.en: Press ‘Enter’ and follow the on-screen instructions.
examples.zh: 按回车键，然后按照电脑屏幕上的指示来操作。

words.definition: to become very successful or very strong and healthy; succeed, flower
words.translation: 兴旺,繁荣；繁荣，兴旺；茁壮成长

examples.en: plants that thrive in tropical rain forests
examples.zh: 在热带雨林蓬勃生长的植物

examples.en: a business which managed to thrive during a recession
examples.zh: 在经济萧条时期也能顺利发展的一家企业

words.definition: books and stories about imaginary people and events; invention, novel
words.translation: 虚构,小说；小说；虚构，编造；谎言

examples.en: romantic fiction
examples.zh: 爱情小说

examples.en: historical fiction
examples.zh: 历史小说

words.definition: the part of a machine that makes it work or move, by changing power, especially electrical power, into movement; engine, automobile, car; automotive, mobile; auto
words.translation: 发动机；[动力][电]发动机，马达；汽车；汽车的；机动的；乘汽车

examples.en: an electric motor
examples.zh: 电动马达

words.definition: not completely; half
words.translation: 部分地；偏袒地

examples.en: The operation was only partially successful.
examples.zh: 手术不尽如人意。

examples.en: Remember that you are partially responsible for their unhappiness.
examples.zh: 记住，你对他们的不幸负有部分责任。

words.translation: 德国

examples.en: Germany borders on France.
examples.zh: 德国与法国接壤。

examples.en: Bismarck ruled Germany by a strong hand.
examples.zh: 俾斯麦用铁腕手段统治德国。

examples.en: The new Nazism is resurging in some places in Germany.
examples.zh: 新纳粹主义正在德国的一些地方复活。

words.definition: someone or something that is beautiful is extremely attractive to look at; fair, seraphic
words.translation: 美丽的

examples.en: She was even more beautiful than I had remembered.
examples.zh: 她比我记忆中更美。

examples.en: a beautiful bunch of flowers
examples.zh: 一束美丽的花

words.definition: a machine with an engine that is used to take people or things from one place to another, such as a car, bus, or truck; instrument, engine, tool, gear, implement
words.translation: 交通工具, 车辆；[车辆]车辆；工具；交通工具；运载工具；传播媒介；媒介物

examples.en: a description of the stolen vehicle
examples.zh: 对被盗车辆的描述

examples.zh: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

examples.zh: 他走遍了欧洲各地。

examples.zh: 他那紧握的拳头是他内心愤怒的唯一外在表现。

examples.zh: 最上面的门向外开着。

examples.zh: 她本想成为第一位登上珠穆朗玛峰的女性，而且差一点就成功了。

examples.zh: 正如你所知道的那样，每年都要收取一笔费用。

words.translation: 日用品；商品，[贸易]货物

words.definition: used for, relating to, or resulting from experiments; tentative, laboratorial

examples.zh: 用于实验的动物

words.definition: to touch someone or something quickly and hard with your hand, a stick etc; dong, impact on; impact on, beat upon; success, prosperity, victory, blow, stroke

examples.zh: 钻石是碳元素的晶体结构。

examples.zh: 议会大楼位于一个大广场上。

examples.en: He’s got a computer sitting on his desk, but he doesn’t use it.
examples.zh: 他有一台电脑放在书桌上，但他不用。

examples.zh: 我的登山靴在橱柜里，一直没有穿。

words.definition: the number 30
words.translation: 三十

examples.zh: 在30年代，乘飞机旅行迅速流行了起来。

words.definition: award, capture; assess, acquire, evaluate, value, rate

examples.zh: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

examples.zh: 他在澳大利亚过着豪华舒适的生活。

words.translation: 斯堪的纳维亚（北欧地名）

examples.zh: 在我小时候，本地的乳品公司向当地农场主收购牛奶。

words.definition: one of the stages of a process of development or change; stage, age, grade
words.translation: 阶段,方面；[物]相；阶段；[天]位相

examples.en: a new drug that is in the experimental phase
examples.zh: 处于试验阶段的一种新药

examples.en: It’s just a phase he’s going through .
examples.zh: 这只是他要经历的一个阶段。

words.definition: massive, extensive, macro, much, volume; essence, entity, principle, texture, interior
words.translation: 可观的,牢固的，实质的；大量的；实质的；内容充实的；本质；重要材料

examples.zh: 我们有相当多家长的支持。

words.translation: 不断地，频繁地；不断地；频繁地

examples.zh: 沙漠在不断地侵蚀肥沃土地。

examples.en: If you continually question why he included this section at all, then you will be frustrated.
examples.zh: 如果您不断地询问他究竟为什么要包含此部分，那么您将感到失落。

It is used in the manufacture of cement, plaster, paint, glass, and fertilizer. Composition: calcium carbonate. Formula: CaCO3. Crystal structure: hexagonal (rhombohedral); limespar
words.translation: 方解石；[矿物]方解石

examples.zh: 然后，我们用石英方解石测量作为位置函数的方向，石英方解石对光的影响这取决于光线的传播方向。

examples.zh: 这种蛋白将碳酸钙转换为构成蛋壳的方解石晶体，每24小时生成6克蛋壳。

examples.zh: 他指挥一个管弦乐队。

examples.zh: 她在一个拥有40种乐器的管弦乐队里当指挥。

words.translation: 我；自我；极端自私的人；自我的一部分

examples.zh: 住手，你弄疼我了。

examples.zh: 他给我买了一杯酒。

examples.en: Give that book to me.
examples.zh: 把那本书给我。

words.translation: 向南 a向南的

examples.zh: 严格的老师

examples.zh: 把香草放进鱼肚里。

examples.zh: 部落文化
