examples.en: ...a dark blue baseball cap.
examples.zh: …一顶深蓝色的棒球帽。

words.definition: someone who carves wood or stone; cleaver, sculpsit
words.translation: 雕刻匠；切肉刀；[口腔]雕刻者；切肉的人

examples.en: The ivory industry employed about a thousand carvers.
examples.zh: 象牙工业雇佣了大约一千个雕刻工。

words.definition: to succeed in doing something, especially after trying very hard; carry out, come true, perform, complete, fulfill
words.translation: 完成,实现；完成；实现；达到

examples.en: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
examples.zh: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

examples.en: (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
examples.zh: 大功告成。

words.definition: correctly, or in a way that is considered right; correctly, exactly, well, appropriately, adequately
words.translation: 适当地；正确地；恰当地

examples.en: The brakes don’t seem to be working properly.
examples.zh: 刹车似乎不正常。

examples.en: Then he’s not doing his job properly.
examples.zh: 那么他没把分内事做好。

examples.en: Parents should teach their children to behave properly in public.
examples.zh: 家长应该教导子女在公共场合要有规有矩。

words.definition: a comet of almost parabolic orbit that reached its closest approach to the sun in Dec 1973
words.translation: [天]科胡特克彗星

examples.en: But comet kohoutek offered astronomers a unique opportunity to make a concerted attack on many of them.
examples.zh: 科霍切克慧星为天文学家提供了 一个难得的机会，使他们能同时研究其中的许都问题。

words.definition: tank, lakelet
words.translation: 仅仅的,起码的；小湖；池塘

examples.en: She lost the election by a mere 20 votes.
examples.zh: 她仅仅以20票之差落选。

words.definition: someone who is immune to a particular disease cannot catch it; exonerative
words.translation: 免疫的；[免疫]免疫的；免于……的，免除的

examples.en: Once we’ve had the disease, we’re immune for life.
examples.zh: 我们一旦得过这种病，就获得了终身免疫力。

words.definition: one of the organs on the sides of a fish through which it breathes; ravine
words.translation: 鳃,及耳[液量单位]；腮；菌褶；（山谷中的）沟壑，峡流；及耳（容量单位）

words.definition: a situation in which people express different opinions about something and sometimes argue; controversy, combat, variance, disparity
words.translation: 不一致；争论；意见不同

examples.en: We’ve had a few disagreements , but we’re still good friends.
examples.zh: 虽然有过一些分歧，但我们仍是好朋友。

words.definition: someone who starts a new business or arranges business deals in order to make money, often in a way that involves financial risks; contractor, enterpriser
words.translation: 企业家, 主办人；企业家；承包人；主办者

examples.en: “You have to be an optimist to be an inventor or entrepreneur, ” he concludes.
examples.zh: 要成为一位发明家或企业家，你必须得是个乐天派。

examples.en: If any of you end up being entrepreneur, which I hope you will be, what do you have in store for yourself, and what does that journey look like?
examples.zh: 如果你们当中任何一个人成了企业家，这也是我希望你们做到的，你自己会有什么样的储备，那样的一段旅程又将是什么样的？

examples.en: How would you define personal growth as an entrepreneur?
examples.zh: 你会如何定义,一个企业家的个人成长？

words.definition: one of the foods that you use to make a particular food or dish; element, factor, material, basic, essential
words.translation: 成分, 因素；原料；要素；组成部分

examples.en: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 把所有食材都放在一个大碗里。

examples.en: The food is home-cooked using fresh ingredients.
examples.zh: 这种食物是用新鲜的食材在家里烹制的。

words.definition: important; obvious, excellent, remarkable, brilliant, marked
words.translation: 显著的,杰出的, 突出的；突出的，显著的；杰出的；卓越的

examples.en: a prominent Russian scientist
examples.zh: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

examples.en: The World Cup will have a prominent place on the agenda.
examples.zh: 世界杯赛将占据议程表的重要位置。

words.definition: the act of travelling through a place in order to find out about it or find something such as oil or gold in it; inquiry, detection, search
words.translation: 探险, 探测；探测；探究；踏勘

examples.en: oil exploration facilities in the North Sea
examples.zh: 北海的石油勘探设施

examples.en: You can then use this hut as a base for explorations into the mountains around.
examples.zh: 你到时可以把这间小屋当大本营，去周围的山里探险。

words.definition: a style of clothes, hair etc that is popular at a particular time; to shape or make something, using your hands or only a few tools; mode, style, type; make use of, employ, influence, exercise, shift
words.translation: 方式,流行款式；形成,塑造；时尚；[服装]时装；样式；时髦人物；使用；改变；做成…的形状

examples.en: Young people are very concerned with fashion
examples.zh: 年轻人很关注时尚。

examples.en: Hats like that just aren’t the fashion.
examples.zh: 那样的帽子不流行。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger; panic, tocsin; exercise, alert, warn
words.translation: 警报 vt恐吓, 警告；警报，[安全]警告器；惊慌；警告；使惊恐

examples.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
examples.zh: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

examples.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
examples.zh: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

examples.en: a sophisticated alarm system
examples.zh: 精密的警报系统

words.definition: the man that a woman is married to; hubby, worse half
words.translation: 丈夫

examples.en: Have you met my husband Roy?
examples.zh: 你见过我的丈夫罗伊吗？

words.definition: to continue to do something that has already been planned or started; occur, happen, travel, pursue
words.translation: 进行,继续下去；开始；继续进行；发生；行进

examples.en: Before proceeding further, we must define our terms.
examples.zh: 我们必须先定义术语，然后再往下展开。

words.definition: something that is an impressive achievement, because it needs a lot of skill, strength etc to do; merit, exploit; becoming, shaped, applicable, likely, possible
words.translation: 功绩，伟业；功绩，壮举；技艺表演；合适的；灵巧的

examples.en: A racing car is an extraordinary feat of engineering.
examples.zh: 赛车是工程学的一项非凡业绩。

words.definition: the space between two straight lines or surfaces that join each other, measured in degrees; fish, figure for; hao, jiao
words.translation: [数]角,角落；钓鱼；谋取；角度，[数]角

examples.en: You didn’t measure the angle accurately.
examples.zh: 你没有量准角度。

words.definition: to organize an activity so that the people involved in it work well together and achieve a good result; paratactic, tantamount; adjust, restructure; sort, concert
words.translation: 调节，协调；并列的；[物化]同等的；调整；整合；协调

examples.en: The agencies are working together to co-ordinate policy on food safety.
examples.zh: 这些机构在共同合作为食品安全政策做协调工作。

words.definition: to use something new or diffe-rent instead of something else; replacement, proxy; supply, fill in; replace, cover for, take the place of somebody, stand in for sb
words.translation: 代替,替换；代用品；代替者；[计]替代；代替

examples.en: Michael Owen had to be substituted after 20 minutes on the field.
examples.zh: 迈克尔·欧文上场 20 分钟后，不得不被换下。

words.definition: a look that clearly expresses the way someone feels, even though nothing is said; significant, eloquent
words.translation: 意味深长的；有意义的

examples.en: Sam and Barbara exchanged meaningful glances.
examples.zh: 萨姆和芭芭拉交换了会意的眼神。

words.definition: Agrarian means relating to the ownership and use of land, especially farmland, or relating to the part of a society or economy that is concerned with agriculture; ground, earth's
words.translation: 有关土地的, 耕地的；土地的；耕地的；有关土地的

examples.en: an agrarian economy (=  based on farming  )
examples.zh: 农业经济

words.definition: a spoken or written piece of information that you send to another person or leave for them; news, prediction, word; inform of, report to; give notice, instruct, advise of
words.translation: 消息,信息；消息；差使；启示；预言；广告词；报信，报告；[通信]报文；通知

examples.en: He left a message saying he would probably be a little late.
examples.zh: 他留言说可能会晚一点来。

words.definition: the empty space at the side of a page; profit, gain, brink, suburb
words.translation: 边缘,余地,页边空白；[心理]边缘；[会计]利润，余裕；[印刷]页边的空白

examples.en: Someone had scribbled a note in the margin .
examples.zh: 有人在页边写了条批注。

examples.en: Use double spacing and wide margins to leave room for comments.
examples.zh: 采用双倍行距和宽阔的页边空白，以便留出地方写评注。

words.definition: a vehicle that flies through the air and has one or more engines; plane, aeroplane
words.translation: 飞机；[航]飞机

examples.en: The airplane cracked up in landing.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在着陆时坠毁。

examples.en: The new airplane flies at twice the speed of sound.
examples.zh: 这架新式飞机以两倍于音速的速度飞行。

examples.en: We beamed the airplane down safely.
examples.zh: 我们给飞机导航使它安全降落。

words.definition: a service such as gas or electricity provided for people to use; practical use, public facility; applied, universal, current
words.translation: 效用,公用；实用；效用；公共设施；功用；实用的；通用的；有多种用途的

examples.en: Does your rent include utilities?
examples.zh: 你的房租包括公用事业费吗？

words.definition: to tell someone that something bad or dangerous may happen, so that they can avoid it or prevent it; alarm, jack, message, alert
words.translation: 警告，告诫；警告，提醒；通知

examples.en: ‘Be careful, the rocks are slippery,’ Alex warned.
examples.zh: “小心，岩石很滑。”亚历克斯提醒说。

words.definition: the reason that makes someone do something, especially when this reason is kept hidden; incentive, goals, intention, topic, purpose; prompt, stir up
words.translation: 动机，目的；主题；使产生动机，激起

examples.en: What do you suppose the killer’s motive was?
examples.zh: 你认为凶手的动机是什么？

examples.en: The violence was clearly prompted by political motives.
examples.zh: 这次暴力事件显然是由政治动机引发的。

examples.en: It’s not the kind of thing he’d do unless he had an ulterior motive (= a reason he kept hidden ) .
examples.zh: 他不会做这种事的，除非他另有隐情。

words.definition: a written or printed message that is usually put in an envelope and sent by mail; literature, knowledge, learning, study, certificate
words.translation: 信，函件，字母；信；[语]字母，文字；证书；文学，学问；字面意义

examples.en: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
examples.zh: 英语字母表有26个字母。

words.definition: contrary ideas, opinions, or actions are completely different and opposed to each other; used to add to a negative statement, to disagree with a negative statement by someone else, or to answer no to a question; opposite, adverse, counter, against, cross; counter, backward, conversely, inversely; inverse, verso
words.translation: 相反的；反面, 相反；对立的；相反地；相反；反面

examples.en: Two contrary views emerged.
examples.zh: 出现了两种相反的观点。

examples.en: The men shouted contrary orders.
examples.zh: 这些人大声喊叫的命令互相矛盾。

words.definition: A canoe is a small, narrow boat that you move through the water using a stick with a wide end called a paddle
words.translation: 独木舟

examples.en: Nearby were two canoes in which they had cine to the island.
examples.zh: 附近有二条独木舟，他们就是坐这个独木舟来的。

examples.en: The rivers are our brothers; they quench our thirst. The rivers carry our canoes, and feed our children.
examples.zh: 我们兄弟的河流解了我们的渴，河流载送我们的独木舟而且喂养了我们的孩子。

examples.en: When we reached the downstream end of the island and were about to get back into our inflatable rafts Cho said, "Ed – look behind you". I turned and saw five canoes paddling up to us.
examples.zh: 当我们走到小岛在下游处的顶端准备回到橡皮艇上时，裘对我说，“艾德，看后面，”我回过头来，看见有五条独木舟正向我们划来。

words.definition: enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose; suitable, competent, appropriate, proper, becoming
words.translation: 足够的,适当的；充足的；适当的；胜任的

examples.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
examples.zh: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

examples.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
examples.zh: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

examples.en: The standard of his work is barely adequate .
examples.zh: 他的工作水准勉强合格。

words.definition: a common bird with shiny black feathers that lives especially in cities; cowbird, blackbird
words.translation: 欧掠鸟；桥墩尖端分水桩；挡水木桩；燕八哥；[鸟]欧椋鸟

words.definition: if two things or ideas correspond, the parts or information in one relate to the parts or information in the other; cotton, identify, square, accord, meet with
words.translation: 符合,相当；符合，一致；相应；通信

examples.en: The two halves of the document did not correspond.
examples.zh: 这份文件的前后两部分不相符。

words.translation: 第十五

examples.en: So, initially they came up with four lines and then eventually five and even six, and then they went back to five by the fifteenth century.
examples.zh: 那么,他们最初提出的是四条线,但是最终却是五条线,甚至六条线,然后在十五世纪又回到了五条线

examples.en: When oil paint replaced tempera in the fifteenth century, it helped painters to deal with difficult subjects like the human figure because, unlike tempera, oil can be blended and overpainted.
examples.zh: 油画颜料在十五世纪取代蛋彩的时候, 画家开始能够处理一些诸如人像画等困难的题材, 因为不象蛋彩,油画颜料可以混合和覆盖.

examples.en: It is unacceptable that here, in the country that invented the Internet, we fell to fifteenth in the world in broadband deployment.
examples.zh: 令人无法接受的是，在这个发明互联网的国家，我们宽带数量的排名却滑到了世界第十五位。

words.definition: to enter a country, town, or area using military force, in order to take control of it; strike, make inroads into; make inroads into, intrude upon
words.translation: 侵略；侵袭；侵扰；涌入；侵入；侵犯

examples.en: The Romans invaded Britain 2,000 years ago.
examples.zh: 2,000年前古罗马人入侵了英国。

words.definition: easily upset or offended by events or things that people say; vulnerable, subtle, quick
words.translation: 敏感的,灵敏的；[仪]敏感的；灵敏的；感光的；易受伤害的

examples.en: a very sensitive child
examples.zh: 一个很敏感的小孩

words.definition: the amount of water contained in the air; wet, moisture capacity
words.translation: 湿气,潮湿；[气象]湿度；湿气

examples.en: The room is kept at 72 degrees and 50% relative humidity.
examples.zh: 房间的温度保持在72度，相对湿度50%。

words.definition: a substance that is added to food to improve its taste, appearance etc; addition agent, make weight; attached, plus, more, second, excess
words.translation: 附加的；添加剂；[建][物化]添加剂，添加物；[数]附加的；加法的

examples.en: As you build these kinds of simulations, or anything like this, you need to think through whether things should be multiplicative or additive.
examples.zh: 正如你建立各种仿真程序，或者类似的仿真程序时，你应该去想一想,他们应该是用加法还是用乘法。

examples.en: When these dots are projected onto the total resources columns (top of figure), the results are additive.
examples.zh: 当这些点映射到总资源列（图的顶部）上时，结果是附加的。

words.definition: to want something to happen or be true and to believe that it is possible or likely; wish, pleasure, confidence, promise, anticipation; want, desire to; rely, depend, expect, like, trust
words.translation: 希望,信心；希望；期望；信心；期待；信赖

examples.en: I do hope everything goes well.
examples.zh: 我真心希望一切顺利。

examples.en: It was hoped that the job would be filled by a local person.
examples.zh: 希望该职位由当地人来担任。

examples.en: Let’s just hope someone finds her bag.
examples.zh: 希望有人找到她的提包。

words.definition: in the outer area of something, or relating to this area; secondary, supporting, minor
words.translation: 外围的,不重要的；[昆][计]外围的；次要的

examples.en: the city’s peripheral suburbs
examples.zh: 这座城市的市郊

examples.en: the peripheral nervous system
examples.zh: 周围神经系统

words.translation: 埃及

examples.en: They caravaned through Egypt.
examples.zh: 他们结队在埃及坐大篷车旅行。

examples.en: The established religion of Egypt is Islam.
examples.zh: 埃及的国教是伊斯兰教。

examples.en: Glazes had been used from ancient times in Egypt.
examples.zh: 埃及自古代起就使用釉料。

words.definition: firmly, equably
words.translation: 稳定地,坚定地；稳定地；稳固地；有规则地

examples.en: The bus climbed steadily up the road.
examples.zh: 公共汽车稳定地沿公路向上爬。

words.definition: smell, wind, fame
words.translation: 气味；名声

examples.en: I smelled the odor of money.
examples.zh: 我闻到了一股铜臭气。

examples.en: The researchers demonstrate that it is possible to generate odor in a compact device that can fit on the back of a TV with potentially thousands of odors.
examples.zh: 研究员表示，将一个可以散发上千种气味的小型设备安装在电视背后，从而实现电视(根据情景)生成气味是可能的。

examples.en: Pewter has an odor.
examples.zh: 锡器有一股臭气。

words.definition: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it; shear, strip of
words.translation: 剥夺,使丧失；使丧失，剥夺

examples.en: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
examples.zh: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

words.definition: to make a bullet or  arrow  come from a weapon; flight, pot, screen, spring; put, screen, pop; photography, rapid, rush
words.translation: 发射, 开枪；射击，射中；[摄]拍摄；发芽；使爆炸；给…注射；射击；拍电影；摄影；狩猎；急流

examples.en: Don’t shoot! I’m coming out with my hands up.
examples.zh: 别开枪！ 我现在举起双手出来。

examples.en: The soldiers had orders to shoot to kill (= shoot at someone with the intention of killing them ) .
examples.zh: 士兵奉命开枪射杀。

words.definition: to get control of a country by fighting; defeat, master; overcome, win the day
words.translation: 征服, 战胜；战胜，征服；攻克，攻取；胜利；得胜

examples.en: The Normans conquered England in 1066.
examples.zh: 诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。

examples.en: Egypt was conquered by the Persian king Kambyses.
examples.zh: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

words.definition: the quality of remaining faithful to your friends, principles, country etc; faith, devotion
words.translation: 忠诚；忠心；忠实

examples.en: the agony of divided loyalties (= loyalty to two different or opposing people ) for the children in a divorce
examples.zh: 父母离婚过程中孩子两面都要依顺的痛苦

words.definition: used to describe something that is surprising because you were not expecting it; sudden, surprising
words.translation: 想不到的,意外的；意外的，想不到的

examples.en: The experiment produced some unexpected results.
examples.zh: 这次试验产生了一些意想不到的结果。

examples.en: Her death was totally unexpected.
examples.zh: 她的死完全出人意料。

examples.en: Hague’s announcement was not entirely unexpected.
examples.zh: 黑格的声明并非完全出乎意料。

words.definition: a very large strong bird with a beak like a hook that eats small animals, birds etc; hawk
words.translation: 鹰；鹰状标饰

examples.en: The eagle drooped its wings.
examples.zh: 那只鹰收拢双翅做俯冲。

examples.en: Maybe they could not hold on to the arrival of the spring, but the female eagle thought what if their father could bring back the food?
examples.zh: 它们或许已经挨不到春天的到来了。 雌鹰这样想，但如果它们的爸爸会把食物带来呢？

examples.en: She lacks the skill to accomplish this, but recognizes that an eagle can help her.
examples.zh: 她缺乏完成这项任务的能力，不过她认识到老鹰可以帮助她。

words.definition: a person or thing that exchanges; bourse, interchanger
words.translation: 交换器, 换热器；交换器；交易所；交换程序

examples.en: The Zurich laboratory has already constructed a prototype that feeds the water from the chips into a heat-exchanger.
examples.zh: 苏黎世实验室已经建造了一个模型，把从芯片中流出的水引入一个热交换器。

examples.en: Reaction Engines is focusing on a critical piece of technology called a heat exchanger, needed to rapidly cool the air before it can be used by the spaceplane's engines.
examples.zh: 反应引擎部着力于一种称为热交换的关键技术,该技术需要快速冷却空气,在其可被空天飞机的引擎利用之前。

words.definition: in a way that must be obeyed; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, fully
words.translation: 严格地；完全地；确实地

examples.en: Alcohol is strictly forbidden on school premises.
examples.zh: 校内严禁喝酒。

examples.en: The ban on hunting is not strictly enforced .
examples.zh: 狩猎禁令并未严格执行。

words.translation: 精神动力的

examples.en: In the early 1900s, Sigmund Freud developed the psychodynamic view of human behavior.
examples.zh: 早在20世纪的初期，西格蒙德•弗洛伊德就开发了人类行为的精神动力观。

examples.en: This observation has led to a "psychodynamic" interpretation of the individual's preference for the submissive/bottom or dominant/top role in a BDSM sexual encounter or scene.

examples.zh: 通过一道楼梯和一台电梯连接两层楼和封闭的屋顶平台。

examples.zh: 镜墙、天窗和大型的金属镀窗俯瞰花园和阳台，让这个现代空间充满光线。

words.definition: something that is kept hidden or that is known about by only a few people; privacy, confidence, mystery, tips, stealth; classified, underground, chamber, inside, confidential

examples.zh: 这两个男人相互仇视，这算不得什么秘密。

examples.zh: 别担心，我会替你保守秘密。

words.definition: land that is always very wet or covered with a layer of water; wetland, cienaga; embog; sunk
words.translation: 沼泽,湿地；[地理]沼泽；湿地；使陷于沼泽；使沉没；使陷入困境；下沉；陷入沼泽；陷入困境；不知所措（过去式swamped，过去分词swamped，现在分词swamping，第三人称单数swamps，名词swampiness，形容词swampy）

examples.zh: 我整个晚上都在这条路后面的一个沼泽地旁听蛙鸣。

examples.zh: 对于一些微生物而言，没有什么比生活在充满了锌、砷和镉之类的重金属的有毒淤泥中更加惬意的。

examples.en: The new standards adopted will go a long way towards protecting human health, as they set out new, maximum limits for lead in fish, cadmium in rice, marine bivalve molluscs and cephalopods.
examples.zh: 通过的这些新标准将对保护人类健康大有帮助，因为它们提出鱼类中铅以及大米、海洋双壳贝类和头足类动物中镉的新的最高限量。

words.definition: someone who works in a bank in an important position; money changer
words.translation: 银行家；[金融]银行家；银行业者；掘土工

examples.zh: …一位投资银行家。

words.definition: to choose someone or something for a particular job or purpose; specify, ticket, name, appoint; assigned, named, appointed
words.translation: 指明,指定；指定；指派；标出；把…定名为；指定的；选定的

examples.en: Some of the rooms were designated as offices.
examples.zh: 其中一些房间是被指定用作办公室的。

words.definition: a painting, design etc which contains shapes or images that do not look like real things or people; brief, summary, resume; deep, nonobjective; extract, brief
words.translation: 摘要,抽象；[图情]摘要；抽象；抽象的概念；抽象的；深奥的；提取；使……抽象化

examples.en: Talking about crime in the abstract just isn’t enough.
examples.zh: 抽象地谈论犯罪根本不足以说明问题。

words.definition: a process in which you make a judgment about a person or situation, or the judgment you make; appraisal, evaluation, valuation, estimate
words.translation: 估计；评估；评定；[税收]估价

examples.zh: 阅读评估测试

words.definition: the fact of being more powerful, more important, or more noticeable than other people or things; governance, superiority, advantage, disposal, edge
words.translation: 支配,优势；[植]优势；统治；支配

examples.zh: 最近的战斗似乎是冲突各方在试图争夺控制权。

words.definition: a strong feeling of wanting to hurt or criticize someone because they have done something bad to you or been unkind to you; wrath, bile; provoke, enrage; chafe at, be hot under the collar

examples.zh: 民众对政府越来越不满。

words.definition: a musical instrument made of skin stretched over a circular frame, played by hitting it with your hand or a stick; kettle
words.translation: 鼓；鼓声

examples.zh: 一面低音大鼓

examples.zh: 1,000人打着鼓扛着旗游行。

words.translation: 园艺；[园艺]园艺，园艺学

examples.zh: 园艺是这个地区源远流长的传统。

examples.zh: 因此，为了赚取植物科学奖章，一个童子军可以选择农学，园艺，或田野植物学。

examples.en: All volunteers first go through orientation sessions, which are followed with one of three more specific training tracks:horticulture, “Ambassadors, ” and animal care.
examples.zh: 所有的志愿者先要通过新成员训练，然后再在三种特殊训练规划（园艺、“大使”和动物照料）中选择一种。

words.definition: to press something or make it smaller so that it takes up less space, or to become smaller; impact, pack
words.translation: 压缩,摘要叙述；压缩，压紧；精简

examples.zh: 轻质丝绸最适合制作降落伞，因为这种面料便于压缩，而且展开迅速。

examples.zh: 伊索贝尔紧闭着双唇点了点头。

examples.zh: 矿工使用钻岩机和压缩空气来凿穿坚硬的岩石。

words.definition: a set of basic laws and principles that a country or organization is governed by; formation, fabric, structure, build, make
words.translation: 宪法,章程；宪法；体质；章程；构造

examples.zh: 言论自由的权利被写入美国宪法。

examples.zh: 欠下巨额债务的学生

examples.zh: 莱斯利的童年很不幸。

examples.zh: 不幸的婚姻

examples.zh: 而班图人喜欢硬质玉米。

examples.zh: 她穿梭在宾客中间和他们打招呼。

examples.en: Saturday’s game was watched by a capacity crowd (= the maximum number of people that a sports ground etc can hold ) .
examples.zh: 星期六的比赛座无虚席。

words.definition: used to say that you think something is probably true; probably, possibly, maybe
words.translation: 大概,可能,据推测；大概；推测起来；可假定

examples.en: It’s raining, which presumably means that your football match will be cancelled.
examples.zh: 下雨了，这可能意味着你们的足球比赛要取消。

words.definition: the chemical processes by which food is changed into energy in your body
words.translation: 新陈代谢

examples.en: This drug speeds up your metabolism.
examples.zh: 这种药物会加快你的新陈代谢。

words.definition: to move an organ, piece of skin etc from one person’s body and put it into another as a form of medical treatment; remove, transfer of culture; implantation, engraftment; remove, move
words.translation: 移栽,移植 n(器官)移植；[林]移植；迁移；使移居；移植器官；被移植物；移居者；移居

examples.en: The operation to transplant a kidney is now fairly routine.
examples.zh: 移植肾脏的手术如今相当常见。

words.definition: if someone represses upsetting feelings, memories etc, they do not allow themselves to express or think about them; restrict, control, stay; choke back, to suppress
words.translation: 抑制，镇压；抑制；镇压（叛乱等）；约束；镇压

examples.en: He had long ago repressed the painful memories of his childhood.
examples.zh: 他长久压抑着儿时的痛苦记忆。

words.definition: a railway system that runs under the ground below a big city; sub, metro; tube
words.translation: 地铁, 地下通道；[铁路]地铁；地道；[铁路]乘地铁

examples.en: the New York City subway
examples.zh: 纽约市的地铁

examples.en: a crowded subway station
examples.zh: 拥挤的地铁站

examples.en: Boston has the oldest subway system in the US.
examples.zh: 波士顿拥有美国最老的地铁运输系统。

words.definition: relating to the place in an area, country etc where something or someone is
words.translation: 地理(学)的

examples.en: their geographical proximity to Japan (= nearness to Japan )
examples.zh: 它们和日本相邻的地理位置

words.definition: a feeling that you are proud of something that you or someone connected with you has achieved; selfrespect, pretension; exalt; glory, be proud of
words.translation: 自豪；骄傲；自尊心；使得意，以…自豪

examples.en: He wore his medals with pride.
examples.zh: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

examples.en: The people have a sense of pride in their community.
examples.zh: 人们对自己的社区有一种自豪感。

examples.en: His heart swelled with pride when his daughter came in.
examples.zh: 女儿进来时他的内心充满了自豪感。

words.definition: a large piece of electrical kitchen equipment, shaped like a cupboard, used for keeping food and drink cool; icebox, freezer
words.translation: 电冰箱；[制冷]冰箱，冷藏库

examples.en: My refrigerator suddenly started kicking up yesterday.
examples.zh: 我的冰箱昨晚突然出了故障。

examples.en: The minute Tom came home he beelined for the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 汤姆一回到家就直奔冰箱而来。

examples.en: Letters have been pouring into the office complaining about this kind of refrigerator.
examples.zh: 办公室连续收到大批信件抱怨这种电冰箱。

words.definition: a tree with leaves shaped like needles that do not fall off in winter; firtree
words.translation: [植]冷杉；[木]冷杉；枞木

examples.en: a fir tree
examples.zh: 冷杉树

words.definition: to keep something so that it can be used by a particular person or for a particular purpose; store, repertory; stay at, save from; book for, make reservation
words.translation: 储备,保留；[贸易][金融]储备，储存；自然保护区；[军][林]预备队；储备金；[贸易][金融]储备；保留；预约；预订

examples.en: reserved parking spaces
examples.zh: 预留的停车位

words.definition: the place where a trial is held, or the people there, especially the judge and the  jury  who examine the evidence and decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty; playfield, banc; invite, secure, spell, incur; woo
words.translation: 法庭，庭院；[法]法院；球场；朝廷；奉承；招致（失败、危险等）；向…献殷勤；设法获得；求爱

examples.en: It could not be proved in a court of law.
examples.zh: 这无法在法庭上证实。

examples.en: The court case lasted six weeks.
examples.zh: 这场诉讼持续了六个星期。

examples.en: Four people will appear in court today, charged with fraud.
examples.zh: 今天将有四个人因被指控犯有欺诈罪出庭受审。

words.translation: [生]超个体(指群居昆虫等的群体)

examples.en: In fact, the superorganism scenario is in a sense just the cosmic flip side of the diagnosis offered by Carr and other techno-skeptics.
examples.zh: 事实上，在卡尔和其他科技怀疑论者的诊断里，超个体的假设在某种意义上只不过是宇宙的反面。

words.definition: A calculation is something that you think about and work out mathematically. Calculation is the process of working something out mathematically.; computation, estimation, appraisal, valuation, count
words.translation: 计算,考虑；[数]计算；估计；计算的结果；深思熟虑

examples.en: Leonard made a rapid calculation: he'd never make it in time.
examples.zh: 伦纳德做了个快速的估算：他不可能及时做完。

words.definition: rational thoughts, decisions etc are based on reasons rather than emotions; reasonable, logical, possible, just, legitimate
words.translation: 理性的,合理的；合理的；理性的

examples.en: Parents need to be fully informed so they can make a rational decision.
examples.zh: 父母需要充分了解情况，这样才可以作出合理的决定。

examples.en: I’m sure there’s a rational explanation for all this.
examples.zh: 我相信这一切都有合理的解释。

examples.en: It’s impossible to have a rational conversation with him.
examples.zh: 不可能和他进行理性的谈话。

words.definition: a standard that you use to judge something or make a decision about something; standard, formula, level, prototype, norm
words.translation: 标准；（批评判断的）[标准]标准；准则；规范；准据

examples.en: the criteria we use to select candidates
examples.zh: 我们挑选候选人的标准

words.definition: cloth made from the flax plant, used to make high quality clothes, home decorations etc; flax; flaxen
words.translation: 亚麻布（制品）；亚麻布，亚麻线；[纺]亚麻制品；亚麻的；[纺]亚麻布制的

examples.en: a linen jacket
examples.zh: 亚麻布夹克

words.translation: (纽约的）黑人住宅区

examples.en: It was winter, and I was in Harlem.
examples.zh: 这是一个冬天，我是在黑人住宅区。

examples.en: So was Harlem: Tear gas hung in the air as I came out of the subway on West 96th Street.
examples.zh: 黑人住宅区也是如此：我走出西区第96街的地铁站，空气中弥漫着催泪瓦斯。

examples.en: The study included children who were born to non-smoking Black and Dominican American women age 18 to 35 who resided in Washington Heights, Harlem or the South Bronx in New York.
examples.zh: 研究中包括住在纽约华盛顿高地、黑人住宅区和南布朗克斯，年龄从18岁到35岁的妇女的孩子，他们的母亲是不吸烟的多米尼加人。

words.translation: 奥尔良[法国]

words.definition: the type of activity or subject that a person or organization seems most interested in and gives most attention to; aspect, way, quarter, guiding, adaptation
words.translation: 方向，目标；方向；[测]定向；适应；情况介绍；向东方

examples.en: The party has a broadly socialist orientation.
examples.zh: 该政党大体上倾向于社会主义。

words.definition: to help a skill, feeling, idea etc develop over a period of time; cultivate, rear, raise, plant, mother
words.translation: 收养；培养，促进；培养；养育，抚育；抱（希望等）

examples.en: The bishop helped foster the sense of a community embracing all classes.
examples.zh: 主教鼓励一种包容各个阶层的社区精神。

words.definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid; certain, necessary, automatic
words.translation: 不可避免的, 必然的；必然的，不可避免的

examples.en: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.
examples.zh: 危机的进一步升级现在看来已不可避免。

words.definition: causing a lot of disagreement, because many people have strong opinions about the subject being discussed; disputed, questioned
words.translation: 有争议的,引起争论的；有争议的；有争论的

examples.en: the controversial issue of welfare reform
examples.zh: 福利改革这一有争议的话题

examples.en: a highly controversial (= very controversial ) plan to flood the valley in order to build a dam
examples.zh: 一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划

examples.en: He is a controversial figure (= person who does controversial things ) in the art world.
examples.zh: 他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

words.definition: to think about something that you would like to happen or have; come to mind, bethink of; voice, aspirations; ideal, unreasonable
words.translation: 做梦 n梦,梦想；梦想；做梦，梦见；想到；梦想，愿望；[心理]梦；做梦；梦的；理想的；不切实际的

examples.en: She had been dreaming and had not followed the conversation.
examples.zh: 她一直在走神，没注意听谈话。

words.translation: 地理(学)的

examples.en: User community and geographic distribution of users.
examples.zh: 用户社区和用户的地理分布。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes a film or picture appear on a screen or flat surface; projection apparatus, diascope
words.translation: 放映机；[仪][光]投影仪；探照灯；设计者

examples.en: ...a slide projector.
examples.zh: …幻灯机。

words.definition: a box containing moving pictures that you look at through a small hole; zoetrope, thaumatrope
words.translation: 西洋镜

examples.en: The cinema did not emerge as a form of mass consumption until its technology evolved from the initial "peepshow" format to the point where images were projected on a screen in a darkened treater.
examples.zh: 直到科技发展使得最初的西洋镜形式到如今可以在漆黑的戏院里投放大屏幕的戏剧，电影才第一次得以成为一种大众消费品。

examples.en: The cinema did not emerge as a form of mass consumption until its technology evolved from the initial "peepshow" format to the point where images were projected on a screen in a darkened treater.
examples.zh: 知道电影技术从最初的西洋镜格式进化到图像可以在漆黑的影院中放映到屏幕上，电影才以大批量生产的模式出现。

words.definition: a plant with red, white, or blue flowers; windflower
words.translation: [植]银莲花, [动]海葵；银莲花；银莲花属

examples.en: In the spring all everything around the place is covered with primroses. At the moment wood anemone is abloom.
examples.zh: 春天来了，这里周围的一切都被樱草花淹没，而此刻银莲花正在愉快的盛放。

examples.en: A big red anemone made for perfect negative space behind the two nudis, and the picture turned out to be one of my very favorites from this trip.
examples.zh: 一个巨大的红色海葵在这两个裸体动物的后面，权充为完美实体周围的背景空间，照片画面的结果竟然是从我此行中最喜爱的一个。

words.definition: the tendency to use one hand more skilfully or in preference to the other
words.translation: 用右手或左手的习惯

examples.en: An important factor that the researchers took note of was the participants' handedness.
examples.zh: 研究人员考察的一个重要因素是参与者的用手习惯。

words.definition: when people live or work together without fighting or disagreeing with each other; peace, keeping
words.translation: 协调,融洽；协调；和睦；融洽；调和

examples.en: I do believe it is possible for different ethnic groups to live together in harmony.
examples.zh: 我确信不同民族的人民可以融洽相处。

words.definition: a dry brown fruit inside a hard shell, that grows on a tree; nutsert, female screw
words.translation: 坚果；螺母，螺帽；难对付的人，难解的问题

examples.en: a pine nut
examples.zh: 松子

examples.en: roasted nuts
examples.zh: 烘坚果

examples.en: We were sitting round the fire cracking nuts (= opening them ).
examples.zh: 我们围坐在火炉边夹碎坚果。

words.definition: any of various fishes having elongated jaws, esp any fish of the family Istiophoridae, such as the spearfish and marlin
words.translation: 长嘴鱼,尖嘴鱼

words.definition: exactly the same, or very similar; self, same
words.translation: 同一的,相同的；[数]同一的；完全相同的

examples.en: four identical houses
examples.zh: 四幢一模一样的房子

words.definition: mutual feelings such as respect, trust, or hatred are feelings that two or more people have for each other; corporate, common, collective, joint
words.translation: 相互的,共有的；共同的；相互的，彼此的

examples.en: I didn’t like Dev, and the feeling seemed to be mutual.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢德夫，他好像也不喜欢我。

examples.en: The two men were a mutual admiration society , gushing about how much they were learning from each other.
examples.zh: 两个男人互相吹捧，盛赞对方让自己受益匪浅。

words.definition: when the same thing keeps happening often, especially with the same amount of time between each occasion when it happens; balance, symmetry
words.translation: 规律性,规则性；[数]规则性；整齐；正规；匀称

examples.en: Climate change is disrupting the regularity of the seasons.
examples.zh: 气候的变化正在打乱季节的规律性。

words.definition: when you achieve something that you had planned or hoped for; implementation, completion
words.translation: 实现；领悟

examples.en: the realization of assets
examples.zh: 资产变现

words.definition: open circuit, clear the way for; till, plough; Dipper, Triones
words.translation: 耕, 犁；[农机]犁；耕地；破浪前进；开路；耕；似犁的工具；北斗七星

examples.en: He teamed one horse and one cow to a plow.
examples.zh: 他把一匹马和一头牛套在犁上。

examples.en: The huge animals use their heads like a plow to push snow aside in search of food.
examples.zh: 这些庞大的动物在找食物时用他们的头像犁一样将雪推到一边。

examples.en: In 1930, a farmer with a tractor-pulled plow, combine, and truck could do the job in 20 hours.
examples.zh: 1930年，农民使用拖拉机牵引的犁、联合收割机和卡车只需20小时便可完成这些工作。

words.definition: the minimum number, degree, or amount of something is the smallest or least that is possible, allowed, or needed; the smallest amount of something or number of things that is possible or necessary; lowest, least, smallest
words.translation: 最小的；最小值,；[数]最小的；最低的

examples.en: The minimum number of students we need to run the course is fifteen.
examples.zh: 我们开这门课程最少要有15个学生。

examples.en: The minimum age for retirement is 55.
examples.zh: 最小退休年龄为55岁。

words.definition: used to emphasize that the way you are describing something is really true; sincerely, really, true
words.translation: 真正地；忠实地；真实地，不假；真诚地

examples.en: His work is truly original.
examples.zh: 他的作品确实十分独特。

examples.en: Fawcett was a truly remarkable man.
examples.zh: 福西特是一位真正不同凡响的人。

examples.en: a truly great work of medieval literature
examples.zh: 一部真正伟大的中世纪文学作品

words.definition: a small model of a person or animal used as a decoration; statuette
words.translation: 小雕像；小雕像，小塑像

examples.en: Michelle and her mother once gave me a figurine of a beautiful black child sitting in a wheelchair.
examples.zh: 米歇尔和她的母亲曾经送给我一座小雕像，是一个坐在轮椅上的漂亮黑人小孩。

examples.en: It was very early in the morning while I was doing my prayer time when the figurine of Michelle, for no apparent reason, fell from my bookshelf to the floor.
examples.zh: 有一个很早的清晨，我正在祈祷，但是莫名其妙地，米歇尔的小雕像从书架上跌落到了地上。

examples.en: This recycled fair trade plastic bag chicken figurine is handcrafted by disadvantaged crafters in the townships near Cape Town, South Africa, and produced exclusively for Wow!
examples.zh: 这组可回收的平价公鸡小塑像是由一群南非开普敦附近乡镇的贫民工匠们手工制作完成，并且专供给WOW进口公司。

words.definition: a flat shape with three or more sides; NGon, stereogram
words.translation: [数]多角形,多边形；[数]多边形；多角形物体

examples.en: The color is used for the area covered by a (multi-)polygon or the line of a (multi-)linestring.
examples.zh: 颜色用于显示一个（多）多边形所覆盖的区域或一个（多）行字符串的行。

examples.en: If the horizontal line drawn is aligned with a polygon vertex, then only the segments that are below the line are counted.
examples.zh: 如果所绘制的水平线与一个多边形顶点对齐，那么只会计算位于该线下方的部分。

examples.en: Although the bounding box is a polygon defining the area represented for the user, I simplify and use one point of this data.
examples.zh: 尽管这个边界框是一个用于定义表示用户的区域的多边形，但我简化并使用这些数据的一个点。

words.definition: to suggest a possible explanation that has not yet been proved to be true; assume that, to suppose
words.translation: 假设,猜测；假设，假定

examples.en: To explain this, they hypothesize that galaxies must contain a great deal of missing matter which cannot be detected.
examples.zh: 为了解释这一点，他们假定银河系一定包含了大量无法探测到的不明物质。

words.definition: consumption, waste, wear
words.translation: 损耗；消耗；放血

examples.en: Overfishing not only causes depletion in individual fish stocks, but also disruption to entire ecosystems and food webs in the ocean.
examples.zh: 过度捕捞不仅引起个别鱼种的消耗，而且还引起海洋中整个生态系统和食物网的崩溃。

examples.en: This decreases the device thickness and depletion voltage and consequently reduces material quality requirements and cost of the detector material.
examples.zh: 这减少了设备的厚度和电压损耗，从而降低材料的质量要求和探测器的材料成本。

words.definition: to ask for something in a polite or formal way; asking, necessity, need, motion, want; exact, desire, call for
words.translation: 请求, 要求；[计]请求；需要；要求，[计]请求

examples.en: To request more information, please call our toll free number.
examples.zh: 欲知详情，请拨打我们的免费电话。

examples.en: You have to request permission if you want to take any photographs.
examples.zh: 拍照必须征得同意。

words.definition: the protection of natural things such as animals, plants, forests etc, to prevent them from being spoiled or destroyed; preservation, protection, maintenance, lee, safeguard
words.translation: 保存,保持；保存，保持；保护

examples.en: wildlife conservation
examples.zh: 野生生物保护

examples.en: a local conservation group
examples.zh: 当地的一个环境保护团体

words.definition: a clear liquid with a strong bad smell that is used for cleaning or in cleaning products; Amonia
words.translation: [化]氨, 氨水；[无化]氨，阿摩尼亚

examples.en: Dilute the ammonia with water before you use it.
examples.zh: 使用氨之前用水稀释它。

words.translation: 白令海和楚可奇海海域

words.definition: involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc; fierce, hard
words.translation: 猛烈的,暴力的；暴力的；猛烈的

examples.en: the increase in violent crime
examples.zh: 暴力犯罪的增多

examples.en: violent clashes between the police and demonstrators
examples.zh: 警方与示威者之间发生的暴力冲突

examples.en: 31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
examples.zh: 今天一天有31人在暴力事件中受伤。

words.definition: when someone or something arrives somewhere; coming, advent
words.translation: 到来, 到达；到来；到达；到达者

examples.en: Only the timely arrival of the police prevented the situation from becoming worse.
examples.zh: 警方及时赶到才阻止了事态恶化。

examples.en: Traffic problems account for one third of late arrivals.
examples.zh: 迟到的人有三分之一是因为交通问题。

words.definition: the natural process by which small pieces of rock, earth etc settle at the bottom of the sea etc and form a solid layer; settlement, precipitation
words.translation: 沉淀,沉降；[矿业][物化]沉降，[化学]沉淀

examples.en: Scientists estimate that human activities—such as pollution, global warming, and sedimentation—could kill 30 percent of reefs in the next three decades.
examples.zh: 科学家估计人类活动--例如污染、全球变暖和沉淀--会在接下来的三十年间杀死30%的暗礁。

examples.en: The natural sedimentation of cells due to gravity is balanced by the bioreactor's rotation, resulting in a gentle falling of cells within the media in the chamber.
examples.zh: 由重力作用导致的细胞的自然沉降被反应器的旋转所平衡掉，因而细胞能够在反应器腔内的培养基中温和地下降。

examples.en: When the brain relaxes, it’s like a sedimentation process in action.
examples.zh: 当大脑休息的时候，它犹如进入了一个问题沉淀处理的环节。

words.definition: having the shape of a rectangle; quartering
words.translation: 长方形的，矩形的；[数]矩形的；成直角的

examples.en: ...a rectangular table.
examples.zh: …一张长方形的桌子。

words.definition: a business that provides a particular service for people or organizations; procuration, intermediary agent
words.translation: 代理处, 中介；[贸易]代理，[经]中介；代理处，经销处

examples.en: We had to hire maids through an agency.
examples.zh: 我们得通过代理公司雇用女佣。

words.definition: a written set of questions which you give to a large number of people in order to collect information
words.translation: 调查表, 问卷

examples.en: Teachers will be asked to fill in a questionnaire.
examples.zh: 教师们将被要求填写一份调查问卷。

words.definition: a building where people go to  worship  , in the Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh, and Mormon religions; vihara, fane
words.translation: 庙, 寺；庙宇；寺院；神殿；太阳穴

examples.en: They lighted the temple with many candles.
examples.zh: 他们用许多蜡烛照亮这个寺庙。

examples.en: The entire valley reverberated with the sound of the temple bells.
examples.zh: 整个山谷回荡着庙宇的钟声。

examples.en: After the fire, nothing remained of the magnificent buildings of the temple.
examples.zh: 大火过后， 寺院里的那些雄伟建筑已荡然无存。

words.definition: far from towns or other places where people live; distant, lonely
words.translation: 遥远的, 偏僻的；遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的

examples.en: a remote border town
examples.zh: 一个偏远的边境小镇

examples.en: a fire in a remote mountain area
examples.zh: 偏远山区的火灾

words.definition: a black sticky substance that becomes hard when it dries, used for making the surface of roads; bitumen, chian
words.translation: 沥青；[材]沥青；[建]柏油

examples.en: These comprise asphalt, tar and waxes.
examples.zh: 其中包括沥青，焦油和蜡。

words.definition: a tree or bush that does not lose its leaves in winter; an evergreen tree or bush does not lose its leaves in winter; indeciduous
words.translation: 常绿树；常绿的；[林][植]常绿的；永葆青春的

examples.en: Holly, like ivy and mistletoe, is an evergreen.
examples.zh: 冬青与常春藤和槲寄生一样，也是一种常绿植物。

words.definition: a type of reptile that has four legs and a long tail; cabrite
words.translation: [动]蜥蜴；[脊椎]蜥蜴；类蜥蜴爬行动物

examples.en: Neither the lizard nor the glass has any secrets.
examples.zh: 无论是蜥蜴还是玻璃，都没有任何秘密。

examples.en: A lizard will regenerate its tail if it's cut off.
examples.zh: 蜥蜴的尾巴如被切掉，它会重新生出一条尾巴。

examples.en: Meetings are just one symptom of anorganization run by the lizard brain.
examples.zh: 会海只是这类靠蜥蜴脑运作的组织的一个症状。

words.definition: a small object that you keep in your house because it is beautiful rather than useful; decoration, adornment; paint, hang, modify, bedeck
words.translation: 装饰(品),美化；[建][服装]装饰；装饰物；教堂用品；[建][服装]装饰，修饰

examples.en: a shelf covered with books and ornaments
examples.zh: 摆满书籍和装饰品的架子

examples.en: a cabinet in which she kept her collection of china ornaments
examples.zh: 她放置瓷器摆设收藏品的柜子

words.definition: relating to being a parent and especially to being responsible for a child’s safety and development
words.translation: 父母的

examples.en: parental responsibility
examples.zh: 父母的责任

examples.en: Opening a new school will increase parental choice.
examples.zh: 开办一所新学校将会扩大父母的选择范围。

examples.en: Parental consent is required before the operation can take place.
examples.zh: 手术前须征得父母同意。

words.definition: a clear explanation or understanding of a particular subject; lumination, luminous intensity
words.translation: 阐明, 启发；[电]照明；[光]照度；启发；灯饰（需用复数）；阐明

examples.en: The only illumination came from a small window high in the opposite wall.
examples.zh: 惟一的照明来自对面墙上位于高处的一扇小窗户。

words.definition: physically strong and not likely to become ill or weak; robust, fit, sound, fine, well
words.translation: 健康的；健康的，健全的；有益于健康的

examples.en: a healthy baby boy
examples.zh: 健康的男婴

examples.en: I’ve always been perfectly healthy until now.
examples.zh: 直到现在，我的身体一直非常健康。

words.definition: to make something easier or less complicated; predigest, deformalize
words.translation: 单一化,简单化；简化；使单纯；使简易

examples.en: an attempt to simplify the tax system
examples.zh: 简化税制的尝试

examples.en: The law needs to be simplified.
examples.zh: 这部法律需要简化。

examples.en: a simplified version of the game
examples.zh: 这个游戏的简化版

words.definition: an imaginary line drawn around the middle of the Earth that is exactly the same distance from the North Pole and the South Pole; equinoctial
words.translation: 赤道；[天][地理]赤道

examples.en: The United States is north of the equator.
examples.zh: 美国位于赤道以北。

examples.en: In the hot zone near the equator the sun heats the air continually; hence the air there ascends.
examples.zh: 在靠近赤道的热带地区，太阳不断地加热那里的空气，于是那里的热空气就上升。

words.definition: a person or company that advertises something
words.translation: 登广告者,广告客户

examples.en: the Stockport Advertiser
examples.zh: 《斯托克波特广告报》

words.definition: Persians were the people who came from the ancient kingdom of Persia
words.translation: 波斯人[语]

words.definition: a newborn child, esp in the first week of life and up to four weeks old; baby, infant, babe
words.translation: 初生婴儿；婴儿

examples.en: “Full, unabashed, total irradiation of a neonate,” Dr. Sclafani said, adding, “This poor, defenseless baby.
examples.zh: “对初生婴儿过量的毫不在乎的辐射，”Sclafani医生说，又接着说，“这些可怜的毫无防护能力的婴儿。”

examples.en: Central lines allow the easy administration of fluids and medication through the navel, and the neonate can receive necessary antibiotics through blood vessels in the arm.
examples.zh: 中间管线经肚脐向新生儿输送流质和药物，新生儿通过手臂上的血管接受必要的抗生素治疗。

words.definition: a very high level of intelligence, mental skill, or ability, which only a few people have; energy, gift, spirit, soul, mind
words.translation: 天才, 天赋；天才，天赋；精神

examples.en: The film reveals Fellini’s genius.
examples.zh: 这部影片展现了费里尼的天赋。

examples.en: a work of pure genius
examples.zh: 天才之作

words.definition: a small creature like a  worm  with many legs that eats leaves and that develops into a  butterfly  or other flying insect; palmerworm, eruca
words.translation: 毛虫；[无脊椎]毛虫；[车辆]履带车

examples.en: A caterpillar transforms into a butterfly.
examples.zh: 毛虫变成了蝴蝶。

examples.en: The caterpillar might well give you nightmares though!
examples.zh: 但是，它的毛虫却可能引起你噩梦！

examples.en: The caterpillars grow.This caterpillar is big and fat.
examples.zh: 这毛虫渐渐成长.这个毛虫是大的和肥的。

words.definition: the process or system by which water or waste liquid flows away; wastewater, bailing
words.translation: 排水系统,下水道；[农工][建]排水；排水系统；污水；排水面积

examples.en: A handful of pebbles in the bottom of a flowerpot will help drainage.
examples.zh: 在花盆底下放一把鹅卵石能够帮助排水。

examples.en: a plan to improve the town’s drainage system
examples.zh: 改善城里排水系统的计划

words.definition: remarks that say what you think is bad about someone or something; comment, animadversion
words.translation: 批评, 批判；批评；考证；苛求

examples.en: Despite strong criticism , the new system is still in place.
examples.zh: 尽管遭到了猛烈的批评，新制度依然原封不动。

examples.en: There has been widespread criticism of the decision.
examples.zh: 这一决定受到了普遍的批评。

examples.en: We try to give students constructive criticism .
examples.zh: 我们设法对学生提出有建设性的批评。

words.definition: to make someone feel admiration and respect; propagate; print, mark, characteristic, trace
words.translation: 印,留下印象；盖印；强征；传送；给予某人深刻印象；印象，印记；特征，痕迹

examples.en: Steve borrowed his dad’s sports car to impress his girlfriend.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫借来他爸爸的跑车向女友炫耀。

examples.en: ‘He’s a lawyer?’ Mum looked suitably impressed (= as impressed as you would expect ).
examples.zh: “他是个律师？”妈妈看上去果然对他印象颇好。

words.definition: to make your mouth curve upwards, in order to be friendly or because you are happy or amused; beam on
words.translation: 微笑

examples.en: her smiling face
examples.zh: 她的笑脸

words.definition: a thin smooth soft cloth made from very thin thread which is produced by a silkworm; seda; filar, sericeous
words.translation: 丝绸；[纺]蚕丝；丝织物；丝的；丝绸的；丝制的

examples.en: pure silk stockings
examples.zh: 生丝面料的漂亮连衣裙

words.definition: disagreement, angry feelings, or unfriendliness between people; attrition, frottage
words.translation: 摩擦,摩擦力；[力]摩擦，摩擦力

examples.en: Putting oil on both surfaces reduces friction.
examples.zh: 两面都上油可减小摩擦力。

words.definition: a larger amount of something than is allowed or needed; immoderation, exorbitance; additional, added, attached, extra, plus
words.translation: 过量(的)；超过，超额；过度，过量；无节制；额外的，过量的；附加的

examples.en: After you apply the oil, wait 20 minutes before wiping off any excess.
examples.zh: 涂上油以后，等20分钟再擦掉多余部分。

words.definition: a blue-white metal that is used to make brass and to cover and protect objects made of iron. It is a chemical element: symbol Zn
words.translation: 锌

examples.en: Copper and zinc are fused to make brass.
examples.zh: 铜与锌熔合后形成黄铜。

examples.en: Some microbes like nothing better than to be nestled in a toxic sludge of heavy metals like zinc, arsenic and cadmium.
examples.zh: 对于一些微生物而言，没有什么比生活在充满了锌、砷和镉之类的重金属的有毒淤泥中更加惬意的。

words.definition: someone who is vulnerable can be easily harmed or hurt; sensitive, assailable
words.translation: 易受伤的，脆弱的；易受攻击的，易受…的攻击；易受伤害的；有弱点的

examples.en: He took advantage of me when I was at my most vulnerable.
examples.zh: 他在我最脆弱的时候利用了我。

examples.en: We work mainly with the elderly and other vulnerable groups.
examples.zh: 我们主要和老年人以及其他弱势群体打交道。

words.definition: a plan or suggestion which is made formally to an official person or group, or the act of making it; suggestion, advice, offer, instance, recommendation
words.translation: 提议,建议；提议，建议；求婚

examples.en: The president is to put forward new proposals for resolving the country's constitutional crisis.
examples.zh: 总统将提出解决国家宪法危机的新议案。

words.definition: in a way that produces the result that was intended; efficiently, actually, really, even
words.translation: 有效地；有效地，生效地；有力地；实际上

examples.en: Children have to learn to communicate effectively.
examples.zh: 小孩子应该学会有效地沟通。

words.definition: to leave somewhere very quickly, in order to escape from danger; lift, disappear, blank; escape, desert
words.translation: 逃避,逃跑,消失；逃走；消失，消散；逃跑，逃走；逃避

examples.en: His attackers turned and fled.
examples.zh: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

examples.en: Masaari spent six months in prison before fleeing the country .
examples.zh: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

words.definition: the period of time when a country is fighting a war
words.translation: 战时

examples.en: The government will commandeer ships only in wartime.
examples.zh: 政府只在战争时期征用船只。

words.translation: 幼发拉底河

examples.en: These grew up in the world's great fertile river valleys, the Euphrates, the Tigris and the Indus, but I want to start with the most famous river of them all, the Nile.
examples.zh: 最早期的城市与国家崛起于世界上伟大的肥沃河谷里，幼发拉底河、底格里斯河、印度河等等，然而我想从这所有河流中最著名的尼罗河开始。

examples.en: "The current level of the Euphrates cannot feed the small tributaries that give water to the marshlands, " he continued. "The people there have started to dig wells for their own survival.
examples.zh: “目前，幼发拉底河无法养活哪些给沼泽地供水的小支流了，”他继续说：“为了自己的生存，那里的居民已经开始自己挖井了。

examples.en: Droughts are not rare in Iraq, though officials say they have been more frequent in recent years. But drought is only part of what is choking the Euphrates and its larger, healthier twin, the Tigris.
examples.zh: 干旱原本在伊拉克也并不罕见 只是官员们说 这些年更加频繁了.但是干旱只是使幼发拉底河和她更广阔 更健康的胞胎底格里斯河枯萎的原因之一.

words.definition: a soft white substance that is used to make  plaster of paris; gesso, plaister
words.translation: 石膏,；[矿物]石膏；石膏肥料

examples.en: Their mouths were full of gypsum.
examples.zh: 他们的嘴里叼满了石膏。

examples.en: Modern Paris sits atop massive formations of limestone and gypsum.
examples.zh: 近代巴黎是由大块的石灰岩和石膏构成的。

examples.en: The yellow substance was gypsum, or calcium sulfate dehydrate, a common component of plaster.
examples.zh: 这种黄色的物质叫做脱水硫化钙，通常是石膏的一种组成部分。

words.definition: something that you are trying hard to achieve, especially in business or politics; impersonal, accusatival; intention, purpose, sake, target, goal
words.translation: 目标,目的a客观的；[医]客观的；目标的；[语]宾格的；目的；目标；[光]物镜；[语]宾格

examples.en: He vowed to achieve certain objectives before the end of his presidency.
examples.zh: 他立誓要在他的总统任期结束之前实现某些目标。

examples.en: the best way to accomplish your objectives
examples.zh: 完成目标的最佳方法

examples.en: The degree program has two main objectives.
examples.zh: 该学位课程有两个主要目标。

words.definition: a good idea about what you should do, write, say etc, especially one which you get suddenly; stimulation, afflatus
words.translation: 灵感；鼓舞；[生理]吸气；妙计

examples.en: The Malvern Hills have provided inspiration for many artists and musicians over the decades.
examples.zh: 几十年来，莫尔文丘陵为很多艺术家和音乐家提供了灵感。

examples.en: He raised his eyes to the altar as if seeking inspiration.
examples.zh: 他抬头看看祭坛，似乎在寻求灵感。

examples.en: He draws inspiration from ordinary scenes.
examples.zh: 他从日常生活中得到灵感。

words.definition: a place that is connected with a holy event or holy person, and that people visit to pray; temple, Holy Land; enshrine
words.translation: 圣地, 神龛；圣地；神殿；神龛；圣祠；将…置于神龛内；把…奉为神圣

examples.en: Elvis’ home has become a shrine for his fans.
examples.zh: 猫王的故居成了歌迷的朝圣地。

words.definition: melted snow or ice
words.translation: 冰雪融化成的水

examples.en: No one quite knows why glaciers and ice shelves are melting so fast, or how a meltwater lake on the Greenland ice sheet covering six square kilometres could drain away in 24 hours, as it did in 2006.
examples.zh: 没有人非常了解为什么冰架这么迅速的融化，也没人知道格林兰冰架上的一个覆盖6平方千米的融水湖会在24小时内流干——这在2006确实发生了。

examples.en: Blue stripes are often created when a crevice in the ice sheet fills up with meltwater and freezes so quickly that no bubbles form.
examples.zh: 蓝色条纹通常是当冰层上的裂缝被融冰填充再极速凝固的过程中没有产生气泡而形成的状态。

examples.en: The Gulf Stream carries tropical heat from the Caribbean to northern Europe but is already being disrupted by meltwater pouring from the Arctic as global warming intensifies.
examples.zh: 墨西哥湾流从加勒比海向北欧输送热带的热量，但是，随着全球变暖日益严重，它已经被北极注入的融冰水截断了。

words.definition: a part of an area of activity, especially of business, trade etc; ministry, division, department
words.translation: 部分, 部门；部门；扇形，扇区；象限仪；函数尺

examples.en: ...the nation's manufacturing sector.
examples.zh: …该国的制造部门。

words.definition: a root shaped like a ball that grows into a flower or plant; third wheel, electric lamp
words.translation: 鳞茎,球形物；[电]电灯泡；[植]鳞茎；球状物

examples.en: tulip bulbs
examples.zh: 郁金香球茎

words.translation: 万亿

examples.en: In a short time the number of cells is more than a trillion.
examples.zh: 不久细胞的数量就超过了一万亿。

examples.en: Japan’s exports were worth $43 trillion last year.
examples.zh: 去年日本的出口商品价值43万亿美元。

words.definition: when one group, person, or thing is separate from others; insulation, segregation
words.translation: 隔离，孤立；[电子]隔离；孤立；[电]绝缘；[化学]离析

examples.en: Because of its geographical isolation, the area developed its own unique culture.
examples.zh: 由于地理上的隔绝，该地区发展了自己独特的文化。

examples.en: The mansion sits in splendid isolation on top of the hill (= it is far from everything and looks impressive ).
examples.zh: 宅邸位于山顶，远离尘嚣。

examples.en: a patient’s isolation period
examples.zh: 病人的隔离期

words.definition: a frontal view, as in a painting or other work of art
words.translation: 正面描绘
塔斯马尼亚岛, 塔斯马尼亚州(澳大利亚州名)

examples.en: The next partial eclipse of the sun will occur on Nov. 25, 2011, but it will only be visible from Antarctica, Tasmania, New Zealand and southern South Africa.
examples.zh: 下一次的太阳日偏食将发生在2011年11月25日，但它只能从南极洲、塔斯马尼亚岛、新西兰和南非的南部可以见到。

examples.en: The long-spined sea urchin [Centrostephanus rodgersii], for example, has moved from the warming seas off mainland Australia and has invaded more temperate waters off Tasmania.
examples.zh: 例如以前生活在澳洲大陆附近温暖水域的长须海胆已经迁移到了比以海温较以前温暖的 塔斯马尼亚岛海域。

examples.en: We’ve gone wine tasting in the Napa Valley, hiking in Arizona, sightseeing in Costa Rica, snorkeling in the Galápagos, exploring the culture of Tasmania.
examples.zh: 我们在纳帕山谷品酒、亚利桑那州远足、哥斯达黎加观光、加拉帕格斯群岛潜水、塔斯马尼亚岛体验文化。

words.definition: the language used in ancient Rome
words.translation: 拉丁文,拉丁语(的)

examples.en: He is well grounded in Latin.
examples.zh: 他拉丁语的功底很扎实。

examples.en: I must brush up on my Latin.
examples.zh: 我必须把拉丁语重温一下。

examples.en: This word comes from Latin.
examples.zh: 这个词源于拉丁语。

words.definition: in or to a foreign country; foreign country
words.translation: 到国外,在国外；海外；异国

examples.en: I’ve never lived abroad before.
examples.zh: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

examples.en: She often goes abroad on business.
examples.zh: 她经常出国公干。

examples.en: We never travelled abroad when we were kids.
examples.zh: 我们小时候从来没有去国外旅行过。

words.definition: any inhabitant of a borough; citizen, member, municipality
words.translation: (英国)市民，镇民；（英）自由民；市民；议员；（美）镇行政官

words.definition: if a group of people splits, or if it is split, people in the group disagree strongly with each other and the group sometimes divides into separate smaller groups; leave, quit; leave, quit, get out; crack, cleavage; cloven, cleft
words.translation: 分裂；撕裂 n裂口；分离；使分离；劈开；离开；被劈开；断绝关系；[木]裂缝；劈开的

examples.en: It was feared that the issue would split the church.
examples.zh: 人们担心这一问题会导致教会分裂。

words.definition: if two things alternate, or if you alternate them, they happen one after the other in a repeated pattern; turn by one's, take one's turn; rotate; rotary, vicissitudinary; refill
words.translation: 交替, 轮流；交替；轮流；使交替；使轮流；[物]交替的；轮流的；替换物

examples.en: Her aggressive moods alternated with gentle or more cooperative states.
examples.zh: 她的挑衅情绪与温和或更为合作的情绪互相交替。

words.definition: a formal promise that something will be done; assurance, certification, commitment, warranty, pledge; assure, undertake, swear for
words.translation: 保证(书)vt保证, 担保；[金融]保证；[法]担保；保证人；保证书；[经]抵押品

examples.en: They offer a two-year guarantee on all their electrical goods.
examples.zh: 他们所有的电器产品都有两年的保修期。

words.definition: Manganese is a greyish white metal that is used in making steel
words.translation: n〈化〉锰

words.definition: finally, after everything else has been done or considered; eventually, finally, basically, lastly, either
words.translation: 最后，最终；最后；根本；基本上

examples.en: Ultimately, the decision rests with the child’s parents.
examples.zh: 最终，决定权在这孩子的父母手中。

examples.en: a long but ultimately successful campaign
examples.zh: 一场历时很久但最终成功的运动

words.definition: unusual or surprising, especially in a way that is difficult to explain or understand; unknown, lay; queerly, anticly
words.translation: 陌生的,奇怪的；奇怪的；陌生的；外行的；奇怪地；陌生地，冷淡地

examples.en: strange noises
examples.zh: 奇怪的噪声

examples.en: Does Geoff’s behaviour seem strange to you?
examples.zh: 你觉得杰夫的行为反常吗？

examples.en: She felt there was something strange about Dexter’s voice.
examples.zh: 她觉得德克斯特的声音有点奇怪。

words.definition: an occasion when you travel from one place to another, especially over a long distance; tour, trip; travel, have a trip, go on a trip, wayfare
words.translation: 旅行；[交]旅行；行程

examples.en: the friends they made on the journey

examples.zh: 在我年轻时我父亲立契让我给一名铁匠当学徒。

examples.en: The smith [blacksmith] forges horseshoes with great skill.
examples.zh: 这个铁匠锻制马掌的手艺很高。

examples.en: A hammer, pliers and an anvil - the main tools of a blacksmith.
examples.zh: 铁匠使用的重要工具：一把大锤、一把铁钳和一个大铁墩

words.definition: something that you do to fix a thing that is damaged, broken, or not working; perform maintenance, fix up; restore, doctor, help; renovation, fixing
words.translation: 修理 vt修理(补)；修理；修复；恢复；补救，纠正；修理，修补；修补部位

examples.en: The church tower is in need of repair .
examples.zh: 教堂的塔楼需要修缮。

examples.en: They did a good repair job on the roof.
examples.zh: 他们把屋顶修得很好。

words.definition: electronic equipment, such as computers and televisions, uses electricity that has passed through computer chips, transistors etc
words.translation: 电子的

examples.en: electronic games
examples.zh: 电子游戏

examples.en: an electronic organizer (= a small piece of electronic equipment that you can use to record addresses, phone numbers etc )
examples.zh: 电子记事本

words.definition: to state something in an exact and detailed way; name, appoint
words.translation: 指定, 详细说明；指定；详细说明；列举；把…列入说明书

examples.en: Payments will be made for a specified number of months.
examples.zh: 款项将在规定的几个月内支付。

words.definition: used when adding another reason; moreover, again, also, additionally, then; unless, except as, in addition to
words.translation: 除之外；此外, 也；此外；而且；除…之外

examples.en: I need the money. And besides, when I agree to do something, I do it.
examples.zh: 我需要这笔钱，而且，我一旦答应做什么事情就会做到。

words.definition: the raised place beside a railway track where you get on and off a train in a station; flatform, hathpace
words.translation: 站台, 讲台；[计][矿业]平台；月台，[铁路]站台；坛；[家具]讲台

examples.en: The Edinburgh train will depart from platform six.
examples.zh: 开往爱丁堡的火车将从六号站台发车。

words.definition: environmental, ambient; context, circumstance, setting, condition
words.translation: 围绕物,环境 a周围的；周围的，附近的；环境，周围的事物

words.definition: the dried brown leaves that are smoked in cigarettes, pipes etc; smoke, baccy
words.translation: 烟草(制品)；[作物]烟草，烟叶；[轻]烟草制品；抽烟

examples.en: ...Cuba's tobacco crop.
examples.zh: …古巴的烟草作物。

words.definition: equal, comparative, opponent, match, adversary; match, compete against; contest, cope, struggle to; competitive, vying
words.translation: 竞争,对抗；对手；[劳经]竞争者；与…竞争；比得上某人；[劳经]竞争；[劳经]竞争的

words.definition: when people have the same opinion as each other; accordance, protocol, unity, identity, keeping
words.translation: 同意, 一致；[法]协议；同意，一致

examples.en: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
examples.zh: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

words.definition: something that is done by people in a particular society because it is traditional; manner, habit, way; made-to-order, tailored
words.translation: 习惯, 风俗,；习惯；风俗；海关；定制的，定做的

examples.en: He awoke early, as was his custom.
examples.zh: 他很早醒来，这是他的习惯。

words.definition: very expensive, especially wasting a lot of money; expensive, rich, dear
words.translation: 昂贵的，代价高的；昂贵的；代价高的

examples.en: Such a database would be extremely costly to set up.
examples.zh: 建立这样一个数据库要花很多钱。

words.definition: handle, to put to use
words.translation: 尽(力),发挥；运用，发挥；施以影响

examples.en: He exerted considerable influence on the thinking of the scientific community on these issues.
examples.zh: 他对科学界在这些问题上的思考施加了相当大的影响。

words.definition: someone who is in charge of a particular activity or organization; co-director, boss-man
words.translation: 主管,导演；主任，[管理]主管；[电影]导演；人事助理

examples.en: "Cut!" the director yelled. "That was perfect."
examples.zh: “停！”导演叫道。“太好了！”

words.definition: a natural ability; giving, tribute, present, genius; put, endow with
words.translation: 赠品, 天赋；礼物；天赋；[贸易]赠品；赋予；向…赠送

examples.en: As a youth he discovered a gift for teaching.
examples.zh: 年轻的时候他就发现了自己教书的天赋。

words.definition: If you do something repeatedly, you do it many times; again and again, iteratively
words.translation: 重复地, 再三地；反复地；再三地；屡次地

examples.en: Both men have repeatedly denied the allegations.
examples.zh: 两个人都再三地否认这些指控。

words.definition: one of the long thin parts of a sea creature such as an  octopus  which it uses for holding things; antenna, palpus
words.translation: (动物)触角；触手，触须，[动]触角

examples.en: Free speech is being gradually eroded year after year by new tentacles of government control.
examples.zh: 言论自由正被政府控制的新触角逐渐侵蚀。

words.definition: the ability of the land or soil to produce good crops; productivity, pregnancy
words.translation: 肥沃, 多产；多产；[土壤]肥沃；[生物][生理][农经]生产力；丰饶

words.definition: the quality of being simple and not complicated, especially when this is attractive or useful; homeliness, austerity
words.translation: 简单, 朴素；朴素；简易；天真；愚蠢

examples.en: Mona wrote with a beautiful simplicity of style.
examples.zh: 莫娜的文笔朴实优美。

examples.en: For the sake of simplicity, the tax form is divided into three sections.
examples.zh: 为简明起见，税单分成三个部分。

examples.en: James’ solution to this problem was simplicity itself (= very simple ) .
examples.zh: 詹姆斯对这个问题的解决办法十分简单。

words.definition: yearly
words.translation: 每年；按年计算；一年一次

examples.en: This is a perennating rhizome from which flowering shoots arise annually.
examples.zh: 这是一种每年发芽开花的多年生根茎。

words.definition: a strong feeling of interest and enjoyment about something and an eagerness to be involved in it; passion, flame, fire, warmth
words.translation: 热情, 热衷；热心，热忱，热情

examples.en: Gillian and Darren greeted the speakers with great enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 吉利恩和达伦非常热情地接待了演讲者。

examples.en: We went along to the local diving club, full of enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 我们兴高采烈地去了当地的潜水俱乐部。

examples.en: They go about their tasks with little enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 他们执行任务时没多大干劲。

words.definition: The rear of something such as a building or vehicle is the back part of it; cultivate, foster, plant, set, bed; rise, tower; fro, aback; latter, back; back, behind, ass
words.translation: 后部(面，方)(的) vt养，种；培养；树立；栽种；暴跳；高耸；向后；在后面；[军]后方的；后面的；背面的；后面；屁股；后方部队

examples.en: He settled back in the rear of the taxi.
examples.zh: 他在出租车后座，往后靠着坐好了。

words.definition: a vehicle pulled by horses that was used in past times for carrying passengers and letters; dawk
words.translation: 公共马车；驿站马车

examples.en: The Pony Express was much faster than the stagecoach.
examples.zh: 驿马快信要比当时的公共马车快多了。

words.definition: a feature or quality that makes something seem interesting or enjoyable; appeal, charm
words.translation: 吸引(力)；具有吸引力的事物(或人)；吸引，[力]吸引力；引力；吸引人的事物

examples.en: The attraction between them was almost immediate.
examples.zh: 他们几乎是一见钟情。

words.definition: to try to find out the truth about something such as a crime, accident, or scientific problem; check into, inquire into
words.translation: 调查, 研究；调查；研究

examples.en: The state police are investigating the incident.
examples.zh: 州警察正调查此事。

examples.en: The study investigates the impact of violent TV programming on children.
examples.zh: 该研究调查暴力电视节目对儿童的影响。

examples.en: I heard a noise and went downstairs to investigate.
examples.zh: 我听见响声，就下楼去看个究竟。

words.definition: in or near the area where you are, or the area you are talking about
words.translation: 在本地, 地方性地, 局部地

examples.en: I live locally, so it’s easy to get to the office.
examples.zh: 我就住在附近，所以上班很方便。

words.definition: much more than is reasonable or necessary; extreme, ultra, tall
words.translation: 过多的,过分的；过多的，极度的；过分的

examples.en: his excessive drinking
examples.zh: 他的酗酒

examples.en: $15 for two beers seems a little excessive.
examples.zh: 两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

words.definition: a small change made to a machine, system, or calculation; restructuring, conditioning, modulation, setup, accommodation
words.translation: 调整, 调节；调整，调节；调节器

examples.en: a period of adjustment
examples.zh: 一段调整期

words.definition: a figurative word or phrase is used in a different way from its usual meaning, to give you a particular idea or picture in your mind; tralatitious, parabolical
words.translation: 比喻的，借喻的；比喻的；修饰丰富的；形容多的

examples.en: He’s my son, in the figurative sense of the word.
examples.zh: 打个比方，他就像是我的儿子。

words.definition: a piece of writing inscribed on a stone, in the front of a book etc; epigraph, mintage
words.translation: 题字, 碑铭；题词；铭文；刻印

examples.en: a Latin inscription on the memorial stone
examples.zh: 纪念碑上的拉丁语碑文

words.translation: 阿帕拉契山脉的

words.definition: an important official statement about a particular situation or plan, or the act of making this statement; profession, announcement
words.translation: 宣布, 声明；（纳税品等的）[税收]申报；宣布；公告；[法]申诉书

examples.en: a ceasefire declaration
examples.zh: 停火声明

examples.en: Under Islamic law it was possible to divorce by simple declaration.
examples.zh: 从前按照伊斯兰法律，作简单的声明就可以离婚。

words.definition: obviously, clearly, broadly, remarkably, dramatically
words.translation: 显著地,明显地；明显地；显著地；引人注目地

examples.en: Bankers say that they have got tougher but they have still tightened lending standards less markedly than their counterparts in the euro area as a whole.
examples.zh: 银行业主说他们已经紧缩了信用，但是整体上他们对借贷标准的收紧并没有像欧洲其他地区的同行那样明显。

words.definition: to go to an event such as a meeting or a class; present oneself, invite, serve, board, mind; present oneself, nurse
words.translation: 出席, 参加,照料；出席；上（大学等）；照料；招待；陪伴；致力于；照顾

examples.en: Only 12 people attended the meeting.
examples.zh: 只有12个人出席了会议。

examples.en: Please let us know if you are unable to attend.
examples.zh: 如果不能出席，请通知我们。

words.definition: to move up, down, or across something using your feet and hands, especially when this is difficult to do; arise, raise, scale; scale, come up; escalade
words.translation: 攀登, 爬；爬；攀登；上升

examples.en: Harry climbed the stairs.
examples.zh: 哈里爬上楼梯。

examples.en: Boys were climbing trees along the river bank.
examples.zh: 男孩们在河边爬树。

words.definition: efficacy
words.translation: 效力

examples.en: Sometimes you have to sacrifice efficiency for effectiveness.
examples.zh: 有时候你需要牺牲效率来达到效果。

examples.en: However, its viability and effectiveness still have to be established.
examples.zh: 然而，它的有效性和可行性尚有待验证。

examples.en: So, how do you manage and measure the effectiveness of your IT governance solution for your business?
examples.zh: 那么，您如何管理并度量面向您的企业的 IT 治理解决方案的有效性呢？

words.definition: to give someone something or allow them to have something that they have asked for; award, let, accept, recognize, agree; accept, see with, to agree with, agree on/upon, be agreeable to; appropriation
words.translation: 授予,同意，准予；[法][专利]授予；允许；承认；同意；拨款；[法][专利]授予物

examples.en: Britain could grant Spain’s request .
examples.zh: 英国可能会同意西班牙的请求。

examples.en: I would love to be able to grant her wish.
examples.zh: 我很希望能够满足她的愿望。

words.definition: relating to machines or processes which are concerned with light, images, or the way we see things; visual, ocular
words.translation: 视觉的, 光学的；光学的；眼睛的，[生理]视觉的

examples.en: microscopes and other optical instruments
examples.zh: 显微镜和其他光学仪器

words.definition: cloudy, dull; shadow, shield
words.translation: 遮盖,变暗；覆盖, 阴天；[气象]阴天的；阴暗的；愁闷的；使沮丧；包缝；遮蔽

examples.en: Tomorrow will be overcast.
examples.zh: 明天是阴天。

examples.en: The sky is overcast.
examples.zh: 天阴了。

examples.en: During the daytime, it will be overcast, turning clear later.
examples.zh: 今天白天，阴转晴。

words.definition: someone or something that is noisy makes a lot of noise; furious, boisterous; klang, babelism
words.translation: 吵杂的, 聒噪的；嘈杂的；喧闹的；聒噪的；响声；嘈杂声

examples.en: The kids have been really noisy today.
examples.zh: 孩子们今天实在是吵。

examples.en: a noisy engine
examples.zh: 噪声大的发动机

words.definition: having large strong muscles; robust, intramuscular
words.translation: 肌肉发达的，强壮的；肌肉的；肌肉发达的；强健的

examples.en: She was fast and strong, with a slender, muscular body.
examples.zh: 她动作敏捷，身体强壮，身材苗条，肌肉结实。

examples.en: He’s very muscular.
examples.zh: 他很强壮。

words.definition: notably, dramatically, considerably, prominently, markedly
words.translation: 非凡地；显著地；非常地；引人注目地

examples.en: Remarkably, all of the passengers survived the crash.
examples.zh: 令人称奇的是，这次事故中所有乘客都幸免于难。

words.definition: a group of people who play a game or sport together against another group; group, crew, suit; partner; work together, co-operate
words.translation: 队, 组；队；组；使合作；合作

examples.en: Which team do you support?
examples.zh: 你支持哪个队？

examples.en: Our team are winning.
examples.zh: 现在是我们队赢。

words.definition: to be even better or greater than someone or something else; overcome, top, exceed, cap, transcend
words.translation: 超越, 胜过；超越；胜过，优于；非…所能办到或理解

examples.en: He had surpassed all our expectations .
examples.zh: 他超越了我们所有的预期。

examples.en: The number of multiple births has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
examples.zh: 多胎产首次突破了 10 万例。

words.definition: found, construct, father, initiate; academy, college, union, school
words.translation: 学院 vt建立，设立；开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼）；学会，协会；学院

examples.en: research institutes
examples.zh: 研究所

words.definition: used to show that two people or teams are competing against each other in a game or court case; in the teeth of
words.translation: 对抗, 与相对；对；与...相对；对抗

examples.en: the New York Knicks versus the LA Lakers
examples.zh: 纽约尼克斯队对洛杉矶湖人队

examples.en: the Supreme Court decision in Roe vs. Wade
examples.zh: 最高法院关于罗诉韦德案的判决

words.definition: the short weak high-pitched cry of a young bird; chirp
words.translation: 吱吱的叫声 v吱吱地叫

words.definition: someone who had your job before you started doing it; father, grand old man
words.translation: 前辈, 前任；前任，前辈

examples.en: Kennedy’s predecessor as President was the war hero Dwight Eisenhower.
examples.zh: 肯尼迪总统的前任是战争英雄德怀特·艾森豪威尔。

words.translation: [罗神]花神

words.definition: A pollinator is something that pollinates plants, especially a type of insect
words.translation: 授花粉器

examples.en: measure until farmers get their act together and facilitate the growth of native pollinator
examples.zh: 他们还需要认识到，它们的角色很大程度上是临时的，作为一项权宜直到农民能共同行动起来，促进自然授粉者数量的增长。

examples.en: It is nectarivorous, which means it feeds mostly on nectar and is an important pollinator in its tropical deciduous forest habitat.
examples.zh: 它是食蜜动物，就是说，它主要的食物是花蜜，在其热带落叶林栖息地里，是重要的花粉传播者。

words.definition: someone who is related to a person who lived a long time ago, or to a family, group of people etc that existed in the past; falling, downward; child, seed
words.translation: 子孙, 后裔；下降的；祖传的；后裔；子孙

examples.en: He was a direct descendant of Napoleon Bonaparte.
examples.zh: 他是拿破仑·波拿巴的嫡系后裔。

words.definition: in some way, or by some means, although you do not know how; one way or another, puzzlingly
words.translation: 以某种方式,不知怎么地；以某种方法；莫明其妙地

examples.en: Don’t worry, we’ll get the money back somehow.
examples.zh: 别担心，我们总会把那些钱拿回来的。

examples.en: Somehow, I managed to lose my keys.
examples.zh: 我不知怎的竟然把钥匙弄丢了。

examples.en: Maybe we could glue it together somehow or other .
examples.zh: 也许我们可以想什么办法把它粘起来。

words.definition: a building or large room for public events such as meetings or dances; passage, corridor
words.translation: 会堂, 大厅；门厅，走廊；[建]会堂；食堂；学生宿舍

examples.en: a concert at Carnegie Hall
examples.zh: 卡内基音乐厅的一场音乐会

words.definition: effectively, usefully
words.translation: 有效地；能胜任地；效率高地（efficient的副词形式）

examples.en: This oil lubricates efficiently.
examples.zh: 这油能有效地起润滑作用。

words.definition: firmly, fast
words.translation: 紧紧地, 坚固地；紧紧地；坚固地

words.definition: connected with the Middle Ages (= the period between about 1100 and 1500 AD ); original, primitive
words.translation: 中世纪的；原始的；仿中世纪的；老式的

examples.en: These spices were first brought to Italy from the East in medieval times.
examples.zh: 这些香料最早是在中世纪时从东方被带到了意大利。

examples.en: a medieval castle
examples.zh: 一座中世纪城堡

words.translation: 珠宝

examples.en: We have purchased some valuable jewelry.
examples.zh: 我们购置了几件贵重的珠宝饰物。

examples.en: The robbers buried the jewelry chest on the mountain.
examples.zh: 盗贼们把珠宝箱埋藏在山上。

examples.en: They buy jewelry and clothes for themselves with images of cats on them.
examples.zh: 他们为自己购买带有猫咪图象的珠宝饰物和衣服。

words.definition: variously, dissimilarly
words.translation: 不同地，有差别地；不同地；差异；各种

words.definition: a building where Christians go to worship; exercise, worship; ecclesial, hierurgical
words.translation: 教堂；礼拜；教派；教会的；礼拜的

examples.en: a short church service
examples.zh: 简短的教堂礼拜仪式

examples.en: church bells
examples.zh: 教堂的钟

words.definition: to hit a golf ball lightly a short distance along the ground towards the hole; hole out
words.translation: 短打,把球轻轻打进洞；击球入洞

examples.en: Turner, however, putted superbly, twice holing from 40 feet.
examples.zh: 然而，特纳两次在40英尺之外漂亮地把球轻击入洞。

words.definition: an idea, belief, or opinion; concept, idea, eye, construct, sight
words.translation: 概念,观念,想法；概念；见解；打算

examples.en: She had no notion what he meant.
examples.zh: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

words.definition: reconstruct, rebuild
words.translation: 改造, 再成形；改造；再成形

examples.en: If they succeed, then they will have reshaped the political and economic map of the world.
examples.zh: 如果他们获得成功，他们将会改变世界的政治和经济格局。

words.definition: a small area of fresh water that is smaller than a lake, that is either natural or artificially made; tank, mere
words.translation: 池塘；[水文]池塘

examples.en: The path descends to  the pond.
examples.zh: 小路下斜通到池塘。

examples.en: This pond often catches in winter.
examples.zh: 这个池塘在冬天常常结冰。

examples.en: Wild flowers and grasses rimmed the little pond.
examples.zh: 各种野花和野草环绕着这个小池塘。

words.definition: relating to your body’s metabolism; changed, sliding, varying, variational
words.translation: 新陈代谢的；变化的；[生理]新陈代谢的

examples.en: Exercise can increase your metabolic rate.
examples.zh: 运动可以提高新陈代谢率。

examples.en: the metabolic activity of the brain
examples.zh: 大脑的新陈代谢活动

words.definition: a gas that you cannot see or smell, which can be burned to give heat; marsh gas, firedamp
words.translation: 甲烷,沼气；[有化]甲烷；[能源]沼气

examples.en: Methane is one of the principal gases contributing to the greenhouse effect.
examples.zh: 甲烷是造成温室效应的主要气体之一。

words.definition: a black substance, thick and sticky when hot but hard when cold, used especially for making road surfaces; asphalt, tarre; cloud, pollute

examples.zh: 他史无前例地声明那些谣言实属子虚乌有。

examples.zh: 犯罪率增幅之大前所未有。

words.translation: 保守的,守旧的；保守的；保守派，守旧者

examples.zh: 对待教育非常守旧的态度

examples.zh: 保守的观点

words.definition: someone’s identity is their name or who they are; accordance, estate, unity, agreement, quality
words.translation: 一致, 身份, 特征；身份；同一性，一致；特性；恒等式

examples.zh: 凶手的身份仍未查明。

words.definition: the total amount of money that a government, organization, or person spends during a particular period of time; spending, payout
words.translation: 支出, 花费；[会计]支出，花费；经费，消费额

examples.zh: 大幅度削减公共开支

examples.zh: 政府的教育开支

examples.zh: 〔公司的〕资本开支

words.definition: combinative
words.translation: 粘着的；有结合力的；紧密结合的；有粘着力的

words.definition: Practically means almost, but not completely or exactly; almost, nearly, actually, really, most
words.translation: 实际上,几乎，简直；实际地；几乎；事实上

examples.zh: 他几乎从小就认识那位老人。

words.definition: all the people who work on a ship or plane; team, group, personnel, suit
words.translation: 全体人员；队，组；全体人员，全体船员

examples.zh: 飞机坠毁，造成两名机组人员和四名乘客死亡。

examples.zh: 一名机组人员

words.definition: shaped like a circle; indirect, cyclic, rounded; notice, advice, information
words.translation: 圆形的, 循环的；循环的；[数]圆形的；间接的；通知，传单

examples.zh: 圆桌

words.definition: someone or something that existed before something similar that developed or came later; warning, precursor
words.translation: 先驱(者)；先驱；先驱者；预兆

examples.zh: …一台在某些方面是现代直升飞机的前身的机器。

words.definition: guard, vigilance
words.translation: 警戒, 机敏；警戒；机敏

examples.en: Environmental issues such as noise and level of alertness may interfere with learning new behaviors.
examples.zh: 环境问题诸如噪音和警戒的水平也许会妨碍新行为的学习。

examples.en: In order to use the alertness approach in selecting a managerial style, you have to determine what each of your employees needs from you.
examples.zh: 为了机敏地选择管理风格，你必须确定每一个下属的工作需求。 也就是他们到底需要你给予多少管控和/或鼓励？

words.definition: when the army of one country enters another country by force, in order to take control of it; violence, aggression, infringement
words.translation: 入侵；入侵，侵略；[医]侵袭；侵犯

examples.en: the annual invasion of teenagers for the Glastonbury Festival
examples.zh: 每年前来参加格拉斯顿伯里音乐节的青少年的涌入

words.definition: an occasion when something that has happened before happens again; circulation, revolution, rotation, cycle, round
words.translation: 复发, 重现；再发生；循环；重现；重新提起

examples.en: If you have a recurrence, talk to your doctor about getting a new biopsy before settling on treatment.
examples.zh: 如果你存在复发，那么跟你的医生谈论在制定治疗方案前再做一次新的活检。

examples.en: As someoneundergoing treatment for cancer, I wanted to do whatever I could to stop it inits tracks and prevent a recurrence.
examples.zh: 作为一个正在接受癌症治疗的人，我想要做我所能做的一切来阻止它的进程和防止复发。

examples.en: If, after treatment and after those five years, there is no recurrence of the cancer, then the patient is declared cured.
examples.zh: 癌症的一个康复标准是：如果在经过治疗后五年病情没有复发，那么这个患者我们可以说他是得到了康复。

words.definition: a large bird that hunts and eats small birds and animals; tout, cough up; have a cough; eagle
words.translation: 鹰；兜售，沿街叫卖；捕捉；咳出；清嗓；咳嗽；像鹰一般地袭击；[鸟]鹰；鹰派成员；掠夺他人的人

words.translation: 补足物；补足，补助
