examples.zh: 绿色墙纸是旧松木梳妆台的完美衬托。

words.definition: if the weather is humid, you feel uncomfortable because the air is very wet and usually hot; wet, moisty
words.translation: 充满潮湿的, 湿润的；[气象][物]潮湿的；湿润的；多湿气的

examples.en: Tokyo is extremely humid in mid-summer.
examples.zh: 仲夏的东京十分潮湿。

examples.zh: 她将可以伸开蜷缩的四肢，休息几个小时。

examples.zh: 电脑用户

examples.zh: 地表覆盖着冰碛石。

examples.zh: 我们的帐篷搭在沙石的海岸上，对面是巨大的布鲁姆斯特莱德冰川，这是一块庞大的浮冰，当它的冰山融入海水中时，发出吱吱嘎嘎的声音。

examples.zh: 这种土壤沙很多。

words.definition: of, denoting, or formed in the second period of the Mesozoic era, between the Triassic and Cretaceous periods, lasting for 55 million years during which dinosaurs and ammonites flourished

examples.zh: 整个州的企业都很景气。

words.translation: 传统上, 照惯例；传统上；习惯上；传说上

examples.zh: 女性必须在那些传统上被禁止的每一个领域中证明自己。

examples.zh: 正如我们所看到的那样，那些变更是跨学科的，并且在传统上并不属于版本工程学要求的一部分。

examples.en: To be successful selling to them, you have to cater to their emotions and concerns more than ever before, even when selling products that men traditionally buy.
examples.zh: 为了成功的向她们推销，你必须比以往更加迎合这部分人群的情感和关切，甚至传统上由男人来购买的产品也是一样。

words.definition: the events that form the main story of a book, film, or play; action, designing, scenario; lot, to divide; be up to something, to plan

examples.zh: 情节有些费解。

examples.zh: 那匹马驹跳着跑过牧场。

examples.zh: 一组聪明异常的学生

examples.zh: 桑塔格曾被称为美国最聪明的女人，这是众人皆知的事。

words.definition: an opinion that you express about someone or something; opinion, criticism, mind, judgement, thinking; declare oneself, air one's opinion

examples.zh: 他因谩骂裁判而被罚款。

examples.zh: 像这样的海洋建筑技术非常复杂，有些类似于尝试在水下建筑一座桥。

words.translation: 女演员

examples.zh: 他们两人都称这次会晤亲切友好，使双方增进了解。

examples.zh: 除了学生的学习兴趣，教育者们别无所求。

examples.zh: 有九个共和国参加了全民公决。

examples.zh: 可以说，他是混战中的一个无懈可击的侏儒。

examples.en: The only other known example of such an oddly angled orbit was Pluto, until its demotion to dwarf planet status.
examples.zh: 唯一的另一个已知的以如此奇怪的角度运行的例子是冥王星，直到它降级为矮行星。

examples.zh: 我的舞蹈编导总是不断雕琢我，一心将我塑造成完美的舞蹈家。

examples.zh: “一个舞蹈编导告诉我专家们寻找优秀舞蹈演员的核心指标就是身体力量，”内尔博士透露。

examples.zh: 这位老前辈甚至邀请他到家里来，在这儿杰克逊为阿斯泰尔和他的舞蹈教练展示了太空步。

examples.zh: 这座城镇在战争中遭到了严重破坏。

examples.zh: 她现在是重度残疾。

examples.zh: 这个团体建了一个网站来宣扬他们的主张。

examples.zh: 为了避免混淆，各队穿着不同颜色的服装。

examples.zh: 今天是爸爸的生日，我们打算出去吃饭庆祝一下。

examples.zh: 我父母正在庆祝他们结婚50周年。

examples.zh: 13世纪城堡的杰出典范

examples.zh: 了不起的成功

examples.zh: 那铁匠非常熟练地锻造马蹄铁。

examples.zh: 它只在欧洲多年生植物马蹄野豌豆上产卵（如上图）。

examples.en: Their ability to go on a sustained eating binge while at the bay is due entirely to another creature: the horseshoe crab. These bizarre animals are among the oldest on Earth.
examples.zh: 让它们能不停地在特拉华湾狂吃的原因，完全是因为老天爷在那里安排了另一种生物：马蹄蟹，地球上最古老的奇怪的动物。

examples.zh: 你们一定要权衡正反两方面的可能性，然后再裁定他是否犯罪。

examples.zh: 男孩子们想踢足球。

examples.zh: 11到18岁之间的男孩和女孩

examples.en: What a polite little boy (=  young male child  ) you are.
examples.zh: 你真是个有礼貌的小男孩。

words.translation: 特别地；明确地，具体地；明确地

examples.zh: 专门针对儿童的广告

words.translation: 投票；投票，选举；选票；得票数；提议，使投票；投票决定；公认；选举，投票

examples.zh: 1918年，英国妇女获得了选举权。

examples.zh: 很多电视广告瞄准了易受影响的幼儿。

examples.zh: 我展望了一个有着优质教育的未来。

words.definition: a system of written marks or signs used to represent something such as music, mathematics, or scientific ideas; symbol, notes, sign, mark
words.translation: 符号；[计][数]符号；乐谱；注释；记号法

examples.en: Musical notation was conceived for the C major scale and each line and space represents a note in this scale.
examples.zh: 乐谱为C大音阶而构思，在这个音阶中的每一个线和间都代表一个音符。

words.definition: not relaxed; moderate, relax; comfort, leisure; relax, to alleviate
words.translation: 安逸；减轻，缓和；使安心；轻松，舒适；安逸，悠闲；放松；灵活地移动

examples.en: You always look ill at ease in a suit.
examples.zh: 你穿套装看上去总有些不自在。

words.definition: if a boat capsizes, or if you capsize it, it turns over in the water; turn turtle, keel over; tip, turn turtle
words.translation: (特指船)倾覆；倾覆（特指船）；翻覆；弄翻；翻；倾覆

examples.en: The sea got very rough and the boat capsized.
examples.zh: 海的风浪变得很大，船翻了。

words.definition: If you elicit a response or a reaction, you do or say something that makes other people respond or react; premise, attract, produce, cause, operate
words.translation: 得出, 引出, 抽出, 引起；抽出，引出；引起

examples.en: Mr. Norris said he was hopeful that his request would elicit a positive response.
examples.zh: 诺里斯先生说他希望他的要求会引起积极的回应。

words.definition: someone who controls or lends large sums of money; kid, pull a fast one; moneyman, money changer
words.translation: 财政家, 金融家；欺骗；从事欺骗性金融活动；金融家；投资家

examples.en: The Connells were leading financiers of the Democratic Party in Congress.
examples.zh: 康奈尔家族是民主党在国会中的主要出资方。

words.definition: fuzzy, dark, vague, lowering; overcurtain, becloud
words.translation: 暗的 vt使暗,使不明显；模糊的；晦涩的；[光]昏暗的；遮掩；使变暗；使难理解

examples.en: The contracts are written in obscure language.
examples.zh: 那些合同是用复杂难懂的语言写的。

words.definition: a turbulent situation or period of time is one in which there are a lot of sudden changes; angry, chaotic, troubled, confused
words.translation: 狂暴的,动荡的；骚乱的，混乱的；狂暴的；吵闹的

examples.en: the turbulent times of the French Revolution
examples.zh: 法国大革命的动荡时期

examples.en: He has had a turbulent political career.
examples.zh: 他的政治生涯动荡不定。

words.definition: contemporaneously, synchronously
words.translation: 同时地

examples.en: The image below is an example of showing an image and some text simultaneously.
examples.zh: 下面的图像是同时显示图像和一些文本的示例。

examples.en: It will save considerable machining time to use more than one tool in one machine to perform several machine operations either in sequence or simultaneously.
examples.zh: 在一台机器上使用数种刀具来顺次或同时进行几项机器操作， 将节省大量加工时间。

examples.en: If they have multiple test cases that will be run on the same platforms, they can select multiple configurations simultaneously and apply the configurations to several of them in batch mode.
examples.zh: 如果他们拥有多个将要运行在同一个平台上的测试用例的话，那么他们能够同时选择多个配置，并且将这些配置批量应用到平台上。

words.definition: any small animal of the type that has long sharp front teeth, such as a rat or a rabbit; corrosive, erosive; gnawer
words.translation: 啮齿类动物；[脊椎]啮齿类的；咬的，嚼的；侵蚀性的；[脊椎]啮齿动物

examples.en: This is an actual monster, some sort of rodent-like creature with a dinosaur beak.
examples.zh: 这真的是怪兽，有点像啮齿动物，但长着恐龙一样的嘴巴。

examples.en: But the new  study found that 70 percent of rodent and primate groups have species with an appendix.
examples.zh: 但是，这项新的研究发现，70%的啮齿动物和灵长目动物的物种具有阑尾。

examples.en: Like Plasmodium, which cycles between mosquitoes and man, Toxoplasma cycles between its rodent and feline hosts, living out different phases of its existence in each.
examples.zh: 像疟原虫在蚊子和人之间循环一样，弓形虫的循环界于其啮齿类和猫科宿主之间，在不同宿主体内活出不同的生存阶段。

words.definition: language in its usual form, as opposed to poetry; essay, monotony; ordinary, stock, stupid
words.translation: 散文；单调；散文的；平凡的；乏味的

examples.en: Shute's prose is stark and chillingly unsentimental.
examples.zh: 舒特的散文刻板而冷峻。

words.definition: a  sailor  or someone who travels regularly by ship; shipman, navigator
words.translation: 船员, 航海家；船员；航海家

examples.en: The Estonians have always been seafarers.
examples.zh: 爱沙尼亚人总是在海上漂泊。

words.definition: to give a particular quality to something; afford, allow, deal, reveal, extend
words.translation: 传授, 赋予, 告知；给予（尤指抽象事物），传授；告知，透露

examples.en: She had information that she couldn’t wait to impart.
examples.zh: 她得到了消息，迫不及待地想告诉别人。

words.definition: not smooth, flat, or level; odd, heterogeneous
words.translation: 不平坦的,不均匀的；不均匀的；不平坦的；[数]奇数的

examples.en: She walked back carefully over the uneven ground.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地从凹凸不平的地面上走回来。

words.definition: If you repudiate something or someone, you show that you strongly disagree with them and do not want to be connected with them in any way; negative, refuse, deny
words.translation: 批判；拒绝；否定；与…断绝关系；拒付

examples.en: Leaders urged people to turn out in large numbers to repudiate the violence.
examples.zh: 领导们力劝人们集体出面来声讨该暴力。

words.translation: 动物区系的

examples.en: Nor do we have an idea as to the timing of these faunal connections.
examples.zh: 我们也不知道这些动物物种联系的时间表。

examples.en: This paper analyzes their species distribution, population size and faunal and ecological distribution characteristics.
examples.zh: 对它们的种类分布、种群数量、区系与生态分布特点进行了分析。

examples.en: Intermittent faunal connections do not necessarily require land bridges to connect isolated areas only to be afterwards destroyed;
examples.zh: 间歇性的动物物种联系并不一定需要大陆桥来连接之后会被摧毁的隔离区域；

words.definition: the time during the night; nite
words.translation: 夜间

examples.en: During the riots last year, the nighttime patrol force was beefed up with volunteers.
examples.zh: 去年骚乱期间志愿者增加了夜间巡逻力量。

examples.en: A prescription antidiuretic can cut down on nighttime urination if this is the only problem.
examples.zh: 如果这是唯一的问题，抗利尿的处方可以减少夜间排尿。

examples.en: "Because of these impacts, we'd like to know what happens to these nitrogen oxides in nighttime air, where do they go, what do they do," Thornton said.
examples.zh: 桑顿说：“由于这些影响，我们想知道夜间空气中的这些氮氧化物发生什么变化，到那里去，会有什么影响。”

words.definition: almost not; just, ill, fresh, scarcely, barely
words.translation: 几乎不,刚刚；几乎不，简直不；刚刚

examples.en: My parents divorced when I was six, and I hardly knew my father.
examples.zh: 我六岁时父母离婚，我对父亲几乎一无所知。

examples.en: The children were so excited they could hardly speak.
examples.zh: 孩子们兴奋得几乎连话都说不出来了。

examples.en: I can hardly believe it.
examples.zh: 这简直让我难以置信。

words.definition: to try to find out details about someone else’s private life in an impolite way; prize up, jimmy; burrow into; lever, heaver
words.translation: 探查；撬动，撬开；刺探，探查；窥探；[机]杠杆

examples.en: I don’t want to pry , but I need to ask you one or two questions.
examples.zh: 我不想唐突，不过我需要问你一两个问题。

words.definition: deliberately not allowing someone to do something or be part of a group; particular, antiforeign; scoop
words.translation: 排外的,独占的,唯一的；独有的；排外的；专一的；独家新闻；独家经营的项目；排外者

examples.en: a racially exclusive hiring policy
examples.zh: 种族排外的聘用政策

words.definition: a company, organization, or business; career, cause, undertaking, project, push
words.translation: 企业, 事业；[经]企业；事业；进取心；事业心

examples.en: commercial enterprises such as banks and food manufacturers
examples.zh: 银行和食品制造厂等商业企业

words.definition: If you discard something, you get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it; yield, desert, quit; fall out of, render up, to renounce, to abandon, to give up; rejection, abandonment
words.translation: 丢弃, 抛弃；抛弃；放弃；丢弃；被丢弃的东西或人

examples.en: Read the manufacturer's guidelines before discarding the box.
examples.zh: 先阅读制造商的说明书再把盒子丢掉。

words.definition: the activity of producing conditions which are similar to real ones, especially in order to test something, or the conditions that are produced; acting, emulation, analog
words.translation: 仿真, 假装；[计]仿真；模拟；模仿；假装

examples.en: a computer simulation used to train airline pilots
examples.zh: 用于训练航空公司飞行员的电脑模拟程序

words.definition: to find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem or difficulty; solve, condition, conclude; settle, work out, figure out; determinateness
words.translation: 解决, 决定；决定；溶解；使…分解；决心要做…；解决；决心；分解；坚决；决定要做的事

examples.en: Barnet was desperate for money to resolve his financial problems.
examples.zh: 巴尼特急需钱来解决他的经济问题。

words.definition: a small piece of thick rough material which covers part of a floor; cushion, gaddi; entwist; lustreless, unpolished
words.translation: 席子，垫子；垫；垫子；衬边；缠结；铺席于……上；无光泽的

examples.en: Wipe your feet on the mat.
examples.zh: 在地垫上蹭蹭你的鞋底。

words.definition: core, kernel, nucleus; sensitive, rapid, fast, forward, ready; rapidly, soon, fast, promptly, ready
words.translation: 快的, 迅速的；核心；伤口的嫩肉；快的；迅速的，敏捷的；灵敏的；迅速地，快

examples.en: He downed his opponent with a quick right to the jaw.
examples.zh: 他迅速准确击中对手的下颌而把他击倒。

words.definition: a man who is admired for doing something extremely brave; chief actor, starring actor
words.translation: 英雄；男主角，男主人公

examples.en: He had dared to speak out against injustice, and overnight he became a national hero .
examples.zh: 他敢于站出来抨击不公正的现象，一夜之间就成了国家英雄。

examples.en: His father was a war hero , a former fighter pilot.
examples.zh: 他父亲是一位战争英雄，曾经是战斗机飞行员。

examples.en: the unsung heroes who drove convoys of aid to Bosnia
examples.zh: 运载援助物品到波斯尼亚的那些无名英雄

words.definition: to make someone think and behave exactly as you want them to, by skilfully deceiving or influencing them; man, guide, work, handle
words.translation: 操纵,影响；操纵；操作；巧妙地处理；篡改

examples.en: He was one of those men who manipulated people.
examples.zh: 他是那种要摆布别人的人。

examples.en: You have the constant feeling you are being manipulated.
examples.zh: 你总感觉自己是被人控制着的。

words.definition: a piece of music for one performer; alone, independent, isolated, separate, sole; solely, alone, individually
words.translation: 独奏曲 a单独的；独奏的；独唱的；单独的；单独地

examples.en: a gorgeous piano solo
examples.zh: 一首极其美妙的钢琴独奏曲

words.definition: someone whose job is to make plans or patterns for clothes, furniture, equipment etc; stylist; fashion-conscious, turned-on
words.translation: 设计者；[建]设计师；谋划者；由设计师专门设计的；享有盛名的；赶时髦的

examples.en: an interior designer
examples.zh: 室内装潢设计师

examples.en: a software designer
examples.zh: 软件设计师

words.definition: denoting the characteristic scenery of a limestone region, including underground streams, gorges, etc
words.translation: 石灰岩地区常见的地形

words.definition: happening or existing between the stars; astral
words.translation: 星际的；[航][天]星际的

examples.en: ...interstellar space.
examples.zh: ...星际空间。

words.definition: to rub your skin with your nails because it feels uncomfortable; abrasion, brush-burn; hit-and-miss; paw, hent; grasp, strike
words.translation: 抓，搔,划(痕)；擦伤；抓痕；刮擦声；乱写；打草稿用的；凑合的；碰巧的；抓；刮；挖出；乱涂；搔；发刮擦声；勉强糊口；退出比赛

examples.en: John yawned and scratched his leg.
examples.zh: 约翰打了个呵欠，挠了挠腿。

examples.en: Try not to scratch.
examples.zh: 尽量别挠。

words.definition: to put used objects or materials through a special process so that they can be used again; regeneration, breeding, rebirth
words.translation: 使再循环, 反复应用 n再循环, 再生, 重复利用；再生；再循环；重复利用

examples.en: We take all our bottles to be recycled.
examples.zh: 我们把我们所有的瓶子都回收利用。

examples.en: packaging made of recycled paper
examples.zh: 再生纸包装材料

words.definition: to find out about something that has been kept secret; detect, reveal; to discover, sniff out
words.translation: 揭露，揭示；发现；揭开；揭露；揭示；揭去盖子

examples.en: Customs officials uncovered a plot to smuggle weapons into the country.
examples.zh: 海关官员侦破了一个走私武器入境的阴谋。

words.translation: 直布罗陀(海峡)

words.definition: to fill something again; replenish; alternate
words.translation: 再装满,再充填；再装满；再充满；替换物；再注满

examples.en: The waitress refilled our coffee cups.
examples.zh: 女服务员又把我们的咖啡杯斟满。

words.definition: the state of being known about by a lot of people because of your achievements; tradition, celebrity, tale
words.translation: 名声, 名望；名声，名望；传闻，传说

examples.en: He claims he is not really interested in fame.
examples.zh: 他称自己对出名真的没有兴趣。

words.definition: a vehicle that a car can pull and in which people can live and sleep when they are on holiday; circus wagon, schooner
words.translation: 旅行队,商队, 大篷车；大篷车；旅行队

examples.en: a gipsy caravan
examples.zh: 吉卜赛人的大篷车

words.definition: a living thing that is so small that it cannot be seen without a  microscope; organism, animalcule
words.translation: 微生物；[微]微生物；微小动植物

examples.en: This is actually just a microorganism. But it has roughly 500 genes.
examples.zh: 这其实只不过是一个微生物，却拥有约500个基因。

examples.en: Spread the contents of the amber onto a petri dish containing a microorganism food like starch or soy.
examples.zh: 把琥珀内嵌标本放在皮氏培养皿中，并加入微生物食品，比如淀粉或大豆。

examples.en: Slight mutations that allow a microorganism to resist the full killing power of a medicine are an evolutionary advantage that greatly expedites the development of drug resistance.
examples.zh: 略微的突变即可使微生物具有抵抗力，使药物完全失去杀伤力，这种突变是一个进化优势，大大加快了耐药性的产生。

words.definition: likely to exist, happen, or be true; likely, trusted, authentic
words.translation: 很可能的, 大概的；很可能的；可信的

examples.en: The probable cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
examples.zh: 起火的原因很可能是电路故障。

examples.en: Success is highly probable .
examples.zh: 成功的希望相当大。

words.definition: an agreement that is achieved after everyone involved accepts less than what they wanted at first, or the act of making this agreement; harm, meet someone halfway; meet someone halfway, come to terms with; accommodation, reconciliation
words.translation: 妥协, 让步；妥协；危害；让步；妥协，和解；折衷

examples.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of marriage.
examples.zh: 妥协是婚姻生活中必不可少的。

examples.en: To stop the argument they decided on a compromise.
examples.zh: 为停止争吵，他们决定作出妥协。

examples.en: If moderates fail to reach a compromise , the extremists will dominate the agenda.
examples.zh: 如果温和派不能达成妥协，激进派就会主宰议事日程。

words.definition: an unfair situation, in which some groups in society have more money, opportunities, power etc than others; difference, disparity
words.translation: 不平等, 不平均；[数]不平等；不同；不平均

examples.en: People are concerned about corruption and social inequality.
examples.zh: 人们对腐败和社会不公感到担忧。

words.definition: a scientist who has special knowledge and training in  physics; physical scientist
words.translation: 物理学者, 唯物论者；物理学家；唯物论者

examples.en: ...a nuclear physicist.
examples.zh: …一位核物理学家。

words.definition: involving a lot of activity, effort, or careful attention in a short period of time; enhanced, reinforced, concentrated, searching, mass
words.translation: 强烈的, 精深的；加强的；[经]集中的；透彻的；加强语气的

examples.en: a one-week intensive course in English
examples.zh: 为期一周的英语强化课程

examples.en: a day of intensive negotiations
examples.zh: 紧张谈判的一天

words.definition: to not remember facts, information, or people or things from the past; fail, sponge out; sponge out, slip one's mind
words.translation: 忘记, 忽略；忘记；忽略

examples.en: I’m sorry, I’ve forgotten your name.
examples.zh: 对不起，我忘记你的名字了。

examples.en: I know you told me, but I forgot.
examples.zh: 我知道你告诉过我，但是我忘了。

examples.en: What happened that day will never be forgotten.
examples.zh: 那一天的事永远难忘。

words.definition: relating to the official system which takes letters from one place to another; post card
words.translation: 邮政的,邮局的；明信片

examples.en: the U.S. postal service
examples.zh: 美国邮政

examples.en: an increase in postal charges
examples.zh: 邮资的上涨

words.definition: a playing card with a picture of a queen on it; Regina, lady in waiting
words.translation: 王后, 女王；女王，王后；（纸牌中的）皇后；（蜜蜂等的）蜂王

examples.en: the queen of diamonds
examples.zh: 方块Q，方块王后

words.definition: someone who works on a ship; matlo, matelot
words.translation: 海员, 水手；水手，海员；乘船者

examples.en: Six British sailors drowned.
examples.zh: 六名英国海员溺水身亡。

examples.en: We were both experienced sailors.
examples.zh: 我们两个都是经验丰富的水手。

words.definition: the act of becoming involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens; prevention, violation
words.translation: 干涉；介入；调停；妨碍

examples.en: government intervention to regulate prices
examples.zh: 政府介入控制物价

words.definition: not moving at all; settled, steady, constant, standing, permanent
words.translation: 不动的, 静止的；固定的；稳定的；不变的

examples.en: She could see a figure sitting immobile, facing the sea.
examples.zh: 她看到一个人影面朝大海坐着，一动不动。

words.definition: something that exists as a single and complete unit; presence, existence, essence, principle, texture
words.translation: 实体；存在；本质

examples.en: The mind exists as a separate entity.
examples.zh: 思想作为一个独立的实体存在。

examples.en: Good design brings a house and garden together as a single entity.
examples.zh: 优秀的设计能把一所房子和花园合为一体。

words.definition: a set of pages that show the days, weeks, and months of a particular year, that you usually hang on a wall; daily schedule, ephemeris
words.translation: 日历, 历法；日历；[天]历法；[管理]日程表

examples.en: There was a calendar on the wall above, with large squares around the dates.
examples.zh: 墙的上方曾有一本日历，日期框在大方格里。

words.definition: to become firm, steady, or unchanging, or to make something firm or steady
words.translation: 稳定

examples.en: The patient’s condition has now stabilized.
examples.zh: 病人的情况现已稳定下来了。

examples.en: an attempt to stabilize the economy
examples.zh: 稳定经济的努力

words.definition: a series of musical notes that are played or sung and are nice to listen to; accordance, breast, air, concert; adjust, coordinate, accord, restructure; sort, concert
words.translation: 曲调vt调音, 调整；曲调；和谐；心情；调整；使一致；为…调音；[电子][通信]调谐；协调

examples.en: That’s a nice tune.
examples.zh: 那曲调很美。

examples.en: She sang some old classics and a few new tunes.
examples.zh: 她唱了几首经典老歌和一些新曲。

words.definition: mostly or mainly; mainly, basically, largely, mostly, primarily
words.translation: 主要地, 占优势地；主要地；显著地

examples.en: The city’s population is predominantly Irish.
examples.zh: 该城市的人口绝大多数是爱尔兰人。

words.definition: a very strong feeling of dislike that almost makes you sick, caused by something unpleasant; aversion, abomination; indispose, repel
words.translation: 厌恶vi令人厌恶，作呕；厌恶，嫌恶；使厌恶；使作呕

examples.en: He reached into the bin with a look of disgust on his face.
examples.zh: 他把手伸进垃圾箱，脸上带着厌恶的表情。

words.definition: not containing or having enough of something; insufficient, short, inadequate, lacking, disabled
words.translation: 缺乏的, 不足的；不足的；有缺陷的；不充分的

examples.en: Women who are dieting can become iron deficient.
examples.zh: 节食的女性有可能缺铁。

words.definition: help or support; aid, hand, help, boost

examples.zh: 国王想通过战争来提高自己的威信。

examples.zh: 这家名不见经传的英国公司如今已经声名鹊起。

examples.zh: 眼下流行艳丽的色彩。

examples.zh: 这个教派，原本是一个多世纪以前从摩门教末世圣徒教会分离出来的，相信一夫多妻制可以升上天堂。

examples.zh: 他建立了一个宗教，一开始是个宗派，然后是宗教，最后成为一个帝国，神圣罗马帝国，即是按着他,教诲的名义而建立。

examples.en: Thus was the technology preserved through this holy sect. Many brilliant souls were among these.
examples.zh: 因此，这技术是透过 神圣的教派所保存的 ，其中有许多才华横溢的灵魂。

examples.zh: 在此后的十五年中，她分别在百老汇和歌舞杂耍中演出。

examples.en: Target girl is a term sometimes used in circus and vaudeville to denote a female assistant in "impalement" acts such as knife throwing, archery or sharpshooting.
examples.zh: 标靶女郎是有时用于马戏团和杂耍的一个词语，指的是在飞刀，射箭或飞镖之类“飞刺”节目中的女助手。

examples.en: If the euro zone wants its currency to survive, it must stem the panic and make Italy’s vaudeville politics credible.
examples.zh: 如果欧元区希望它们的货币幸存，它必须遏制恐慌并使得意大利的杂耍般的政治变得可信。

words.definition: a pleasant smell that something has; smell, nose, mark, wind, trace; discover, wake to; show evidence of
words.translation: 气味；嗅觉；痕迹；察觉能力；闻到；发觉；使充满…的气味；循着遗臭追踪；发出…的气味；有…的迹象；嗅着气味追赶

examples.zh: 这本指南正被翻译成好几种语言，准备在圣诞节前后出版。

examples.zh: 他的声音里含着一丝悲伤。

examples.zh: 冻成冰块的狗屎点缀着高尔夫球场的苔原。

examples.zh: 没几个军官认为德捷之战会是局部战争。

examples.zh: 这架航天飞机已经停止了传输数据，这是这次任务中一个十分严重的反常现象。

examples.zh: 几天以后，我军解放了这座城市。

examples.zh: 母亲的过世使他感到更加孤单。

examples.zh: 她用楔形文字写下了献给神祇的颂歌。

examples.zh: 楔形文字是世界上已知最古老的文字。 这是一种刻在陶片上的文字，它的使用者是5000多年以前生活在美索不达米亚平原上的人们。

examples.zh: 申请人必须提供证明文件。

examples.zh: 甚至于地球的表层——岩石圈——也已经被改变了。

examples.zh: 它的主要组成成分是硫酸盐、硝酸盐、氨、氯化钠、碳、矿物粉尘和水。

examples.zh: 反对猎杀动物运动的人士举行的示威游行

examples.zh: 仅仅四年之后，第一艘蒸汽船横渡了大西洋。

examples.zh: 它有至少一个基因是光合作用所必需的——到目前为止这是唯一被发现具有此项能力的动物。

examples.zh: 但是随着海水变暖，它的层次会更加分明，温度更高的海水会停留在表面，而这里正是生物体进行光合作用必需的地方。

examples.zh: 用特殊的着色剂后，你会发现有的细菌上长着不少波状的"毛发"即鞭毛，而有的细菌只有一根鞭毛。

examples.zh: 这肉里应该加点盐和芥末调味。

examples.zh: 我递给他们番茄酱和芥末酱，他们给了我一切！

examples.zh: 如果条件允许的话，最好在自然日光下工作。

examples.zh: 坐在那里进行着静脉点滴，我想到了所有的人类劳动和独创性在这一时刻汇聚到了一起。

examples.zh: 当她把汽车搭上齿轮时，汽车便开始颠簸地行进。

examples.zh: 这个大齿轮带动小齿轮使滚筒旋转。

examples.zh: 警察正在调查这家医院的儿童神秘死亡事件。

examples.en: Benson later disappeared in mysterious circumstances .
examples.zh: 本森后来就神秘地失踪了。

examples.en: There’s something mysterious going on.
examples.zh: 出了件怪事。

words.definition: relating to sound that is recorded or broadcast; vocal, sonic
words.translation: 音频的,声音的；[声]声音的；音频的，声频的

examples.en: audio and video equipment
examples.zh: 音频视频设备

words.definition: a building where lights on a curved ceiling show the movements of planets and stars
words.translation: 天文馆

examples.en: The motions of the stars can be approximated in a planetarium.
examples.zh: 星星的运动可在天文馆里模拟。

examples.en: Washington lived in an impoverished West Side community and has strong memories of preschool field trips to the library, zoo and planetarium where he learned to love science.
examples.zh: 华盛顿住在贫困的西部社区，他深深地记得那时候在学前班时的图书馆，动物园和天文馆的活动，在那里，他学会了热爱科学。

examples.en: Thecomplex also has Europe’s largest planetarium, an IMAX theater, and an opera house.
examples.zh: 其综合设施还有欧洲最大的天文馆，IMAX电影院和一个歌剧院。

words.definition: a small creature with eight legs, which catches insects using a fine network of sticky threads; araneid, tripod
words.translation: 蜘蛛,三脚架；[无脊椎]蜘蛛；设圈套者；三脚架

words.definition: funny and enjoyable; funny, witty
words.translation: 幽默的,诙谐的；诙谐的，幽默的；滑稽的，可笑的

examples.en: humorous stories
examples.zh: 诙谐的故事

examples.en: The film has some mildly humorous moments.
examples.zh: 那部电影中有些略显幽默的片段。

words.definition: belonging to or typical of the aristocracy; noble, nobiliary
words.translation: 贵族政治的,贵族的；贵族的；贵族政治的；有贵族气派的

examples.en: an aristocratic family
examples.zh: 贵族家庭

words.definition: a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly coloured feathers that can be taught to copy human speech; Nuri, popinjay
words.translation: 鹦鹉；[鸟]鹦鹉；学舌者，应声虫；机械模仿别人的人

examples.en: We recited poems parrot fashion.
examples.zh: 我们鹦鹉学舌般机械地背诵诗歌。

words.definition: shrub, frutex; peter; cluster; robust, gross, rough, country
words.translation: 矮树丛；[林]灌木；以灌木装饰；使…精疲力竭；丛生；浓密地生长；如灌木般长得低矮的；粗野的

words.definition: a piece of equipment that uses radio waves to find the position of things and watch their movement
words.translation: 雷达,电波探测器

examples.en: The coastline can now be monitored by radar.
examples.zh: 现在能用雷达监测海岸线了。

examples.en: We could see the plane quite clearly on the radar screen.
examples.zh: 我们在雷达屏幕上可清晰地看到飞机。

words.definition: to leave or drive (ships, fish, etc) aground or ashore or (of ships, fish, etc) to be left or driven ashore; string, thread, cluster; ground; beach, take the ground
words.translation: 使搁浅；线；串；海滨；使陷于困境；弄断；使落后；搁浅

words.definition: the ability of a system to conduct electricity, measured by the ratio of the current flowing through the system to the potential difference across it; the reciprocal of resistance; electric conduction, electrical conduction
words.translation: 电导, 导率；[电]电导；导率；电导系数

examples.en: They measure skin conductance, or sweating response.
examples.zh: 这些措施皮肤电导，或出汗的反应。

examples.en: Most studies of physiology-based measurements of pain have focused on heart rate, skin conductance and EEG.
examples.zh: 大多数基于生理的疼痛测量研究都聚焦于心率、皮肤电导和脑电图。

examples.en: These, say the researchers, correspond to drops in conductance when DNA strands slide across the gap via a biochemical process known as translocation.
examples.zh: 研究人员认为这是由于DNA链通过时产生了一种叫做易位的生化过程，使得石墨烯的电导发生了下降。

words.definition: to remove unwanted substances from water, air etc by passing it through a special substance or piece of equipment; sink in, seep into; strainer, percolator; penetrate, lauter
words.translation: 过滤 ,透(过)；滤过；渗入；慢慢传开；[电子][光]滤波器；[轻][核][化工]过滤器；筛选；滤光器；[轻][核][化工]过滤；渗透；用过滤法除去

examples.en: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
examples.zh: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

examples.en: The ozone layer filters harmful UV rays from the sun.
examples.zh: 臭氧层过滤掉有害的太阳紫外线。

words.translation: 雨林

examples.en: The rainforest is essential in other areas also.
examples.zh: 雨林在其他地区也是必不可少的。

examples.en: The rainforest around our house sometimes brings forth intriguing creatures like this.
examples.zh: 我们的房子周围的雨林有时带来了这样有趣的生物。

examples.en: Then we carried on in the worst conditions yet: low, tangled rainforest that blocked out the light, and mud up to our thighs.
examples.zh: 那时我们还在最糟糕的环境里行进着：低矮、纷乱的雨林遮住了阳光，泥浆没至我们的大腿。

words.definition: hormone, incretion; incretionary, hormonic
words.translation: 内分泌；[生理]内分泌；激素；内分泌物；[生理]内分泌的；激素的

examples.en: Located near the base of the neck, the thyroid is a large endocrine gland that produces hormones that help control growth and metabolism.
examples.zh: 甲状腺位于颈部的底部附近，是一个很大的内分泌腺体，它产生激素，协助控制生长和新陈代谢。

examples.en: Located near the base of the neck, the thyroid is a large endocrine gland that produces hormones that help control growth and metabolism.
examples.zh: 甲状腺位于脖子底部附近，它是一个较大的内分泌腺体，产生的荷尔蒙控制生长和新陈代谢。

examples.en: Some of the chemicals that are all around us have the ability to interfere with our endocrine systems, which regulate the hormones that control our weight, our biorhythms and our reproduction.
examples.zh: 我们周围的某些化学物质会影响人体的内分泌系统——其作用是通过调节激素分泌从而控制体重、生理周期以及生殖能力。

words.definition: a very poisonous plant, or the poison that is made from it
words.translation: 铁杉,毒芹

examples.en: Soon a dark wall of trees—red spruce, balsam fir, beech, hemlock—surrounds you, and there's a sudden stony persistence.
examples.zh: 很快你会被一堵厚厚的树墙包围——红云杉、香脂冷杉、山毛榉和铁杉，这会持续一段时间。

examples.en: Then our first taste of wilderness at the Kejimkujik 147-square-mile National Park, whose rolling hills and waterways are home to moose, bear, red squirrels and ancient hemlock forests.
examples.zh: 我们初次见到荒野是在凯吉姆库吉克147平方英里的国家公园，这里群山起伏，河流纵横，古老的铁杉林中是麋鹿，熊和红松鼠的家乡。

examples.en: Gossamer veils of fog lay over the dark spruce and hemlock hills that disappeared in the mist above me.
examples.zh: 轻纱般的薄雾笼罩着长满云杉和铁杉的山峦，让人难以看清它们的容颜。

words.definition: the quality of trying to do something even when it is difficult; decision, resolution, push, backbone
words.translation: 决心, 果断；决心；果断

examples.en: his dogged determination (= very strong determination ) to succeed
examples.zh: 他想要成功的坚定决心

words.definition: Exclusively is used to refer to situations or activities that involve only the thing or things mentioned, and nothing else; solely
words.translation: 专门地，排除其他地；唯一地；专有地；排外地

examples.en: ...an exclusively male domain.
examples.zh: …一个由男性独占的领域。

words.definition: a sentence or phrase from a book, speech etc which you repeat in a speech or piece of writing because it is interesting or amusing; citing, citation
words.translation: 引文,引语；[贸易]报价单；引用语；引证

examples.en: The following quotation is taken from a nineteenth century travel diary.
examples.zh: 下文引自19世纪的一篇旅行日记。

examples.en: a dictionary of quotations
examples.zh: 引语词典，语录汇编

words.definition: to notice or understand something by thinking about it carefully; recognize, identify; see clearly, tell from
words.translation: 察觉出,识别；识别；领悟，认识；看清楚，辨别

words.definition: teacher, master
words.translation: 教授；教师；公开表示信仰的人

examples.en: The professor improvised a poem in the class.
examples.zh: 教授在课堂上即兴创作了一首诗。

examples.en: The professor lambasted me for my careless mistake.
examples.zh: 教授严厉批评了我的粗心错误。

examples.en: We were laughing about that absent-minded professor.
examples.zh: 我们都在笑那个心不在焉的教授。

words.definition: the natural process of depositing a substance on rocks or soil; mineral deposit, orebed
words.translation: 沉积, 免职；[地质]沉积物；矿床；革职

examples.en: the deposition of marine sediments
examples.zh: 海洋沉积物的沉积

words.definition: an amount that you can hold in your hand; fewness, the minority
words.translation: 一把, 少数；少数；一把；棘手事

examples.en: There were only a handful of people there.
examples.zh: 那里只有几个人。

words.definition: a mistake, mark, or weakness that makes something imperfect; checking, defect, deficiency, vice, fault; crack, fracture
words.translation: 缺点，瑕疵；瑕疵，裂纹；缺点；一阵狂风；使无效；使破裂，使有缺陷

examples.en: A design flaw (= a mistake or weakness in the way something was made ) caused the engine to explode.
examples.zh: 一个设计缺陷导致了引擎爆炸。

words.definition: a  space shuttle; spaceplane
words.translation: 航天飞机；梭子 v穿梭来回(运送)；[航]航天飞机；穿梭；[纺]梭子；穿梭班机、公共汽车等

examples.en: He took the Washington - New York shuttle.
examples.zh: 他乘坐华盛顿－纽约的往返班机。

words.definition: something that you need to have in order to live; need, want, demand, requirement for
words.translation: 需要,必需品；需要；[数]必然性；[经]必需品

examples.en: She saw books as a necessity, not a luxury.
examples.zh: 她视书籍为必需品而非奢侈品。

examples.en: A car is an absolute necessity if you live in the country.
examples.zh: 你要是住在乡下，绝对需要有辆汽车。

words.definition: in a way that is right or fair; relatively, fairly, comparatively, pretty, considerably
words.translation: 有理地；合理地；相当地；适度地

examples.en: He can’t reasonably be expected to have known that.
examples.zh: 按理说，他是不可能知道那件事的。

words.definition: if you chill something such as food or drink, or if it chills, it becomes very cold but does not freeze; cold, algor; cold, distant; refrigerate
words.translation: 使变冷(冷冻) n寒冷；寒冷；寒意；寒心；寒冷的；冷漠的；扫兴的；冷冻，冷藏；使寒心；使感到冷

examples.en: a glass of chilled white wine
examples.zh: 一杯冰镇白葡萄酒

examples.zh: 把混合物舀进碗里，冷藏两小时。

examples.en: The longer this salad chills, the better the flavour.
examples.zh: 这种色拉冷藏时间越长味道越好。

words.definition: a pale red colour; picture, ideal; stick, string
words.translation: 粉红色(的)；粉红色；化身，典范；石竹花；头面人物；扎，刺，戳；使…变粉红色；使…面红耳赤

examples.en: Her room was decorated in bright pinks and purples.
examples.zh: 她的房间装饰成明亮的粉红色和紫色。

examples.en: She had arrived dressed in pink.
examples.zh: 她穿着粉色的衣服来了。

words.definition: the inner surface of the top part of a room; overhead, high limit
words.translation: 天花板, 上限；[建]天花板；上限

examples.en: rooms with high ceilings
examples.zh: 天花板很高的房间

examples.en: a light hanging from the ceiling
examples.zh: 吊在天花板上的灯

words.definition: messmateism, mutualism
words.translation: 共栖；[生态]共栖；共生

examples.en: Some associations of species are almost a form of commensalism.
examples.zh: 有些种类的组合几乎是共栖的形式。

examples.en: The symbiosis behavior mode of enterprise and farmer household include commensalism, dissymmetry mutualism and symmetry mutualism.
examples.zh: 企业与农户共生行为模式包括偏利共生、非对称性互惠共生和对称性互惠共生三种。

examples.en: Otherwise, choosing market segmenting and niche so as to change the relationship from competition to commensalism and reciprocity between first-mover and second-mover should be a good choice.
examples.zh: 相反，则宜采取市场细分“拾余补漏”策略将与先行者的竞争关系转化为互惠共生关系。

words.definition: the relationship between a parasite and its host
words.translation: 寄生状态, 寄生病

words.definition: existing, happening, or used outside, not inside a building; weather, out of door
words.translation: 室外的, 户外的；户外的；露天的；野外的（等于out-of-door）

examples.zh: 一个规模庞大的露天市场

examples.en: outdoor recreational activities
examples.zh: 户外娱乐活动

examples.en: outdoor clothing
examples.zh: 户外装

words.definition: a cover for a bed, usually made of wool; soogan, sugan; entire, corporate, overall, universal; invest, house, sheet, roof, cap
words.translation: 毯子；毛毯，毯子；毯状物，覆盖层；[经]总括的，全体的；没有限制的；覆盖，[电子]掩盖；用毯覆盖

examples.en: She huddled herself in the blanket.
examples.zh: 她用毯子紧紧裹住自己。

examples.en: They muffled up her head with a blanket.
examples.zh: 他们用毯子蒙住了她的头。

examples.en: He lapped his daughter in a warm blanket.
examples.zh: 他把女儿裹在一个暖和的毯子里。

words.definition: to make something such as a system or building more modern
words.translation: 使现代化

examples.en: They need more funds to modernize the country’s telephone system.
examples.zh: 他们需要更多的资金将本国的电话系统现代化。

examples.en: a tastefully modernized old farmhouse
examples.zh: 雅致而现代化的旧农舍

words.definition: the feeling you have when you are bored, or the quality of being boring; taedium, ennui
words.translation: 厌倦；令人厌烦的事物

examples.en: a game to relieve the boredom of a long journey
examples.zh: 长途旅行中解闷的一个游戏

examples.en: the sheer boredom of being in jail
examples.zh: 牢狱生活的单调乏味

words.definition: in or to a place, but you do not say or know exactly where
words.translation: 某处, 在某处

examples.en: My wallet must be around here somewhere.
examples.zh: 我的钱包肯定是在这里的什么地方。

examples.en: We could meet for dinner at Giorgio’s or somewhere (= or a similar place ) .
examples.zh: 我们可以在乔治家或别的什么地方一起吃饭。

words.definition: the state of being happy; welfare, xingfu, eudemonia
words.translation: 幸福, 快乐；幸福

examples.en: Juliet’s eyes shone with happiness.
examples.zh: 朱丽叶的双眼闪耀着幸福的光芒。

examples.en: We want our children to have the best possible chance of happiness.
examples.zh: 我们希望自己的孩子得到追求幸福的最佳机会。

words.definition: the system or type of money that a country uses; money, circulating medium
words.translation: 流通；[金融]货币；通货

examples.en: The bank can supply you with foreign currency .
examples.zh: 这家银行能为你提供外币。

examples.en: There are moves towards a single currency in Europe.
examples.zh: 欧洲有向单一货币发展的趋势。

examples.en: The local currency is the Swiss franc.
examples.zh: 当地的货币是瑞士法郎。

words.definition: an area of a state or country that has its own government to deal with local matters; prefecture, shire
words.translation: 县, 郡；郡，县

examples.en: Fairfax County, Virginia
examples.zh: 弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯县

words.definition: the letters that someone sends and receives, especially official or business letters; accordance, communication, unity, agreement, identity
words.translation: 通信, 信件, 相符；通信；一致；相当

examples.en: A secretary came in twice a week to deal with his correspondence.
examples.zh: 一个秘书每个星期来两次处理他的信件。

words.definition: the feeling that you can trust someone or something to be good, work well, or produce good results; faith, trust, secret, privacy, hope
words.translation: 信心；信任；秘密

examples.en: I felt I was doing well and my confidence began to grow.
examples.zh: 我觉得自己干得不错，自信心就开始增加了。

words.definition: when something affects or covers a particular area or group of things; lay over, decken
words.translation: 覆盖；[植]覆盖，覆盖范围

examples.en: More satellites are needed to provide telephone coverage in remote areas.
examples.zh: 需要更多的人造衞星覆盖边远地区的电话服务。

words.definition: the scientific study of plants; phytology
words.translation: 植物学；[植]植物学；地区植物总称

examples.en: To what degree are you interested in botany?
examples.zh: 你对植物学的兴趣达到什么程度?

examples.en: I went to that class straight from the botany class, which didn't help me any in understanding either subject.
examples.zh: 我上完植物学课后直接去上经济学课，不过这对于我理解这两门科目都毫无帮助。

words.definition: appearing to have a particular quality, when this may or may not be true
words.translation: 表面上地

examples.en: seemingly unrelated bits of information
examples.zh: 似乎互不相关的零星信息

words.definition: someone who supports the idea that women should have the same rights and opportunities as men
words.translation: 男女平等主义者

examples.en: She’s been an outspoken feminist for over twenty years.
examples.zh: 20多年来，她一直是个直言不讳的女权主义者。

words.definition: a white metal that is  radioactive  and is used in the treatment of diseases such as  cancer  . It is a chemical  element  : symbol Ra
words.translation: [化]镭

examples.en: Madame Curie discovered radium.
examples.zh: 居里夫人发现了镭。

examples.en: The  radiation  radius of the  radioactive  radium  radiator in the  stadium is  variable.
examples.zh: 放射性的镭暖气装置的辐射半径在体育场是易变的。

examples.en: Madame Curie was the physicist with expertise in chemistry that, in 1898, discovered the radioactive substances of radium and polonium in Paris, France.
examples.zh: 居里夫人是一位具有化学专门知识的物理学家。 1898年，她在法国巴黎发现了放射性物质的镭和钋。

words.definition: to send out electronic signals, messages etc using radio, television, or other similar equipment; release, send, communicate, project, let go
words.translation: 传送,传达；传输；传播；发射；传达；遗传

examples.en: The US Open will be transmitted live via satellite.
examples.zh: 美国公开赛将通过卫星现场直播。

examples.en: The system transmits information over digital phone lines.
examples.zh: 这一系统通过数字电话线路传输信息。

words.definition: to continue to do something, although this is difficult, or other people oppose it; stay, abide; iterate
words.translation: 坚持, 持续；存留，坚持；持续，固执；坚持说，反复说

examples.en: ‘I don’t think it’s right,’ John persisted.
examples.zh: “我认为那不对。”约翰坚持说道。

words.definition: a soldier or fighter who is brave and experienced – used about people in the past; champion, fighter, brave
words.translation: 勇士，武士；战士，勇士；鼓吹战争的人

examples.en: a noble warrior
examples.zh: 忠勇的战士

words.definition: able to be carried or moved easily; luggable, hand-held
words.translation: 便于携带的,轻便的；手提的，便携式的；轻便的

examples.en: a portable radio
examples.zh: 便携式收音机

words.definition: kind and careful in the way you behave or do things, so that you do not hurt or damage anyone or anything; pacific, moderate, soft, mild, temperate; soften, milden; grubworm, maggot
words.translation: 温和的, 文雅的；温和的；文雅的；使温和，使驯服；蛆，饵

examples.en: Arthur was a very gentle, caring person.
examples.zh: 阿瑟是一个非常温柔体贴的人。

words.definition: happening or done quickly and immediately; quick, rapid, fast, forward, ready; quickly, rapidly, fast, promptly, ready
words.translation: 迅速的,敏捷的；快的；迅速的；敏捷的；立刻的；迅速地

examples.en: My letter received a swift reply.
examples.zh: 我的信很快就得到了回复。

examples.en: She shot a swift glance at Paul.
examples.zh: 她迅速瞥了保罗一眼。

words.definition: to think that something is probably true, especially something bad; sus; doubtful, questionable; dispute, imagine, wonder, question; wonder, imagine, question, suppose
words.translation: 推测,怀疑；[法]嫌疑犯；可疑的；不可信的；怀疑；猜想

examples.en: She strongly suspected he was lying to her.
examples.zh: 她非常怀疑他在对她撒谎。

examples.en: She’s not going to be very happy about this, I suspect .
examples.zh: 我想对于此事她不会太高兴。

words.definition: tired and ready to sleep; inactive, slumberous
words.translation: 困乏的,欲睡的；欲睡的；困乏的；不活跃的

examples.en: The warmth from the fire made her feel sleepy.

examples.zh: 你最不想要的就是不断让你想起一段糟糕经历的东西。

words.definition: food - used especially when talking about the business of producing or selling food; diet, eating, edible, commissariat

examples.en: a shortage of basic foodstuffs
examples.zh: 基本食品短缺

words.definition: someone whose job is to take care of sheep; to lead or guide a group of people somewhere, making sure that they go where you want them to go; guide, coach, supervise; minister, priest
words.translation: 牧羊人；带领，引导；牧羊；带领；指导；看管；牧师；指导者

examples.en: In comparison, a German shepherd has a biting pressure of 750 pounds per square inch.
examples.zh: 相比较，德国牧羊犬在咬牙时每平方英寸大约有750英镑的压力。

words.definition: a tall tree with long hard sharp leaves that do not fall off in winter; rare, aspire; ananas; regret, grieve over
words.translation: 松(树) vi消瘦；渴望，痛苦；憔悴；[林]松树；凤梨，菠萝；为…悲哀；哀悼

examples.zh: 一片古老的松树林

examples.en: One of the witnesses was a paid informant for the FBI.
examples.zh: 目击者之一是联邦调查局出钱雇用的线人。

words.definition: to use something for a particular purpose, give something to a particular person etc, especially after an official decision has been made; portion, part, appropriate; parcel out, to assign
words.translation: 分派, 分配；分配；拨出；使坐落于；指定

examples.en: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
examples.zh: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

words.definition: a large  evergreen  tree with leaves shaped like needles; cedrus
words.translation: 雪松；香柏；西洋杉木

examples.en: The yacht is built of cedar strip planking.
examples.zh: 这艘游艇用雪松木板材制成。

words.definition: to disappear suddenly, especially in a way that cannot be easily explained; disappear, blank; unmake
words.translation: 消失；[数]消失；突然不见；成为零；使不见，[数]使消失

examples.en: My keys were here a minute ago but now they’ve vanished.
examples.zh: 我的钥匙刚刚还在这里，现在却不翼而飞了。

examples.en: The bird vanished from sight.
examples.zh: 那只鸟从视线中消失了。

examples.en: She seemed to have just vanished into thin air (= suddenly disappeared in a very mysterious way ).
examples.zh: 她好像就蒸发了似的。

words.definition: a thick flat piece of a hard material such as stone; thick plate, heavy plate
words.translation: 厚板，平板；厚板，[木]平板；混凝土路面；厚片

examples.en: a concrete slab
examples.zh: 水泥板

examples.en: paving slabs
examples.zh: 铺路石板

words.definition: if two different things coexist, they exist at the same time or in the same place
words.translation: 共存

examples.en: But I think both can coexist.
examples.zh: 但是我认为两者可以共存。

examples.en: In fact, both do coexist.
examples.zh: 事实上，两者是共存的。

examples.en: We must coexist with them, but not let them take us over.
examples.zh: 我们必须与之共存，但不要让它们将我们压垮。

words.definition: a type of hard rock that becomes smooth when it is polished, and is used for making buildings,  statue s  etc; mable, sarcophagus; hard, coldhearted
words.translation: 大理石；[岩]大理石；大理石制品；弹珠；[岩]大理石的；冷酷无情的

examples.en: The columns were of white marble.
examples.zh: 柱子是白色的大理石。

examples.en: a marble statue
examples.zh: 大理石雕像

words.definition: a large brown animal like a  deer  that has very large flat  antler s (= horns that grow like branches )  and lives in North America, northern Europe, and parts of Asia
words.translation: [动] 驼鹿

examples.en: So did we encounter our bear, or a moose?
examples.zh: 那么，我们到底遇到了熊或者麋鹿吗？

examples.en: On the islands of the Kronotsky river, wild reindeer and moose coexist with bears.
examples.zh: 在克罗诺茨基河畔，驼鹿，驯鹿还有棕熊这三种动物和平共处。

examples.en: Except for the moose wandering down the road.
examples.zh: 除了你可以看到麋鹿在马路上游逛。

words.definition: ling, codfish; kid, pull a fast one; sell, fox, make a fool of
words.translation: 货到付款 (Cash on Delivery) n鳕鱼；[鱼]鳕鱼；愚弄；哄骗；欺骗

words.definition: someone who goes to live in another area or country, especially in order to find work; visitor, migratory bird; ragamuffinly, nomadic
words.translation: 移居者, 候鸟；候鸟；移居者；随季节迁移的民工；移居的；流浪的

examples.en: The government divides asylum seekers into economic migrants and genuine refugees.
examples.zh: 政府将寻求政治庇护的人划分为经济移民和真正的难民。

words.definition: the science or practice of flying in aircraft; avigation, airmanship
words.translation: 航空,飞机制造业；[航]航空；飞行术；飞机制造业

examples.en: ...the aviation industry.
examples.zh: …航空工业。

words.definition: anterior, full-face
words.translation: 前沿；额的；[气象]正面的，前面的

examples.zh: 通过脑电波监测，他发现这些人在解开谜语之前，其右额叶皮质会出现一种高频率的神经活动，通常在得出答案的八秒钟甚至更短的时间内发生。

words.definition: A hexagonal object or shape has six straight sides
words.translation: 六角形的,六边的

examples.en: Instead it is the Desert Express that pulls in, its nine coaches in smart blue, orange and white livery with large hexagonal windows.
examples.zh: 然而驶进车站的是沙漠快车，它的九节车厢漆成漂亮的蓝色、橙色和白色，带有六边形的车窗。

examples.en: He has instead looked to the hexagonal matrices of snowflakes, which as structurally supported objects combine high volume with low weight.
examples.zh: 他期望使用雪花的六角形矩阵造型来作为支撑，因为这种结构做到了低重量与大容量的统一。

examples.en: In fact, I have kept a souvenir of those days: a dark green hexagonal glass spittoon that is now a very original flowerpot.
examples.zh: 说真的，我还保存了一个那个时代的纪念品--一个深绿色六角形的玻璃痰盂，如今，它成为了我的一个很别致的花盆。

words.definition: a serious magazine produced for professional people or those with a particular interest; magazine, diary
words.translation: 定期刊物, 杂志；日报，[图情]杂志；日记；分类账

examples.en: the British Medical Journal
examples.zh: 《英国医学杂志》

words.definition: to tell someone that something will definitely happen or is definitely true so that they are less worried; undertake, swear for
words.translation: 使确信, 确保；保证；担保；使确信；弄清楚

examples.en: The document is genuine, I can assure you .
examples.zh: 我能向你保证，这文件是真的。

words.definition: Sizable means fairly large; considerable, good-sized
words.translation: 相当大的；大小相当的

examples.en: Harry inherited the house and a sizable piece of land that surrounds it.
examples.zh: 哈里继承了那座房子和房子周围一块相当大的土地。

words.definition: to decay or make something decay; resolve, break down; analyze, break down
words.translation: (使)腐烂；分解；使腐烂；腐烂

examples.en: a partially decomposed body
examples.zh: 部分腐烂的尸体

words.definition: a soldier, plane etc that is sent to search the area in front of an army and get information about the enemy; searching, scanning; detect, watching, dog, guard; spy, make one's rounds
words.translation: 侦察员 vi侦察；搜索，[航][军]侦察；侦察员；侦察机；[航][军]侦察；跟踪，监视；发现；巡视；嘲笑

examples.en: He sent three scouts ahead to take a look at the bridge.
examples.zh: 他派出三名侦察兵到前面侦察大桥的情况。

words.translation: 矿化作用,成矿作用

words.definition: Krypton is an element that is found in the air in the form of a gas. It is used in fluorescent lights and lasers.
words.translation: [化] 氪

examples.en: Xenon and krypton are not retained by the body so they have little effect.
examples.zh: 氙和氪不能在人体内停留所以对人体影响很小。

examples.en: The krypton and xenon isotope ratios in the gas samples provided a surprising result: They did not match the ratios found in the primordial cloud that spawned the solar system.
examples.zh: 气体采样中的氪和氙同位素比值产生了一个令人吃惊的结果：这些比值跟在形成太阳系的原始云团中所发现的比值不一致。

words.definition: to become or make something become smaller or less; micrify, minify; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: (使)减少, (使)变小；使减少；使变小；减少，缩小；变小

examples.en: The party’s share of the electorate has diminished steadily.
examples.zh: 支持这个政党的选民比例持续下降。

examples.en: These drugs diminish blood flow to the brain.
examples.zh: 这些药物会减少流向脑部的血液量。

words.definition: remaining after a process, event etc is finished; surplus, spare; remaining, surplus, odd
words.translation: 剩余的, 残留的；[数]剩余；残渣；[数][地质]剩余的；残留的

examples.en: the residual effects of drug treatment
examples.zh: 药物治疗的残留作用

words.definition: the green-coloured substance in plants
words.translation: [生化]叶绿素

examples.en: The chlorophyll in wheatgrass also helps to purify the liver.
examples.zh: 麦草中的叶绿素同样可以帮助净化肝脏。

examples.en: Wheatgrass has antibiotic properties and is packed with chlorophyll as it is a plant.
examples.zh: 麦草含有抗生素，由于它是一种植物，所以含有许多叶绿素。

examples.en: This could be estimated at 1000 litres of hydrogen for 330 grams of chlorophyll per day whereas for example colza produces roughly only 1000 litres of oil per hectare . . .
examples.zh: 这种农场每天估计能够产生1000升氢气，而且只消耗330克叶绿素； 而比如种植菜籽，每公顷土地才能产生大约1000升油。

words.definition: a colourless gas that is found in very small quantities in the air. It is a chemical element: symbol Xe; Xe
words.translation: 氙(惰性气体的一种,元素符号Xe)；[化学]氙（稀有气体元素）

examples.zh: 气体采样中的氪和氙同位素比值产生了一个令人吃惊的结果：这些比值跟在形成太阳系的原始云团中所发现的比值不一致。

examples.en: Bathed in xenon spotlights, the white spaceship, attached to its twin solid rocket boosters and orange external fuel tank, crept 3.4 miles on the back of an enormous tractor called the Crawler.
examples.zh: 沐浴着氙气聚光灯光，白色的飞船，带着一对固体火箭推进器和橙色外挂燃料箱，在称为“爬行者”的巨大拖拉机上缓慢行驶了3.4英里。

words.definition: to wind or twist into a series of rings, or to make something do this; entwine; book, volume, roll, winding; wreathe
words.translation: 盘绕, 卷；盘绕，把…卷成圈；[电]线圈；卷；成圈状

examples.zh: 这条蛇盘在树枝上。

examples.en: Her long hair was coiled up in a plait at the top of her head.
examples.zh: 她的长发编成辫子盘在头顶。

examples.en: He coiled the rope.
examples.zh: 他把绳子卷了起来。

examples.en: He reacted well to penicillin.
examples.zh: 他对青霉素的反应良好。

examples.zh: 他向四周看了看，看了看路上也看了看宅基地和树林的边缘。

words.definition: admired as one of the best and most important; celebrated
words.translation: 享有声望的；有名望的

examples.zh: 享有盛名的文学奖

examples.zh: 赫赫有名的大学

examples.zh: 会有这样的时刻:当他感觉很好挫折和它爆发出来了。

examples.en: Your frustration could be an indication that you just need some input or assistance.
examples.zh: 你的挫折可能是在暗示你只是需要一些意见或援助。

examples.en: But before you give up, I’d like you to ask yourself what your frustration is telling you.
examples.zh: 但是，在你放弃之前，我希望你能问下自己，你的挫折在向你传达着怎样的讯息。

words.definition: someone, especially in the past, who was paid to clean someone’s house, cook for them, answer the door etc, and who often lived in the house; man, flunky
words.translation: 仆人；仆人，佣人；公务员；雇工

examples.en: Many young girls became domestic servants .
examples.zh: 许多年轻姑娘成了家仆。

words.translation: 仿制的,模仿的；模仿的；仿制的

examples.en: Young people might be provoked into imitative crime by the exploits they see on TV.
examples.zh: 年轻人可能会从电视上看到的“英勇行为”中受到启发而仿效电视主人公实施犯罪。

words.definition: a period of time in which someone is taught a particular skill, for example how to play a musical instrument or drive a car; lecture, indoctrinization; attend class, have a class
words.translation: 功课；教训；课；上课

examples.en: piano lessons
examples.zh: 钢琴课

words.translation: 孵卵；孵化；培养；温育；逐渐发展；酝酿

examples.en: The birds returned to their nests and continued to incubate the eggs.
examples.zh: 那些鸟儿返巢继续孵卵。

words.definition: a unit for measuring area, equal to 10,000 square metres; hektare
words.translation: 公顷（等于1万平方米）

examples.en: Mist rose from a nearby stand of thriving eucalyptus trees she planted after receiving title to more than a hectare of farmland.
examples.zh: 雾气从附近生长繁茂的桉树林中升起，这些树是她在获得对一公顷多农田的所有权后栽种的。

examples.en: This could be estimated at 1000 litres of hydrogen for 330 grams of chlorophyll per day whereas for example colza produces roughly only 1000 litres of oil per hectare . . .
examples.zh: 这种农场每天估计能够产生1000升氢气，而且只消耗330克叶绿素； 而比如种植菜籽，每公顷土地才能产生大约1000升油。

examples.en: Researchers at the algae greenhouse plan to scale up the trial to a 100 hectare (247 acre) site over the next three years.
examples.zh: 藻类温室的研究人员计划在未来三年内将试验范围扩大到一片100公顷（合247英亩）的场地上。

words.definition: giving all your attention to what is happening, being said etc; alarm, warn; vigilant, precautious; guard, vigilance
words.translation: 警觉的n戒备；警告；使警觉，使意识到；[军]警惕的，警觉的；留心的；[军]警戒，警惕；警报

examples.en: The animal raised its head, suddenly alert.
examples.zh: 那只动物突然警觉地抬起头来。

examples.en: Taking notes is one of the best ways to stay alert in lectures.
examples.zh: 记笔记是听课时集中注意力的最佳方法之一。

words.translation: 委员会

examples.zh: 委员会会议

words.definition: a sweet brown food that you can eat as a sweet or use in cooking to give foods such as cakes a special sweet taste

examples.zh: 巧克力条

examples.en: a chocolate cake
examples.zh: 巧克力蛋糕

examples.en: a packet of chocolate biscuits
examples.zh: 一包巧克力饼干

words.definition: blindly, dissolutely
words.translation: 松散地；宽松地；放荡地；轻率地

examples.en: If you actually combine the best ideas of both, you end up with an extensible and modular and loosely coupled system.
examples.zh: 如果你真的结合二者的最佳思想，就可以得到一个可扩展的、模块化的、松散耦合的系统。

examples.en: You can achieve greater flexibility, adaptability, and independence when each layer is only loosely coupled to the layer above and below.
examples.zh: 当每个层仅松散耦合到其上和其下的层时，您可以实现更强的灵活性、适应性和独立性。

examples.en: Applications that interact via messages have the advantage of being loosely coupled, because changes in one system have no impact on the other as long as both sides agree to the same message format.
examples.zh: 通过消息进行交互的应用程序具有松散耦合的优点，因为只要双方使用相同的消息格式，那么一个系统中的更改就不会对另一个系统产生影响。

words.definition: someone who made or invented a particular thing; coiner, inventor
words.translation: 创建者, 创作者；创造者；创建者

examples.en: ...Ian Fleming, the creator of James Bond.
examples.zh: …伊恩·弗莱明，詹姆斯·邦德的创作者。

words.definition: any substance that makes things dirty, such as mud or dust; earth, dust, clay, powder
words.translation: 污垢, 泥土；污垢，泥土；灰尘，尘土；下流话

examples.en: You should have seen the dirt on that car!
examples.zh: 你没看见那车上沾了多少泥！

examples.en: His face and hands were black with dirt.
examples.zh: 他的脸和手黑乎乎的，全是泥。

examples.en: a patch of grass, covered in dog dirt
examples.zh: 满是狗屎的一小片草地

words.definition: someone from Asia, or whose family originally came from Asia, especially India or Pakistan
words.translation: 亚洲(的), 亚洲人(的)

examples.en: Many of the shops were run by Asians.
examples.zh: 这些商店中有许多是由亚洲人经营的。

words.definition: feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something; intense, warm, crazy, eager, tropical
words.translation: 热心的, 热情的；热情的；热心的；狂热的

examples.en: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
examples.zh: 改革的热心支持者

words.definition: facts, information, documents etc that prove something is true; authentication, certification, demonstration, confirmation, witness; try out, put to test
words.translation: 证据，证明；证明；证据；校样；考验；验证；试验；校对；使不被穿透

examples.zh: 没有证据证明这份文件是真的。

words.translation: 下部构造,基础下部组织

examples.en: Some countries lack a suitable economic infrastructure.
examples.zh: 一些国家缺乏适当的经济基础设施。

examples.en: a $65 billion investment package in education, health care and infrastructure
examples.zh: 用于教育、医疗和基础设施的650亿美元一揽子投资计划

words.translation: (长篇)小说家；小说家

examples.zh: 一个浪漫派小说家成功的关键在于对自己故事的绝对信念。

words.definition: A Peruvian is someone who is Peruvian
words.translation: 秘鲁人(的)

words.translation: 静态的, 静止的；静态的；[电磁]静电的；静力的

examples.en: Economists predict that house prices will remain static for a long period.
examples.zh: 经济学家预测，房价将长期保持稳定。

words.definition: a type of large bird that kills and eats fish
words.translation: 白色的羽毛, 鱼鹰
苏格兰(英国的一部分,在不列颠北部)

examples.zh: 他去年在苏格兰旅行。

examples.en: England, Scotland and Wales compose the island of Great Britain.
examples.zh: 英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士组成大不列颠岛国。

examples.en: Why should they not go on to Scotland, if that had been the case?
examples.zh: 要是真象你所想的那样，那他们干吗不到苏格兰去呢？

words.definition: Underneath is also an adverb; hereunder, down below; basis, bottom, base; following, nether
words.translation: 在下面 prep在的下面；在下面；在底下；下面；底部；下面的；底层的

examples.en: He has on his jeans and a long-sleeved blue denim shirt with a white T-shirt underneath.
examples.zh: 他身穿牛仔裤和一件蓝色长袖粗斜纹棉布衬衫，里面还有件白色T恤衫。

examples.en: The shooting-range is lit from underneath by rows of ruby-red light fixtures.
examples.zh: 射击场被一排排宝石红照明装置从下面照亮。

words.definition: somebody who is an important and respected member of a group, and is involved in many public activities; column, ridgepole
words.translation: 柱子, 栋梁；柱子，柱形物；栋梁；墩

examples.en: Mr Fitzwilliam had been seen as a pillar of the community.
examples.zh: 菲茨威廉先生已被视为社区的骨干。

words.definition: Your affections are your feelings of love or fondness for someone; infection, impression, favor, effect, influence
words.translation: 影响, 感情；喜爱，[心理]感情；影响；感染

examples.en: Caroline is the object of his affections.
examples.zh: 卡罗琳是他感情的归属。

words.definition: used to mean a person, when you do not know or do not say who the person is
words.translation: 有人, 某人

examples.en: What would you do if someone tried to rob you in the street?
examples.zh: 要是有人在街上抢劫你，你会怎么办？

examples.en: Will someone please explain what’s going on?
examples.zh: 谁能说说是怎么回事？

examples.en: Have Brooks or someone fax this to New York right away.
examples.zh: 叫布鲁克斯或谁立刻把这个发传真到纽约。

words.definition: to be in or move into a position where your body is resting on your knees; drop to one's knees, go down on one's knees
words.translation: 跪下；跪下，跪

examples.en: Tom knelt down and patted the dog.
examples.zh: 汤姆跪下来轻轻拍了拍那只狗。

words.definition: a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is; appraisal, valuation, assessment, estimate, judgement
words.translation: 估价, 评价；评价；[审计]评估；估价；求值

examples.en: We need to carry out a proper evaluation of the new system.
examples.zh: 我们要对新系统进行合理的评估。

examples.en: They took some samples of products for evaluation.
examples.zh: 他们抽取了一些产品样本以作评估。

words.definition: any American ericaceous shrub of the genus Gaylussacia, having edible dark blue berries with large seeds
words.translation: 越橘类

examples.en: Groves of stunted red spruce, huckleberry, blueberry, mountain laurel, mountain holly, speckled alder, and cranberry bogs, show combinations of colors throughout the year.
examples.zh: 发育不良云杉的小树林、黑果木、蓝莓、山月桂、山冬青，斑点桤木和种越橘的沼泽地，显示着全年各种颜色的组合。

examples.en: I have watered the red huckleberry, the sand cherry and the nettle-tree, the red pine and the black ash, the white grape and the yellow violet, which might have withered else in dry seasons.
examples.zh: 我还浇灌红色的越橘树、沙色的樱桃树和荨麻树、红色的松树和黑色的白蜡树，还有白色的葡萄树和枯黄的紫罗兰，不然它们会在干旱的季节里枯萎的。

words.definition: a very large brown North American, European, and Asian animal with wide flat horns; milu, wapiti
words.translation: 麋鹿；软鞣粗皮；驼鹿皮革

examples.en: I covered the elk with a tarp and sat down near it, wrapping myself in blankets.
examples.zh: 我用一块防水布盖住了麋鹿，然后用毯子把自己裹起来，坐在它旁边。

examples.en: When the elk got up, the tarp slid off.
examples.zh: 麋鹿站起来的时候，防水布从它身上滑落。

words.definition: to become dark, or to make something dark; fog, becloud; black, grow dark
words.translation: (使)变暗；使变暗；使模糊；变黑；变得模糊

examples.en: The sky darkened and a few drops of rain fell.
examples.zh: 天色变暗，落下几滴雨来。

examples.en: a darkened theater
examples.zh: 变暗了的剧院

examples.en: The evening shadows darkened the room.
examples.zh: 夜幕使房间暗了下来。

words.definition: to experience physical or mental pain; stomach, stand, experience, tough, abide; stomach, come under
words.translation: 遭受, 经历；遭受；忍受；经历；遭受，忍受；受痛苦；经验；受损害

examples.en: At least he died suddenly and didn’t suffer.
examples.zh: 至少他死得突然，没有遭罪。

examples.en: She’s suffering a lot of pain.
examples.zh: 她遭受着巨大的痛苦。

words.definition: the lower part of your face. Its shape is sometimes thought to show your character; chin, jowl; rabbit on; lesson
words.translation: 颚,下巴；[脊椎]颌；下巴；[地质]狭窄入口；唠叨；教训；对…唠叨

examples.en: He punched him on the jaw.
examples.zh: 他一拳打在他的下巴上。

examples.en: a rugged physique and a strong square jaw
examples.zh: 强健的体格以及结实的方下巴

examples.en: She’s got a very determined jaw.
examples.zh: 她一脸坚毅。

words.definition: something that makes your life difficult or unpleasant, especially a lack of money, or the condition of having a difficult life; affliction, bitterness
words.translation: 困苦, 艰难；困苦；苦难；艰难险阻

examples.en: an economic policy that caused great hardship for many people
examples.zh: 造成许多人贫困的经济政策

examples.en: Many students are suffering severe financial hardship.
examples.zh: 许多学生经济非常困难。

words.translation: 历史上地

examples.en: And historically they acted with that sense of stewardship in mind, thinking of what was appropriate for the whole system and not simply for their firm.
examples.zh: 而且在历史上，他们也在心目中带有那种使命感，思考的是什么对这个社会是最好的，不仅仅是对自己的公司。

examples.en: After all, historically, the two nations have been enemies.
examples.zh: 毕竟在历史上，两个国家曾经是敌人。

examples.en: Because historically, we have not defined marriage in our constitution.
examples.zh: 因为历史上我们从未在宪法中给婚姻下过定义。

words.definition: bemaze
words.translation: 使失去方向感, 使迷惑；使…迷惑；使…失去方向感
[植]花青素, [化]花色醣苔

examples.en: Smith says that some species, most famously maples, produce anthocyanin during autumn as a kind of antioxidant for trees.
examples.zh: 史密斯说，一些物种，例如最有名的枫树，在秋天会产生的一种抗氧化剂的花青素。

examples.en: Smith said the crimson anthocyanin protects the delicate mechanisms that allow the tree to extract all the nutrients from its leaves.
examples.zh: 史密斯说，深红色的花青素保护着微妙的机制，它让树木从叶子里提取所需要的全部营养物。

examples.en: The canopy pictured above gets its crimson hue from a pigment called anthocyanin, the same component that lends red cabbage its intense color.
examples.zh: 图中华盖的深红色调来自一种称为花青素的色素，这种色素与红叶卷心菜的浓烈色彩有着相同的成分。

words.definition: very sour; sour, vinegary
words.translation: 酸的,酸性的；酸的，酸性的；产生酸的

examples.en: Some fruit juices taste a bit acidic.
examples.zh: 有些果汁味道略酸。

words.definition: to be older than someone else; better, ancient; older, senior, advancing
words.translation: 年长者, 老人；老人；长辈；年长者；父辈；年长的；年龄较大的；资格老的

examples.en: a meeting of the village elders
examples.zh: 村里长辈们的集会

words.definition: a small change made in something such as a design, plan, or system; correction, alteration, changing, revision
words.translation: 更改, 修改；修改，修正；改变

examples.en: They have used the same process for almost 50 years with only minor modifications .
examples.zh: 同样的工序他们用了将近50年，期间只做过很小的改动。

words.definition: used to refer to any person, when it is not important to say exactly who
words.translation: 任何一个

examples.en: Anyone could win tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚任何人都可能赢。

examples.en: They offer help and advice to anyone interested in becoming a teacher.
examples.zh: 他们为任何有兴趣当老师的人提供帮助和咨询。

examples.en: If anyone sees Lisa, ask her to call me.
examples.zh: 如果有谁看见莉萨，叫她打电话给我。

words.definition: keyboard, keyset
words.translation: 键盘；弦乐器指板

examples.en: I'm just doing it with a series of switches instead of a fingerboard, which we obviously don't have-- Okay. That's fine. That's great.
examples.zh: 只是我用的是阀键,代替圆号上很明显没有的指板,好的,很棒

words.definition: a boat or ship or such vessels collectively
words.translation: 船只

examples.en: Either way it seems certain that these people were using quite sophisticated technology and watercraft to fish offshore.
examples.zh: 不管人们用的那种方法抓鱼，似乎可以肯定，那些人使用了娴熟的技术和船只。

examples.en: People use “jet ski” to refer to a wide variety of personal watercraft; “rollerblade” to mean any inline skates—and “chupacabra” to mean any weird animal.
examples.zh: 人们用“jet ski”这个词组表示各种各样的个人船只；用“rollerblade”这个词表示任何直排轮滑——也用“卓帕卡布拉”来表示任何神秘的动物。

examples.en: When the Coast Guard spotted the vessel off the coast of Honduras, its crew sank the watercraft. They were later detained, according to a Coast Guard press release.
examples.zh: 据海岸警卫队透漏的消息，当海岸警卫队在洪都拉斯海岸截获该船的时候，船员将船沉入到了海底，随即，他们被拘捕了。

words.definition: development, formation, growth, making, enhancing
words.translation: 集结, 增长；增强；发展；形成；组合；树立名誉

words.definition: a clear liquid that is painted onto things, especially things made of wood, to protect them, or the hard shiny surface produced by this; to cover something with varnish; vernis, frills; colour, paint, hang, sugar
words.translation: 清漆；光泽；涂清漆，使光亮；亮光漆，清漆；虚饰；光泽面；装饰，粉饰；在…上涂清漆；使…有光泽

examples.en: The varnish comes in six natural wood shades.
examples.zh: 这种清漆有6种天然木材的色泽可选。

words.definition: the activity of fighting in a war – used especially when talking about particular methods of fighting; war, interference, sword, conflict, collision
words.translation: 战争, 作战, 冲突, 竞争；战争；冲突

examples.en: the realities of modern warfare
examples.zh: 现代战争的真实面貌

words.definition: a police officer; grasp, noble, collar, clutch at; patrolman, Irvine
words.translation: 警官, 巡警；抓住；巡警，警官

examples.en: the local cop
examples.zh: 本地警察

examples.en: a narcotics cop
examples.zh: 缉毒警官

examples.en: He pulled out his badge and said he was a cop.
examples.zh: 他拿出警徽说自己是警察。

words.definition: the relationship between different living things that depend on each other; partnership, intergrowth
words.translation: [生]共生(现象),合作关系；[生态]共生；合作关系；共栖

examples.en: ...the link between bacteria, symbiosis, and the evolution of plants and animals.
examples.zh: ...细菌、共生和动植物进化间的联系。

words.definition: relating to a president
words.translation: 总统的

examples.en: a presidential election
examples.zh: 总统大选

examples.en: the party’s presidential candidate
examples.zh: 该党的总统候选人

words.definition: a piece of a soft natural or artificial substance full of small holes, which can suck up liquid and is used for washing; efface; cosher; spunge
words.translation: 海绵 vt擦；抹掉；用海绵擦拭；讨得；采集海绵；过寄生生活；海绵般地吸收；[橡胶][无脊椎]海绵；海绵状物

examples.en: a Victoria sponge
examples.zh: 维多利亚海绵蛋糕

words.definition: the parts inside a machine or piece of equipment; courage, inside, neck, channel, narrow; eviscerate; simple, organic, plain, fundamental, essential
words.translation: 内脏；肠子；剧情；胆量；海峡；取出内脏；摧毁内部装置；简单的；本质的，根本的

examples.en: By the time they finish, the crewmen are standing ankle-deep in fish guts.
examples.zh: 到他们结束时，船员们正站在齐脚踝深的鱼内脏堆里。

words.translation: 俄罗斯

examples.en: This program is beamed at Russia.
examples.zh: 这套节目是对俄罗斯广播的。

examples.en: That transmitter was beamed at Russia.
examples.zh: 那台发射机曾用于对俄罗斯广播。

examples.en: He was doubling for America and Russia.
examples.zh: 他给美国和俄罗斯当双重间谍。

words.definition: a dry substance in the form of very small grains; dust, dirt; pulverize
words.translation: 粉(末) v搽粉,撒粉；[材]粉；粉末；[化工][军]火药；尘土；使成粉末；撒粉；搽粉于

examples.en: curry powder
examples.zh: 咖喱粉

examples.en: talcum powder
examples.zh: 滑石[爽身]粉

examples.en: Grind the sugar into a powder .
examples.zh: 把糖碾成粉末。

words.definition: Organizational abilities and methods relate to the way that work, activities, or events are planned and arranged; anatomic, tissular
words.translation: 组织的；编制的

examples.en: Evelyn's excellent organizational skills were soon spotted by her employers.
examples.zh: 伊夫琳出色的组织才干很快就被她的雇主发现了。

words.definition: suddenly, shortly, sharp
words.translation: 突然地；粗鲁地；唐突地

examples.en: The ground rises abruptly.
examples.zh: 地势突然隆起。

words.definition: relating to the work of managing a company or organization; regulatory, managing, executive
words.translation: 管理的，行政的

examples.en: The job is mainly administrative.
examples.zh: 这份工作主要是行政方面的。

words.definition: based on a situation that is not real, but that might happen; theoretical, if-then
words.translation: 假说的，臆说的；假设的；爱猜想的

examples.en: The question is purely hypothetical .
examples.zh: 这个问题完全基于假设。

words.definition: typical of the simple peaceful life in the country; ministerial, ecclesiastical; eclogue, idyll
words.translation: 田园生活的，宁静的；牧师的；牧人的；田园生活的；乡村的；牧歌；田园诗；田园景色

examples.en: a charming pastoral scene
examples.zh: 迷人的田园景象

words.definition: time that you spend working in your job in addition to your normal working hours; extension of time
words.translation: 超时；[劳经]加班时间；延长时间

examples.en: six hours’ overtime
examples.zh: 六小时的加班

examples.en: They’re working overtime to get the job finished.
examples.zh: 他们正在加班赶工。

examples.en: He’s been doing a lot of overtime recently.
examples.zh: 他近来加班很多。

words.definition: occurring or formed between periods of glacial action
words.translation: 间冰期的

examples.en: This new investigation shows temperature 'spikes' within some of the interglacial periods over the last 340,000 years.
examples.zh: 这项新的调查显示在过去的340,000年气温都“被钉在”间冰期内。

examples.en: Previous analysis of ice cores has shown that the climate consists of ice ages and warmer interglacial periods roughly every 100,000 years.
examples.zh: 早先的冰芯分析显示气候的有冰龄和温暖的间冰期大致为100，000年为一个周期。

examples.en: Human effects on the climate notwithstanding, the cycle will continue to turn, the interglacial will some day come to an end – and the ice sheets will descend again.
examples.zh: 人类对于气候有一定影响，但循环将会继续下去，总有一天间冰期将会结束，到那时冰层又将卷土重来。

words.definition: an opinion about whether a person, group, or idea is good or bad that influences how you deal with it; preference, favour; deflective
words.translation: 偏见vt使存偏见；偏见；偏爱；斜纹；乖离率；偏斜的

examples.en: Students were evaluated without bias.
examples.zh: 对学生的评估都是公正的。

words.definition: forth, in advance, previously, to, along; forward, antrorse
words.translation: 在前, 向前；领先；向前；预先；领先的；向前的

words.definition: an object that produces light by using electricity, oil, or gas; light; light up, lumine; brighten up, resplend
words.translation: 灯；[电]灯；照射器；照亮；发亮

examples.en: She switched on the bedside lamp.
examples.zh: 她打开了床头灯。

words.definition: to obey a law, rule etc; accord, meet with; accord, reconcile; united, consistent, matching, uniform, corresponding
words.translation: 使一致, 遵从；符合；遵照；适应环境；使遵守；使一致；使顺从；一致的；顺从的

words.definition: slanderer, traducer
words.translation: 诽谤者；贬低者

examples.en: The attack took many by surprise, because few had anticipated that the major detractor of the faith would be one of our own.
examples.zh: 这一攻击使许多人非常惊奇，因为很少人料想到信仰的主要诽谤者竟是我们自己中间的一位。

words.definition: the period of time it takes for something to happen or be completed
words.translation: 时标, 时间量程

examples.en: The timescale for completing the work would be fairly tight.
examples.zh: 完成这项工作的时间很紧。

words.definition: a piece of kitchen equipment on which you cook food in pots and pans, and that contains an  oven; furnace, greenhouse
words.translation: 炉；火炉；[炉窑]窑；温室

examples.en: a wood-burning stove
examples.zh: 烧木柴的火炉

words.definition: any of several large scombroid game fishes of the genus Istiophorus, such as I; spearfish
words.translation: 旗鱼；[鱼]旗鱼

examples.en: A fine start to the day, and my first sailfish on a fly.
examples.zh: 这一天的开局真不错，这也是我第一次用飞杆钓到旗鱼。

examples.en: And both have been pioneers of strict marine conservation practices, including catch-and-release only policies for sailfish and marlin.
examples.zh: 两国还率先实行了极为严格的海洋资源保护措施，其中包括对捕获的旗鱼和青枪鱼必须放生。

words.definition: a large sea fish with a long sharp nose, which people hunt for sport
words.translation: 枪鱼

examples.en: He drank a little water before he lashed the marlin to bow and stern of his skiff.
examples.zh: 他喝了一点水，然后把马林鱼捆绑在他那条小船的头部和尾部。

examples.en: It was a fierce Mako, and it came in fast to slash with raking teeth at the dead marlin.
examples.zh: 这是一条凶猛的尖吻鲭鲨。 它飞快地游了过来，用耙一样的牙齿撕这条死马林鱼。

examples.en: Sustained by the pride of his calling, the only pride he has left, a broken old fisherman ventures far out into the Gulf Stream and there hooks the biggest marlin ever seen in those waters.
examples.zh: 故事讲到一个精神沮丧的老渔人，在他对职业的自豪感(他留下的唯一自豪感)的支持之下，冒险远航至墨西哥湾流并在那里钓住了一条该水域中从未见过的最大的马林鱼。

words.definition: a large fish with a very long pointed upper jaw; saurida
words.translation: 旗鱼；箭鱼

examples.en: ...grilled swordfish with a yoghurt dressing.
examples.zh: ...浇上酸奶酪的烤箭鱼。

words.definition: to do something wrong or illegal; sin, do sth. wrong
words.translation: 犯罪, 承诺, 委托；犯罪，做错事；把...交托给；指派…作战；使…承担义务

examples.en: Women commit fewer crimes than men.
examples.zh: 女性犯罪比男性少。

words.definition: when an activity, situation, or process begins again after a period when it had stopped; recovery, innovation, update, restoration, reformation
words.translation: 更新, 恢复；更新，恢复；复兴；补充；革新；[图情]续借；重申

examples.en: Mark’s contract comes up for renewal at the end of this year.
examples.zh: 马克的合同将在今年年末到期，需要续签。

words.definition: a statement, story etc that is false is completely untrue; artificial, wrong, incorrect, improper, inaccurate; trickily
words.translation: 错误的；假的；虚伪的；伪造的；欺诈地

examples.en: Please decide whether the following statements are true or false .
examples.zh: 请判断以下说法的对错。

examples.en: false accusations
examples.zh: 不实的指责

words.definition: relating to both Europe and Asia
words.translation: 欧亚的, 欧亚人的

examples.en: ...the whole of the Eurasian continent.
examples.zh: ...整个欧亚大陆。

words.definition: allowing people to do, say, or believe what they want without criticizing or punishing them; kind, good-tempered
words.translation: 宽容的, 容忍的；宽容的；容忍的；有耐药力的

examples.en: a tolerant society
examples.zh: 宽容的社会

words.definition: not interesting or exciting; slow, blunt; relax, benumb; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 乏味的；阴沉的；钝的；迟钝的；无趣的；呆滞的；阴暗的；使迟钝；使阴暗；缓和；减少；变迟钝

examples.en: Life is never dull when Elizabeth is here.
examples.zh: 有伊丽莎白在这里生活绝不会无聊。

examples.en: a dull movie
examples.zh: 一部沉闷的电影

examples.en: It sounded pretty dull to me.
examples.zh: 在我听来，这很无聊。

words.definition: to make someone feel very unhappy; drive down, weigh down
words.translation: 使沮丧, 使消沉；压低；使沮丧；使萧条

examples.en: The thought of taking the exam again depressed him.
examples.zh: 想到要补考，他就心情沮丧。

examples.en: It depresses me that nobody seems to care.
examples.zh: 似乎没有人在乎，这让我感到很沮丧。

words.definition: someone who is fortunate has something good happen to them, or is in a good situation; lucky, providential
words.translation: 幸运的, 侥幸的；幸运的；侥幸的；吉祥的；带来幸运的

examples.en: By a fortunate coincidence, a passer-by heard her cries for help.
examples.zh: 所幸正巧有个过路人听到了她的呼救。

words.definition: able to float or keep things floating; flowing, rising
words.translation: 有浮力的, 轻快的；轻快的；有浮力的；上涨的

examples.en: Cork is very buoyant.
examples.zh: 软木浮性很好。
