examples.zh: 关于动物预测死亡的相关信息以及动物行为学和相关话题，如感兴趣请在原文的下一页进行链连。

words.definition: a small change, improvement, or addition that is made to a law or document, or the process of doing this; improvement, correction, reformation
words.translation: 改善, 改正；修正案；改善；改正

examples.en: constitutional amendments
examples.zh: 宪法修正案

words.definition: wanting to know about something; critical, odd
words.translation: 好奇的, 奇特的；好奇的，有求知欲的；古怪的；爱挑剔的

examples.en: Puppies are naturally curious.
examples.zh: 小狗天生好奇。

words.definition: a strong feeling of trust or confidence in someone or something; belief, confidence, trust, credit, loyalty
words.translation: 信仰, 信念；信仰；信念；信任；忠实

examples.en: People have lost faith in the government.
examples.zh: 人们已失去了对政府的信心。

words.definition: to go past a moving vehicle or person because you are going faster than them and want to get in front of them; catch up with, to catch up; cut in
words.translation: 追上，超过；赶上；压倒；突然来袭；超车

examples.en: He pulled out to overtake the van.
examples.zh: 他把车驶出所在车道想超过那辆小货车。

examples.en: Never try to overtake on a bend.
examples.zh: 绝不要在转弯处超车。

words.definition: the part of your body that joins your head to your shoulders, or the same part of an animal or bird; narrow, channel, sound, collar
words.translation: 脖子, 颈；脖子；衣领；海峡

examples.en: Mike rubbed the back of his neck.
examples.zh: 迈克揉了揉后颈。

examples.en: You have a lot of tension in your neck muscles.
examples.zh: 你的颈部肌肉很紧张。

examples.en: He patted his horse’s neck.
examples.zh: 他拍了拍马脖子。

words.definition: a substance of a low quality that is contained in or mixed with something else, making it less pure; foreign matters, nastiness
words.translation: 不纯；杂质；不洁

examples.en: All natural minerals contain impurities.
examples.zh: 凡天然矿物都含有杂质。

examples.en: Our oatmeal face mask absorbs impurities from your skin.
examples.zh: 我们的燕麦面膜能够吸收皮肤上的杂质。

words.definition: very powerful or impressive, and often frightening; powerful, terrible, august, horrible
words.translation: 可怕的；难以克服的；强大的；令人敬畏的；艰难的

examples.en: The building is grey, formidable, not at all picturesque.
examples.zh: 那幢建筑呈灰色，气势凛然，与漂亮沾不上边。

examples.en: The new range of computers have formidable processing power.
examples.zh: 该系列的新型计算机处理能力惊人。

words.definition: good enough to be used for a particular purpose or to be considered satisfactory; receivable, admissible
words.translation: 可接受的, 合意的；可接受的；合意的；可忍受的

examples.en: Students who achieve an acceptable standard will progress to degree studies.
examples.zh: 达到一定程度的学生可以进一步攻读学位。

examples.en: How do we reach an acceptable level of data security?
examples.zh: 我们如何使数据安全达到令人满意的程度？

words.definition: looter, pillager
words.translation: 强征(粮食)者；抢劫者；强征队员

words.definition: (esp of something threatening) to be about to happen; be imminent; close in
words.translation: 迫近，逼近；迫近；即将发生
玻璃状的

examples.en: One animal captured on video looks like a flower, covered with glasslike needles, but scientists think it is probably a carnivorous sponge.
examples.zh: 在视频中拍摄到的一种动物看上去像是朵花，覆盖着玻璃状的针，不过科学家认为这可能是一种食肉海绵。

examples.en: It's a hard, clear, glasslike plastic, and one of the main ingredients in that is a chemical called bisphenol A (BPA), which is an estrogen mimic.
examples.zh: 这是一种坚硬、透明、类似玻璃的塑料。 主要材料之一是称作双酚A (BPA)的化学物质，与雌激素极相似。

words.definition: not trans-parent, but clear enough to allow light to pass through; crystal, limpid
words.translation: 半透明的；[光]透明的

examples.en: Blue veins showed through her translucent skin.
examples.zh: 她半透明的皮肤下青筋显现。

words.definition: the upper level of soil in which most plants have their roots
words.translation: 表层土

examples.en: Dump the topsoil here.
examples.zh: 把表土倒在这里。

examples.en: Stone is the foundation, above which is soil, and then topsoil.
examples.zh: 石头是基础，上面是泥土，再上面是表土。

examples.en: After shoveling out the topsoil, Garfinkel uncovered coins and other artifacts from the time of Alexander the Great.
examples.zh: 在铲去了表层土以后，加芬克尔发现了来自亚历山大大帝时期的硬币和其他人工制品。

words.definition: a connection between two things that makes them affect each other; correlation, mutuality
words.translation: 相互关系

examples.en: ...the interrelationships between unemployment, crime, and imprisonment.
examples.zh: ...失业、犯罪和监禁之间的相互关系。

words.definition: the flat cutting part of a tool or weapon; sword, vane
words.translation: 刀刃, 刀片；[植][脊椎]叶片；[机]刀片，刀锋；剑

examples.en: a razor blade
examples.zh: 剃刀刀片

words.definition: a type of small bag in or on a coat, trousers etc that you can put money, keys etc in; money, container, vessel, QIAN; lock, stomach, stand, go, tough; miniative, baby-size
words.translation: 衣袋，小袋；口袋；钱；容器；隐藏；忍受；将…放入衣袋；小型的，袖珍的；金钱上的

examples.en: Luke came in with his hands in his pockets.
examples.zh: 卢克走了进来，双手插在口袋里。

examples.en: The policeman told me to turn out my pockets (= take everything out of them ) .
examples.zh: 警察让我把口袋里的东西都掏出来。

words.definition: the sloping side of a hill; mountainside, brae
words.translation: 山腰；山坡，山腹

examples.en: The airplane crashed on a hillside.
examples.zh: 飞机在山坡上坠毁。

examples.en: They are quarrying the hillside for marble.
examples.zh: 他们正从山坡上采大理石。

examples.en: They sat and had their lunch on a grassy hillside.
examples.zh: 他们坐在长满草的山坡上吃午饭。

words.definition: next to or very close to the side of someone or something; at the side of, in comparison to
words.translation: 在…旁边,和…相比；在旁边；与…相比；和…无关

examples.en: Wendy came up and sat beside me.
examples.zh: 温迪走过来，坐在我身边。

examples.en: the table beside the bed
examples.zh: 床边的桌子

examples.en: I was standing right beside her at the time.
examples.zh: 当时我就站在她的旁边。

words.definition: to pay money, usually once a year, to have copies of a newspaper or magazine sent to you, or to have some other service; sign, donate money; ink, agree, sign, uphold
words.translation: 订阅, 签名,捐赠；订阅；捐款；[经]认购；赞成；签署；捐助

examples.en: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.
examples.zh: 我订阅《新科学家》的主要原因是要跟上科学的进步。

words.definition: someone or something that protects one thing or person from being harmed by another; dashpot, oscillation absorber
words.translation: 缓冲器；[机][车辆][助剂]缓冲区；[计]缓冲器，减震器

examples.en: Keep savings as a buffer against unexpected cash needs.
examples.zh: 备有存款来作为急需现金时的缓冲。

words.definition: To embody an idea or quality means to be a symbol or expression of that idea or quality; objectify, reify
words.translation: 使具体化；体现，使具体化；具体表达

examples.en: Jack Kennedy embodied all the hopes of the 1960s.
examples.zh: 杰克•肯尼迪体现了20世纪60年代的全部希望。

examples.en: For twenty-nine years, Checkpoint Charlie embodied the Cold War.
examples.zh: 29年来，查理检查站具体象征了冷战。

words.definition: having feelings of pleasure, for example because something good has happened to you or you are very satisfied with your life; pleased, glad, blessed, smart
words.translation: 快乐的，幸福的；幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的

examples.en: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
examples.zh: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

examples.en: I’ve never felt happier in my life.
examples.zh: 我一生从未感到如此快乐。

examples.en: He was a happy child who rarely cried.
examples.zh: 他是一个快乐的孩子，很少哭鼻子。

words.definition: the system that allows millions of computer users around the world to exchange information; network, web; harvest, come into; pure, whole
words.translation: 网, 网络；网；网络；净利；实价；得到；净赚；用网捕；纯粹的；净余的

examples.en: Bruce spends most evenings surfing the Net (= looking at information in different places on the Internet ).
examples.zh: 布鲁斯晚上大多在网上浏览信息。

words.definition: Litter is rubbish or waste that is left lying around outside; refuse, garbage, junk, rubbish, trash; give birth
words.translation: 垃圾 v乱扔东西；垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱；产仔；乱扔废弃物

examples.en: If you see litter in the corridor, pick it up.
examples.zh: 如果你看到走廊里有垃圾，就把它捡起来。

words.definition: someone who is not accepted as a member of a particular social group; gaijin
words.translation: 外行, 局外人；[劳经]外人；无取胜希望者

examples.en: I’m an outsider, the only foreign woman in the group.
examples.zh: 我是个外人，是这群人里唯一的外国女人。

words.definition: a generally white or grey mineral, found in sedimentary rocks and as deposits from hot springs. Composition: calcium carbonate. Formula: CaCO3. Crystal structure: orthorhombic
words.translation: [矿]霰石, 文石

examples.en: So will corals, especially those whose skeletons are composed of aragonite, a particularly unstable form of calcium carbonate.
examples.zh: 珊瑚礁对此也受到同样的危险，对于骨骼由霰石（极不稳定的碳酸钙）构成的珊瑚来说，情况更是如此。

examples.en: One indicator is the levels of calcium and aragonite.
examples.zh: 其中一个就是水体中的钙和霰石的水平。

words.definition: the quality of being suitable or useful for a particular purpose, especially by making something easier or saving you time; john, bathroom, toilet
words.translation: 便利,适宜；便利；厕所；便利的事物

examples.en: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
examples.zh: 即食餐因为方便销路好。

words.definition: a move to a more important job or position in a company or organization; advancement, acceleration, impetus
words.translation: 提升；促进；提升，[劳经]晋升；推销，促销；发扬，振兴

examples.en: I want a job with good prospects for promotion.
examples.zh: 我想要一份有良好晋升机会的工作。

words.definition: Something that remains unaltered has not changed or been changed; constant, permanent, steady
words.translation: 未被改变的；不变的；照旧的

examples.en: The rest of the apartment had fortunately remained unaltered since that time.
examples.zh: 从那时起公寓的其余部分就幸运地未曾改变过。

words.definition: if you take a bath, you wash your body in a bath; ablutions, bagnio; wash oneself
words.translation: 沐浴, 浴室；沐浴；浴室；[建]浴盆；洗澡

examples.en: After a week of camping, I really needed a bath.
examples.zh: 我露营了一个星期，实在得洗个澡了。

examples.en: I’ll give the children their bath (=  wash them in a bath  ) .
examples.zh: 我要给孩子们洗澡了。

words.definition: relating to the direction in which something is pointing or moving
words.translation: 方向的

examples.en: Unless he was equipped with a directional microphone, he was out of earshot.
examples.zh: 除非给他配备一个定向扬声器，否则谁也听不见他。

words.definition: support, adhesion; undertaking
words.translation: 保持，固定；举办；支持；召开；担任（hold的ing形式）；握住

words.definition: showing strong feelings of love; fantastic, amorous
words.translation: 传奇式的, 浪漫的；浪漫的；多情的；空想的

examples.en: ‘Tom always sends me red roses on my birthday.’ ‘How romantic!’
examples.zh: “我过生日时汤姆总是给我送红玫瑰。”“多浪漫啊！”

words.definition: a treeless area has no trees in it
words.translation: 没有树木的

examples.en: a treeless landscape
examples.zh: 寸木不生的地貌

words.definition: A recorder is a machine or instrument that keeps a record of something, for example in an experiment or on a vehicle; tape-recorder, dictating machine
words.translation: 记录员, 记录器；[电讯]录音机；[法][仪][电子]记录器；记录员；八孔直笛

examples.en: Data recorders also pinpoint mechanical faults rapidly, reducing repair times.
examples.zh: 数据记录仪器也能很快查明机械故障，减少维修时间。

words.definition: A seller of a type of thing is a person or company that sells that type of thing; salesman, bargainor
words.translation: 售货者；卖方，售货员

examples.en: ...a flower seller.
examples.zh: …一个卖花的人。

words.definition: obviously, clearly, remarkably, notably, markedly
words.translation: 显著地，显然；显著地，明显地；引人注目地

words.definition: Plunge is also a noun; investment, input; plough into, throw one's self into; let sb in for, let in for
words.translation: 投入, 跳进；投入；跳进；陷入；使陷入；使投入；使插入

examples.en: ...a plunge into cold water.
examples.zh: …向着冰冷的水中的纵身一跳。

words.definition: to completely get rid of something such as a disease or a social problem; destroy, root out
words.translation: 根除；根除，根绝；消灭

examples.en: an attempt to eradicate inflation
examples.zh: 为消除通货膨胀所作的努力

examples.en: This problem has now been completely eradicated.
examples.zh: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

words.definition: A caste is one of the traditional social classes into which people are divided in a Hindu society; social status, social position
words.translation: 印度的世袭阶级；（印度社会中的）种姓；（具有严格等级差别的）社会地位；（排他的）社会团体

examples.en: Most of the upper castes worship the goddess Kali.
examples.zh: 大部分的印度上层种姓都信奉卡莉女神。

words.definition: to receive money, property etc from someone after they have died; succeed to, take sth over
words.translation: 继承；遗传而得

examples.en: inherited wealth
examples.zh: 继承的财富

words.definition: a young  goose
words.translation: 小鹅，年轻无知的人

words.definition: officially; officially, in state
words.translation: 正式地, 形式上；正式地；形式上

examples.en: We announced a decision formally recognizing the new government.
examples.zh: 我们宣布了一个决定，正式承认新政府。

words.definition: if you rattle something, or if it rattles, it shakes and makes a quick series of short sounds; harp on, go on about sth; jay, chatterer
words.translation: 嘎嘎作响n咯咯声;吵闹声；使发出咯咯声；喋喋不休；使慌乱，使惊慌；喋喋不休的人；吓吱声，格格声

examples.en: Dan banged on her door and rattled the handle.
examples.zh: 丹砰砰地敲她的门，还把门把手拽得咯吱作响。

examples.en: The window rattled in the wind.
examples.zh: 窗户被风吹得咯吱作响。

examples.en: Bottles rattled as he stacked the beer crates.
examples.zh: 他把啤酒箱摞起来，酒瓶咣当咣当地响。

words.definition: a house, especially a large or official one; home, accommodation
words.translation: 居住, 住处；住宅，住处；居住

examples.en: the ambassador’s official residence
examples.zh: 大使官邸

words.definition: an event, organization, or thing that is similar to the one you have mentioned but existed earlier; father, root; advance, prodromal
words.translation: 先行的；祖先；前情；先行词；前驱的；先前的

examples.en: That's an antecedent standard. Moral desert.
examples.zh: 道德应得，那是一个先行标准。

examples.en: Some patients state that lesions develop at the site of antecedent trauma.
examples.zh: 一些患者指出，病灶出现在先前的创伤部位。

examples.en: The user can then explore the lattice by using specified criteria, such as support and confidence bounds, or by placing restrictions on the antecedent sequence.
examples.zh: 用户然后可以使用指定的条件（比如支持和置信界限），或在先前的序列上设置限制来分析该格子。

words.definition: a pointed piece of wood, metal etc, especially one that is pushed into the ground to support something or mark a particular place; bonus, dividend; encourage, carry, fund, second, back; lay, make a bet
words.translation: 树桩；桩，棍子；赌注；火刑；奖金；资助，支持；系…于桩上；把…押下打赌；打赌

examples.en: tent stakes
examples.zh: 帐篷桩

words.definition: Disloyalty is disloyal behaviour; unfaithfulness, falseness
words.translation: 不忠实；不义，不贞；背信弃义

examples.en: Charges had already been made against certain officials suspected of disloyalty.
examples.zh: 已对某些被怀疑有不忠行为的官员提出指控。

words.definition: the state of being completely certain; very like a whale, inerrability
words.translation: 确定, 确实的事情；必然；确实；确实的事情

examples.en: The result is impossible to predict with any degree of certainty .
examples.zh: 这一结果完全无法确切预测。

words.definition: an antibiotic obtained from the bacterium Streptomyces noursei: used in the treatment of infections caused by certain fungi, esp Candida albicans; fungicidin
words.translation: [微]制霉菌素；[药]制真菌素，制霉菌素

examples.en: Localised disease may be treated at first with relatively inexpensive drugs such as nystatin, miconazole or clotrimazole.
examples.zh: 治疗局部感染可先使用较为便宜的药物，如制霉菌素、咪康唑或克霉唑等。

examples.en: The results of drug sensitivity showed that amphotericin (AMB) and nystatin (NYS) were the most sensitive and flucytosine (5- Fc ) was the most resistant (54.2%).
examples.zh: 药敏结果显示，药物敏感性最高为两性霉素（AMB）和制霉菌素（NYS），耐药性最高的为5-氟胞嘧啶（54.2%）。

words.definition: to make a book, list, record etc, using different pieces of information, music etc; to edit, copy-edit
words.translation: 编译, 编辑；编译；编制；编辑；[图情]汇编

examples.en: The document was compiled by the Department of Health.
examples.zh: 这份文件是由卫生部汇编的。

words.definition: very large or great in a surprising or impressive way; tremendous, wonderful, huge, enormous, massive
words.translation: 巨大的, 惊人的；惊人的，异常的，奇妙的；巨大的

examples.en: the artist’s prodigious output
examples.zh: 那位艺术家惊人的高产

words.definition: wall; wall painting, painting in fresco
words.translation: 墙壁的  n壁画；墙壁的；[建]壁画；（美）壁饰

examples.en: This work is clearly connected with The Last Supper: the Christ has the same ethereal and elusive quality as the faded figure at the centre of Leonardo's sublime mural.
examples.zh: 这幅画显然和《最后的晚餐》有某种关联：画中的基督，和达·芬奇最伟大的壁画中心那已褪色的基督形象一样，同样空灵缥缈。

words.definition: a structure from which water is pushed up into the air, used for example as decoration in a garden or park; principle, well
words.translation: 喷泉；[地质]喷泉，泉水；源泉

examples.en: ...the fountains on the 16th Street Mall.
examples.zh: …第16街商业区的喷泉。

words.definition: someone who gathers something; divertor, holding tank
words.translation: 收集者, 收集器；采集者，收集器

examples.en: information gatherers
examples.zh: 信息收集者

words.translation: 制鞋

examples.en: In fact, he once took a hiatus from acting to study shoemaking.
examples.zh: 事实上，他曾经一度中断演艺生涯跑去学习制鞋。

examples.en: Iran's main shoemaking federation also offered to supply a lifetime of shoes to Zaidi, who remains in a Baghdad jail awaiting trial.
examples.zh: 伊朗制鞋协会还向扎一迪奉送了“终身鞋”，然而扎一迪却在巴格达一所监狱等待着审判。

examples.en: The Frenchman began his shoemaking career at Les Compagnons du Tour de France, a venerable crafts guild.
examples.zh: 这名法国人的制鞋生涯从知名的手工业协会──法国传统艺师培训所(Les Compagnons du Tour de France)开始。

words.translation: 用电力;有关电地

words.definition: someone who is generous is willing to give money, spend time etc, in order to help people or give them pleasure; handsome, liberal
words.translation: 慷慨的,丰富的；慷慨的，大方的；宽宏大量的；有雅量的

examples.en: a generous glass of wine
examples.zh: 一大杯葡萄酒

words.definition: to lie or sit with your arms or legs stretched out in a lazy or careless way; creep, to spread; sprig; rampancy
words.translation: 伸开；蔓延；伸开手足躺；无计划地扩展；懒散地伸开；使蔓生；蔓生；伸开手足躺卧姿势

examples.en: He sprawled out on the sofa.
examples.zh: 他摊开手脚躺在沙发上。

examples.en: I tripped on a stone and went sprawling on the pavement.
examples.zh: 我被一块石头绊了一下，四仰八叉地摔在人行道上。

examples.en: a blow which sent him sprawling
examples.zh: 打得他四脚朝天的一拳

words.definition: one of the coloured parts of a flower that are shaped like leaves
words.translation: 花瓣

examples.en: rose petals
examples.zh: 玫瑰花瓣

examples.en: The flower has seven petals.
examples.zh: 这种花有七片花瓣。

words.translation: 科技地

examples.en: However, if the inhabitants are technologically inferior, you should find a small tribe of primitives as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 然而，如果这些居民的科技次于地球，你应该尽快找到一个小的原始部落。

words.definition: appropriately, commensurately
words.translation: 相称地, 成比例地；相称地，成比例地

words.definition: a brittle crystalline grey element that is a semiconducting metalloid, occurring principally in zinc ores and argyrodite: used in transistors, as a catalyst, and to strengthen and harden alloys
words.translation: 锗

examples.en: It s also the first germanium laser to operate at room temperature.
examples.zh: 这同样也是第一速在室温下得到控制的锗激光。

examples.en: The researchers inject pairs of electrons and holes into the germanium.
examples.zh: 研究者们注射成对的电子和凹陷到锗中。

examples.en: Changing the angle and length of the bonds between germanium atoms also changed the energies required to kick their electrons into the conduction band.
examples.zh: 改变锗原子的连接角度和长度的同时，将它们的电子踢到传导带所需的能量也变化了。

words.definition: the degree to which something can reasonably be expected to happen; possibility, probability, feasibility, potential, maybe
words.translation: 可能(性)；可能性，可能

examples.en: If I refused, it would in all likelihood mean I’d lose my job.
examples.zh: 如果我拒绝，那我十有八九会丢掉工作。

words.definition: to pay a company for the use of their aircraft, boat etc; license; license, patent, permit
words.translation: 租 n宪章；特许；[车辆][航]包租；发给特许执照；宪章；执照；特许状

examples.en: We chartered a boat to take us to some of the smaller islands.
examples.zh: 我们包了一条船带我们到一些较小的岛上去。

words.definition: the entrance to a room or building, or the area of floor or ground at the entrance; entry, conception, limitation, beginning, opening
words.translation: 门槛, 开端；入口；[建]门槛；开始；极限；临界值

examples.en: She opened the door and stepped across the threshold.
examples.zh: 她打开门，跨过门槛。

words.definition: existing only in small amounts; exiguous, infrequent
words.translation: 稀少的, 稀疏的；稀疏的；稀少的

examples.en: his sparse brown hair
examples.zh: 他那稀疏的棕色头发

examples.en: rural areas with sparse populations
examples.zh: 人口稀少的农村地区

words.definition: statues; effigy
words.translation: 雕象；雕像；雕像艺术

examples.en: a fine collection of Greek statuary
examples.zh: 一批精美的希腊雕塑藏品

words.definition: any of the filaments that constitute the body (mycelium) of a fungus; mycelia
words.translation: [植]菌丝；菌丝

examples.en: The state in certain fungi in which each compartment of a hypha contains two nuclei, each derived from a different parent.
examples.zh: 双核某种真菌中的状态，在这种真菌中，每个菌丝体都含有两个核，而每个核都是从不同的母体上衍生的。

examples.en: Dextrose and maltose was the best carbon source, while asparagine (Asn)was the optimum nitrogen source for both hypha growth and spore bearing.
examples.zh: 葡萄糖和麦芽糖为菌丝生长和产孢的最佳碳源。 天冬酰胺是菌丝生长和孢子产生的最佳氮源。

examples.en: Effect of dews on cucumber leaves and juice of cucumber leaves of different varieties on the ratio of germination, quantity of sprout and length of hypha was different.
examples.zh: 不同黄瓜品种叶表露珠及叶片研磨液对分生孢子萌发率、 芽管数量、菌丝长短有显著影响。

words.definition: If you describe someone as farsighted, you admire them because they understand what is likely to happen in the future, and therefore make wise decisions and plans; forward-looking, sagacious
words.translation: 有先见之明的, 远视的；有远见的；能看到远处的

examples.en: Haven't farsighted economists been telling us that in the future we will work less, not more?
examples.zh: 有远见的经济学家们不是一直在告诉我们，将来我们会工作得更少而不是更多吗？

words.definition: If you say that someone is fattening something such as a business or its profits, you mean that they are increasing the value of the business or its profits, in a way that you disapprove of; enrich, fat up; fat up, make a pile
words.translation: 养肥；使肥沃；使充实；（靠…）发财

examples.en: They have kept the price of sugar artificially high and so fattened the company's profits.
examples.zh: 他们一直人为地使糖价居高不下，以此为公司牟利。

words.definition: the watery liquid that is produced in your mouth; golly; release, project, let go; saliva, slabber
words.translation: 唾液 v吐(唾沫)；吐痰；吐口水；发出劈啪声；吐，吐出；发出；发射；唾液

examples.en: And ink from soot and spit.
examples.zh: 墨水用煤灰和唾液来做。

examples.en: But is it even possible not to spit during a match?
examples.zh: 但是，在比赛中间一口唾沫都不吐，这可能么？

words.definition: to move along on your hands and knees with your body close to the ground; creep; creep, aquarium
words.translation: 爬行, 蠕动；爬行；匍匐行进；[水产]养鱼池；匍匐而行

examples.en: The traffic had slowed to a crawl.
examples.zh: 车辆放慢速度，缓缓行进。

words.definition: careful to avoid danger or risks; prudent, wary
words.translation: 谨慎的, 小心的；谨慎的；十分小心的

examples.en: a cautious driver
examples.zh: 一位谨慎的司机

examples.en: a cautious approach to the crisis
examples.zh: 处理危机的谨慎态度

examples.en: The air-pollution board has reacted with cautious optimism to the announcement.
examples.zh: 空气污染委员会对这项通告表示谨慎乐观。

words.definition: a very large area of water, sky, land etc; openness, broadness
words.translation: 广阔；宽阔的区域；宽阔；广阔的区域；苍天；膨胀扩张

examples.en: The Mandarin Oriental's pool is small in real life, suitable only for a quick dip… nothing like the vast, blue expanse of water in the marketing photo.
examples.zh: 文华东方的游泳池在现实中是很小的，只适合快速浸泡一下......一点都不像宣传照片上那一大片宽阔的蓝色水域。

words.definition: the time at the beginning of the day when light first appears; morning, origin; come out, break of day
words.translation: 黎明 vi破晓,开始出现；[天]黎明；开端；破晓；出现；被领悟

examples.en: When dawn broke (= the first light of the day appeared ) , we were still 50 miles from Calcutta.
examples.zh: 破晓的时候，我们离加尔各答还有50英里。

examples.en: I was up at the crack of dawn (= very early in the morning ) to get the plane.
examples.zh: 我一大早就起来赶飞机。

examples.en: We worked from dawn to dusk (= through the whole day while it is light ) .
examples.zh: 我们从早干到晚。

words.definition: a small vehicle with four wheels in which a baby can lie down while it is being pushed; baby-car, baby carriers
words.translation: 婴儿车；送牛奶用的手推车

examples.en: a young woman pushing a pram
examples.zh: 推着婴儿车的年轻女子

words.definition: to remove dirty or harmful substances from something; cleanse, decontaminate; fine purification, purge
words.translation: 使纯净；净化；变纯净

examples.en: chemicals used to purify the water
examples.zh: 用于净化水质的化学品

words.definition: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good; excellent, famous, super, great, class
words.translation: 精彩的, 极好的；奇妙的；极好的

examples.en: The cold, misty air felt wonderful on his face.
examples.zh: 那凉凉的雾气使他脸上感觉好极了。

examples.en: It's wonderful to see you.
examples.zh: 见到你好极了。

words.definition: an ancient language of India
words.translation: 梵语(的)

examples.en: They got the name from Persian who in turn got it from Sanskrit, from the Indians themselves.
examples.zh: 他们从波斯人那里得知的名字，而波斯人是依次从梵文、从印第安人他们自己得知的名字。

examples.en: An ancient Sanskrit saying says, woman is the home and the home is the basis of society. It is as we build our homes that we can build our country.
examples.zh: 一个古梵文谚语说，女人是家而家是社会的基础就像我们能建设自己的家园我们才能建设我们的国家。

words.definition: relating to the orbit of one object around another
words.translation: 轨道的

examples.en: the Earth’s orbital path
examples.zh: 地球的运行轨道

words.definition: to leave a job, school etc, especially without finishing it completely; yield, desert, split, get out; split, get out; leaving, Gone away
words.translation: 离开, 辞职；离开；放弃；停止；使…解除；[劳经]辞职；[计]退出

examples.en: He quit his job after an argument with a colleague.
examples.zh: 他和一个同事争吵后就辞职了。

examples.en: I quit school at 16.
examples.zh: 我十六岁辍学。

examples.en: She has decided to quit show business.
examples.zh: 她已决定退出娱乐圈。

words.definition: if a problem, difficulty etc confronts you, it appears and needs to be dealt with; front, compare
words.translation: 面临, 对抗；面对；遭遇；比较

examples.en: The problems confronting the new government were enormous.
examples.zh: 新政府面临的难题是巨大的。

words.definition: an animal like a large cow, with hair on its head and shoulders; aurochs, wisent
words.translation: (美洲)野牛；北美野牛；欧洲野牛

examples.en: Sixty acres of woods and ponds are home to camels, zebra, bison, water buffalo, ostrich and antelope.
examples.zh: 六十英亩的森林和池塘是骆驼，斑马，野牛，水牛，鸵鸟和羚羊的家园。

examples.en: But the biggest obstacle is the ranchers themselves, whose cattle compete with prairie dogs and bison for grass and space.
examples.zh: 但最大的阻碍来自牧场主本身，他们的牲畜与土拨鼠和野牛们竞争着草场和空间。

examples.en: Watching bison up close is mesmerizing, like watching a grass fire about to leap out of control.
examples.zh: 近距离观察野牛会使人生疑，就像看到一场失控的大火即将恣肆于草原。

words.definition: laterad
words.translation: 旁的, 横向的；向侧面地；向一旁

words.definition: a member of a nomadic Asian people, probably Semites, who controlled Egypt from 1720 bc until 1560 bc
words.translation: 希克索斯王朝(古埃及王朝之一)

words.definition: involving a lot of strength and effort; hard, rapid, bold, struggling
words.translation: 费力的, 辛勤的；努力的；费力的；险峻的

words.definition: ratchel, grait
words.translation: 大石头；[建]卵石，大圆石；[地质]巨砾

examples.en: Imagine trying to balance a chest of drawers on just one of its legs, on top of a boulder, and you get an idea of what Gray gets up to.
examples.zh: 想像自己尝试仅仅依靠衣柜的一个腿把它平稳地放到一个大圆石上，你就知道格雷达到了什么境界。

words.definition: someone who is given the title ‘saint’ by the Christian church after they have died, because they have been very good or holy; sadu, sadhu; sacred, divine, blessed, godly
words.translation: 圣人, 圣徒；圣人；圣徒；道德崇高的人；神圣的

examples.en: Saint Patrick
examples.zh: 圣帕特里克

examples.en: Statues of saints lined the walls of the church.
examples.zh: 教堂的墙边立着一排圣徒像。

words.definition: A bathhouse is a public or private building containing baths and often other facilities such as a sauna; changing room, changeroom
words.translation: 公共浴室, 澡堂,；澡堂；更衣室；公共浴室

examples.en: For personal hygiene, Wang and her family go to a public bathhouse in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 至于个人卫生问题，王秀丽一家去附近的公共澡堂洗澡。

examples.en: After stints carrying sacks on a construction site and selling lamb kebabs in the street, she ended up as a masseuse in a public bathhouse earning $60 a month.
examples.zh: 她曾在工地搬砖，在大街上卖过羊肉串，后来成为公共澡堂的女按摩师，月收入60美元。

words.definition: to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid; watery, attenuant; break, deliquate; thin
words.translation: 稀释，冲淡；稀释的；淡的；稀释；冲淡；削弱；变稀薄；变淡

examples.en: diluted fruit juice
examples.zh: 稀释的果汁

words.definition: mainly; largely, basically, mainly, mostly, primarily
words.translation: 主要地；大部分

examples.en: The money is principally invested in stocks and shares.
examples.zh: 这笔钱主要投资于股票。

examples.en: He was principally a landscape painter.
examples.zh: 他主要是风景画画家。

examples.en: We met principally to discuss the future of the school.
examples.zh: 我们开会主要是为了商讨学校的前途。

words.definition: a lack of a fair or correct balance between two things, which results in problems or unfairness; instability, disbalance
words.translation: 不平衡,不均衡；[医]不平衡；不安定

examples.en: a hormonal imbalance
examples.zh: 内分泌失调

words.definition: to form ions or make them form
words.translation: 使离子化 ,电离

examples.en: So if we can figure out the binding energy, we can also figure out how much energy we have to put into our atom in order to a eject or ionize an electron.
examples.zh: 所以如果我们可以计算出结合能，我们也可以计算出,我们需要注入多少能量到原子中,去逐出或电离一个电子。

examples.en: They were using the laser to excite and ionize the atoms liberated by the heat of the flame in order to measure the characteristic emissions of different flames.
examples.zh: 当时他们用这种激光来激发并电离那些被火焰的高温裂解出来的原子，目的是测量不同火焰的特征辐射。

examples.en: As the graphic above shows, the radiation emitted in this region is nonionizing: it may heat molecules in the body but does not ionize them (that is, set electrons free).
examples.zh: 以上图片显示，该区域内的辐射的不电离的：它只加热体内分子，并不使它们电离（即释放电子）。

words.definition: the process of entering another country in order to live there permanently; settling, transmigration
words.translation: 移民入境；外来移民；移居

examples.en: He called for a common European policy on immigration.
examples.zh: 他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

words.definition: when you are so anxious, nervous, or upset that you cannot think calmly; warmth, excitation
words.translation: 鼓动，焦虑；激动；搅动；煽动；烦乱

examples.en: She was in a state of considerable agitation.
examples.zh: 她处于相当焦虑的状态。

words.definition: vivid memories, dreams, descriptions etc are so clear that they seem real; telling, live, bright
words.translation: 生动的，栩栩如生的；生动的；鲜明的；鲜艳的

examples.en: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
examples.zh: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

examples.en: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
examples.zh: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

words.definition: to make it necessary for you to do something; ask, lack, pressure, claim
words.translation: 使成为必需,迫使；使成为必需，需要；迫使

examples.en: Lack of money necessitated a change of plan.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金，只能改变计划。

words.definition: You use Hollywood to refer to the film industry that is based in Hollywood, California
words.translation: 好莱坞

examples.en: ...a major Hollywood studio.
examples.zh: ...一家好莱坞大制片厂。

words.definition: the situation or experience of being poor; difficulty, shortage, hardness, want
words.translation: 贫穷, 贫困；贫困；困难；缺少；低劣

examples.en: Millions of elderly people live in poverty .
examples.zh: 数百万老年人生活在贫困之中。

examples.en: We need an effective strategy to fight poverty .
examples.zh: 我们需要制定一个有效的对策来与贫困作斗争。

examples.en: continued efforts to alleviate poverty and raise living standards
examples.zh: 缓解贫困和提高生活水平的不懈努力

words.definition: a flower or the flowers on a tree or bush; if trees blossom, they produce flowers; succeed, come into flower; bloom, inflorescence
words.translation: 花；开花；[植]开花；兴旺；发展成；[植]花；开花期；兴旺期；花开的状态

examples.en: pale pink blossoms
examples.zh: 淡粉色的花朵

examples.en: The cherry tree was covered in blossom.
examples.zh: 樱桃树花满枝头。

words.definition: larithmic
words.translation: 人口统计学的；人口学的

words.definition: unexpectedly, fortuitously
words.translation: 意外的,偶然(发生)的；意外地；偶然地

examples.en: She accidentally erased the tape.
examples.zh: 她意外地抹去了录了音的磁带。

words.definition: the industry of making ships; newbuilding
words.translation: 造船；[船]造船；造船业；造船术

examples.en: a shipbuilding yard
examples.zh: 造船厂

words.definition: a pipe or tube that liquids, air,  cable s  etc pass through; conveying pipe, conveyer pipe
words.translation: 管道, 导管；用导管输送；输送管，[生物]导管

examples.en: Air is heated and then circulated through large ducts to all parts of the house.
examples.zh: 空气加热后通过大管道循环输送到房子的各处。

words.definition: drops of salty liquid that come out through your skin when you are hot, frightened, ill, or doing exercise; stream, shed; sudor, globule; smart, labour over
words.translation: 汗 v(使)出汗；使出汗；流出；使干苦活；剥削；藉出汗减轻；焦急地期待；汗；水珠；焦急；苦差使；出汗；辛苦工作；懊恼；结水珠

examples.en: Ian came off the squash court dripping with sweat .
examples.zh: 伊恩大汗淋漓地离开壁球场。

examples.en: Beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.
examples.zh: 他的额头上冒出了汗珠。

examples.en: Sweat poured down his face.
examples.zh: 他满头大汗。

words.definition: based on scientific testing or practical experience, not on ideas
words.translation: 经验主义的

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["empirical evidence"]}
examples.zh: 实验证据

words.definition: to try to end a quarrel between two people, groups, countries etc; center, intercede; communicate, convey; indirect, circular
words.translation: 调停, 斡旋；调解；斡旋；居中；调停；传达；间接的；居间的

examples.en: The former president has agreed to mediate the peace talks.
examples.zh: 前总统同意就和谈进行斡旋。

words.definition: the blood flowing in your body
words.translation: 血流

examples.en: The drug is injected directly into the bloodstream.
examples.zh: 这种药物是直接注射到血液中的。

words.definition: to discover whether something is correct or true; touch bottom, check on
words.translation: 核实, 证明；核实；查证

examples.en: American forces will remain to verify compliance with the treaty.
examples.zh: 美军将继续驻留，核查条约是否得到遵守。

words.definition: recleaning
words.translation: 再选, 改选；改选；再选

examples.en: After they finished their commission business, Chernomyrdin came to see me to brief me on events in Russia and Yeltsin’s prospects for reelection.
examples.zh: 在他们完成了使命后，他来拜访我，向我简单介绍了俄罗斯的近况和叶利钦再次当选的前景。

examples.en: Every member of the House of Representatives and about one-third of the Senate is up for reelection in any given election year.
examples.zh: 在每个规定的选举年中，全国都要重新选举全体的众议院议员和大约三分之一的参议院议员。

words.definition: a house, apartment etc where people live; residence, accommodation; living
words.translation: 住处；寓所；居住（dwell的现在分词）

examples.en: Some 3,500 new dwellings are planned for the area.
examples.zh: 大约三千五百套新住宅计划在这个地区新建。

words.definition: the best or most important; principal, supreme, main, lead; firstly, primarily, initially, first of all, chiefly
words.translation: 最重要的,最初的；最重要的；最先的；首先；居于首位地

examples.en: one of the country’s foremost authorities on chemical warfare
examples.zh: 该国化学战方面的最高权威之一

examples.en: Rostropovich was long considered the world’s foremost cellist.
examples.zh: 长期以来，罗斯特罗波维奇一直被视为世界上首屈一指的大提琴家。

words.definition: in the air or the sky, away from the ground
words.translation: 半空中

examples.en: The planes collided in midair.
examples.zh: 飞机在空中相撞。

words.definition: a large  reptile  with a long mouth and many sharp teeth that lives in lakes and rivers in hot wet parts of the world; cayman, caiman
words.translation: 鳄鱼, 鳄鱼皮；鳄鱼

examples.en: a crocodile briefcase
examples.zh: 鳄鱼皮公文包

words.definition: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you; sis, tittie
words.translation: 姐妹；修女；护士

examples.en: Janet and Abby are sisters.
examples.zh: 珍妮特和阿比是两姐妹。

examples.en: He has two sisters and a brother.
examples.zh: 他有两个姊妹和一个弟弟。

examples.en: She’s my twin sister .
examples.zh: 她是我的孪生妹妹。

words.definition: to give birth to a  calf
words.translation: 生小牛, (使)冰山崩解

examples.en: The whales migrate some 6,000 miles to breed and calve in the warm lagoons.
examples.zh: 这种鲸鱼环游了6,000英里到暖水湖里生育繁殖。

words.definition: the combining of two or more things so that they work together effectively; synthesis, comprehensiveness
words.translation: 综合；集成

examples.en: problems of racial integration
examples.zh: 种族融合的问题

words.definition: the state of being useful or the degree to which something is useful; validity, availability
words.translation: 有用, 有效性；有用；有效性；有益

examples.en: As a commuter service, the ferry has outlived its usefulness(= is no longer useful ).
examples.zh: 作为一种通勤服务，渡船已经没有用武之地了。

words.definition: connected with the sense of smell; osphradium
words.translation: 嗅觉的；嗅觉器官

examples.en: the olfactory cells in the nose
examples.zh: 鼻腔内的嗅觉细胞

words.definition: Cranial means relating to your cranium
words.translation: 头盖(形)的

examples.en: ...cranial bleeding.
examples.zh: ...颅出血。

words.definition: something that is necessary before something else can happen or be done; prior condition, pre-condition
words.translation: 先决条件

examples.en: Good self-esteem is a prerequisite for a happy life.
examples.zh: 良好的自尊心是幸福生活的先决条件。

words.definition: relating to or caused by your job; vocational, professional
words.translation: 职业的；占领的

examples.en: occupational pension schemes
examples.zh: 职业退休金计划

examples.en: an occupational health centre
examples.zh: 职业医疗保健中心

examples.en: occupational disease
examples.zh: 职业病

words.definition: an occasion when the sun or the moon cannot be seen, because the Earth is passing directly between the moon and the sun, or because the moon is passing directly between the Earth and the sun
words.translation: (日、月)食 vt形成(日、月)食

examples.en: an eclipse of the sun
examples.zh: 日食

examples.en: a total eclipse
examples.zh: 全食

words.definition: to prove that a statement or idea is not correct; disprove, redargue
words.translation: 驳斥，驳倒；反驳，驳斥；驳倒

examples.en: It was the kind of rumour that it is impossible to refute.
examples.zh: 这是那种不可能推翻的谣言。

words.definition: upcurrent, ascending air current
words.translation: 上升气流；[建]向上之排气

examples.en: Peak updraft strength is slightly enhanced with hodograph curvature, 29.0 m/s in B versus 26.1 in C.
examples.zh: 山顶上升气流强度随速矢端迹曲率加大而稍有加强，在（图上）B点是每秒29米，C点是每秒26.1米。

examples.en: As the hot air rises, a powerful updraft is also created by the tower that allows air to be continually sucked through 32 turbines, which spin to generate power 24 hours a day.
examples.zh: 当热空气上升时，一股有力的上升气流被可以让32个涡轮持续吸引的塔所生成，那些涡轮可以产生24小时的动力来纺纱。

examples.en: Finally, a two-megawatt solar updraft tower produces additional energy in clear weather.
examples.zh: 最后是一座2兆瓦的太阳能热气流发电塔。 它能在天气晴朗时产生超过大厦自身需要的能源。

words.definition: careful consideration or discussion of something; consideration of, leisureliness
words.translation: 仔细考虑；商量；审议；考虑；从容；熟思

examples.en: After much deliberation, first prize was awarded to Derek Murray.
examples.zh: 经仔细商议，一等奖颁给了德里克·默里。

words.definition: a tall pole on which a flag hangs
words.translation: 旗杆

examples.en: The new Namibian flag was hoisted up the flagpole.
examples.zh: 纳米比亚的新国旗被升到旗杆顶上。

words.definition: to ask for help from someone more powerful than you, especially a god; attract, produce, cause, operate, occasion
words.translation: 恳求；调用；祈求；引起

examples.en: St. Genevieve is often invoked against plagues.
examples.zh: 人们经常祈求圣女日南斐法来消除瘟疫。

words.definition: if someone is hypersensitive to a drug, substance etc, their body reacts very badly to it; irritable, touchy
words.translation: 过份敏感的；[医]过敏的；高灵敏度的；超感光度的

examples.en: Student teachers were hypersensitive to any criticism of their performance.
examples.zh: 实习教师对任何针对他们表现的批评意见都异常敏感。

words.definition: impossible to prevent; inevitable, inescapable
words.translation: 不可避免的；不能废除的

examples.en: There are now fears that war is unavoidable.
examples.zh: 人们现在担心战争不可避免。

words.definition: having good luck; fortunate, providential
words.translation: 幸运的, 吉祥的；幸运的；侥幸的

examples.en: I didn’t really know your name – it was just a lucky guess .
examples.zh: 我并不知道你的名字―只是运气好猜中的。

words.definition: happening soon; imminent, forthcoming
words.translation: 即将来临的

examples.en: the upcoming elections
examples.zh: 即将举行的选举

words.definition: the second month of the year, between January and March
words.translation: 二月(略作Feb)

examples.en: He joined the Army in February 1943.
examples.zh: 他1943年2月参军。

words.definition: to pull or carry something heavy with difficulty
words.translation: (用力)拖拉

examples.en: Nobody wants to lug around huge suitcases full of clothes.
examples.zh: 没有人愿意拖着装满衣服的大箱子到处转。

words.definition: obviously, clearly, markedly, distinctly
words.translation: 宽广地, 广泛；明显地；宽广地；概括地；露骨地；粗鄙地

examples.en: The president broadly got what he wanted out of his meeting.
examples.zh: 总统大体上得到了他想从会议中得到的东西。

words.definition: a relationship between friends; fellowship, companionship
words.translation: 友谊, 友好；友谊；友爱；友善

examples.en: her close friendship with her aunt
examples.zh: 她与姑母的亲密友谊

examples.en: a lifelong friendship
examples.zh: 一生的友谊

examples.en: The two boys formed a deep and lasting friendship .
examples.zh: 这两个男孩子建立了深厚持久的友谊。

words.definition: two; liang, tael
words.translation: 两, 双, 二；两；二；一对

words.definition: something that causes disease in your body; causative agent, harmful bacteria
words.translation: [微生物]病菌, 病原体；[基医]病原体；病菌

examples.en: This would introduce only a small number of GM plants into the environment, so farmers could choose not to harvest them while still benefiting from their pathogen-detecting ability.
examples.zh: 这只需要把少量转基因作物引入到环境中，因此农民可以选择不收获它们，同时仍然享受它们的病原体探测能力的益处。

examples.en: Scientists talk about the 'virulence' of a pathogen, but what does that mean to laypeople?
examples.zh: 科学家谈论一种病原体的“毒力”，但是这对于普通人的意义是什么？

words.definition: very good, enjoyable, or unusual, and worth remembering; obvious, prominent, marked, noted, outstanding
words.translation: 难忘的,重大的；显著的，难忘的；值得纪念的

examples.en: We want to make this a truly memorable day for the children.
examples.zh: 我们想让今天成为孩子们永远难忘的日子。

words.definition: relating to the ability to hear; listener, assembly room; acoustic, aural
words.translation: 耳的, 听觉的；听众；礼堂；[生理]听觉的；耳朵的

examples.en: ...the limits of the human auditory range.
examples.zh: …人类听觉范围的局限。

words.definition: radical, underground; before
words.translation: 先锋的,激进的；激进的；先锋派的；在…之前

examples.en: The first Dada performances were put on by a group of avant-garde poets, writers and performances artists at Cabaret Voltaire.
examples.zh: 第一个达达表演是由一群先锋派诗人、作家和表演艺术家们在伏尔泰夜总会上演的。

examples.en: Nothing, though, should take away from this phenomenal work of outsider art, a neo-avant-garde exercise in bodyshock violence that features an unknown cast and dialogue in Latin and Aramaic.
examples.zh: 虽然，没什么能从这部非凡的化外艺术作品中拿走？ ，一次新先锋派在身体暴力上的练习，由一组不知名演员出演，以拉丁语和阿拉米语进行对话。

words.definition: third in place, degree, or order; third age; third, ternary
words.translation: 第三的, 第三位的；[数]第三纪；第三修道会会员；第三级教士；[数]第三的；第三位的；三代的

examples.en: He must have come to know those philosophers through secondary or tertiary sources.
examples.zh: 他一定是通过第二手或第三手资料了解那些哲学家的。

words.definition: a ship, especially a military one, that can stay under water; sub, pigboat; benthonic, undersea
words.translation: 潜水艇；海底生物；[海洋]海底的；水下的

examples.en: a nuclear submarine
examples.zh: 核潜艇

words.definition: a small area of a country, city etc; situation, site, spot, lie, where
words.translation: 位置, 地点；所在；位置；地点

examples.en: weather reports from several different localities
examples.zh: 来自几个不同地区的天气报告

words.definition: not likely to be true or correct; suspicious, doubtful
words.translation: 可疑的；有问题的

examples.en: The statistics are highly questionable.
examples.zh: 这个统计数据大有问题。

words.definition: The Inuit are the people descended from the original people of Alaska, Eastern Canada, and Greenland
words.translation: 因纽特人,  因纽特语

examples.en: He pays heed to the observations of the Inuit.
examples.zh: 他留意到因纽特人的观察结果。

examples.en: The involvement of the Inuit is crucial also because alterations brought on by climate change increase the chances of intervention in their lifestyle - impossible a decade ago.
examples.zh: 因纽特人的参与之所以至关重要，还因为气候变化带来的改变增加了他们的生活方式受到干扰的可能性——这在十年前是不可能的。

examples.en: Whales have long been central part of Inuit life in Greenland, where a regulated subsistence hunt continues to this day.
examples.zh: 在格陵兰，猎鲸是长期以来因纽特人生活的中心内容，在那里，受规管的自给狩猎一直持续至今。

words.definition: seaweed, varech
words.translation: 藻类,海藻；藻类；海藻

examples.en: Even more strangely, the researchers think the salamanders might inherit the alga from their parents.
examples.zh: 更奇怪的是，研究人员认为这些海藻是火蜥蜴从它们父母那里继承来的。

examples.en: The town is the centre of a black-market trade in facai, a species of alga whose name is spelt and pronounced similarly to 'get rich'.
examples.zh: 这座城镇是一个发菜黑市交易的中心。 发菜是一种藻类，在汉语里它的写法和发音类似于“发财”。

words.definition: a form of a language which is spoken only in one area, with words or grammar that are slightly different from other forms of the same language; patois, provincialism
words.translation: 方言；方言，土话；同源语；行话；个人用语特征

examples.en: the local dialect
examples.zh: 当地方言

words.definition: in the same order as the things you have just mentioned; separately, alone, in several
words.translation: 分别地, 各个地；分别地；各自地，独自地

examples.en: The cups and saucers cost £5 and £3 respectively.
examples.zh: 茶杯和茶碟的价钱分别为5英镑和3英镑。

words.definition: not at work, school, a meeting etc, because you are sick or decide not to go; missing, vacant
words.translation: 缺席的；缺乏的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的

examples.en: He has been absent from his desk for two weeks.
examples.zh: 他已经两个星期没来了。

words.definition: a type of grey or white mineral; felspar
words.translation: [矿]长石；[矿物]长石

examples.en: The results indicate that the jade mainly consists of illite and a small quantity of feldspar, quartz, hematite, siderite and rutile, which is argillaceous sedimentary rock.
examples.zh: 结果表明，其矿物成分以伊利石为主，含有少量的长石、石英、赤铁矿、菱铁矿和金红石，为泥质沉积岩。

examples.en: It's got lower aluminium and more magnesium relative to silicon, so it has a lower abundance of feldspar [minerals], and so it has clearly undergone a unique geological history.
examples.zh: 和硅比起来，它的表面含吕较少。 含镁较多。 所以它表面的长石（一种矿物质）含量很少，水星有一个独特的地理历史。

examples.en: The feldspar found in granite gives the Brandberg Massif areddish appearance during sunset.
examples.zh: 在花冈岩中发现的长石使布兰德山在日落时分呈现红色外貌。

words.definition: the scientific study of living things; life-form, living things

examples.zh: 天真的小女孩

examples.zh: 一系列正版的迪士尼商品在出售。

examples.zh: 他们仔细地检查了商品。

examples.zh: 图像的色彩绚丽，主要为天青石色，亦配有几种不同色调的金色。

examples.zh: 地毯和古董商人会很高兴的让你坐在地板上，打开装满宝贵石头的小包裹给你看，里面的宝石来自中亚而巨大的青金石来自阿富汗。

words.translation: 突破；突破性进展

examples.en: The company looks poised to make a significant breakthrough in China.
examples.zh: 该公司看上去稳将在中国实现一次重大突破。

words.definition: someone whose job is to manage part or all of a company or other organization; executive, gerente
words.translation: 经理, 管理人员；经理；管理人员

examples.zh: 我们的一位地区经理

examples.zh: 一家计算机公司的中层管理人员

words.definition: builtup
words.translation: 合成的,组成的；组成的；创作的；作曲的

words.translation: 年青人,  少年；年轻人；少年

examples.zh: 其他的年轻人没有这么幸运。

words.definition: inwardly

examples.zh: 人际沟通

words.translation: 阿富汗(西南亚国家)

examples.zh: 在阿富汗我们有一个工厂。

examples.zh: 人们问我们是否在伊拉克和阿富汗取得一些成功，我说是的。

examples.en: And if I leave this country, if other people like me leave this country, who will come to Afghanistan?
examples.zh: 如果我离开这个国家，如果像我一样的其他人离开这个国家，谁还会来阿富汗？

words.definition: azure stone
words.translation: 天青石；[岩]青金石（等于lapis lazuli）

examples.en: Rembrandt didn't go to the local art shop and buy tubes of paint. He had to grind and mix his paints from things such as lapis lazuli to make blue.
examples.zh: 伦勃朗没法在美术商店买到一管管的颜料，他只能自己研磨做颜料，比如把天青石磨成粉来当蓝色颜料用。

examples.en: The carpet and antique sellers will gladly sit you on the floor and unpack small purses filled with precious stones from central Asia and huge lapis lazuli from Afghanistan.
examples.zh: 地毯和古董商人会很高兴的让你坐在地板上，打开装满宝贵石头的小包裹给你看，里面的宝石来自中亚而巨大的青金石来自阿富汗。

words.translation: 电子地, 通过电子手段

words.definition: the mixture of waste from the human body and used water, that is carried away from houses by pipes under the ground; wastewater, polluted water

examples.en: Chlorine is used in sewage treatment.
examples.zh: 氯被用于污水处理。

examples.en: The factory secretly dumped millions of gallons of raw sewage (= sewage that had not been treated ) into the Ohio river.
examples.zh: 这家工厂偷偷地把几百万加仑未经处理的污水排放进了俄亥俄河。

words.definition: to give official permission for something; confirm, allow
words.translation: 批准；批准，认可；授权给；委托代替

examples.zh: 城市垃圾场

examples.zh: 市级选举

words.definition: the use of words or pictures to describe ideas or actions in poems, books, films etc; comparison, visualization
words.translation: 意象, 肖像；像；意象；比喻；形象化

examples.zh: 他们的梦里常常有很多复杂的情节，充满了生动的画面。

words.definition: to freeze or be frozen again after having defrosted
words.translation: 再结冰, 重新冻结

examples.en: In this process the water can refreeze, creating additional cracks in the more vulnerable warm ice, according to the study.
examples.zh: 根据该项研究，在这个过程中，水可以重新冻结，在更脆弱的暖冰中造成更多裂缝。

examples.en: The sun is heating the newly open water, so it will take longer to refreeze this winter, and the resulting thinner ice will melt more easily next summer.
examples.zh: 太阳给无冰水面不断加热，因此，今年冬天这些冰层重新冻结将会耗时更久，而且产生的薄薄的冰层在下一年夏天融化时更快。

words.translation: 水文的

examples.en: While evaporation from the oceans is the primary vehicle for driving the surface-to-atmosphere portion of the hydrologic cycle, transpiration is also significant.
examples.zh: 海洋的蒸发作用是水文循环中的主要方式，它使得水从地球表面进入大气层中，蒸腾作用也具有举足轻重的地位。

examples.en: Only when a system possesses natural or artificial boundariesthat associate the water within it with the hydrologic cycle may theentire system properly be termed hydrogeologic.
examples.zh: 只有当某一地质系统拥有自然的或人工的界限，将该系统内的水与水文循环起来，这整个系统方能被恰当地称为与水文地质学相关。

examples.en: Natural disasters are catastrophic events with atmospheric, geologic, and hydrologic origins. Disasters include earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, landslides, tsunamis, floods, and drought.
examples.zh: 自然灾害是指大气、地质或水文等因素造成的灾变，包括地震、火山爆发、泥石流、海啸、洪水和干旱等。

words.definition: related to the food someone eats
words.translation: 饮食的；规定的食物

examples.zh: 特殊的饮食要求

words.definition: hydroelectric power
words.translation: 水力发出的电力

examples.zh: 如果靠自力更生，只有靠水电站带来的廉价能源了。

examples.en: Developing hydropower more quickly would allow for increasing the renewable energy target above the envisaged government target without increasing the incremental cost of the program.
examples.zh: 加快发展水电可以在不增加整个可再生能源开发方案总成本的同时，实现可再生能源发展的新目标。

words.definition: a small hard piece of something; particle, grain

examples.zh: 咖啡颗粒

examples.zh: 你的鼓励会激发我进一步努力。

examples.zh: …公园及其它娱乐设施。

examples.en: Many of them work in low-paid insecure jobs.
examples.zh: 他们当中的许多人都做着薪水低、不稳定的工作。

examples.zh: 我们往北走以绕开这些山。

examples.zh: 今年全体员工工作都非常出色。

examples.zh: 吸烟是我唯一的恶习。

examples.zh: 欧洲盟军最高指挥官

examples.zh: 汽车占绝对优势地位的国家

words.translation: 取最大值, 最佳化

examples.zh: 我们要充分利用空间。

examples.zh: 最上等的茶叶价格很贵。

examples.en: industrial grade diamonds
examples.zh: 工业等级钻石

examples.zh: 这片低洼的沼泽地沿海湾方向延伸数英里。

examples.zh: 他焦虑的心情

examples.zh: 工厂安装了摄像头，这引起了工人的高度不安。

examples.en: It can help if you discuss your anxieties with someone.
examples.zh: 与别人谈谈自己的忧虑会有帮助的。

words.translation: 退休；[劳经]退休，[军]退役

examples.zh: 她去年提前退休了。

examples.zh: 爸爸快到退休年龄了。

examples.zh: 一个有同情心的朋友

examples.zh: 一种同情的态度

examples.en: We hope always to provide a friendly sympathetic ear (= someone willing to listen to someone else’s problems ) .
examples.zh: 我们希望总能做到友善地倾听。

examples.zh: 同一群体的不同动物对同一疾病有不同的表现形式。

examples.zh: 我们俩都是初次感受大城市多姿多彩的生活。

examples.zh: 在缅因州，公路交通事故中杀死的动物种类是北美箭猪。

examples.zh: 它不像豪猪的刺或其它什么的，但是在表面上有尖状的凸起使这个器官起伏不平。

examples.en: The issue of animal experimentation is an emotive subject.
examples.zh: 动物实验问题是个敏感的话题。

words.definition: musical instruments such as drums, bells etc which you play by hitting them; vibration, collision, impact, crash
words.translation: 碰撞, 打击乐器；[临床]叩诊；振动；碰撞；敲打乐器；打击乐器组

examples.en: Tonight we have Paul Duke on percussion (= playing a percussion instrument ) .
examples.zh: 今晚我们请到保罗·杜克先生负责打击乐。

examples.en: a range of percussion instruments
examples.zh: 一组打击乐器

words.definition: reasonable and likely to be true or successful; smooth-tongued, rhetoric
words.translation: 似真实合理的；貌似可信的，花言巧语的；貌似真实的，貌似有理的

examples.en: His story certainly sounds plausible.
examples.zh: 他的叙述听上去当然很合理。

examples.en: a plausible explanation
examples.zh: 说得过去的解释

words.definition: conflict, discrepancy; cross, cruciate; cross, intercross
words.translation: 交叉, 来回移动；十字形；矛盾；十字形的；交叉的；交叉；交叉往来

examples.en: They spent the next two years crisscrossing the country by bus.
examples.zh: 接下来的两年他们乘公共汽车在乡间来回奔波。

words.definition: to shut and open your eyes quickly; wink one's eyes; wink one's eyes, nictate; moment, breath, second, instant
words.translation: 眨眼, 闪烁；眨眼；使…闪烁；闪烁；瞬间；闪光

examples.en: I blinked as I came out into the sunlight.
examples.zh: 我走出来，在太阳光下直眨眼睛。

words.definition: a situation in which two people or groups have had a serious disagreement and begun to dislike and not trust each other; crack, split; separate, unhinge; gap, seam, spring off
words.translation: 裂口；裂开；[木]裂缝；不和；[地质]使断裂；使分开

examples.en: He set out to heal the rifts in the party.
examples.zh: 他着手弥合党内的裂痕。

words.definition: a thin metal container that is fastened to a wall and through which hot water passes to provide heat for a room; heatsink, heating unit
words.translation: 暖气片，散热器；[电]散热器；[建]暖气片；[声][物][核]辐射体

examples.en: We bled the car radiator off.
examples.zh: 我们排放汽车散热器中的气。

examples.en: When her cellphone rang in class one day, the teacher smashed it against the radiator.
examples.zh: 有一次在课堂上她的手机响了，老师立马将它摔到了暖气片上。

examples.en: It still has dingy corridors, ancient washrooms, rusting bunk beds (six to a room), a single fluorescent bulb hanging from the ceiling and an ancient radiator in front of the window.
examples.zh: 仍旧是昏暗的走廊，老式的厕所，生锈的床铺（六人一间），一只荧光灯泡吊在天花板上，还有一只旧暖气片放在窗前。

words.definition: very many; thousand, countless, million, infinite, innumerable; million, innumerability
words.translation: 无数的 n无数；无数的；种种的；无数，极大数量；无数的人或物

examples.en: the myriad causes of homelessness
examples.zh: 导致人们无家可归的种种原因

words.definition: a musical instrument like a piano, that was played especially in the past; fortepiano
words.translation: 翼琴(钢琴的前身)；古钢琴，翼琴

examples.en: It is called a clavichord.
examples.zh: 它被称作古钢琴。 这是一个被动语态的句子。

examples.en: Our clavichord is kept in the living room.
examples.zh: 我们的这架古钢琴存放在起居室里。

examples.en: That's why she wanted to play the clavichord.
examples.zh: 这就是她想弹古钢琴的原因。

words.definition: a type of  fossil  of a small sea creature
words.translation: [古生]三叶虫

examples.en: It looks like a cyborg trilobite; just the thing you want to caress while scrolling through the next chapter of “Victorians on Venus”.
examples.zh: 它看起来像一只电子三叶虫，当你在电脑上阅读蒸汽朋克小说的时候，这款鼠标用起来准让你爱不释手。

examples.en: In addition, the trilobite said, the shifting of tectonic plates, and with them, the birth of new mountain ranges, river valleys, and coastlines, seemed to be coming along great.
examples.zh: 这只三叶虫还补充说大陆板块正在移动，随之而来的还有全新的山脉、河谷和海岸线的诞生，这些看上去很完美。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that changes the form of something, especially so that it can be more easily used; rectifier, commutator
words.translation: 转炉；[电][电子]变流器，整流器；[计]转化器

examples.en: a converter that allows you to view digital television on your old TV
examples.zh: 让你可以在旧电视机上收看数字电视的转换器

words.definition: the way in which something such as a town, garden, or building is arranged; programming, exposure, disposal, showing, design
words.translation: 布局，安排；布局；设计；安排；陈列

examples.en: All the flats in the building had the same layout.
examples.zh: 大楼里所有的公寓布局都是一样的。

words.definition: a sharp curved nail on an animal, bird, or some insects; talon, unguis
words.translation: (脚)爪；[动]爪；螯，钳；爪形器具

examples.en: The cat dug his claws into my leg.
examples.zh: 猫的爪子抓进了我的腿中。

examples.en: lobster claws
examples.zh: 龙虾的螯

words.definition: to make someone who is attacking you go away, by fighting them; refuse, roll back
words.translation: 排斥,击退；击退；抵制；使厌恶；使不愉快

examples.en: The army was ready to repel an attack.
examples.zh: 军队已准备好击退进攻。

words.definition: sawback
words.translation: [地]齿状山脊, [鱼]马鲛；[地理]锯齿山脊；呈齿状起伏的山脉

words.definition: fair or reasonable; legal, reasonable, valid, logical, rational
words.translation: 合法的；正当的；合理的；正统的

examples.en: That’s a perfectly legitimate question.
examples.zh: 那个问题完全合乎情理。

examples.en: Most scientists believe it is legitimate to use animals in medical research.
examples.zh: 大多数科学家认为用动物作医学研究是正当的。

words.definition: used to show that one number or amount is added to another; benefit, good; additional, attached, positive, more, second
words.translation: 加上 a正的；正号，加号；好处；附加额；[数]正的；附加的

examples.en: Three plus six equals nine (3+6=9).
examples.zh: 3 加6等于9。

examples.en: The total cost was $10,000, plus 14% interest.
examples.zh: 全部费用是1万美元，外加14%的利息。

words.definition: a sea creature with eight tentacles (= arms ); poulp, devilfish
words.translation: 章鱼；[无脊椎]章鱼

examples.en: ...plates of octopus.
examples.zh: …一盘盘章鱼肉。

words.definition: related to or limited by time; impermanent, interim
words.translation: 现世的, 暂时的；暂时的；当时的；现世的

examples.en: the temporal character of human existence
examples.zh: 人生的短促

words.translation: 不可预测性

examples.en: The danger lies in its unpredictability. Yet that may also be a reason for hope.
examples.zh: 危险就在于其不可预测性，而这也可能是希望尚存的一个原因吧。

examples.en: With the unpredictability of the volcano, authorities widened the danger zone around the mountain to 20 kilometers.
examples.zh: 鉴于这一火山的不可预测性，印尼官员将“危险区域”扩大到方圆20公里。

examples.en: While the West views democracy as an advantage since it can offer United States an institutional and bloodless process for renewal, Beijing views it as a source of irrationality and unpredictability.
examples.zh: 尽管西方认为民主是一种优势，可以给美国提供一种制度上的、不流血的更新进程，但北京认为这是非理性和不可预测性的一个源头。

words.translation: 最低限要求者

words.definition: very enjoyable, exciting, or romantic, in a strange or special way; demonic
words.translation: 魔术的, 神奇的；魔术的；有魔力的

examples.en: that magical evening we spent together
examples.zh: 我们一起度过的那个美妙夜晚

words.definition: the part of a store that faces the street; shopfront
words.translation: 店头, 店面；[贸易]店面；店头

examples.en: A small storefront leads to an English-language school run by Disney.
examples.zh: 一个小的店面通向由迪尼斯经营的英语语言学校。

examples.en: That small number Wei quoted would presumably fund business with an online storefront and a small amount of goods, which could be sold for proceeds to pay the loan and buy more wares.
examples.zh: 据推测，魏提到的少量自有资金或许将用来开设在线店面，以及购置少量货物，这些货物出售后的款项将用来继续提供贷款，以及购买更多货物。

examples.en: Anybody can rent out a storefront and start their own church, and many people have done so.
examples.zh: 任何人都可以租一间店面，开创自己的教会，而且也有很多人这样做了。

words.definition: made to be used for a short time only when nothing better is available; quick fix, provisional measure; temporary, extraordinary, odd, occasional
words.translation: 临时的；临时替代物；权宜之计；凑合；临时措施；将就；权宜之计的；凑合的

examples.en: The refugees slept in makeshift tents at the side of the road.
examples.zh: 逃难者睡在路边临时搭建的帐篷里。

words.definition: a very bad situation that someone is in; difficulty, corner, dilemma, fix, predicament; undertake, assure
words.translation: 困境；境况；誓约；保证；约定

examples.en: the country’s economic plight
examples.zh: 该国的经济困境

words.definition: a desert plant with sharp points instead of leaves; Cholla Stem, cholla
words.translation: [植]仙人掌；[园艺]仙人掌

examples.en: The giant cactus is the vegetable skycraper.
examples.zh: 高大的仙人掌是植物界巨人。

examples.en: A saguaro cactus stands tall amid a frenzy of lightning bolts in Arizona.
examples.zh: 亚利桑那州，一株巨人柱仙人掌矗立在一团狂暴的闪电中。

examples.en: The cactus… well, that will have to languish in the bathroom until next Spring.
examples.zh: 仙人掌……，在春天到来前都应该把它放在浴室里。

words.definition: very serious and not happy, for example because something bad has happened or because you are at an important occasion; serious, sacred, majestic, grave
words.translation: 庄严的,严肃的；庄严的，严肃的；隆重的，郑重的

examples.en: a solemn expression
examples.zh: 严肃的表情

examples.en: Their faces suddenly grew solemn.
examples.zh: 他们的脸突然变得严肃起来。

examples.en: a solemn procession of mourners
examples.zh: 庄重的送葬队伍

words.definition: to cut and collect a crop of grain; acquire, earn, buy, find, make; crop, to harvest
words.translation: 收割, 收获；收获，获得；收割；收割，收获

examples.en: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
examples.zh: 你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

words.definition: to do something without any preparation, because you are forced to do this by unexpected events; extemporize
words.translation: 即兴创作；即兴表演；临时凑合

examples.en: I forgot to bring my notes, so I had to improvise.
examples.zh: 我忘了带笔记，只好临时发挥。

words.definition: to move up through the air; raise, arise, go up, climb; scale, climb
words.translation: 攀登, 上升；上升；登高；追溯；攀登，上升

examples.en: The plane ascended rapidly.
examples.zh: 飞机迅速爬升。

words.definition: player, entertainer
words.translation: 戏剧制作人, 玩杂耍的；玩杂耍的人；马戏团的老板；表演者

examples.en: He is the band’s best showman.
examples.zh: 他是这支乐队中风头最盛的人。

words.definition: height, sky, peak, apex, crown; first-chop, ritzy
words.translation: 顶点, 最高阶层；顶点；最高级会议；最高阶层；最高级的；政府首脑的

words.definition: an arrangement for a meeting at an agreed time and place, for a particular purpose; convention, bond, nomination
words.translation: 约会, 指定；[管理]任命；约定；任命的职位

examples.en: All consultations are by appointment only .
examples.zh: 就诊必须预约。

words.definition: someone whose job is to advise people about laws, write formal agreements, or represent people in court; advocate, lawer
words.translation: 律师；[法]律师；法学家

examples.en: Prosecution and defence lawyers are expected to deliver closing arguments next week.
examples.zh: 原告律师和被告律师下周将要作终结辩论。

words.translation: 阿拉斯加人 a阿拉斯加的

examples.en: But his obeying the ordinary driving commands of the Alaskan trail is no demonstration that he is yours. Any dog in Alaska would obey you as he obeyed.
examples.zh: 他遵守阿拉斯加的驱赶命令并不意味着他就是你的狗，任何阿拉斯加的狗都会像他一样对你俯首贴耳。

examples.en: But this crab also suffers from something of an identity crisis: Imported king crab is often misnamed Alaskan king crab, because most people think that's the name of the crab.
examples.zh: 但这种蟹类也遭受了类似于身份危机的问题: 由于大多数人认为阿拉斯加帝王蟹就是这种螃蟹的名字，进口帝王蟹通常被这样误称。

words.definition: to limit something; chain, bound, force, provoke, enforce
words.translation: 强迫, 限制；驱使；强迫；束缚

examples.en: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
examples.zh: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

examples.en: Women’s employment opportunities are often severely constrained by family commitments.
examples.zh: 女性的就业机会常常受到家庭责任的严重限制。

words.definition: the development and use of minerals, forests, oil etc for business or industry; development, utilization, using
words.translation: 开发, 开采；开发，开采；利用；广告推销

words.definition: a set of beliefs that form an important part of a religion or system of ideas; principle, theory, belief, teaching
words.translation: 教条, 学说；主义；学说；教义；信条

examples.en: traditional doctrines of divine power
examples.zh: 神力的传统教义

examples.en: Marxist doctrine
examples.zh: 马克思主义学说

words.definition: You use immeasurably to emphasize the degree or extent of a process or quality; infinitely, unlimitedly
words.translation: 无法计量地, 无限地；无限地；广大无边地；不能测量地

examples.en: They have improved immeasurably since their arrival.
examples.zh: 从他们抵达以来，他们已极大程度地改进了。

words.definition: determination to be successful, rich, powerful etc; careerism, aspiration; pursue / pursuit, go after
words.translation: 野心, 雄心；野心，雄心；抱负，志向；追求；有…野心

examples.en: He was young and full of ambition.
examples.zh: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

words.definition: retain, keep up
words.translation: 使永存, 使不朽；使不朽；保持

examples.en: an education system that perpetuates the divisions in our society
examples.zh: 使我们的社会持续分化的一种教育制度

words.definition: the life that some people believe people have after death; eternity, kingdom come
words.translation: 来世, 后来的岁月；来世；死后的生活

words.definition: to enjoy sitting or lying in the heat of the sun or a fire; lie in the sun
words.translation: 晒太阳；取暖；愉快或舒适

examples.en: All through the hot, still days of their holiday Amy basked in the sun.
examples.zh: 在整个炎热、寂静的假期里埃米都在晒太阳。

words.definition: philanthropic, caritative; philanthropist, charitarian
words.translation: 人道主义者(的)；人道主义的；博爱的；基督凡人论的；人道主义者；慈善家；博爱主义者；基督凡人论者

examples.en: And on each of those issues we have said that we would consider that and, in fact, have provided some humanitarian support.
examples.zh: 对于每一件这样的事情，我们都说过，我们将会对此进行考虑，事实上，我们向他们提供了人道主义援助。

examples.en: But part of trying to do what is right for the Burmese people is to provide humanitarian assistance in this time of extreme need.
examples.zh: 但是，对缅甸人民来说，正确的行动部分是为他们提供人道主义援助，而在目前这个时刻更是极端的需要”。

examples.en: But otherwise, it is best left to the humanitarian experts, who will be there after you are gone and therefore need to preserve their independence and their impartiality.
examples.zh: 但是，如果不能，最好将这些任务留给人道主义专家，这些专家在部队撤退之后仍将留在那，因此需要保持他们的独立和公正。

words.definition: someone who makes shoes and boots; souter, crispin
words.translation: 鞋匠；补鞋工人

examples.en: Mr Zhu, a shoemaker from Foshan, near Hong Kong, is on his second trip to Africa.
examples.zh: 朱先生是一个来自离香港不远的佛山的鞋匠，这是他第二次来非洲。

examples.en: The witch was astounded.Then she took him to a room where there were thirteen maidens with their faces covered: the shoemaker had to discover which one was the princess.
examples.zh: 女巫大吃一惊，接着她把年轻人带到了一个房间，里面有蒙着面纱的是三个少女：鞋匠必须从中找出真正的公主。

examples.en: His father, a poor shoemaker, died in 1816.
examples.zh: 他的父亲，一个贫困的鞋匠，在1816年去世。

words.definition: A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land in North America. Prairies have very few trees.; llanos, grasslands
words.translation: 大草原；（美）大草原（prairie的复数）

examples.en: He  has  transformed woodlands and prairies into farms and made lakes and reserviors out of rivers for irrigation purposes or hydroelectric power.
examples.zh: 他将林地和草原改造成为农田，使江河变成湖泊和水库，用于灌溉或用于水力发电。

examples.en: Cather was the great, elegiac chronicler of the prairies and small towns of the old American west, captured by her just as the coming of railroads changed it forever.
examples.zh: 凯瑟是古老的美国西部小镇和草原挽歌的伟大记录者，她赶在它们即将因铁路的出现而永远改变之际把它们记录了下来 。

examples.en: Many gains in cropland are associated with irrigation, but there are also swaths of improvement in rain-fed cropland and pastures in the prairies and plains of North America and western India.
examples.zh: 农田在许多方面的改善与灌溉相关，但是北美洲和印度西部大草原和平原地区的一些雨育农田及牧场也得到改善。

words.definition: an activity such as sewing or making baskets, in which you use your hands in a skilful way to make things; artifact
words.translation: 手工艺(品)；手工艺；手工艺品

examples.en: a shop selling handicrafts
examples.zh: 一家出售手工艺品的商店

words.translation: 符合逻辑地, 逻辑上地

words.definition: slipstream, airflow
words.translation: 气流；（尤指与飞机前进方向相反者）气流

examples.en: The Growler is able to keep its weapons charged up and humming by lowering special turbines into the airstream that rushes past the plane when it is flying.
examples.zh: 咆哮者可将特制的涡轮机降至飞机飞过时留下的气流里来实现对武器进行充电并使其重新进入活跃状态。

examples.en: The Growler is able to keep its weapons charged up and humming by lowering special turbines into the airstream that rushes past the plane when it is flying.
examples.zh: 咆哮者可以通过降低特殊涡轮转动将自身带入飞过的气流来保证电磁武器充电、运作。

examples.en: The ramp sits at an acute angle to deflect the intake airstream from the longitudinal direction.
examples.zh: 这个斜面锐角使进气口的气流纵向流变。

words.definition: used to say that it does not matter who does something, is in a particular place etc
words.translation: 任何人, 无论谁

examples.en: I’ll take whoever wants to go.
examples.zh: 谁想去我就带谁去。

examples.en: When you’re done with the book, just give it to Kristin or Shelley or whoever.
examples.zh: 你看完书以后，就给克里斯廷或谢利，或者随便谁都行。

words.definition: dangerous or likely to cause harm; dangerous, critical, risky
words.translation: 不安全的；[安全]不安全的；危险的；不安稳的

examples.en: The building is unsafe.
examples.zh: 那栋大楼不安全。

examples.en: water that’s unsafe to drink
examples.zh: 不能安全饮用的水

words.definition: A flashbulb is a small bulb that can be attached to a camera. It makes a bright flash of light so that you can take photographs indoors.
words.translation: [摄]闪光灯泡

examples.en: Actually even so-called 'flashbulb memories'—like where you were when Kennedy was shot—can be quite inaccurate or easily change over time.
examples.zh: 事实上，即使是闪光灯记忆，就像你在肯尼迪被射杀的现场，也是非常不精确的，非常容易改变的。

words.definition: relating to cows; slow, oxy
words.translation: (似)牛的，迟钝的；[脊椎]牛的；似牛的；迟钝的

examples.en: bovine diseases
examples.zh: 牛病

words.definition: serious and quiet because you are thinking a lot; considerate
words.translation: 深思的；体贴的；关切的

examples.en: a thoughtful look
examples.zh: 若有所思的神情

examples.en: a thoughtful silence
examples.zh: 沉思不语

words.definition: to start burning, or to make something start burning; heat, light; burn, light the fire
words.translation: 点火；点燃；使燃烧；使激动；燃烧

examples.en: The petrol tank suddenly ignited.
examples.zh: 油箱突然着火了。

examples.en: The candle ignited the plastic.
examples.zh: 蜡烛烧着了塑料。

words.definition: a long thin pointed piece of ice hanging from a roof or other surface; icle
words.translation: 冰柱；[水文]冰柱；垂冰；冷冰冰的人

examples.en: Missis walked in', she said, `as chill as an icicle, and as high as a princess.
examples.zh: “夫人走进来了，”她说，“跟个冰柱似的，冷冰冰的，又像个公主似的高不可攀。

words.translation: 象玻璃的；像玻璃的；光亮透明的；呆滞的
