examples.zh: 水明净如镜。

examples.en: ...glassy green pebbles.
examples.zh: ...透明的绿色鹅卵石。

words.definition: the thick central woody stem of a tree; stock, bole; arterial
words.translation: 树干, 行李箱；树干；躯干；象鼻；汽车车尾的行李箱；[航][铁路]干线的；躯干的；箱子的

examples.en: He left his bicycle leaning against a tree trunk .
examples.zh: 他把他的自行车斜靠在树干上。

words.definition: one of ten equal parts of something; decimus
words.translation: 第十, 十分之一；十分之一的；第十个的

words.definition: not able to be obtained
words.translation: 难以获得的

examples.en: Funding for the new school is unavailable.
examples.zh: 这座新学校没有经费。

words.definition: sulphuric, thio
words.translation: [化] 硫磺的,含硫的；硫磺的；含多量硫磺的；含（六价）硫的

examples.en: Sulfur dioxide turns into tiny droplets of sulfuric acid. These light-colored droplets cool the Earth by reflecting sunlight back to space.
examples.zh: 二氧化硫能转变为微小的硫酸雨滴，这些浅色的雨滴能通过反射太阳光返回太空来使地球降温。

examples.en: This variety is said to have a dog or panther-like nose and face, a forked tongue protruding from it, large fangs, and to hiss and screech when alarmed, as well as leave a sulfuric stench behind.
examples.zh: 据说，它还拥有狗或是豹子一样的鼻子和脸，像叉子一样的舌头，很大的獠牙，被惊吓到时会嘶嘶作声并尖叫并放出含有大量硫磺的臭气。

words.definition: the most recent or the newest; recent, current, last, nearest
words.translation: 最近的；最新的，最近的；最迟的

examples.en: all the latest gossip
examples.zh: 最近所有的流言蜚语

examples.en: His latest film is one of the funniest he’s ever made.
examples.zh: 最新的这部影片是他最搞笑的电影之一。

words.definition: If you redefine something, you cause people to consider it in a new way
words.translation: 重新定义

examples.en: Feminists have redefined the role of women.
examples.zh: 女权主义者们已重新定义了女性角色。

words.definition: a glass building used for growing plants that need warmth, light, and protection; heated housing, glasshouse
words.translation: 温室, 花房；[园艺]温室

examples.en: But these two countries are responsible for almost half of all greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.zh: 但是这两个国家的温室气体排放量几乎占了全世界的一半。

examples.en: A fiery steed is not trained in a courtyard, nor does a pine grow sturdy in a greenhouse.
examples.zh: 院子里练不出千里马， 温室里长不出万年松。

examples.en: If this is true, it means that the UK will not cut its greenhouse gases by 80% by 2050, as the government promised. It means it will cut them by 40%.
examples.zh: 如果这是真的，这意味着英国将不会象政府承诺的那样，到2050年削减其80%的温室气体排放量，这意味着英国将只削减40%。

words.translation: 本能地

examples.en: What do we instinctively do?
examples.zh: 出于本能，我们会怎么做？

examples.en: He thought how like her expression was then, to what it had been when she looked round at the Doctor - that night - and instinctively dropped her hand and turned away.
examples.zh: 他想，她现在的表情跟她那天夜里环视四周，最后望着医生时的表情是多么相像啊，于是他就本能地放下她的手，走开了。

examples.en: We answer this question instinctively and quite quickly because we have some intuitive sense of the whole experience.
examples.zh: 我们本能而迅捷地回答这个问题，因为对于整个经历，我们有一些直觉的感受。

words.definition: If something is universally believed or accepted, it is believed or accepted by everyone with no disagreement; generally, everywhere, around, throughout, about
words.translation: 普遍地；人人；到处

examples.en: ...a universally accepted point of view.
examples.zh: …一个被普遍接受的观点。

words.definition: the act or duty of protecting places or people, or of preventing prisoners from escaping; to protect a person, place, or object by staying near them and watching them; vigilance, alertness; keep one's eye on the ball, keep one's eyes peeled; watching, shield
words.translation: 警戒；守卫；护卫队；[安全]防护装置；警惕；保卫；监视

examples.en: The Sergeant told Swift to guard the entrance.
examples.zh: 中士叫斯威夫特守着入口。

examples.en: a lioness guarding her cubs
examples.zh: 守护着幼狮的母狮

words.definition: clarifiant, devaporizer
words.translation: 更清楚的；[助剂]澄清剂；清洁器

examples.en: It will be clearer if you delete the last paragraph.
examples.zh: 如果你删去最后那一段，它将会更清楚。

examples.en: These concepts will become clearer in the next section.
examples.zh: 这些概念在下一节将变得更清楚。

examples.en: But, if you are one of those looking to improve their eyesight in this way, at least you can now do so with a decidedly clearer view!
examples.zh: 但是如果你是指望用这种方式来改善视力的人之一，至少你现在有了更清楚更确切的看法：懂得看门道了！

words.definition: an arrangement of numbers, letters, or signs in rows and  column s  that you consider to be one amount, and that you use in solving mathematical problems; model, shape, former, substrate
words.translation: 矩阵；[数]矩阵；模型；[生物][地质]基质；母体；子宫；脉石

examples.en: a matrix table
examples.zh: 矩阵表

words.definition: a statement in which someone complains about something; sickness, complain of
words.translation: 诉苦, 抱怨；抱怨；诉苦；疾病；委屈

examples.en: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
examples.zh: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

examples.en: The sales assistants are trained to deal with customer complaints in a friendly manner.
examples.zh: 售货员都受过培训，要以友好的态度处理顾客的投诉。

words.definition: the time when you complete a university degree course or your education at an American  high school; scale, calibration
words.translation: 毕业典礼；毕业；[仪]刻度，[机]分度；分等级

examples.en: After graduation Neil returned to Ohio.
examples.zh: 尼尔毕业以后回到了俄亥俄州。

examples.en: On graduation (= after completing a first degree ) , Nancy became an art teacher.
examples.zh: 南希毕业以后当了一名美术老师。

words.definition: if a group of people huddle together, they stay very close to each other, especially because they are cold or frightened; gather up, cower; chaos, disorder, confusion, congestion, involvement
words.translation: 拥挤,挤作一团；蜷缩；挤作一团；拥挤；混乱；杂乱一团

examples.en: We lay huddled together for warmth.
examples.zh: 我们紧紧挤在一起取暖。

words.definition: if a plant or a flower blooms, its flowers appear or open; youth, flower, green; flower; blossom out, come into blossom
words.translation: (使)开花,(使)繁盛；[植]花；青春；旺盛；使开花；使茂盛；开花；茂盛

examples.en: The roses bloom every few days.
examples.zh: 玫瑰每隔几天开花。

examples.en: These dots were markers that enabled them to measure every change in the size and shape of the flower as it went from bud to bloom.
examples.zh: 这些点作为记号可以使他们测量到百合花从花蕾到开花过程中大小和形状的每一次变化。

words.definition: symbol, abstract, brief, summary, significant
words.translation: 摘要；缩影；[图情]摘要；象征

words.definition: a group of similar plants or animals that is smaller than a  species
words.translation: [生]亚种

examples.en: Several other subspecies of gull are found in the region.
examples.zh: 几个海鸥的其他亚种在此地区被找到。

words.definition: a small piece of paper, cloth etc; to decide not to use a plan or system because it is not practical; bit, debris, chip, fight; out of use, disaffirm; waste, dumped; quarrel, exchange words
words.translation: 碎片；废弃；[机]碎片；残余物；打架；少量；使解体；拆毁；废弃的；零碎的；吵架

examples.en: a rug made out of old scraps of material
examples.zh: 用旧零碎材料拼做的一块小地毯

words.definition: an occasion or party when you celebrate something; festival, commemoration
words.translation: 庆祝, 庆典；庆典，庆祝会；庆祝；颂扬

examples.en: the lively New Year celebrations in the city centre
examples.zh: 市中心热闹的新年庆祝活动

words.definition: a light cloud low over the ground that makes it difficult for you to see very far; gauze; fog; fog, obfuscate
words.translation: 薄雾；[气象]薄雾；视线模糊不清；模糊不清之物；下雾；变模糊；使模糊；使蒙上薄雾

examples.en: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
examples.zh: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。

examples.en: He vanished into the mist.
examples.zh: 他消失在雾中。

examples.en: The hills were shrouded in mist (= covered in mist, so that you could not see them ) .
examples.zh: 山峦笼罩在雾霭之中。

words.definition: great happiness and pleasure; pleasure, festival, fun, sweet, enjoyment; jubilate; be pleased, lift up one's head
words.translation: 欢乐, 喜悦；欢乐，快乐；乐趣；高兴；欣喜，欢喜；高兴，使快乐

examples.en: the look of joy on her face
examples.zh: 她脸上的喜悦表情

words.definition: to move, drive, or push something forward; stimulate, power
words.translation: 推进, 驱使；推进；驱使；激励；驱策

examples.en: a boat propelled by a small motor
examples.zh: 由小马达驱动的小船

examples.en: One of our students was unable to propel her wheelchair up the ramp.
examples.zh: 我们有名学生无法把她的轮椅推上坡道。

words.definition: small sticks of a white or coloured substance like soft rock, used for writing or drawing; register, formulate, programme; creta, pastille
words.translation: 粉笔；用粉笔写；用白垩粉擦；记录；规划；[轻]粉笔；[岩]白垩；用粉笔划的记号

examples.en: a box of coloured chalks
examples.zh: 一盒彩色粉笔

examples.en: a piece of chalk
examples.zh: 一支粉笔

examples.en: writing in chalk on the blackboard
examples.zh: 黑板上的粉笔字

words.definition: someone whose job is to weave cloth
words.translation: 织布者
滴石

words.definition: without any limit; limitless, interminate
words.translation: 无限的；过渡的；[数]无限制的；无限量的；无条件的

examples.en: The system can support an unlimited number of users.
examples.zh: 该系统可以支持无限多的用户。

examples.en: unlimited access to information
examples.zh: 无限制查阅资料

examples.en: The ticket offers unlimited travel on the London underground for seven days.
examples.zh: 凭本票可在七日内无限次乘坐伦敦地铁。

words.definition: someone who has to defend their own case in a law court, especially in a  divorce  case; answering; accused person, indictee
words.translation: 应答者, 被告；[医]回答的；应答的；[法]被告；应答者

examples.en: Upon receipt of a copy of the arbitration application, the respondent shall, within the time limit prescribed by the Arbitration Rules, submit its defence to the arbitration commission.
examples.zh: 被申请人收到仲裁申请书副本后，应当在仲裁规则规定的期限内向仲裁委员会提交答辩书。

words.definition: the way someone or something is described or shown in a book, film, play etc; image, figure, icon
words.translation: 描画, 描写；描绘；画像，肖像

examples.en: ...a moving portrayal of St. John the Evangelist by Simone Martini.
examples.zh: …西蒙纳·马蒂尼创作的福音传道者圣约翰的感人画像。

words.definition: to state officially and publicly that a particular situation exists or that something is true; bill, state; to announce, hand down
words.translation: 宣布，声明；断言，宣称；声明，宣布

examples.en: A state of emergency has been declared.
examples.zh: 已宣布进入紧急状态。

examples.en: Mr Steel has been declared bankrupt
examples.zh: 斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。

examples.en: We celebrate September 16, the day when Mexico declared independence from Spain (= officially stated that it was no longer ruled by Spain ) .
examples.zh: 我们在9月16日举行庆祝活动，这一天是墨西哥摆脱西班牙统治宣布独立的日子。

words.definition: a piece of hanging cloth that can be pulled across to cover a window, divide a room etc; screen, window hangings; shadow, shield
words.translation: 窗帘；幕；[建]窗帘；遮蔽；装上门帘

examples.en: red velvet curtains
examples.zh: 红色的丝绒窗帘

words.definition: a shape with six sides; sexangle
words.translation: 六角形, 六边形；[数]六角形，六边形

examples.en: He presses the bolt against a small hexagon tattooed on his forearm. The sizes match.
examples.zh: 他将螺钉与他前臂的一个小六边形纹身比了比，尺寸是一样的。

words.definition: relating to poetry, or typical of poetry; odic, melic
words.translation: 诗歌的；诗的，诗歌的；诗意的；诗人的

examples.en: poetic expression
examples.zh: 诗歌的表达方式

words.definition: not interrupted or moved; quiet, collected, contained, tranquil
words.translation: 未受干扰的；安静的；镇定的；[物]未被扰乱的；泰然自若的

examples.en: At last I was able to work undisturbed.
examples.zh: 我终于可以安安静静地工作了。

words.definition: the act of climbing something or moving upwards; rise, upgrade, raise
words.translation: 上升,提高；上升；[公路]上坡路；登高

examples.en: the first ascent of Qomolangma
examples.zh: 首次攀登珠穆朗玛峰

words.translation: [动]塔尔博特提猎狗

examples.en: The photograph was taken by William Henry Fox Talbot, the inventor of the negative / positive photographic process.
examples.zh: 这张照片是由威廉·亨利·福克斯·塔尔博特摄制，他是负片/正片摄影过程的发明者。

words.definition: a question that you ask to get information, or to check that something is true or correct; doubt, question; question, inquire about
words.translation: 质问,疑问；疑问，质问；疑问号；[计]询问；对……表示疑问；表示怀疑

examples.en: Staff are always available to answer your queries.
examples.zh: 员工随时为您解答疑问。

words.definition: to produce a strong feeling or memory in someone; earn, attract, cause, produce, occasion
words.translation: 唤起, 引起；引起，唤起；博得

examples.en: The photographs evoked strong memories of our holidays in France.
examples.zh: 那些照片勾起了我们到法国度假的深刻回忆。

examples.en: His appearance is bound to evoke sympathy.
examples.zh: 他的外表肯定会引起人们的同情。

examples.en: Her speech evoked a hostile response.
examples.zh: 她的讲话引起了敌对的反应。

words.definition: if you amass money, knowledge, information etc, you gradually collect a large amount of it; pile up, store up
words.translation: 积累，积聚；积聚，积累

examples.en: For 25 years, Darwin amassed evidence to support his theories.
examples.zh: 25年间，达尔文收集了大量证据来支持自己的理论。

examples.en: He amassed a fortune after the war.
examples.zh: 战后，他积累了大量财富。

words.definition: the process of finding out what people think about something by asking many people the same question, or the record of the result; vote, referendums; crop, cast one's vote; cast one's vote, ballot; hummel, hornless
words.translation: 民意测验, 投票；投票；民意测验；投票数；投票所；剪短；对…进行民意测验；获得选票；无角的；剪过毛的；修过枝的

examples.en: A recent poll found that 80% of Californians support the governor.
examples.zh: 最近的一项民意调查发现80%的加利福尼亚人支持州长。

examples.en: Polls indicate that education is the top issue with voters.
examples.zh: 民意调查显示，教育是选民心中的头等大事。

examples.en: Labour is ahead in the polls.
examples.zh: 工党在民意调查中处于领先地位。

words.definition: relating to the connection between two things, where one causes the other to happen or exist
words.translation: 原因的

examples.en: Rawlins stresses that it is impossible to prove a causal link between the drug and the deaths.
examples.zh: 罗林斯强调说证实毒品与死亡之间的因果关系是不可能的。

words.definition: to move smoothly and quietly, as if without effort; slippage, portamento; ebb away
words.translation: 滑行；滑翔；滑移；滑音；悄悄地走；消逝

examples.en: Waiters glide between tightly packed tables bearing trays of pasta.
examples.zh: 侍者们托着一盘盘的意大利面食在拥挤的餐桌间自如穿行。

words.translation: 金工工人

examples.en: Some scholars believe that this astrolabe was created by the prince in collaboration with an unnamed metalworker.
examples.zh: 一些学者认为，这个星盘是奥马尔王子与一位无名金属制造工匠共同制作的。

examples.en: And soon after the Blessed One had eaten the meal provided by Cunda the metalworker, a dire sickness fell upon him, even dysentery, and he suffered sharp and deadly pains.
examples.zh: 不久以后，圣尊已经吃了那个金属工人供奉的晚餐， 可怕的疾病跟随他，正是痢疾，他遭遇了剧烈和致命的痛苦。

words.definition: with many smooth twists and turns; indirect, curve, winding
words.translation: 蜿蜒的；弯曲的；迂回的

examples.en: They followed the sinuous trail deep into the mountains.
examples.zh: 他们沿着弯弯曲曲的小径进入深山。

words.definition: made of flowers or decorated with flowers or pictures of flowers; vegetable, flowery
words.translation: 花的,像花的；花的；植物的，植物群的；花似的

examples.en: a scarf with a bold floral pattern
examples.zh: 印有鲜艳花卉图案的围巾

examples.en: a pretty floral dress
examples.zh: 漂亮的印花连衣裙

examples.en: a light floral fragrance
examples.zh: 幽幽的花香

words.definition: to completely understand a fact or an idea, especially a complicated one; control, understanding, comprehension, guiding, hold; see, appreciate, noble, collar; strike, scratch
words.translation: 抓住,领会；抓住；理解；控制；领会；抓

examples.en: At that time, we did not fully grasp the significance of what had happened.
examples.zh: 当时，我们没有完全明白所发生之事的重要性。

examples.en: Some people find the idea of relativity difficult to grasp.
examples.zh: 有些人觉得相对论的概念很难理解。

words.definition: strange, unexpected, or unsuitable in a particular situation; absonant, uncoordinated
words.translation: 不协调的,不一致的；不协调的；不一致的；不和谐的

examples.en: The new theatre looks utterly incongruous in its setting.
examples.zh: 这座新剧院和周围的环境格格不入。

words.definition: to not notice something, or not see how important it is; forget, examine, survey, review, inspect; inobservancy, negligence
words.translation: 俯瞰,忽视；忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上；忽视；眺望

examples.en: It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
examples.zh: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

examples.en: Nobody could overlook the fact that box office sales were down.
examples.zh: 谁也无法忽视票房销售额在下降这个事实。

words.definition: someone who enjoys adventure; sportsman, gambler
words.translation: 冒险家；投机商人

examples.en: an adventurer travelling the world
examples.zh: 周游世界的冒险家

words.definition: to put your name or  initial s  on something, or to decorate it in your own way, to show that it belongs to you
words.translation: 个人化, 私人化

examples.en: Why not do something to personalize your office?
examples.zh: 为什么不做点什么使你的办公室有些个性呢？

words.definition: someone who lives in a house, room etc and pays rent to the person who owns it; lessee, renter; rent
words.translation: 承租人, 房客；[租赁]承租人；房客；佃户；居住者；租借（常用于被动语态）

examples.en: The desk was left by the previous tenant.
examples.zh: 书桌是上一个房客留下来的。

words.definition: plants that are herbaceous have soft stems rather than hard stems made of wood; green, leafy
words.translation: 草本植物的；[植]草本的；绿色的；叶状的

examples.en: To their surprise, Ms Sagot and Dr Stevens found that all four of the most sociable species are among those forced to use herbaceous plants, and thus to build ramshackle homes.
examples.zh: 令他们吃惊的是，萨戈女士和史蒂文斯博士发现，所有最善群居的四个种群是那些迫使运用草本植物并因此建造摇摇欲坠的巢穴的蝙蝠。

words.definition: the watery substance that carries food through a plant; energy, vitality, tunnel, spring, steam; deplete
words.translation: 树液  vt耗尽；[植]树液；精力，元气；活力；[军]坑道；使衰竭，使伤元气；挖掘以破坏基础

examples.en: The leaves, bark and sap are also common ingredients of local herbal remedies.
examples.zh: 树叶、树皮和树液也是当地草药疗法的常用药材。

words.definition: used before a plural noun to refer to the different things that belong to each separate person or thing mentioned; several, each
words.translation: 分别的, 各自的；分别的，各自的

examples.en: We all went back to our respective homes to wait for news.
examples.zh: 我们都各自回家等待消息。

examples.en: the respective roles of teachers and students
examples.zh: 教师和学生各自不同的角色

words.definition: existing at the beginning of time or the beginning of the Earth; organic, original, fundamental, ultimate, radical
words.translation: 原始的,最初的；[生物]原始的；根本的；原生的

examples.en: the primordial seas
examples.zh: 原始海洋

words.definition: to be in charge of a group of workers and check that a piece of work is done satisfactorily; police, survey

examples.zh: 第十一条，取缔不劳而获的收入。

words.definition: a passage in the ground made by an animal such as a rabbit or  fox  as a place to live; If an animal burrows into the ground or into a surface, it moves through it by making a tunnel or hole; explore, search after; to dig, tap into; residence, hole, subway, underground, accommodation
words.translation: 洞穴；挖地洞；探索，寻找；挖地洞，挖通道；住入地洞，躲藏起来；钻进某处；偎依著；挖掘，挖出；在…挖洞（或通道）；使躲入洞穴；（兔、狐等的）洞穴，地道；藏身处，住处

examples.zh: 知道向你欢呼的，那民是有福的。 耶和华阿，他们在你脸上的光里行走。

examples.zh: 扪心自问，如果你们是莱奥 梅西，你拥有惊人天赋、无数奖牌、数不尽的钱和海潮般的欢呼，你唯一的缺憾就是从那个葡萄牙佬手上抢到金靴。

words.definition: a short piece of wood, metal, or plastic that is attached to a wall or fits into a hole, used especially to hang things on or to fasten things together; to set prices, wages etc at a particular level, or set them in relation to something else; excuse, blind, stake; block, set a limit to; scud

words.definition: when you translate something, or something that has been translated; interpretation, version
words.translation: 翻译, 译文；[语][计]翻译；译文；转化；调任

examples.en: She read the letter and gave us a rough translation (= she did not translate everything exactly ) .
examples.zh: 她看了信，给我们大概翻译了一下。

examples.zh: 我只读过《包法利夫人》的翻译本。

words.definition: thick thread made of cotton or wool, which is used to knit things; relation, story, tale, narrative; tell a story

words.definition: to walk slowly across or around an area, usually without a clear direction or purpose; lose oneself, hang about; range, louse around

examples.zh: 她漫无目的地在房子里走来走去。

examples.en: He has found his ideal mate.
examples.zh: 他已经找到了理想的配偶。

words.translation: 微生物的,  由细菌引起的

examples.zh: ...这个火星上是否存在或曾经存在过微生物的问题。

examples.zh: 细菌感染现在每年杀死1700万人。

examples.zh: 军队将不得不干预以阻止进一步的战斗。

examples.zh: 我记得当《侏罗纪公园》出现的时候，一个微生物学家朋友不断的告诉我这影片太奇异了，但是在几年之内，他说影片中的科技到底还有多久才能实现很令人感兴趣。

examples.zh: 自1892年以来科学家一直在争论这个(病毒是死是活的）问题。 当时俄罗斯微生物学家德米特里｀伊凡诺夫斯基报告说烟草中的一种病通过比细菌还要小的东西传播。

examples.zh: 大约六分之一的儿童承认吸毒。

examples.zh: 如今在电视上看到的尽是性和暴力。

examples.zh: 零售价在500美元左右。

examples.zh: 1月份零售额下降了1.3%。

words.translation: 日本；[轻]漆器；[涂料]日本亮漆

examples.zh: 我来把它用微波炉热一热。

examples.zh: 我们驯养狗来帮助我们打猎。

examples.zh: 关于是否有自由意志的哲学问题

examples.zh: 哲学争论

examples.zh: 他被一个自称是百万富翁之子的年轻人骗了。

words.translation: 有审美能力地

words.translation: 人类学；[人类]人类学

words.translation: 拆卸,使分开；分离；派遣；使超然

examples.en: Please detach and fill out the application form.
examples.zh: 请撕下申请表并填好。

words.definition: of or concerned with the mechanical properties of fluids; waterpower
words.translation: 水力的；[流]流体动力学的

examples.en: A second type of thermal escape is far more dramatic. This form of thermal escape is called hydrodynamic escape or, more evocatively, the planetary wind.
examples.zh: 热逸过程的第二种情形更为奇特，可称为流体力学逃逸（hydrodynamic escape），用通俗一些的话说，叫做“行星风”（以便和“太阳风”呼应）。

examples.en: Evolution of stars of all masses takes place on a hydrodynamic time scale .
examples.zh: 各种质量的恒星的演化，均以流体力学的时间尺度进行。

examples.en: It was theorized with a high degree of probability that the change in period was due to the nonlinearity of the hydrodynamic pressure acting on the upstream face of the dam.
examples.zh: 据推论最大可能性是在那一时间段非线性水压作用于坝体上游面所造成的差别。

words.definition: the land along the edge of a large area of water such as an ocean or lake; coastline, sea line
words.translation: 海岸线；[海洋]海岸线；海岸线地带

examples.en: the bay’s 13,000 km of shoreline
examples.zh: 这个海湾 1.3 万公里的海岸线

words.definition: a plant similar to grass that grows in wet ground and on the edge of rivers and lakes
words.translation: [植]莎草

examples.en: Victims have ranged from the great auk and the lynx to the humble blue stag beetle and Davall's sedge.
examples.zh: 受害者从大型海雀、猞猁到不值一提的蓝色鹿角虫和Davall's莎草。

examples.en: So the sedge which lines the banks knows hardly any disturbance until the fishermen come with their nets.
examples.zh: 连两岸的莎草没有带着渔网前来的渔夫的打搅也几乎从不摇摆。

examples.en: The rain and mist can't mask the funky rot. Pink and chum salmon carcasses lie tangled in linguine strands of tidal sedge.
examples.zh: 薄薄的雨雾并不能遮盖腐臭的味道，粉红色大马哈鱼的尸体杂乱地缠绕在一缕缕潮汐冲来的莎草中。

words.definition: too much or too little in relation to something else
words.translation: 不成比例的

examples.en: the disproportionate amount of money being spent on defence
examples.zh: 比例失衡的国防开支

words.definition: a vehicle or ship specially built to carry large quantities of gas or liquid, especially oil
words.translation: 油轮

examples.en: A Greek oil tanker has run aground.
examples.zh: 一艘希腊油轮已经搁浅了。

words.definition: Someone's lament is an expression of their sadness, regret, or disappointment about something; keen, elegy; grieve over, mourn over; regret, grieve over
words.translation: 悲伤v哀悼；挽歌；恸哭；悲痛之情；哀悼；悲叹；悔恨；痛惜

examples.en: She spoke of the professional woman's lament that a woman's judgment is questioned more than a man's.
examples.zh: 她谈到职业女性的悲哀，即女性的判断会比男性的遭到更多的置疑。

words.definition: organically, methodically
words.translation: 有系统地, 有条理地；有系统地；有组织地

examples.en: Rumours of possible human cases in other parts of the country have been systematically followed up.
examples.zh: 已系统地对关于该国其它地区可能的人间病例的传闻进行跟踪。

examples.en: Never before has anyone systematically looked for the last queen of Egypt.
examples.zh: 以前没有人曾系统地寻找过这位埃及最后的女王。

words.definition: the desire to know about something; treasure, pearl
words.translation: 好奇心；好奇，好奇心；珍品，古董，古玩

examples.en: I opened the packet just to satisfy my curiosity .
examples.zh: 我打开包裹只是为了满足我的好奇心。

examples.en: The news aroused a lot of curiosity among local people.
examples.zh: 这条消息在当地人中间引起了很大的好奇心。

examples.en: She decided to follow him out of curiosity .
examples.zh: 她出于好奇决定跟踪他。

words.definition: You use ancestral to refer to a person's family in former times, especially when the family is important and has property or land that they have had for a long time; patrimonial
words.translation: 祖先的；[生物]祖先的；[遗]祖传的

examples.en: ...the family's ancestral home in southern Germany.
examples.zh: …这一家在德国南部的祖宅。

words.definition: to start doing something again after stopping or being interrupted; bio, abstract, brief, summary, record; recover, start over
words.translation: (中断后)继续 n摘要；简历；[管理]履历；个人简历；摘要；重新开始；重新获得

examples.en: She hopes to resume work after the baby is born.
examples.zh: 她想生完孩子后继续工作。

examples.en: The rebels have resumed hostilities against government troops.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子继续与政府军发生冲突。

words.definition: someone who is eligible for something is able or allowed to do it, for example because they are the right age; qualified, applicable, becoming, shaped, likely; acceptee
words.translation: 有资格的, 合适的；合格的，合适的；符合条件的；有资格当选的；合格者；适任者；有资格者

examples.en: Stephen was regarded as an eligible bachelor.
examples.zh: 斯蒂芬被认为是一个钻石王老五。

words.definition: completely and in every way; totally, entirely, completely, thoroughly, strictly, fully
words.translation: 完全地, 绝对地；绝对地；完全地

examples.en: He made his reasons for resigning absolutely clear.
examples.zh: 他把辞职的理由讲得一清二楚。

examples.en: Are you absolutely sure?
examples.zh: 你绝对肯定吗？

examples.en: This cake is absolutely delicious.
examples.zh: 这蛋糕好吃极了。

words.definition: a member of the Senate or a senate; commissioner, councilor
words.translation: 参议员；（古罗马的）元老院议员；评议员，理事

examples.en: Senator Kennedy
examples.zh: 肯尼迪参议员

words.definition: a farm animal with short legs, a fat body and a curved tail. Pigs are kept for their meat, which includes  pork  ,  bacon  and  ham  .; police, copper, swine, pork
words.translation: 猪；猪肉；警察

examples.en: He kept pigs and poultry.
examples.zh: 他养过猪和家禽。

words.definition: You can describe something or someone as a marvel to indicate that you think that they are wonderful; phenomenon, miracle, wonder
words.translation: 令人惊奇的事物(或人物)；奇迹

examples.en: The whale, like the dolphin, has become a symbol of the marvels of creation.
examples.zh: 鲸，和海豚一样，已经成为造物杰作的象征。

words.definition: frightened because you think that you may get hurt or that something bad may happen; worried, scared
words.translation: 害怕的；恐怕；担心的

examples.en: There’s no need to be afraid.
examples.zh: 没有必要害怕。

words.definition: the wide part of a river where it goes into the sea; kuala, river mouth
words.translation: 河口, 江口；[地理][水文]河口；江口

examples.en: the Thames estuary
examples.zh: 泰晤士河河口

words.definition: relating to or caused by  earthquakes
words.translation: [地]地震的

examples.en: increased seismic activity
examples.zh: 越来越频繁的地震活动

words.definition: the distance from the centre to the edge of a circle, or a line drawn from the centre to the edge; semidiameter
words.translation: 半径（范围）；[数]半径，半径范围；[解剖]桡骨；辐射光线；有效航程

examples.en: The shock of the explosion was felt over a radius of forty miles.
examples.zh: 爆炸引起的剧烈震动在方圆40英里内都能感觉得到。

words.definition: the act of moving an army, weapons etc away from the area where they were fighting; cancellation, pullback
words.translation: 收回, 撤退；[军]撤退，收回；[金融]提款；取消；退股

examples.en: large-scale troop withdrawals
examples.zh: 大规模撤军

words.definition: a piece of wood or coal that stays red and very hot after a fire has stopped burning; ash
words.translation: 灰烬, 余烬；灰烬，余烬

examples.en: glowing embers
examples.zh: 发光的余烬

words.definition: to start something, usually something big or important; release, send, project, drive, let go; proceed, start in; emission, shot, sending, projection, loose
words.translation: 发射；[航]发射（导弹、火箭等）；发起，发动；使…下水；开始；下水；起飞；[航]发射；发行，投放市场；汽艇

examples.en: The organization has launched a campaign to raise $150,000.
examples.zh: 为了筹集15万美元，该组织发起了一场募捐活动。

examples.en: The Canadian police plan to launch an investigation into the deal.
examples.zh: 加拿大警方计划对这宗交易进行调查。

examples.en: The book launched his career as a novelist.
examples.zh: 这本书开启了他的小说创作生涯。

words.definition: a type of grain that is grown in tropical areas; durra, broomcorn
words.translation: [植]高粱属的植物；[作物]高粱；蜀黍；甜得发腻的东西

examples.en: But some plants, including maize and sorghum, have evolved to use a type called C4.
examples.zh: 但是一些植物，包括玉米和高粱，进化成了使用C4型的光合作用。

words.translation: 古生态学家

words.definition: original, major, central, premier, leading; deliver, free, unhold
words.translation: 最初的；原始的；主要的；释放（被压抑的童年情绪）

examples.en: Yet some of the most radical ideas about our primal urges have been harnessed by those who want everyone to drink the same brand of beer.
examples.zh: 然而，那些恨不得人人都喝同一品牌啤酒的守旧派们，则给人类原始冲动中的某些最本质的欲望，套上了枷锁。

words.definition: a regulatory authority has the official power to control an activity and to make sure that it is done in a satisfactory way; administrative, managing, guiding
words.translation: 管理的, 控制的；管理的；控制的；调整的

examples.en: Partially, that has to do with our regulatory framework, which is built on the idea that medicine is all about disease.
examples.zh: 部分原因跟我们的监管架构有关。 这个架构建立在药物全是用来治病的理念之下。

words.translation: 同位素的,合痕的

examples.en: The variations in isotopic ratios take place on the right time scale, and they mirror those seen in modern corals, he notes.
examples.zh: 他说，同位素比例变化所发生的时间范围恰到好处，这与在现代珊瑚中的发现保持了一致。

examples.en: While initial research was aimed at looking at seasonal variations in diet, the isotopic tests pointed them instead to apparent gender variations.
examples.zh: 虽然初始的研究是为了确定其食物随季节的变化，同位素测试让他们发现了明显的性别差异。

examples.en: Magma rising from deep within the Earth has a different isotopic and chemical composition than magma that forms just below Earth's crust.
examples.zh: 从地球深处所喷出的岩浆与仅低于地壳表面所形成的岩浆有着了不同的同位素和化学成分。

words.definition: the sailor in charge of a ship, or the pilot in charge of an aircraft; leader, chief, boss, officer; officer, boss, lead
words.translation: 首领, 船长；队长，首领；[水运]船长；上尉；海军上校；指挥；率领

examples.en: The captain and crew welcome you aboard.
examples.zh: 机长和全体机组人员欢迎各位乘坐本次航班。

words.definition: the process of making a road, building etc bigger or longer, or the part that is added; delay, spread
words.translation: 延长, 扩充；延长；[经]延期；扩大；伸展；电话分机

examples.en: We are thinking of having an extension built, as we now require an extra bedroom.
examples.zh: 我们正在考虑扩建房屋，因为我们现在需要多一间卧室。

words.definition: someone’s ultimate aim is their main and most important aim, that they hope to achieve in the future; final, organic, fundamental, radical, underlying; telos, fundamental principle
words.translation: 最后的, 最终的n终极(限)；最终的；[物]极限的；根本的；终极；根本；基本原则

examples.en: The ultimate outcome of the experiment cannot be predicted.
examples.zh: 试验的最后结果无法预测。

words.definition: to not include someone or something, either deliberately or because you forget to do it; understand, elide
words.translation: 省略,遗漏；[数]省略；遗漏；删除；疏忽

examples.en: Please don’t omit any details, no matter how trivial they may seem.
examples.zh: 请不要忽略任何细节，不管它多细小。

words.definition: if something is applicable to a particular person, group, or situation, it affects them or is related to them; becoming, shaped, likely, possible, meet
words.translation: 合适的, 适用的,；[药]可适用的；可应用的；合适的

examples.en: What is a reasonable standard for one family is not applicable for another.
examples.zh: 对一个家庭合理的标准对于另一个家庭并不适用。

words.definition: a storm with strong winds and a lot of snow; blizzard, stormy weather
words.translation: 暴风雪；[气象]雪暴

examples.en: The snowstorm added to our difficulties.
examples.zh: 暴风雪增加了我们的困难。

examples.en: From beneath, it was at times like gazing into a snowstorm. It was hard not to think of souls.
examples.zh: 从下面往上看时，就像在暴风雪中抬头看到的一样，让人不禁想起了逝去的那些亡灵。

examples.en: I step outside the house and nothing can stop me—the late season snowstorm, the puddle of standing water at the bottom of my porch steps that will never evaporate, the mud and muck this season brings.
examples.zh: 我踏出家门，没有任何事情能阻挡我——深冬季节的暴风雪、我家门廊台阶上那永远挥散不去的雨水坑，还有这个季节带来的烂泥和污秽。

words.translation: 麦当劳快餐店

words.definition: movement or the ability to move; movement, removal, exercise, sport, campaign
words.translation: 运动, 移动；运动；移动；旅行

examples.en: Flight is the form of locomotion that puts the greatest demands on muscles.
examples.zh: 飞行是对肌肉要求最高的运动形式。

words.definition: convincingly, conceivably
words.translation: 有说服力的；令人信服地；口才好地

words.definition: (of a room, house, etc) suitable for living in; liveable, inhabitable
words.translation: 适于居住的；生活过得有价值的

examples.en: “The goal should be to make the villages livable, ” he said.
examples.zh: 他说，“这个目标应该是使村庄适宜居住。

examples.en: In many neighborhoods, someone forgot to plan for that basic building block of livable cities, the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 在许多社区，有人竟然忘记为这些适宜居住的城市修建基础设施——人行道。

words.definition: a woman or child who is pretty has a nice attractive face; lovely, taking, smart, cute, tony; relatively, fairly, comparatively, reasonably, considerably
words.translation: 漂亮的, 可爱的；漂亮的；可爱的；优美的；相当地；颇

examples.en: a pretty little girl
examples.zh: 漂亮的小姑娘

examples.en: Maria looks much prettier with her hair cut short.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚把头发剪短好看多了。

words.definition: a coin of the US and Canada, worth one tenth of a dollar
words.translation: <美> 一角硬币

examples.en: Filling stations have whacked as much as a dime off their regular prices.
examples.zh: 加油站已经把正常价格降了一角银币。

words.definition: to make a formal statement of what is true, especially in a court of law; demonstrate, prove, favor, make sure, argue; seal of, give evidence of
words.translation: 证明, 证实；证明，证实；作证；证明

examples.en: Mr Molto has agreed to testify at the trial.
examples.zh: 莫尔托先生已经同意出庭作证。

examples.en: Can you testify that you saw the defendant at the scene of the crime?
examples.zh: 你能作证你看到被告在犯罪现场吗？

words.definition: far from the centre of a city, town etc or from a main building; unrelated, irrespective
words.translation: 远离中心的，偏僻的；边远的；无关的

examples.en: one of the outlying suburbs
examples.zh: 边远郊区之一

words.definition: the standard unit of money in the US, Canada, Australia, and some other countries, divided into 100  cent s  : symbol $; peso
words.translation: 元, 美元；美元

examples.en: It cost three dollars.
examples.zh: 它要三美元。

examples.en: a ten-dollar bill
examples.zh: 一张十元钞票

examples.en: You can pay in dollars or euros at the airport.
examples.zh: 在机场你可以使用美元或欧元。

words.definition: a cover for the open part of a pot, box, or other container; limitation, qualification, restriction, cover
words.translation: 盖子,vt给盖盖子；盖子；眼睑；限制

examples.en: She lifted the lid of the box and displayed the contents.
examples.zh: 她把盒盖掀起，展示了里边的东西。

words.definition: a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people; franchise, peculiar
words.translation: 特权，优惠；[计]特权；优待；基本权利

examples.en: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
examples.zh: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

words.translation: 行为性的,  行为学的

examples.en: At Agile 2006, she examined the cooperative behavior of Bonobo apes from an ethological perspective and spoke about how “natural” the cooperative aspects of Agile are.
examples.zh: 在Agile2006上，她从动物行为学的角度分析了Bonobo大猩猩的合作行为，并说明了敏捷的合作性是多么“自然”。

examples.en: At Agile 2006, she examined the cooperative behavior of Bonobo apes from an ethological perspective and spoke about how "natural" the cooperative aspects of Agile are.
examples.zh: 在2006年的敏捷开发大会上，她从行为学的角度详细分析了倭黑猩猩的合作行为，谈到敏捷开发在合作方面是多么的“自然”。

examples.en: The harmony between dog and dog-handler is achieved through the best possible use of ethological and empirical knowledge and correctly structuring the social relationship between man and dog.
examples.zh: 狗与狗之间的处理程序和谐是通过行为学和最好的经验知识和正确的结构可能使用人与狗之间的社会关系。

words.definition: destruction, breaking, blasting, demolition
words.translation: 分裂；破坏，毁坏；分裂，瓦解

examples.en: He could draw men round him and keep them bound to him; while his powerful attraction was there, disruption was out of the question.
examples.zh: 他能够把人们吸引到他的周围而且保持他们的忠心；而他的强大吸引力所在之处，就不可能有分裂。

words.definition: the condition of only just having enough money or food to stay alive; life, existence, presence, entity, living
words.translation: 生存, 生活, 留存；生活；生存；存在

examples.en: Many of the families are forced to live at the subsistence level.
examples.zh: 很多家庭被迫生活在基本生活水准线上。

examples.en: The land provided subsistence and little more.
examples.zh: 这块土地只能提供人们的基本生活所需，别无富余。

words.definition: in spite of something; still, toujours; in spite of, in despite of; although, while, though, as, albeit
words.translation: ／ ad尽管；尽管，仍然；尽管，虽然；虽然

examples.en: Notwithstanding differences, there are clear similarities in all of the world’s religions.
examples.zh: 世界上的宗教尽管各不相同，但都有明显的相似之处。

examples.en: Fame and fortune notwithstanding, Donna never forgot her hometown.
examples.zh: 尽管名利双收，但唐娜从未忘记自己的家乡。

words.definition: the season between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes cooler; fall, maturation phase; fall
words.translation: 秋天；成熟期；渐衰期，凋落期；秋天的，[天]秋季的

examples.en: autumn mists
examples.zh: 秋天的雾霭

words.definition: shear, crop; shear, trim off; shear, cutting back
words.translation: 夹子 vt夹住；[园艺]修剪；夹牢；痛打；夹子；回形针

examples.en: The wire is held on with a metal clip.
examples.zh: 电线用金属夹子固定。

words.definition: an influence that makes something happen or makes it happen more quickly; momentum, promotion, acceleration
words.translation: 推动力, 促进；动力；促进；冲力

examples.en: The discovery gave fresh impetus to the research.
examples.zh: 这个发现为研究带来新动力。

words.definition: A grower is a person who grows large quantities of a particular plant or crop in order to sell them; cultivator, raiser
words.translation: 种植者，栽培者；栽培者；生长物

examples.en: The state's apple growers are fighting an uphill battle against foreign competition.
examples.zh: 该州的苹果种植者们正在与外来竞争进行艰难的抗争。

words.definition: The sophistication of people, places, machines, or methods is their quality of being sophisticated; complexity, intricacy
words.translation: 老练, 精明；复杂；诡辩；老于世故；有教养

examples.en: It would take many decades to build up the level of education and sophistication required.
examples.zh: 要花好几十年的时间来逐步达到所需要的教育和发展水平。

words.definition: providing a lot of useful information; beneficial, helpful, useful, conducive, advantageous
words.translation: 有益的, 教育性的；有益的；教育性的

examples.en: Thank you, that was very instructive.
examples.zh: 谢谢，这很有启发性。

examples.en: an instructive comparison
examples.zh: 有启发性的比较

words.definition: manual work involves using your hands or your physical strength rather than your mind; handmade, mechanic; guide, handbook, notebook
words.translation: 手工的 n手册,指南；手工的；体力的；手册，指南

examples.en: People in manual occupations have a lower life expectancy.
examples.zh: 干体力活的人预期寿命较短。

words.definition: ordinary and not interesting or exciting; ordinary, lay, universal, international, stock
words.translation: 平凡的, 世俗的；世俗的，平凡的；世界的，宇宙的

examples.en: Initially, the work was pretty mundane.
examples.zh: 刚开始，这工作非常乏味。

examples.en: The mundane task of setting the table can be fun on holidays.
examples.zh: 摆放餐具这种无趣的事情在假日里也会变得有意思起来。

words.definition: A raindrop is a single drop of rain; drip-drop
words.translation: 雨滴, 雨点；[气象]雨滴；雨点

examples.en: If I were a raindrop ...
examples.zh: 如果我是雨滴的话...

words.definition: to arrange figures or information together in a set or a list, so that they can be easily compared; surface
words.translation: 把制成表格；使成平面；把…制成表格

examples.en: Results for the test programme haven't been tabulated.
examples.zh: 试验项目的结果还没有制成表格。

words.definition: to make someone happy or satisfied; glad, satisfy; ace in; prithee
words.translation: 请 v使高兴；使喜欢；使高兴，使满意；讨人喜欢；令人高兴；请（礼貌用语）

examples.en: a business that wants to please its customers
examples.zh: 希望让顾客满意的一家公司

examples.en: She did everything she could to please him.
examples.zh: 她千方百计讨好他。

examples.en: Most children are eager to please .
examples.zh: 大多数孩子都渴望取悦别人。

words.definition: particularly, inimitably
words.translation: adv独特地, 唯一地；独特地；珍奇地

words.definition: a tree with smooth  bark (=  outer covering  )  and thin branches, or the wood from this tree; brich
words.translation: 桦树, 白桦；桦木；桦树；桦条

examples.en: In Finland purists insist that only birch bark should be added.
examples.zh: 在芬兰，纯化论者坚持说只能加白桦树皮。

examples.en: After a lovely stretch running right along the edge of Lake Baikal we moved away from birch and pine tree territory into lusher pastures.
examples.zh: 在沿着贝加尔湖的一段美妙行程之后，我们离开了桦树和松树的地域，进入了令人迷醉的大草原。

examples.en: This also explains why some migrants from east Asia to northern Europe suddenly develop an allergic reaction to jackfruit once they have come into contact with birch pollen.
examples.zh: 这也解释了为什么来自东亚的某些移民，到了北欧后，一旦接触到桦树花粉，会突然出现菠萝蜜过敏反应的现象。

words.definition: flexibility, fitness, applicability
words.translation: 适应性；可变性；适合性

examples.en: You can achieve greater flexibility, adaptability, and independence when each layer is only loosely coupled to the layer above and below.
examples.zh: 当每个层仅松散耦合到其上和其下的层时，您可以实现更强的灵活性、适应性和独立性。

examples.en: We hope that positive social mechanisms that are conducive to human adaptability will play an ever more effective role in meeting the challenges of the future.
examples.zh: 我们寄希望于积极的社会机制，以期有助于人类更加适应自然，对未来的挑战扮演一个更加积极有效的角色。

words.definition: to make a great effort to achieve something; apply oneself, struggle, labor
words.translation: 努力, 奋斗；努力；奋斗；抗争

examples.en: He strives hard to keep himself very fit.
examples.zh: 他努力使自己保持非常的健康。

words.definition: relating to the quality or standard of something rather than the quantity
words.translation: 性质上的, 定性的

examples.en: There are qualitative differences in the way children of different ages and adults think.
examples.zh: 不同年龄的儿童和成人在思维方式上有着质的差异。

words.definition: the basic unit for measuring weight in the  metric system; garbanzo, chick-pea
words.translation: 克；鹰嘴豆（用作饲料）

examples.en: Then they chose one gram for weighing water in a cubic centimetre.
examples.zh: 然后他们将一立方厘米的水的重量定为一克。

examples.en: Theanalysis module can process up to one gram of flowing sample per minute.
examples.zh: 这种分析模块可以在每分钟内处理一克流体的样本。

examples.en: One of them combines lithium manganese oxide with other ions, and operates at about three to five volts with a charge capacity of 200 milliamp hours per gram.
examples.zh: 平面能源正在研发三种不同的电池化学配方。 其中之一是把锂锰氧化物与其他离子化合，充电电压三到五伏，容量200毫安时每克。

words.definition: a prohibitive rule prevents people from doing things; inhibitory, verboten
words.translation: 禁止的, 抑制的；禁止的，禁止性的；抑制的；（费用，价格等）过高的；类同禁止的

examples.en: prohibitive regulations
examples.zh: 禁律

words.definition: someone who looks for gold, minerals, oil etc
words.translation: 探勘者, 采矿者

examples.en: Although he failed as a prospector, he succeeded as a journalist.
examples.zh: 他作为采矿者遭遇失败，但作为记者大获成功。

examples.en: The man, of Asian descent, wearing the clothes of a low-level prospector, seemed to be quite intrigued by what was going on inside.
examples.zh: 一个亚洲血统的男人，穿着初级勘探者的制服站在窗外，似乎对这里面的情况很感兴趣。

words.definition: a difference between two statements, beliefs, or ideas about something that means they cannot both be true; conflict, discrepancy
words.translation: 反驳, 矛盾；[数]矛盾；否认；反驳

examples.en: apparent contradictions in the defendant’s testimony
examples.zh: 被告证词中的明显矛盾

words.definition: the part of a theatre where people sit when watching a play, concert etc; assembly hall, assembly room
words.translation: 听众席,观众席,；礼堂，会堂；[建]观众席

examples.en: Anderson was to sing at the Constitution Hall auditorium.
examples.zh: 安德森将要在宪法厅的观众席演唱。

words.definition: something that you say when you express an opinion or say what you have noticed; regard, notice, publicity; observe on, to comment on; talk of, discourse
words.translation: 备注,评论 vt评论；注意；言辞；评论；觉察；谈论

examples.en: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
examples.zh: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

words.definition: when you learn something by repeating it many times, without thinking about it carefully or without understanding it; rotte
words.translation: 死记硬背；生搬硬套

examples.en: In old-fashioned schools, much learning was by rote .
examples.zh: 在旧式学校里，很多学习都是靠死记硬背。

examples.en: the rote learning of facts
examples.zh: 对资料的死记硬背

words.definition: the largest type of ship used in war, with very big guns and heavy  armour
words.translation: 战舰

examples.en: A new battleship was launched from a shipyard.
examples.zh: 一艘新战舰从船坞下水。

examples.en: The new battleship shall be armed with 16-inch guns.
examples.zh: 新战舰将以16英寸口径的大炮武装起来。

words.definition: a government, especially one that was not elected fairly or that you disapprove of for some other reason; government, power
words.translation: 政权制度,政权；政权，政体；社会制度；管理体制

examples.en: The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
examples.zh: 该政权清除了大多数反对者。

words.definition: scepticism
words.translation: 怀疑论；怀疑的态度

examples.en: I know there are those who don’t believe we can do all these things. I understand the skepticism.
examples.zh: 我知道有些人不相信我们可以完成所有这些事情，我理解他们所持的怀疑态度。

examples.en: Therefore, I do not think we should go in for complete skepticism, but for a doctrine of degrees of probability.
examples.zh: 因而我绝不认为我们应当赞成彻底的怀疑主义，而是赞成可能性程度的学说。

examples.en: I understand that skepticism, which is why this recovery plan must and will include unprecedented measures that will allow the American people to hold my Administration accountable for these results.
examples.zh: 我理解这些怀疑，这也是为什么复苏计划一定要包括这些前所未有的措施，即将会允许美国人民要我的政府对这些计划的结果负责。

words.definition: someone who studies the way in which money and goods are produced and used and the systems of business and trade; saver
words.translation: 经济学者；[经]经济学者；节俭的人

examples.en: Do you have some hints for me, how to become a good economist?
examples.zh: 如何成为一名好的经济学家，你有什么给我的提示吗？

examples.en: You know, Gordon, I should not like you. You are Scottish, we have nothing in common and you are an economist.
examples.zh: 你知道吗，戈登，我不应该喜欢你，你是苏格兰人，又是个经济学家，我们没有任何共同的地方。

words.definition: act, ordinance
words.translation: 戒律；法令

examples.en: So you would not break the third commandment.
examples.zh: 那么你就不会违反第三条戒律。

examples.en: A friend of mine applied this commandment in his own life, with great success.
examples.zh: 我的一位朋友在自己的生活中应用了这个戒律，而且大获成功。

words.definition: If you get a glimpse of someone or something, you see them very briefly and not very well; glance, dekko; catch sight of
words.translation: 一瞥v瞥见；一瞥，一看；瞥见

examples.en: Some of the fans had waited 24 hours outside the hotel to catch a glimpse of their heroine.
examples.zh: 某些追星族为了一睹女杰的风采已在宾馆外守候了24小时。

words.definition: better or more suitable; Mair
words.translation: 更好的,更合意的；更好的，更可取的；更合意的

examples.en: For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
examples.zh: 做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。

examples.en: In warm weather, clothes made of natural fabrics are infinitely preferable (= much better ) .
examples.zh: 天气暖和的时候，穿天然织物的衣服要舒适得多。

words.definition: to describe or draw something carefully so that people can understand it; represent, trace, picture, figure
words.translation: 描绘；描写；画…的轮廓

examples.en: The document delineates your rights and your obligations.
examples.zh: 这份文件阐明了你的权利和义务。

words.definition: land that is rugged is rough and uneven; crude, rough, harsh, coarse
words.translation: 高低不平的, 崎岖的；崎岖的；坚固的；高低不平的；粗糙的

examples.en: a rugged coastline
examples.zh: 崎岖不平的海岸线

examples.en: the rugged beauty of the Highlands
examples.zh: 苏格兰高地崎岖起伏的美景

words.definition: the object or idea to which a word or phrase refers; indicant
words.translation: 指示物；指示对象

words.definition: insufficiency, impropriety
words.translation: 不充分；不适当，不充分；不完全；不十分

words.definition: A gypsy is a member of a race of people who travel from place to place, usually in caravans, rather than living in one place. Some people find this word offensive.; Gippy, diddy; vagabondize, stray
words.translation: 吉普赛人(的),吉普赛语（的）；吉卜赛人；吉卜赛语；像吉布赛的人；歌舞剧中的歌舞队员；流浪

examples.en: I'm proud of being brought up by gypsies.
examples.zh: 我为自己是吉卜赛人抚养长大的而感到自豪。

words.definition: a mass of gravel, sand, etc, carried and deposited by the water derived from melting glaciers; ablation
words.translation: [地质]冰水沉积；消融，冲蚀

examples.en: This landslide deposit pretty much rules out the idea that the deposits farther upstream are glacial outwash.
examples.zh: 这个滑坡沉积物大可以排除远离上游的沉积物是冰川沉积的想法。

examples.en: Sometimes the animal multitudes are horizontal, as on Salisbury Plain, a glacial outwash delta densely colonized by king penguins, fur and elephant seals, and kelp gulls.
examples.zh: 有些地方动物种群是水平分布的，比如在索尔兹伯里平原，这块冰碛沉积三角洲密集分布着王企鹅、软毛海豹、象海豹和黑背海鸥。

examples.en: Hmm. At the time our colleague suggested that maybe these were delta deposits or possibly glacial outwash (although we don’t know the extent of past glaciations in the park).
examples.zh: 嗯，当时我们同事建议这些可能是三角洲沉淀或者可能是冰川沉积时（尽管我们不知道这个公园里冰期的程度）。

words.definition: if something, especially something made of stone or rock, is crumbling, small pieces are breaking off it; fall apart at the seams, come apart; fall apart at the seams, go to pieces
words.translation: 弄碎,崩溃；崩溃；破碎，粉碎；弄碎，粉碎

examples.en: The old stonework was crumbling away.
examples.zh: 古老的石筑部分逐渐崩塌。

examples.en: crumbling colonial buildings
examples.zh: 逐渐坍塌的殖民时期建筑

words.definition: a feeling of not being satisfied; grievance, disaffection
words.translation: 不满；令人不满的事物

examples.en: She has already expressed her dissatisfaction with this aspect of the policy.
examples.zh: 她已对政策的这方面表示了不满。

words.definition: stroke, dong; mountaintop, hillcrest
words.translation: 敲击；打碎，敲击；猛咬；山顶，丘顶
玄武岩的

examples.en: Frantz Josef Land is a basaltic plateau split into many islands and covered with ice.
examples.zh: 法兰仕约瑟夫地的群岛是由一个玄武岩高原分裂而成的，终年覆盖着冰雪。

examples.en: In this image streaks of dark basaltic sand have been carried frombelow the ice layer to form fan-shaped deposits on top of the seasonalice.
examples.zh: 在这幅图像中黑色玄武岩沙带被从冰层下面显露出来，在季节性冰盖的顶部形成扇形堆积。

examples.en: Researchers have found the deposits contain opaline silica and iron sulfates, which you would expect to find if acidic water once flowed over basaltic materials in low temperatures.
examples.zh: 研究人员发现，这些沉积物中含有乳白石英和铁硫酸盐，而这些东西只出现在低温状态下被酸性水侵蚀的玄武岩地区。

words.definition: a large area of flat land that is higher than the land around it; altiplano, high land; level out
words.translation: 高地, 高原；[地理]高原；稳定水平；托盘；平顶女帽；达到平衡；达到稳定时期

examples.en: A broad valley opened up leading to a high, flat plateau of cultivated land.
examples.zh: 一个宽阔的山谷展开，通向一片平坦的高原耕地。

words.definition: (of a compound) containing carbon, esp tetravalent carbon
words.translation: (含)碳的

examples.en: Should the carbon dioxide mix with water underground and form carbonic acid, they say, it could leach poisonous materials from rock deep underground that could then seep out.
examples.zh: 他们说，一旦二氧化碳与地下水融合极易形成碳酸，而这会把地下岩石中的有毒物质分解出来，从而污染我们的水资源。

examples.en: A new mathematical analysis solves a longstanding cave-formation puzzle: how a trickle of water laced with carbonic acid manages to quickly dissolve rock to create massive conduits.
examples.zh: 一个全新的数学分析方法解决了一个长期存在的洞穴形成难题：含有碳酸的一股细流如何快速溶解石头从而产生了大量的通道。

words.definition: continuing for a long time, often too long; farflung, redundant
words.translation: 冗长的；漫长的，冗长的；啰唆的

examples.en: A lengthy period of training is required.
examples.zh: 需要很长一段时间的培训。

examples.en: An accident is causing some lengthy delays.
examples.zh: 一起事故造成长时间的延误。

words.definition: if two lines or roads intersect, they meet or go across each other; cross, cut; transect, cross cut
words.translation: 贯穿, 交叉；相交，交叉；横断，横切；贯穿

examples.en: So tell me about. You have done music, where do these things intersect for you?
examples.zh: 那么，你已经做过音乐和，艺术，这些事情的交叉点在哪里呢？

words.definition: a work of art, a piece of writing or music etc that is of very high quality or that is the best that a particular artist, writer etc has produced; chef-d'oeuvre, magnum opus
words.translation: 杰作, 名著；杰作；绝无仅有的人

examples.en: Mary Shelley was just 18 when she wrote the horror masterpiece ‘Frankenstein’.
examples.zh: 玛丽•雪莱创作《科学怪人》这部恐怖小说名作的时候年仅18岁。

words.translation: 耶鲁

examples.en: What is the endowment of Yale?
examples.zh: 耶鲁的捐赠基金是什么？

examples.en: Although, through these three presidents, I understand that the quality of Yale graduates is not so even.
examples.zh: 但是透过这三位总统我也明白了，耶鲁大学的毕业生的水准也并不很平均。

examples.en: Ray Fair, my colleague at Yale, for one, warns that any trend up or down may suddenly be reversed if there is an economic “regime change” — a shift big enough to make people change their thinking.
examples.zh: 我在耶鲁大学的同事雷．费尔警告说，任何向上或向下的趋势可能会突然发生逆转，如果是经济的“政权更替”一个足够大的改变可使人们改变他们的想法。

words.definition: a very tall tree that grows in California and Oregon, or the wood from this tree; sequoia
words.translation: [植]红杉；[木]红木树，[林]红杉；红树木材

examples.en: Members of the group stand atop the stump of a giant redwood tree.
examples.zh: 研究项目组的成员长在一块巨大的红杉树桩之上。

examples.en: So far her team has mapped out how climate change might alter the habitats of a dozen species, from the Canadian lynx to the California redwood.
examples.zh: 到目前为止她的队伍已经绘制出天气怎样的变化会改变一些物种的习性，从加拿大的山猫到加利福尼亚的红杉。

words.definition: someone who knows a lot about something such as art, food, or music; sharp, maven
words.translation: 鉴赏家；内行

examples.en: a wine connoisseur
examples.zh: 品酒专家

words.definition: something such as a piece of equipment or a decoration that is not necessary, but that makes a machine, car, room etc more useful or more attractive; attachment, mating parts; deputy, vice, subsidiary, auxiliary
words.translation: 附件；辅助的；配件；[法]从犯；副的；同谋的；[昆]附属的

examples.en: bathroom accessories such as mirrors and towel-rails
examples.zh: 镜子和毛巾架等浴室配件

words.definition: the quality of being serious; gravity, solemnness
words.translation: 严肃, 认真；严重性；严肃；认真

examples.en: With great seriousness he pondered upon the problem.
examples.zh: 他极其严肃地仔细考虑问题。

examples.en: Only the chairman's strong control was able to impart some sense of seriousness to the meeting.
examples.zh: 只有主席强有力的掌握会场的能力才能使会议具有某种严肃感。

words.definition: into very thin or very small pieces; considerably, remarkably, tremendously
words.translation: 细微地,美好地；非常地；细微地；美好地；雅致地

examples.en: finely chopped onion
examples.zh: 剁得细碎的洋葱

words.translation: 优先的, 优待的

examples.en: Heterosexuals should not be treated preferentially when the state carries out that role.
examples.zh: 当国家执行这个作用的时候不应该优先对待异性恋者。

examples.en: Then back in Spain, they trained a strain of Pseudomonas bacteria to preferentially nibble salt blooms.
examples.zh: 回到西班牙后，他们便培养了一种可以优先吞食盐层的假单胞菌。

examples.en: "We try to find which parts of the brain preferentially talk to which other parts, " he says. "We can sort of map that out, and at the end it sort of spits out a number.
examples.zh: “我们希望弄明白大脑中哪些部分优先和哪些部分通信”他说“我们可以从某种程度上将其映射出来，并最终以数字的方式反映出来，这就是“脑龄””。

words.definition: the process by which you gain knowledge or learn a skill; getting, procurement, winning
words.translation: 获得(物)；获得物，获得

examples.en: the acquisition of language
examples.zh: 语言的习得

words.definition: if soldiers or other people march somewhere, they walk there quickly with firm regular steps; demonstration, anabasis; step by, road to
words.translation: 行军；行军，进军；进行曲；示威游行；进军；走过

examples.en: An estimated 5,000 people marched through the city to demonstrate against the factory closures.
examples.zh: 大约有五千人在市里游行示威，抗议关闭工厂。

words.definition: a narrow road in the countryside; vector, driveway
words.translation: 小路, 小巷；[交]车道；小巷；[航][水运]航线

examples.en: a quiet country lane
examples.zh: 一条宁静的乡间小路

words.definition: sterile land cannot be used to grow crops; hungry, desert
words.translation: 贫脊的,不结果的；不育的；无菌的；贫瘠的；不毛的；枯燥乏味的

examples.en: The classrooms are sterile, with no artwork on the walls.
examples.zh: 这些教室毫无生气，墙上一张画都没有。

words.definition: a plant that grows in the sea; varech, sea wrack
words.translation: 海草, 海藻；海藻，[植]海草

examples.en: So the next time you see a chunk of seaweed ... notice the beauty of it, yes.
examples.zh: 所以下次你碰见一大片海藻时，要毫不犹豫的欣赏它的美。

examples.en: The crabs come closer to shore at this time of year, Child said, where they feed on the seaweed.
examples.zh: 这些螃蟹每年这个时间，要来到这里海岸的边上，恰尔特说，它们以吃海藻为生。

examples.en: In many places, like Japan, people get iodine from seafood, seaweed, vegetables grown in iodine-rich soil or animals that eat grass grown in that soil.
examples.zh: 像日本等许多地方，人们通过食用海鲜、海藻得到碘，还可以从生长在高碘土壤里的蔬菜或食草动物那里得到碘。

words.definition: relating to the time in a child’s life before they are old enough to go to school; kindergarten, nursery school
words.translation: 未满学龄的n幼儿园；幼儿园，育幼院

examples.en: preschool children
examples.zh: 学龄前儿童

words.definition: to melt a rock that contains metal in order to remove the metal; refine; ayu, sparling
words.translation: 熔解，熔炼；熔炼，冶炼；精炼；香鱼；[鱼]胡瓜鱼

words.definition: river bed, cauce
words.translation: 河床

examples.en: Within 30 minutes, I was marching up a dry streambed, above the trees, on a ridge matted with magenta shrubs and dotted by boulders.

examples.zh: 他们也较少能受益于预防工作，而且较少能获取高质量的治疗和康复服务。

words.definition: a long light boat that is pointed at both ends and which you move along using a  paddle; pirogue, dugout

examples.en: We saw the canoe overturn, throwing its passengers into the water.
examples.zh: 我们看到独木舟倾覆了，把上面的乘客掀入水中。

examples.en: At a summer job working as park naturalists that year, I flipped the canoe Air and I were paddling and we had to push it to shore.
examples.zh: 那年我在公园里做暑期兼职，我把独木舟翻转个身，然后我们一起合力将它推到岸边，这样我们就可以划船了。

examples.zh: 在迈阿密适合你的保湿剂、各式乳霜和基础护肤品，不会在明尼阿波利斯就不适合你。

examples.zh: 考虑到通用汽车公司在境内业务广泛，加拿大政府和安大略省政府均同意出资，为通用汽车公司的未来贡献自己的一份力量，我对此表示感谢。

words.definition: the sixth month of the year, between May and July

examples.zh: 1986年6月，他和我们呆了两个半星期。

examples.zh: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。

examples.zh: 他们给我发了一封回绝信。

words.translation: 在重量(或价值等)上超过；比…重（在重量上）；比…重要；比…有价值

examples.en: The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.
examples.zh: 这笔交易的利远大于弊。

words.definition: a vehicle with two wheels pulled by a horse, used in ancient times in battles and races
words.translation: 战车

examples.en: Then, when much blood had clogged their chariot-wheels, I would go up and wash them from sweet wells, Even with truths that lie too deep for taint.
examples.zh: 因此当大量的血液凝固，阻塞了战车前进的轮之际，我就要起身，用甘甜清澈的井水刷洗猩红，甚至是用深深隐藏在污点后的事实。

examples.en: When humans first started building things, determining whether they would work as planned was mostly a matter of trial and error. Build a bridge, drive a chariot across it, and see if it collapsed.
examples.zh: 一开始人类建造房屋时,决定房屋是否合格的方法是去试一下,看看有什么不妥的地方.建成一座桥,把辆战车开上面跑一跑,看看桥会不会倒.

examples.en: I drove my chariot to the vineyard gate, and there I saw the twoKings.
examples.zh: 我驾着战车来到葡萄园的门口，看到了那两个国王。

examples.zh: 当你叫我阿拉伯人的时候，我说是。

examples.zh: 在2011年的阿拉伯，后一种是什么呢？

examples.zh: 在怀孕期间对某些酶进行检测是非常有益的，比如白细胞或血小板含量。

examples.zh: 那么，你想做一个炼金术士，还是一个化学家呢？

examples.zh: 别来怪我——又不是我的错。

examples.zh: 医生一会儿就到。

examples.zh: 一会儿我就睡着了。

examples.zh: 对重新选举董事长的提议有人持反对意见。

examples.zh: 如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。
