examples.zh: 在那些无声祷告、为神憔悴的人群中间，总混有许多病态的家伙；他们极端憎恨有洞察力的人，憎恨那些最近得道、坦诚的人。

words.definition: set of ancient myths; fairy story, fairy tales
words.translation: 神话；神话学；神话集

examples.en: characters from classical mythology
examples.zh: 古典神话中的人物

words.translation: 迟, 晚

examples.en: I must report your lateness to the teacher.
examples.zh: 我必须报告老师你迟到了。

examples.en: I remember that rich bass voice hanging in the night air, making some elaborate operatic point despite the lateness of the hour - and the train.
examples.zh: 尽管那次时间已经很晚，再加上火车的隆隆声，我还记得那饱满的低音弥漫在夜空之中，详尽地阐述他关于歌剧的看法 。

examples.en: The guesthouse in Nanshao was the most pleasant we have come across, run by a welcoming Miao family who despite the lateness of the hour gave us hot water for our feet and hot food for our bellies.
examples.zh: 南哨的旅馆是我们遇到的最友善的旅馆，由一家好客的苗族人经营。 尽管那天已经很晚，主人还是为我们的双脚提供了热水，为我们的肚子提供了热饭。

words.definition: while noisy, busy, or confused events are happening – used in writing or news reports; in the interim
words.translation: 在中；在其中，在其间

examples.en: The dollar has fallen in value amid rumors of weakness in the US economy.
examples.zh: 在一片美国经济疲软的传言中，美元贬值了。

examples.en: Demonstrators ripped up the national flag amid shouts of ‘Death to the tyrants!’
examples.zh: 示威者在“处死暴君！”的叫喊声中将国旗撕得粉碎。

words.definition: fictitious, imaginary
words.translation: 神话(学)的；神话的；神话学的；虚构的

examples.en: Plato describes in “Phaedrus,” in mythological language, why and how the souls take their birth upon this plane, either as human or animal.
examples.zh: 柏拉图在他的“斐德罗篇”中，以神话的语言描述了灵魂为何和怎样在人类的层面上或动物的层面上产生。

examples.en: This genre painting became very popular in the Netherlands and the north in general, because it was opposed to the mythological painting of Italy.
examples.zh: 这种绘画类型在荷兰乃至整个北部变得流行起来，因为它是对意大利神话题材绘画的反叛。

examples.en: While Henry’s essay is of course speculative, he nevertheless takes on an authoritative tone, and makes copious references to ancient mythological texts, as well as Zecharia Sitchin ’s works.
examples.zh: 尽管亨利的文章当然是推测性的，他依然采用一种权威式的口吻，并参考了大量的古代神话文本和撒迦利亚? 西琴的作品。

words.definition: the first form that a new design of a car, machine etc has, or a model of it used to test the design before it is produced; criterion, standard, level, norms, type
words.translation: 原型；[生物]原型；标准，模范

examples.en: But how do you come up with the architecture for this evolutionary prototype?
examples.zh: 但是你将如何为这个进化的原型提出系统的架构呢？

examples.en: But it may be an alternative when you have to finish a prototype in limited time.
examples.zh: 但是，当您需要在有限的时间内完成一个原型时，这也许是一种选择。

words.definition: someone who has only recently arrived somewhere or only recently started a particular activity; latecomer, tenderfoot
words.translation: 新来的人；移民；[劳经]新来者；新到的移民

examples.en: a special award for the most promising newcomer
examples.zh: 颁发给最有前途新人的特殊奖项

words.definition: a time of rest from work, school etc; festival, Feriae
words.translation: 假日；节日；休息日

examples.en: The school holidays start tomorrow.
examples.zh: 学校假期从明天开始。

words.definition: a seriousness of manner that people respect; grandeur, solemnity
words.translation: 庄严(举止)；（拉）庄严；庄重；庄严的举止

examples.en: He is pale, dark, and authoritative, with the gravitas you might expect of a Nobel prize winner.
examples.zh: 他面色苍白、皮肤呈深色、有权威性，带着你可能期待的一位诺贝尔奖得主的那种庄严。

words.translation: 先见之明

words.definition: to record music, a radio programme etc on a machine so that it can be used later
words.translation: 事先录音

examples.en: a prerecorded interview
examples.zh: 事先录制的采访

words.definition: delicate, tender, fragile
words.translation: 易碎的, 脆弱的；易碎的，[冶]脆弱的；易生气的

examples.en: In systems such as this we also often find that there are either no tests around this configuration code, or the tests that do exist are brittle and/or not realistic.
examples.zh: 在这样的系统中，我们经常会发现对于这些配置代码没有进行测试，或者尽管存在测试，但它很脆弱且/或不切实际。

examples.en: But while our screens are brittle, theirs is flexible––at what they say is one tenth the price.
examples.zh: 但我们的屏幕都很脆弱，他们的却很柔软，而且价钱是我们的十分之一。

words.definition: to give something to people, especially in fixed amounts; perform, implement, portion, discharge, part; get free of, exempt from
words.translation: 分发, 分配；分配，分发；免除；执行；免除，豁免

examples.en: a machine for dispensing cash
examples.zh: 取款机

words.definition: if something is inedible, you cannot eat it because it tastes bad or is poisonous; uneatable, unedible
words.translation: 不能吃的，不宜食用的；不能吃的

examples.en: The meat was so burnt that it was inedible.
examples.zh: 肉烧得那么焦，不能吃了。

words.definition: to persuade someone to do something, especially something wrong or dangerous, by making it seem attractive or exciting; temptation, gentle; induce, tempt
words.translation: 引诱；诱惑；饵；诱惑物

examples.en: He lured her to his home and shot her with his father's gun.
examples.zh: 他把她诱骗到家里，然后用父亲的枪把她打死。

words.definition: quickly, rapidly, promptly
words.translation: 很快地, 即刻；很快地；敏捷地；即刻

examples.en: As I looked swiftly away, it seemed to me that his glance held some kind of unmet expectation.
examples.zh: 我很快地看向别处，对我来说他的目光里似乎带着某种得不到满足的渴望。

examples.en: I believe that anywhere within a metre or so of daily maximum sea level would be swiftly eroded.
examples.zh: 我认为在那些水深达到一米或是每天水位最高到一米的地方，海平面会被很快侵蚀。

examples.en: Next time such an apology is likely to happen swiftly and immediately as women candidates set up media watchdog brigades to force the media to give them more equal treatment.
examples.zh: 下一次这类道歉可能会很快地和迅速地得到处理因为女性候选人建立了媒体监察队来强迫媒体给她们一个更公平的对待。

words.definition: involving a risk that something bad will happen; dangerous, critical, threatening, perilous, hazardous
words.translation: 危险的；冒险的；（作品等）有伤风化的

examples.en: Doctors say it’s too risky to try and operate.
examples.zh: 医生说动手术风险太大。

examples.en: Buying a secondhand car is a risky business .
examples.zh: 买二手汽车是有风险的。

words.definition: a small animal like a monkey, with long arms and no tail, that lives in trees in Asia
words.translation: 长臂猿

examples.en: Beverly: Why else would you grow a pancreas in a teenaged gibbon?
examples.zh: 要不然在年轻长臂猿体内培育人类胰腺干什么?

examples.en: The Christian Coalition should adopt as their mascot the white-handed gibbon, with his perfect nuclear family of one loyal  gibbette and several gibblets.
examples.zh: 其中白交长臂猿拥有最忠实和完美的小家庭，基督教联盟完全可以将其作为最纯洁的吉祥物。

words.definition: a small North American animal with black fur around its eyes and black and grey rings on its tail; racoon, coon
words.translation: <美>[动]浣熊；浣熊；浣熊毛皮

examples.en: a raccoon coat
examples.zh: 浣熊皮大衣

words.definition: to look at something quickly and secretly, especially through a hole or opening; peek; occur, figure, offer
words.translation: 窥视, 偷看；偷看；隐约看见，瞥见；窥视；慢慢露出，出现；吱吱叫

examples.en: On our website you can peep our video interview with R&B’s newest supergroup.
examples.zh: 在我们的网站可以观看到节奏布鲁斯最新超级组合的采访录像。

words.definition: stimulus, animation, excitation
words.translation: 觉醒, 激励；[心理]觉醒；激励

examples.en: It distracts us, and takes our arousal back to the starting blocks.
examples.zh: 它分散我们的注意力，使我们的觉醒又回到了起点。

examples.en: I asked as a primitive sense of arousal kicked in at the base of my medulla.
examples.zh: 真够神的，”我回答说，脑子里似乎有一种原始的欲望在觉醒，在升腾。

words.definition: a chemical by which a nerve cell communicates with another nerve cell or with a muscle
words.translation: [生化]神经传递素

examples.en: All drugs of abuse stimulate the release of the neurotransmitter dopamine.
examples.zh: 所有的药物滥用都刺激了神经递质多巴胺的释放。

examples.en: Dopamine is a neurotransmitter critical to the experience of pleasure and desire, and sends a signal to the brain: Pay attention, this is important.
examples.zh: 多巴胺是一种神经递质，对于人感受快乐和欲望至关重要，而且会向大脑发送这样一个信号：注意了，这很重要。

examples.en: The nucleus accumbens is associated with other kinds of longing — for alcohol and drugs — and is more dense in the neurotransmitter dopamine than in serotonin.
examples.zh: 阿肯柏氏核还与其他种类的渴望（比如嗜酒，嗑药）相联系---而且在血清素里神经传递素多巴胺的浓度更高。

words.definition: a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls down the side of a mountain; slide, snowslide, lawine; molder
words.translation: 雪崩；[水文][地理]雪崩；崩塌

examples.en: Two skiers were killed in the avalanche.
examples.zh: 两名滑雪者在雪崩中丧生。

words.definition: sky, sharp increase
words.translation: 冲天火箭（烟火）；飞涨，突然高升

words.definition: one of a pair of boots with metal blades on the bottom, for moving quickly on ice; ice skating, ice-skate; ice-skating
words.translation: 冰鞋 vi溜冰；滑冰；滑过；溜冰；冰鞋

words.definition: a wild goat that lives in the mountains of Europe, Asia, and North Africa
words.translation: 野生山羊

examples.en: Other common forms of synecdoche include two concentric circles or triangles (used as eyes in horse and bison paintings), ibex horns and the hump of a mammoth.
examples.zh: 其他普通的提喻形式包括两个同心圆或者三角形（在壁画上马和犀牛的眼睛里也有使用），野生山羊的羊角和长毛象弓起的背部。

words.definition: a small brown animal with a long tail, which uses its hands to climb trees and lives in hot countries; urchin, simian; horse around, mess about; guy, make game of
words.translation: 猴子；顽童；胡闹；捣蛋；嘲弄

examples.en: The monkey is beating up and down.
examples.zh: 那只猴子到处乱窜。

examples.en: The monkey engulfed the food whole.
examples.zh: 这只猴子囫囵吞下食物。

examples.en: The monkey had deflowered an entire section of the garden.
examples.zh: 这只猴子把花园中一整块地方的花都糟蹋了。

words.definition: a pause or stop; stop, break, stay, hang, stand
words.translation: 停止；中止；中断

examples.en: He would not agree to a cessation of hostilities.
examples.zh: 他不会同意敌对状态的停止。

words.definition: a tool with a rounded blade and a long handle used for moving earth, stones etc; shool; weed; spade
words.translation: 铲,挖斗机；铁铲；一铲的量；铲车；铲除；用铲挖；把…胡乱塞入；[机]铲

examples.en: ...a coal shovel.
examples.zh: …一把煤铲。

words.definition: behaving in a way that is unusual and different from most people; someone who behaves in a way that is different from what is usual or socially accepted; abnormal, odd, curious; fantastic, weirdo
words.translation: 古怪的；怪人；古怪的，反常的；古怪的人

examples.en: His eccentric behaviour lost him his job.
examples.zh: 他古怪的行为使他丢了工作。

examples.en: Aunt Nessy was always a bit eccentric.
examples.zh: 内西姑妈总是有点古怪。

words.definition: a  steamship; boat, streamboat
words.translation: 汽船, 蒸汽机；轮船；蒸汽机；蒸笼

words.definition: someone who is sentimental is easily affected by emotions such as love, sympathy, sadness etc, often in a way that seems silly to other people; melting, mushy
words.translation: 感伤的；多愁善感的；感情脆弱的

examples.en: She said a sentimental goodbye.
examples.zh: 她依依不舍地道别。

words.definition: shot, irised
words.translation: 闪光的，现晕光的；彩虹色的；闪光的

examples.en: small iridescent blue flies
examples.zh: 色彩变幻的蓝色小苍蝇

words.definition: the Eocene epoch or rock series
words.translation: 始新世(的)

words.definition: a cloth bag filled with soft material that you put on a chair or the floor to make it more comfortable; gaddi, mat
words.translation: 垫子；[轻]垫子；起缓解作用之物；（猪等的）臀肉；银行储蓄

examples.en: a velvet cushion
examples.zh: 天鹅绒垫子

examples.en: a cushion cover
examples.zh: 垫子套

words.definition: the system of tubes inside your body where food is made into solid waste material and through which it passes out of your body; interior, inside, inner, feeling, compassion
words.translation: 肠；内部；同情

examples.en: cancer of the bowel
examples.zh: 肠癌

words.definition: someone whose job is to check equipment or machines and make sure that they are working properly; lab-technician
words.translation: 技术员, 技师；[劳经]技师，技术员；技巧纯熟的人

examples.en: a laboratory technician
examples.zh: 实验室技术人员

examples.en: a hospital technician
examples.zh: 医院技术人员

words.definition: used to say that something may happen or may be true but you are not certain; perhaps, possibly, probably, like; possibility, probability, feasibility, potential, chance
words.translation: 大概, 或许；也许；可能；大概；可能性；不确定性

examples.en: Maybe it’s all just a big misunderstanding.
examples.zh: 也许这只是一个很大的误会。

examples.en: ‘Do you think he’ll come back?’ ‘Maybe.’
examples.zh: “你认为他会回来吗？”“也许会吧。”

examples.en: Maybe they’re right, but maybe not .
examples.zh: 也许他们是对的，但也许不是。

words.definition: a deep mass of snow formed by the wind
words.translation: 雪堆

examples.en: Weller was once a stranded motorist himself. Driving in an Illinois blizzard when he was 16, he got stuck in a snowdrift.
examples.zh: 韦勒自己曾经也是一个无助驾驶员，在他16岁的时候驾驶在伊利诺斯州的暴风雪中，陷入了雪堆。

examples.en: This snow had decided to go on falling until everything was a single, vast wet snowdrift, and nobody would remember what had been underneath it.
examples.zh: 雪决定继续下，下到所有的东西都变成一个孤零零的，巨大湿雪堆，没有人能记得下面曾是什么。

examples.en: No sense fretting about taking down the 5-foot Christmas tree buried in a snowdrift on her deck in Brookfield, Conn.
examples.zh: 当她从位于康涅狄格州布鲁克菲尔德的自家平台上拆下埋在雪里的5英尺高圣诞树时也不用烦恼了。

words.definition: the number 70; three score years and ten
words.translation: 七十；七十个；七十岁；七十年代

examples.en: We lost touch during the seventies.
examples.zh: 我们在70年代失去了联系。

words.definition: someone whose job is to clean other people’s houses, offices etc; detergent, cleaning media
words.translation: 清洁工人, 清洁器；[化工]清洁剂；清洁工；干洗店；干洗商；[建]洗洁器

examples.en: a vacuum cleaner
examples.zh: 真空吸尘器

words.definition: a musical instrument like a large box that you hold in both hands. You play it by pressing the sides together and pulling them out again, while you push buttons and  key s  .; folding, collapsable; squeezebox
words.translation: 手风琴；可折叠的

examples.en: But my fancy accordion might as well have been a cardboard box that afternoon.
examples.zh: 但是那天下午，我别致的手风琴好像变成了纸板盒。

examples.en: All at once I pictured my own father, patiently enduring my nightly accordion practice sessions though he must have yearned for peace and quiet after his long days at the pizza factory.
examples.zh: 突然，我想起了我的父亲。 虽然他在比萨厂呆了一整天后一定非常渴望清静，但还是耐心地忍受着我每天晚上练习手风琴的那段时间。

examples.en: So you may be saying to yourself, I have to sign up right now for Swahili and calculus and accordion lessons before my brain withers away!
examples.zh: 你或许因此对自己说，趁着我的大脑还没退化，赶紧报名学习史瓦西里文和微积分，还有手风琴班吧！

words.definition: waste matter from animals that is mixed with soil to improve the soil and help plants grow; till, farm; fertilizer
words.translation: 肥料；施肥于；耕种；[肥料]肥料；粪肥

examples.en: ...bags of manure.
examples.zh: …一袋袋的肥料。

words.definition: a small plant, usually with three leaves on each stem. If you find one with four leaves, it is thought to bring you luck.; trifolium, shamrock
words.translation: [植]三叶草；苜蓿；红花草

examples.en: a four-leaf clover
examples.zh: 四叶（车轴）草

words.definition: a machine for making air or water hotter; warmer, heating appliance
words.translation: 加热器；[建]加热器；加热工

examples.en: Did you turn the heater off?
examples.zh: 你关掉加热器了吗？

words.definition: the distance or measurement around the outside of a circle or any round shape; periphery, chest/bust
words.translation: 圆周, 周围；[数]圆周；周长；胸围

examples.en: ...a scientist calculating the Earth's circumference.
examples.zh: …一位正在计算地球周长的科学家。

words.definition: a particular way of behaving towards someone or of dealing with them; therapy, transactions, settlement, disposal, computing
words.translation: 待遇, 对待；[临床]治疗，疗法；处理；对待

examples.en: Just lately, Kyra has been giving me the silent treatment (= refusing to speak to me because she is angry with me ) .
examples.zh: 就在最近，凯拉一直对我不理不睬。

words.definition: the protection of public health by removing and treating waste, dirty water etc; hygiene of environment, environmental health
words.translation: 卫生(设施)；[医]环境卫生；卫生设备；下水道设施

examples.en: Overcrowding and poor sanitation are common problems in prisons.
examples.zh: 过度拥挤和卫生状况差是监狱里的普遍问题。

words.definition: someone whose job is to tell jokes, sing etc in order to entertain people; player, showman
words.translation: 款待者, 表演娱乐节目的人；演艺人员，表演者

examples.en: Sinatra remains one of the top entertainers of all time.
examples.zh: 西纳特拉一直是最著名的艺人之一。

examples.en: street entertainers
examples.zh: 街头艺人

words.definition: to remove something from a surface using the edge of a knife, a stick etc; difficulty, corner, dilemma, fix; raw, brush burn; shave off
words.translation: 刮，擦；刮掉；擦痕；困境；刮擦声；刮；擦伤；挖成；刮出刺耳声

examples.en: Scrape the carrots and slice them thinly.
examples.zh: 把这些胡萝卜去皮切成薄片。

examples.en: The two of them scraped their dishes clean .
examples.zh: 他们两个把盘子擦得干干净净。

words.definition: with a lot of force in a way that is very difficult to control; strongly, extremely, heavily, hard, fiercely
words.translation: 猛烈地, 激烈地；猛烈地，激烈地；极端地

examples.en: Several people have been violently attacked in the subway.
examples.zh: 有几个人在地铁里受到了暴力袭击。

words.definition: the bricks or stone from which a building, wall etc has been made; stoneworker
words.translation: 石工术, 石匠职业；石工；石工行业；[建]石造建筑

examples.en: Several people were buried under falling masonry.
examples.zh: 好几个人被埋在倒塌的砖石下面。

words.definition: the ability to change or be changed easily to suit a different situation; give, elasticity, adaptability
words.translation: 灵活性, 弹性；灵活性；[力]弹性；适应性

examples.en: Employees expect flexibility in the workplace.
examples.zh: 员工们盼望工作安排有弹性。

words.definition: to block a road, passage etc; let, violate; plug up, block up
words.translation: 阻塞，堵塞；妨碍；阻塞；遮断；设障碍

examples.en: A small aircraft was obstructing the runway.
examples.zh: 一架小型飞机堵住了跑道。

examples.en: The column obstructed our view of the stage.
examples.zh: 柱子挡着，我们看不见舞台。

words.definition: not very good; ordinary, general, secondary, middle, average
words.translation: 平庸的；普通的；平凡的；中等的

examples.en: I thought the book was pretty mediocre.
examples.zh: 我认为这本书非常一般。

examples.en: a mediocre student
examples.zh: 能力一般的学生

words.definition: a stream or river that flows into a larger river; subsidiary, assistant, helping; branch, distributary
words.translation: 支流(的)，进贡(的)；纳贡的；附属的；辅助的；[地理][水文]支流；进贡国；附属国

examples.en: ...the Napo river, a tributary of the Amazon.
examples.zh: ...纳波河，亚马孙河的一条支流。

words.definition: someone who is choosy will only accept things that they like a lot or they consider to be very good; picksome
words.translation: 好挑剔的

examples.en: Skiers should be particularly choosy about the insurance policy they buy.
examples.zh: 滑雪者在购买保险的问题上应特别谨慎。

words.definition: easy to recognize as being different from something else; diacritical, cognizable
words.translation: 可区别的, 可辨别的；可区别的；辩认得出的；可辨识的

examples.en: ...features that make their products distinguishable from those of their rivals.
examples.zh: …将他们的产品与其竞争对手们的产品区别开来的一些特色。

words.definition: to regularly travel a long distance to get to work; exchange for, give for
words.translation: 通勤, 折换；乘车上下班；减刑；[数]交换；用……交换；使……变成

examples.en: Mike commutes to Miami every day.
examples.zh: 迈克每天通勤去迈阿密。

words.definition: Absenteeism is the fact or habit of frequently being away from work or school, usually without a good reason; truancy
words.translation: 旷课, 旷工；[劳经]旷工；旷课；有计划的怠工；经常无故缺席

examples.en: His boss discharged him for habitual absenteeism.
examples.zh: 他的老板因他习惯性旷工而解雇了他。

examples.en: School refusal — any kind of absenteeism, from phobia to truancy, that can be traced to the child’s own actions and wishes — is at the very intersection of education, psychology and pediatrics.
examples.zh: 拒学症---任何一种旷课，从恐惧到逃学，都能从孩子自身的品行和愿望上找到根源---而且是教育，心理学和儿科学等因素交织在一起。

words.translation: 点彩派画家

examples.en: The book is composed, like a pointillist painting, of thousands of factual details.
examples.zh: 这本书像是一副点彩画，由成千上万证据确凿的细节组合而成。

examples.en: That’s the science part. The artistry comes in when the surgeon makes tiny incisions for depositing the enriched fat cells, building a breast one dot-sized injection at a time like a 3-D pointillist.
examples.zh: 除了科学因素外，艺术工作也参与了其中，外科医生就像三维点彩画家一样，在乳房上打开一个微小的切口，植入浓缩的脂肪细胞，每次注射会形成点状区域。

words.definition: roughly, coarsely
words.translation: 粗糙地, 粗鲁地；粗糙地；天然地；粗鲁地；不成熟地

examples.en: The adult characters seemed too crudely drawn; the hopes and dreams of the fathers – and one assumes, the mothers – too easily dismissed.
examples.zh: 成年人的角色塑造的太过粗糙，父亲们抑或是母亲们的希望和梦想太过轻易地被排斥。

words.definition: to sit on an animal, especially a horse, and make it move along; horse, trust, swim; possess, regulate, contain, manage, bottle; vehicle, embarkation
words.translation: 骑, 乘；骑马；乘车；依靠；漂浮；骑；乘；控制；乘坐；交通工具；可供骑行的路

examples.en: She learned to ride when she was seven.
examples.zh: 她七岁时学会了骑马。

examples.en: He was riding a large grey mare.
examples.zh: 他骑着一匹灰色的大母马。

words.definition: a long or important letter; carta
words.translation: 书信；使徒书；书信体诗文

examples.en: Now immediately we can see that this is an epistle which has a great deal to teach us as we live in the last times of the Gentiles.
examples.zh: 现在我们能看见当我们住在非犹太人的最后时期，这是一封常常有教我们的书信。

examples.en: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
examples.zh: 你们念了这书信，便交给老底嘉的教会，叫他们也念。 你们也要念从老底嘉来的书信。

words.translation: 温血动物, 恒温动物

examples.en: For instance, humans are endotherms and maintain an internal temperature of 37℃, no matter whether the environment is warm or cold.
examples.zh: 比如，人是恒温动物，无论环境温度是怎样，体温都维持在37℃。

examples.en: Many scientists have problems with the arguments you read in the passage. They don't think those arguments prove that dinosaurs were endotherms.
examples.zh: 很多科学家对你们刚刚听到的文章持有不同意见。他么认为这些理由不能支持恐龙是恒温动物。

words.definition: to spread information or ideas to as many people as possible; distribute, publicize, transmit; shed, put about
words.translation: 散布，传播；宣传，传播；散布；广为传播

examples.en: Her findings have been widely disseminated .
examples.zh: 她的发现已广为传播。

words.translation: 冰山

examples.en: At a time when sprawling shelves of ice are disintegrating, this berg seemed to signify more.
examples.zh: 当伸展的冰架正在瓦解的时侯，这座冰山的出现更显得意味深长。

examples.en: While a Polar bear sleeping on an ice berg with its paws clutched around it like a toddler holding their teddy bear is truly cute.
examples.zh: 当北极熊在冰山上睡觉时，爪子抓住周围，就像一个蹒跚学步的婴儿抓着他们的泰迪熊一样，那是真的非常可爱！

words.definition: collected works
words.translation: 资料, 文集；[计]语料库；文集；本金

words.definition: Something that is unchangeable cannot be changed at all; constant, permanent, steady, balanced, quiet
words.translation: 不变的,不能改变的；不变的；不能改变的；安定的

examples.en: The doctrine is unchangeable.
examples.zh: 这条教义是不可改变的。

words.definition: someone who loves their country and is willing to defend it – used to show approval; Aigo, The Patriot
words.translation: 爱国者

examples.en: It has been suggested the founders were not true patriots but men out to protect their own interests.
examples.zh: 有人指出创建者并非真正的爱国者，而是一些维护自己利益的人。

words.definition: a thick wet substance that is used in beauty or cleaning products; jel, colloform
words.translation: 凝胶体 v成冻胶；[物化]凝胶，胶体

examples.en: hair gel
examples.zh: 发胶

examples.en: shower gel
examples.zh: 沐浴露

words.definition: not knowing facts or information that you ought to know; dark, empty, innocent
words.translation: 无知的；愚昧的

examples.en: an ignorant and uneducated man
examples.zh: 不学无术的人

words.definition: false but seeming to be real or true; phantasmal, mendacious
words.translation: 虚幻的；错觉的；幻影的；虚假的；产生幻觉的

examples.en: First impressions can often prove illusory.
examples.zh: 第一印象往往被证明是不真实的。

words.definition: thin, barely
words.translation: 稀疏地；贫乏地

examples.en: If an entry is only sparsely filled in, the results may look more like Figure 8.
examples.zh: 如果一个条目只填充了稀疏的内容，那么结果看上去就像图 8 那样。

examples.en: Instead, user mail files are sparsely distributed across a subset of servers within the cluster.
examples.zh: 相反地，用户邮件文件稀疏地分布在集群内的部分服务器中。

examples.en: A carpet of deep green covers most of the rugged landscape, but patches of bare or sparsely vegetated ground occur around the fringes of this image.
examples.zh: 一片深绿色的地毯覆盖了大部分崎岖的地表，而片片裸地或植被稀疏的地块散布于图片边缘。

words.definition: of, consisting of, or containing the monovalent group of atoms CH3
words.translation: 甲基, 木精

examples.en: However, thiomersal, the preservative in some vaccines, contains ethyl mercury not methyl mercury.
examples.zh: 然而，在某些疫苗中用作防腐剂的硫柳汞含乙基汞，并非含甲基汞。

examples.en: Further, ethyl mercury is actively excreted via the gut, unlike methyl mercury, which accumulates in the body.
examples.zh: 另外，乙基汞通过肠道被积极排除出去，而不像甲基汞那样在体内积累。

examples.en: In particular, ethyl mercury decomposes much more quickly than methyl mercury and does not accumulate in the body.
examples.zh: 特别是乙基汞的分解速度比甲基汞快很多，并且不会在体内累计。

words.definition: adorer, venerator
words.translation: 礼拜者；崇拜者；爱慕者

examples.en: If a worshipper should make a mistake, do you not think God will know his intent?
examples.zh: 如果崇拜者犯了错，那么,你以为上帝不知道他的意图吗

examples.en: But, in this view, God is so powerful and so transcendent that God will know the heart of the worshipper.
examples.zh: 但是，在这个观点里，上帝是强大超群的,上帝会知晓崇拜者的心灵。

examples.en: Bethlehem, West Bank: A Christian worshipper inside the Church of Nativity, believed by many to be the birthplace of Jesus Christ
examples.zh: 约旦河西岸，伯利恒：一个基督徒礼拜者在主诞教堂内，这里被认为是许多人认为是耶稣基督诞生的地方。

words.definition: Saturday is the day after Friday and before Sunday
words.translation: 星期六

examples.en: He called her on Saturday morning at the studio.
examples.zh: 他星期六早上在工作室给她打电话。

examples.en: Every Saturday dad made a beautiful pea and ham soup.
examples.zh: 每个星期六爸爸都做一道鲜美的豌豆火腿汤。

words.definition: A watercourse is a stream or river, or the channel that it flows along
words.translation: 水流, 河道

examples.en: This often results in huge holes in the ground, noxious spoil-heaps and polluted watercourses.
examples.zh: 这常常会在地面上留下一个个巨大的坑，有毒的矸子山和污染的河道.

words.definition: very expensive, beautiful, and comfortable; abundant, super, full, extravagant
words.translation: 奢侈的, 豪华的；奢侈的；丰富的；放纵的；特级的

examples.en: a luxurious 30-room villa
examples.zh: 一栋有30个房间的豪华度假别墅

words.definition: a container for putting things in; container, vessel, jack, pocket
words.translation: 容器；[植]花托；插座

examples.en: a trash receptacle
examples.zh: 垃圾箱

words.definition: a fast two-wheeled vehicle with an engine; autocycle, motor van
words.translation: 摩托车, 机车；[车辆]摩托车；机动车

examples.en: You'd better encash your motorcycle at once.
examples.zh: 你最好马上卖掉摩托车换成现款。

examples.en: She can ride a motorcycle， to say nothing of a bicycle.
examples.zh: 她摩托车都会骑， 自行车更不在话下了。

examples.en: He runs behind a motorcycle for half an hour every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早晨跟在摩托车后面跑半个小时。

words.definition: an activity that you do for pleasure or amusement; entertainment, pleasure, sport, occupation, amusement
words.translation: 消遣, 娱乐；娱乐；消遣；休养

examples.en: His only recreations are drinking beer and watching football.
examples.zh: 他唯一的消遣就是喝啤酒和看足球比赛。

examples.en: the provision of recreation facilities
examples.zh: 提供娱乐设施

words.definition: a piece of underwear without sleeves that you wear on the top half of your body; shirt, waistcoat; award, grant, invest, habit, give
words.translation: 汗衫 vt使穿衣服, 授予；[服装]背心；汗衫；授予；使穿衣

words.definition: the branch of chemistry concerned with the industrial use of organic raw materials, esp materials of agricultural origin; applied chemistry
words.translation: [化]农业化工,实用化学；应用化学；[农]农业化工

examples.en: The branch of chemistry that studies and finds ways to use raw materials from farm products to make industrial products is called chemurgy .
examples.zh: 化学的一个分科就是要研究发现利用从农产品中提取的原料来创造新的产品，它被称为农业化学。

words.definition: An imitator is someone who copies what someone else does, or copies the way they speak or behave; simulator, aper
words.translation: 模仿者；[自]模拟器

examples.en: He doesn't take chances; that's why he's survived and most of his imitators haven't.
examples.zh: 他不去碰运气；这就是为什么他得以幸存下来，而他的大部分仿效者却没有。

examples.en: ...the Beatles and their many imitators.
examples.zh: ...甲壳虫队及其很多效仿者们。

words.definition: a building, especially a large one; mansion, large building
words.translation: 大厦, 大建筑物；大厦；大建筑物

examples.en: Their head office was an imposing edifice.
examples.zh: 他们的总部大楼是一幢宏伟建筑。

words.definition: cautious, prudent
words.translation: 机警的；谨慎的；惟恐的；考虑周到的

words.definition: to guess that something is true, using the information you know already; make a guess at, guess at sth; consider, guess at sth; speculation, theory, guess, projection
words.translation: 猜测；推测；认为；猜度

examples.en: There's so little to go on, we can only surmise what happened.
examples.zh: 几乎没有什么可继续进行的，我们只能猜测发生过的事。

words.definition: If you feel disdain for someone or something, you dislike them because you think that they are inferior or unimportant; defiance, snotnose
words.translation: 轻蔑 v蔑视；蔑视

examples.en: Janet looked at him with disdain.
examples.zh: 珍妮特轻蔑地看着他。

words.definition: containing poison or producing poison; toxic, evil, rank, vicious, venomous
words.translation: 有毒的, 恶意的；有毒的；恶毒的；讨厌的

examples.en: Some mushrooms are extremely poisonous.
examples.zh: 一些蘑菇有剧毒。

examples.en: poisonous gases such as hydrogen sulfide
examples.zh: 硫化氢等有毒气体

examples.en: poisonous substances
examples.zh: 有毒物质

words.definition: averse, opposing; opponent, objector
words.translation: 反对者 a反对的；反对的；反对者，反对论者

words.definition: a person who continues something, esp the work of someone else
words.translation: 继续者

examples.en: Whether you are the anti-innovator or the traditional continuator, the indispensable premise and foundation is fully understanding about tradition.
examples.zh: 无论是反传统的革新者，还是维护传统的继承派，都必须充分地认识并理解传统是其必要的前提和基础。

examples.en: In other words, much attention was paid on that Mao Zedong is a continuator and developer of Marxism, rather than that he is also a continuator and developer of traditional culture.
examples.zh: 换言之，以往只关注毛泽东是马克思主义的继承者和发展者，而忽略了发掘他作为传统文化继承者和弘扬者的一面。

words.definition: a metal frame with bars across it; reseau, latticework
words.translation: 格子, 栅格；[电子]网格；[数]格子，栅格；输电网

examples.en: ...a grid of ironwork.
examples.zh: …铁格栅。

words.definition: to make someone more likely to suffer from a particular health problem
words.translation: (使)易罹患, (使)预先偏向于

examples.en: They take pains to hire people whose personalities predispose them to serve customers well.
examples.zh: 他们煞费苦心雇用那些具备把顾客服务好的个性的人。

words.translation: 飞行员

examples.en: Like his father, he hopes to become a naval aviator.
examples.zh: 与父亲一样，他希望成为海军飞行员。

examples.en: The Man Angel was lighter-than-air and had paddles like a rowboat that the aviator could pump.
examples.zh: “人类天使”比空气还轻，并且有着类似于小船的桨，飞行员可以驱动这些桨。

examples.en: Air Chief Marshal Glenn Torpy told the graduates: "This is probably one of the most significant milestones in an aviator's career.
examples.zh: 空军上将格伦•托比在毕业典礼上致辞说：“这可能是飞行员职业生涯中最重要的里程碑之一。

words.definition: completely unreasonable or silly; ridiculous, absurd
words.translation: 荒谬的, 可笑的；荒谬的；可笑的

examples.en: The whole idea sounds absolutely preposterous!
examples.zh: 整个想法听起来荒谬透顶！

words.definition: the quality that something has when it has been done in a clever or skilful way, with careful attention to small details; delicacy, acuity
words.translation: 微妙, 精明；微妙；敏锐；精明

examples.en: The play lacks subtlety.
examples.zh: 这部戏不够精细。

examples.en: She argued her case with considerable subtlety.
examples.zh: 她非常巧妙地为自己的论点辩护。

words.definition: an area where people live which is away from the centre of a town or city; margin, banlieue
words.translation: 市郊, 郊区；郊区；边缘

examples.en: a London suburb
examples.zh: 一个伦敦郊区

examples.en: a kid from the suburbs
examples.zh: 来自郊区的小孩子

words.definition: a type of bus that runs on electricity along metal tracks in the road; trolley car, trolley-bus
words.translation: 路面电车；[车辆]有轨电车

examples.en: She was wearing a uniform jacket and skirt, and I realized that she was streetcar conductor.
examples.zh: 她穿着制服上衣和裙子，我明白她原来是有轨电车检票员。

examples.en: She was scrupulously clean, she showered every morning, and I liked the smell of perfume, fresh perspiration, and streetcar that she brought with her from work.
examples.zh: 她有洁癖，每天早晨都洗澡，我喜欢香水味道，还有她从有轨电车带回来的清爽的汗水味道。

examples.en: Life in those areas, roughly paralleling the historic St. Charles Avenue streetcar line, has bounced back to normal.
examples.zh: 大体上，在靠近闻名遐迩的圣查尔斯大街有轨电车线附近的那些地区，生活已恢复到了正常水平。

words.definition: if an electric current oscillates, it changes direction very regularly and very frequently; destabilize; hesitate, to swing
words.translation: 振荡；使振荡；使振动；使动摇；摆动；犹豫

examples.en: The associated cross-peak amplitude also appears to oscillate.
examples.zh: 相关的交叉峰的幅度也在振荡。

words.definition: properly, well, adequately, appropriately, befittingly
words.translation: 适当地,适宜地；适宜地；适当地

examples.en: The aptly named Skyline Restaurant provides spectacular views of the city below.
examples.zh: 天际餐厅名副其实，可以俯瞰城市美景。

words.definition: under your feet where you are walking
words.translation: 在脚下面, 踩着地

examples.en: ...a room, high and square with carpet underfoot and tapestries on the walls.
examples.zh: ...天花板很高的一间四方的房间，脚下有地毯，墙上有挂毯。

words.definition: a bull whose sex organs have been removed, often used for working on farms; cattle, bull
words.translation: 牛, 公牛；[畜牧][脊椎]牛；公牛

words.definition: a person or company that makes money by buying land and then building houses, factories etc on it; eikonogen, developing agent
words.translation: 开发者；[摄][试剂]显影剂

examples.en: a Florida property developer
examples.zh: 佛罗里达州的一家房地产开发公司

words.definition: to make someone feel anxious about something; trouble, fear; harry, trouble, tear; trouble, concern about/for/over
words.translation: 烦恼, 忧虑；担心；烦恼；撕咬；发愁；折磨

examples.en: The recent changes in the Earth’s climate are beginning to worry scientists.
examples.zh: 近来地球的气候变化使科学家开始担忧起来。

examples.en: I didn’t tell Mum and Dad – I didn’t want to worry them.
examples.zh: 我没告诉爸妈——我不想让他们担心。

examples.en: Doesn’t it worry you that Sarah spends so much time away from home?
examples.zh: 萨拉整天往外跑，你不担心吗？

words.definition: a round fruit whose outer shell can be used as a container, or the container made from this fruit; cucurbit, calabash
words.translation: 葫芦；葫芦，葫芦属植物；脑瓜

examples.en: I refused the last but washed down the fruit and vegetables with clear, cold water from a hollowed gourd.
examples.zh: 我没有动第三碗，只就着一只葫芦里干净的凉水，把水果和蔬菜风卷残云地吃了下去。

examples.en: "I keep these stocks as my security, my backup, " he says, looking down at the gourd casks filled with what I now realize are seeds.
examples.zh: “我保存这些存货作为我的保障，我的后备，”他一边说，一边低头觑着那些葫芦罐，我这才认出那里面装满的是种子。

examples.en: The practice of carving and lighting the gourd is a Celtic custom brought to America by Irish immigrants, who used the more-plentiful turnip back home.
examples.zh: 在葫芦上刻鬼脸并作为灯笼的习俗最早来自于凯尔特民族，由爱尔兰移民传至美国，而美国人更常用芜菁。

words.definition: someone who owns land, especially a large amount of it; Tichu, lairdship
words.translation: 土地所有者；地主，土地所有者

examples.en: wealthy landowners
examples.zh: 有钱的地主

words.definition: a place where two lines, roads, tracks etc cross; intersection, four corners; traversing
words.translation: 交叉口；十字路口；杂交；横渡；横道；横越（cross的现在分词）

examples.en: Turn left at the first crossing.
examples.zh: 在第一个十字路口左转。

words.definition: a piece of glass used in a window or door; rim, planum
words.translation: 窗格玻璃；长方块；窗格；边；面；[建]窗格玻璃；嵌板

examples.en: a window pane
examples.zh: 一块窗玻璃

examples.en: a pane of glass
examples.zh: 一块玻璃

words.definition: known to be definitely true; unarguable, incontestable
words.translation: 无可置辩的；无可争辩的；无异议的；毫无疑问的

examples.en: Doctors found undisputed evidence of nerve damage.
examples.zh: 医生发现了神经受损的确凿证据。

words.definition: strategy, device, exercises; dry run; boss, dry run
words.translation: 策略[ pl]演习 v(巧妙)控制；用策略；[军]机动；演习；策略；调遣；用计谋；用计
可预见性

examples.en: Maybe that's the definition of predictability?
examples.zh: 也许那就是可预测性的定义？

examples.en: We need to improve the predictability and quality of our software across the board.
examples.zh: 我们需要把提高软件的可预测性和质量提上日程。

examples.en: Stability, reliability, and predictability are the means of achieving peace of mind.
examples.zh: 稳定性、可靠性和可预测性是达到内心宁静的方法。

words.definition: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees. It is represented by the symbol °C.
words.translation: 摄氏的

examples.en: Highest temperatures 11° Celsius, that's 52° Fahrenheit.
examples.zh: 最高温度11摄氏度，即52华氏度。

words.definition: not feeling physically comfortable, or not making you feel comfortable; troubled, uneasy
words.translation: 不舒服的，不自在的；不舒服的；不安的

examples.en: This sofa is so uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 这张沙发太不舒服了。

words.definition: reconstruction, fresh, renaissance, renewal
words.translation: 新生 复兴；复兴；复苏；新生

examples.en: Such bioactive mushroom metabolites are believed to have the capability to helping revitalization of our immune system against a large number of pathogenic and non-pathogenic diseases.
examples.zh: 这种具有生物活性的蕈类代谢产物被认为是能够帮助我们的免疫系统新生，抵抗大量致病性的和非致病性的疾病。

words.definition: an American leguminous tree, Cercis canadensis, that has heart-shaped leaves and small budlike pink flowers
words.translation: 紫荆属植物

examples.en: The production of flowers and fruits on the older branches or trunks of woody plants, such as the redbud, and many mostly tropical plants, including cacao.
examples.zh: 木本植物，如紫荆以及包括可可在内的许多热带植物，其老枝或树干上生出的花朵或果实。

words.definition: Phragmites, reed
words.translation: 芦苇；纸草；香蒲

words.definition: someone who buys goods, property,  shares  in a company etc, hoping that they will make a large profit when they sell them; lame duck, venturer
words.translation: 投机者；思索者

examples.en: a New York property speculator
examples.zh: 纽约的一名房地产投机者

words.definition: dirt farmer, yeoman
words.translation: 农场所有权人, 自耕农；农场所有人；分得土地之定居者；自耕农

words.definition: a part of a tube or pipe that opens and shuts like a door to control the flow of liquid, gas, air etc passing through it; depression tube, evacuated tube
words.translation: 阀,活门；[机]阀；[解剖]瓣膜；真空管；活门

examples.en: heart valves
examples.zh: 心脏瓣膜

words.definition: difficult or impossible to reach
words.translation: 难接近的, 难达到的

examples.en: In winter, the villages are inaccessible by road.
examples.zh: 冬天时，进入这些村子的路很难走。

words.definition: a piece of writing or a plan that is not yet in its finished form; to write a plan, letter, report etc that will need to be changed before it is in its finished form
words.translation: 草稿；草拟

examples.en: the rough draft of his new novel
examples.zh: 他的新小说的草稿

examples.en: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
examples.zh: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

examples.en: All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
examples.zh: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

words.definition: if something qualifies you to do something, you have the necessary skills, knowledge, ability etc to do it; block, set a limit to; be in a position, be qualified to
words.translation: (使)胜任,(使)合格；限制；使具有资格；证明…合格；取得资格，有资格

examples.en: Free school lunches are given to children who qualify.
examples.zh: 符合条件的儿童可获得免费的学生午餐。

words.definition: a small round raised part, especially a small swelling on a plant or someone’s body; hubble, bouton
words.translation: 节结；[解剖]小结；小瘤

examples.en: A simple and rapid diagnostic field test for BU is urgently needed because early disease – nodule – can be treated locally and inexpensively.
examples.zh: 由于早期疾病 - 节结 - 可在当地廉价地进行治疗，迫切需要布鲁里溃疡的一种现场简单快速诊断检测。

examples.en: One of the major limitations of CT screening is the number of screens in which a nodule or other indeterminate finding potentially related to lung cancer is found.
examples.zh: CT成像的一个主要局限性在于要做几次扫描才能发现一个结节或其它可能与肺癌相关的异常。

examples.en: Buruli ulcer often starts as a painless, mobile swelling in the skin called a nodule.
examples.zh: 布鲁里溃疡通常开始时在皮肤上出现一个无疼痛感的移动肿块，称为节结。

words.definition: fine, tactfully
words.translation: 巧妙地,技术好地；巧妙地；精巧地

words.definition: the ability to do something well; ability, capacity, rights, power, jurisdiction
words.translation: 能力；能力，[胚]胜任；权限；作证能力；足以过舒适生活的收入

examples.en: Typing is considered by most employers to be a basic competence.
examples.zh: 大多数雇主认为打字是一项基本技能。

words.definition: hibernation, winter sleep
words.translation: 休眠；[生物]休眠，冬眠；蛰伏

examples.en: Automatic logoff feature helps alleviate such risks by automatically disabling the session using recommended time-out values for dormancy.
examples.zh: 自动下线特性通过对休眠使用推荐的超时值，可以帮助降低此类风险。

examples.en: All nine were put in dimensional locks, essentially powered down into energetic dormancy through the technology of the Alliance. Many other magnificent Temple Crystals were lost.
examples.zh: 这 九个水晶都放置着维度锁，基本上经由(外星)联盟的技术将其能量降至休眠的状态 。

examples.en: After a 20-year period of dormancy, the volcanobegan to erupt once more.
examples.zh: 在20年的休眠后，这座火山又再一次肆虐。

words.definition: perhaps, maybe, like
words.translation: 推测地, 大概；可能；按照推测；恐怕

words.definition: Basketry is baskets made by weaving together thin strips of materials such as wood
words.translation: 篓编织品

examples.en: Eva specializes in one of the most difficult techniques of basketry.
examples.zh: 伊娃专攻一种最难的编织篮筐的技艺。

words.definition: the sharp loud sound made by a dog; have a cough, huff and puff; rap out; ululation
words.translation: 吠声；吠叫；咆哮；咳嗽；厉声说出；高声叫卖；任何似犬狐叫的声音

examples.en: Amy’s voice was a hoarse bark.
examples.zh: 艾美发出的是粗哑的吼声。

words.definition: If something amuses you, it makes you want to laugh or smile; to entertain, wile away
words.translation: 使发笑,使愉快；娱乐；消遣；使发笑；使愉快

examples.en: The thought seemed to amuse him.
examples.zh: 这个想法好像让他觉得好笑。

words.definition: if something is legal, you are allowed to do it or have to do it by law; legitimate, lawful
words.translation: 法律的,合法的；[法]法律的；合法的；法定的

examples.en: What the company has done is perfectly legal.
examples.zh: 公司所做的这一切完全合法。

examples.en: plans to make the carrying of identity cards a legal requirement
examples.zh: 使携带身份证成为法定要求的计划

examples.en: He had twice the legal limit of alcohol in his bloodstream.
examples.zh: 他血液中的酒精含量是法定限度的两倍。

words.translation: 真核状态的

examples.en: These genes are needed for cell respiration, and without them eukaryotic cells die.
examples.zh: 这些基因的细胞都需要呼吸，如果没有它们，真核细胞就会死亡。

examples.en: This overturns the traditional view that the jump to complex 'eukaryotic' cells simply required the right kinds of mutations.
examples.zh: 这颠覆了传统的观点，即实现复杂的'真核'细胞的跳跃发展仅仅要求正确种类的突变。

examples.en: These compartmentalised cells are called 'eukaryotic', and they all share a common ancestor that arose just once in four billion years of evolution.
examples.zh: 这些划分的细胞被称为“真核生物”，它们源于一个共同的祖先，在四十亿年的进化出现只有一次。

words.definition: a mixture of liquids that do not completely combine, such as oil and water
words.translation: 乳状液

words.definition: to move suddenly from side to side or up and down, usually with a lot of force, or to make something or someone do this; rock, swing motion; wave, rock; rocking motion, wafture
words.translation: 摇动，颤抖；动摇；摇动；震动；发抖；哆嗦

examples.en: She shook him to wake him up.
examples.zh: 她摇摇他，想把他叫醒。

examples.en: Shake the bottle before you open it.
examples.zh: 打开瓶子之前先摇一摇。

examples.en: The whole house started to shake.
examples.zh: 整幢房子摇晃起来。

words.definition: the act of making something shorter; compression, hitting
words.translation: 浓缩；[物]冷凝；凝结；[声]压缩

words.definition: a ball that is on the rebound has just hit something and is moving back through the air; springback, ringback; firm up, resile; carom
words.translation: /v回弹；回弹；篮板球；回升；弹回；使弹回

examples.en: I caught the ball on the rebound.
examples.zh: 我接住了弹回的球。

words.definition: not clear or exact; fuzzy, huge, dark, infinite, unsure
words.translation: 不明确的，含糊的；不确定的；无限的；模糊的

examples.en: Teachers find the report’s terminology so indefinite that it is confusing.
examples.zh: 老师们发现报告的专门用语含义不明确，令人费解。

words.definition: indifferent, small-beer
words.translation: 无关紧要的,  可忽略的；无关紧要的

examples.en: You realize that your problems are insignificant in comparison.
examples.zh: 要知道，你的问题相对来说微不足道。

words.definition: made by people using their hands, not by a machine; manual, mechanic
words.translation: 手工的；手制的

examples.en: a pair of expensive handmade shoes
examples.zh: 一双昂贵的手工制作的鞋子

words.translation: 冰岛(欧洲岛名,在大西洋北部,近北极圈)

examples.en: WHICH country will be the next Iceland?
examples.zh: 哪个国家会成为下一个冰岛？

examples.en: Austria and Turkey beat out Iceland for the two seats allocated to this region.
examples.zh: 奥地利和土耳其击败冰岛赢得该地区分配到的两个席位。

words.definition: producing a bright light when heated; molten, fervent
words.translation: 遇热发光的, 白炽的；辉耀的；炽热的；发白热光的

examples.en: the invention of the incandescent lamp
examples.zh: 白炽灯的发明

words.definition: furtively, clandestinely
words.translation: 含蓄地,  暗中地；含蓄地；暗中地

words.definition: to steal money or property from a person, bank etc; hijack, spoliate; prey upon, pillage
words.translation: 抢夺；抢劫；使…丧失；非法剥夺；掠夺

examples.en: They killed four policemen while robbing a bank.
examples.zh: 他们抢劫一家银行的时候杀了4名警察。

examples.en: A 77-year-old woman was robbed at knifepoint.
examples.zh: 一名77岁老妪遭到持刀抢劫。

words.definition: imagined rather than based on facts – often used to show disapproval; suppositional, imaginary
words.translation: 想像的, 奇怪的；想像的；稀奇的

examples.en: a fanciful story
examples.zh: 想象出来的故事

examples.en: The suggestion that there was a conspiracy is not entirely fanciful.
examples.zh: 说有人在搞阴谋，这并不完全是臆想。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that is fixed inside a house or building and is sold as part of the house; equipment, furniture, facility, plant
words.translation: 固定物(装置)；设备；固定装置；固定于某处不大可能移动之物

examples.en: light fixtures
examples.zh: 照明设备

words.definition: an object that provides a supply of electricity for something such as a radio, car, or toy; electric cell, electric element
words.translation: 电池；[电]电池，蓄电池

examples.en: You have to take the top off to change the batteries .
examples.zh: 你得把顶盖拿掉才能更换电池。

examples.en: When the red light comes on, you should recharge the battery .
examples.zh: 红灯亮起的时候你就应该给电池充电了。

examples.en: The car’s got a flat battery .
examples.zh: 汽车的蓄电池没电了。

words.definition: to strongly disapprove of or criticize something; combat, attack
words.translation: 抨击, 反对；反对；抨击；轻视；声明不赞成

examples.en: He deprecated the low quality of entrants to the profession.
examples.zh: 他抨击了行业中的滥竽充数。

words.definition: the act of putting a new feeling or quality into something; stimulus, animation
words.translation: 灌输；浸泡；注入物；激励

examples.en: He brought a tremendous infusion of hope to the people.
examples.zh: 他给人们带来极大的希望。

words.definition: a vehicle with wheels that is pulled by a horse, used in the past; transportation, behavior, traffic, charges, bearing
words.translation: 马车, 客车；运输；运费；四轮马车；举止；[铁路]客车厢

examples.en: The president-elect followed in an open carriage drawn by six beautiful grey horses.
examples.zh: 新当选的总统紧随其后，坐着6匹灰色骏马开道的敞篷马车。

words.definition: to become worse or make something worse; go ill, change for the worse; aggravate, complicate
words.translation: 恶化；变得更坏；更坏；使恶化；使变得更坏

examples.en: A lot of teachers expect the situation to worsen over the next few years.
examples.zh: 许多老师认为接下来的几年情形会更糟。

examples.en: Interfering now could worsen the problem.
examples.zh: 目前介入可能会使问题更严重。

words.definition: A portraitist is an artist who paints or draws people's portraits; iconographer
words.translation: 肖像画家；人像摄影师

examples.en: Rembrandt began to work as a professional portraitist about 1631.
examples.zh: 伦勃朗成为一名职业画家的时间约是1631年。

examples.en: Ben Heine is a painter, illustrator, portraitist, caricaturist and photographer.
examples.zh: Ben Heine 是一个画家、插画家、肖像画家、漫画家和、摄影家。

examples.en: Both of us had chosen Simmie Knox to paint our portraits: we liked Knox’s lifelike style, and he would be the first African-American portraitist to have his work hang in the White House.
examples.zh: 我俩都选了西米·诺克斯来为我们画像：我们欣赏他逼真的风格，他也将成为第一位将作品悬挂在白宫的非裔画家。

words.definition: A rhythmic movement or sound is repeated at regular intervals, forming a regular pattern or beat; cadent, metronomic
words.translation: 节奏的, 合拍的；[生物]有节奏的；有韵律的

examples.en: Good breathing is slow, rhythmic and deep.
examples.zh: 良好的呼吸缓慢、有节奏并且深沉。

words.definition: done in order to find out more about something; expeditionary
words.translation: 勘探的, 探索的；勘探的；探究的；考察的

examples.en: He’s going to have exploratory surgery on his knee.
examples.zh: 他的膝盖要做探查性手术。

words.definition: the large brown seed of a tropical tree, which has a hard shell containing white flesh that you can eat and a milky liquid that you can drink; cokernut, cocos nucifera
words.translation: 椰子；[园艺]椰子；椰子肉

examples.en: large tropical gardens of coconut palms
examples.zh: 大型热带椰树园

words.definition: morning, prime
words.translation: 幼年；初期；婴儿期；[地质]幼年

words.definition: to form a picture of someone or something in your mind; imagine, picture, think of
words.translation: 想象，设想；形象，形象化；想像，设想

examples.en: I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
examples.zh: 我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

words.definition: the acceptance of something as true; faith, trust, confidence, dependence
words.translation: 信任；凭证；祭器台（等于credence table，credenza）

examples.en: Good studies are needed to lend credence to the notion that genuine progress can be made in this important field.
examples.zh: 要有优秀的研究才能使人相信在这一重大领域能取得真正的进步。

words.definition: to cover or surround something completely; pack, enclose
words.translation: 装入, 包住；包住；围绕；包装

examples.en: When nuclear fuel is manufactured it is encased in metal cans.
examples.zh: 核燃料生产出来时被装在金属罐中。

words.definition: to complain or say that you are disappointed about something; regret; sigh, suspire
words.translation: 哀叹；惋惜；为…恸哭；叹息

examples.en: He was bemoaning the fact that lawyers charge so much.
examples.zh: 他抱怨律师收费太高。

words.definition: a dark brownish red colour; sorrel, chestnut; castaneous, nut-brown
words.translation: 栗色 a栗色的；栗色；逃亡黑人奴隶；孤立的人；栗色的

examples.en: I wore a maroon velvet trouser suit that my daughter chose, and most of the village came to the reception.
examples.zh: 那天，我穿了女儿为我挑选的栗色天鹅绒裤装，村庄里的大多数人都应邀参加了我的婚礼。

examples.en: On an impulse I grab a little maroon dress, pull Christiane from Frau Ballin's arms—she is still wearing only her undergarments—and quickly dress her in it.
examples.zh: 慌乱中，我随手抓起一件栗色的连衣裙，给在巴林女士怀里的克丽丝汀换上，——可怜的克丽丝汀，她还穿着那件薄衬衣。

words.definition: according to the law; lawfully, licity
words.translation: 法律上, 合法地；合法地；法律上

examples.en: They are still legally married.
examples.zh: 他们在法律上仍然是夫妻。

examples.en: Which of them is legally responsible for the accident?
examples.zh: 他们中谁应该对这起事故负法律责任？

examples.en: a legally binding agreement
examples.zh: 一份具有法律约束力的协议

words.definition: an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed; examination, checking, monitoring
words.translation: 检查, 视察；视察，检查

examples.en: An inspection was carried out at the school.
examples.zh: 有人来学校视察了一遍。

words.definition: the state of being immune to a disease; phylactic power, immunizing power
words.translation: 免疫性；[免疫]免疫力；豁免权；免除

examples.en: To protect you against small pox or diphtheria, you are vaccinated with a small amount of the toxin, and then your body develops immunity against that toxin.
examples.zh: 为了避免你长小脓包或得白喉病，所以会给你的身体接种小量毒素，然后你的身体会针对这些毒素产生免疫力。

examples.en: Very few people will have any immunity to this particular combination, which is what gives the concern that this will be a pandemic rather than just a normal seasonal flu outbreak.
examples.zh: 因为很少有人具备对这种特别的混合病毒的免疫力。 人们因此担心，这将不仅仅是正常的季节性流感疫情，而是一次传染病的大流行。

examples.en: But a new study shows that people with true expertise in a subject have some immunity to the siren song of corporate sponsorship.
examples.zh: 一项新的研究发现，在某一方面有真才实学的人们对广告赞助商的“糖衣炮弹”有一定的免疫力。

words.definition: a tax on goods coming into a country or going out of a country
words.translation: 关税

examples.en: America wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.
examples.zh: 美国想要取消电子类产品的关税。

words.definition: a rule or law that limits or controls what people can do; limitation, qualification, chain, constraint
words.translation: 限制, 约束；限制；约束；束缚

examples.en: a 50 mph speed restriction
examples.zh: 每小时50英里的限速

words.definition: a thin semifluid layer of the earth (100
words.translation: 岩流圈

examples.en: The mesosphere comprises the rest of the mantle below the asthenosphere.
examples.zh: 中间圈包括岩流圈以下地幔的其余部分。

examples.en: As the plates spread apart, the lithosphere, or crust, is moved aside like a lid, allowing molten rock from the liquid asthenosphere to seep through.
examples.zh: 板块分离时，岩石圈或地壳象盖子般移到一旁，液态软流层中的熔岩渗溢而出。

examples.en: Seamounts form from magmatic eruptions, which occur when lava seeps up to the crust through the partially-melted sub-layer, known as the asthenosphere, in the mantle.
examples.zh: 火山岩透过地幔中部份熔融的软流层渗入到地壳，岩浆喷发，海山由此形成。

words.definition: a plant with small dark purple flowers, or sometimes white or yellow ones; Violet Mist, johnny-jump-up; Tyrian purple
words.translation: 紫罗兰 a紫色的；紫罗兰；堇菜；羞怯的人；紫色的；紫罗兰色的

examples.en: She inhaled the violet perfume, saying “How sweet!”
examples.zh: 她一边闻紫罗兰的芳香， 一边说“好香啊！”

words.definition: the edge of an area; margin, suburb
words.translation: 外围；外围，[地理]边缘；圆周；圆柱体表面

examples.en: extremists on the periphery of the animal rights movement
examples.zh: 处于动物权利运动边缘的极端分子

words.definition: to buy insurance so that you will receive money if something bad happens to you, your family, your possessions etc; undertake, assure; to ensure, snake stare
words.translation: 给保险,确保；确保，保证；给…保险；确保；投保

examples.en: Have you insured the contents of your home?
examples.zh: 你给家庭财产投保了吗？

words.definition: to offend someone by saying or doing something they think is rude; hurt, abuse; despite, contumely
words.translation: 侮辱, 辱骂；侮辱；辱骂；损害；凌辱；无礼

examples.en: Nobody insults my family and gets away with it!
examples.zh: 谁也别想侮辱了我的家人之后就这么算了！

examples.en: I hope Andy won’t be insulted if I don’t come.
examples.zh: 如果我不来，希望安迪不要介意。

words.definition: a great landmass thought to have existed in the geological past and to have split into smaller landmasses, which drifted and formed the present continents
words.translation: [地]超大陆

examples.en: The very first supercontinent was called Vaalbara and it started forming more than 3.6 billion years ago.
examples.zh: 真正意义上的第一个超大陆名叫瓦尔巴拉，它从36亿年前就开始形成了。

examples.en: Many of us are familiar with the idea that the world's continents once fit snuggly together into one huge single supercontinent called Pangea.
examples.zh: 我们之中的许多人熟知一个概念：世界的几片大陆曾经紧紧靠在一起，组成了一个超大陆。 我们称之为泛古陆。

examples.en: The dino path to dominance appears to have been cleared when the supercontinent Pangea cracked, setting off 600,000 years of volcanic activity that wiped out the dinosaurs’ crocodilian competitors.
examples.zh: 恐龙走向繁盛的原因目前看起来开始清楚了，在超级大陆泛大陆开始分裂的时候，持续了600，000年的火山活动，就是这些火山活动摧毁了恐龙的鳄鱼类竞争对手。

words.definition: famous or well-known for something bad; infamous, disreputable
words.translation: 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的，臭名昭著的

examples.en: a notorious computer hacker
examples.zh: 声名狼藉的电脑黑客

examples.en: notorious cases of human rights abuses
examples.zh: 臭名昭著的践踏人权案

words.definition: a group of words that has a special meaning that is different from the ordinary meaning of each separate word. For example, ‘under the weather’ is an idiom meaning ‘ill’.; phrase, dialect
words.translation: 成语, 方言；成语，习语；土话

examples.en: the new musical idiom
examples.zh: 新的音乐风格

words.definition: mentation, psychological science
words.translation: 心理学；[心理]心理学；心理状态

examples.en: I understood the psychology of this, but it still hurt.
examples.zh: 我理解这种心理，但这仍然让我感到伤心。

examples.en: It was not until the mid-twentieth century that psychology really came into its own.
examples.zh: 直到20世纪中叶心理学才得到应有的重视。

examples.en: His speciality was psychology -- one important branch on the great tree of knowledge.
examples.zh: 他的专业是心理学，这是知识之树上的一个重要分枝。

words.definition: clearly separate; uncontinuous, incontinuous
words.translation: 不连续的, 离散的；离散的，[数]不连续的

examples.en: The change happens in a series of discrete steps.
examples.zh: 这个变化在一系列分离的步骤中发生。

words.definition: a picture or symbol representing an object, concept, or sound; ideograph, pictograph; mysterious, pictographic
words.translation: 象形文字；[语]象形文字；象形文字写的文章；[语]象形文字的；难解的

examples.en: The Inca had no system of hieroglyphic writing, as the Maya did, and any portraits that Inca artists may have made of their rulers were lost.
examples.zh: 和玛雅人一样，印加人也没有象形文字书写系统，而且印加艺术家们所绘制的统治者肖像业已失传。

examples.en: The Inca had no system of hieroglyphic writing, as the Maya did, and any portraits that Inca artists may have made of their rulers were lost.
examples.zh: 印加人没有发明象形文字，不像玛雅人，而印加的艺术工匠即便画过君王的肖像，也已遗失殆尽。

words.definition: a storm that has very strong fast winds and that moves over water; cyclone, storms
words.translation: 飓风, 狂风；飓风，[气象]暴风

examples.en: The hurricane devastated a large section of the coast.
examples.zh: 飓风毁坏了沿海地区的大部分。

examples.en: The hurricane demage was assessed at three million dollars.
examples.zh: 飓风损害赔偿金的金额被确定为三百万美元。

examples.en: The building can accommodate all of the offshore workers and protect them from hurricane damage.
examples.zh: 这个建筑能容纳所有的海上工人并且保护他们不受飓风的伤害。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that changes a gas into a liquid; capacitor, condensing apparatus
words.translation: 冷凝器, 电容器；冷凝器；[电]电容器；[光]聚光器

examples.en: You take that gas phase mixture, and you condense it in your condenser.
examples.zh: 然后用这新得到的气相混合物，在冷凝器中冷凝。

examples.en: Air-conditioning systems—both centralized ones and window units—have three important components: an evaporator, a condenser, and a compressor.
examples.zh: 空调系统，包括中央空调和窗口式空调，有三个重要的组成部分：蒸发器，冷凝器，和压缩机。

examples.en: The evaporator helps cool the air, the condenser helps ready the system's refrigerant for the cooling process, and the compressor helps move refrigerant back and forth between them.
examples.zh: 蒸发器有助于冷却空气，冷凝器帮助准备冷却过程中的制冷剂，压缩机有助于制冷剂在它们之间移动来回。

words.definition: written or spoken in two languages
words.translation: 能说两种语言的

examples.en: a bilingual dictionary
examples.zh: 双语词典

examples.en: The report proposed bilingual education in schools.
examples.zh: 报告建议在学校中实行双语教学。

words.definition: to officially end a law, system etc, especially one that has existed for a long time; recall, suppress
words.translation: 废止, 废除；废除，废止；取消，革除

examples.en: Slavery was abolished in the US in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

words.definition: If the title of something such as a book, film, or painting is, for example, "Sunrise," you can say that it is entitled "Sunrise."
words.translation: 给权利(或资格), 给题名

examples.en: ...a performance entitled "United States."
examples.zh: …一场名为“合众国”的演出。

words.definition: an antibiotic obtained from the bacterium Streptomyces griseus: used in the treatment of tuberculosis and Gram-negative bacterial infections; futostrep
words.translation: 链霉素；[药][微]链霉素

examples.en: In 1947 there was no cure for TB - doctors prescribed fresh air and a regular diet - but there was a new, experimental drug on the market, streptomycin.
examples.zh: 1947年，肺结核无异于绝症，医生嘱咐他多呼吸新鲜空气和注意有规律的日常饮食。 但市面上出现了一种新的试验性药物——链霉素。

examples.en: The key to containing any outbreak of plague lies in prompt treatment with common antibiotics such as tetracycline and streptomycin, which can reduce death rates from 60 to 15 per cent.
examples.zh: 遏制鼠疫爆发的关键是利用诸如四环素和链霉素那样的常用抗生素迅速治疗这种疾病，这可以把死亡率从60%减少到15%。

examples.en: A: It happened in 1963 … I had to take the drugs every day for 18 months, including six months of injections with streptomycin.
examples.zh: 答：那是在1963年... 我必须在18个月内每天坚持吃药，包括打了6个月链霉素。

words.definition: your innermost feelings, desires etc are your most personal and secret ones; secret, underground, chamber, inside, cabinet
words.translation: 最里面的, 内心的；内心的；最里面的，最深处的；秘密的

examples.en: a man who would never share his innermost thoughts with anyone
examples.zh: 一个永远不会告诉别人自己内心深处想法的人

words.definition: if an insect or a plant stings you, it makes a very small hole in your skin and you feel a sharp pain because of a poisonous substance; stimulus, smart, incentive, excitement, hit; stick, pink; smart, bite
words.translation: 刺, 刺痛；刺痛；讽刺，刺激；刺毛；刺；驱使；使…苦恼；使…疼痛；被刺痛；感到剧痛

examples.en: He was stung by a bee.
examples.zh: 他被蜜蜂蜇了。

words.definition: a sea animal that has a round transparent body and can sting you; nettlefish, acaleph
words.translation: 水母；[无脊椎]海蜇；软弱无能的人

examples.en: But many marine experts have been saying for several years that we need to start loving jellyfish – because in the not too distant future, they may be the most plentiful marine species around.
examples.zh: 但是，多年来，许多海洋专家一直在说，我们需要开始热爱水母——因为在不远的将来，它们也许是我们周围最丰富的海洋物种。

examples.en: Mr. Loughlin and others at the beach said it took a while for everyone to realize what was happening, because jellyfish stings are so rare at the beach.
examples.zh: 洛夫林先生和其他在海滩上的人说，过了好一会儿，大家才意识到发生了什么，因为水母蜇人在这片海滩上实属罕见。

words.definition: not changing or making progress, and continuing to be in a bad condition; slow, dull
words.translation: 停滞的；萧条的；不景气的；污浊的；迟钝的

examples.zh: 政府振兴低迷经济的计划

words.definition: from a long distance away; away, far, beyond, remotely
words.translation: 遥远地；在远处

examples.en: I saw him from afar.
examples.zh: 我远远地看到了他。

words.definition: a book, poem, or film that tells a long story about brave actions and exciting events; rhapsodical; epos, heroic
words.translation: 史诗, 伟大事迹；史诗的，叙事诗的；史诗；叙事诗；史诗般的作品

examples.zh: 好莱坞史诗电影

examples.en: The President’s power is circumscribed by Congress and the Supreme Court.
examples.zh: 总统的权力受到国会和最高法院的制约。

words.definition: not doing anything, not working, or not moving; lazy, idle

examples.zh: 在睡觉时脑细胞不活跃。

examples.zh: 年轻人变得不热衷政治了。

words.translation: [生化]脱氧核糖核酸(=deoxyribonucleic acid)

examples.en: At the moment, the regulation on how much human DNA can be put into an animal is vague.
examples.zh: 目前，有关多少人类脱氧核糖核酸可以放入一只动物身上的规定，还很模糊。

words.definition: any of a group of nitrogenous basic compounds found in plants, typically insoluble in water and physiologically active
words.translation: [化]生物碱

examples.en: Cocaine is a crystalline tropane alkaloid that is obtained from the leaves of the coca plant.
examples.zh: 可卡因是一种结晶状的莨菪生物碱，是从古柯叶中提取得来的。

examples.en: The company insists, however, that coca leaves are used as a flavoring agent only after removing the illegal cocaine alkaloid.
examples.zh: 然而，公司坚持古柯叶是在消除了非法可卡因生物碱之后才被用作调味剂。

examples.en: Scientists are not clear how the fungus controls the ants, but know that it releases alkaloid chemicals into the insect as it consumes it from the inside.
examples.zh: 科学家还不清楚寄生菌是如何控制木蚁的，只知道寄生菌在木蚁体内吸收营养物质的同时释放出生物碱。

words.translation: 广播, 播映

words.translation: 树桩;残余部分；笨重地走,使为难；[林]树桩；残余部分；假肢；砍伐；使为难；在…作巡回政治演说

examples.zh: 候选人应该参加严肃的政治对话。

examples.en: Pollinators are often visually attracted by the shape and colours of the labellum .
examples.zh: 传粉昆虫通常被唇瓣的形状和颜色的视觉效果所吸引。

examples.en: Appendages on orchid floral labellum that lack floral rewards for pollinators are considered attractive signals to potential pollinators.
examples.zh: 一些兰科植物常常利用多种多样的欺骗性传粉机制吸引传粉者，唇瓣上的附属物就是其中之一。

examples.en: ...the fisheries off Newfoundland.
examples.zh: …纽芬兰附近的那些渔场。

words.translation: 坏死；[病理]坏死；坏疽；骨疽

examples.en: ...liver necrosis.
examples.zh: ...肝坏死。

words.translation: 向东的；向东；东部；东方

examples.zh: …该市的东扩。

examples.zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雪正向东转移。

examples.en: The new institutions do not encroach on political power.
examples.zh: 这些新机构没有侵犯到政治权力。

words.translation: 音节；按音节发音；讲话

examples.en: The accent falls on the third syllable.
examples.zh: 重音落在第三个音节上。

examples.en: The stress falls on the second syllable.
examples.zh: 重音在第二个音节上。

examples.en: Accentuate the word “accent”on the first syllable.
examples.zh: 在“accent”一词的第一个音节上加重音符号。

words.translation: [植] 美洲杉；红杉（产于美国加州）

examples.en: I like your sense of humor.
examples.zh: 我喜欢你的 幽默感。

examples.en: His remarks participated of the sense of humor.
examples.zh: 他的话里带有几分幽默感。

examples.en: She loved everything about him -- his personality, his humor, the way he dressed.
examples.zh: 她爱他的一切——他的性格，他的幽默，还有他的衣着打扮。

words.definition: a type of paint in which the colour is mixed with a thick liquid
words.translation: 蛋彩画

examples.en: The acclaimed artist painted landscapes and figure subjects and worked mostly in tempera and watercolor.
examples.zh: 这位著名艺术家的创作多以风景和人物为主题，大多数作品为蛋彩画和水彩画。

examples.en: That the Temple of Dendur would once more be erected in all its cardboard and tempera glory, and the final bittersweet pages of “Tuck Everlasting” read aloud in Ms. Duffy’s husky, choked-up voice?
examples.zh: 丹杜尔神庙会在硬纸板上壮丽的蛋彩画上重新矗立起来吗？ 达夫老师还会再一次用她那嘶哑结巴的嗓音大声朗读《真爱无敌》那苦乐参半的结局吗？

words.definition: cornus, common macrocarpium fruit; fawn-coloured
words.translation: 山茱萸；山茱萸科植物的；淡黄褐色的

examples.en: Tilly sat in Colleen’s mother’s lap, still eating cake, and Karen ran around the dogwood, chased by one of her cousins.
examples.zh: 蒂莉坐在科琳妈妈的怀里，还在吃蛋糕，卡伦被一个表妹追得绕着山茱萸跑。

examples.en: Spring had come early that year, with warm quick rains and sudden frothing of pink peach blossoms and dogwood dappling with white stars the dark river swamp and far-off hills.
examples.zh: 春天来得很早，伴随来的是几场温暖的春雨，这时粉红的桃花突然纷纷绽放，山茱萸雪白也似的繁花将河边湿地和山冈装点起来。

words.translation: 瑞士(欧洲中部国家)

examples.zh: 莱茵河发源于瑞士。

examples.en: But I did not need to go to Switzerland to learn that.
examples.zh: 到瑞士要是就为了知道这些就大可不必去了。

examples.en: The banks needed to do something, so they turned themselves into the Switzerland of the Gulf.
examples.zh: 银行必须做点什么，于是它们把迪拜变成了波斯湾地区的瑞士。

words.definition: to come into a country in order to live there permanently; move into
words.translation: 移入

examples.en: His father and mother immigrated when he was two.
examples.zh: 他的父母在他两岁时移民到这里。

examples.zh: 一长条厚木板

examples.en: She took one of the parcels from her father to lighten his load.
examples.zh: 她从父亲那儿拿过一个包以减轻他的负担。

examples.en: This will lighten your spirit and give you strength and motivation.
examples.zh: 这样会减轻你的精神压力并会给你能力和动力。

examples.zh: 缺乏鲜明品牌形象的产品

examples.en: Could some of the deaths have been prevented in this notoriously high-risk area?
examples.zh: 在这个众所周知的高危地区，有些死亡是否可以避免？

examples.en: Derrida famously, notoriously, said "there is nothing outside the text," right? What he meant by that, of course, is that there's nothing but text.
examples.zh: 德里达著名地，恶名昭彰地，说道，文本之外什么都没有“,是吧，当然，他意思就是说，需要考虑的只有文本。

words.definition: not wearing any clothes or not covered by clothes; explicit, frank

examples.zh: 孩子们光着身子跑过院子。

examples.zh: 裸体男子的照片

examples.zh: 他们发现尸体半裸着躺在草丛中。

examples.en: It provides collection of images of minerals in thin sections, and microtextures of plutonic , volcanic and metamorphic rocks.
examples.zh: 网站提供了大量的矿物薄截面、火成岩、火山岩以及变质岩显微质地的图片。

examples.en: A mineral consisting of titanium dioxide in crystalline form; occurs in metamorphic and plutonic rocks and is a major source of titanium.
examples.zh: 一种含有二氧化的矿物，呈晶体状，见于变质岩和火成岩中，是的主要来源。

examples.en: The rise of plutonic granitic magma was the basic heat source generating strong dynamometamorphism and one of the main factors that influenced dynamic deformation.
examples.zh: 深成花岗岩浆隆升作用是发生强烈动力变质作用的基本热源并影响动力变形作用的主要因素之一。

words.translation: 使恶化, 加重；加重；使恶化；激怒

examples.en: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
examples.zh: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

examples.en: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation .
examples.zh: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。
