words.translation: 纪念物, 纪念馆；[建]纪念碑，纪念馆；纪念仪式；纪念物；记忆的；[建]纪念的，追悼的

examples.en: Building a memorial to Columbus has been his lifelong dream.
examples.zh: 建一座哥伦布纪念碑一直是他一生的梦想。

words.definition: a very large South American  vulture (= a bird that eats dead animals ); vulture
words.translation: [动]秃鹰, 秃鹫；秃鹫，秃鹰

examples.en: Just like this California condor, which—though teetering on the edge of extinction—still soars near the Grand Canyon in Arizona and in the state it was named after.
examples.zh: 就像加利福利亚秃鹫，虽然依旧翱翔于亚利桑那和加利福利亚的大峡谷附近，但已在灭绝的悬崖边摇摇欲坠。

examples.en: An Andean condor fliesover the Colca canyon at the Colca valley in Arequipa, south of Lima, on January 30, 2011.
examples.zh: 2011年1月30日，利马南部城市阿雷基帕的科尔卡大峡谷，一直安第斯秃鹰正在展翅飞翔。

examples.en: One example is the California condor.
examples.zh: 有一个加利福尼亚秃鹫的例子。

words.definition: a feeling of unhappiness because something is not as good as you expected, or has not happened in the way you hoped; depression, sell
words.translation: 失望；沮丧

examples.en: He could see the disappointment in her eyes.
examples.zh: 他看到了她眼中的失望。

examples.en: Several people expressed disappointment at the delay.
examples.zh: 有好几个人对这次延误表示失望。

examples.en: She hid her bitter disappointment .
examples.zh: 她把深深的沮丧掩饰起来。

words.definition: When plants, vegetables, or seeds sprout, they produce new shoots or leaves; put, come into bud; germinate, bud; seed, bud
words.translation: 萌芽 n苗芽；发芽；长芽；使发芽；使萌芽；[植]芽；萌芽；苗芽

examples.en: It only takes a few days for beans to sprout.
examples.zh: 豆子只需几天就会发芽。

words.definition: in an unsatisfactory or unsuccessful way; extremely, greatly, highly, quite, too, seriously
words.translation: 严重地, 恶劣地；非常，很；严重地，厉害地；恶劣地

examples.en: The company has been very badly managed.
examples.zh: 这家公司的管理非常差。

examples.en: The novel was translated badly into English.
examples.zh: 这部小说被拙劣地翻成了英语。

examples.en: badly made furniture
examples.zh: 做工粗糙的家具

words.definition: the dead body of a person; lich, carcass, Corse, ptoma
words.translation: 尸体

examples.en: The corpse was found by children playing in the woods.
examples.zh: 这具尸体是在林子里玩耍的孩子发现的。

words.definition: in order to help, improve, or please someone or something; goals, intention, purpose, behalf, objective
words.translation: 缘故，理由；目的；利益；理由；日本米酒

examples.en: He moved to the seaside for the sake of his health.
examples.zh: 他为了健康而迁居海滨。

examples.en: I only went for Kay’s sake.
examples.zh: 我是为了凯才去的。

examples.en: I hope he’s told the truth for his own sake (= because it will be good for him ) .
examples.zh: 为了他自己好，我希望他已经说出了真相。

words.definition: success in achieving something or reaching a particular level; achievement, effort, success, wisdom, accomplishment
words.translation: 达到；成就；学识

examples.en: a low level of educational attainment
examples.zh: 教育程度低

words.definition: not paying enough attention to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes, damage things etc; unwary, sloppy
words.translation: 粗心的, 疏忽的；粗心的；无忧无虑的；淡漠的

examples.en: It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 他忘了锁门，真是粗心大意。

examples.en: a careless mistake
examples.zh: 粗心造成的错误

examples.en: careless driving
examples.zh: 粗心驾驶

words.definition: series, advancement, succession, ongoing
words.translation: 行进, 级数；前进；连续

words.definition: a plastic or rubber tube containing wires that carry telephone messages, electronic signals, television pictures etc; electrical conduit, electric line
words.translation: 缆绳；电缆；[电]电缆；海底电报

examples.en: cables and switches for computers
examples.zh: 电脑的缆线和开关

words.translation: 海洋学者, 海洋研究者

examples.en: The oceanographer told delegates that the problem of ocean acidification was worse in high latitudes, in the Arctic and around Antarctica, than it was nearer the equator.
examples.zh: 这位海洋学家告诉与会代表，高纬度地区的海洋酸化问题更加严重，北极和南极周围比赤道附近糟糕得多。

examples.en: Before the war, Munk had been studying oceanography, so he took his concerns to his mentor, Harald Sverdrup, then director of Scripps and widely regarded as the top oceanographer in the US.
examples.zh: 战前，芒克一直在研究海洋学，他很关注他的导师--哈拉尔斯维德鲁普，在他的指导下芒克很快成为美国顶尖海洋学家。

words.definition: reasonably, rightfully
words.translation: 正当地, 合理地；合理地；正当地

examples.en: Methods that use this comparator legitimately depend on it to compare two files, without throwing any exceptions.
examples.zh: 使用这个比较器的方法合理地依靠它来比较两个文件，而不抛出任何异常。

words.definition: formed or deposited in an estuary
words.translation: 入海的, 在入海口形成的

examples.en: estuarine muds

words.definition: a small round container, usually with a handle, that you use to drink tea, coffee etc; aleyard, tumblerful
words.translation: 杯子；奖杯；酒杯

examples.en: Mathew picked up the cup and sipped his coffee.
examples.zh: 马修拿起杯子抿了口咖啡。

examples.en: She put her cup and saucer down on the table.
examples.zh: 她把杯碟放到桌上。

words.definition: A speciality of a particular place is a special food or product that is always very good there; profession, quality, identity, tang, character
words.translation: 特性, 特质；专业，专长；特性

examples.en: ...seafood, paella, and other specialities.
examples.zh: …海鲜、西班牙肉菜饭及其他特色食品。

words.definition: the part of a town or an area of land next to the sea, a river etc; shore, oceanfront
words.translation: 水边地码头区, 滨水地区；滩，海滨；水边

examples.en: The hotel is down on the waterfront.
examples.zh: 这家酒店位于滨水区。

words.translation: 石炭层

words.definition: something that is believable can be believed because it seems possible, likely, or real; trusted, credible, authentic
words.translation: 可信的

examples.en: a story with believable characters in it
examples.zh: 人物真实可信的故事

examples.en: That scenario is entirely believable.
examples.zh: 那样的设想完全是可信的。

words.definition: adjust, coordinate, restructure
words.translation: 使有规则, 使有秩序；调整；使有秩序；使合法化

examples.en: Cohabiting couples would regularize their unions, they said.
examples.zh: 他们说，同居情侣会让他们的结合合法化。

words.definition: relaxed and not worried, or seeming not to care about something; extraordinary, temporary, informal, odd; leisure suit, slack suit
words.translation: 偶然的, 不经意的；随便的；非正式的；临时的；偶然的；便装；临时工人；待命士兵

examples.en: a casual manner
examples.zh: 漫不经心的态度

examples.en: His eyes were angry, though he sounded casual.
examples.zh: 虽然他的语气满不在乎，但他的眼神充满怒气。

examples.en: Marsha was quite casual about appearing on TV.
examples.zh: 玛莎对于上电视很无所谓。

words.definition: like a skeleton or relating to a skeleton; boned, osteal
words.translation: 骨骼的, 梗概的；[生物]骨骼的，像骨骼的；骸骨的；骨瘦如柴的

examples.en: Police discovered the skeletal remains of a corpse buried near the river.
examples.zh: 警方发现了埋在河边的一具尸骨。

words.definition: something that is easy to recognize, such as a tall tree or building, and that helps you know where you are; Placemark, checkpost
words.translation: (航海)陆标, 地界标；[航]陆标，地标；[建]里程碑；[地理][测]地界标；划时代的事

examples.en: One of Belfast’s most famous landmarks, the Grosvenor Hall, has been demolished.
examples.zh: 贝尔法斯特最著名的地标之一格罗夫纳大厦已被拆毁了。

words.definition: to make it difficult for something to develop or succeed; slow, impede; latter, back, rear
words.translation: 阻碍, 打扰；阻碍；打扰；后面的

examples.en: His career has been hindered by injury.
examples.zh: 由于受伤，他的事业受到了阻碍。

examples.en: policies that will hinder rather than help families
examples.zh: 对家庭有害无益的政策

words.definition: existing as a simple chemical element that has not been combined with anything else; basic, fundamental, essential, primary, major
words.translation: 元素的,自然力的；基本的；主要的；自然力的；四大要素的（土、水、气、火）

examples.en: elemental sulphur
examples.zh: 元素硫

words.definition: winding like a snake; winding, sinuous; ophiolite
words.translation: 蜿蜒的；阴险的；弯弯曲曲的；[矿物]蛇纹石

examples.en: the serpentine course of the river
examples.zh: 蜿蜒曲折的河道

words.definition: an area of low wet muddy ground, sometimes containing bushes or grasses; cienaga, quagmire
words.translation: 沼泽；[地理]沼泽；泥塘

examples.en: Your car will bog down in the mud.
examples.zh: 你的车会陷进泥沼的。

examples.en: They had a cinnamon-like herb called bog myrtle, but it was the Romans who introduced many of the herbs and vegetables that we now know and love.
examples.zh: 他们有类似桂皮的香料名为沼泽香桃木，但是与很多我们现在了解并且十分喜欢的香料和蔬菜一样，这是古罗马人带来的。

examples.en: “We also built bog bridges, ” Macie says. “You need to take the supportive logs underneath and remove their bark, because the bark can rot quickly.
examples.zh: “我们还在沼泽建起小桥，”马西埃说，“你需要将一些原木支在下面，去掉上面的树皮，因为它们腐烂的很快。

words.definition: to live in a particular place; occupy, belong to
words.translation: 居住；住，居住；属于

examples.en: He spent most of his time in Rutherglen, where his family resided.
examples.zh: 他大部分时间都在拉瑟格伦度过，他的家人就在那里居住。

words.definition: one of the five movable parts at the end of your foot; tootsies, pettitoes
words.translation: 趾, 脚趾；[解剖]脚趾；足尖

examples.en: He stubbed his toe (= hurt it by kicking it against something ) on a rock.
examples.zh: 他的脚趾踢到一块石头上受了伤。

words.definition: briefly, pro tem
words.translation: 试验性地,犹豫不决地；暂时地；试验性地

words.definition: intensity, sunshine, animation
words.translation: 光亮, 明亮；[光][天]亮度；聪明，活泼；鲜艳；愉快

examples.en: A torch symbolizes the brightness (of the future).
examples.zh: 火炬象征光明。

examples.en: She took the little girl in her arms, and they both flew upwards in brightness and joy far above the earth, where there was neither cold nor hunger nor pain, for they were with God.
examples.zh: 她把小姑娘抱起来，搂在怀里。 她们俩在光明和快乐飞走了，越飞越高，飞到既没有寒冷，又没有饥饿和痛苦的地方，因为她们来到了极乐世界。

examples.en: It also will measure the brightness of each laser reflection.
examples.zh: 它还将测量每一道激光反射的光亮度。

words.definition: reconstruction, breeding, restructuring, rebirth
words.translation: 再生, 重建；[生物][化学][物]再生，重生；重建

examples.en: But they can definitely determine how they plan to grow as more people move in, and also how they want to rehabilitate areas that need regeneration.
examples.zh: 但它们确实可以决定怎样在更多的人迁移进来的同时计划它们的增长，以及它们希望怎样修复需要重建的区域。

examples.en: There are three parts to your hair: the hair shaft (the fiber), the hair bulb (the root) and the hair cycle (the period of rest and regeneration).
examples.zh: 我们的头发包含三个部分：毛干(纤维)，毛球(根部)和毛发周期(休息和再生的周期)。

examples.en: And doctors are already experimenting with ways of using tactile cues to improve wound healing and regeneration.
examples.zh: 医生已经在试验运用触觉信号来提高伤口愈合及再生的方法。

words.definition: the shape of the outer edges of something such as an area of land or someone’s body; profile, brief
words.translation: 轮廓；[气象]等高线；[数]周线；电路；概要

examples.en: the contours of the hills
examples.zh: 群山的轮廓

examples.en: the contours of her face
examples.zh: 她脸部的轮廓

words.definition: a New Zealand bird that cannot fly; actinidia, Chinese gooseberry
words.translation: [鸟]几维(一种新西兰产的无翼鸟)；猕猴桃；几维（一种新西兰产的无翼鸟）；新西兰人

examples.en: Other sources of vitamin E include wheat germ oil, dry almond, safflower oil, hazelnut, peanut butter, spinach, broccoli, kiwi, and mango.
examples.zh: 维生素E的其他来源的包括小麦胚芽油，干杏仁，红花油，榛子，花生酱，菠菜，西兰花，猕猴桃，芒果。

words.definition: A hummingbird is a small brightly coloured bird found in North, Central and South America. It has a long thin beak and powerful narrow wings that can move very fast.; trochilus, wood nymph
words.translation: 蜂雀；[鸟]蜂鸟

examples.en: In a presumably posthumous voiceover, Bwana Beast says he would do it all again, in a hummingbird's heartbeat.
examples.zh: 在大概是死后的画外音里，比斯特说他愿意再来一次，不过这次是以蜂鸟的心跳。

examples.en: Implanted sensors show that a hummingbird’s wing flaps so fast that the brain is generating the muscle signal for the downbeat of its wing while the wing is still going up.
examples.zh: 植入的传感器表明，蜂鸟翅膀击打的速度如此之快，以至于当其脑部发出的肌肉信号命令翅膀向下挥动时，但翅膀还是向上挥。

examples.en: The smaller the bird, for example, the more agile the flying — a swan may need the equivalent of two football fields to take off and get lift, while a hummingbird can rise like a helicopter.
examples.zh: 例如，鸟类的体型越小，飞行动作就越灵敏——天鹅就需要两个足球场大的面积才能完成起飞和抬升动作，而蜂鸟就可以像直升机一样垂直起飞。

words.definition: very silly or unreasonable; laughing, preposterous
words.translation: 荒谬的, 可笑的；可笑的；荒谬的

examples.en: That’s a ridiculous idea!
examples.zh: 那主意很荒唐！

examples.en: Don’t be ridiculous!
examples.zh: 别傻了！

examples.en: I’d look ridiculous in a dress like that.
examples.zh: 我穿那样的裙子会显得很可笑。

words.definition: a formal decision or statement agreed on by a group of people, especially after a vote; settlement, decision, determination, push, backbone
words.translation: 决心,决议；[物][电子][光]分辨率；决议；解决；决心

examples.en: a resolution calling for a ban on dumping nuclear waste
examples.zh: 要求禁止倾倒核废物的决议

examples.en: They have failed to comply with the resolution.
examples.zh: 他们没有遵守决议。

words.definition: not having the right qualities for a particular person, purpose, or situation; inappropriate, inadaptable
words.translation: 不适宜的, 不合适的；不适合的；不适宜的；不相称的

examples.en: unsuitable housing
examples.zh: 不合适的住房

words.translation: 溶液培养的

examples.en: And for those who prefer a healthier diet there is also a hydroponic greenhouse where fresh vegetables will grow all year round.
examples.zh: 还为那些注意健康饮食者建造了温室，温室内熟菜用溶液培养，新鲜绿色食品一年四季络绎不绝。

words.definition: a person who curries leather
words.translation: 制革匠
/a闪族人(语) (的)

words.definition: wild, casually
words.translation: 随便地,任意地；随便地，任意地；无目的，胡乱地；未加计划地

words.definition: between the large groups of stars in space
words.translation: 银河间的, 星际间的

examples.en: Intergalactic travel remains just a nice idea.
examples.zh: 银河间的旅行仍然只是个美好的愿望。

words.definition: To diffuse or be diffused through something means to move and spread through it
words.translation: 扩散,弥漫

examples.en: It allows nicotine to diffuse slowly and steadily into the bloodstream.
examples.zh: 它使尼古丁缓慢、稳步地扩散到血液当中。

words.definition: something that is synonymous with something else is considered to be very closely connected with it
words.translation: 同义的

examples.en: "Getting fit" became synonymous not just with healthier living, but with a leaner, meaner body, and the ground was laid for a burgeoning gym industry.
examples.zh: “获得适合”成为同义词的不只是健康的生活，但一个更精简，寡情的身体，与地面是一个新兴的体育产业奠定。

examples.en: In their minds, effort is synonymous with discomfort.
examples.zh: 在他们心目中，努力是不适的同义词。

words.definition: a weapon usually made from a thin straight piece of wood with a sharp point at one end, that you shoot with a  bow
words.translation: 箭, 箭头记号

examples.en: Follow the arrows to the X-ray department.
examples.zh: 顺着箭头指示的方向去X光科。

words.definition: the process of becoming discoloured; dipping treatment, chromatism
words.translation: 变色, 污点；变色；污点

examples.en: Vitamin K is helpful in reducing discoloration and the appearance of capillaries.
examples.zh: 维生素K能够帮助减少污点和外观毛细血管。

examples.en: Officials had noticed that local trees seemed to be under attack, showing damage such as cracks, discoloration and tissue deterioration.
examples.zh: 此前，当地官员注意到，当地的树木看起来就像是遭受了某种侵害，出现了龟裂、变色、组织恶化等病变。

examples.en: Aside from the possibility of increased heart rate, trouble sleeping and discoloration of teeth, there's another a way that a cup of joe can be detrimental to your well being.
examples.zh: 除了心率增加的可能性之外，还有无法入眠和使牙齿变色。 这是一杯咖啡对你健康的身体造成的伤害的两外一种方式。

words.definition: taking a lot of time and effort; tough, trying, rough
words.translation: 艰苦的, 费劲的；勤劳的；艰苦的；费劲的

examples.en: the laborious business of drying the crops
examples.zh: 把收获的庄稼晒干这一艰苦的工作

words.definition: the  scenery  behind something that you are looking at; prehistory
words.translation: 背景幕, 背景；背景；背景幕；交流声

examples.en: ...the rugged cliffs that formed a backdrop to the village.
examples.zh: ...构成村庄天然屏障的崎岖峭壁。

words.definition: intractable, naughty; diehard
words.translation: 难控制的,耐火的；[医]难治的；难熔的；不听话的；倔强的人；耐火物质

examples.en: ...refractory priests who refused to side with the king.
examples.zh: ...拒绝支持国王的桀骜不驯的牧师。

words.definition: untainted, inviolate
words.translation: 不用泥土(培植)的；不用泥土的；无污点的

examples.en: In horticultural applications, perlite is used throughout the world as a component of soilless growing mixes where it provides aeration and optimum moisture retention for superior plant growth.
examples.zh: 在园艺应用，珍珠岩是用来作为在世界各地的一个组成部分无土混合增长，提供最佳的通风和湿度保持优势植物生长。

words.definition: tight clothes fit your body very closely, especially in a way that is uncomfortable; severe, hard, fast, sealed, rigorous; thoroughly, entirely, completely, fully, fast
words.translation: 紧的；[服装][贸易]紧的；[机]密封的；绷紧的；麻烦的；严厉的；没空的；吝啬的；紧紧地；彻底地

examples.en: tight jeans
examples.zh: 紧身牛仔裤

examples.en: My shoes were so tight that I could hardly walk.
examples.zh: 鞋子很紧，我几乎不能走路。

examples.en: The jacket is rather a tight fit (= it fits too tightly ) .
examples.zh: 这件夹克衫太紧了。

words.definition: Your chest is the top part of the front of your body where your ribs, lungs, and heart are; bureau, treasury, breast
words.translation: 胸腔，橱；[解剖]胸，胸部；衣柜；箱子；金库

examples.en: He crossed his arms over his chest.
examples.zh: 他在胸前交叉双臂。

examples.en: He was shot in the chest.
examples.zh: 他胸部中弹。

words.translation: [天]星云的

examples.en: Ultraviolet radiation from the hot star powers the nebular glow.
examples.zh: 热恒星的紫外辐射使星云发光。

examples.en: Within the Iris, dusty nebular material surrounds a hot, young star.
examples.zh: 在彩虹星云中，星云尘埃物质围绕着一颗炙热的年轻恒星。

examples.en: The dramatic false-color image also highlights the contributions of hydrogen, sulfur, and oxygen, energized by intense ultraviolet radiation, to the nebular glow.
examples.zh: 这张生动的假色影像还突出了氢，硫和氧元素的作用，在强紫外线辐射下，星云发出炽热的光芒。

words.definition: a small plant with green leaves that have a fresh smell and taste and are used in cooking; menta, peppermint; coin
words.translation: 薄荷；[植]薄荷；[金融]造币厂，巨款；铸造，铸币

examples.en: new potatoes sprinkled with chopped mint
examples.zh: 撒上薄荷屑的嫩马铃薯

examples.en: roast lamb with mint sauce
examples.zh: 配薄荷调味汁的烤羔羊肉

examples.en: Decorate with a sprig of mint .

examples.zh: 这份报告的优点就是它对所要求的变动进行了实事求是的评估。

examples.zh: 这些教学方法每一种都有其优点。

examples.zh: 经过专门训练的警犬

examples.zh: 这里有一个寄往迈阿密湖的包裹。

examples.zh: 例如，想一想那些来自美国各地的人们，我们可以观察到他们之间的差异。

examples.zh: 他反复地说“你一定得看看那些手铐，美国造的！”

examples.en: What can Algeria hope for from their next two games against England and USA? Can Ghana be the surprise team of the group phase?

words.definition: something that you use to decorate something; decoration, dressing
words.translation: 装饰, 装饰品；[建][服装]装饰；装饰品

examples.zh: 它曾是一栋完全未经装修的大楼。

words.definition: a photograph; picture, pix
words.translation: 照片

examples.en: Can you take a photo of me and Rachel?
examples.zh: 你能给我和雷切尔拍张照吗？

examples.zh: 政治家应该是很好的沟通者，这很重要。

examples.zh: 这种瑜伽裸体进行，这一事实非常重要，因为在裸体的状态中，身体中的“毒素”会找到一个出口而后引向肉体与灵魂的净化。

examples.en: Buying a house had taken all their savings.
examples.zh: 买房子花掉了他们所有的积蓄。

words.translation: 使惊骇, 使大吃一惊；使惊骇；使震惊

examples.en: If we did all the things we are capable of, we would literally astound ourselves.
examples.zh: 如果我们所做的都是我们擅长的事情，我们最终将使自己大吃一惊。

examples.en: “You astound me!” Mrs. Willoughby said, pressing her clasped hands to her lips, a gesture she normally bestowed upon seniors who were making their final appearance in the spring choral concert.
examples.zh: “你真是令我大吃一惊啊！” 威洛比太太说道，双手紧紧的按在嘴唇上——这是她通常在毕业班学生参加春季合唱音乐会上最后献唱时才会做出的姿势。

words.definition: genetic predisposition, genetic constitution
words.translation: 身份 (identification, identity)；遗传素质；本能冲动

words.definition: if a seed germinates, or if it is germinated, it begins to grow; grow, bud; develop, put
words.translation: 发芽,使生长；使发芽；使生长；发芽；生长

examples.en: Some seed varieties germinate fast, so check every day or so.
examples.zh: 有一些品种的种子发芽快，所以差不多每天都要察看一下。

words.translation: [化]氮的, 含氮的；氮的；含氮的；硝石的

examples.en: ...nitric oxide.

examples.zh: 本月早些时候在维也纳为前联合国工作人员举行了午宴。

words.definition: stickiness, adhesiveness
words.translation: 粘质, 粘性；粘性，[物]粘度

words.translation: 侵入,强挤入；闯入；侵入；侵扰

examples.zh: 新闻媒体因以一种令人无法接受的方式侵入人们的私生活而受到谴责。

examples.zh: 我没有和女孩子约会的经验。

examples.en: The most important member of any hive is the queen bee.
examples.zh: 任何一个蜂房中最重要的成员都是蜂王。

examples.en: What people must remember is that one hive quickly become two, two become four and four become eight.
examples.zh: 人们一定要记住的是，一个蜂巢很快会变成两个，两个变成四个，四个变成八个。

examples.zh: 满是难懂术语的法律文件

examples.zh: 她显然烟瘾很大。

examples.zh: 他显然很痛。

examples.zh: 学校董事会还有两个职位空缺。

examples.zh: 地方议会正想方设法填补这些职缺。

examples.zh: 很多老房子现在都进行了修葺。

examples.zh: 贾森·辛森，衣阿华州金士敦附近的第六代玉米农。 他一边把玉米从行进作业中的联合收割机上卸下来，一边观察着螺旋钻。

words.translation: 习惯的, 惯例的；习惯的；通常的

examples.zh: 芭芭拉以惯有的热情作了回答。

examples.zh: 最高法院已经认可下级法院对这条法规的阐释。

examples.zh: 许多科学家计划等到调查结果被今后的研究证实了以后再作定论。

examples.zh: “给他们看海底的金属硫化物保护膜，他们就会认为这是一个六方会谈了”，他开玩笑的说。

examples.zh: 氢化硫转变为硫的过程十分复杂，通常是在有微生物（如细菌）存在的情况下才会发生。

examples.zh: 这些飞舞的泡沫携带着氢硫化物——河流污染中的一种常见有毒物，刺激着人的眼睛和呼吸系统。

examples.zh: ...乙醚和碘酒散发出的微甜味。

examples.zh: 他们的地图从此被摄影地图册取代。

examples.zh: 该物质经脱水处理后以粉末形式储存。

examples.zh: 选用维生素是因为他们控制了血液中一种叫高半胱氨酸的氨基酸的含量。

examples.zh: 作为评论家，他过于主观。

examples.zh: 工会领袖们在争取工作场所权利的斗争中正迈向胜利。

examples.en: Studying cold trap deposits has direct applicability to learning more about the planet Mercury, and lunar regolith contains information about the history of our Sun.

examples.zh: 以潮汐水道的繁复、泥滩和耐盐的红树林的小岛屿而著名。

examples.zh: 如果使用水质软化器减少饮用水中的矿物含量，就会降低水的作用。

examples.en: If critters were able to control pH at their calcification sites by buffering the acid in the surrounding water, as the calcareous green algae did, they also fared better.
examples.zh: 如果这些海洋生物象富含钙质的绿藻那样，能够通过缓解周围水中的酸性来控制钙化部位的pH值，它们也可能会应对得更好一些。

examples.en: The calcareous white stones of the river Piave constitute this land.
examples.zh: 皮亚韦河钙质的白色石头构成了这片土地。

words.definition: someone whose job is to make men’s clothes, that are measured to fit each customer perfectly; dressmaker, needlecraft, sartor, seamster

examples.zh: 当然，拿出一套对保护啄木鸟行之有效的方案，军方花了几年的功夫 ---- 这对于今天的生态保护工作不失为是一个教训。

examples.en: Savour the silence, if that's what nature serves up, or thrill to the tap-tap of the woodpecker.
examples.zh: 如果这是大自然奉上的一份佳肴，给这份宁静加点作料吧，或是因为啄木鸟的叩击声而兴奋起来吧。

words.definition: fellowship, companionship
words.translation: 友谊,友善；友谊；亲切；亲密

examples.en: His kind smile soon generated friendliness.
examples.zh: 他友善的微笑很快造成了友好的气氛。

examples.en: But American friendliness is not always an offer of true friendship.
examples.zh: 然而美国人的友好并不总是真正友情的表示。

words.definition: the feeling of being sorry for someone who is in a bad situation; acceptance, feeling, compassion, pity
words.translation: 同情, 同情心；同情；慰问；赞同

examples.en: Our sympathies are with the families of the victims.
examples.zh: 我们向受害者家庭表示慰问。

words.definition: the distance from the end of one wing to the end of the other
words.translation: [空]翼展

examples.en: ...a glider with an 18-foot wingspan.
examples.zh: ...一架翼幅为18英尺的滑翔机。

words.definition: the place where you pay or are served in a shop, bank, restaurant etc; arithmometer, counting machine; contrary, backward, conversely, inversely; Break back, knock back; contrary, opposite, adverse, cross
words.translation: 计算器,柜台；相反地；[数][电子][核][计量]计数器，计算器；[贸易]柜台；计算者；反击；反对；相反的

examples.en: He wondered if the girl behind the counter recognised him.
examples.zh: 他在想柜台后面的那个女孩是否认出了他。

words.definition: the land and buildings of a university or college, including the buildings where students live; schoolyard, college life
words.translation: <美>校园,大学教育；（大学）校园；大学，大学生活；校园内的草地

examples.en: a beautiful campus in New England
examples.zh: 新英格兰的一个美丽校园

words.definition: to burn or shine with an unsteady light that goes on and off quickly; spark, coruscate; gleam; movie, film, cinema
words.translation: 闪烁,摇曳；[电子][光]闪烁；摇曳；颤动；扑动翅膀；假装昏倒；[电子][光]使闪烁；使摇曳；闪光；电影

examples.en: The overhead lights flickered momentarily.
examples.zh: 头顶灯闪了一会儿。

words.definition: to officially accept a plan, proposal etc; confirm, agree, uphold, authorize; to ratify, give someone the green light
words.translation: 赞成, 批准；批准；赞成；为…提供证据；满意

examples.en: The conference approved a proposal for a referendum.
examples.zh: 会议通过了举行全民公决的提议。

words.definition: a heavy iron block on which pieces of hot metal are shaped using a hammer; incus, stithy
words.translation: [解]砧骨；[物]铁砧；[解剖]砧骨

examples.en: Scientists recently used a diamond anvil like this one to squeeze tiny samples of metallic glass.
examples.zh: 最近，科学家用一种像图中所示的菱形铁砧来压制金属玻璃的小样品。

examples.en: A senior civil servant in Morocco laments that his country is “between the hammer and the anvil” of Africa and Europe.
examples.zh: 一位摩洛哥高级文职官员不无惋惜地表示，自己的国家是身处非洲和欧洲的"锤砧之间"。

examples.en: Nut-cracking, for example, is a complex skill that involves placing a nut between an anvil stone and a hammer stone and coordinating the movements to hit the nut just right.
examples.zh: 例如，弄碎坚果是一项复杂的技能，需要将坚果放在石砧和石锤之间，然后调整动作以恰当的方式击打坚果。

words.definition: nearness in distance or time; approach, neighborhood
words.translation: 接近, 亲近；亲近，接近；[数]邻近

examples.en: Here the rich and the poor live in close proximity (= very near to each other ) .
examples.zh: 在这里，富人和穷人比邻而居。

words.definition: the quality of being excellent; virtue, strength, morality
words.translation: 优秀, 卓越；优秀；美德；长处

examples.en: centres of academic excellence
examples.zh: 成就卓著的学术中心

words.definition: simple, turkey, put, idiot, stupid
words.translation: 傻子,铁球棒；笨蛋；铁球棒；红海龟

words.definition: If one thing pertains to another, it relates, belongs, or applies to it; gear, serve
words.translation: 适合, 属于；属于；关于；适合

examples.en: ...matters pertaining to naval district defence.
examples.zh: …与海军区域防卫有关的问题。

words.definition: an act of explaining and showing how to do something or how something works; authentication, certification, proof, evidence, march
words.translation: 示范, 实证；示范；证明；示威游行

examples.en: a cookery demonstration
examples.zh: 烹饪示范

words.definition: A dike is a thick wall that is built to stop water flooding onto very low-lying land from a river or from the ocean; barrier, block, bottleneck
words.translation: 堤防；筑堤提防；堤防，堤坝；障碍物；（英）壕沟

examples.en: When the river dike is completed, the crops will be safe against floods.
examples.zh: 修好河堤， 庄稼就不怕淹了。

examples.en: The dyke (or dike in American English) intrudes through the even older rocks of African craton, the core of oldest rocks forming the continent of Africa.
examples.zh: 堤防（或美式英语堤）通过侵入非洲克拉通形成的最古老的非洲大陆岩石核心的更老的岩石。

examples.en: “When the National Health Museum called, I’d never heard of iStockphoto, ” he says. “But now, I see it as the first hole in the dike.”
examples.zh: “国家健康博物馆给我打电话的时候，我还从未听说过 iStockphoto，”他说道，“但现在，我认为它是堤岸上的第一个蚁穴。”

words.definition: something that is ineffective does not achieve what it is intended to achieve; useless, invalid
words.translation: 无效的, (指人)工作效率低的；无效的，失效的；不起作用的

examples.en: an ineffective marketing campaign
examples.zh: 一场毫无成效的营销活动

words.definition: able or likely to explode; a substance that can cause an explosion; volatile, fulminic; blasting agent, detonator
words.translation: 爆炸(性)的,暴露；爆炸物；[力]爆炸的；爆炸性的；爆发性的；[化工]炸药；[力]爆炸物

examples.en: Because the gas is highly explosive, it needs to be kept in high-pressure containers.
examples.zh: 由于这种气体极易爆炸，因此需要保存在高压容器内。

examples.en: A small explosive device (= bomb ) was set off outside the UN headquarters today.
examples.zh: 今天有一枚小型炸弹在联合国总部外爆炸。

words.definition: the upper surface of a roof; housetop
words.translation: 屋顶；屋顶上的

examples.en: Spectators stood on rooftops to watch the parade.
examples.zh: 观众站在屋顶上观看庆祝游行。

words.definition: between the planets
words.translation: 太阳系内的,行星间的

examples.en: interplanetary space missions
examples.zh: 星际太空飞行任务

words.definition: someone who performs in a play or film
words.translation: 男演员,行动者

examples.en: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
examples.zh: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

words.definition: beautiful or attractive; pleasant, pretty, taking, grateful, cute
words.translation: 可爱的,有趣的；可爱的；令人愉快的

examples.en: She had a lovely face.
examples.zh: 她有一张漂亮的脸蛋。

examples.en: What a lovely house!
examples.zh: 多么漂亮的房子啊！

examples.en: You look lovely in that dress.
examples.zh: 你穿那条连衣裙很漂亮。

words.definition: Zhang, chapter
words.translation: 头, 首；[解剖]头；章

examples.en: Chronic portal hypertension may lead to development of collateral circulation , which is manifested as caput medusa in the region of the umbilicus and epigastrium.
examples.zh: 慢性门脉高压可导致侧枝循环建立，可出现脐部和上腹部局部水母头样改变。

words.definition: qualia, sensitibility
words.translation: 感受性,接受能力；[植]感受性；接受能力

examples.en: Group intelligence is correlated, Malone and his colleagues found, with the average social sensitivity — the openness, and receptiveness, to others — of a group's constituents.
examples.zh: 马龙和他的同事们发现团队智能是和团队成员的平均社会敏感度——开放性，接受能力等等相关联的。

words.definition: to make someone suffer because they have done something wrong or broken the law; penalise, chastise; drop across, come down on
words.translation: 惩罚,处罚；惩罚；严厉对待；贪婪地吃喝

examples.en: Smacking is not an acceptable way of punishing a child.
examples.zh: 要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。

examples.en: He promised to punish severely any officials found guilty of electoral fraud.
examples.zh: 他承诺要严惩任何在选举中有欺诈行为的官员。

examples.en: They deserve to be punished for putting passengers at risk.
examples.zh: 他们置乘客于危险之中，理应受到惩罚。

words.definition: Something that is animate has life, in contrast to things like stones and machines which do not; stimulate, lift, spirit, force, drive; lived, zoetic
words.translation: 鼓舞；生气勃勃的；使有生气；使活泼；推动；[生物]有生命的

examples.en: Natural philosophy involved the study of all aspects of the material world, animate and inanimate.
examples.zh: 自然哲学涉及到了对包括有生命体与无生命体的物质世界的全面研究。

words.definition: Militaristic is used to describe groups, ideas, or policies which support the strengthening of the armed forces of their country in order to make it more powerful
words.translation: 军国主义的

examples.en: ...aggressive militaristic governments.
examples.zh: ...侵略性的军国主义政府。

words.definition: the area of a piece of land measured in acres; area, proportion
words.translation: 英亩数, 面积；面积，[测]英亩数

examples.en: The Palestinians would balk at that as far too much, even if they got the equivalent acreage back, perhaps adjacent to the Gaza Strip.
examples.zh: 巴基斯坦方对于这个提议望而却步，即便他们能换回同样多的英亩数，还有可能得到加沙地带的邻近区域。

examples.en: The prevailing price levels for critical commodities should see a significant acreage response in the coming months as countries begin their cultivation cycles.
examples.zh: 现行价格水平为关键的商品应该会看到一个显着的反应面积在未来数月随着各国开始他们的培养周期。

words.definition: simulation, imitation
words.translation: 扮演；模仿；装扮

examples.en: Convinced of his own righteousness, he was the perfect impersonation of a man of rectitude.
examples.zh: 他确信自己很正直，可以完美地扮演刚正不阿的人。

words.translation: 再吸附,重吸收

examples.en: It could just be a cyst that would either reabsorb itself into the body or need to be surgically removed.
examples.zh: 它也有可能仅仅是一个囊肿，能被身体再吸收或者通过手术就可以把它给切除掉。

examples.en: Building huge air-capture plants to reabsorb the carbon dioxide produced by burning fossil fuels would be a perverse outcome.
examples.zh: 建造超大型空气捕捉站来重吸收二氧化碳也许会出人意料的产生可燃烧的化石燃料。

words.definition: an act of interfering; conflict, disturbance, war, obstacle, collision
words.translation: 冲突, 干涉；[通信][物][医]干扰，冲突；干涉

examples.en: Industrial relations should be free from state interference.
examples.zh: 劳资关系应不受政府干预。

words.definition: if you overturn something, or if it overturns, it turns upside down or falls over on its side; destroy, throw down; tip, throw down; capsizal, turn-round
words.translation: 倾覆, 破灭；推翻, 颠倒；推翻；倾覆；破坏；周转；破灭

examples.en: We saw the canoe overturn, throwing its passengers into the water.
examples.zh: 我们看到独木舟倾覆了，把上面的乘客掀入水中。

words.definition: a man with the highest social rank outside the royal family; emperor, sovereignty
words.translation: 公爵；[纸]公爵，（公国的）君主；公爵（种）樱桃

examples.en: the Duke of Norfolk
examples.zh: 诺福克公爵

words.definition: directly and firmly; just, direct
words.translation: 方形地, 直角地；直角地；诚实地；正好；干脆地；正当地

examples.en: He turned and faced her squarely.
examples.zh: 他转过身来和她正面相对。

examples.en: She hit him squarely on the nose.
examples.zh: 她不偏不倚地打在他的鼻子上。

words.translation: 亨德森（姓氏）

examples.en: It was built for one of the Henderson family, right?
examples.zh: 它是为了亨德森家族的一个成员建的，对吧？

examples.en: Come to the Henderson Language School and change your life.
examples.zh: 来到亨德森语言学校，就会改变你的一生。

examples.en: In 1950, roughly one in 20 men of prime working age, like Henderson, was not working; today that ratio is about one in five, the highest ever recorded.
examples.zh: 1950年，大约每20名处于适龄工作年龄的男人中，就有一名像亨德森这样没有工作的；现在这一比例约为五分之一，是历史最高纪录。

words.definition: a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase, such as ‘he’ instead of ‘Peter’ or ‘the man’
words.translation: 代名词

examples.en: Now if we could only figure out the pronoun problem.
examples.zh: 现在我们可以解决这个代词问题了。

words.definition: someone who is taken by force and kept somewhere; capture, galley slave
words.translation: 囚犯的；战俘；囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告

examples.en: He was being held prisoner.
examples.zh: 他正遭囚禁。

examples.en: Our pilot was taken prisoner .
examples.zh: 我们的飞行员被抓起来了。

examples.en: The army advanced, taking 200,000 prisoners .
examples.zh: 军队向前推进，抓获20万名俘虏。

words.definition: the tenth month of the year, between September and November
words.translation: 十月(略作Oct)

examples.en: Most seasonal hiring is done in early October.
examples.zh: 多数季节性招聘是在10月初进行。

words.definition: leather that is in its natural state; peltry
words.translation: 生牛皮；用生牛皮鞭抽打；生牛皮的；生皮；生皮鞭

examples.en: At his belt he carried a rawhide whip.
examples.zh: 他腰间别着一根生牛皮制作的鞭子。

words.definition: not of or relating to agriculture
words.translation: 非农业的

examples.en: Many causes have been proposed for both the intelligence gap and the Flynn effect, including education, income, and even nonagricultural labor.
examples.zh: 人们对智力差距和弗林效应提出了许多成因，包括教育、收入，甚至还包括非农业劳动。

examples.en: There has been "good" progress in persuading locals, mostly people engaged in nonagricultural activities, to give up land, she says.
examples.zh: 她指出，针对当地居民的说服工作已经取得喜人的进展，大部分未从事农业活动的居民表示愿意放弃土地。

words.definition: a valley – used in the past or in the names of places, especially in the North of England; mountain valley, hollow
words.translation: 宽谷, 溪谷；山谷；排水孔

examples.en: the Yorkshire Dales National Park
examples.zh: 约克郡山谷国家公园

words.definition: Devastation is severe and widespread destruction or damage; demolition, disruption
words.translation: 毁坏,荒废；毁坏，荒废

examples.en: The war brought massive devastation and loss of life to the region.
examples.zh: 战争给该地区造成巨大的破坏以及生命的丧失。

words.definition: a person who makes arrows
words.translation: <古>造箭者,弗莱彻

words.definition: in a way that is surprising because it is the opposite of what you would expect; abnormally, eccentrically
words.translation: 相矛盾地,似非而是地；自相矛盾地；似非而是地；反常地

examples.en: Paradoxically, the prohibition of liquor caused an increase in alcoholism.
examples.zh: 矛盾的是，禁酒反而导致酗酒的增加。

words.definition: deserving or able to be believed or trusted; responsible, reliable, tried, honest, safe
words.translation: 可信的,可靠的；可靠的，可信的

examples.en: Her excuse was barely credible.
examples.zh: 她的借口无法让人信服。

examples.en: a credible alternative to nuclear power
examples.zh: 原子能的可靠替代物

words.definition: a musical instrument like a thin pipe, that you play by holding it across your lips, blowing over a hole, and pressing down buttons with your fingers
words.translation: 长笛；吹长笛,刻槽

examples.en: The boy trilled on a flute.
examples.zh: 男孩在长笛上吹颤音。

examples.en: He played a nice tune on the flute.
examples.zh: 他吹奏了一首优美的笛子曲。

examples.en: A pipe organ gives much more volume than a violin or flute.
examples.zh: 管风琴发出的音量比小提琴或笛子都大。

words.definition: to start using computers and machines to do a job, rather than people; robotize
words.translation: 使自动化, 自动操作；使自动化，使自动操作

examples.en: Cash machines automate two basic functions of a bank – deposits and withdrawals.
examples.zh: 柜员机使银行的两个基本功能——存款和取款自动化了。

words.definition: the practice of teaching or the study of teaching; education, struction
words.translation: 教学, 教授；教育；教育学；教授法

examples.en: I’ve learned as much about teaching from learning about marketing as I have from studying pedagogy – maybe more.
examples.zh: 我从销售上学到的有关教育的东西和我研究教育学时候学到的一样多——可能更多。

examples.en: They are making progress by investing in research, reforming traditional approaches to curricula and pedagogy, and beginning to attract outstanding faculty from abroad.
examples.zh: 他们必然要斥巨资投入研究，改革现就的传统的教育模式和课程设置，并积极吸引外国外国教员。

words.definition: if a woman or female animal is pregnant, she has an unborn baby growing inside her body; cyetic, childing
words.translation: 怀孕的, 重要的；怀孕的；富有意义的

examples.en: care for pregnant women
examples.zh: 孕妇保健

examples.en: I knew right away that I was pregnant.
examples.zh: 我立即明白我怀孕了。

examples.en: I thought I was too old to get pregnant .
examples.zh: 我觉得自己年龄太大，已经不能怀孕了。

words.definition: a particular quality in someone’s character; quality, tang, identity, sort, distinction
words.translation: 显著的特点, 特性；特性，特点；[心理]品质；少许

examples.en: The study found that some alcoholics had clear personality traits showing up early in childhood.
examples.zh: 这项研究发现一些酗酒者早在孩童时就表现出明显的个性特征。

words.definition: freedom that a place or an organization has to govern or control itself; self-rule, swaraj
words.translation: 自治；自治，自治权

examples.en: campaigners who want greater autonomy for Corsica
examples.zh: 希望科西嘉有更多自治权的活动家

words.definition: exuberant decorations, patterns etc are exciting and complicated or colourful; lively, rank
words.translation: 繁茂的,生气勃勃的；繁茂的；生气勃勃的，充溢的

examples.en: exube-rant carvings
examples.zh: 充满生气的雕刻品

words.definition: a choice you can make in a particular situation; election, choice
words.translation: 选项, 选择权；[计]选项；选择权；买卖的特权

examples.en: There are a number of options available.
examples.zh: 有多种选择。

examples.en: He had two options.
examples.zh: 他有两种选择。

examples.en: This was not the only option open to him.
examples.zh: 这并非是他的唯一选择。

words.definition: A reaper is a machine used to cut and gather crops; harvester, cropper
words.translation: 收割者, 收割机；[农机]收割者；收割机；收获者

words.definition: restlessly, disturbedly
words.translation: 忧虑地, 不安地；不安地，忧虑地

examples.en: Sometimes kids would come to the set, and I could see them looking at me anxiously.
examples.zh: 偶尔，会有小孩来剧组参观，我可以看出他们不安地看著我。

words.definition: a very large grey animal with four legs, two tusks(= long curved teeth ) and a trunk(= long nose ) that it can use to pick things up
words.translation: 象

examples.en: A trunk distinguishes the elephant.
examples.zh: 长鼻是象的特征。

examples.en: So the part of the elephant I experience applies what we know about people and how we apply that to UX design.
examples.zh: 所以，我体验的那部分的大象就是我们对人的了解和我们将我们的了解应用于用户体验设计。

examples.en: Tom: No.Although 75% of its raw materials is elephant dung, it is light delicate fragrance instead of stink. This is due to its special fabrication technology.
examples.zh: 不，尽管这种纸里75％的原料都是大象的粪便，但它不但不臭，反而有一种淡淡的清香，这是源于它的特殊的制造工艺。

words.definition: a disease that causes death and spreads quickly to a large number of people; to cause pain, suffering, or trouble to someone, especially for a long period of time; disaster, trouble, headache; harry, worry, trouble, tear, devil
words.translation: 瘟疫,麻烦；折磨, 使苦恼；[医]瘟疫；灾祸；麻烦；讨厌的人；折磨；使苦恼；使得灾祸

examples.en: drops in population levels due to plagues and famines
examples.zh: 瘟疫和饥荒造成的人口水平下降

words.definition: to shout loudly in a deep voice; shout at sb., burst out; gnar, huff and puff
words.translation: 怒吼, 咆哮；大声喊叫；大声发出；吼叫；怒吼；咆哮

examples.en: ‘That’s your problem!’ bellowed Hurley.
examples.zh: “那是你的问题！”赫尔利吼道。

examples.en: Tony was bellowing orders.
examples.zh: 托尼正在吆喝着发号施令。

words.definition: an experience, situation etc that is unreal seems so strange that you think you must be imagining it; impossible, untrue
words.translation: 不真实的, 虚幻的；不真实的；假的；幻想的；虚构的

examples.en: It seemed unreal to be sitting and talking to someone so famous.
examples.zh: 和这么一位大名鼎鼎的人坐在一起谈话似乎很不真实。

words.definition: to like someone very much, especially when you have known them for a long time and almost feel love for them; pleased, tender, soft, favorite, pet
words.translation: 喜欢的,温柔的；喜欢的；温柔的；宠爱的

examples.en: Joe’s quite fond of her, isn’t he?
examples.zh: 乔很喜欢她，是不是？

examples.en: Over the years we’ve grown very fond of each other.
examples.zh: 这些年来，我们渐渐喜欢上了对方。

words.definition: a small animal that looks like a large  frog  and lives mostly on land; hoptoad, sad apple
words.translation: [动]蟾蜍；[脊椎]蟾蜍；癞蛤蟆；讨厌的家伙

words.definition: to pull or lift something very heavy with one great effort; a strong rising or falling movement; lift up, hold up; wave, roll; up with, putting, fluctuation, cast, lift
words.translation: 举起；举起,投掷；使起伏；投掷；恶心；发出（叹息等）；起伏；喘息；呕吐；一阵呕吐

examples.en: Michael’s shoulders heaved with silent laughter.
examples.zh: 迈克尔憋着不笑出声来，双肩直抖。

words.definition: a public celebration when musical bands, brightly decorated vehicles etc move down the street; to walk or march together to celebrate or protest about something; display, pageant; show off, brag about; file, show off
words.translation: 游行,炫耀；游行；阅兵；炫耀；行进；阅兵场；列队行进

examples.en: a victory parade
examples.zh: 胜利游行

examples.en: the St Patrick’s Day parade
examples.zh: 圣帕特里克节庆祝游行

words.definition: willing to consider new ideas or listen to someone else’s opinions
words.translation: 善于接受的,能容纳的

examples.en: You might find them in a more receptive mood tomorrow.
examples.zh: 也许他们明天会更乐于接受意见。

examples.en: a receptive audience
examples.zh: 愿意倾听的观众

words.definition: the range of things that a subject, activity, book etc deals with; extent, boundary, region, spectrum, territory, range, area
words.translation: (活动)范围；范围；余地；视野；眼界；导弹射程

examples.en: measures to limit the scope of criminals’ activities
examples.zh: 限制罪犯活动范围的措施

words.definition: not planned or expected; unexpected, sudden, surprising
words.translation: 意外的,在计划外的；意外的；在计划外的；未经筹划的

examples.en: an unplanned pregnancy
examples.zh: 意外怀孕

words.definition: the amount of time that someone or something lives; age, macrobiosis
words.translation: 长命, 寿命；长寿，长命；[生物]寿命

examples.en: The ancient Chinese claimed that garlic promoted longevity.
examples.zh: 中国古人说蒜能延寿。

words.definition: to give a plan, piece of writing etc to someone in authority for them to consider or approve; maintain, advocate; put in, hand in
words.translation: (使)服从,递交；使服从；主张；呈递；[计]提交；服从

examples.en: In desperation, Mrs. Jones submitted to an operation on her right knee to relieve the pain.
examples.zh: 绝望中，琼斯夫人不得已接受了一次她右膝的手术以减轻疼痛。

words.definition: a member of a tribe that travels from place to place instead of living in one place all the time, usually in order to find grass for their animals; Vagabonds, Nads; ragamuffinly, migratory
words.translation: 游牧部落的人,流浪者；游牧的；游牧民；流浪者；流浪的

examples.en: ...a country of nomads who raise cattle and camels.
examples.zh: ...一个饲养牛和骆驼的游牧国家。

words.translation: 蒙古

examples.en: Mongolia really is the land of opportunity.
examples.zh: 蒙古是名副其实的机会之地。

examples.en: Mongolia should begin uranium mining in about 2013, he said.
examples.zh: 他并称,蒙古应该能在2013年前后开始开采铀矿.

words.definition: the clarity of a piece of writing, law, argument etc is its quality of being expressed clearly; transparency, perspicuousness
words.translation: 清楚,透明；清楚，明晰；[化学]透明

examples.en: Letters may be edited for length and clarity.
examples.zh: 信件可能要加以修改以求篇幅合适，意思明了。

examples.en: a lack of clarity in the law on property rights
examples.zh: 产权法律含糊不清

words.translation: 性别地,两性之间地

words.definition: existence, livelihood, way of life
words.translation: 生活方式, 生活；生活方式；生活

examples.en: That alternative is to bring freedom back into existence by taking it back - back to the love of freedom, to our lifeway.
examples.zh: 那选择是把自由带回生活存在 夺回来 回到自由的爱 回到我们生活的路.

examples.en: Such must lead to a conceptual revolution of human being's future lifeway by which Smart Card be the most important, most convenient and most indispensable tool in the 21st century.
examples.zh: 这必将导致全人类未来生活方式的概念性演变，从而使智能卡成为21世纪人类最重要、最便利、最不可缺的工具。

words.definition: the front of a building, especially a large and important one; garment, right side
words.translation: 正面；表面；外观

examples.en: an impressive building with a red brick facade
examples.zh: 正面为红砖的雄伟建筑

words.definition: involving strong emotions, especially of sexual love; intense, warm, hot, tropical, enthusiastic
words.translation: 晒热的,热情的；[气象]晒热的；热情的

examples.en: a torrid love affair
examples.zh: 狂热的风流韵事

words.definition: a school for children aged two to five; play school, nursery school
words.translation: 幼儿园；幼儿园的,启蒙阶段的；幼稚园

examples.en: To my kindergarten.
examples.zh: 去我的幼儿园。

examples.en: She looks after children in the kindergarten.
examples.zh: 她在幼儿园照看孩子。

words.definition: a type of cell that makes up the nervous system and sends messages to other parts of the body or the brain; nerve fiber
words.translation: [解]神经细胞,神经元；[解剖]神经元，神经单位

examples.en: What it does mean is that, for whatever reason, this particular neuron was activated by this particular scene, almost certainly with a network of other neurons across the brain.
examples.zh: 他确切的意思是:无论是处于什么原因，这个特别的神经元会被特别的场景激活，当然，是和大脑中同一个网状下的其它神经元一起工作的。

words.definition: the process of sending out electronic signals, messages etc, using radio, television, or other similar equipment; gear, driving device
words.translation: 播送, 发射；传动装置，[机]变速器；传递；[计][通信]传送；播送

examples.en: worldwide data transmission
examples.zh: 全球数据传输

words.definition: any member of the Eukarya, a domain of organisms having cells each with a distinct nucleus within which the genetic material is contained; eucaryon
words.translation: 〈生〉真核细胞；真核细胞（等于eucaryote）

examples.en: Scientists now know that this common ancestor, 'the first eukaryote', was a lot more sophisticated than any known bacterium.
examples.zh: 科学家现在知道，这个共同的祖先，“第一真核生物”比任何已知的细菌都要复杂得多。

examples.en: Grypania may have been either a bacterial colony or a eukaryote — an organism with specialized cells, enclosed in a membrane.
examples.zh: 卷曲藻可能是一个菌落，或者一种真核生物——其包裹在细胞膜内的细胞功能已经出现分化的生物体。

words.definition: (of two different species of plant or animal) living in close association, such that one species benefits without harming the other; a commensal plant or animal; symbiote; symbiotic, paragenetic
words.translation: 共餐的；共食伙伴, 共生物；共餐者；[生态]共生体；[生态]共生的；同桌的

examples.en: Widespread outbreaks of intestinal disease are so rare that the commensal bacteria face little danger of extermination.
examples.zh: 而且发达国家大规模爆发肠道疾病的可能性很小，使共栖菌被消灭的危险性也大大降低。

examples.en: Under their theory, it is in these biofilms in the appendix, well positioned to avoid pathogens in the rest of the gut, that commensal bacteria take refuge.
examples.zh: 按照他们的理论，正是这些阑尾中的生物薄膜给共栖菌提供了一个避难所，因为阑尾在人体内的有利位置使共栖菌避免受到其他肠道病原体的侵袭。

words.definition: the way that you earn money or the money that you earn; alive now; realistic, existing, active, excited, going; life, existence, livelihood, keep, subsistence; spending, dwelling
words.translation: 生活,生计；活的,逼真的；活的；现存的；活跃的；逼真的；生活；生存；生计；居住（live的ing形式）；度过

examples.en: It’s not a great job, but it’s a living.
examples.zh: 这不是什么了不起的工作，不过是一种生计。

examples.en: What do youdo for a living? (= what do you do as a job? )
examples.zh: 你是做什么营生的？

words.definition: without realizing what you are doing; unintentionally, carelessly
words.translation: 非故意地,不注意地；非故意地；不注意地

examples.en: Viruses can be spread inadvertently by email users.
examples.zh: 病毒会被电子邮件用户无意中传播开来。

examples.en: Robinson’s name was inadvertently omitted from the list.
examples.zh: 鲁宾逊的名字被人无意之中从名单上漏掉了。

words.definition: a unit for measuring the force of an electric current; jook
words.translation: (马术中的)环骑,[电工]伏特；伏特（电压单位）；环骑；闪避

examples.en: That is one electron volt.
examples.zh: 就是一单位的电子伏特。

examples.en: If I multiply these two, what is the coulomb times a volt?
examples.zh: 如果我把这两个乘起来，库仑乘以伏特是多少？

words.definition: the material used to make a road; subgrade, carriage-way
words.translation: 路基；[公路][铁路]路基；车行道

examples.en: The earthquake made the roadbed cave in.
examples.zh: 地震后路基沉陷了。

examples.en: Climbing quickly down a steel ladder, he paused at the bottom, two feet above the roadbed flashing by.
examples.zh: 他疾速攀下铁梯，停在梯子最后—级上，离他脚下飞速掠过的铁路路基有两英尺。

examples.en: As for implanting chargers in the roadbed, that technology is "fascinating, and very expensive, " Smith says.
examples.zh: 至于在路基里埋设充电器，Smith表示这项技术“很棒，但也很贵”。

words.definition: If something encompasses particular things, it includes them; involve, contain, carry out, accomplish, achieve
words.translation: 包围,环绕；包含；包围，环绕；完成

examples.en: His repertoire encompassed everything from Bach to Schoenberg.
examples.zh: 他的表演曲目从巴赫到勋伯格，样样俱全。

words.definition: to be more in number than another group; overnumber
words.translation: 数目超过, 比多；[计划]数目超过；比…多

examples.en: Flats outnumber houses in this area.
examples.zh: 这个地区公寓房比独栋房子多。

examples.en: His troops were hopelessly outnumbered.
examples.zh: 他的军队在数量上远远不及对方。

words.definition: a permanent mark that is left on your skin after you have had a cut or wound; if a wound or cut scars you, it leaves a permanent mark on your body; knife, injure; cure, heal up; wound, trauma
words.translation: 伤痕,疤痕；结疤,使留下伤痕；伤害；给留下伤痕；结疤；痊愈；创伤；伤痕

examples.en: He had a long, curved scar on his right cheek.
examples.zh: 他的右脸上有一道弯弯的长疤。

examples.en: a deep cut that could leave a permanent scar
examples.zh: 可能会留下永久性疤痕的一道很深的伤口

words.definition: to change food in your body into energy and new cells, using chemical processes; transfigure
words.translation: 产生代谢变化；使新陈代谢；使变形

examples.en: Diabetics cannot metabolize glucose properly.
examples.zh: 糖尿病患者不能使葡萄糖进行恰当的新陈代谢。

words.definition: to manage the work or money of a company or organization; manage, afford, perform, conduct, implement
words.translation: 管理, 给予, 执行；管理；执行；给予

examples.en: The money will be administered by local charities.
examples.zh: 这笔资金将由当地慈善机构管理。

examples.en: Our office administers the affairs of the Society.
examples.zh: 我们办公室管理协会的事务。

words.definition: to firmly close a window, gate etc so that it will not open, or to become firmly closed; focus on, fix; pay attention, take hold
words.translation: 扎牢,扣住；使固定；集中于；扎牢；强加于；扣紧；抓住；集中注意力

examples.en: Make sure all the windows are securely fastened before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前要确保所有的窗子都已关严。

words.definition: to change something or to make it change so that there is more variety; vary, variegate
words.translation: 使多样化, 作多样性的投资；使多样化，使变化；增加产品种类以扩大

examples.en: User requirements have diversified over the years.
examples.zh: 这几年来，用户需求已经多样化。

words.definition: Grumble is also a noun; to keep complaining in an unhappy way; beef about, repine; earful, querimony; mouth
words.translation: 嘟囔地说；怨言；发牢骚；抱怨；嘟囔；喃喃地说出

examples.en: My only grumble is that there isn't a non-smoking section.
examples.zh: 我惟一的抱怨是这儿没有无烟区。

words.definition: the process by which something changes to a worse condition; regression, corruption, deterioration, degeneration
words.translation: 降级, 降格, 退化；[生物]退化；降格，[电子]降级；堕落

examples.en: ...air pollution, traffic congestion, and the steady degradation of our quality of life.
examples.zh: …空气污染、交通阻塞以及我们生活质量的持续恶化。

words.translation: [微]脉孢菌

words.definition: money that is paid by a government or organization to make prices lower, reduce the cost of producing goods etc; pension, allowance
words.translation: 补助金,津贴；[财政]补贴；[劳经]津贴；[会计][经]补助金

examples.en: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
examples.zh: 欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

words.translation: 常识的,具有常识的

examples.en: I mean, in spite of this commonsense explanation, we are going to see how to prove this.
examples.zh: 我的意思是，不管常识怎么解释的，我们都将看看如何证明这个定理。

examples.en: If you now look at Hume's have to say about science, a lot of it will look like commonsense.
examples.zh: 如果你现在看看休谟关于自然科学所说的内容，里面的大部分看起来像是常识。

examples.en: At the time it was very far from commonsense and it's a mark of how far we have come that we now accept the ultimate principles of science are ones that we cannot hope to base on pure reason.
examples.zh: 但是当那些内容远没有成为常识的时代,当我们如今已经接受的,自然科学和最终原理还未被采纳的时代,我们不能寄希望于纯粹的推理。

words.definition: the place that someone or something is going to; goal, end-point
words.translation: 目的地；[计]目的地，终点

examples.en: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
examples.zh: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

words.translation: 黄石国家公园, 黄石河

words.definition: a small flying insect that sucks the blood of people and animals, sometimes spreading the disease  malaria; skeeter
words.translation: 蚊子

examples.en: The male mosquito never stings.
examples.zh: 雄蚊不叮。

examples.en: Are your mosquito bites still itching?
examples.zh: 你被蚊子咬的地方还痒吗?

examples.en: The frog darted out its tongue to catch a mosquito.
examples.zh: 这只青蛙突然伸出舌头捕捉蚊子。

words.definition: shortage, deficiency, short of, need, drought
words.translation: 极小量；缺乏；少数；少量

words.definition: to give someone a disease; affect, contract, catch, disease, communicate
words.translation: [医] 传染, 感染；[医]感染，传染

examples.en: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
examples.zh: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

words.definition: a chisel of tempered steel with a sharp lozenge-shaped point, used for engraving furrows in metal, wood, or marble; graver, engraving tool
words.translation: 冰凿,雕刻刀；[轻]雕刻刀，錾刀；雕刻风格

words.definition: a large sea animal with two long tusks(= things like teeth ) coming down from the sides of its mouth; sea elephant, sea-ox
words.translation: [动]海象, 海象胡须；[脊椎]海象

words.definition: to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour; be deserving of
words.translation: 应受, 值得；应受，应得

examples.en: What have I done to deserve this?
examples.zh: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

examples.en: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
examples.zh: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

examples.en: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
examples.zh: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

words.definition: a heated container for keeping eggs warm until they hatch(= the young birds are born ); hatcher, brooder
words.translation: 培养的器具, 孵卵器；[禽]孵卵器；[儿科]保温箱；早产儿保育器；细菌培养器

words.definition: a building where very poor people in the past could live and be fed, which was paid for with public money; xenodochium, asylum
words.translation: 救济院

examples.en: Transport most of us to ancient Rome and we’ll find ourselves in a poorhouse or slave barracks.
examples.zh: 把我们中的大多数传送到古罗马去，基本只能住救济院或奴隶营房呢。

examples.en: The fact is, if the task were left entirely up to him, we’d be in the poorhouse on just his purchases of mega-jars of pickles.
examples.zh: 事实是，如果这个任务完全交给他，我们会因为他购买大罐腌菜而住在救济院中。

words.definition: if a government or organization subsidizes a company, activity etc, it pays part of its costs; fund, stake
words.translation: 资助,津贴；资助；给与奖助金；向…行贿

examples.en: Farming is heavily subsidized (= subsidized a lot ) by the government.
examples.zh: 农业得到政府的大量补贴。

words.definition: the act or process of exciting or state of being excited; stimulus, incentive, animation, warmth, needle
words.translation: 刺激,兴奋, 激动；[物][力]激发，刺激；[电子]激励；激动

words.definition: of or relating to the amnion
words.translation: [昆] 羊膜的

examples.en: The amniotic fluid cushioning the baby in your uterus has reached its highest level this week.
examples.zh: 这周，子宫里起缓冲作用的羊水达到了它最高的水平。

examples.en: Perhaps we are really talking about amniotic fluid, which surrounds the foetus in the birth sac.
examples.zh: 也许我们真正在谈论的是羊水，也就是包围着胎儿的那些液体。

examples.en: Your baby is practicing swallowing amniotic fluid this week working out her digestive system and absorbing water into her body.
examples.zh: 婴儿这击会开始练习吞咽羊水，锻炼她的消化系统，吸收水到她体内。

words.definition: a sea animal that looks similar to a  dolphin  and breathes air; sea hog, common dolphin
words.translation: [动]海豚, 小鲸；[脊椎]海豚；鼠海豚

examples.en: The rays are often seen gathering in groups near the surface, “flying” through the water by flapping their pectoral fins and sometimes even leaping porpoise-like into the air.
examples.zh: 魟鱼经常会成群的聚集在水面以下，通过拍动胸鳍在水中“飞行”，有时候甚至会像海豚一样跃出海面。

examples.en: The Baiji Conservation Aquarium has already scored small successes with a similar breeding scheme aimed at averting the extinction of the endangered Yangtze finless porpoise.
examples.zh: 为防止这种无鳍海豚的灭绝，白鳍豚保护水族馆采用相同的培育方法已经取得了一些成就。

examples.en: Still, she cautions that it's possible that the Dall's porpoise hunt in Japan may harm subpopulations of that animal, which numbers more than a million worldwide.
examples.zh: 然而，他警告在日本的捕猎可能危害白腰鼠海豚的亚种的安全，尽管白腰鼠海豚全种在地球上有一百多万只。

words.definition: to flow out of something quickly in large quantities, or to make something flow out in this way; belch out, spout out; shoot the cat, hork
words.translation: 喷涌,呕吐；喷出；呕吐；喷涌

examples.en: Factory chimneys spewed fumes out into the sky.
examples.zh: 工厂的烟囱向空中喷吐浓烟。

words.definition: to produce a smell, light etc, or to show a particular quality; to send out, give off
words.translation: 散发,发出；发出；散发；发源

examples.en: He emanates tranquility.
examples.zh: 他身上散发着一种恬静气质。

words.definition: harmful or poisonous; harmful, toxic, evil, poisonous, rank
words.translation: 有害的；有毒的；败坏道德的；讨厌的

examples.en: noxious fumes
examples.zh: 有毒烟雾

words.definition: to change what you are doing so that you are not following an expected plan, idea, or type of behaviour; out of contact, break away; diverge
words.translation: 偏离,偏轨；脱离；越轨；使偏离

examples.en: They stopped you as soon as you deviated from the script.
examples.zh: 你一偏离剧本，他们就会叫停。

words.definition: to deliberately avoid someone or something; escape, shy off
words.translation: 避开,避免；避开，避免；回避

examples.en: a shy woman who shunned publicity
examples.zh: 不爱抛头露面的羞怯女子

examples.en: Victims of the disease found themselves shunned by society.
examples.zh: 患这种病的人发现，社会上的人都躲着 他们。

words.definition: separately, not together in a group; separately, personally, alone, solely
words.translation: 个别地,单独地；个别地，单独地

examples.en: The bridegroom thanked them all individually.
examples.zh: 新郎向他们一一道谢。

examples.en: individually wrapped portions of cheese
examples.zh: 独立包装的一份份干酪

words.definition: the act or process of aggregating; collection, polymerization, clustering, gather
words.translation: 集合,集合体；[地质][数]聚合，[昆]聚集；聚集体，集合体

examples.en: An aggregation of fragments is the only kind of whole we now have.
examples.zh: 这种碎片的集合体是我们现有的唯一完整无缺的方式。

words.translation: [拉丁语]直立的

examples.en: Her team is also interested in asking similar questions about human ancestors from East Africa, as well as later species of hominin, such as Homo erectus.
examples.zh: 她的团队对于回答有关人类祖先来自东非的类似问题也有兴趣，以及原始人类的人种问题，比如原始人类的直立行走。

examples.en: The well-preserved fossils resemble Homo erectus, a species from the genus Homo that first appeared in Africa some two million years ago and quickly spread throughout Europe and much of Asia.
examples.zh: 这些保存完好的化石类似于直立人，从这个属系的人类来说，最早是在二百万年前出现在非洲的一些地方，并迅速蔓延至整个欧洲和亚洲大部分地区。

examples.en: H. erectus is generally believed to be the direct ancestor of modern humans and also the first hominid to live in caves and tame fire.
examples.zh: 人们通常认为直立人是现代人的直接祖先，也是第一个生活在洞穴中和学会用火的原始人类。

words.definition: drowsiness, zizz
words.translation: 想睡,瞌睡；睡意，瞌睡；想睡

examples.en: If there is excessive daytime sleepiness and desire to nap, in spite of adequate sleep time, this might suggest a sleep disorder warranting further evaluation.
examples.zh: 如果白天有很强的睡意，想小睡一会，虽然有充足的睡眠时间，这也许意味着睡眠障碍需要进一步评估。

words.definition: a peaceful feeling of being part of a whole; integrity, identity, full
words.translation: 单一,  统一；统一性；单一性；同一性；完整

examples.en: Instead of trying to disidentify from the ego, we need to embrace the ego while merging it with a sense of oneness.
examples.zh: 不要试图从 自我作出错误的识别，我们需要在把 自我 与“ 单一性 ”的观念相合并的同时，要去包容 自我 。

examples.en: You could also move beyond that and identify yourself with pure oneness or consciousness, devoid of any particular individuality.
examples.zh: 也可能超越那些，用纯粹的“单一性”或缺乏特殊个性的自觉意识来识别你自己。

words.definition: the part of something that is left after everything else has gone or been dealt with; leaving, arithmetical compliment; surplus, residual, odd; bargain sale, undercut; bargain sale

examples.zh: 剩余款项必须在6月底之前支付。

words.definition: someone who is passive tends to accept things that happen to them or things that people say to them, without taking any action; driven, negative
words.translation: 被动的,消极的；被动的，消极的；被动语态的

examples.en: Kathy seems to take a very passive role in the relationship.
examples.zh: 凯茜在这一关系中似乎扮演着十分被动的角色。

examples.en: their passive acceptance of their fate
examples.zh: 他们对命运的消极接受

words.definition: to get rid of waste material from your body through your bowels, your skin etc; egest, secrete

examples.zh: 你张开的毛孔排出汗液与污垢。

words.definition: used when saying the names of the people or things you are referring to; viz., i.e.
words.translation: 即,也就是；也就是；即是；换句话说

examples.en: Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
examples.zh: 有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

words.definition: a disease that affects a particular part of your body and is caused by bacteria or a virus; impression, affection, effect, influence, incidence
words.translation: 传染病, 影响,；[医]感染；[内科]传染；影响；传染病

examples.zh: 宝宝耳朵感染了。

examples.en: ...bridges set on stone pilings.
examples.zh: ..建造在石桩上的桥。

words.definition: a small round flat object on your shirt, coat etc that you pass through a hole to fasten it; to fasten clothes with buttons, or to be fastened with buttons; pushbutton, press-button; infibulate, buckle; buckle

examples.zh: 小的珍珠纽扣

examples.zh: 他们远赴摩鹿加群岛寻找香料。

examples.zh: 他从早年开始就一直在寻求宗教信仰。

examples.en: ...his questing mind and boundless enthusiasm.
examples.zh: …他的探索型头脑和无限的热情

examples.zh: 如果这样的身体变化导致更好的工具制造，那么变化的拥有者能够更好地存活下来。

examples.zh: 工具制作行为的观测在这三个观测结果中最具有划时代意义，它在恪守“人类才是唯一的工具制造者”的人类学研究圈中激起了轩然大波。

examples.zh: 婴儿在进食时或进食后常常会打一阵嗝儿。

examples.zh: 像雌鸟一样，雌鸭嘴兽也下蛋。

examples.zh: 尽管如此，鸭嘴兽的基因组还显示其带有气味感觉的基因。

examples.zh: 护士会来给你打针。

examples.zh: 学校的护士送萨拉回家。

examples.zh: 这些资源包括：煤炭、石油、天然气、岩盐、锑、汞、黄金、白银、铅、锌和宝石等。

words.definition: to stay alive when you only have small amounts of food or money; exist, occur; maintain, support, sustain, provide for

examples.zh: 犯人一天三次靠一杯最差的粥维持生活。

examples.zh: 但是从二月到七月，乔伊又无事可做了。

examples.zh: 人们仍然记得去年七月发生的使该地区产生剧烈震动的那次地震。

examples.zh: 两年前的七月，我在玛格丽特号船上和一位名叫莫兰的船长共进晚餐，这艘船从我不熟悉的一个地方出发，驶往爱尔兰西部的某条河流。

examples.zh: 西雅图气象专家表示，这也许是自1990年以来最严重的暴风雪。

examples.zh: 通过电子邮件和耳机，他与首席气象学家杰克·帕里什联络，指挥NOAA的技术人员发射下投式探空仪。

examples.zh: 警方正在调查这名女子的失踪。
