examples.en: Above all be mentally prepared for the rigors of each trading day from the time you get up each morning until you go to bed at night.
examples.zh: 最重要的是在精神上对每个交易日的严峻场面作好准备，从每天早晨你爬起来，一直到晚上回到床上。

words.definition: destroy, kill off
words.translation: 涂去, 删除, 使湮没；消灭；涂去；冲刷；忘掉

words.definition: longing for, eagerness
words.translation: 热望, 渴望；渴望；抱负；呼气；吸引术

words.definition: able to be believed or imagined; feasible, possible, potential, desired
words.translation: 可能的,想得到的；可能的；想得到的，可想像的

examples.en: It is conceivable that you may get full compensation, but it’s not likely.
examples.zh: 你可能会得到全额赔偿，但可能性不大。

examples.en: We were discussing the problems from every conceivable angle.
examples.zh: 我们正在从各个能想到的角度对问题进行讨论。

words.definition: in many different parts of the world
words.translation: 国际性地, 在国际间

examples.en: These days businesses have to be able to compete internationally.
examples.zh: 如今，企业必须要有实力参与国际竞争。

words.definition: slightly green
words.translation: 呈绿色的

examples.en: ...his cold greenish eyes.
examples.zh: ...他冷酷的浅绿色眼睛。

words.definition: clearly expressed in a few words – use this to show approval; brief, concise, compact
words.translation: 简洁的, 紧身的；简洁的；简明的；紧身的

examples.en: a succinct explanation
examples.zh: 简明扼要的解释

words.definition: between two places, and the same distance from each of them; If something is midway between two places, it is between them and the same distance from each of them; casino, midcourse; intermediary, halfway
words.translation: 中途,半路；中途的；在中途；中途；娱乐场

examples.en: Fresno is close to the midway point between LA and San Francisco.
examples.zh: 弗雷斯诺位于接进洛杉矶和旧金山的中间点。

examples.en: The studio is midway between his aunt's old home and his cottage.
examples.zh: 那个工作室位于他姑姑的老房子和他的小屋中间。

words.definition: not praised or famous for something you have done, although you deserve to be
words.translation: 未唱的,未赞颂的

examples.en: one of the unsung heroes of French politics
examples.zh: 法国政坛的一位无名英雄

words.definition: a chemical used for destroying fungus; antifungal agent
words.translation: 杀真菌剂；[药]杀真菌剂

examples.en: For one thing, they’re not confined to rats or to the fungicide he fed them.
examples.zh: 一方面，他们不局限于他所喂养的老鼠及他喂给老鼠的杀菌剂。

examples.en: Spraying an iprodione fungicide on the nests after they’re taken out of the nesting boards “reduced chalkbrood levels by up to 50 percent—with no measurable loss of young,” she reports.
examples.zh: 她报告说，把巢穴从巢套板上拆下来用杀菌剂异菌脲喷洒后“白垩病发病率就会减少50%——没有检测到幼虫死亡。”

examples.en: The environmental exposure doesn’t have to be as extreme as chowing down on a fungicide.
examples.zh: 环境暴露必定不像大量食入杀菌剂一样。

words.definition: to make a difficult subject or idea able to be easily understood by ordinary people who have no special knowledge about it; gain ground, vulgarize
words.translation: 普及；使通俗化

examples.en: Skinner was the psychologist who popularized behavior modification.
examples.zh: 斯金纳就是那位使行为矫正概念得到普及的心理学家。

words.definition: likely to change, or changing often; uncertain, mobile, variable, liquid, unstable
words.translation: 可改变的,无常的；无常的；可改变的；易变的；不定的

examples.en: changeable weather
examples.zh: 变化无常的天气

words.definition: reacting quickly, in a positive way; answering
words.translation: 响应的,应答的；响应的；应答的；回答的

examples.en: a car with highly responsive steering
examples.zh: 方向盘操纵灵活的汽车

words.definition: to make sound louder, especially musical sound; extend, zoom up; expand on, enlarge on
words.translation: 放大,详述；放大，扩大；增强；详述

examples.en: an amplified guitar
examples.zh: 带有扩音设备的电吉他

words.definition: a book made of plain paper on which you can write notes; manual, jotter
words.translation: 笔记簿, 笔记本；笔记本，笔记簿；手册

examples.en: He brought out a notebook and pen from his pocket.
examples.zh: 他从口袋里掏出了一个笔记本和一支钢笔。

words.definition: directly relating to something that is being considered; relevant, relational, correlative
words.translation: 有关的,相干的；相关的，相干的；中肯的；切题的

examples.en: He asked me a lot of very pertinent questions .
examples.zh: 他问了我许多直接相关的问题。

words.definition: short, with no unnecessary words; brief, compact
words.translation: 简明的,简练的；简明的，简洁的

examples.en: Your summary should be as clear and concise as possible.
examples.zh: 你的总结应该尽可能地明白简洁。

words.definition: employment, usage, exploitation, use
words.translation: 利用；利用，使用

examples.en: For someone to realize the value of information, you need to organize data to permit rapid discovery and utilization.
examples.zh: 要使某人实现信息的价值，您需要相应地组织数据以允许快速的发现和利用。

examples.en: At the conclusion of the evaluation run, you should gather and evaluate the utilization levels for all four resources.
examples.zh: 在评价运行的结论中，您应该收集并评价所有四种资源的利用率水平。

examples.en: One consideration is the utilization of pages.
examples.zh: 一个考虑因素是页的利用率。

words.definition: relating to the study of ideas, especially scientific ideas, rather than with practical uses of the ideas or practical experience; academic, reasoning
words.translation: 理论的,理论上的；理论的；理论上的；假设的；推理的

examples.en: theoretical physics
examples.zh: 理论物理

examples.en: Aristotle’s theoretical model of the universe
examples.zh: 亚里士多德有关宇宙的理论模型

examples.en: She has theoretical knowledge of teaching, but no practical experience.
examples.zh: 她有教学方面的理论知识，但没有实际经验。

words.definition: parabolic, tralatitious
words.translation: 借喻的,比喻的；借喻的；具有人的形象的；比喻的

words.definition: something that strongly influences what you do or how you behave; crucial, critical, final, decisive, conclusive; Determinants and Permanents
words.translation: 决定性的；决定因素；[数]行列式

examples.en: I used this to remember how to calculate the determinant of a matrix.
examples.zh: 我就用过这个方法来记住怎么算矩阵中的决定因素。

examples.en: Another determinant that must be observed by you are interactions and reactions.
examples.zh: 另一个你必须观察的决定因素是相互作用和反作用。

words.definition: to make someone do more than they are really able to do, so that they become very tired
words.translation: 课税过重, 使负担过度

examples.en: ...a contralto who has overtaxed her voice.
examples.zh: ...嗓子过度工作的一位女低音。

words.definition: the period of time when someone is young, especially the period when someone is a teenager; green, prime, young man
words.translation: 青春,少年；青年；青春；年轻；青少年时期

examples.en: a gang of youths
examples.zh: 一伙少年

words.definition: relating to the custody of someone, especially a child; depository
words.translation: 保管的,保管人的；[宗]圣物保管容器；保管的；保管人的

examples.en: custodial care
examples.zh: 看护

words.definition: a member of an official organization which encourages the development of literature, art, science etc; don, undergraduate
words.translation: 院士, 大学生；院士；大学生；学会会员；大学教师

examples.en: I'm the first academician in our family.
examples.zh: 我是我们家第一个大学生。

words.definition: rape
words.translation: 油菜, 小菜；油菜

words.definition: If someone flatters you, they praise you in an exaggerated way that is not sincere, because they want to please you or to persuade you to do something; please, glad, satisfy
words.translation: 过分夸赞, 奉承,使满意；奉承；谄媚；使高兴

examples.en: I knew she was just flattering me.
examples.zh: 我知道她只是在奉承我。

words.definition: An impressionistic work of art or piece of writing shows the artist's or writer's impressions of something rather than giving clear details; imposing
words.translation: 印象派的,给人深刻印象的；印象派的；印象主义的；给人深刻印象的

examples.en: His paintings had become more impressionistic as his eyesight dimmed.
examples.zh: 随着他的视力减弱，他的画变得越来越富有印象派风格。

words.definition: a small group of people within a larger group, who have different ideas from the other members, and who try to get their own ideas accepted; wing, junta
words.translation: 派别,小集团；派别；内讧；小集团；纪实小说

examples.en: struggles between the different factions within the party
examples.zh: 党内的派系斗争

examples.en: the leaders of the warring factions
examples.zh: 交战各派的领导人

words.definition: accidentally, unexpectedly
words.translation: 偶然地,意外地；偶然地，意外地

words.definition: chiller
words.translation: 使人毛骨悚然的东西, 使人毛骨悚然的小说；惊险小说；使人毛骨悚然的东西；使人毛骨悚然的小说

examples.en: ...a tense psychological thriller.
examples.zh: …一部紧张刺激的心理惊悚小说。

words.definition: richly, abundantly
words.translation: 丰富地,富裕地；丰富地，富裕地

words.definition: to have complete control over something so that other people cannot share it or take part in it; corner, forestall
words.translation: 独占, 垄断；垄断；独占；拥有…的专卖权

examples.en: The company has monopolized the soft drinks market.
examples.zh: 该公司垄断了软饮料市场。

examples.en: He monopolized the conversation all evening.
examples.zh: 整个晚上都是他一个人在说话。

words.definition: something difficult or worrying that you are responsible for; to have a lot of problems because of a particular thing; liability, duty, weight, strain, trust; eat, bother
words.translation: 担子, 负担；烦扰；负担；责任；船的载货量；使负担；装货于

examples.en: His family responsibilities had started to become a burden.
examples.zh: 家庭责任已开始成为他的负担。

words.definition: stomach, gastro
words.translation: <俚>胃, 腹；胃；面包篮；产粮地区；大型空投炸弹

words.definition: to destroy something or someone completely; defeat, suppress; submerge
words.translation: 消灭,湮灭；歼灭；战胜；废止；湮灭；湮没

examples.en: Just one of these bombs could annihilate a city the size of New York.
examples.zh: 这种炸弹只要一颗就能彻底毁灭纽约那么大的一座城市。

words.definition: made up of sections that can be put together or taken apart; part, fractional, segmental
words.translation: 可组合的,部分的；部分的，节的；可组合的

examples.en: a sectional sofa
examples.zh: 组合沙发

words.definition: a feeling of being jealous; envy, green-eyed monster
words.translation: 嫉妒,猜疑；嫉妒；猜忌；戒备

examples.en: Sexual jealousy is a common motive for murder.
examples.zh: 性嫉妒是常见的谋杀动机。

examples.en: feelings of professional jealousy
examples.zh: 职业上的嫉妒感

examples.en: He quickly discovered the petty jealousies and gossip of village life.
examples.zh: 他很快就发现，在乡村生活中，人们狭隘善妒，喜欢传播流言蜚语。

words.definition: waste material, such as paper, empty containers, and food thrown away; refuse, waste, junk, rubbish, trash
words.translation: 垃圾, 废物；[环境]垃圾；废物

examples.en: Can you take out the garbage when you go?
examples.zh: 你走的时候把垃圾带出去好吗？

words.definition: if something is routinely done, it is done as a normal part of a process or job
words.translation: 例行公事地

examples.en: This vaccine is already routinely used.
examples.zh: 这种疫苗的使用已经常规化。

words.definition: a difficult or unpleasant situation in which you do not know what to do, or in which you have to make a difficult choice; difficulty, status, corner, dilemma, fix
words.translation: 困境,窘状；窘况，困境；状态

examples.en: the country’s economic predicament
examples.zh: 该国的经济困境

examples.en: She went to the office to explain her predicament .
examples.zh: 她到办事处去说明她的难处。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that measures the temperature of the air, of your body etc; temperature gauge, temperature meter
words.translation: 温度计, 体温计；[仪]温度计；[医]体温计

examples.en: The thermometer registered over 100˚C.
examples.zh: 温度计显示高于100摄氏度。

words.definition: A divergence is a difference between two or more things, attitudes, or opinions; variance, bifurcation, gulf
words.translation: 分歧

examples.en: There's a substantial divergence of opinion within the party.
examples.zh: 党内意见严重分歧。

words.definition: the scientific study of the ocean
words.translation: 海洋学

examples.en: She wanted to introduce students to oceanography so that they might apply their knowledge to solve global challenges like climate change.
examples.zh: 她要把海洋学介绍给学生们，希望他们能应用他们所学的知识去解决气候变化等全球性难题。

examples.en: Many different sciences are used to learn about the earth, however, the four basic areas of Earth science study are: geology, meteorology, oceanography and astronomy.
examples.zh: 有很多关于研究地球的科学，然而地球科学主要由四门基础的学科组成，即地质学、气象学、海洋学和天文学。

examples.en: When she returned to El Salvador, Recinos knew that oceanography was the field for her.
examples.zh: 回到萨尔瓦多，雷西诺斯认识到海洋学就是她要从事的领域。

words.definition: a building near a main building, for example a barn or shed; outhouse, adjacent accommodation
words.translation: [建]外屋, (指车库, 谷仓等)；[建]附属建筑物；外屋

examples.en: a farmhouse with a few outbuildings
examples.zh: 带几间外屋的农舍

words.translation: 福布斯（美国著名财经杂志）

words.definition: any of various grasses of the genus Bouteloua, of W North America and South America: often used as pasture grasses
words.translation: 美国西部产的一种牧草

words.definition: a fine-grained igneous rock consisting of quartz, feldspars, and mica or amphibole; liparite
words.translation: [地]流纹岩；[岩]流纹岩；表面光滑的火山岩

examples.en: Topaz occurs in the igneous rock rhyolite.
examples.zh: 黄晶通常产于火成岩岩石纹。

examples.en: People come to this area in order to see the colorful rhyolite mountains.
examples.zh: 人们来到这个地区是为了观看那里五彩缤纷的流纹岩山脉。

examples.en: The violent and unexpected nature of the blasts, together with their rarity, means the Chaiténeruption is the first rhyolite event to have been scientifically assessed in this way [ABC News].
examples.zh: 其猛烈及难以预料的自然爆发，及它们的罕见程度,  意味着Chaitén火山爆发已经被这样合乎逻辑地评估为第一个流纹岩活动 [美国广播公司消息]。

words.definition: an action, event etc that is decisive has a big effect on the way that something develops; crucial, critical, final, committed, confirmed
words.translation: 决定性的,果断的；决定性的；果断的，坚定的

examples.en: a decisive leader
examples.zh: 果断的领袖

words.translation: 同等地,可比较地

words.definition: equipment that sends out radio or television signals; sender, communicator
words.translation: 转送者,传导物,发射机；[电讯][通信]发射机，发报机；传达人

examples.en: ...a homemade radio transmitter.
examples.zh: …一台自制的无线电发射机。

words.definition: exponential growth, increase etc becomes faster as the amount of the thing that is growing increases; index, indice
words.translation: 指数；指数的, 幂数的；[数]指数

examples.en: This is an exponential function.
examples.zh: 因为这里是指数函数。

examples.en: I’m writing a book about trigonometric and exponential functions.
examples.zh: 我在写一本关于三角和指数功能的书。

words.definition: a white ground of plaster and size, used esp in the Middle Ages and Renaissance to prepare panels or canvas for painting or gilding; gypse, plaister
words.translation: (雕刻、绘画用的)石膏, 石膏粉；[材]石膏，石膏粉；石膏底

examples.en: Processing category:Various dry and wet materials that could be crushed, including chemical raw materials, gesso powders, hulls, grains, and plastics .
examples.zh: 加工类别：各种可以粉碎的干湿料物，化工原料、石膏粉、皮类、粮食类、塑料类。棉花类，生物类。

words.definition: someone whose job is to look after or help customers in a public place; relating to or caused by something; accompanied; waiter, suite
words.translation: 服务员；伴随的；侍候的；服务员，侍者；随员，陪从

examples.en: a car park attendant
examples.zh: 停车场的服务员

words.definition: an economic and political system in which businesses belong mostly to private owners, not to the government
words.translation: 资本主义

examples.en: ...the two fundamentally opposed social systems, capitalism and socialism.
examples.zh: …两种根本对立的社会制度，资本主义与社会主义。

words.definition: polite behaviour that shows that you respect someone and are therefore willing to accept their opinions or judgment; compliance, Friend VS Lover
words.translation: 顺从, 尊重；顺从

examples.en: ...the older political tradition of deference to great leaders.
examples.zh: …敬重伟大领导人的较老的政治传统。

words.definition: a process or system that is cumbersome is slow and difficult; problem, hulking
words.translation: 笨重的,累赘的；笨重的；累赘的；难处理的

examples.en: Doctors are complaining that the system is cumbersome and bureaucratic.
examples.zh: 医生抱怨说该体制复杂繁琐，很官僚。

examples.en: cumbersome procedures
examples.zh: 繁琐的程序

words.definition: latitude line, filling yarn
words.translation: [纺]织物,信号旗；纬线；信号旗

examples.en: Usage: This detector is applied to plastic looms for stopping operation in case of broken weft and weft-out. It is composed of signal emitter, receiver and controller.
examples.zh: 用途：本检测器用于塑料园织机在断纬、完纬时控制主机停车之功能。它由信号发射器， 信号接收器和控制器三部分组成。

words.definition: extremely serious or terrible; terrible, ultra, extreme, horrible, awesome
words.translation: 可怕的,极端的；可怕的；悲惨的；极端的

examples.en: warnings of dire consequences that often don’t come true
examples.zh: 对严重后果的警告，尽管这些后果常常不会出现

examples.en: The country is in dire need of food aid.
examples.zh: 这个国家急需食品援助。

examples.en: The situation looked dire.
examples.zh: 情况看来非常严重。

words.definition: a jewel, stone etc that hangs from a thin chain that you wear around your neck; lappet, bulla
words.translation: 垂饰, 下垂物；[建][地质]下垂物，垂饰

examples.en: a ruby pendant
examples.zh: 红宝石吊坠

words.translation: 篮子编织

words.definition: a person who knows about many different things and can do many things well; versatile person, all-rounder
words.translation: 多面手,通才；（有多方面知识和经验的）通才；[劳经]多面手

examples.en: The presidency is a job for a generalist.
examples.zh: 总统的职位是一个多面手做的。

words.definition: a small building made for a dog to sleep in; to put or go into a kennel; keep or stay in a kennel; culvert, cloaca
words.translation: 狗窝；置于狗窝,关进狗窝；狗屋；养狗场；[建]阴沟；一群狗

examples.en: Once you have chosen a kennel, make a booking for your pet.
examples.zh: 一旦您选定了养狗场，请为您的宠物预约。

words.definition: someone who is in charge of a post office
words.translation: 邮局局长

examples.en: As if from far away, he hears her call to the postmaster to send for the police.
examples.zh: 好像是从很远的地方传来的声音，他听见她在让邮政局长打电话叫警察来。

examples.en: In our project, the post office is the message server and the postmaster is the queue manager.
examples.zh: 在我们这个项目中，邮局就是消息服务器，邮政人员是队列管理器。

examples.en: After your letter makes its way through the door of the post office, the postmaster will look at the address information of the envelope and place it in the appropriate slot.
examples.zh: 当您的信进邮局大门后，邮政人员将查看信封的地址信息，并将它放到适当的信箱中。

words.definition: used to introduce a fact that you think is interesting; intriguingly, amusingly
words.translation: 有趣地

examples.en: Interestingly, none of their three children ever married.
examples.zh: 有趣的是，他们的三个孩子都一直没有结婚。

examples.en: Interestingly enough, Pearson made no attempt to deny the rumour.
examples.zh: 很有趣的是，皮尔逊没有试图否认谣传。

words.definition: a liquid with a strong pleasant smell that women put on their skin or clothing to make themselves smell nice; to put perfume on something; fragrance, parfum
words.translation: 芳香,香水；使发香,洒香水于；香水；香味

examples.en: She was wearing the perfume that he’d bought her.
examples.zh: 她擦了他买给她的香水。

words.definition: existing or happening together, especially as a result of something; something that often or naturally happens with something else; accompanied, codependent; accompaniment
words.translation: 伴随的；伴随物；[数]相伴的；共存的；附随的

examples.en: war with all its concomitant sufferings
examples.zh: 战争及其引起的一切苦难

words.definition: someone who is receiving medical treatment from a doctor or in a hospital; able to wait calmly for a long time or to accept difficulties, people’s annoying behaviour etc without becoming angry; indefatigable; sick, sufferer
words.translation: 病人；耐心的；有耐性的，能容忍的；[医]病人；患者

examples.en: She sat by the patient.
examples.zh: 她守护在病人身旁。

examples.en: The doctor went to see that patient day about.
examples.zh: 这个医生每隔一天就去看那个病人一次。

examples.en: The doctor doubted whether the patient would live through that month.

words.translation: 冷藏, 致冷；制冷；[制冷]冷藏；[热]冷却

examples.zh: 霉菌在冷藏条件下也可以生长，正在成熟的奶酪就是一个很好的例子。

examples.zh: 大多数禽类能够由一家人在一餐内食用完，所以对冷藏的需求也偏低。

examples.en: Wasp and fly wings are made from two compressed layers of transparent chitin, with light bouncing off both layers and mixing to produce color.
examples.zh: 果蝇和黄蜂的翅膀其实是由两层压缩的透明甲壳质组成，每层甲壳质都能够在内部对光线进行折射，从而产生出各种色彩。

words.translation: 聚合体；[高分子][有化]聚合物

examples.en: So, what I want to do is go back to this simple polymer configurational model that we introduced before.
examples.zh: 那么，我想做的是回到,简单的聚合物构型模型,我们之前介绍过的。

examples.zh: 一朵花由四部分组成：花萼，花瓣，雄蕊和雌蕊。

examples.zh: …美国艺术基金会。

words.definition: a small pool of liquid, especially rainwater; sump; rile
words.translation: 水坑, 泥潭；搅浊,搅泥泞；水坑，泥潭；[建]胶土（由粘土与水和成，不透水）；使泥泞，搅浑；把…捣制成胶土；搅炼；用胶土填塞

examples.en: Children splashed through the puddles.
examples.zh: 孩子们噼噼啪啪地踩过一个个小水坑。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that produces a bright flame, or the flame itself, used outdoors as a signal; sparkle; burn, shine on; explosion, stroboflash
words.translation: 闪光, 闪耀；闪光,闪耀；使闪耀；使张开；用发光信号发出；使外倾；闪耀，闪光；燃烧；突然发怒；闪光，闪耀；耀斑；爆发；照明弹

examples.en: The distress flares were spotted by another ship.
examples.zh: 遇险信号被另外一艘船发现了。

words.definition: nose, boko
words.translation: 鼻子,[昆] 喙；鼻子；[昆]喙；象鼻；[无脊椎]吻

examples.en: At least they didn't give me a butterfly's proboscis, or crab mandibles.
examples.zh: 至少他们没有给我一只蝴蝶的鼻子，或者一只螃蟹的下颌。

examples.en: The bug’s serrated proboscis touches the skin’s nerves at fewer points than it would if smooth.
examples.zh: 因为不光滑的缘故，所以蚊子锯齿状的尖喙会较少触碰到皮肤中的神经。

words.definition: deep red in colour; if your face crimsons, it becomes red because you are embarrassed; deep red, dark red; wine-colored, laky; blush
words.translation: 深红色的；变深红色；深红色；变为深红色；脸红

examples.en: The leaves turn crimson in autumn.
examples.zh: 树叶在秋天变成了深红色。

examples.en: a crimson dress
examples.zh: 深红色连衣裙

words.definition: extreme tiredness; effeteness, drying up
words.translation: 耗尽枯竭,疲惫,竭尽；枯竭；[电子]耗尽；精疲力竭

examples.en: Sheer exhaustion forced him to give up.
examples.zh: 他疲惫不堪，只好放弃。

examples.en: Many runners were suffering from heat exhaustion (= when you become tired and ill because you are too hot ).
examples.zh: 许多赛跑运动员都出现了热衰竭。

words.definition: a person or animal that has won something; victor, conqueror
words.translation: 胜利者,优胜者；胜利者

examples.en: Five lucky winners will each receive a signed copy of the album.
examples.zh: 五位幸运的获胜者每人将得到一张签名专辑。

examples.en: As a jockey he rode 10 winners.
examples.zh: 作为骑师他曾十度驾驭获胜赛马。

words.translation: 人类学的,人类学上的

examples.en: But now suppose we approach the question from a -I don't say from an empirical point of view but from a speculative anthropological point of view.
examples.zh: 现在假设我们从一个特定角度来看这个问题,我不会说从一个经验主义的角度,而是从一个推测的人类学的角度来看。

examples.en: It seems to me that the idea of a personal God is an anthropological concept which I cannot take seriously.
examples.zh: 对于我来说，每人心中有一个自己的上帝这一人类学观点，我并没有严肃认真地看待。

words.definition: made of or covered with a substance that sticks to surfaces; glutinous, viscous
words.translation: 粘的, 粘性的；[胶粘]粘的；粘性的

examples.en: There’s some sticky stuff in your hair.
examples.zh: 你的头发上有什么黏糊糊的东西。

examples.en: a sticky floor
examples.zh: 黏糊糊的地板

words.translation: 在结构上

examples.en: In this case, the FBML may be structurally correct, but the data is wrong.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，FBML在结构上是正确的，但是数据是错误的。

examples.en: Now the high-level picture is at least structurally complete, and looks like  Figure 4.
examples.zh: 现在，这个高层次的图至少在结构上是完整的了，如  图 4 所示。

examples.en: This produces the following SQL statement which is structurally complete but with invalid syntax.
examples.zh: 这会产生以下 SQL 语句，它在结构上是完整的，但是语法是无效的。

words.definition: likely to make you healthy; healthy, calculating, sound
words.translation: 有益的,健康的,健全的；健全的；有益健康的；合乎卫生的；审慎的

examples.en: good wholesome fun
examples.zh: 健康有益的娱乐

words.definition: a type of music in which several different tunes or notes are sung or played together at the same time; counterpoint
words.translation: 复调音乐, 多音；复调；复调音乐；多音

examples.en: Before Louis Armstrong, solos were brief or non-existent, and the urgent sound of an old New Orleans jazz band came from the polyphony of players winding their melodies around each other.
examples.zh: 在路易斯阿姆斯特朗之前，独奏是一种可有可无或完全不存在的表演形式，旧式奥尔良乐团中，各路乐手用不同的旋律共同交织出复调音乐，通常急促而又紧凑。

words.definition: a musical instrument like a small  trumpet
words.translation: 圆锥形纸袋, 短号

words.definition: a tall plant with large yellow seeds that grow together on a  cob (= long hard part )  , and that are cooked and eaten as a vegetable; yellow, xanthic; yellow, zea mays
words.translation: 玉米, 黄色；玉米色的；黄色的，玉米色的；[作物]玉米；黄色，玉米色

examples.en: We can grow sorghum or maize on this plot.
examples.zh: 这块地可以种高粱或玉米。

examples.en: The maize and millet were just putting forth ears.
examples.zh: 玉米粟子刚刚吐穗。

examples.en: The researchers say it should be possible to transfer this process to rice by inserting genes from maize or from wild relatives of rice that also use it.
examples.zh: 科学家说，通过把来自玉米或者具有此功能的水稻野生亲属的基因插入水稻中，就有可能让水稻也具有这一功能。

words.definition: behaviour that is honourable, kind, generous, and brave, especially men’s behaviour towards women; errantry
words.translation: 骑士精神, 骑士制度；骑士精神（复数chivalries）；骑士制度

examples.en: ...the age of chivalry.
examples.zh: ...骑士制度的时代。

words.definition: without unnecessary or special features or decorations; plain, frugal
words.translation: 朴素的,未装饰的；朴素的；未装饰的

examples.en: They liked their churches to be unadorned.
examples.zh: 他们希望他们的教堂朴素无华。

words.definition: dealing with danger, pain, or difficult situations with courage and confidence; game, magnificent, gorgeous; face up to, outbrave; warrior, lionheart
words.translation: 勇敢的；华丽的；勇敢地面对；勇士

examples.en: brave soldiers
examples.zh: 勇敢的士兵

examples.en: her brave fight against cancer
examples.zh: 她与癌症的勇敢搏斗

words.definition: if two pieces of computer equipment are compatible, they can be used together, especially when they are made by different companies
words.translation: 谐调的,兼容的

examples.en: The new software is IBM compatible (= can be used with IBM computers ) .
examples.zh: 这个新软件与IBM的计算机兼容。

words.translation: 旅馆经营者

words.definition: a small hotel or pub, especially an old one in the countryside; hotel, roadhouse
words.translation: (尤指乡村或公路边的) 旅馆；住旅馆；[经]客栈；旅馆

examples.en: We’re staying at the Holiday Inn.
examples.zh: 我们住在假日酒店。

words.definition: a very large number of people or things; majority, mass
words.translation: 多数, 群众；群众；多数

examples.en: I had never seen such a multitude of stars before.
examples.zh: 我以前从未见过这么多的星星。

examples.en: a multitude of possible interpretations
examples.zh: 种种可能的解释

words.definition: to express in a shorter, clearer, or different way what someone has said or written; a statement that expresses in a shorter, clearer, or different way what someone has said or written; rephrase; free translation
words.translation: 解释；释义；改述；意译

examples.en: To paraphrase Finkelstein, mathematics is a language, like English.
examples.zh: 芬克尔斯坦的意思是，数学是一门语言，就像英语一样。

words.definition: caring about other people and thinking about their needs and wishes before your own; generous, handsome, selfless, liberal
words.translation: 无私的,慷慨的；无私的，慷慨的

examples.en: She started to get a reputation as an unselfish girl with a heart of gold.
examples.zh: 她开始得到有着金子般心灵的无私女孩的名声。

words.definition: a place or social event at which people dance to recorded popular music
words.translation: 迪斯科舞厅

examples.en: the school disco
examples.zh: 学校的迪斯科舞会

words.definition: foreign material, extraneous matter
words.translation: (有机体的)异物；异物

words.definition: a type of music and dancing that has a strong beat and was popular in the US in the early part of the 20th century; funny, humouristic
words.translation: 拉格泰姆音乐；使人发笑的；滑稽的；不严肃的

examples.en: Joplin is considered the foremost composer of ragtime music.
examples.zh: 吉普林被认为是拉格泰姆（Ragtime）音乐最重要的作曲家。

examples.en: He has recorded every major work for the violin, and has also recorded jazz, ragtime and Jewish folk music.
examples.zh: 他录制了每一首主要的小提琴曲，爵士乐，拉格泰姆以及犹太人民间音乐。

words.definition: not limited by anyone or anything; free, unlimited
words.translation: 自由的,无限制的；自由的；无限制的；不受束缚的

examples.en: Freedom to pursue extracurricular activities is totally unrestricted.
examples.zh: 参加课外活动的自由完全不受限制。

words.definition: an object in space that is similar to a star and that shines very brightly
words.translation: 恒星状球体, 类星体

examples.en: This quasar was the only one without a known host galaxy.
examples.zh: 这个类星体似乎无依无傍，不在任何一个星系当中。

examples.en: Within a few million years, both quasar and galaxy will have merged.
examples.zh: 在几百万年的时间里，类星体和伴星系将会合并在一起。

examples.en: But scientists have now found a quasar that's apparently churning out new stars in the absence of a host galaxy.
examples.zh: 但是现在科学家们发现，一颗没有挂靠主星系的类星体显然在大量地制造出新恒星。

words.definition: a musical instrument like a small  accordion  , that you hold in both hands and play by pressing in from each side
words.translation: 类似风琴的六角形的乐器

words.definition: a room for sleeping in; sleeping room, bedchamber
words.translation: 卧室；[建]卧室

examples.en: a hotel with 50 bedrooms
examples.zh: 有50间客房的旅馆

words.definition: a stiff bird’s feather; seta, chaeta; cut through, transpierce
words.translation: 羽茎,大翎毛；刺穿；大翎毛；羽茎；（豪猪、刺猬的）刚毛

examples.en: She dipped a quill in ink, then began to write.
examples.zh: 她把羽毛笔蘸进墨水中，然后开始写字。

words.definition: a long firm  pillow  , usually shaped like a tube; holding, support, adhesion, backing; encourage, second, carry, hand, champion
words.translation: 垫子；支持；长枕；支撑

examples.en: I'll bolster you up.
examples.zh: 我支持你。

examples.en: More timbers are needed to bolster the roof of the mine.
examples.zh: 需要更多的木材支撑矿顶。

examples.en: If you have a bolster or several pillows, place your lower back onto the support.
examples.zh: 如果你有一个支撑或者一些枕头，将你的下半身靠在这些支撑上。

words.definition: a stop or pause; to prevent someone or something from continuing - used especially in news reports; desist from, come to a stop; break, stop, rest, stay, stand; put a stop to
words.translation: 停止,暂停；停止,使立定；停止；立定；踌躇，犹豫；休息；使停止；使立定

examples.en: Heavy snowfalls brought traffic to a halt (= made it stop moving ).
examples.zh: 大雪使得交通陷于停顿。

examples.en: The World Championship was brought to a temporary halt (= was stopped from continuing ).
examples.zh: 世界锦标赛暂停举行。

examples.en: The President has called for a halt to the wave of emigration.
examples.zh: 总统呼吁遏制移民国外的热潮。

words.definition: to breathe air, smoke etc out of your mouth; emit, to send out; to send out, give off
words.translation: 呼气,发出；呼气；发出；发散；使蒸发

examples.en: Take a deep breath, then exhale slowly.
examples.zh: 深吸一口气，然后慢慢呼出。

words.definition: a unit of length equal to 10–10 metre, used principally to express the wavelengths of electromagnetic radiations; tenthmeter
words.translation: [物理]埃(长度单位)；埃（光谱线波长单位）

examples.en: I like the angstrom. It is 10 to the minus 10 meters.
examples.zh: 我喜欢单位，埃，它等于10的负10次方米。

examples.en: So that works out, an angstrom is 10 to the minus 10 meters.
examples.zh: 这样可以计算出，一埃等于10的负10次方米。

examples.en: I like the angstrom because atomic dimensions are conveniently measured by angstroms.
examples.zh: 我喜，埃，因为原子大小的东西,用埃来度量更方便。

words.definition: the study, design, and manufacture of microscopes; microscopic examination
words.translation: 显微镜检查,显微镜使用；[光][临床]显微镜检查；显微镜使用；显微镜学

examples.en: Not only might it have applications in fields such as microscopy, but it apparently also has the ability to optically store data forever.
examples.zh: 它不仅可以在诸如显微镜之类的领域得到应用，显然它同时也具有实现永久性光存储的能力。

examples.en: An examination done on swabs from ulcers or smears from tissue biopsies that can be carried out rapidly at local health facilities where TB microscopy is also done.
examples.zh: 对溃疡拭子或来自组织切片的涂片所做的一种检查，可在同时进行结核显微镜检查的地方卫生设施中快速进行。

words.definition: a type of drug which makes you sleep and reduces pain; a narcotic drug takes away pain or makes you sleep; anesthetic, anaesthetic; drug, banque
words.translation: 麻醉药,镇静剂；麻醉的；[药]麻醉的；有麻醉作用的；催眠的；[药]麻醉药；镇静剂；起麻醉作用的事物

examples.en: The truth of Johnson’s comment was recently brought home to me by the serene calm of a resident who was treating a particularly complicated narcotic-dependent patient.
examples.zh: 最近，一位住院医生对待一位异常复杂的麻醉药依赖病人的平静态度让我领会到了塞缪尔.约翰逊这句话的真谛。

examples.en: As a result, almost 50 years after the agreement was adopted, adequate availability of narcotic drugs for pain treatment remains an unfulfilled promise.
examples.zh: 因此虽然条约早在50年前被通过，但确保治疗疼痛的麻醉药物供应充足仍是个未兑现的承诺。

words.definition: unconsciousness induced by narcotics or general anaesthetics; anesthesia, anaesthesia
words.translation: 昏迷状态, 麻醉；[外科]麻醉；昏迷状态

examples.en: Patient faint shows narcosis , high fever, convulsions, the skin cadaverous or the purple that show blueness.
examples.zh: 病人昏倒呈昏迷状态，高烧，惊厥，皮肤苍白或呈青紫色。

examples.en: Environmental considerations such as exceeding planned depth, encountering currents, cold exposure, entanglements, and narcosis.
examples.zh: 环境考虑，如超出预定深度，遭遇水流，冷暴露，纠缠和昏迷状态。

words.definition: a problem or situation that makes something more difficult to understand or deal with; chaos, confusion, disorder, involvement, mix
words.translation: 复杂化, (使复杂的)因素；并发症；复杂；复杂化；混乱

examples.en: The fact that the plane was late added a further complication to our journey.
examples.zh: 飞机误点给我们的旅行带来了更大的麻烦。

words.definition: something such as a hard mass of blood or a small amount of air that blocks a tube carrying blood through the body
words.translation: 加闰日, 栓塞

words.definition: to break or burst, or to make something break or burst; an occasion when something suddenly breaks apart or bursts; fracture, cracking; fracture, crack; crack, fracture, stop
words.translation: 破裂,裂开；破裂, 决裂；破裂；决裂；疝气；发疝气；使破裂；断绝；发生疝

examples.en: The pipe will rupture at its weakest point.
examples.zh: 管道最薄弱的地方会破裂的。

examples.en: His liver was ruptured when a brick wall collapsed on him.
examples.zh: 一堵砖墙坍塌压住了他，导致他的肝脏破裂。

words.definition: the process of rubbing a surface very hard so that it becomes damaged or disappears; wear and tear, arrosion
words.translation: 磨损；[口腔]磨损；[机]磨耗；[皮肤]擦伤

examples.en: extra protection against abrasion
examples.zh: 防止磨损的额外保护

words.definition: well, adequately, appropriately
words.translation: 成比例地,相称地；成比例地；相称地，适当地

examples.en: However, because of on-chip space limitations, the TLB size can not be increased proportionally.
examples.zh: 然而，由于芯片空间的限制，TLB 的大小不能成比例地增加。

examples.en: This is still a Bermuda rig, but the mainsail is proportionally larger and the jib smaller, for ease of handling and maximum power.
examples.zh: 这仍然是一个百慕大帆，但主帆成比例地变大了，而前帆则相应变小，以便于操纵并获得最大动力。

words.definition: Virgo is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac. Its symbol is a young woman. People who are born approximately between the 23rd of August and the 22nd of September come under this sign.; Vergine
words.translation: 室女宫,室女(星)座；处女座；维尔格铬镍钨

words.definition: a ship or aircraft that carries goods; cargo ship, cargo boat
words.translation: 货船,承运人；[水运][船]货船；承运人

examples.en: The artificial reef, the Triangle, was put together from a freighter, a barge and -- this is the Palm Beach area, after all -- an old Rolls Royce.
examples.zh: 人工鱼礁、百慕大三角通过货船和驳船装运相连在一起，中间的区域便是棕榈滩。 这卡片终究堪比“一辆古老的劳斯莱斯”。

words.definition: scattered or spread over a large area, with a lot of space in between; sparsely
words.translation: 稀疏地,瘦；薄；稀疏地；细；瘦

examples.en: Sow the radish seeds thinly.
examples.zh: 把萝卜籽撒播得稀一些。

examples.en: The mountain regions are more thinly populated than the lowlands.
examples.zh: 山区比低地人烟稀少。

words.definition: beliefs or ideas about what is right and wrong and about how people should behave; virtue, excellence
words.translation: 道德,品行；道德；品行，美德

examples.en: ...standards of morality and justice in society.
examples.zh: …社会中道德和正义的标准。

words.definition: the daughter of Cassiopeia and wife of Perseus, who saved her from a sea monster
words.translation: 埃塞俄比亚的公主, 仙女座

words.definition: something that you compare another thing with, in order to judge how good or successful it is
words.translation: <美> 码尺, 准绳

examples.en: The book gives a yardstick for measuring assets.
examples.zh: 该书为评估资产提供了一种标准。

words.definition: to put someone or something into a high rank or position; promote, upgrade, prefer, elevate
words.translation: 晋升；提升；提拔；赞扬；使得意

examples.en: But it can also inspire and uplift and exalt, because power can be used to help people accomplish marvelous things.
examples.zh: 但是，权力也可以激励人、振奋人和提升人，因为它可以帮助人们成就非同寻常的事业。

words.translation: 一氧化物

examples.en: Then, if the mix of waste is correct, the carbon and oxygen atoms involved recombine to form carbon monoxide and the hydrogen atoms link up into diatomic hydrogen molecules.
examples.zh: 接下去，如果废物的组合是合适的，碳原子和氧原子会重新组合形成一氧化碳，而氢原子则结合起来形成双原子的氢分子。

examples.en: I knew straight away that it was carbon monoxide," he told the New Zealand Herald.
examples.zh: 我马上就知道了这是一氧化碳，”他这样告诉《新西兰先驱报》的记者。

examples.en: That produces hydrogen and carbon monoxide, which can be converted to a liquid fuel.
examples.zh: 其产物是氢气和一氧化碳，并可以进一步转化为液体燃料。

words.definition: If someone or something complies with an order or set of rules, they do what is required or expected; engage, abide by/obey/observe
words.translation: 顺从,答应；遵守；顺从，遵从；答应

examples.en: The commander said that the army would comply with the ceasefire.
examples.zh: 指挥官说过部队会遵从停火协议。

examples.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
examples.zh: 一些海滩没能遵守环保规定。

words.definition: to know that someone’s help has been important to you in achieving something; appreciate, be grateful to
words.translation: 欠(债等),感激；欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于

examples.en: How much do I owe you (= often used to show that you want to pay for something )?
examples.zh: 我该付你多少钱？

words.translation: [冶]锭铁, 工业纯铁

examples.en: ...gold ingots.

words.definition: happening before the natural or proper time; raw, immature; pronatis
words.translation: 未成熟的,早熟的；早产的；不成熟的；比预期早的；早产儿；过早发生的事物

examples.en: his premature death due to cancer
examples.zh: 他因癌症而早逝

examples.en: premature ageing of the skin
examples.zh: 皮肤的早衰

words.definition: a belief that you have been treated unfairly, or an unfair situation or event that affects and upsets you; dissatisfaction, complaint
words.translation: 委屈, 冤情, 不平；不满，不平；委屈；冤情

examples.en: anyone who has a legitimate grievance against the company
examples.zh: 凡是有正当理由对公司感到不满的人

examples.en: ...unskilled work done by unschooled people.
examples.zh: ...未受过正式教育的人做出的不精巧的活计。

words.definition: unable or unlikely to hurt anyone or cause damage; unharmful, noninjurious
words.translation: 无害的；无恶意的

examples.en: Her brother’s a bit simple, but he’s quite harmless.
examples.zh: 她的弟弟有点愚钝，不过他决不会伤害别人。

words.definition: germ, spring up; come into bud, come up; shoots
words.translation: 嫩芽；萌芽；发芽；嫩枝

examples.en: When spring is coming all trees begin to burgeon .
examples.zh: 当春天到来的时候，所有树开始发芽。

examples.en: The brain-drain effect of studying abroad has started to burgeon due to flaws in the domestic academic environment.
examples.zh: 由于国内学术环境恶劣，出国留学造成人才外流的现象已经初显萌芽。

examples.en: The seed of friendship and cooperation we sow today will burgeon and harvest in the future and China-US partnership of cooperation will definitely enjoy a better tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们今天播下的友好合作种子一定能够生根发芽、开花结果，中美合作伙伴关系一定能够迎来更加美好的明天。

words.definition: a  garbage can; trashcan, garbage bin
words.translation: 垃圾桶, 深水炸弹；垃圾桶；深水炸弹

words.definition: letter, texts
words.translation: 文字的,表面意义上的；文字，字义上；无修饰；表面意义上

examples.en: Although the doesn't up help what, can do a good listen to, we each other of the trust have the basal, that foundation be the guest the top literalness exchanges.
examples.zh: 翡瑟虽然帮不上什么，但是可以做一个很好的倾听者，我们彼此的信任是有基础的，那个基础就是博客上文字的交流。

words.definition: jaup, tainture; soil, mud, spot, dirty; to smear
words.translation: 污点,小斑；弄脏；污点；小斑；蝇粪留下的污点

examples.en: Or is it a flyspeck looking like a bird?
examples.zh: 或只是苍蝇留下的看起来像鸟的斑点？

words.definition: an enzyme that occurs in gastric juice and is a constituent of rennet; renin, chymosin
words.translation: 高血压蛋白原酶；[生化]凝乳酶

words.definition: Hormonal means relating to or involving hormones; incretionary
words.translation: 荷尔蒙的,激素的；荷尔蒙的，激素的

examples.en: ...our individual hormonal balance.
examples.zh: …我们个体的荷尔蒙平衡。

words.definition: a peptide of physiological importance that is capable of causing constriction of blood vessels, which raises blood pressure; hypertensin
words.translation: [医]血管紧缩素；[生化]血管紧张肽；血管紧缩素

examples.en: The drugs lower blood pressure by stopping the hormone angiotensin narrowing the body's blood vessels.
examples.zh: 这种药物通过阻止激素血管紧缩素缩小身体内的血管，从而降低血压。

examples.en: But when the rats reached adulthood, an infusion of the hormone angiotensin II resulted in rapid and dramatic increases in all key indicators in animals that experienced early life stress.
examples.zh: 但是当这些经历过早年压力的老鼠成年后，一种名为血管紧缩素Ⅱ的激素的注入导致了心血管疾病的所有关键指标快速和戏剧性的增加。

examples.en: Fried eggs proved particularly successful at blocking angiotensin, lab-based tests showed, the Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry reports.
examples.zh: 据农业期刊和食品化学报道，基于实验室的试验表明，煎蛋在封锁血管紧缩素方面的证明是成功的。

words.definition: If you suffer deprivation, you do not have or are prevented from having something that you want or need; removal, losing, expense, disadvantage, cost
words.translation: 剥夺；损失；免职

examples.en: Millions more suffer from serious sleep deprivation caused by long work hours.
examples.zh: 还有数百万人由于工作时数长导致他们严重睡眠不足。

words.definition: the principal mineralocorticoid secreted by the adrenal cortex. A synthesized form is used in the treatment of Addison's disease. Formula: C21H27O5
words.translation: [生化]醛甾酮,醛固酮

examples.en: As well as binding cortisol, it could respond to other hormones such as aldosterone and deoxycorticosterone.
examples.zh: 在结合应激激素的同时，它还能够对其他激素产生响应，例如醛固酮和去氧皮质酮。

examples.en: In Addison's disease, your adrenal glands produce too little cortisol and often insufficient levels of aldosterone as well.
examples.zh: 阿狄森氏病患者的肾上腺只合成皮质醇过少，醛固酮（同为肾上腺产生）的水平往往也不足。

examples.en: The dietary change was also shown to cause the kidneys to release more of a protein called renin and its hormone aldosterone which is linked with high blood pressure.
examples.zh: 饮食的改变也使肾脏分泌出更多的肾激素，肾激素是一种蛋白质，它的激素醛固酮与高血压密切相关。

words.definition: an official instruction given to a person or organization, allowing them to do something; to give someone the right or power to do something; instruction, order, bidding, word, charge; empower, accredit
words.translation: (书面)命令,训令；委任统治；授权；[法]命令，指令；委托管理；受命进行的工作；托管

examples.en: Matters debated in meetings do not become a mandate automatically.
examples.zh: 会议上讨论的事宜并不能自动成为一项指令。

words.definition: from this time on; forwards, hereafter
words.translation: 今后,自此以后；今后；自此以后

examples.en: multiple sclerosis (henceforth referred to as MS)
examples.zh: 多发性硬化（以下称为MS）

words.definition: In zoology, mammalian means relating to mammals
words.translation: 哺乳动物；哺乳动物的

examples.en: But is it more than just the infusion of the catecholamine neurotransmitter, dopamine, or the mammalian hormone oxytocin?
examples.zh: 而它也许不止是儿茶酚胺类神经递质注入剂、多巴胺、或哺乳类动物的荷尔蒙催产素？

examples.en: Indeed, he takes this evolutionary process seriously: he is fond of pointing out to his audiences that they have both “mammalian” and “reptilian” brains that can be employed at different moments.
examples.zh: 实际上，罗闻全对待这种进化过程的态度是认真的：他喜欢向听众指出，他们都拥有可以在不同时刻使用的“哺乳动物”和“爬虫类”大脑。

examples.en: Sometimes this is for good reason, because we understand the greater social cost of profligacy, but often it's just because our mammalian brains are programmed that way.
examples.zh: 有时候理由是很正当的，因为我们想到了更大范围的社会上的浪费，但更多的时候，仅仅是因为我们脑中那根哺乳动物的弦。

words.definition: wrong, unlawfully
words.translation: 不公平地,不正当地；不公平地；不正当地

examples.en: And that's going to require some very hard choices. And we're going to have to do that in a way that does not add unfairly to the burdens that the average American already faces.
examples.zh: 他还称,"这就需要作出一些十分困难的选择.我们达到此目的所采取的方式,将不会向普通美国人已面临的负担中,增加不公平的累赘."

words.definition: not useful or not relating to a particular situation, and therefore not important; inconnected, unrelated
words.translation: 不相干的,不切题的；不相干的；不切题的

examples.en: We’re focussing too much on irrelevant details.
examples.zh: 我们过于关注不相干的细节。

examples.en: Students viewed Latin as boring and irrelevant.
examples.zh: 学生认为拉丁语无聊且无关紧要。

words.definition: a group of 12 ordinary people who listen to the details of a case in court and decide whether someone is guilty or not; makeshift; quick-fix, lash-up
words.translation: [律] 陪审团；[海]临时应急的；应急的

examples.en: the members of the jury
examples.zh: 陪审团成员

examples.en: The jury found him not guilty.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁定他无罪。

examples.en: the right to trial by jury
examples.zh: 由陪审团进行审理的权利

words.definition: If you describe something as burdensome, you mean it is worrying or hard to deal with; heavy, onerous
words.translation: 繁重的,难以承担的；繁重的；累赘的；恼人的

examples.en: ...a burdensome debt.
examples.zh: …一笔沉重的债务。

examples.en: The load was too burdensome.
examples.zh: 负担太繁重了。

words.definition: a member of a confederacy; allied powers, ally; federal, linked, joint, fed.; combine, ally; band, combine, connect
words.translation: 同盟者,同盟国；同盟的；(使)联盟, 联合；同盟国，同盟者；同盟的，联合的；使联盟；使联合；同伙；帮凶；同盟；联合

examples.en: The young woman was his confederate, of course.
examples.zh: 这个年轻女子当然是他的同谋。

words.definition: to forgive someone for behaving badly; used to say ‘sorry’ after you have made an impolite sound such as a  burp; forgiveness, absolution; forgive, tolerate
words.translation: 原谅,宽恕；原谅；[法]赦免；宽恕

examples.en: He craved the teacher's pardon.
examples.zh: 他恳求老师原谅他。

examples.en: I earnestly pray for your pardon.
examples.zh: 我恳切地请求你原谅。

examples.en: I hope you will pardon me for doing so.
examples.zh: 我希望你原谅我这样做。

words.definition: to prove or officially announce that someone is guilty of a crime after a  trial  in a law court; someone who has been proved to be guilty of a crime and sent to prison; criminal offender, culprit
words.translation: 证明有罪；罪犯

examples.en: a convicted murderer
examples.zh: 已定罪的谋杀犯

words.definition: official permission to do something, or the document giving this permission; commission, confirmation, warranty
words.translation: 授权,认可；[计][法]授权，认可；批准，委任

examples.en: You need special authorization to park here.
examples.zh: 在此停车要有特别的许可。

examples.en: Children may not leave the building without the authorization of the principal.
examples.zh: 没有校长的许可，孩子们不能离开这幢楼。

words.definition: of, relating to, like, or involving gymnastics; calisthenic
words.translation: 体操的,体育的；训练课程；体操的，体育的

examples.en: On our return from school our drawing and gymnastic masters would be ready for us.
examples.zh: 放学回来，我们的图画和体操老师已在家里恭候多时了。

examples.en: When you were 10 years old, she drove you all day,from socer to gymnastic to one birthday party after another. You thanked her by jumping out of the car and never looking back.
examples.zh: 你10岁时，她整天开着车送你，从足球课到体操房再到一个接一个的生日聚会， 你却以跳下车绝不回头看一眼来感谢她。

examples.en: Sylvia didn’t have any gymnastic classes but she was tall, strong, and she was popular.
examples.zh: 西尔维娅没有上过任何的体操课，但是她长得又高又壮的，很受大家的欢迎。

words.definition: to walk or move unsteadily, almost falling over; interlace; titubate, hesitate; titubation, hitchiness; altern, interlaced
words.translation: 蹒跚,交错；交错的；蹒跚；使交错；使犹豫；犹豫；交错安排；错开的

examples.en: He managed to stagger home.
examples.zh: 他好不容易才蹒跚着走回家。

examples.en: She staggered back a step.
examples.zh: 她踉跄着后退了一步。

examples.en: The old man staggered drunkenly to his feet.
examples.zh: 老汉醉醺醺地踉跄着站了起来。

words.definition: a period of time when a country is not fighting a war; everyday
words.translation: 和平时期；和平时期的；平时

examples.en: We could afford to reduce defence spending in peacetime without excessive risk.
examples.zh: 在和平时期我们可以减少国防开支而并不引起风险增加。

words.definition: to get used to a new situation, job, or way of life
words.translation: 重新调整,再调整

examples.en: It takes time to readjust after a divorce.
examples.zh: 离婚后需要时间重新适应。

words.definition: a situation in which two or more people, teams, or companies are competing for something, especially over a long period of time, and the feeling of competition between them; competition, war, struggle, match, contest
words.translation: 竞争,竞赛,敌对；竞争；对抗；竞赛

examples.en: The two players have developed a friendly rivalry .
examples.zh: 这两名选手之间已形成一种友好的竞争关系。

examples.en: She had never overcome her feelings of sibling rivalry (= rivalry between brothers and sisters ) .
examples.zh: 她一直没有克服和兄弟姐妹较劲的那种心理。

words.definition: the group of people in some countries who belong to the highest social class and have titles such as ‘Duke’ or ‘Countess’; prince, noble, dignity
words.translation: 高贵,贵族；贵族；高贵；高尚

examples.en: the nobility of his intentions
examples.zh: 他崇高的志向

words.definition: to bring something back after it has not been used or has not existed for a period of time; come back to life again, resurge; recall, reinvigorate
words.translation: 苏醒, (使)复兴；复兴；复活；苏醒；恢复精神；使复兴；使苏醒；回想起；重演，重播

examples.en: Local people have decided to revive this centuries-old tradition.
examples.zh: 当地人决定复兴这一延续了数个世纪的传统。

words.definition: slow or awkward because of being very big and heavy; mechanical, wooden, dead, cumbersome
words.translation: 笨重的,沉闷的；笨重的；沉闷的；呆板的

examples.en: an elephant’s ponderous walk
examples.zh: 大象笨拙的步态

words.definition: a person who threshes; thrasher, threshing machine
words.translation: 打谷者, 打谷机, [鱼]长尾鲨；[农机]打谷机；打谷者；[鱼]长尾鲨

words.definition: a thing such as a knife, spoon etc that you use when you are cooking; vessel, tool
words.translation: 器具；用具，[轻]器皿

examples.en: kitchen utensils
examples.zh: 厨房用具

words.definition: a man with a high rank in the past who was trained to fight while riding a horse; If someone is knighted, they are given a knighthood; chevalier, Cavs
words.translation: (欧洲中世纪的)骑士；授以爵位；骑士，武士；爵士

examples.en: knights in armour
examples.zh: 身披盔甲的骑士

examples.en: He was knighted in June 1988.
examples.zh: 他于1988年6月被授予爵士称号。

words.definition: done deliberately and usually intended to cause harm; studied, designed, conscious
words.translation: 故意的,策划的；故意的；蓄意的；策划的

examples.en: I did trip him, but it wasn’t intentional.
examples.zh: 我的确把他绊倒了，但不是故意的。

words.definition: using money carefully and wisely; economical, successful, managing, made, saving
words.translation: 节约的；茂盛的；成功的

examples.en: hard-working, thrifty people
examples.zh: 勤劳节俭的人们

words.definition: The enactment of a law is the process in a legislature by which the law is agreed upon and made official; establishment, act
words.translation: 设定,制定；制定，颁布；通过；法令

examples.en: We support the call for the enactment of a Bill of Rights.
examples.zh: 我们支持《权利法案》制定的呼吁。

words.definition: to say publicly or officially that something important is true or exists; indicate, sound, post, state, publish
words.translation: 宣布,声明,显露；宣告，公布；声明；表明；赞扬

examples.en: The President proclaimed the republic’s independence.
examples.zh: 总统宣布共和国独立。

words.definition: animals from the sea that you can eat, for example fish and  shellfish
words.translation: 海产食品, 海味

examples.en: a seafood restaurant
examples.zh: 海鲜餐馆

words.definition: to surround a city or castle with military force until the people inside let you take control; eat, invest, case, burden
words.translation: 围困,围攻；围困；包围；烦扰

examples.en: In April 655, Osman’s palace was besieged by rebels.
examples.zh: 公元655年4月，奥斯曼的宫殿遭到叛军围攻。

words.definition: not proved to be true; uncorroborated, unattested
words.translation: 未经证实的,无事实根据的；未经证实的，无事实根据的

examples.en: unsubstantiated allegations of child abuse
examples.zh: 未经证实的虐待儿童的指控

words.definition: not noticing or realizing what is happening; unknowing, unware; unexpectedly, accidentally
words.translation: 不知道的, 没觉察到的；不知道的，无意的；未察觉到的；意外地；不知不觉地

examples.en: Many people are unaware of just how much food and drink they consume.
examples.zh: 许多人不知道自己到底消耗掉多少食物和饮料。

words.translation: 半熔的

words.definition: to burn something completely in order to destroy it; cremate
words.translation: 把烧成灰,烧弃；焚化；烧成灰

examples.en: All the infected clothing was incinerated.
examples.zh: 所有沾染了细菌的衣服都被焚化了。

words.definition: A topographical survey or map relates to or shows the physical features of an area of land, for example, its hills, valleys, and rivers; physiographic
words.translation: 地志的,地形学的；地志的；地形学的（等于topographic）

examples.en: This is a suburb with very narrow streets, because it was not mapped out by the municipal topographical office.
examples.zh: 这个郊区地区的街道非常狭窄，因为没有经过市政地形办公室的规划。

examples.en: The first is they're topographical and what this means is that if two parts of the— two parts are close together on the body, they'll be close together on the brain.
examples.zh: 首先它们是具有地形学特点的,这意味着,如果身体上的两个部位是紧挨着的话,那它们在大脑中对应的区域也是紧挨着的

examples.en: However, due to a considerable variation in land area,1 population density and climatic, geological and topographical conditions, the extent of forest cover differs greatly among the island states.
examples.zh: 然而，由于各岛屿国家的陆地面积、1人口密度、气候、地理地形条件等有很大差异，它们的森林覆盖程度也有很大差别。

words.definition: a special occasion when people celebrate something such as a religious event, and there is often a public holiday; holiday, joy, celebration; cheerful, enjoyable
words.translation: 节日,喜庆日；节日的,快乐的；节日；庆祝，纪念活动；欢乐；节日的，喜庆的；快乐的

examples.en: Christmas is one of the main festivals in the Christian Calendar.
examples.zh: 圣诞节是基督教历的重大节日之一。

words.definition: a deep valley with very steep sides of rock that usually has a river running through it; glen, coomb, kloof
words.translation: <美>峡谷, 溪谷；[地理]峡谷

examples.en: The canyon is famous for producing echoes.
examples.zh: 这个峡谷以回声而闻名。

examples.en: The grand canyon was not dug by the hand of man, but riven by nature.
examples.zh: 大峡谷并非人力所开而是受大自然之力而成的。

examples.en: We made our way up the fixed rope and then down into a deeper third canyon.
examples.zh: 我们沿着固定的绳索前进，然后到达了一个更深的峡谷，这已经是第三个了。

words.definition: someone who trains falcons to hunt
words.translation: 以鹰狩猎者,养鹰者

words.definition: the legal right to keep something that belongs to someone who owes you money, until the debt has been paid
words.translation: 留置权,抵押品所产生的利息

words.definition: an un-reasonable dislike and distrust of people who are different from you in some way, especially because of their race, sex, religion etc – used to show disapproval; to influence someone so that they have an unfair or unreasonable opinion about someone or something; violation, bias; hurt, blast
words.translation: 偏见,损害；损害,有偏见；偏见；侵害；损害；使有偏见

examples.en: Women still face prejudice in the workplace.
examples.zh: 女性在职场中仍然面临歧视。

examples.en: It takes a long time to overcome these kinds of prejudices.
examples.zh: 战胜这些偏见需要假以时日。

words.definition: a flat sea animal that has five arms forming the shape of a star; sea star, asteroidean
words.translation: 海星；[无脊椎]海星

examples.en: She lays a kindly hand like a tiny starfish on my knee.
examples.zh: 她和善地伸出手，像小海星一样放在我的膝盖上。

examples.en: In the oceans, you can find starfish and sea horses. They are interesting and beautiful sea animals.
examples.zh: 在海洋中，你能看到海星以及海马，它们都是很有趣并且美丽的海洋动物。

examples.en: One reason is their diet: They eat only starfish (and sometimes sea urchins), and they reportedly prefer to eat them alive.
examples.zh: 原因之一是它们的饮食：它们只能吃到海星（有时是海胆），据报道它们喜欢吃活的。

words.definition: badly, highly, greatly, too, most
words.translation: 非常,格外地；非常；格外地；非凡地

words.definition: to cut a body into pieces or tear it apart; segment, chainsaw
words.translation: 肢解,割断手足；肢解，割断手足；分割，瓜分

examples.en: She then dismembered him, hiding parts of his body in the cellar.
examples.zh: 她接着将他的尸体肢解，把几块碎尸藏进了地窖。

words.definition: used to emphasize that something is certainly true; justifiably
words.translation: 无可非议地,确凿地；无可非议地；确凿地

examples.en: The Eiffel Tower is unquestionably one of Paris’s most familiar landmarks.
examples.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔无疑是巴黎最为人熟知的地标之一。

words.definition: one of the large groups into which scientists divide plants, animals, and languages; door, languages, gateway
words.translation: (生物分类学上的)门, 语群；门（分类）；语系

words.definition: a small  upright piano
words.translation: 古时的小型竖琴, 小型立式钢琴

words.definition: be of help, have it; have it, to advantage; behalf, utility, benefit, sake, profit
words.translation: 有益于,有帮助；效用, 利益；有用，有利；有利，有用；效用，利益

words.definition: the position in which you are more powerful or advanced than anyone else; sovereignty, hegemony
words.translation: 地位最高的人,至高,霸权；霸权；至高无上；主权；最高地位

examples.en: Japan’s unchallenged supremacy in the field of electronics
examples.zh: 日本在电子领域无人挑战的领先地位

words.definition: fame, hearsay; noise

examples.zh: 谣言使整个城市惊慌不安。

examples.zh: 这是那些不可靠的流言所说的两倍。

words.definition: a  passage 1; hall, door, exit, channel, route
words.translation: 过道,出入口；通道；走廊

examples.en: He led me down a narrow passageway.
examples.zh: 他带着我穿过一条狭窄的过道。

words.definition: the Gothic style of building was common in Western Europe between the 12th and 16th centuries and included tall pointed  arches  and windows and tall  pillars; wild, brutal; Gothic style
words.translation: 哥特式；哥特式的,野蛮的；哥特式的；野蛮的

examples.en: Gothic tattoos run along her back, and deep knife scars trace her shoulder.
examples.zh: 她的背上布满了哥特式纹身，肩头上有深深的刀疤。

words.definition: to pretend something, especially in order to achieve what you want in a difficult or dangerous situation; cliff, precipice; befool, assify; shit up; explicit, frank, naked
words.translation: 断崖,诈骗；绝壁的；诈骗；吓唬；绝壁；断崖；愚弄；直率的；陡峭的

examples.en: One of the choppers set down on the beach below them, the other on the bluff above.
examples.zh: 有一架直升机在他们下面的海滩上降落，其余的直接降落在断崖上。

words.definition: multifunctionality
words.translation: 多功能性；多才多艺；用途广泛

examples.en: Its versatility, flexibility, and wide range of implementations and environments make it difficult to describe procedures to cover all cases.
examples.zh: 其通用性、灵活性以及广泛的实现和环境，使得描述能涵盖所有情况的过程非常困难。

words.definition: relating to tones of colour or sound
words.translation: 音调的

examples.en: The tonal range she uses is wide and varied.
examples.zh: 她使用的色调丰富多彩。

words.definition: one of the two parts of a bicycle that you push round with your feet to make the bicycle go forward; to turn or push the pedals on a bicycle or other machine with your feet; ride bike; footplate, treadboard; ride
words.translation: 踏板；踩的踏板；踩踏板；骑车；脚蹬子；骑（自行车）；踩……的踏板

examples.en: She put her foot down on the accelerator pedal.
examples.zh: 她踩下了油门踏板。

words.definition: causing problems, often in a way that is annoying; disadvantageous, intrusive
words.translation: 不便的,打扰的；不便的；打扰的

examples.en: Monday’s a bit inconvenient for me. How about Wednesday?
examples.zh: 周一我不太方便，周三如何？

examples.en: Am I calling at an inconvenient time?
examples.zh: 我电话打得不是时候吧？

words.definition: someone who gives money, help, ideas etc to something that a lot of other people are also involved in; benefactor, doner
words.translation: 贡献者,捐助者；贡献者；投稿者；[经]捐助者

examples.en: campaign contributors
examples.zh: 竞选捐助人

words.translation: 耕种过度

words.definition: when something or someone enters or passes through something, especially when this is difficult; breakthrough, perception, insight, infiltration, intrusion
words.translation: 穿过, 渗透, 突破；渗透；突破；侵入；洞察力

examples.en: Cover the entire device to prevent water penetration.
examples.zh: 把整台设备都罩住以免进水。

words.definition: to take a number or an amount from a larger number or amount; substract, subduce
words.translation: (～ from)减去, 减；减去；扣掉

examples.en: Mandy subtracted the date of birth from the date of death.
examples.zh: 曼迪从死亡的日期减去了出生的日期。

words.definition: the area of floor around a fireplace in a house; cooking bench, ingleside
words.translation: 壁炉地面, 家庭（生活）；灶台；炉边；炉床；[建]壁炉地面

examples.en: It was winter and there was a huge fire roaring in the hearth.
examples.zh: 时值冬天，壁炉里的炉火在熊熊燃烧。

words.definition: a giant cactus, Carnegiea gigantea, of desert regions of Arizona, S California, and Mexico, having white nocturnal flowers and edible red pulpy fruits
words.translation: 仙人掌之一种

examples.en: A saguaro cactus stands tall amid a frenzy of lightning bolts in Arizona.
examples.zh: 亚利桑那州，一株巨人柱仙人掌矗立在一团狂暴的闪电中。

words.definition: to go beyond the usual limits of something; overcome, exceed, top, cap, surpass
words.translation: 超越, 胜过；胜过，超越

examples.en: The desire for peace transcended political differences.
examples.zh: 对和平的渴望超越了政治分歧。

words.definition: the large main root of a plant, from which smaller roots grow
words.translation: [植]主根, 直根

examples.en: A largely Protestant nation that can trace its theological taproot to Martin Luther ought to know better.
examples.zh: 作为一个主要由新教徒构成的国家，有必要了解到它的神学根源来自于马丁·路德。

words.definition: Fire is the hot, bright flames produced by things that are burning; When a pot or clay object is fired, it is heated at a high temperature in a special oven, as part of the process of making it; discharge, dismissal; lighting, urging
words.translation: 开火, 生火；开火,烧制；开火；烧制；解雇；生火；解雇（fire的ing形式）；点燃；激励

examples.en: They saw a big flash and a huge ball of fire reaching hundreds of feet into the sky.
examples.zh: 他们看到一道强光和一个巨大的火球直冲天空达几百英尺。

examples.en: After the pot is dipped in this mixture, it is fired.
examples.zh: 这个壶在混合料里浸过之后，就进行烧制。

words.definition: a company or person that supplies shops and companies with goods; dealer, franchiser
words.translation: 发行人,经销商；经销商；[纺][电]分配器；分配者；散布者；配电盘

examples.en: ...Spain's largest distributor of petroleum products.
examples.zh: …西班牙最大的石油产品经销商。

words.definition: If an event, a sign, or a symbol signifies something, it is a sign of that thing or represents that thing; indicate, bid, forecast, mean, shadow; matter, count for
words.translation: 颇为重要, 意味；表示；意味；预示；有重要性；要紧；冒充内行

examples.en: These were not the only changes that signified the end of boyhood.
examples.zh: 这些不是表示男孩时代已结束的惟一变化。

words.definition: to pay attention to something, especially something someone says, and seriously consider it; to pay attention to someone’s advice or warning; take care of, mind you, be mindful of; watching, take care of, be mindful of, mind you
words.translation: 注意,留意；注意，留心

examples.en: The government was taking little heed of these threats.
examples.zh: 政府对这些威胁几乎不当回事。

examples.en: Tom paid no heed to her warning.
examples.zh: 汤姆根本没有理会她的警告。

words.definition: a class at a university or college for a small group of students and a teacher to study or discuss a particular subject; forum, consultation, symposium
words.translation: 研究会,讨论发表会；讨论会，研讨班

examples.en: a Shakespeare seminar
examples.zh: 莎士比亚研讨班

words.definition: sapor, palatability
words.translation: 情味, 风味；加味于；情味，风味；香料；滋味

words.definition: to fail to satisfy; disappoint
words.translation: 使感觉不满, 不满足

words.definition: Adequacy is the quality of being good enough or great enough in amount to be acceptable; fitness, relevance
words.translation: 适当, 足够；足够；[审计]适当；妥善性

examples.en: There are questions to be raised about the adequacy of the inmates' legal representation.
examples.zh: 关于监犯的法定代表是否够格会有一些问题被提出。

words.definition: If you describe something or someone as uninteresting, you mean they have no special or exciting qualities; stupid, flavourless
words.translation: 无趣味的，乏味的；令人厌倦的

examples.en: Their media have earned the reputation for being rather dull and uninteresting.
examples.zh: 他们的媒体得到的名声是乏味无聊。

words.definition: a singer or musician in the Middle Ages; singer, vocalist
words.translation: 吟游诗人(或歌手)；歌手，艺人；吟游诗人

examples.en: Alfred the Great acted his own spy, visiting Danish camps disguised as a minstrel.
examples.zh: 他扮作吟游歌手到丹麦军队的营地里侦察。

examples.en: If some minstrel belts out “Imagine” or gets a crowd to sing along hoping to carry away a hatful of coins, this busker could face a fine ranging from $50 to $200.
examples.zh: 如果在这片草莓园里，有流浪歌手高歌吟唱他的《想象》或是唱着民谣摇滚，招致大批群众围观，而只是为了能让自己“行乞”的帽子装满硬币的街头艺人们，可能会面临50到200美元不等的罚款。

words.definition: irreversible damage, change etc is so serious or so great that you cannot change something back to how it was before; non-reversible, nonreversing
words.translation: 不可逆的,不能取消的；不可逆的；不能取消的；不能翻转的

examples.en: Fossil fuels have caused irreversible damage to the environment.
examples.zh: 矿物燃料已对环境造成了不可挽回的破坏。

words.definition: to praise or approve of someone or something publicly; recommend, put in a good word; speak well of, pay a tribute to
words.translation: 称赞, 表扬, 推荐；推荐；称赞；把…委托；表扬

examples.en: The paper was highly commended in the UK Press Awards.
examples.zh: 该报获得了“英国新闻奖”的高度褒奖。

words.definition: any of several gadoid food fishes of the northern coastal genus Molva, esp M; cod, codfish
words.translation: 鳕鱼, 石南之一种；鳕鱼；石南之一种；一种似雪鱼的食用鱼

words.definition: one of the various forms of a  salt  of  phosphorus  , often used in industry
words.translation: 磷酸盐

examples.en: The role of these glands is to regulate calcium and phosphate in our bloodstream.
examples.zh: 这些腺体的作用是稳定血液中钙质和磷酸盐的含量。

examples.en: They dissolved cobalt and phosphate in water and then zapped it with electricity through an electrode.
examples.zh: 他们把钴和磷酸盐溶解到水溶液中，然后，通过电极对它们进行电解。

examples.en: The cobalt and phosphate form a thin-film catalyst around the electrode that then use electrons from the electrode to split the oxygen from water.
examples.zh: 钴和磷酸盐在电极周围形成了薄膜型的催化剂，这些催化剂就利用电极发射的电子从水中分解氢和氧。

words.definition: costing or having a particular amount each; respectively, each
words.translation: 每个, 每人, 各；每人；每个；各自地

examples.zh: 这些画每幅价值约一万英镑。

examples.zh: 排名最高的两支球队各得十分。

words.translation: 徒步者, 参加竞走者；步行者；散步者；参加竞走者

examples.zh: 这地方很受徒步者欢迎。

examples.en: climbers and hill-walkers
examples.zh: 登山者和山地徒步旅行者

words.definition: clearly; obviously, clearly, easily, strictly, no doubt
words.translation: 清楚地, 显然；明显地；无疑地，确实地

examples.en: Speak clearly and distinctly.
examples.zh: 说话要清楚明白。

examples.en: He distinctly remembered the day his father left.
examples.zh: 他清晰地记得父亲离开的那一天。

words.translation: (使)恶化；恶化，变坏；恶化

examples.zh: 埃塞尔的健康状况恶化了。

examples.zh: 美国日渐恶化的经济

words.definition: stretched tight; intense, stressed; intertangle, entangle

examples.zh: 降低税率将刺激投资，有助于经济增长。

examples.zh: 这两名救护车的救护员迅速把普洛弗放在担架上并抬进了那辆救护车。

examples.en: The horses' hooves often could not get a proper grip.
examples.zh: 这些马的蹄子经常踩不稳。

examples.zh: 正确的姿势应是，右后腿早应向前迈，并且应该在跨出前腿之前就迈出后腿。

examples.en: The researchers found, for example, that a skeleton of a dog at a Finnish museum depicts the right hindleg in a rearward position while the right foreleg is lifted and moving forward.
examples.zh: 例如，研究人员发现在一家芬兰博物馆中的一副狗的骨架，其右前腿已经离地向前而其右后腿仍在后方。

examples.zh: 他也穿着吊带裤。

words.translation: 带扣 v扣住, 变弯曲；扣住；变弯曲；使弯曲

examples.en: He wore a belt with a large brass buckle.
examples.zh: 他系了一根有很大黄铜扣的皮带。

words.definition: to rub part of your body to make it warm; anger, provoke; brush burn, rub the wrong way; brush-burn, abrasion

examples.zh: 我的短裤蹭得我大腿疼。

examples.zh: 就和止血带的功用一样了。

examples.en: Still, it remains to be seen whether the tourniquet will hold. Even after the new plan, Greece will have a staggering load of debt.
examples.zh: 然而止血带能否承受压力尚待分晓。即使新计划得以实施，希腊仍将面临巨额债务负担。

examples.en: This tourniquet is tight. How does it feel?
examples.zh: 好了，止血带紧了，觉得怎样？

examples.en: These days, her bandanna is usually red.
examples.zh: 这些天，她的印花大手帕通常是红色的。

examples.en: The next morning, he bundled up some food in a red bandanna handkerchief, told his parents good-by, and set off into the world .
examples.zh: 次日早晨，他用一块红色的印花大手帕包了一些点心，告别了双亲，出发去闯天下。

words.definition: a special quality someone or something has that makes people like them, feel attracted to them, or be easily influenced by them – used to show approval; grace, appeal, fascination; intoxicate
words.translation: 吸引力, 魅力；迷人, 使陶醉；魅力，吸引力；魔力；使陶醉；行魔法

examples.en: Joe’s boyish charm
examples.zh: 乔身上的稚趣

examples.en: She turned on the charm (= used her charm ) to all the men.
examples.zh: 她对所有那些男人都施展魅力。

examples.en: The room had no windows and all the charm of a prison cell (= used to say that something has no charm ) .
examples.zh: 这房间没有窗，简直就是牢房。

words.definition: a vestigial part of the body has never developed completely or has almost disappeared; degenerative, degraded
words.translation: 退化的,发育不全的；[生物]退化的；残余的；发育不全的

examples.zh: 蛇的腿已经退化或完全消失。

不运行的
珠穆朗玛峰(世界最高峰)

examples.en: Workers dug a trench for gas lines.
examples.zh: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设煤气管道。

examples.zh: 门罗接替麦迪逊当上总统。

examples.zh: 枪伤 ：在被推选为总统之前，1776年，詹姆斯·门罗辍学参军，在第三维吉尼亚步兵团当了一名军校学员。

examples.en: When woven together, as they would be in policies ranging from the Monroe Doctrine to the Marshall Plan, they were the warp and woof of a sturdy foreign policy.
examples.zh: 当它们可以和谐地在一起运作的时候，不管是从门罗主义到马歇尔计划也好，它们都是国际事务处理的参考基础。

words.definition: to admit that something is true or correct, although you wish it were not true; afford, accept, agree, recognize, extend; meet halfway, give ground

examples.zh: “那是唯一可行的解决办法。”“对，我想是。”查尔斯承认道。

words.definition: one of the bones that your teeth are in, especially the lower bone; credit, honor

words.definition: careful about what you choose to do, buy, allow etc; alternative
words.translation: 选择的, 选择性的；选择性的

examples.zh: 择优录取学生的学校

examples.zh: 他的记忆选择性很强。

words.translation: 伊拉克共和国

examples.zh: 因此，如果你可以去加拿大的话，为什么要去伊拉克呢？

examples.zh: 我有一张您和我一起在伊拉克的照片。

examples.zh: 我从报上得知伊拉克目前的严重局势。
