examples.zh: 我在1995年做了一次失败的面部拉皮手术。

words.definition: something, especially money, that you give to a person or an organ-ization in order to help them; endowment, offertory
words.translation: 捐赠品, 捐款, 贡献；捐款，[经]捐赠物；捐赠

examples.en: There have been generous donations from EU funds.
examples.zh: 欧盟基金给予了慷慨的捐款。

words.definition: a group of mountains forming one large solid shape; cerro, tepe
words.translation: 山丘；断层块；大厦

examples.en: Tanakhat Monastery complex is located on a hill of a very picturesque massif.
examples.zh: 塔纳哈修道院坐落在一处风景如画的山丘上。

words.definition: a book containing maps, especially of the whole world
words.translation: 地图, 地图集

words.definition: Wireless technology uses radio waves rather than electricity and therefore does not require any wires; a radio; threadless; marconi
words.translation: 无线的；无线；[通信][电讯]无线的；无线电的；[通信][电讯]打无线电报；打无线电话

examples.en: ...the fast-growing wireless communication market.
examples.zh: …快速增长的无线通讯市场。

words.definition: to make something completely clean by killing any  bacteria  in it; listerize, antisepticize
words.translation: 杀菌, 消毒, 使成不毛；消毒，杀菌；使成不毛；使绝育；使不起作用

examples.en: Sterilize the bottles with boiling water.
examples.zh: 用沸水把这些瓶子消毒。

examples.en: sterilized milk
examples.zh: 消过毒的牛奶

examples.en: sterilizing solution
examples.zh: 消毒溶液

words.translation: 重进入, 再加入；重返

examples.en: After waiting a while, and with a fresh canary, the miners could safely reenter the mine.
examples.zh: 过一段时间之后，如果新换上的金丝雀安然无恙，矿工们又可以安全地重返矿井。

examples.en: Cornell runs halfway houses and youth prisons and has noticed an uptick in the demand for drug treatment, housing, or job placement programs that help prisoners reenter society.
examples.zh: 科内尔公司运营了半途房屋、青年监狱，同时他们还注意到对吸毒者治疗需求的上升，房屋和工作安排项目将使得犯人重返社会。

examples.en: Or, certain computer users might always fully delete and reenter information into a new record rather than just editing the old record -- a vestigial behavior associated with older technology.
examples.zh: 或者，某些计算机用户可能总是完全删除并将信息重新输入到新的记录中，而不要仅仅编辑旧记录 —— 一种与老技术相联系的残留行为。

words.definition: dispute, let, stem, block; prevention, check, detention
words.translation: 延迟, 妨碍；延迟；阻止；妨碍；使减速

examples.en: Continuing violence will retard negotiations over the country's future.
examples.zh: 持续不断的暴力活动会阻碍关于国家未来的谈判的进行。

words.definition: a way of thinking about something that seems correct and reasonable, or a set of sensible reasons for doing something
words.translation: 逻辑, 逻辑学；逻辑的

examples.en: There isa certain logicin their choice of architect.
examples.zh: 他们对建筑师的选择是有一定道理的。

words.definition: to decay by a gradual natural process, or to make something do this; corruption, decomposition; fall into decay, blet; corrupt, eat out; rats, fiddlesticks
words.translation: (使)腐烂, (使)腐败 n腐烂, 腐败；[植保]腐烂；腐败；腐坏；堕落；[植保]使腐烂；[木]使腐朽；使堕落；（表示厌恶、蔑视、烦恼等）胡说；糟了

examples.en: Candy will rot your teeth.
examples.zh: 吃糖会腐蚀牙齿。

examples.en: The trees were cut and left to rot .
examples.zh: 树被砍伐后任其腐烂。

words.definition: a feeling of happiness or pleasure because you have achieved something or got what you wanted; content, fill, satisfied with, Lays
words.translation: 满意, 满足, 令人满意的事物；满意，满足；赔偿；乐事；赎罪

examples.en: She got great satisfaction from helping people to learn.
examples.zh: 她在帮助人们学习的过程中得到很大的满足。

examples.en: ‘I’ve passed all my exams’, he announced with satisfaction.
examples.zh: “我通过了所有的考试。”他满意地宣布。

words.definition: relations, society, affinity
words.translation: 和谐, 亲善；密切关系，交往；和谐一致

examples.en: And last but not least, people with whom you can build a rapport and camaraderie with.
examples.zh: 一直到最后、并非最不重要的一个人，与你建立起和谐融洽的友谊。

words.definition: When someone or something achieves a more important rank or status, you can say that they are elevated to it; promote, upgrade, prefer
words.translation: 举起, 提升的职位；提升；举起；振奋情绪等；提升…的职位

examples.en: He was elevated to the post of president.
examples.zh: 他被提拔到总裁的职位。

words.definition: control, grasp, hold, guiding, command; keep hold of, enclasp; beef about, repine
words.translation: 紧握, 柄；握紧；控制；发牢骚；肠绞痛；绞痛；惹恼；抱怨，发牢骚

words.definition: a conversation in which you exchange information with someone about other people’s lives and things that have happened; essay, quidnunc; chat about, make conversation
words.translation: 闲话, 闲谈；小道传闻；随笔；爱说长道短的人；闲聊；传播流言蜚语

examples.en: Phil’s in there, having a gossip with Maggie.
examples.zh: 菲尔在那里面跟玛吉闲聊。

words.definition: the number of people who attend a game, concert, meeting etc; presence
words.translation: 出席, 出席的人数；出席；到场；出席人数

examples.en: We have an average attendance of 4,000 fans per game.
examples.zh: 每场比赛平均有4,000名球迷来观战。

examples.en: Last year’s fair saw attendance figures of 32,000.
examples.zh: 去年的交易会有3.2万人参加。

words.definition: the process by which people, especially children, are made to behave in a way that is acceptable in their society
words.translation: 社会化, 社会主义化

examples.en: Schools play an important part in the socialization of our children.
examples.zh: 学校对儿童适应社会的过程起着重要的作用。

words.definition: people from Ireland; Hibernian, Milesian; Erin, Republic of Ireland
words.translation: 爱尔兰人(的),爱尔兰语（的）；爱尔兰的；爱尔兰人的；爱尔兰；爱尔兰人；爱尔兰语

examples.en: I am starting to sense that maybe I and people like me are to blame because it is we, the Irish people, who are paying with our jobs, livelihoods, health care and education.
examples.zh: 我开始感觉到或许就是我以及像我这样的人，该受责备，因为就是我们，让爱尔兰人民，正在为我们的工作、生活、医疗卫生和教育买单。

examples.en: On the other hand, the Irish are also right to be suspicious of intentions in Brussels and Berlin.
examples.zh: 另一方面，爱尔兰对于柏林和布鲁塞尔的意图持怀疑态度也是有道理的。

words.definition: someone who has seen something such as a crime happen, and is able to describe it afterwards; witness
words.translation: 目击者, 见证人；目击者；[法]见证人

examples.en: One eyewitness said he saw her talking to a man in a blue car.
examples.zh: 一名目击者说他看见她在跟一个坐在蓝色汽车里的男子说话。

words.definition: a large business organization consisting of several different companies that have joined together; enterprise group, keiretsu; volumed
words.translation: 聚结；企业集团；[岩]砾岩；[动]聚合物；成团的；砾岩性的

examples.en: an international conglomerate
examples.zh: 国际大型联合企业

words.definition: a group of criminals who work together; cluster, bunch, qun
words.translation: (一)伙, (一)群；群；一伙；一组

examples.en: Several gangs were operating in the area.
examples.zh: 有好几个犯罪团伙在这个地区活动。

examples.en: Armed gangs have hijacked lorries.
examples.zh: 武装犯罪团伙劫持了卡车。

words.definition: to involve something as a necessary part or result; charge, inflict on
words.translation: 使必需, 使蒙受；[建]限定继承权；必需，使承担；限定继承

examples.en: A new computer system entails a lot of re-training.
examples.zh: 使用新的计算机系统需要大量的再培训。

examples.en: Some foreign travel is entailed in the job.
examples.zh: 做这份工作有时要到国外出差。

words.definition: to make a hole in something, using a metal tool or other sharp object; blanking press, drilling machine; jab
words.translation: 冲孔, 打孔；[机]冲压机；打洞器；[计]钻孔机；用拳猛击

examples.en: The guard punched my ticket and I got on.
examples.zh: 守卫在我的票上打孔后，我就上去了。

examples.en: These bullets can punch a hole through 20 mm steel plate.
examples.zh: 这些子弹可以穿透20毫米厚的钢板。

words.definition: the end of a railway line
words.translation: 铺设中的铁路末端, 终点

words.definition: preferential treatment, rates etc are deliberately different in order to give an advantage to particular people; prior, underlying
words.translation: 优先的；选择的；[税收]优先的；[贸易]特惠的；先取的

examples.en: preferential credit terms for reliable borrowers
examples.zh: 向可靠借款人提供的优惠信贷条件

words.definition: relating to or affecting your brain; encephalic, cranic
words.translation: 脑的, 大脑的；[动]大脑的，脑的

examples.en: a cerebral haemorrhage
examples.zh: 脑出[溢]血

words.translation: 肯尼亚

examples.en: Let us now fuse together now as one people who want to do something for the people of Kenya. Let us strengthen the foundation of multiparty democracy in our country.
examples.zh: 现在让我们融汇在一起，团结起来，就像希望为肯尼亚人民作一些事情的同一个人，让我们一起巩固我国多党民主制的基础。

examples.en: Some of the best programmers in Kenya are working for nonprofits when they could be creating an economy.
examples.zh: 在肯尼亚，一些最好的程序员在他们能够创造经济效益时却为非盈利组织工作。

words.definition: a set of letters, arranged in a particular order, and used in writing; ABC, rudiments
words.translation: 字母表；[语]字母表，字母系统；入门，初步

examples.en: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
examples.zh: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

words.definition: quickly and smoothly with a single movement; purely, immaculately; kosher
words.translation: 干净地, 清洁地；干净地；清洁地；干净的；爱清洁的

examples.en: The branch snapped cleanly in two.
examples.zh: 树枝啪的一下断成两截。

words.translation: [植]金鸡纳树皮, 奎宁

words.definition: an unresolved problem or question has not been answered or solved; outstanding, unsolved
words.translation: 未解决的，未决定的；未解决的；无决断力的；不果断的

examples.en: the unresolved issue of who will pay for the project
examples.zh: 项目由谁出资这个悬而未决的问题

examples.en: an unresolved conflict
examples.zh: 没有解决的冲突

words.definition: a meal eaten in the middle of the day; dejeuner, Mittagessen
words.translation: 午餐

examples.en: What’s for lunch?
examples.zh: 午饭吃什么？

words.definition: to make someone feel very excited and happy; glad, please, satisfy
words.translation: 使高兴, 使愉快；使高兴，使振奋；使愉快

words.definition: the art of arranging how dancers should move during a performance
words.translation: 舞蹈术, 舞台舞蹈

examples.en: The choreography of Eric Hawkins is considered radical by ballet audiences.
examples.zh: 埃里克·霍金斯的舞蹈编排被芭蕾舞剧的观众认为是不同凡响的。

words.definition: abound with, be imbued with; swill
words.translation: 大量出现；充满；倒出

examples.en: God, said, ‘Let the waters teem with countless living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of heaven.
examples.zh: 上帝说：“水中要有万种游鱼，地上要有无数飞鸟”于是上帝创造出种类繁多的大小鱼类及飞鸟。

words.definition: recently; of late, odd-come-shortly
words.translation: 近来, 最近；近来，不久前

examples.en: What have you been doing lately?
examples.zh: 你最近在干什么？

examples.en: Lately, I’ve had trouble sleeping.
examples.zh: 最近我睡眠有问题。

words.definition: a situation in which there is not enough of something; shortage, short of, deficiency, insufficient, need
words.translation: 缺乏, 不足；不足；缺乏

examples.en: ...an ever increasing scarcity of water.
examples.zh: …越来越匮乏的水资源。

words.definition: When a movie or show premieres or is premiered, it is shown to an audience for the first time; The premiere of a new play or movie is the first public performance of it; first-time; leading actress, chief actress
words.translation: 初次公演；初次的演出；杰出的；首位的；初次的；女主角的；女主角

examples.en: The documentary premiered at the Jerusalem Film Festival.
examples.zh: 那部记录片在耶路撒冷电影节上首映。

examples.en: Four astronauts visited for last week's premiere of the movie Space Station.
examples.zh: 四位宇航员到场参加了上个星期举行的电影《空间站》的首映式。

words.definition: the showing of a film or television programme; If something is screened by another thing, it is behind it and hidden by it; showing, filtration; filming
words.translation: 放映；遮蔽,筛选；[矿业]筛选；[物]屏蔽；审查；防波；拍摄（screen的ing形式）；遮蔽；隔挡

examples.en: a screening of Spielberg’s new movie
examples.zh: 斯皮尔伯格的新片放映

examples.en: Most of the road behind the hotel was screened by an apartment block.
examples.zh: 旅馆后面那条路的大部分都被一排公寓楼挡住了。

words.definition: an exemplary punishment is very severe and is intended to stop other people from committing the same crime; emulable
words.translation: 典范的,惩戒性的；典范的；惩戒性的；可仿效的

examples.en: a company with an exemplary record on environmental issues
examples.zh: 在处理环境问题方面可作为楷模的公司

words.definition: someone from Austria; relating to Austria or its people
words.translation: 奥地利人；奥地利的, 奥地利人的

examples.en: When I began to cough, I blamed it on the Austrian cigarettes.
examples.zh: 当我开始咳嗽时，我把这事怪在抽奥地利的香烟上。

examples.en: Austrian euro coins have a unique design for each denomination, with a common theme for each of the three series of coins.
examples.zh: 奥地利的欧元硬币对于每个货币的命名有着唯一的设计，三个系列的硬币有着共同的设计主题。

examples.en: She quotes an Austrian banker as saying: “I always find it easier to do business [in English] with partners from Greece or Russia or Denmark.
examples.zh: 她引用了一位奥地利银行家的话称：“我总是发现，（用英语）和希腊、俄罗斯或丹麦人做生意更容易一些。

words.definition: the time in the evening after which television programmes that are not considered suitable for children may be shown in Britain; valley, divide, river basin
words.translation: 分水岭；（美）[水文]流域；[地理]分水岭；集水区；转折点

examples.en: The election of Mary Robinson in 1990 was a watershed in Irish politics.
examples.zh: 1990年玛丽·鲁滨逊的当选是爱尔兰政治的分水岭。

words.definition: the act or process of dividing history into periods
words.translation: (历史等的)时期(或时代)划分

words.definition: a woman who works at home cleaning and cooking etc and does not have another job; hausfrau, matron
words.translation: 主妇

examples.en: Whether you are a carpenter or a therapist, a homemaker or a professor, it makes no difference.
examples.zh: 不论你是一个木匠或是一个治疗师，一个家庭主妇还是教授，这都没有区别。

examples.en: My mother was a mother, homemaker.… I think my mother influenced me as far as my love for reading.
examples.zh: 我母亲就是一位母亲，家庭主妇……我想我母亲对我的影响很大，甚至包括我对阅读的喜爱。

examples.en: “I would not have wanted to live in my parents’ or grandparents’ time,” said Mrs. Peeples, a full-time homemaker.
examples.zh: 皮尔普斯太太现在是个全职主妇。 她说：“我不会继续活在我父母或祖父母那个时代了。

words.definition: a written record of a series of events, especially historical events, written in the order in which they happened; to describe events in the order in which they happened; page, register; register, to record
words.translation: 编年史；编入编年史；编年史，年代记；记录；把…载入编年史

examples.en: ...this vast chronicle of Napoleonic times.
examples.zh: …这本关于拿破仑时期的大部头编年史。

words.definition: the substance upon which an enzyme acts; matrix, ground substance
words.translation: （土地）底层,基础；基质；基片；底层（等于substratum）；酶作用物

examples.en: As chemical precursors stream onto the surface of a rolling metal or plastic substrate, they react with one another to form a network of nanoparticles.
examples.zh: 各化学母质流向滚动中的金属或塑料基片的表面，他们互相作用，形成一层纳米级微粒网状结构。

examples.en: Fundamentally, these paradigms can be (and are) built on top of a substrate of threads and locks, but they create higher level abstractions that push much of that complexity down.
examples.zh: 从根本上讲，这些范例可以（且是）构建于线程和锁的基底之上，但是它们创建降低复杂度的更高的抽象级别。

examples.en: This means that a file system would serve as a reasonable substrate for a synchronization database.
examples.zh: 这意味着文件系统作为同步数据库的底层支持是合情合理的。

words.definition: food that people or animals need in order to live; food, diet, holding, eating, support
words.translation: 食物, 生计, (受)支持；食物；生计；支持

examples.en: Without sustenance, the animals will soon die.
examples.zh: 没有食物，动物很快就会死亡。

examples.en: Potatoes were their only means of sustenance.
examples.zh: 马铃薯是他们唯一的食物。

words.definition: relating to giving help to the poor; generous, handsome, liberal
words.translation: 慈善事业的,慷慨的,仁慈的；慈善事业的；慷慨的，仁慈的；宽恕的

examples.en: charitable groups
examples.zh: 慈善团体

examples.en: a charitable donation
examples.zh: 慈善捐赠

words.definition: considerably, remarkably, finely
words.translation: 非常地,可怕地,惊人地；非常地；可怕地；惊人地

words.definition: a view from a particular place; viewpoint, scenery, perspective, picture, eye
words.translation: 景色, 展望；展望；观点；景色

examples.en: a very pleasing outlook from the bedroom window
examples.zh: 从卧室窗户看出去的宜人景色

words.definition: sensory, apperceptive
words.translation: 感知的,知觉的；感知的，知觉的；有知觉力的

examples.en: a perceptive young man
examples.zh: 一个观察敏锐的年轻人

words.definition: something that happens or exists as a result of things that happened at an earlier time; heritage, inheritance
words.translation: 遗赠(物), 遗产；遗赠，[法]遗产

examples.en: She received a small legacy from her aunt.
examples.zh: 她从姨妈那里继承了一小笔遗产。

words.definition: careful, tough, rough, diligent; industry, diligence
words.translation: 辛苦；辛苦的, 辛勤的；艰苦的；勤勉的；小心的；勤勉

examples.en: You said in your address that "developing excellence is a slow, painstaking process".
examples.zh: 你在你的致词中说“发展卓越性是一个缓慢艰苦的过程”。

examples.en: In order to transform their environment, he drew up the project with painstaking accuracy.
examples.zh: 为了改造环境， 他苦心孤诣地制订了这个计划。

words.definition: not certain about something or about what you have to do; indefinite, inconclusive
words.translation: 没有自信的, 不确定的；不确定的；不肯定的；没有自信的

examples.en: Chris seemed nervous and unsure of herself.
examples.zh: 克丽丝显得紧张，没有自信。

words.definition: a light-coloured fine-grained accumulation of clay and silt particles that have been deposited by the wind; sienna
words.translation: 黄土；[地质]黄土

examples.en: Could there have been a really large dam that caused a deep lake in both Zharu and the main valleys and is older than the loess deposits?
examples.zh: 这儿有可能有一个真正巨大的大坝，导致扎如和主峡谷之间的深湖，并且时间比黄土沉积物还久远吗？

examples.en: Then something strange happened: The loess in the terraces wasn’t on top of crushed rock anymore — it was on top of very finely laminated clay-rich sediments.
examples.zh: 然后一些很奇怪的事儿发生了： 梯田里的黄土不再在碎岩石上- 在非常完美层压的黏土丰富的沉积物上。

words.definition: a measure of the ability of a surface to reflect radiation, equal to the reflectance of a layer of material sufficiently thick for the reflectance not to depend on the thickness; reflection power, albedo
words.translation: 反射率；[光][物]反射率；反射性；反射比

examples.en: With these layers downloaded, you can combine them with the base reflectivity image to produce a more easily readable image map.
examples.zh: 下载了这些图层之后，您可以把它们与基本反射率图像结合起来生成更易于阅读的图像地图。

examples.en: Using a model that simulates how light, water, and air interact, Seitz found that microbubbles could double the reflectivity of water at a concentration of only one part per million by volume.
examples.zh: 塞茨利用一个模型模仿了光、水和空气是如何产生相互作用的，他发现：按体积计算，密度仅为百万分之一时，微型气泡可以使水的反射率加倍。

examples.en: Do not include the radar base reflectivity image as it can make precise area location more difficult.
examples.zh: 请勿包括雷达基本反射率图像，因为它可能会使精确定位地区变得更困难。

words.translation: 巴尔干半岛(的)

examples.zh: 两名搜救成员用降落伞落到一块更大的浮冰上，然后匍匐着去够他。

examples.zh: 它具有难以置信的强度和弹性，而其异常的高导电性和半导体中灵活的应用可以提高计算能力。

examples.zh: 旨在防止不公平竞争的法令

examples.zh: 回到缅因州，要是斯科特把一件脏衣服丢进衣物篮我就开始感谢他。

examples.zh: 另外，每一所住宅都有充足的能源与高效保温。 一个随时运转的太阳能热水器，和一个集水系统来回收雨水用来冲洗卫生间或是洗衣服。

examples.zh: 她咬着嘴唇站在那里，等着，等了将近一个小时，约瑟夫才放下手鼓、睁开眼睛。

examples.zh: 约瑟夫在一个名叫“草地”的乐队敲鼓，有的时候敲手鼓。

examples.zh: 由于市场固有的流动性和即时性，所以我们经常构建新知识领域。

examples.zh: 除了女性，性别的流动性同样会出现在男性身上，但这有证据显示女性在这个方面更有可能和可塑性。

examples.zh: 他们仍在寻找一个新主任

examples.zh: 讨论仍在继续。

examples.zh: 我卧室窗外的景色美得令人窒息。

examples.zh: 令人咋舌的傲慢举动

words.translation: 不可预见地,  不能预料地

examples.zh: 或者像我一样，你可以后退或者前进，抑或是刮去那堆堆积物，通过呈现更多使你自己变得更加容易接近。

words.definition: to arrange or organize something in a new way; arrange, sort things out; set in order, to revise
words.translation: 改组, 整顿；整理；改组；重新制定；整顿；改编

examples.en: Our office is being completely reorganized.
examples.zh: 我们办公室正在彻底改组。

words.definition: a branch or subfamily of the Altaic family of languages, including Turkish, Turkmen, Kirghiz, Tatar, etc, members of which are found from Turkey to NE China, esp in central Asia
words.translation: 土耳其语(的), 土耳其语系者(的)

words.definition: someone who is immature behaves or thinks in a way that is typical of someone much younger – used to show disapproval; crude, rough, raw, coarse, harsh
words.translation: 不成熟的, 未完全发展的；不成熟的；未成熟的；粗糙的

examples.en: He forgave his son’s immature behaviour.
examples.zh: 他原谅了儿子的幼稚行为。

words.definition: the ability to do something in an exact way without making a mistake
words.translation: 精确性, 正确度

examples.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
examples.zh: 他传球准确无误。

words.definition: for a very short time; briefly, soon, immediately, now, shortly
words.translation: 暂时地, 立刻地；随时地；暂时地；立刻

examples.en: She was momentarily lost for words.
examples.zh: 她一时语塞。

examples.en: Jimmy paused momentarily.
examples.zh: 吉米停顿了片刻。

words.definition: excessively confident; proud, conceited
words.translation: 自负的, 过于自信的；过于自信的；自负的

examples.en: God warns us never to get cocky and overconfident; that is the recipe for disaster.
examples.zh: 神警告我们绝不可自高过于自信，那是招致灾难的处方。

examples.en: Islamists should be careful not to fall into the trap of feeling overconfident: they must accommodate other trends, even if it means making painful concessions.
examples.zh: 伊斯兰教徒要小心地避开可能陷入的自负的陷阱：他们必须适应潮流，即使这意味着他们必须做出痛苦的让步。

examples.en: I will always remember Brittany as that loud, overconfident girl, and a part of that shy, insecure person I used to be will always keep me humble.
examples.zh: 我会一直记住布里塔尼，那个举止招摇而又张狂自负的女孩。 而曾经腼腆而又不自信的我也会一如既往地保持那份谦卑。

words.translation: 扩张主义(的)

words.definition: to annoy someone, especially by interrupting them when they are trying to do something; eat, burden; worry, go to trouble; trouble, worry, headache
words.translation: 烦扰, 打扰 v；烦扰，打扰；使……不安；使……恼怒；操心，麻烦；烦恼；麻烦

examples.en: Danny, don’t bother Ellen while she’s reading.
examples.zh: 丹尼，埃伦看书的时候不要去打扰她 。

examples.en: Would it bother you if I put on some music?
examples.zh: 我放点音乐会你介意吗？

words.definition: the person who employs you or who is in charge of you at work; leader, employer, chief, captain, landlord; officer, captain, lead; call the shots
words.translation: 老板, 上司 vt指挥；[劳经]老板；首领；工头；指挥，调遣；当…的领导；当首领，发号施令

examples.en: I’ll have to ask my boss for a day off.
examples.zh: 我得向老板请一天假。

examples.en: Since I’m my own boss (=  I work for myself, rather than for an employer  ) , my hours are flexible.
examples.zh: 我自己当老板，所以我的时间很灵活。

words.definition: a heavy iron bar used to lift something or force it open; wrecking bar, jimmy
words.translation: 撬棍, 铁橇；撬棍；铁橇；起货钩

examples.en: They cover him quickly as the crowbar clangs to the ground.
examples.zh: 他们迅速掩盖了洞口，撬棍当啷一声，落在了地上。

examples.en: I pried it loose with a crowbar and hoisted it into the wheelbarrow.
examples.zh: 我用撬棍把它撬松，然后搬到了手推车里。

examples.en: I was holding a large crowbar, and my co-worker was holding a sledgehammer.
examples.zh: 我拿着一根很大的撬棍，我的同事拿着一把大锤。

words.definition: a situation in which people or things depend on each other; codependency
words.translation: 互相依赖；[统计]互相依赖

examples.en: ...the interdependence of nations.
examples.zh: …国家间的相互依赖。

words.definition: the force of an  earthquake; dimensions, moment, size, importance
words.translation: 大小, 数量,量级；大小；量级；[地震]震级；重要；光度

examples.en: An operation of this magnitude is going to be difficult.
examples.zh: 一个这么大的手术会很难的。

words.definition: to affect or include more people or things, or to make something affect or include more people or things; enlarge, extend; exaggerate, bulk out
words.translation: 放宽, 变宽, 扩大, 加宽；扩大，变阔；变宽，加宽；使扩大；使变宽

examples.en: Mr Mates said the party must broaden its appeal to younger voters.
examples.zh: 梅茨先生说该党必须扩大在年轻选民中的影响。

examples.en: Flynn’s appeal broadened as the campaign continued into the summer months.
examples.zh: 随着这场运动持续到夏季，弗林的号召力也扩大了。

examples.en: I want to broaden the discussion to other aspects of the problem.
examples.zh: 我想将讨论范围扩展到这个问题的其他方面。

words.definition: until; glacial drift; unto, hasta; farm, plant crops; plant crops
words.translation: 直到, 在以前；[地理][水文]冰碛；放钱的抽屉；[会计]备用现金；直到；耕种；犁；耕耘

examples.en: I didn’t have a boyfriend till I was 17.
examples.zh: 我直到17岁才有男朋友。

examples.en: The shop’s open till nine o’clock on Fridays.
examples.zh: 这家商店周五营业到9点。

words.definition: not suitable or right for a particular purpose or in a particular situation; inadequate, unhappy, wrong, improper
words.translation: 不适当的, 不合宜的；不适当的；不相称的

examples.en: There is no suggestion that clients have been sold inappropriate policies.
examples.zh: 没有迹象表明向客户出售过不适当的保险单。

words.definition: pot, shock; collide with, conflict with; stimulate, fan, shock
words.translation: 罐子 v刺激，震动；[陶瓷]罐；[轻]广口瓶；震动；刺耳声；冲突；不一致；震惊；发刺耳声；刺激；使震动

examples.en: a jam jar
examples.zh: 果酱罐

words.definition: a substance that remains on a surface, in a container etc and cannot be removed easily, or that remains after a chemical process; surplus, spare
words.translation: 残渣, 剩余物；残渣；[冶][数]剩余；滤渣

examples.en: The flies leave a sticky residue on crops.
examples.zh: 苍蝇在庄稼上留下黏糊糊的分泌物。

examples.en: Rinse off any soap residue.
examples.zh: 冲净残留的肥皂。

words.definition: having the ability to think of new activities or ideas and make them work; aggressive, courageous
words.translation: 有事业心的, 有进取心的；有事业心的；有进取心的；有魄力的；有胆量的

examples.en: Some enterprising students are designing software.
examples.zh: 一些有创业精神的学生在设计软件。

examples.en: an enterprising scheme to provide interest-free loans
examples.zh: 一项提供无息贷款的创业计划

words.definition: get wet, wet up; dampen
words.translation: 弄湿 vi变潮湿；弄湿；使…湿润；潮湿；变潮湿

examples.en: Moisten the clay if it seems too dry.
examples.zh: 如果黏土太干，就把它润润湿。

words.definition: used for treating medical problems; beneficial, helpful, useful, treated, advantageous
words.translation: 药物的，治疗的；[药][医]药的；药用的；治疗的（等于medicinable）；有益的

examples.en: Garlic is believed to have medicinal properties (= contain things that can cure medical problems ) .
examples.zh: 大蒜被认为具有药用功效。

words.translation: 部落(或宗族等)成员

words.definition: not attractive, pretty, or pleasant to look at; charmless, unglamorous
words.translation: 无魅力的, 无吸引力的；不吸引人注意的；没有魅力的；不美丽的

examples.en: an unattractive man
examples.zh: 没有魅力的男子

words.definition: to pull with one or more short, quick pulls; tugboat, towboat; contest, cope; rouse up, stack up against
words.translation: 用力拉, 拖船；拖船；拖曳；苦干；用力拉；竞争；努力做；较量；用拖船拖

examples.en: The woman gently tugged his arm.
examples.zh: 那女人轻轻拽了拽他的胳膊。

words.definition: a thin paper cover in which you put and send a letter; cover, involucrum
words.translation: 信封, 封套；信封，封皮；包膜；[天]包层；包迹

examples.en: envelopes and stamps
examples.zh: 信封和邮票

examples.en: She tore open the envelope and frantically read the letter.
examples.zh: 她撕开信封慌忙看信。

examples.en: He got a job stuffing envelopes (= filling them with letters ) at the campaign headquarters.
examples.zh: 他找了一份在竞选总部装信封的工作。

words.definition: Crucible is used to refer to a situation in which something is tested or a conflict takes place, often one which produces something new; copple, xble
words.translation: 坩锅, 严酷的考验；[冶]坩埚；严酷的考验

examples.en: ...a system in which ideas are tested in the crucible of party contention.
examples.zh: ...一个在严峻党派纷争中检验不同观点的体系。

words.definition: misty weather is weather with a lot of mist; fuzzy, dark, vague
words.translation: 有薄雾的；模糊的；有雾的

examples.en: a cold, misty morning
examples.zh: 一个雾蒙蒙的寒冷早晨

words.definition: not able to be broken
words.translation: 不易破碎的, 牢不可破的

examples.en: unbreakable glass
examples.zh: 不碎玻璃

words.definition: the part of your hand that is shaped like a thick short finger and helps you to hold things; turn over, browse through
words.translation: 拇指；翻阅；以拇指拨弄；作搭车手势；笨拙地摆弄

examples.en: a baby sucking its thumb
examples.zh: 吮着大拇指的婴儿

examples.en: She held the coin carefully between finger and thumb.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地把那枚硬币捏在食指和拇指之间。

words.translation: 间歇地

examples.en: The malaria victim fevers intermittently.
examples.zh: 疟疾病人间歇地发热。

examples.en: This has significant cost savings over purchasing and maintaining the hardware for jobs run intermittently.
examples.zh: 对于间歇运行的作业，这可以极大地节省购买和维护硬件的成本。

examples.en: Pockets of thick fog get trapped along the ridgelines, magpies nest among the outcrops, and springs intermittently spray over the rocks.
examples.zh: 厚重的浓雾弥漫于山脊线，露头的岩层上还垒着喜鹊窝，间歇的山泉水喷洒在岩石之上。

words.definition: a container filled with air or gas, fixed to something to make it float; floatation
words.translation: 浮选；浮选（等于floatation）

examples.en: A rise in the value of old securities is an indispensable preliminary to the flotation of new issues.
examples.zh: 一只旧的有价证券的升值是浮现新问题的必不可少的第一步。

words.definition: likely to make you healthy; robust, fit, fine, well, sound
words.translation: 有益健康的；健康的；卫生的

examples.en: healthful mountain air
examples.zh: 有利于健康的山区空气

words.definition: material made from threads or wires that have been woven together like a net, or a piece of this material; web, trap; joggle
words.translation: 网，筛孔；网眼；网丝；圈套；[机]啮合；以网捕捉

examples.en: The windows were covered in wire mesh to keep out flies.
examples.zh: 窗户上装了铁丝纱网，防止苍蝇飞入。

examples.en: a mesh fence
examples.zh: 网状围栏

words.definition: aquation
words.translation: 水合作用；[化学]水合作用

examples.en: The team believes one of the most important factors is hydration - the way skin collects and retains moisture.
examples.zh: 科研人员称，其中最重要的因素是水合，指皮肤吸收水分、保持湿度的过程。

examples.en: Previous experiments and simulations, however, indicated that the free energy of hydration did not match this predicted linear trend.
examples.zh: 然而，过去的研究和模拟表明，烷烃的水化自由能并不符合预计的线性变化趋势。

words.translation: [昆]南美切叶蚁

examples.en: Currie added that leafcutter ants are the subject of thousands of papers authored over the last century, “yet this critical aspect of their success was completely unknown.”
examples.zh: 库里补充道：切叶蚁上个世纪以来数千页作品的主角。 但是到目前为止它们成功的重要一面还完全未被人所知。

words.translation: 扎格罗斯山脉[伊朗西南部]
阿拉伯人 a阿拉伯(人)的

examples.en: The term "Arabian Gulf" has been in casual but inconsistent use by various members of the US navy and government, and by many Arab states, for a few decades now.
examples.zh: 这一术语“阿拉伯湾”只是一个非正式的词汇，但它已经被美国海军各机构和美国政府，以及许多阿拉伯国家南腔北调的用了几十年。

words.definition: to avoid obeying a rule, system, or someone in an official position; ignore, neglect; side road, passby
words.translation: 绕开, 忽视 n旁道；绕开；忽视；设旁路；迂回；旁路；[公路]支路

examples.en: Francis bypassed his manager and wrote straight to the director.
examples.zh: 弗朗西斯绕过他的经理，直接写信给董事。

words.definition: to separate one group of people from others, especially because they are of a different race, sex, or religion; separate, split, divorce
words.translation: 隔离；使隔离；[生物]使分离；在…实行种族隔离

examples.en: A large detachment of police was used to segregate the two rival camps of protesters.
examples.zh: 一大队分遣警察被派来隔离两群敌对的抗议者。

words.definition: willing to, What Makes a Man
words.translation: 乐意, 愿意；乐意；心甘情愿；自动自发

examples.en: So we do believe we have improved the willingness of our people for our acceptance in the future.
examples.zh: 因此，我们确实认为，我们已经使群众发生变化，愿意将来接受我们的领导。

examples.en: But when we focus on God and His ability and willingness to help us in every way -- all our excuses become insignificant.
examples.zh: 但是当我们聚焦在神时，他的能力和意愿会用任何方法去帮助我们---我们所有的借口都变得毫无意义。

examples.en: That provides a measure of willingness to punish, even at a cost to the punisher.
examples.zh: 这提供了一个对惩罚的愿意程度的衡量手段，即使惩罚有代价。

words.definition: the part of business activity that is concerned with buying and selling goods in competition with other companies; exchanges, plaza, fair
words.translation: 集会场所, 市场；市场；商场；市集

examples.en: Some retailers worry that new regulations will hurt their ability to compete in the marketplace.
examples.zh: 有些零售商担心新规定会削弱他们的市场竞争力。

words.definition: money that a business or organization receives over a period of time, especially from selling goods or services; taxes, income, proceeds, yield
words.translation: 收入,税收；税收，国家的收入；[会计]收益

examples.en: advertising revenue
examples.zh: 广告收入

examples.en: Strikes have cost £20 million in lost revenues .
examples.zh: 罢工造成的收入损失达到2,000万英镑。

words.definition: automatically, senselessly
words.translation: 无意识地；不觉察地；不知不觉

examples.en: He unconsciously switched a tree with his cane when he talked to her.
examples.zh: 在和她讲话时，他无意识地用手里的鞭子抽打着一棵树。

words.definition: someone who was a member of your family a long time in the past; father, root
words.translation: 祖先, 祖宗；祖先；祖宗

examples.en: I'll come back to the land of my forebears.
examples.zh: 我将回到祖先的土地。

words.definition: a small soft creature that moves very slowly and has a hard shell on its back; pachyderm, schnook
words.translation: 蜗牛；[无脊椎]蜗牛；迟钝的人

examples.en: Traffic was moving at a snail’s pace.
examples.zh: 车辆移动的速度慢得像蜗牛。

words.definition: the science of describing an area of land, or making maps of it; terrain, surface relief
words.translation: 地形学；地势；地志

examples.en: The topography of the river's basin has changed significantly since the floods.
examples.zh: 洪水过后，这条河的流域地形已经明显改变了。

words.definition: a male member of the clergy; minister, priest, preacher
words.translation: 牧师, 教士；牧师；教士

examples.en: "Then I need ask no further," said the clergyman, somewhat hastily rising from his chair.
examples.zh: “这样看来，我就不必多问了，”牧师说着，有点匆忙地从椅子上站起身。

examples.en: Yet, if the clergyman were rightly viewed, his strength seemed not of the body. It might be spiritual, and imparted to him by angelic ministrations.
examples.zh: 然而，如果没有看错的话，牧师的力量似乎并不在身体上，倒是在精神上，而且是由天使通过宗教仪式赋予他的。

examples.en: Her spirit sank with the idea that all must have been a delusion, and that, vividly as she had dreamed it, there could be no real bond betwixt the clergyman and herself.
examples.zh: 她认为一切全都是一场梦幻，她虽然梦得如此真切，但在牧师和她本人之间不可能有任何真实的联系，她的精神随着这种念头而消沉了。

words.definition: to make straight hair curly by using chemicals
words.translation: /n电烫（头发）

examples.en: I’m going to have my hair permed .
examples.zh: 我要去烫头发。

examples.en: her blonde permed hair
examples.zh: 她烫过的金色鬈发

words.translation: 海地

examples.en: We went through this after the Haiti earthquake, and all of the arguments which applied there apply to Japan as well.
examples.zh: 我们在海地地震后讨论过这个，并且相信所有适用于那里的论断同样会在适用于日本。

examples.en: Gratitude to the people of Haiti, for their strength, resilience and faith, the faith of human spirit, the spirit that burns in all of us today.
examples.zh: 我们感激海地人民，他们展现了毅力、韧劲和信念，这是人类精神信念，是今天在我们所有人心中燃烧的信念。

examples.en: When something happens in Haiti or Hunan, the rest of us learn about it in real time – from real people.
examples.zh: 在海地或湖南发生什么情况时，我们其余的人都能从当事者那里实时得知。

words.definition: very great tiredness; tiredness, weariness; wear down; tire
words.translation: 疲劳，劳累 v(使)疲劳；[生理][心理][力]疲劳，疲乏；杂役；[生理][心理][力]使疲劳；使心智衰弱；[生理][心理][力]疲劳

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["metal fatigue"]}
examples.zh: 金属疲劳

words.definition: to damage something such as a building or vehicle so badly that it cannot be repaired; destruction, breaking, blasting, remain, disruption; destroy, undermine, founder
words.translation: 毁坏；使遇难 n失事(船等)，残骸；破坏；[水运]失事；残骸；失去健康的人；[水运]使失事；拆毁

examples.en: The car was completely wrecked in the accident.
examples.zh: 汽车在事故中完全损毁。

words.definition: to break up, or make something break up, into very small pieces; collapse, dissolve; collapse, chip
words.translation: 分裂成小片，瓦解；使分解；使碎裂；使崩溃；使衰变；瓦解；碎裂；衰变

examples.en: The plane just disintegrated in mid-air.
examples.zh: 飞机就在半空中解体了。

words.definition: annoyed or unhappy; passionate, temperamental
words.translation: 易怒的, 情绪化的；喜怒无常的；易怒的；郁郁寡欢的

examples.en: Keith had seemed moody all morning.
examples.zh: 基思好像整个早上都不高兴。

words.definition: remaining loyal to a particular person, belief, political party etc and continuing to support them; loving, devoted
words.translation: 守信的, 忠实的；忠实的，忠诚的；如实的；准确可靠的

examples.en: a faithful friend
examples.zh: 忠诚的朋友

examples.en: years of faithful service to the company
examples.zh: 为公司多年忠诚的服务

examples.en: our faithful family dog, Bogey
examples.zh: 我家的忠犬博吉

words.definition: extremely impressive, serious, or difficult so that you feel great respect, worry, or fear; terrible, horrible, fearful, dire, dreadful
words.translation: 可怕的, 表示敬畏的；可怕的，引起敬畏的

examples.en: an awesome responsibility
examples.zh: 一项令人惊惧的责任

examples.en: the awesome sweep of the scenery
examples.zh: 连绵的壮丽景色

words.definition: a twist in something that is normally straight; whim, vagary
words.translation: 结 v纠结,纽绞；扭结；奇想；蜷缩

words.definition: using water power to produce electricity; hydel
words.translation: 水力电气的；[电]水力发电的；水电治疗的

examples.en: a huge hydroelectric power station
examples.zh: 大型水力发电站

words.definition: successfully, warmly
words.translation: 赞同地, 亲切地；顺利地；亲切地；好意地

words.definition: feeling pleased about something that you have done or something that you own, or about someone or something you are involved with or related to; beamish, complacent
words.translation: 自豪的, 得意的；自豪的；得意的；自负的

examples.en: Seth was the proud owner of a new sports car.
examples.zh: 赛思因为有了新跑车而扬扬得意。

words.definition: the number of people in a particular country or area who cannot get a job; joblessness, jobless rate
words.translation: 失业, 失业人数；[劳经]失业；失业率；失业人数

examples.en: a town where there is high unemployment
examples.zh: 高失业率城镇

words.definition: soon, rather, first
words.translation: 更好地,宁愿；较好；宁可，宁愿；更适宜

words.definition: the hard area or road between your house and the street; carriage drive, driftway
words.translation: 车道

examples.en: I was running down the driveway to the car and I lost my balance.
examples.zh: 我正沿着车道向车子跑去，然后我失去了平衡。

words.definition: aerospacecraft, astrovehicle
words.translation: 太空船；宇宙飞船，[航]航天器

examples.en: Each of the papers in Science reports data from one of the spacecraft.
examples.zh: 科学杂志上发表的论文分别报告了来自这些太空船的数据。

words.definition: someone who lives alone and has a simple way of life, usually for religious reasons; anchorite, eremite
words.translation: 隐士, 隐居者；（尤指宗教原因的）隐士；隐居者

examples.en: I've spent the past ten years living like a hermit.
examples.zh: 我过去10年里过着隐士般的生活。

words.definition: to do something or go somewhere more quickly than usual, especially because there is not much time; hasty indeed, haste; hasten; get a hump on, make haste
words.translation: 赶紧,匆忙；匆忙，急忙；使赶紧；使匆忙，使急忙；赶紧，赶快；匆忙

examples.en: If we hurry, we’ll get there in time.
examples.zh: 要是赶紧的话，我们能及时到那里。

examples.en: I hate having to hurry a meal.
examples.zh: 我讨厌匆匆忙忙地吃饭。

examples.en: We’ll have to hurry, otherwise we’ll miss the start.
examples.zh: 我们得赶紧，否则就会错过开头部分了。

words.definition: to take hold of someone or something with a sudden or violent movement; pounce at, commandeer; pounce at, snatch up; arrogation
words.translation: 抢夺, 攫取；攫取；霸占；将…深深吸引；夺取；夺取之物

examples.en: I grabbed my bag and ran off.
examples.zh: 我抓起我的包就跑。

examples.en: Two men grabbed her and pushed her to the ground.
examples.zh: 两名男子抓住她，把她推倒在地上。

examples.en: Kay grabbed hold of my arm to stop herself falling.
examples.zh: 凯抓住我的手臂，以免自己摔倒。

words.definition: a path; mechanism, tao, approach, pass, routes
words.translation: 路, 径；路，道；途径，路径

examples.en: Richard was coming up the pathway.
examples.zh: 理查德正沿路走来。

words.definition: rules or instructions about the best way to do something
words.translation: 方针

examples.en: This chapter gives you some guidelines to help you in your work.
examples.zh: 本章将介绍一些指导性原则，为你的工作提供帮助。

words.definition: the 11th month of the year, between October and December
words.translation: 十一月(略作Nov)

examples.en: And again in November.
examples.zh: 在十一月又一次。

examples.en: Too much snow in November.
examples.zh: 太多的大雪在十一月。

words.translation: 象牙

words.definition: a large flood, or period when there is a lot of rain; flood, fresh, flow, inundation; overwhelm, snow under
words.translation: 洪水, 豪雨；洪水；泛滥；暴雨；使泛滥；压倒

examples.en: Even so, the data deluge is already starting to transform business, government, science and everyday life (see our special report in this issue).
examples.zh: 尽管如此，数据洪水正在开始改变商业、政府、科学和人们的日常生活。

words.definition: particularly, detailedly
words.translation: 每分钟的,持续的；详细地；精密地

examples.en: Even the levels of carbon dioxide can be minutely altered.
examples.zh: 甚至二氧化碳的浓度每分钟也有改变。

words.definition: a landlocked country, state etc is surrounded by other countries, states etc and has no coast
words.translation: 陆地包围的, 内陆水域的

examples.en: ...the landlocked West African nation of Mali.
examples.zh: ...西非内陆国家马里。

words.definition: to force someone to have sex, especially by using violence; violation, cole; harry, despoil
words.translation: 掠夺, 强奸；强奸，掠夺；[园艺]油菜；葡萄渣；强奸；掠夺，抢夺

examples.en: She had been raped and stabbed.
examples.zh: 她遭到强奸，还被刀捅了。

words.definition: enormous, huge, integral, holistic
words.translation: 单片电路, 单块集成电路；[建]整体的；巨石的，庞大的；完全统一的

examples.en: This monolithic environment for an application eliminated any concern about which clock to use -- because there was only one clock.
examples.zh: 对于一个应用程序的这个单块集成电路环境消除了使用哪个时钟的问题 —— 因为只有一个时钟。

examples.en: The solutions that were developed for that were usually large monolithic programs containing the business-level logic hardcoded in the modules.
examples.zh: 为此开发的解决方案通常是大型单片电路程序，在一些模块中包含硬编码的业务层面逻辑。

words.definition: cohesive property, caking property
words.translation: 粘合, 凝聚性；凝聚力；粘结性；内聚力

examples.en: We see human civilizations begin throughout both North and South America with different levels of complexity, technology and cohesiveness.
examples.zh: 我们看到北美洲和南美洲的人类文明在复杂性、技术力和凝聚力上以不同的水平展开。

examples.en: Another function is to maintain cohesiveness by regulating the willingness of various stakeholders to serve the organization, and by maintaining the stability of authority.
examples.zh: 而另一项职能则是通过调节不同利益相关者为组织服务的愿望，以及维护权威的稳定性来保持凝聚力。

words.definition: in a strange or unusual way; especially, strange
words.translation: 古怪地,  特有地；特别；尤其；古怪地；奇怪地

examples.en: Theo had been behaving peculiarly.
examples.zh: 西奥的举止一直很古怪。

words.definition: If a car, ship, or aircraft cruises somewhere, it moves there at a steady comfortable speed; range, expatiate; range, roam about
words.translation: 巡游, 漫游；巡航，巡游；漫游

examples.en: A black and white police car cruised past.
examples.zh: 一辆黑白相间的警车平稳驶过。

words.translation: 海洋学的

examples.en: The Navy will use the machine principally for oceanographic modeling and weather forecasting.
examples.zh: 海军将主要将该计算机用于海洋图像建模和天气预报。

words.definition: violent and cruel in a way that hurts someone physically; severe, fallen, malicious, poisonous
words.translation: 恶毒的，凶残的；恶毒的；恶意的；堕落的；有错误的；品性不端的；剧烈的

examples.en: a vicious murder
examples.zh: 一桩凶残的谋杀案

examples.en: a vicious killer
examples.zh: 凶狠的杀手

examples.en: Keep away from that dog, he can be vicious.
examples.zh: 离那只狗远点，它有时很凶猛。

words.definition: a large round pale yellow vegetable that grows under the ground, or the plant that produces it; daikon, neep
words.translation: [植]芜箐(甘蓝)；萝卜；芜菁甘蓝，大头菜

words.definition: the outside top level of a ship that you can walk or sit on; board, storage room; paint, hang, dress oneself, array
words.translation: 甲板, 舰板；[船]甲板；行李仓；露天平台；装饰；[船]装甲板；打扮

examples.en: Let’s go up on deck .
examples.zh: 我们到甲板上去吧。

words.definition: If there is congestion in a place, the place is extremely crowded and blocked with traffic or people; injection, crowding
words.translation: 拥塞, 充血；拥挤；拥塞；[病理]充血

examples.en: The problems of traffic congestion will not disappear in a hurry.
examples.zh: 交通堵塞问题不会很快消失。

words.definition: create, inflict; result, breed
words.translation: 造成；使产生；产生；引起

examples.en: In such circumstances, governments must do all they can to create and engender trust among its nation’s constituents and institutions.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，政府必须尽其所能在它的国家选民和公共机构之间创造和产生信任。

examples.en: Retrospectives on the process and working practices regularly capture the lessons learned by the project and engender a culture of continuous process improvement within the project.
examples.zh: 对过程和工作实践的回顾有规律地捕捉从项目中得到的经验，并在项目中造成一个持续的过程改进的文化。

words.definition: the room, building etc where you work; plant, working space
words.translation: 工作场所；[管理]工作场所；车间

examples.en: ...the difficulties facing women in the workplace.
examples.zh: …妇女在工作场所中面临的困难。

words.definition: very careful about small details, and always making sure that everything is done correctly; punctilious, wary of
words.translation: 一丝不苟的, 缜密的；一丝不苟的；小心翼翼的；拘泥小节的

examples.en: He kept meticulous accounts.
examples.zh: 他的账记得一丝不苟。

examples.en: Their planning and preparation were meticulous.
examples.zh: 他们的计划和准备工作都很周密。

examples.en: He cleaned the tools with meticulous care.
examples.zh: 他十分认真地清洁了工具。

words.definition: able to speak a language very well; fluid, mellifluous
words.translation: 流利的, 流畅的；流畅的，流利的；液态的；畅流的

examples.en: He spoke in fluent Italian.
examples.zh: 他用流利的意大利语讲话。

words.definition: anicca, transiency
words.translation: 暂时, 无常；无常；暂时性

examples.en: So why then do we reject the impermanence of the ever-changing universe when it comes to our own lives?
examples.zh: 所以，为什么我们要拒绝这千变万化的宇宙中的无常，当它来到我们身边时？

examples.en: During difficult times, be committed to resolving problems, but also lighten up and ride the waves of impermanence.
examples.zh: 身处困境时，既要全神贯注地解决问题，也要身心放松，驾驭无常的世事。

words.definition: impossible to get through, see through, or get into; resistant, stubborn
words.translation: 不能穿过的, 不可理喻的；不能通过的；顽固的；费解的；不接纳的

examples.en: The trees formed a dark and impenetrable barrier.
examples.zh: 这些树形成了一道无法通过的黑暗屏障。

examples.en: the impenetrable blackness of the night
examples.zh: 夜晚伸手不见五指的黑

words.definition: consumable; consumable supplies
words.translation: 消耗品, 可牺牲的；可消费的；排出的；不重复使用的；可牺牲的；消耗品

examples.en: You may be doing what could just as easily be done by someone else, which means you’re highly expendable. You may be playing follow the follower.
examples.zh: 你可能在做一些其他也能轻易完成的事，那可能意味着你是完全可牺牲的，你可能是追随追随者的人。

examples.en: In the same way our bodies allocate blood flow away from expendable extremities in favour of vital organs during a crisis, companies must make sure their best markets and consumers are protected.
examples.zh: 就像我们的身体在危急时刻，把血液从可以牺牲的四肢调配给致命器官的方式一样，公司必须确保其最好的市场和顾客受到保护。

words.definition: definitely true or certain; incontestable, undisputed
words.translation: 不可否认的, 无可辩驳的；不可否认的；公认优秀的；无可争辩的

examples.en: undeniable proof
examples.zh: 确证

words.definition: The conquerors of a country or group of people are the people who have taken complete control of that country or group's land; winner, vanquisher
words.translation: 征服者, 胜利者；征服者；胜利者

examples.en: The people of an oppressed country obey their conquerors because they want to go on living.
examples.zh: 一个被压迫国家的人民顺从他们的征服者，是因为他们想活下去。

words.definition: if you incur a cost, debt, or a fine, you have to pay money because of something you have done; invite, court, secure, spell, trigger
words.translation: 招致；招致，引发；蒙受

examples.en: The government had also incurred huge debts.
examples.zh: 政府也已承受了大笔债务。

words.definition: backbreaking work is physically difficult and makes you very tired; arduous, exertive
words.translation: 非常辛苦的,极累人的；非常辛劳的；费力的

examples.en: Just as our exchanges with the local grocer free us from backbreaking farm work, so do imports from around the world move us even more toward the very economic specialization that enriches us.
examples.zh: 就好像我们与当地的杂货店交易，我们就不用非常辛苦地从事农业劳动，来自全世界的进口品让我们更快地走向经济专业化，使我们富裕。

words.definition: to be more concerned with making money from something than about its quality - used to show disapproval
words.translation: 使商业化

examples.en: Christmas has become so commercialized.
examples.zh: 圣诞节现已变得非常商业化了。

words.definition: brethren, countryfolk
words.translation: 同胞,同乡；同胞；未出过海的人；新水手

words.definition: the ratio of the intensity of light reflected from an object, such as a planet, to that of the light it receives from the sun; reflectivity, reflection power
words.translation: [天文](星体)反照率；（行星等的）[核][天]反射率；星体反照率

examples.en: A similar example of lowered albedo occurs when sea-ice melts and disappears, causing the darker coloured sea underneath to absorb more heat.
examples.zh: 当海冰融化消失时，会同样降低反射率，导致深色的海底吸收更多的热量。

examples.en: Different varieties of the same plant can vary in how much light they reflect, a property called albedo, so selecting for higher-albedo crops would enhance the cooling effect from agriculture.
examples.zh: 同一类植物的不同品种具有不同的反射率，而选择那些反射率更高的品种将能提高农业对控制全球变暖的贡献。

examples.en: "You change the albedo of the Earth, " he explained.
examples.zh: 他解释道：“因为你改变了地球的反照率。

words.translation: 可用言辞表达的

words.definition: variance, disparity
words.translation: 不两立, 不相容；[免疫][数]不相容；不协调；不一致

examples.en: In a time when there is so much dispute about the compatibility or incompatibility of science with religion, it may be a good idea to revisit what Newton and Einstein had to say about God.
examples.zh: 在这个科学与宗教到底相容还是不相容众说纷纭的时候 还是让我们重新审视一下牛顿和爱因斯坦怎么说主吧。

words.definition: the main idea and meaning of what someone has said or written; substance, core, heart, essential, kernel
words.translation: 要点, 要旨；主旨，要点；依据

examples.en: Don’t worry about all the details as long as you get the gist (= understand the main meaning ) of it.
examples.zh: 不要去管各个细节，只要理解主要意思就行了。

words.definition: a child’s toy that looks like a small person or baby; babydoll, Living Doll
words.translation: 洋娃娃, 玩偶；洋娃娃；玩偶；无头脑的美丽女人

examples.en: a small wooden doll
examples.zh: 一个小木玩偶

words.definition: If you are at the forefront of a campaign or other activity, you have a leading and influential position in it
words.translation: 最前部, 最前线

examples.en: They have been at the forefront of the campaign for political change.
examples.zh: 他们一直处于政治变革运动的前沿。

words.definition: a style of art, literature etc that is simple, regular, and does not show strong emotions; classic style
words.translation: 古典主义,古典风格；古典主义；古典风格

examples.en: The great thing about classicism for Gadamer, or what he calls "tradition," is that it's something we can share.
examples.zh: 对于伽达默尔来说古典主义，或者传统，最伟大之处是这是我们可以分享的。

words.definition: the ability to imagine what is likely to happen and to consider this when planning for the future; prescience, prevision
words.translation: 远见, 深谋远虑；先见，远见；预见；深谋远虑

examples.en: It was an example of the authorities’ lack of foresight .
examples.zh: 这是当权者缺乏远见的一个例证。

words.definition: unable to have babies; hungry, desert
words.translation: 贫瘠的, 不能生育的；不肥沃的；不毛的；不结果实的；不能生殖的

examples.en: infertile couples
examples.zh: 不孕的夫妇

words.definition: Horticultural means concerned with horticulture
words.translation: 园艺的

examples.en: ...the John A. Sibley Horticultural Centre.
examples.zh: …约翰A.西布莉园艺中心。

words.definition: an object that has been wrapped in paper or put in a special envelope, especially so that it can be sent by post; package, bindle; package, enlace
words.translation: 包裹 vt打包, 捆扎；[邮]包裹，小包；打包；捆扎

examples.en: The parcel was delivered last week.
examples.zh: 那个邮包上周送到了。

examples.en: He sends regular food parcels to his family in Libya.
examples.zh: 他定期给在利比亚的家人邮寄食品包裹。

words.translation: 就医,  使住院

examples.en: Most people do not have to be hospitalized for asthma or pneumonia.
examples.zh: 多数人不必因哮喘或肺炎住院。

words.definition: not enough; tight, lacking, scarce
words.translation: 缺乏的,不足的；缺乏的；吝啬的；仅有的；稀疏的

examples.en: There is only scanty evidence of his involvement.
examples.zh: 显示他牵涉其中的证据不足。

words.definition: vocally
words.translation: 用言辞地, 口头地；口头地，非书面地；用言辞地

words.definition: containing a lot of juice; telling, live, vivid
words.translation: 多汁(液)的；[食品]多汁的；利润多的；生动的

examples.en: a juicy lemon
examples.zh: 多汁的柠檬

words.definition: to make something look neater by cutting small pieces off it; shear, arrange, crop; cut to the bone, cut down to; status, shear, regularity; ordered, regular, straight, soigne
words.translation: 修剪；整理；装点；削减；整齐；情形；整齐的

examples.en: Pete was trimming the lawn around the roses.
examples.zh: 皮特在修剪玫瑰丛周围的草坪。

examples.en: I have my hair trimmed every six weeks.
examples.zh: 我每六周剪一次头发。

words.translation: 生理上, 在生理学上

examples.en: But now there is evidence that individualized advice can also be physiologically effective — that it can actually change your neural pathways.
examples.zh: 但是现在有证据表明，个性化的建议也可以产生生理影响——事实上它可以改变你的神经通路。

words.definition: a particular way of thinking about a problem or subject; perspective, outlook, eye, perception, sentiment
words.translation: 观点；[计]观点，看法；视角

examples.en: Different viewpoints produce different images.
examples.zh: 角度不同，产生的画面也不同。

words.definition: a small American animal similar to a  squirrel  with black lines on its fur; flickertail
words.translation: [动] 花栗鼠；[脊椎]花栗鼠；金花鼠

examples.en: The boy stood motionless, like a mouse or a chipmunk when it knows you're watching.
examples.zh: 男孩一动不动站着，好像一只老鼠或花栗鼠知道有人在盯着它一样。

examples.en: The picture featured a cartoon rendering of the fan’s face on top of the company’s logo of a cute chipmunk.
examples.zh: 这些画像是印在公司非常可爱的花栗鼠标志上。

examples.en: The idea of a 50 gram cute, tiny and fluffy chipmunk with its adorable curly tail drinking from a baby bottle is enough to warm even the coldest hearts.
examples.zh: 一个50克重的可爱的，小巧的，毛茸茸的金花鼠，还有一个讨人喜欢的卷毛大尾巴，捧着一个婴儿奶瓶在喝水，这个想法恐怕足够的温暖一个最冰冷的心。

words.definition: your birthday is a day that is an exact number of years after the day you were born
words.translation: 生日

examples.en: It’s my birthday on Monday.
examples.zh: 星期一是我的生日。

examples.en: My aunt called to wish me a happy birthday.
examples.zh: 我姑妈打电话来祝我生日快乐。

examples.en: Anne’s birthday party
examples.zh: 安妮的生日派对

words.definition: a bird of the crow family that is noisy and brightly coloured; bird, niao
words.translation: 松鸡；鸟；喋喋不休的人

words.definition: the part of a nut or seed inside the shell, or the part inside the stone of some fruits; quick, main, heart, essential, nucleus
words.translation: 果仁，核心；核心，要点；[计]内核；[植]仁；[粮食]麦粒，谷粒；精髓

examples.en: The kernel of that message was that peace must not be a source of advantage or disadvantage for anyone.
examples.zh: 那一信息的核心是和平绝不应该成为对任何人有利或不利的根源。

words.definition: an alcoholic drink made from grapes, or a type of this drink; liquor, drink, grape, vin; liquor, knock over a drink
words.translation: (葡萄)酒；[食品]酒，葡萄酒；紫红色；喝酒

examples.en: a glass of wine
examples.zh: 一杯葡萄酒

words.definition: if a situation, fact etc inclines you to do or think something, it influences you towards a particular action or opinion; pitch, slope, affect; slope, lean; hill, slope, decline, pitch
words.translation: (使)倾斜；倾向于， n斜面；倾斜；倾向；易于；使倾斜；使倾向于；斜面；斜坡

examples.en: The telescope is inclined at an angle of 43 degrees.
examples.zh: 这架望远镜以43度角倾斜。

words.definition: a belief or idea of what a particular type of person or thing is like. Stereotypes are often unfair or untrue.; truism, conventionality
words.translation: 老套，固定模式；陈腔滥调，老套；铅版

examples.en: There's always been a stereotype about successful businessmen.
examples.zh: 对成功的商人们总有一种成见。

words.definition: a piece of iron or steel that can stick to metal or make other metal objects move towards itself; aimant, leading stone
