examples.zh: 假设火星上可能存在微生物，其他人就认为火星应该是我们做任何事来避免污染的野生动物保护区那样来被保护着。

words.definition: a substance that can be used as a dye or from which a dye can be obtained; dye, coloring agent
words.translation: 染料；[染料]染料，[助剂]着色剂

examples.en: Usage: Mainly used in chemical, glass, dyestuff, ceramic and mechanic.
examples.zh: 用途：主要用于化学、 玻璃、染料、冶金、机械、搪瓷等工业。

examples.en: There are German dyestuff patents that were confiscated by the United States during the First World War and became part of the foundation of the American chemical industry.
examples.zh: 还包括第一次世界大战时美国从德国没收的染料专利资料，并最终成为美国化学工业基础的一部分。

examples.en: All the artwork can be eaten since no dyestuff is used, said Ju.
examples.zh: 桔多淇表示，因为她没有用颜料，她的作品都能吃。

words.definition: unfavourable and likely to cause problems for you; adverse, against
words.translation: 不利的；不便的；贬抑的

examples.en: The sale of part of the company could be disadvantageous to investors.
examples.zh: 对公司局部的出售可能对投资人不利。

words.definition: someone from the southern part of a country
words.translation: 南方人, 居住在南方的人

examples.en: Bob Wilson is a southerner, from Texas.
examples.zh: 鲍勃•威尔逊是个南方人，来自得克萨斯州。

words.definition: boring; flat, blank, monotonous; sandy beige, cafe au lait; lethargize
words.translation: 土褐色的, 单调的；单调的；土褐色的；浅褐色；无生气；邋遢；小额；使无生气

examples.en: people forced to live grey, drab existences in ugly towns
examples.zh: 被迫在丑陋的城市里过着平淡乏味生活的人

words.definition: in the area around a particular place
words.translation: 邻近, 附近

examples.en: The stolen car was found in the vicinity of the station.
examples.zh: 被盗汽车在车站附近被发现。

examples.en: There used to be a mill in the vicinity.
examples.zh: 附近曾有一座磨坊。

words.translation: 足智多谋

examples.en: What stories can you relay that show your passion, initiative and resourcefulness?
examples.zh: 你可以讲述什么样的故事来展示你的激情，主动和足智多谋呢？

examples.en: Additionally, with no belief in your capabilities and resourcefulness, you find it hard to take up new challenges or to explore new frontiers.
examples.zh: 除此之外，由于你不相信你很有能力而且足智多谋，你就发现迎接新的挑战或者探索新的领域是多么困难。

examples.en: However, Dr Haselhuhn argues that physical clues to dishonesty could survive if they were also linked to qualities seen as positive by women – such as charm or resourcefulness.
examples.zh: 然而，哈瑟尔罕争论道：如果这些生理特征对于女性来说是优点的话，比如说有魅力或者足智多谋，那么还是可能继续存在的。

words.definition: a native or inhabitant of Micronesia, more akin to the Polynesians than the Melanesians, but having Mongoloid traces
words.translation: 密克罗尼西亚人(的)

words.definition: a framework for supporting a pontoon outside and parallel to the hull of a boat to provide stability; cantilever beam, cantilever girder
words.translation: (承力外伸)支架；舷外支架；悬臂梁

examples.en: The outrigger tripod is available in both a high and low profile version, to fulfill a diverse array of environmental requirements.
examples.zh: 外伸的三脚架有高型和低型两种配置，以满足不同的环境要求。

words.definition: the act of telling a story; relation, statement, story, telling, tale
words.translation: 叙述；叙述，讲述；故事

examples.en: I need some good pictures for narration.
examples.zh: 我需要一些叙述时用的好镜头。

examples.en: Her narration, she said, was meant to be ironic and self-mocking — “I find it very funny, almost obtuse.
examples.zh: 她的叙述，她说，本来是想讽刺和嘲笑自己的——“我觉得这很有趣，我觉得自己是如此愚钝”。

examples.en: It includes narration by some of the finest actors and academics of the last half century including Sam Waterston, Arthur Miller, and Shelby Foote.
examples.zh: 该片中还有上半个世纪中优秀演员和专业学者像萨姆·沃森，亚瑟·米勒以及谢尔比·福特等的叙述。

words.definition: until; until, before
words.translation: 在…之前；在…以前；毋宁

examples.en: Yet this we ask ere you leave us, that you speak to us and give us of your truth.
examples.zh: 然而在你离开我们之前，对我们说话，把你的真理传述给我们。

examples.en: Yet, if death be in this cup, I bid thee think again, ere thou beholdest me quaff it.
examples.zh: 不过，要是这杯药可以致我于死地，在你眼看着我一口吞下去之前，我请求你再想一想。

words.definition: something that is usable can be used; practicable, useable
words.translation: [亦作useable] 可用的, 合用的；可用的；合用的（等于useable）

examples.en: The computer language involved was readily usable.
examples.zh: 所涉及的计算机语言便于使用。

examples.en: usable information
examples.zh: 可用的资料

words.definition: harmonious relationships are ones in which people are friendly and helpful to one another; united, balanced, sweet, friendly, musical
words.translation: 和谐的, 和睦的；和谐的，和睦的；协调的；悦耳的

examples.en: The decor is a harmonious blend of traditional and modern.
examples.zh: 这种装饰风格是传统与现代的和谐统一。

words.definition: to begin a different job, start to live in a different place etc, especially after a difficult period in your life; newly, afresh
words.translation: 重新, 再；重新；再

examples.en: I was ready to leave everything behind and start anew in California.
examples.zh: 我准备好舍弃一切，在加利福尼亚开始新的生活。

words.definition: used when talking about a situation in which the opposite of what you expected happens or is true; satirically, sarcastically
words.translation: 具有讽刺意味地；嘲讽地；讽刺地；说反话地

examples.en: Ironically, his cold got better on the last day of his holiday.
examples.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，他的感冒竟在假期的最后一天有所好转。

words.definition: a particular type of art, writing, music etc, which has certain features that all examples of this type share; description, type, style, breed
words.translation: 类型, 流派；类型；流派；风俗画

examples.en: a literary genre
examples.zh: 文学体裁

words.definition: relating to a change in cost, value etc when one more thing is produced, one more dollar is earned etc; critical, terminal
words.translation: 边缘的, 边际的；[数]边缘的；临界的；末端的

examples.en: marginal revenue
examples.zh: 边际收益

words.definition: externally, visibly
words.translation: 在视觉上地, 真实地；形象化地；外表上；看得见地

words.definition: if someone or something has primacy, they are the best or most important person or thing; predominance, preeminence
words.translation: 首位；卓越；大主教的职位

examples.en: We must give primacy to education.
examples.zh: 我们必须以教育为本。

words.definition: small white grains obtained from some  palm  trees, used to make sweet dishes with milk
words.translation: 西米, 西米椰子

words.definition: a large tropical fruit that looks like bread when it is cooked; artocarpus
words.translation: 面包果树；[园艺]面包果

examples.en: At the Marriott, for example, guests ramble amid breadfruit and frangipani trees and photograph one another by an enormous, amoeba-shaped swimming pool.
examples.zh: 比如，在万豪酒店，客人们可以在面包果树和鸡蛋花树之间徜徉，在硕大的不规则形状游泳池边相互拍照。

examples.en: Now almost a year later, they still live in a shelter they built by cutting a breadfruit tree in their garden. Their tailoring business has not resumed.
examples.zh: 现在，几乎一年之后，他们仍然居住在他们用院子里的面包果树搭成的棚屋中，也没有恢复他们的裁缝生意。

words.definition: a tropical plant grown for its thick root, which is boiled and eaten; Chinese eddo, dasheen
words.translation: 芋头；芋头，[园艺]芋艿

examples.en: According to Deng, Japan imports taro from Chenzhou because of its high quality.
examples.zh: 通过海港，日本也因为芋头的质量高，于是从郴州中进口。

examples.en: The first I clicked on, the Danag, was a Filipino vampire supposedly responsible for planting taro on the islands long ago.
examples.zh: 我首先点开了“丹拿”，这是一种菲律宾的吸血鬼，很多年以前是负责在岛上种植芋头的。

examples.en: And we went into the poisonous giant tubers, like the yam and the taro, which also had to be leeched, ground up and cooked before we could eat them.
examples.zh: 我们也寻找到了那些带有毒性的、个头颇大的块茎，像山药、芋头，这些在食用之前得经过榨取、提炼和烹饪。

words.definition: a tall tropical plant from whose stems sugar is obtained
words.translation: [植]甘蔗

examples.en: He cut the sugarcane into several pieces.
examples.zh: 他把甘蔗截成几节。

examples.en: The  sugared  vinegar is  refined from the sugarcane and  pine.
examples.zh: 加糖的醋是从甘蔗和松木中精炼出来的.

words.definition: to determine beforehand; preordain
words.translation: 预先确定；预先决定；预先查明

examples.en: What if you could predetermine the genetics of your newborn baby?
examples.zh: 要是你能预先设定新生宝宝的基因，你会怎么办？

examples.en: The applications predetermine queue names, messages, and message formats, just like two network applications agree on socket numbers.
examples.zh: 应用程序预先确定队列名称、消息和消息格式，就像两个网络应用程序就套接字数量达成协议一样。

words.definition: no one; small potatoes, worm
words.translation: 无人, 没有任何人；无名小卒；小人物

examples.en: I knocked on the door but nobody answered.
examples.zh: 我敲了敲门，但没人应门。

words.definition: dangerous, especially to people’s health or safety; risky, jeopardous
words.translation: 危险的, 冒险的；有危险的；冒险的；碰运气的

examples.en: the disposal of hazardous waste
examples.zh: 有害废弃物的处理

words.definition: If you describe something as unsuspected, you mean that people do not realize it or are not aware of it; unknown, sealed
words.translation: 未知的, 未被怀疑的；不受怀疑的；未知的

examples.en: A surprising number of ailments are caused by unsuspected environmental factors.
examples.zh: 惊人数量的慢性病是由未知的环境因素引起的。

words.definition: someone who has been sent to a foreign country to teach people about Christianity and persuade them to become Christians; Boanerges, preacher
words.translation: 传教士(的) ,传教的,；传教士

examples.en: My mother would still like me to be a missionary in Africa.
examples.zh: 我母亲还是想让我在非洲做一名传教士。

words.definition: to think or guess that something is smaller, cheaper, easier etc than it really is; disappreciate, sell short; disappreciation
words.translation: 估计不足，低估；低估；看轻

examples.en: Fourteen percent may be an underestimate.
examples.zh: 14%可能是低估的。

words.definition: used in the name of substances containing nitrogen and oxygen. Nitrates are often used to improve soil.
words.translation: [化]硝酸盐, 硝酸钾

examples.en: potassium nitrate
examples.zh: 硝酸钾

examples.en: high levels of nitrates in drinking water
examples.zh: 饮用水中的大量硝酸盐

words.definition: the act, business, or process of exporting goods or services; exit, way out, debouche
words.translation: 出口；[贸易]出口

examples.en: "The laws prohibiting such exportation must be reinstated as soon as possible, " he said.
examples.zh: “关于禁止出口珍稀林木的法案必须尽快得到恢复，”他说。

examples.en: The princess, refusing to go without the fabric she loved, would finally break the imperial ban on silk worm exportation.
examples.zh: 这位公主在没有她所爱的织物而拒绝出嫁，最终将打破了皇帝桑蚕出口的禁令。

examples.en: India, with its concentration of talented scientists, is a true hot spot for pharmaceutical innovation and a leader in the production and exportation of low-cost medical products.
examples.zh: 印度人才荟萃，有许多才华出众的科学家，堪称为真正的医药创新热土，在生产和出口低成本医疗产品领域具有领先地位。

words.definition: The extremity of a situation or of someone's behaviour is the degree to which it is severe, unusual, or unacceptable; radicalness, Desperate Remedies
words.translation: 极度，绝境；极端；绝境；非常手段；手足

examples.en: In spite of the extremity of her seclusion she was sane.
examples.zh: 尽管完全与世隔绝，她依然神智清醒。

examples.en: In the past, the region had been protected by its forbidding geography and the extremities of its climate.
examples.zh: 过去，这个地区受到令人生畏的地理条件和极端的天气状况的保护。

words.definition: to have a conversation with someone; contrary, opposite, adverse, counter, cross; colloquize, rap off; regression, retrogradation
words.translation: 交谈 n反面说法 a相反的；相反的，逆向的；颠倒的；交谈，谈话；认识；逆行，逆向；倒；相反的事物

examples.en: Luke sat directly behind the pilot and conversed with him.
examples.zh: 卢克坐在飞行员的正后方和他交谈。

words.definition: a training in the basic parts of a subject or skill; elements, basis, foundation, base, bed; stranding
words.translation: 基础训练, 染色的底色, [电]接地；[电]接地；基础；搁浅；（染色的）底色；[电]接地（ground的ing形式）

examples.en: The degree provides a thorough grounding in both mathematics and statistics.
examples.zh: 这个学位提供对数学和统计学全面的基础训练。

words.definition: a  spill2 1; superflux, extravasation
words.translation: 溢出, 溢出量；溢出；溢出量

words.definition: inquiringly
words.translation: 好奇地

examples.en: After the second of third offence I was warned that I should be beaten next time, but I received the warning in a curiously roundabout way.
examples.zh: 这样子一两次之后，我被警告，如果再有第三次我会挨揍的。 我以一种好奇的迂回曲则的方式接受了这个警告。

examples.en: "What are you thinking?" he asked curiously.
examples.zh: “你在想什么？” 他好奇地问道。

words.definition: done or happening at exactly the right time; well-timed, realtime; in good season, opportunely
words.translation: 及时的, 适时的；及时的；适时的；及时地；早

examples.en: The fight ended only with the timely arrival of the police.
examples.zh: 幸亏警察及时赶到，打斗总算停止。

words.definition: on or towards the shore of a lake, river, sea etc; shoreward
words.translation: 向岸地, 在岸上地；在岸上；向岸

examples.en: Several dead birds had been washed ashore.
examples.zh: 几只死鸟被冲上了岸。

words.definition: If a building, vehicle, or system is redesigned, it is rebuilt according to a new design in order to improve it; refashion; new design
words.translation: 重新设计；新设计

examples.en: The hotel has recently been redesigned and redecorated.
examples.zh: 该酒店最近刚进行了重新设计及装修。

examples.en: We need to redesign the school system so that it produces a well-educated population.
examples.zh: 我们需要重新设计教育体系，使之培育出拥有良好教育的一代人。

words.definition: all the citizens in a particular town, country, or state; people, municipality, burgher
words.translation: 公民成市民(集合称)；市民；公民

examples.en: He used the medium of radio when he wanted to enlist public support or reassure the citizenry.
examples.zh: 当他想得到公众支持或恢复民信时，他使用广播作载体。

words.definition: a written description of the characters, place, and things that will happen in a film, play etc; drama, action, plot
words.translation: 剧情说明书，剧本；方案；情节；剧本

examples.en: Imagine a scenario where only 20% of people have a job.
examples.zh: 设想一下这种情况: 只有20%的人有工作。

words.definition: Duplicate is also a noun; repeat, double; repeat, reproduction, counterpart; reproductive, copied; print off, to copy
words.translation: 复制品 a复制的 vt复制，复印；[印刷][专利]复制；使加倍；副本；[印刷][专利]复制品；[印刷][专利]复制的；二重的；重复

examples.en: The tight race is almost a duplicate of the elections in Georgia and South Dakota last month that pitted a Republican challenger against a Democratic incumbent.
examples.zh: 这次紧张的竞选几乎是上个月在佐治亚州和南达科他州选举的翻版，由一个共和党的挑战者竞争一个现任的民主党人。

words.definition: stuffing, filling compound; stuff up, obturate
words.translation: 填料 vt填塞；填料；块状软物；使成一团；填塞；使成卷

words.definition: A smelter is a container for smelting metal; furnace, forge
words.translation: 熔炉, 熔炼工；[冶]熔炉；冶金厂；熔炼工

words.definition: a clear, very hard valuable stone, used in jewellery and in industry; sparkler, adamas; rhombic
words.translation: 钻石,金钢石；[宝]钻石，[矿物]金刚石；[数]菱形；方块牌；[数]菱形的；金刚钻的

examples.en: a diamond engagement ring
examples.zh: 订婚钻戒

words.definition: if you crook your finger or your arm, you bend it; fraud, dog, sharp, loop; wind, sell, curve, bend, fox; bend, double up
words.translation: 使弯曲；骗子，坏蛋；弯处，弯曲部分；钩状物；[公路]使弯曲；欺骗，诈骗；[公路]弯曲，成钩形

examples.en: He crooked his finger: "Come forward," he said.
examples.zh: 他弯了弯手指，说：“过来。”

words.translation: [植]菥蓂

examples.en: Any of several related plants, such as pennycress and watercress.
examples.zh: 菥蓂，水田芥：任一与其类似的植物，如菥蓂和水田芥。

examples.en: Like white mustard, field pennycress also has potential as a biodiesel crop.
examples.zh: 像白芥一样，野生菥蓂也有可能成为生物柴油作物。

words.definition: what you will do if everything else fails; instrument, shift, road, tool, implement; appeal, ask for help
words.translation: 求助，采用；凭借，手段；度假胜地；常去之地；求助，诉诸；常去；采取某手段或方法

examples.en: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
examples.zh: 他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

words.translation: 水耕法,  水栽培

words.definition: the stalk by which a leaf is attached to the rest of the plant; cabo, leafstalk
words.translation: 叶柄, 柄部；[植]叶柄；柄部

examples.en: Light green, elliptical, very thin, long flexible petiole. Usually single crown. Large.
examples.zh: 亮绿色椭圆型很薄的叶子，长而有弹性的叶柄。通常单个顶芽。大型。

examples.en: In long shoot, the leaf width, leaf length, leaf area, petiole length and basal angle decreased, but the leaf index and the ratio of lobation increased as its arrangement increased.
examples.zh: 一年生长枝叶片的叶宽、叶长、叶面积、叶柄长、叶基角均随叶序的增加逐渐减小，叶形指数和有缺刻叶的比例则增加。

examples.en: The basic medium, choice of node petiole explants, plant growth regulator concentration and variety all affected the induction of somatic embryos and the regeneration of adventitious buds.
examples.zh: 结果表明，体胚的诱导和不定芽的再生与基本培养基、叶柄的着生部位、生长调节物质种类和浓度等因素有关。

words.definition: to encourage people to support something in an active way; organize, remove, structure, form
words.translation: 动员；动员，调动；集合，组织；使…流通；使…松动

examples.en: an attempt to mobilize popular opinion
examples.zh: 鼓动公众舆论的尝试

examples.en: a campaign to mobilize support for the strike
examples.zh: 动员大家支持罢工的宣传活动

words.definition: in a way that is useful to you because it saves you time or does not spoil your plans or cause you problems; expediently, eligibly
words.translation: 方便地；合宜地；便利地

examples.en: Conveniently, her parents are often willing to babysit.
examples.zh: 方便的是，她父母通常都愿意临时照看一下小孩。

examples.en: At that time, ice cream couldn’t be conveniently bought in a store.
examples.zh: 那时候冰激凌还无法很方便地在商店里买到。

words.definition: a piece of equipment consisting of a tube-shaped piece of wood, metal etc that rolls over and over, used for painting, crushing, making things smoother etc; platen, tumbling barrel
words.translation: 滚筒；[机]滚筒；滚轴；辊子；滚转机

examples.en: a paint roller
examples.zh: 刷漆滚筒

examples.en: a garden roller
examples.zh: 碾草坪机

words.definition: more important than anything else; primary, main, major, central, great; monarch, imperator
words.translation: 极为重要的；最重要的，主要的；至高无上的；最高统治者

examples.en: During a war the interests of the state are paramount, and those of the individual come last.
examples.zh: 战争时期国家利益是首要的，个人利益置于最后。

examples.en: Women’s role as mothers is of paramount importance to society.
examples.zh: 女性作为母亲的角色对社会至关重要。

words.definition: a member of a North American Indian people of the southwestern US, related to the Aztecs
words.translation: 美国休休尼族印第安人;休休尼语

words.definition: to breathe quickly and with difficulty after the effort of running, carrying something heavy etc; expand, belch out; fill, swell with; tumor, knub
words.translation: 喘气；抽烟；喷出，张开；使膨胀；夸张；使骄傲自满；膨胀；张开；鼓吹；粉扑；泡芙；蓬松；一阵喷烟；肿块；吹嘘，宣传广告

examples.en: George puffed and panted and he tried to keep up.
examples.zh: 乔治喘着粗气想跟上。

examples.en: He caught up with Gary, puffing for breath .
examples.zh: 他赶上了加里，累得直喘粗气。

words.definition: a large fish with silver skin and pink flesh that lives in the sea but swims up rivers to lay its eggs; trout, red fish
words.translation: [鱼]鲑鱼, 大麻哈鱼；鲑鱼；[鱼]大马哈鱼；鲑肉色

examples.en: The salmon was brought to the table whole, garnished with parsley and slices of tomato and cucumber.
examples.zh: 整条大麻哈鱼被端上了桌，并用欧芹、西红柿片和黄瓜片作为花色配菜。

examples.en: State authorities have ordered cutbacks in deliveries of water from the delta because of the threat to endangered species of salmon and smelt.
examples.zh: 由于鲑鱼和胡瓜鱼这些濒危物种受到威胁，国家当局已经要求消减从该三角洲往外输水的量。

words.translation: 牛津郡[英国]

words.definition: island
words.translation: ( 小)岛；岛

examples.en: We have looked at Lord Foster's plan and he appears to want to place his fantasy Isle of Grain airport on top of the LNG plant and a power station.
examples.zh: 我们已经参看过福斯特爵士的计划，看起来他似乎想把他想象中的谷岛机场安置在液化天然气厂和发电站的顶上。

examples.en: It was taken on the Isle of Mull, off the West coast of Scotland, where shepherds have long campaigned against the reintroduction of eagles which they see as a threat to their livelihoods.
examples.zh: 该照片是在苏格兰西海岸外的摩尔岛上拍摄的。当地的牧羊人一直以来都反对鹰这种猛禽的重新引进，他们认为这威胁到了他们的生计。

words.translation: 以煤气灯照明的
伦敦人

words.definition: an extremely small living thing which you can only see if you use a  microscope  . Some microbes can cause diseases.; bacterium, organism
words.translation: 微生物, 细菌；细菌，[微]微生物

examples.en: ...a type of bacteria that include the microbes responsible for tuberculosis and leprosy.
examples.zh: …包括引起结核病和麻风病的微生物在内的一类细菌。

words.definition: a round tent with a pointed top, used by some Native Americans; teepee
words.translation: 美国印第安人的圆锥形帐篷；（北美印第安人的）圆锥形帐篷

examples.en: Designed by the renowned Brazilian architect Oscar Niemeyer, the Cathedral of Brasília rises like a tepee in the middle of Brazil’s capital city.
examples.zh: 由巴西著名建筑大师Oscar Niemeyer设计的巴西利亚大教堂，看上去像一个在首都中心搭起的印第安大帐篷~

examples.en: Each June, after a long journey into the mountainous tundra of northern Norway, the Gaup family waits for the herd in tepee-like structures called lávut.
examples.zh: 每年6月，在经过了长途跋涉来到挪威北部的山区冻土地带，高普一家人就在被称作“ lávut  " 的锥形帐篷里等待着鹿群。

words.definition: a member of a confederacy of related North American Indian peoples, formerly living in Nebraska and Kansas, now chiefly in Oklahoma
words.translation: 波尼族人(语)

examples.en: The American Indian exhibit intrigues visitors with its collection of totem poles and its Pawnee Earth Lodge, created to explain the traditional ways of the Pawnee Indians, a Nebraska tribe.
examples.zh: 美国印第安人展厅的图腾柱和波尼土房也吸引了不少观众，那里展示了内布拉斯加州印第安人部落波尼人的传统生活方式。

words.definition: trier, treves
words.translation: 实验者；实验者，试验者

examples.en: The experimenter said “Look at my toy!
examples.zh: 试验者对孩子说：“看看我的玩具！

examples.en: The pull we all feel to please the experimenter, to fit in with the situation, to do what is expected of us.
examples.zh: 我们都会受到一种拉力，它让我们想要讨好实验者，融入情境中，做别人期待我们去做的事情。

examples.en: With a second group of children, the experimenter acted differently.
examples.zh: 对于第二组孩子，试验者采取的方法不同。

words.definition: made, done, seen etc on the Internet or on a computer, rather than in the real world; valid, available, effective, telling, significant
words.translation: 实质的, 虚拟的；[计][物]虚拟的；有效的；实质上的，事实上的

examples.en: The website allows you to take a virtual tour of the art gallery.
examples.zh: 这个网站可让你对美术馆作一番虚拟参观。

examples.en: constructing virtual worlds
examples.zh: 构筑虚拟世界

words.definition: to bury a dead person
words.translation: 埋葬

examples.en: The team of archaeologists found the spot where his bones were originally interred.
examples.zh: 这队考古学家发现了起初埋葬他骸骨的地方。

words.definition: not being used or not needed at the present time; economize on, save on; excuse from, economize on; thin, unnecessary, waste, redundant, superfluous; surplus, residual
words.translation: 备用的；多余的；节约，吝惜；饶恕；分出，分让；饶恕，宽恕；节约；瘦的；少量的；剩余；备用零件

examples.en: Have you got any spare boxes?
examples.zh: 你有没有多余的盒子？

examples.en: You could sleep in the spare bedroom.
examples.zh: 你可以睡那间空着的客房。

examples.en: Do you have any spare cash?
examples.zh: 你手头有闲钱吗？

words.definition: not living; dead, lifeless
words.translation: 无生命的；[医]无生命的；无生气的

examples.en: an inanimate object
examples.zh: 无生命的物体

words.definition: bisect
words.translation: 二等分,  分享；二等分；把……减半

examples.en: Halve the potatoes lengthwise.
examples.zh: 把马铃薯竖着切成两半。

words.definition: notes, explanation, legend
words.translation: 注释, 解说词；评论；注释；评注；说明

examples.en: Commentary is by Tom Ferris.
examples.zh: 由汤姆•费里斯现场解说。

words.definition: freely, beautifully, nicely
words.translation: 漂亮地,慷慨地；漂亮地；慷慨地；相当大地

examples.en: He did us handsomely.
examples.zh: 他慷慨地款待我们。

examples.en: Doing so will pay off handsomely in the end.
examples.zh: 这样做最终将让您漂亮地搞定一切。

words.definition: a rock or group of rocks above the surface of the ground; emergence, bryle; show up
words.translation: 露出地面的岩层；[地质]露头；露出

examples.en: Below us was a pool surrounded by rocky outcrops.
examples.zh: 我们的下面是一个岩石围绕的水塘。

words.definition: the distance from one side of something to the other; width, range
words.translation: 宽度, (布的)幅宽, (船)幅；宽度，幅度；宽宏

examples.en: The breadth of the whole camp was 400 paces.
examples.zh: 整个营地的宽度为400步。

words.definition: the area that a priest in some Christian churches is responsible for
words.translation: 教区

examples.en: Father Doyle moved to a new parish.
examples.zh: 多伊尔神父调到了新的教区。

words.translation: 核的

examples.en: Organisms rely on phosphorus to build nucleic acids and other molecules to grow and proliferate.
examples.zh: 有机物依赖于磷来制造核酸和其他生长与繁殖所需的分子。

examples.en: Working with subsurface ice, brine or soil samples, SETG would attempt to isolate, amplify, detect and identify nucleic acids -- right there on Mars.
examples.zh: SETG研究了地下冰、盐水或土壤样本，试图隔离、放大、监测和识别核酸，这种核算恰好就在火星上。

examples.en: Thus, any random changes in the interior, fledgling ribozymes that could speed up nucleic acid replication rates will spread rapidly through an evolving population.
examples.zh: 这样一来，细胞内部发生的使得核酶加速核酸复制速率的任何变化，都会在进化群体中快速扩散。

words.definition: a hard level surface or path at the side of a road for people to walk on; sidewalk, footpath
words.translation: 人行道, 公路；人行道

examples.en: A small group of journalists waited on the pavement outside her house.
examples.zh: 有一小群记者守候在她家外面的人行道上。

examples.en: a pavement cafe
examples.zh: 路边咖啡馆

words.definition: eager, hungry, desired, anxious, sick
words.translation: 渴望的；渴望的，贪婪的；热心的

examples.en: Meanwhile, time after time on other issues -- such as the economic stimulus package, health care and Iraq -- he has tacked to the center, much to the frustration of his most avid supporters.
examples.zh: 与此同时，在其他问题上，比如经济刺激计划、医保改革以及伊拉克问题，他不止一次改弦易辙、转向中庸，这让他最热心的支持者感到失望。

words.definition: to feel sorry for someone because they are in a very bad situation; regret, feeling, compassion, mercy, sympathy
words.translation: 可怜 n怜悯, 同情；怜悯，同情；遗憾

examples.en: I pity anyone who has to feed a family on such a low income.
examples.zh: 我同情那些得依靠如此微薄的收入养活全家的人。

examples.en: Sam pitied his grandmother there alone, never going out.
examples.zh: 萨姆很同情独自生活、从不出门的祖母。

examples.en: Pity the poor teachers who have to deal with these kids.
examples.zh: 同情一下那几位可怜的老师吧，他们不得不和这些孩子打交道。

words.definition: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing; blame, put down to
words.translation: 归因于, 归咎于；归因于；归咎于

examples.en: An autopsy eventually ascribed the baby's death to sudden infant death syndrome.
examples.zh: 一次尸检最终把这名婴儿的死亡归因于婴儿猝死综合症。

words.definition: very many, or too many to be counted; thousand, countless, million, infinite
words.translation: 无数的,数不清的；无数的，数不清的

examples.en: She’s served on innumerable committees.
examples.zh: 她在多个委员会担任委员。

words.definition: the whole of something; sum, amount, gross
words.translation: 全部，总数；[天]全食；全体；总数

examples.en: ...a process of social, economic and political change which involves the totality of human experience.
examples.zh: ...一个涉及人类经验总和的社会、经济和政治变革过程。

words.definition: migration, transplantation
words.translation: 移民出境, 侨居；移民；移民出境；移居外国

examples.en: We have reminded them of the circumstances of our emigration and settlement here.
examples.zh: 我们也曾把我们移民来这里和在这里定居的情况告诉他们。

words.definition: if a bird pecks something or pecks at something, it makes quick repeated movements with its beak to try to eat part of it, make a hole in it etc; cavil about, find quarrel in a straw; throw into; lots of, sea, hundred, much, thousands of
words.translation: 啄,小口地吃；啄食；扔石头；吹毛求疵；扔；许多；配克（容量单位，等于2加仑）；啄痕

words.definition: an old man who is respected as the head of a family or tribe; author, paterfamilias
words.translation: 家长, 族长, 创办人；家长；族长；元老；创始人

examples.en: The patriarch of the house, Mr. Jawad, rules it with a ferocity renowned throughout the neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 那户人家的家长贾瓦德先生治家严苛，名闻乡里。

words.definition: gravity, magnificence
words.translation: 庄严, 伟大；壮丽；庄严；宏伟

examples.en: The most visited city in the world, here is a capital whose great talent has been to interweave the grandeur of its official buildings with the everyday charm of its many quartiers.
examples.zh: 世界上访问者最多的城市，就是这里，拥有庞大人才资本的首都，这城市中庄严肃穆的官方建筑与许多城区的日常魅力始终融合在一起。

words.definition: continuing for ever, even after someone has died; eternal, permanent, lasting, timeless
words.translation: 永恒的, 持久的；永恒的；接连不断的

examples.en: everlasting fame
examples.zh: 永久的名声

examples.en: a symbol of God’s everlasting love
examples.zh: 上帝永恒之爱的象征

examples.en: a belief in life everlasting
examples.zh: 对永生的信念

words.definition: pieces of waste that remain after something has been broken up or used; rubble, crushed stone
words.translation: 碎石；碎石，[地质]岩屑

examples.en: In the distance, the detritus of a century of oil exploration lines the horizon.
examples.zh: 在远方地平线上，矗立着一个世纪以来开采石油产生的碎石堆。

examples.en: We have emptied the bus of all our detritus.
examples.zh: 我们把所有零碎东西从巴士上清理下来。

examples.en: Indeed, once this detritus of our ignorant past has been cleared away, we might see more clearly the nature of good, and pursue it aright at last.
examples.zh: 的确，一旦当我们这些琐碎的无知正为过去，我们将看到更加清晰的自然地面目，并且永远追随正确的步伐。

words.definition: if a bird, insect, or  helicopter  hovers, it stays in one place in the air; plane, orbit; vibration, spinning around; brood, hatch
words.translation: 盘旋；盘旋，翱翔；徘徊；犹豫；孵；徘徊在…近旁

examples.en: After rising through the air it stops to hover outside the window of a building several storeys high.
examples.zh: 在空气中上升后，它在一幢几层楼高的建筑物的窗前停止升高，进入盘旋状态。

words.definition: the state of being finished; achievement, realization, implementation, execution, finish
words.translation: 完成；完成，结束；实现

examples.en: The house is nearing completion (= almost finished ) .
examples.zh: 房子即将完工。

examples.en: The project has a completion date of December 22nd.
examples.zh: 该项目的完成日期是12月22日。

words.definition: If things abound, or if a place abounds with things, there are very large numbers of them; teem with, be imbued with
words.translation: 富于,  充满；富于；充满

examples.en: Stories abound about when he was in charge.
examples.zh: 他负责时传闻很多。

words.definition: one of several types of fattysubstances in living things, such as fat, oil, or wax; axunge, grease
words.translation: 脂质, 油脂；[生化]脂质；油脂

examples.en: Cholesterol, a type of lipid, is found in foods from animal sources.
examples.zh: 胆固醇也是一种油脂，存在于动物来源的食物中。

examples.en: The virus also increases lipid sensitivity and decreases leptin secretion of the new fat cells.
examples.zh: 该病毒还会增加新脂肪细胞的脂肪灵敏度，并降低其瘦素分泌。

examples.en: Discard the yolk or a portion of it if you're trying to lower your fat intake, as the yolk is almost 100% lipid.
examples.zh: 如果你试图降低你的脂肪摄入，可以去掉整个蛋黄或者部份蛋黄，因为蛋黄几乎是 100% 的脂质。

words.definition: producing too much smoke; fumy, reeky
words.translation: 冒烟的, 烟状的；冒烟的；烟熏味的；熏着的；呛人的；烟状的

examples.en: a smoky engine
examples.zh: 冒出大量烟的引擎

words.definition: to officially give someone a title etc, especially as a reward for something they have achieved; afford, award, allow, grant, deal; arrange, treat
words.translation: 授予, 协商；授予；给予；协商

examples.en: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
examples.zh: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。

words.definition: very ancient; original, earlier, young
words.translation: 原始的, 早期的；原始的；初期的（等于primaeval）

examples.en: primeval forests
examples.zh: 原始森林

words.definition: A viral disease or infection is caused by a virus
words.translation: 滤过性毒菌的

examples.en: ...a 65-year-old patient suffering from severe viral pneumonia.
examples.zh: …一位65岁患有严重病毒性肺炎的病人。

words.definition: the process of taking a number or amount from a larger number or amount; reduction, loss, decrease
words.translation: 减少；[数]减法；差集

examples.en: In other words, we can use the magic of subtraction.
examples.zh: 换句话说，我们可以借助减法的魔力。

examples.en: It also lets you perform mathematical operations like addition, subtraction, division, and multiplication on two statistics.
examples.zh: 它还允许您对两个统计数据执行诸如加、减、乘、除等数学运算。

examples.en: Atomicity enables the two operations -- the subtraction from the savings account and the addition to the checking account -- to be treated as a single transaction.
examples.zh: 原子性使得这两个操作 —— 从储蓄帐户减钱和向支票帐户加钱 —— 被当作单个事务进行处理。

words.definition: having the same centre; co-axial, in-line
words.translation: 同中心的, 同轴的；[电]同轴的；同中心的

examples.en: concentric circles
examples.zh: 同心圆

words.definition: diagram, illustration
words.translation: 肖像学, 肖像画法；肖像研究；肖像学；图解

words.definition: a very small particle, creature, or object; particle, bug
words.translation: 微小的东西,；极小量；小虫；小孩儿；微小的东西

examples.en: Poor mite! You must be starving!
examples.zh: 可怜的小家伙！你一定是饿坏了！

words.definition: an innate quality or ability is something you are born with; inherent, native, intrinsic, congenital
words.translation: 先天的, 天生的；[医]先天的；固有的；与生俱来的

examples.en: Children have an innate ability to learn language.
examples.zh: 儿童学习语言的能力是与生俱来的。

words.definition: indigenous people or things have always been in the place where they are, rather than being brought there from somewhere else; native, inherent, mainland, intrinsic
words.translation: 本地的, 天生的；本土的；土著的；国产的；固有的

examples.en: the many indigenous cultures which existed in Siberia
examples.zh: 存在于西伯利亚的许多当地文化

words.definition: cloudy air near the ground which is difficult to see through; vapor, smog; obfuscate, befog; mist
words.translation: 雾, 烟雾；[气象][摄]雾；烟雾，尘雾；迷惑；使模糊；使困惑；以雾笼罩；被雾笼罩；变模糊

examples.en: It will be a cold night, and there may be fog patches .
examples.zh: 今夜天气寒冷，部分地区可能有雾。

examples.en: A blanket of fog covered the fields.
examples.zh: 大雾笼罩了田野。

examples.en: The fog lifted (= disappeared ) in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午，雾散了。

words.definition: a small part of something that remains after the rest of it has been used, destroyed, or eaten; surplus, residual, spare; remaining, surplus, residual, odd
words.translation: 残余, 剩余；剩余；剩余的

examples.en: Beneath the present church were remnants of Roman flooring.
examples.zh: 在目前的这座教堂下面还有残余的古罗马地板。

words.definition: moving in a smooth and attractive way, or having an attractive shape or form; elegant, pretty, exquisite
words.translation: 优美的；优雅的

examples.en: Her movements were graceful and elegant.
examples.zh: 她举手投足优雅而高贵。

examples.en: The branches formed a graceful curve.
examples.zh: 那些树枝形成一条优美的曲线。

words.definition: your first involvement in a particular activity, from which you can develop and become stronger
words.translation: （攀岩时的）立足点,（发展的）起点

examples.en: Delta`s agreement with Singapore Airlines gave them a toehold in the Pacific.
examples.zh: 德尔塔与新加坡航空公司的协议为他们在太平洋地区提供了一个立足点。

words.definition: wise decisions and actions are sensible and based on good judgment; intelligent, learned, knowing, bright, clever; enlighten, indoctrinate; know about, learn about, get to know, make sth of
words.translation: 英明的, 明智的；明智的；聪明的；博学的；使知道；教导；了解

examples.en: a wise precaution
examples.zh: 明智的预防措施

examples.en: I don’t think that would be a very wise move (= not be a sensible thing to do ).
examples.zh: 我认为那样做不是很明智。

words.definition: eternity, aeon
words.translation: 永世, 无数的年代；永世；无数的年代；极长时期

words.definition: Planetary means relating to or belonging to planets
words.translation: 行星的

examples.en: Within our own galaxy there are probably tens of thousands of planetary systems.
examples.zh: 在我们所在的银河系中，很可能存在数以万计的行星系。

words.definition: spittoon, goboon
words.translation: 痰盂；（美）痰盂

words.definition: An activist is a person who works to bring about political or social changes by campaigning in public or working for an organization; rustler
words.translation: 激进主义分子, 行动主义分子；积极分子；激进主义分子

examples.en: The police say they suspect the attack was carried out by animal rights activists.
examples.zh: 警方说他们怀疑这次袭击是由保护动物权利的激进分子实施的。

examples.en: Dobson blames activist judges for undermining families with favourable gay-marriage rulings.
examples.zh: 多布森责备激进派法官们通过赞成同性婚姻的裁决破坏家庭。

words.definition: a colour or type of colour; cry, wow
words.translation: 色彩，色调；[光]色彩；色度；叫声

examples.en: a golden hue
examples.zh: 一种金黄色调

words.definition: when someone says officially that they know who someone else is, especially a criminal or a dead person; authentication, recognition
words.translation: 辨认, 鉴定；鉴定，[计]识别；认同；身份证明

examples.zh: 我们肩并肩地走着,她专心地听着我讲述你,讲述我们,以及我们一起分享的那些美好时光。

words.definition: to do something very well, or much better than most people; overcome, cap
words.translation: 优秀, 胜过他人；优于，胜过；擅长

examples.en: You have excelled yourself with the new exhibition.
examples.zh: 你新办的这次展览特别成功。

words.definition: industry, hardwork
words.translation: 勤奋；勤奋，勤勉；注意的程度

examples.en: Genius is nothing but labor and diligence.
examples.zh: 天才无非是工作和勤奋。

examples.en: We should cultivate the good habits of diligence and frugality.
examples.zh: 我们要养成勤俭节约的好风气。

words.definition: two things that are separable can be separated or considered separately; dissociable, demountable
words.translation: 可分离的, 可分的；[数]可分离的；可分隔的

examples.en: Character is not separable from physical form but is governed by it.
examples.zh: 性格和外表是分不开的，而且性格决定外表。

words.definition: one of the two round raised parts on a woman’s chest that produce milk when she has a baby; chest, uber; be at grips with
words.translation: 胸脯，乳房；[解剖]乳房，胸部；胸怀；心情；以胸对着；与…搏斗

examples.en: These bras are specially designed for women with large breasts.
examples.zh: 这些胸罩专为乳房丰满的女性设计。

examples.en: breast milk
examples.zh: 母乳

examples.en: breast cancer
examples.zh: 乳腺癌

words.definition: a small metal or plastic cap used to protect your finger when you are sewing; connecting, sleeve
words.translation: 顶针；嵌环；套管

examples.en: Is this your thimble?
examples.zh: 这是你的顶针吗？

examples.en: The Lord again dipped into the river. He held out a golden thimble studded with rubies.
examples.zh: 上帝又把手伸进河里，捞出一个镶嵌着红宝石的金顶针。

examples.en: Etymology can only ask why a small cuplike guard used in sewing is called a thimble, though it is put on the third finger.
examples.zh: 词源学只能问，为什么缝纫时使用的一个小杯状装置被称为顶针，但它却是在中指上使用的。

words.definition: to put too many things or people on or into something; superimposed load, surcharge
words.translation: 使超载  n超载；[交][电]超载；负荷过多

examples.en: Be careful not to overload the washing machine.
examples.zh: 注意别让洗衣机负荷过重。

words.definition: happening in cycles; circular, periodic
words.translation: 循环的,周期性的；环的；循环的；周期的

examples.en: cyclical changes in the economy
examples.zh: 经济的周期性变化

words.definition: pessimal, baddest
words.translation: 最坏(的)，最差(的)；最差的，最坏的；最不利的；效能最低的

examples.en: Hope for the best and prepare for the worst.
examples.zh: [谚语]寄予乐观的希望，作最坏的准备。

examples.en: There’s no reason why I should be one of the worst!
examples.zh: 这样讲毫无理由，我怎么可能是最差的攀岩者！

words.definition: someone who buys something expensive such as a house or car; bargainee, vendee
words.translation: 买主, 顾客；买主；[贸易]采购员

examples.en: There were several potential buyers.
examples.zh: 有好几个潜在的买家。

examples.en: discounts for first-time buyers
examples.zh: 为首次购买的顾客提供的折扣

words.definition: if a light dims, or if you dim it, it becomes less bright; fuzzy, dark, dirty, lowering; breathe upon; fog, mist; simple, turkey, put, idiot, stupid
words.translation: (使)暗淡,(使)模糊；暗淡的，昏暗的；模糊的，看不清的；悲观的，怀疑的；使暗淡，使失去光泽；使变模糊；变模糊，变暗淡；笨蛋，傻子

examples.en: The lights in the theatre began to dim.
examples.zh: 剧院里的灯光开始暗下来。

words.definition: to cut something, especially branches from a tree, usually with a single strong movement; fell; moon, muck about
words.translation: 剪去, 砍掉；砍伐；剪去树枝；砍，删；闲荡；下垂

examples.en: Workmen have lopped off more branches in an effort to save the tree.
examples.zh: 为了救活这棵树，工人们砍下了更多的树枝。

words.definition: injuriously, hurtfully
words.translation: 伤害地,有害地；有害地；伤害地
象箱子一样的

examples.en: Then he lifted his shirt to reveal a heavy, boxlike device dangling from his neck.
examples.zh: 说完之后，他掀开他的衣领，露出一个悬挂在他脖子上的沉重的，盒子样的装置。

examples.en: William M. Clark, a retired businessman, generously provided a collection of engines, levers, pumps, axles, and crankshafts for us to display in boxlike frames.
examples.zh: 一位退休的商人William M.Clark慷慨的为我们提供了一系列的引擎，撬杠，水泵，轴和机轴来帮助我们在盒子一样的框架里面展示。

words.definition: astonishingly, marvelously
words.translation: 惊奇地, 惊人地；令人惊讶地；惊奇地

examples.en: Even those passengers who were most distrustful of themselves pluck up amazingly.
examples.zh: 甚至那些对自己最缺乏信心的乘客也令人惊奇地鼓起了勇气。

words.definition: a very small hole in something, especially one made by a pin; blacking hole, pore
words.translation: 针孔, 小孔；[电子]针孔；[纺][冶]小孔

examples.en: The yellow parts has small oval-shaped protrusions, each with one or two “pinhole” depressions.
examples.zh: 黄色部分有小的椭圆形突出，每个突出又有一到二个“针孔”状凹陷。

examples.en: For their next work, they'll be looking at how to replicate the intricate grooves and pinhole depressions.
examples.zh: 至于下一步的工作，他们要研究怎么模拟复杂的沟槽和针孔凹陷。

examples.en: They also abandoned using any corrective lenses, firing the X-ray pulse through a pinhole and then collecting the diffracted rays after they pass through the sample.
examples.zh: 他们也放弃使用任何矫正透镜，而是通过一个针孔发射X光射线，然后采集经过样品后的衍射光线。

words.definition: used when you are admitting that something is true; allowedly, acknowledgedly
words.translation: 不可否认的, 公认地；公认地；无可否认地；明白地

examples.en: This has led to financial losses, though admittedly on a fairly small scale.
examples.zh: 这已造成了经济损失，尽管这个损失其实还比较小。

words.definition: typical of the way a good mother behaves or feels; mother, umbilical
words.translation: 母亲的, 母系的；[生物]母亲的；母性的；母系的；母体遗传的

examples.en: Annie was wonderfully warm and maternal.
examples.zh: 安妮非常亲切慈爱。

examples.en: She seems to have a strong maternal instinct (= desire to have babies and take care of them ) .
examples.zh: 她似乎有很强的母性。

words.definition: the time when it is winter; peret
words.translation: 冬, 冬季；冬季

examples.en: This photo of the towers was taken during wintertime.
examples.zh: 这些钙华塔的照片是在冬季拍摄的。

examples.en: For instance, an ear of corn will cost about 10 cents in the summer and nearly a dollar in the wintertime.
examples.zh: 举例来说，一个玉米棒在夏季的时候售10美分左右，而在冬季的时候差不多售1美元。

examples.en: As a result, sea ice extent for the Arctic actually peaked on March 31, 2010—the latest peak of wintertime Arctic sea ice extent in the satellite record.
examples.zh: 结果导致2010年北极的海冰范围是在3月31日达到峰值——这是有卫星记录以来北极海冰范围最晚的冬季峰值。

words.definition: able to bend without breaking or cracking
words.translation: 柔顺的

examples.en: a shoe made of soft pliable leather
examples.zh: 柔韧的皮革做成的鞋子

words.translation: 人类学上

examples.en: This course examines computers anthropologically, as meaningful tools revealing the social and cultural orders that produce them.
examples.zh: 本课程系以人类学的观点探讨电脑，显示过去生产电脑的社会和文化秩序。

words.definition: a cobblestone; to repair or make shoes; roundstone
words.translation: 圆石,鹅卵石；修补；鹅卵石，圆石

examples.en: And such urban architecture - from the simplicity of small, cobble-and-whitewash towns to the 17th-century glories of Cartagena and Popayán.
examples.zh: 如此的城市建筑，有简朴的铺着鹅卵石道路和白色房屋的小镇，也有遗留着17世纪荣光的喀他赫纳和博帕雍。

words.definition: a man who has never been married
words.translation: 单身汉, 文理学士

examples.en: Gerald was 38, and a confirmed bachelor (=  a man who has decided that he will never marry  ) .
examples.zh: 杰拉德38岁，抱定主意独身。

examples.en: The Crown Prince was Japan’s most eligible bachelor (=  a rich young man who has not yet married  ) .
examples.zh: 皇太子是日本最理想的适婚男子。

words.definition: able to read and write; educated; student, scholar, academic
words.translation: 有读写能力的；有文化修养的；受过教育的；精通文学的；学者

examples.en: Over one-quarter of the adult population are not fully literate.
examples.zh: 四分之一以上的成年人是半文盲。

words.definition: the belief in kinship of groups or individuals having a common totem
words.translation: 对图腾的信仰, 图腾制度

words.definition: mysterious, arcane
words.translation: 谜的, 莫明其妙的；神秘的；高深莫测的；谜一般的

words.definition: someone who has not learned to read or write; letterless, unlettered; unschooled, analphabetic
words.translation: 文盲 a不识字的；文盲的；不识字的；没受教育的；文盲

examples.en: ...a subclass of illiterates.
examples.zh: …文盲阶层。

words.definition: something said or written that mentions a subject, person etc indirectly; connotation, reference, mention, reminder, implication
words.translation: 提及, 暗示；暗示；提及

examples.en: This last point was understood to be an allusion to the long-standing hostility between the two leaders.
examples.zh: 这最后一点曾被理解为对这两位领导人之间长久敌意的一种影射。

words.definition: to ask someone for information; question, query
words.translation: 询问,  查究；询问；查究；问明；询价

examples.en: ‘Why are you doing that?’ the boy inquired.
examples.zh: “你为什么这么做？”男孩问道。

examples.en: Toby would have liked to inquire further (= ask more questions ).
examples.zh: 托比本想问更多的问题。

words.definition: a tendency to behave in a particular way, or to like a particular thing – used especially about something bad; tendency, liability, trend, preference, disposition
words.translation: 倾向；癖性

examples.en: his sexual proclivities
examples.zh: 他的性倾向

words.definition: lumpingly, clumsily
words.translation: 笨拙地, 无技巧地；笨拙地；无技巧地

words.definition: argument and disagreement between people; thesis, combat
words.translation: 争夺, 争论；争论，争辩；争夺；论点

examples.en: It is my contention that death and murder always lurk as potentials in violent relationships.
examples.zh: 我的观点是，在暴力关系中总是潜伏着死亡和谋杀的可能。

words.definition: to tell someone a story or describe a series of events; relate, narrate; roll-back
words.translation: 叙述；重新计算；重算

examples.en: He then recounted the story of the interview for his first job.
examples.zh: 他然后叙述了有关他第一份工作面试的故事。

words.definition: a feeling of great sadness, usually because someone has died or because something terrible has happened to you; soreness, disconsolateness; feel sad
words.translation: 悲哀, 悲痛；悲伤；懊悔；伤心事；遗憾；感到悲伤

examples.en: He said that his decision to resign was made more in sorrow than in anger.
examples.zh: 他说他作出辞职的决定与其说是出于气愤，不如说是因为悲伤。

words.definition: a shield, esp a heraldic one that displays a coat of arms; nameplate, data plate
words.translation: 有花纹的盾, 锁眼盖, 孔罩；饰有纹章的盾；[五金]锁眼盖；孔罩；铭牌

words.definition: A horticulturalist is a person who grows flowers, fruit, and vegetables, especially as their job
words.translation: 园艺家

examples.en: The progress of the bloom was checked closely by museum horticulturalist Zac Stayton.
examples.zh: 博物馆的园艺学家扎克•斯泰顿严密监测着开花的过程。

examples.en: Father-of-three Mr England, who works as a RHS horticulturalist and lives in Lockleaze, Bristol, was stunned because wild squirrels are usually highly secretive animals.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫·英格兰先生有三个孩子，他是皇家园艺学会的园艺师，目前居住在布里斯托尔的Lockleaze。 当时他被眼前的情景惊呆了，因为通常情况下，野生松鼠的行踪高度诡秘。

examples.en: I'm a professional horticulturalist, and I'm excited about the topic of ornamenting one's garden and teaching others how best to accomplish this.
examples.zh: 我是专业的园艺家，我对装饰花园，及教导别人如何完成装饰花园等主题，十分感兴趣。

words.definition: a social meeting of people who have not met for a long time, especially people who were at school or college together
words.translation: 团圆, 重聚

examples.en: an annual reunion
examples.zh: 一年一度的聚会

examples.en: a family reunion
examples.zh: 家庭聚会

examples.en: a high-school reunion
examples.zh: 高中同学联谊聚会

words.translation: 按字母表顺序地

examples.en: For example, you could list your records in your report alphabetically.
examples.zh: 例如，可以在报告中按字母顺序列出记录。

examples.en: Some options led to a second list of recipes organized alphabetically or by most recent entry.
examples.zh: 一些选项指向按字母顺序或者按最近访问组织的另一个菜谱列表。

examples.en: You can sort the rows within a table of data according to the data type, allowing you to order by figures — alphabetically and by date.
examples.zh: 您还可以根据数据类型对数据表格中的行进行排序，这样便可以按数字、字母和日期进行排序。

words.definition: If someone does something carelessly, they do it without much thought or effort; sloppily, inadvertently
words.translation: 粗心地；疏忽地；不注意地；无忧无虑地

examples.en: He carelessly left the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 他很粗心，没锁上门。

examples.en: "Oh," he said carelessly. "I'm in no hurry to get back."
examples.zh: "哦，"他漫不经心地说道，"我不急着回去。"

words.definition: a very famous fashion model; Zoolander
words.translation: 超级名模

examples.en: Jeff: If you were a supermodel, I can see why that would be important.
examples.zh: 杰夫：如果你是一个超级名模我就明白为什么这很重要。

examples.en: British supermodel Naomi Campbell has interviewed Venezuela's President Hugo Chavez, describing him as a "rebel angel" who is unafraid to speak his mind but poses no threat to democracy.
examples.zh: 英国超级名模娜奥米·坎贝尔日前采访了委内瑞拉总统胡戈·查韦斯，她称查韦斯为“叛逆天使”，因为他完全不惧恐吓，坚持自己的理念。

examples.en: Some of the celebrities, including actress Eva Mendes and supermodel Cindy Crawford appeared in a "Stars Without Makeup" section in which they were photographed wearing no make-up for their close-ups.
examples.zh: 其他一些名人，如女演员伊娃·曼德斯和超级名模辛迪·克劳馥德等出现在“不施粉黛最美人物”单元，这些明星在近距离拍照时不化妆。

words.definition: freely, shortly
words.translation: 唐突地, 粗率地；唐突地；直率地

words.definition: short stiff hairs that grow on a man’s face if he does not  shave
words.translation: 短须, 麦茬

examples.en: The stubble was burning in the fields.
examples.zh: 残株在田地里燃烧着。

words.definition: not involving anything or anyone else; alone, exclusively, individually
words.translation: 独自地, 单独地；单独地，唯一地

examples.en: Scholarships are given solely on the basis of financial need.
examples.zh: 奖学金完全是根据经济需要发放的。

examples.en: I shall hold you solely responsible for anything that goes wrong.
examples.zh: 出现任何差错的话，我唯你是问。

words.definition: If you flout something such as a law, an order, or an accepted way of behaving, you deliberately do not obey it or follow it; despite, derision; scoff at, laugh at; laugh at, make a mockery of
words.translation: 轻视, 嘲笑；嘲笑；轻视；愚弄；藐视；表示轻蔑

examples.en: ...illegal campers who persist in flouting the law.
examples.zh: …一向无视法律的非法露营者。

words.definition: A Chihuahua is a very small dog with short hair
words.translation: 吉娃娃(一种产于墨西哥的狗)

examples.en: Well, I think my chihuahua just killed him...
examples.zh: 哦，我想我的吉娃娃刚要了它的命……

examples.en: Shortly before their recent wedding they were arrested by the morality police while sitting in their car with their pet chihuahua.
examples.zh: 这对新婚夫妇在结婚前不久曾被道德警察逮捕，当时他们正和他们的吉娃娃宠物狗一起坐在车里。

words.translation: 形态学的

examples.en: Many scientists agree that the domestic dog displays more morphological variation than any other known species, thanks to selective breeding by humans.
examples.zh: 许多科学家都认为，国内的狗更显示形态比任何其他已知的物种变异，人类有选择育种的感谢。

examples.en: Other morphological features have also been identified that are inconsistent with a bird-from-dinosaur theory.
examples.zh: 其他的形态学特征也被认为与鸟类自恐龙演化的理论不一致。

words.definition: reacting to events or situations rather than starting or doing new things yourself; corresponsive, retroactive
words.translation: 反应的, 反作用的；反应的；电抗的；反动的

examples.en: a reactive foreign policy
examples.zh: 回应式的外交政策

words.definition: Philippine means belonging or relating to the Philippines, or to their people or culture
words.translation: 菲律宾的, 菲律宾人的

examples.en: CMMI certification, she says, would ensure a higher quality of software development and help Philippine software companies compete more effectively, particularly in the international market.
examples.zh: 她说，CMMI认证将确保更高质量的软件开发，帮助菲律宾的软件公司，特别是在国际市场上，更有效地竞争。

examples.en: Among the outstanding questions is whether victims were killed by Mendoza's or Philippine police bullets during the botched rescue operation and how the negotiation process was carried out.
examples.zh: 在蹩脚的救援行动期间，遇难者是死于门多萨还是菲律宾警方的子弹，以及他们到底怎样进行的谈判，这些问题到现在依然是个迷。

examples.en: During the trip, the youth met with staff from the Philippine Rural Reconstruction Movement.
examples.zh: 在旅程中，这班年青人跟「菲律宾乡村重建运动」的人员会面。

words.translation: 地热的

examples.en: The first geothermally generated electricity was produced in Larderello, Italy, in 1904.
examples.zh: 1904年，在意大利的拉德莱罗，首次实现了地热发电。

words.definition: the movement of people, money, goods etc into a place; afflux, inrush; flow into, feed into
words.translation: 流入, 流入物；[流]流入；流入物；岭量；货币回笼

examples.en: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
examples.zh: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

words.translation: 低于冰点的

words.definition: the belief that animals or objects have the same feelings and qualities as humans
words.translation: 拟人论,拟人观

examples.en: The comments on webcam sites are rife with anthropomorphism, not surprisingly, and even when this is pointed out, the contributors are often undaunted.
examples.zh: 不出意外的，在动物直播网站里充满了各种拟人化的评论，虽然已经有人指出，但是那些评论者却从不更改。

words.definition: a long narrow hole in a surface, that you can put something into; location, situation, site, lie; dog, follow up the scent
words.translation: 狭缝；空位；位置；狭槽；水沟；硬币投币口；跟踪；开槽于

examples.en: Alan dropped another quarter into the slot on the pay phone.
examples.zh: 艾伦往付费电话的投币口里又塞了一枚 25 分的硬币。

words.definition: a very large house; palace, edifice
words.translation: 大厦, 官邸；大厦；宅邸

examples.en: a beautiful country mansion
examples.zh: 漂亮的乡村宅第

words.definition: making you feel embarrassed so that you are not sure what to do or say; testing, embarrassed
words.translation: 难使用的, 笨拙的；尴尬的；笨拙的；棘手的；不合适的

examples.en: I hoped he would stop asking awkward questions .
examples.zh: 我希望他不要再问令人难堪的问题。

examples.en: There was an awkward moment when she didn’t know whether to shake his hand or kiss his cheek.
examples.zh: 她不知道是该跟他握手还是亲他的脸颊，一时很尴尬。

examples.en: an awkward silence
examples.zh: 令人尴尬的沉默

words.definition: something that limits your freedom to do what you want; enforcement, restriction
words.translation: 约束, 强制；[数]约束；局促，态度不自然；强制

examples.en: the constraints of family life
examples.zh: 家庭生活的约束

words.definition: to stay somewhere a little longer, especially because you do not want to leave; hang about, wander about; spend, while away
words.translation: 逗留, 闲荡；徘徊；苟延残喘；磨蹭；消磨；缓慢度过

examples.en: I spent a week at Kandersteg and could happily have lingered on.
examples.zh: 我在坎德施泰格逗留了一个星期，本来还可以开开心心地多待几天。

words.definition: the act of putting someone in a room, prison etc that they are not allowed to leave, or the state of being there; limitation, delivery, restriction, qualification, prison

examples.zh: 这是个令人很遗憾的错误。

examples.zh: 而赫顿不整合结构正好佐证了这种观点，这处位于杰德堡的交错岩层完全不同于在苏格兰其他地区所发现的光滑片岩和砂岩层结构。

examples.zh: 下面是两个比较突出的品种片岩。

words.translation: 泰国人, 泰国语

examples.zh: 她接受了以色列电视台关于这位泰国工人致死的报道，并且她计划继续致力于为和平而工作。

examples.en: If the consensus is that you should continue, then I will support the government loyally from the backbenches.
examples.zh: 如果一致意见是你应该继续留任，那么我会以一名普通议员的身份忠诚地支持政府。

examples.en: Eighteenth-century prints caricature George III as a farmer, laugh at Hanoverian German accents – yet the same crowds who laughed at the printshop windows turned out loyally for coronations.
examples.zh: 18世纪出版的讽刺漫画农民乔治三世，嘲弄汉诺威的德国口音，然而对着印刷品橱窗大笑的人群转过身就对加冕礼表现出绝对的忠诚。

examples.zh: 可以查出胎儿遗传变异的化验
