words.translation: 引起瘟疫的, 有害的；引起瘟疫的；瘟疫似的；讨厌的

examples.en: ...people who were dependent for their water supply on this pestilential stream.
examples.zh: ...那些靠这条致病的河流来取水的人们。

words.definition: harmful, evil, destructive
words.translation: 毒气的, 瘴气的；有害的；瘅气的

words.definition: on the stage in a theatre
words.translation: 台上的,舞台表演区的

examples.en: Even today I get nervous before I go onstage.
examples.zh: 直到今天我上舞台前还是会感到紧张。

words.definition: an island in a river, lake, or estuary
words.translation: (河，湖中的)小岛

words.definition: not any longer; not any longer, never again
words.translation: 不再, 再也不；再也不，不再

examples.en: Nick doesn’t live here anymore.
examples.zh: 尼克不再住在这里了。

examples.en: She told me not to phone her anymore.
examples.zh: 她叫我不要再给她打电话。

words.definition: load, deep draft
words.translation: 装载量, 列车载重；列车载重；装载量

examples.en: A trainload more may soon be on the way.
examples.zh: 承载更多运输量的列车即将出现。

examples.en: Recently, with the improvement of train speed and trainload, traffic safety on railway becomes more and more important. Accordingly, the demand of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) is growing higher.
examples.zh: 近年来，随着列车速度的不断提升和列车运载重量的不断增加，铁路的运营安全越来越重要，相应地对无损检测（NDT）的要求也越来越高。

words.translation: 古代亚述及巴比伦之金字形神塔(顶上有神殿)

words.translation: 不成形的, 无定形的；不成形的；不定形的；不象样的

examples.en: a shapeless dress
examples.zh: 松松垮垮不成形的连衣裙

words.definition: a group of singers, actors, dancers etc who work together; gout, wodge; road show
words.translation: 剧团；一班；一团；巡回演出

examples.zh: …巡回演出的演员剧团。

words.definition: relating to or influenced by postmodernism
words.translation: 后现代主义的

examples.en: postmodern architecture
examples.zh: 后现代主义建筑

words.definition: an expressionless face or voice does not show what someone thinks or feels; mechanical, wooden, dead
words.translation: 无表情的；呆板的

examples.en: a blank expressionless stare
examples.zh: 面无表情的注视

words.definition: moving or doing things in a careless way, especially so that you drop things, knock into things etc; awkward, inept
words.translation: 笨拙的

examples.zh: 一名笨手笨脚的服务员把葡萄酒洒得她新裙子上到处都是。

examples.en: a clumsy attempt to catch the ball
examples.zh: 笨拙的接球动作

words.definition: a loud horn on a ship, used in fog to warn other ships of its position
words.translation: [航海]雾角,尖而响的声音

words.translation: 雄伟的，壮丽的；庄严的；宏伟的

examples.zh: 这座美丽的村庄四周山色壮丽。

words.translation: 维也纳人（语）(的)

words.translation: 委员, 专员；委员，专员；理事；行政长官

examples.en: ...Alaska's commissioner of education.
examples.zh: …阿拉斯加州的教育要员。

words.definition: a small round juicy fruit which is dark red, purple, or yellow and has a single hard seed, or the tree that produces this fruit; wine, amaranth; favorable, beneficial, advantageous
words.translation: [植] 李子, 洋李；李子；梅子；洋李；紫红色；人所希望的；有利的；上等的

examples.en: juicy ripe plums
examples.zh: 多汁的成熟李子

words.definition: a  sailor  on a ship or in the navy who is not an officer; marine, sailor
words.translation: 海员, 水手；海员，水手；水兵

examples.en: The men emigrate to work as seamen.
examples.zh: 这些男人移居国外当海员。

words.definition: one of two poles which you can stand on and walk high above the ground; leg, support, backbone, stay
words.translation: 高跷, 支柱；高跷；支柱，[建]支撑物

examples.en: They inhabit reed huts built on stilts above the water.
examples.zh: 他们居住在建在水中木桩上的芦苇草屋里。

words.definition: an upright stone slab or column decorated with figures or inscriptions, common in prehistoric times; kingbolt
words.translation: 石碑,  匾额；[建]石碑；[植]中柱；石柱

examples.zh: 我们确实有胜利颂歌，刻在石碑上的胜利颂歌,那是一块石板，立于公元前1204年。

examples.en: First published straight from the stele in 1902, the book begins by detailing the names of numerous members of the royal family dating back to the 1st Dynasty.
examples.zh: 纸质书1902年出版，直接临摹石碑，书的开头不厌其烦地罗列从第一王朝以来无数王室成员的名字。

examples.en: Collect archaic stele , portraits of Roman emperors, and pottery.
examples.zh: 收藏古体的石碑、罗马皇帝的肖像和陶器。

words.definition: an account of events in the order in which they happened; Fasti
words.translation: 年代学, 年表；[图情]年表；年代学

examples.en: The book includes a chronology of his life and works.
examples.zh: 本书附有他的生平和著作年表。

words.definition: overt actions are done publicly, without trying to hide anything; obvious, distinct, visible, declared, evident
words.translation: 明显的, 公然的；明显的；公然的；蓄意的

examples.en: an overt attempt to silence their political opponents
examples.zh: 他们想压制政敌言论的明显企图

examples.en: Overt race discrimination is illegal.
examples.zh: 公然的种族歧视是非法的。

words.definition: variously
words.translation: 华美的, 富有色彩的；多彩地；绚烂地

examples.en: That's what he told us again and again in his campaign, not as colorfully as Edwards, but ultimately more convincingly.
examples.zh: 那也是他在竞选中一次次告诉大家的，尽管言语没有爱德华说的那么有文采，但最终却更加让人信服。

examples.en: Traditional clothing consists of colorfully embroidered shirts and dresses and in some regions loose-fitting pants for women.
examples.zh: 传统的服装包括色彩绚丽的刺绣衬衫和裙子，在某些地区女性则穿宽松的裤子。

words.definition: the quality of being famous and important; splendour, predominance
words.translation: 出众, 显赫；显赫；卓越；高处

examples.en: Many of the pilots were to achieve eminence in the aeronautical world.
examples.zh: 其中的很多飞行员后来在航空界都取得了显赫的声名。

words.definition: a light that is put somewhere to warn or guide people, ships, vehicles, or aircraft; lighthouse, phare; lamp, light up
words.translation: 信号灯，闪光灯；[水运]灯塔，信号浮标；烽火；指路明灯；照亮，指引

examples.en: ...a huge office tower with aircraft warning beacons on the roof.
examples.zh: …一个屋顶有航行警告灯的巨型办公塔。

words.definition: perverseness, wilfulness
words.translation: 倔强, 顽强；倔强；顽强；棘手

words.definition: If you prearrange something, you plan or arrange it before the time when it actually happens; preconcert
words.translation: 预先安排

examples.en: When you prearrange your funeral, you can pick your own flowers and music.
examples.zh: 当你预先准备自己的葬礼时，你就能够选择自己喜欢的鲜花和音乐。

words.definition: to continue trying to do something in a very determined way in spite of difficulties – use this to show approval; stay, stand on
words.translation: 坚持；不屈不挠；固执己见（在辩论中）

examples.en: It can be tricky at first, but persevere.
examples.zh: 一开始会有些棘手，不过要坚持。

words.translation: 垒球运动, 垒球
莎士比亚(1564-1616,英国剧作家,诗人)

examples.en: He turned to the study of Shakespeare.
examples.zh: 他致力于莎士比亚的研究。

examples.en: As a playwriter,Shakespeare belongs to the 16th century.
examples.zh: 作为一位剧作家，莎士比亚属于16世纪。

examples.en: He was reading the plays of Shakespeare when I met him in the library the other day.
examples.zh: 前几天我在图书馆遇见他时，他正在阅读莎士比亚的戏剧。

words.definition: cruel or violent treatment of someone; punishment, vice; strain, maltreat
words.translation: 滥用, 虐待,辱骂；滥用；虐待；辱骂；弊端；恶习，陋习

examples.en: several cases of child abuse
examples.zh: 数宗虐待儿童案

examples.en: An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
examples.zh: 一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

words.translation: 齐特拉琴(古希腊一种类似竖琴的古乐器)；齐特拉琴（等于cittern）

words.definition: designed in a way that looks very modern and very different from previous styles; updated, present-day
words.translation: 现代的, 现代主义的；[建]现代的，现代化的；现代派的，现代主义的

examples.en: a modernistic office building
examples.zh: 现代风格的办公大楼

words.definition: the piece of thread in a candle, that burns when you light it; lampwick
words.translation: 蜡烛心, 灯芯；灯芯，蜡烛心

words.definition: steel, durability, toughness
words.translation: 强健, 雄壮, 坚固；坚固；强健，雄壮

words.definition: Wicker is long thin sticks, stems, or reeds that have been woven together to make things such as baskets and furniture; rod, vergo
words.translation: 柳条 a柳条制的；[林]柳条；枝条；柳条制品

examples.en: ...a wicker basket.
examples.zh: ...一个柳条编的篮子。

words.definition: plain and simple and without any decoration; severe, naked
words.translation: 简朴的, 严厉的；严峻的；简朴的；苦行的；无装饰的

examples.en: the church’s austere simplicity
examples.zh: 那座教堂的朴实无华

words.definition: happening or existing in every part of the country; countrywide
words.translation: 全国性的；全国范围的

examples.en: a nationwide search for a missing British tourist
examples.zh: 在全国范围内对一名失踪英国游客的搜寻

examples.en: nationwide television
examples.zh: 全国性的电视节目

words.definition: horoscopic, Chaldaean
words.translation: 占星的, 占星术的；占星的；占星学的，占星术的

examples.en: So, the problem with astrological predictions is not that they're wrong.
examples.zh: 占星预测的问题并不在于它们是错误的。

examples.en: After all, much of what we have inherited from past civilisations is of little practical use: the Venus Tablet of Ammisaduqa, for instance, consists largely of astrological mumbo jumbo.
examples.zh: 毕竟，人类从过去的文明中所继承下来的都是些缺少实用价值的知识，例如阿米萨杜卡金星文书中大部分都由一些占星术组成的。

examples.en: Astrologers call this period aGreat Year, and they divide it into 12 Great Months or astrological"ages", each about 2, 147 years long. Each age corresponds to one of thesigns of the zodiac.
examples.zh: 占星家们管这段时期为一个大年，并且将其划分为12个大月或称之为占星学意义上“时代”，每一个时代持续2 147年，对应十二星座符号之一。

words.definition: an effect caused by hot air in a desert, which makes you think that you can see objects when they are not actually there; Dessert Mirage, Fata Morgana
words.translation: 海市蜃楼,幻想；[气象]海市蜃楼；幻想，妄想

examples.en: Perhaps we are just chasing a mirage.
examples.zh: 也许我们只是在追逐一个梦。

words.definition: reserve, warehouse
words.translation: 仓库；储备；全部剧目

words.definition: to save someone or something from a situation of danger or harm; deliverance
words.translation: ／ n营救，救援；营救；援救；解救

examples.en: Survivors of the crash were rescued by helicopter.
examples.zh: 空难的生还者被直升机救了出来。

words.definition: approach, neighborhood
words.translation: 靠近, 接近；接近；密切；近似

examples.en: God is nearer to me than I am to myself; my existence depends on the nearness and the presence of God.
examples.zh: 上帝比我更靠近我自己；我的存在取决于上帝的存在以及上帝离我有多近。

words.definition: a light cake made of  meringue  , cream and fruit
words.translation: 奶油水果蛋白饼

words.definition: the food and other substances that people and other living things need to live, grow, and stay healthy; nutrition, diet, eating
words.translation: 食物, 营养品；食物；营养品；滋养品

examples.en: lack of proper nourishment
examples.zh: 缺乏适当的营养

examples.en: The soil provides nourishment for plant roots.
examples.zh: 土壤为植物根部提供养分。

words.definition: a room used for teaching in a small school; classroom, teaching room
words.translation: 教室；讲堂

examples.en: They seemed like so many little flags dotted about the schoolroom.
examples.zh: 这些卡片就像无数面小旗点缀着教室。

examples.en: One day, all of a sudden, he proposed that each one in turn should jump off the bench in our schoolroom.
examples.zh: 一天，他突然提议大家都轮流从教室的椅子上跳下去。

examples.en: A clear example of this nationalism was displayed in the schoolroom, where one whole corner was given over to pictures and the pronouncements of Atatürk, the founder of the Turkish republic.
examples.zh: 关于这种民族主义的一个明显是例证就在学校的教室里，有一整个角落给了阿塔托克（Atatürk）的肖像和宣言，他是土耳其共和国的创始人。

words.definition: unable to look after yourself or to do anything to help yourself; unassisted, inefficient
words.translation: 无助的,没用的；无助的；无能的；没用的

examples.en: He began to feel depressed and helpless.
examples.zh: 他开始觉得沮丧、无助。

examples.en: a vicious attack on a helpless victim
examples.zh: 对无助受害者的残暴攻击

examples.en: Newman threw out a hand in a helpless gesture.
examples.zh: 纽曼伸出手做了个无助的手势。

words.definition: Your grandparents are the parents of your father or mother
words.translation: 外祖父母, 祖父母

examples.en: Tammy was raised by her grandparents.
examples.zh: 塔米是由她的祖父母抚养大的。

words.definition: fertility, good crop
words.translation: 多产, 肥沃；丰收，丰硕；多实，肥沃

words.definition: the main church of a particular area under the control of a  bishop; minster, duomo
words.translation: 大教堂

examples.en: St Paul’s Cathedral
examples.zh: 圣保罗大教堂

words.definition: the electrical part of a vehicle’s engine that makes it start working; combustion, burning, fires, inflammation
words.translation: 点火, 点燃；[动力]点火，点燃；[热]着火，燃烧；点火开关，点火装置

examples.en: The device automatically disconnects the ignition.
examples.zh: 那个装置自动断开了点火器。

words.definition: Midwestern means belonging or relating to the Midwest
words.translation: 美国中西部的

examples.en: ...the Midwestern plains.
examples.zh: ...这些中西部的平原。

examples.en: ...traditional Midwestern values.
examples.zh: ...传统的中西部价值观。

words.definition: to interrupt what someone else is saying with a sudden remark; cut in, strike in
words.translation: 插嘴, 突然插入；突然插入；插嘴

examples.en: ‘That’s absolute rubbish!’ he interjected.
examples.zh: “那全是废话！”他突然插话道。

words.definition: ease, easiness
words.translation: 轻盈, 灵活；轻盈；轻松；明亮；（颜色）浅淡

words.definition: bucolic
words.translation: 田园短诗的, 牧歌的；牧歌的，田园诗的

examples.en: It was an attractive hope that the high technology of our society might be wrested from the grip of benighted forces and used to restore us to an idyllic natural state.
examples.zh: 人类社会的高科技可能将我们自愚昧势力的控制之中拯救出来，并重建一个田园诗般的自然状态，这曾是一个有吸引力的愿景。

examples.en: Of the ordinary, idyllic society that we all took for granted.
examples.zh: 对于大众来说，这就是我们习以为常的田园诗般的社会。

words.definition: the special meaning or importance that something has for you because it relates to your own experiences; sympathetic vibration, reflections
words.translation: 共鸣,  反响；[力]共振；[物]共鸣；反响

examples.en: a tradition that has little resonance in the 21st century
examples.zh: 在21世纪难以引起共鸣的传统

examples.en: His words will have resonance for many musicians.
examples.zh: 他的话将在很多音乐家心里产生共鸣。

words.definition: a story, painting etc in which the events and characters represent ideas or teach a moral lesson; parable, apologue
words.translation: 寓言

examples.en: The poem's comic allegory was transparent.
examples.zh: 这首诗歌的喜剧性讽寓很明显。

words.definition: a large curve of different colours that can appear in the sky when there is both sun and rain; fancy, fantasy; multicolour, pavonine
words.translation: 彩虹；[气象]彩虹；五彩缤纷的排列；幻想；五彩缤纷的；彩虹状的

examples.en: ...silk and satin in every shade of the rainbow.
examples.zh: …如彩虹般五颜六色的丝绸与锦缎。

words.definition: excuse, display, blind
words.translation: 借口,伪装，自吹；借口；虚假；炫耀；自吹（等于pretence）

examples.en: Using as little pretense as possible (ideally none), ask the person if he or she would like to get together for a cup of coffee or do something similarly casual.
examples.zh: 在问对方是否愿意出来喝杯咖啡或做一些其他类似的事情的时候，尽量不要用虚伪的借口（理想中应该是一点虚假也没有）。

words.definition: said or done without a good reason, in a way that offends someone; free, groundless
words.translation: 无缘无故的；免费的；无理由的，无端的

examples.en: children’s books which include gratuitous violence
examples.zh: 包含无谓暴力内容的儿童书籍

words.definition: animation, heat, brightness, volatility
words.translation: 活泼；热烈；鲜明

examples.en: We need to consolidate and develop the current political situation of democracy, solidarity, liveliness, stability and harmony.
examples.zh: 我们要巩固和发展民主团结、生动活泼、安定和谐的政治局面。

examples.en: His understanding and opinions all please me; he wants nothing but a little more  liveliness, and that, if he marry  prudently, his wife may teach him.
examples.zh: 他的见识，他的言论，我都很喜欢。 他没有任何缺点，只不过稍欠活泼；关于这一点，只要他结婚结得当心一些，娶个好太太，他也许会让她给教好的。

examples.en: She was really but a child, fresh, vivacious and aloof; it seemed that she always shook off every unpleasant thought with a liveliness that was, at once, charming, ingenuous and roguish.
examples.zh: 她确实还只是个孩子，容光焕发，性情活泼，而又态度孤傲；似乎她随时能用她那娇媚、天真、淘气的活泼抖落掉一切不愉快的心思。

words.definition: a very strong bad smell; malodor, effluvium; stink of
words.translation: 恶臭, 臭气；恶臭；[矿业]臭气；发恶臭

examples.en: the stench of urine
examples.zh: 尿臭味

words.definition: sludge, mucus
words.translation: 粘土, 粘液；黏液；烂泥

examples.en: He swam down and retrieved his glasses from the muck and slime at the bottom of the pond.
examples.zh: 他潜下水去，从池塘底部的烂泥污物中找回了眼镜。

words.definition: a black and white sea bird that has long wings and a tail with two points; scray, triplet
words.translation: 三个一组, [鸟]燕鸥；燕鸥；三个一组

examples.en: The tiny arctic tern makes the longest migration of any animal in the world, flying about two times farther than previously thought, a new study says.
examples.zh: 一项新的研究表明，小小的北极燕鸥竟创下了动物世界的飞行记录，“旅途”长度是此前相关数据的二倍。

examples.en: When they get a tern or pelican to drop a fish, they plunge down and grab it off the surface of the water, which may have been how this bird got oiled.
examples.zh: 当军舰鸟发现一只燕鸥或者鹈鹕准备冲入水中捕鱼时就猛冲下去，在捕鱼的鸟离开海面时抓住它们，这可能就是这种鸟为何解决到石油的原因。

words.definition: stellate
words.translation: 星形的, 星般闪烁的；星形的；星般闪烁的

examples.en: In chapter three, we get the upper bounds and some properties of the second order item of homogeneous expansion for E starlike mappings as well as some order items for one special E starlike mappings.
examples.zh: 第三章在单位超球上给出了E 星形映照族齐次展开式的二次项和一类特殊的E 星形映照齐次展开式相关项的上界估计，并将其结果应用到单位球上的凸映照和 星形映照，得出相应的结论。

words.definition: covered with  slime  , or wet and slippery like slime; artificial, false
words.translation: 黏滑的, 卑劣的；黏滑的；泥泞的；谄媚的，虚伪的

examples.en: slimy mud
examples.zh: 黏糊糊的泥巴

words.definition: a very small living thing that can make you ill; seed, plantule; burgeon, spring up
words.translation: 微生物, 细菌；[植]胚芽，萌芽；[微]细菌；萌芽

examples.en: Put disinfectant down the toilet to kill any germs.
examples.zh: 在抽水马桶里投放消毒剂杀菌。

words.definition: a room where goods are stored; storage room, boxroom
words.translation: 储藏室, 库房；库房；储藏室

examples.en: ...a storeroom filled with massive old furniture covered with dust.
examples.zh: ...一间堆满了尘封的大件旧家具的贮藏室。

words.translation: 奥克兰(美国加利福尼亚州西部城市)

examples.en: I thought this building should be physically and symbolically connected with the city as a powerful social and cultural resource for Oakland.
examples.zh: 我认为，这座建筑应该作为奥克兰一个强大的社会与文化资源，在外形和寓意上都与这座城市彼此相联。

examples.en: I met with Sculley in a hotel lobby near Oakland airport. Sculley had been taking meetings for his investment fund and was waiting for a flight back home on the east coast.
examples.zh: 我是在奥克兰机场附近的酒店大厅里遇见的斯卡利，他刚刚参加完自己投资基金的一个会议，在机场附近等候航班回东海岸的家。

examples.en: Now living in Oakland, they own three wine stores and have a baby boy.
examples.zh: 现在他们住在奥克兰，拥有三家葡萄酒商店，生了一个男孩。

words.definition: If you allude to something, you mention it in an indirect way
words.translation: 暗指，提及

examples.en: With friends, she sometimes alluded to a feeling that she herself was to blame for her son's predicament.
examples.zh: 和朋友们一起时，她有时暗示她感到儿子的困境要怪她自己。

words.translation: 从云隙射下的阳光

examples.en: A pyramid built by the mysterious Maya looms against sunburst clouds in Chichén Itzá, a postclassic site of the lost civilization on the Yucatán Peninsula.
examples.zh: 尤卡坦半岛失去的文明古遗址奇琴伊察，一座由神秘玛雅人建造的金字塔隐现在破云而出的阳光下。

words.definition: behaving in a way that shows you think you are better or more important than other people; superior, lofty; superciliously, fastuously
words.translation: 高贵的；高傲的；贵族气派的；贵族般地；高傲地

examples.en: a lordly disdain for the common man
examples.zh: 对平民百姓的轻慢

words.definition: a long narrow hole dug at the side of a field, road etc to hold or remove unwanted water; reject, slough off; furrow; conduit, sike
words.translation: 沟,  壕沟；在…上掘沟；把…开入沟里；丢弃；开沟；掘沟；沟渠；壕沟

examples.en: Both vehicles ended up in a ditch.
examples.zh: 两辆车都掉进了沟里。

words.definition: deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behaviour; resistant, mutinous
words.translation: 反抗的，难控制的；反抗的；造反的；难控制的

examples.en: rebellious teenagers
examples.zh: 叛逆的青少年

examples.en: He’s always had a rebellious streak (= a tendency to rebel ) .
examples.zh: 他向来个性叛逆。

words.definition: someone who believes in the ideas of a great teacher or leader, especially a religious one; Christian, protege
words.translation: 信徒, 弟子；门徒，信徒；弟子

examples.en: ...a major intellectual figure with disciples throughout Europe.
examples.zh: …一位信徒遍布欧洲的重要知识分子。

words.definition: If you describe a place or the weather as arctic, you are emphasizing that it is extremely cold; hyperboloidal, gelid; the Arctic Circle
words.translation: 北极的 n北极(圈)；北极的；极寒的；北极圈；御寒防水套鞋

examples.en: The bathroom, with its spartan pre-war facilities, is positively arctic.
examples.zh: 这个有简陋战前设施的浴室实在冷极了。

words.definition: a small creature that has a long tail, lives in water, and grows into a  frog  or  toad; pollywog
words.translation: [动]蝌蚪；[脊椎]蝌蚪

examples.en: The tadpole has become a frog.
examples.zh: 这个蝌蚪已长成青蛙。

examples.en: He is my tadpole.
examples.zh: 他就是我的蝌蚪。

examples.en: The tadpole produce the sound by pushing air out of their lungs.
examples.zh: 这种蝌蚪通过将空气从肺中挤出，来发出声音。

words.definition: a natural tendency to behave in a particular way; tendency, liability, behaviour, trend, habit
words.translation: 倾向；[心理]倾向，习性；癖好，偏爱

examples.en: Mr. Bint has a propensity to put off decisions to the last minute.
examples.zh: 宾特先生有一种将决定拖到最后一分钟的倾向。

words.definition: Wildflowers are flowers that grow naturally in the countryside, rather than being grown by people in gardens
words.translation: 野花

examples.en: And yes,if I see the blue flowers again,you can bet I'll stop and transplant them to my wildflower garden.
examples.zh: 是的，如果我再次看到那些蓝色的花儿，你可以相信，我会停下来把它们移值到我的野花花园里。

examples.en: And yes, if I see the blue flowers again, you can bet I'll stop and transplant them to my wildflower garden.
examples.zh: 是的，如果我再次看到那些蓝色的花儿，你可以相信，我会停下来把它们移植到我的野花花园里。

examples.en: From wildflower meadows to redwood forests to alpine bogs, the diversity of seed plants rings out as one of evolution's great achievements.
examples.zh: 从野花遍布的草地到红杉森林，再到阿尔卑斯的沼泽地，种子植物多样性的耀眼成就吹响了植物进化的号角。

words.definition: to stop something from happening or developing; kill, snuff out; choke
words.translation: 窒息, 抑制；扼杀；使窒息；藏匿；窒息；被扼杀

examples.en: rules and regulations that stifle innovation
examples.zh: 压制创新的规章制度

examples.en: How can this party stifle debate on such a crucial issue?
examples.zh: 该党怎么可以压制对这么一个重要问题的辩论？

words.definition: a long thin piece of rope or leather with a handle, that you hit animals with to make them move or that you hit someone with to punish them; fan, egg, leather; mixer, flagellum; whirl
words.translation: 鞭子 v鞭打；抽打；煽动；搅打（蛋，奶油）；彻底击败；[畜牧]鞭子；车夫；[机]搅拌器；急走；拍击

examples.en: The coachman cracked his whip and the carriage lurched forward.
examples.zh: 马车夫甩了一记响鞭，马车猛然向前冲去。

words.definition: the first public appearance of an entertainer, sports player etc or of something new and important
words.translation: 首次演出，初次露面

examples.en: She made her debut in a 1937 production of "Hamlet."
examples.zh: 她在1937年《哈姆雷特》的演出中首次登台。

words.definition: the state of being or having enough; plenty, amplitude, enough
words.translation: 充足；充裕；足量，充足；自满

examples.en: The war has affected the country’s economic sufficiency.
examples.zh: 战争已经影响到了这个国家的经济富足。

words.definition: someone who opposes or fights against people in authority; to oppose or fight against someone in authority or against an idea or situation which you do not agree with; strive against, come out against; rat, putschist; resistant, mutinous
words.translation: 反叛分子；反叛；反对；反抗；造反；反叛者；叛徒；反抗的；造反的

examples.en: Anti-government rebels attacked the town.
examples.zh: 反政府的叛乱分子攻击该镇。

examples.en: the rebel leader
examples.zh: 叛军首领

words.definition: a short sudden attack by a group of soldiers, especially in order to get food or supplies; attack, attempt, invasion, push, aggression; descend on, set at; reave
words.translation: 突袭，偷袭；突袭；侵略；攻击；袭击；劫掠

examples.en: These base camps were used by the PKK guerrillas to make forays into Turkey.
examples.zh: 这些基地营被库尔德工人党游击队用来对土耳其进行突袭。

words.definition: someone who is being taught, especially a child; student, minor
words.translation: 小学生；学生；[解剖]瞳孔；未成年人

examples.en: About 20 pupils study music here.
examples.zh: 大约20名小学生在这里学习音乐。

examples.en: staff and pupils
examples.zh: 教职员工和学生

examples.en: a star pupil
examples.zh: 一名优秀的小学生

words.definition: a liquid painted onto metal or wood to form a hard shiny surface; paint coating; japan, lacker
words.translation: 漆, 漆器；涂漆；使表面光泽；[涂料]漆；漆器

examples.en: We put on the second coating of lacquer.
examples.zh: 我们刷了第二层漆。

words.definition: Gobi Desert
words.translation: 戈壁；戈壁沙漠

words.definition: a young girl, or a woman who is not married; unwed, virgin; damoiselle, jill
words.translation: 少女, 处女；未婚的，处女的；初次的；少女；处女

examples.en: ...stories of noble princes and their brave deeds on behalf of beautiful maidens.
examples.zh: …高贵的王子以及他们英雄救美的故事。

words.definition: technically
words.translation: 学业上；学术上

examples.en: Challenge yourself academically, but give yourself plenty of time for fun as well.
examples.zh: 学业上要努力，但也要给自己充足的娱乐时间。

examples.en: "Research in the UK shows those born at the start of the school year also do better academically and have more confidence," he said.
examples.zh: 班纳还说道：“英国的研究人员还发现，在学校学年开始时出生的人，会在学术上表现得较好，而且他们也更有自信。”

words.definition: to protect a person or animal from a disease by giving them a vaccine
words.translation: 接种疫苗，给…打防疫针

examples.en: Dogs must be vaccinated against distemper.
examples.zh: 犬类必须接种疫苗以防犬热病。

examples.zh: 教材从文化角度来看必须恰当。

examples.en: Historically and culturally, Britain has always been linked to the continent.
examples.zh: 英国在历史上和文化上历来都和欧洲大陆休戚相关。

words.translation: 肖像的, 图像材料的

words.definition: sincerity, staidness
words.translation: 坚定, 认真；认真；诚挚；正经

examples.en: We would admire both his earnestness and his self-aware irony.
examples.zh: 我们由衷地钦佩他的认真和有自知之明的讽刺艺术。

words.translation: 民间传说的, 民俗的

examples.en: T here are films as lovely, but none lovelier than "Cinema Paradiso, " a folkloric salute to the medium itself, flickering with yesterday's innocence and lingering on the mind like bubbles in wine.
examples.zh: 世 界上有如《天堂电影院》一般动人的影片，但绝无出其右，一部对媒体自身的民俗的礼赞，闪烁着往日的纯真无邪，如同葡萄酒中的泡泡那般萦绕心头挥之不去。

examples.en: The first was the so-called “hidden people”—or, to put it more plainly, elves—in whom some large number of Icelanders, steeped long and thoroughly in their rich folkloric culture, sincerely believe.
examples.zh: 第一个问题是所谓的“隐藏的人”——或者通俗地讲，小精灵——为数众多的冰岛人长久以来对他们丰富的民间传说深深相信并沉浸其中。

words.definition: a vibrant colour is bright and strong; oscillatory, libratory
words.translation: 震动的；明亮的；[力]振动的；充满生气的；响亮的；战栗的

examples.en: a painting full of vibrant reds and blues
examples.zh: 满是鲜亮的红色和蓝色的画作

words.definition: if a story unfolds, or if someone unfolds it, it is told; crack, assume, open up; expand, develop
words.translation: 展开,显露，展现；打开；呈现；展开；显露

examples.en: As the story unfolds, we learn more about Max’s childhood.
examples.zh: 随着故事的展开，我们对马克斯的童年有了更多的了解。

words.definition: when something such as a piece of writing is easy to understand because its parts are connected in a clear and reasonable way; accordance, unity, agreement, identity, consensus
words.translation: 一致；[计]连贯性；[物]凝聚

examples.en: An overall theme will help to give your essay coherence.
examples.zh: 一个总的主题将有助于使文章连贯紧凑。

examples.en: He had a coherence of outlook and thought.
examples.zh: 他的观点和想法条理清晰。

words.definition: a delay before something bad happens or continues to happen; stay of execution; probation, suspended sentence
words.translation: 缓刑，暂时解救；缓期执行；暂时解救；暂缓；缓刑

examples.en: Fourteen people, waiting to be hanged for the murder of a former prime minister, have been reprieved.
examples.zh: 因谋杀前总理而等受绞刑的十四个人获得缓刑。

words.definition: a fault in the way a machine or part of someone’s body works; get out of order, be out of order; fault, trouble, complaint, sickness
words.translation: 故障；发生故障；不起作用；失灵；疾病

examples.en: a malfunction in one of the engines
examples.zh: 其中一个引擎的失灵

examples.en: an equipment malfunction
examples.zh: 设备故障

words.definition: able to express your ideas and opinions well, especially in a way that influences people; meaningful, affecting, significant, moving, speaking
words.translation: 雄辩的, 有口才的；意味深长的；雄辩的，有口才的；有说服力的；动人的

examples.en: an eloquent appeal for support
examples.zh: 极具说服力的求助呼吁

words.definition: tending to think deeply about your own thoughts, feelings, or behaviour; idiotropic
words.translation: 反省的；内省的

examples.en: a shy and introspective person
examples.zh: 一个腼腆自省的人

words.definition: a picture made by printing from an etched metal plate
words.translation: 蚀刻版画

examples.en: Mary is very keen on etching.
examples.zh: 玛丽很喜爱蚀刻艺术。

examples.en: He is busy (in) etching.
examples.zh: 他正忙于蚀刻。

examples.en: The technology used for making the objects is that of bending metal tubes and wood etching.
examples.zh: 制作那个物体用到的技术有金属管弯曲和木料蚀刻。

words.definition: a method of painting using colours that are mixed with water and made thicker with a type of glue
words.translation: 树胶水彩画

examples.en: Her preferred medium is oil, but she also enjoys acrylic, gouache , and pen and wash.
examples.zh: 她主要是画油画，但对丙烯，水粉画，钢笔和水彩画也很感兴趣。

words.definition: full of energy and fun; alive, lively, activated
words.translation: 活泼的, 欢闹的；活泼的；欢闹的

examples.en: a frisky horse
examples.zh: 一匹欢蹦乱跳的马

words.definition: bawl out; cry, bawl out; outcry, screeching
words.translation: 咆哮；叫喊；狗吠；（因痛而）叫喊，叫喊着说；尖叫，大叫；吠声

words.definition: lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, body
words.translation: 一桶之量, 大量；一桶之量；大量

examples.en: Biotech pharmaceuticals require networked intelligence to manage living soups as they flow by the barrelful from one vat to the next.
examples.zh: 生物技术制药也需要这种网络化的智慧来管理那些“活体基液”在大桶容器之间的流动。

words.definition: a large group of people who sing together; choir
words.translation: 合唱(队)；合唱队；齐声；歌舞队；合唱；异口同声地说；异口同声地说话

examples.en: I sing with the university chorus.
examples.zh: 我在大学合唱队里唱歌。

words.definition: ill, especially for a short time; ill, uncomfortable, uneasy
words.translation: 不舒服的；生病的

examples.en: She had been feeling unwell.
examples.zh: 她觉得不舒服。

words.definition: Displacement is the removal of something from its usual place or position by something which then occupies that place or position; shifting, subrogation
words.translation: 移置, 转移, 取代；[化学]取代，[心理]移位；[船][航][机]排水量

examples.en: ...the displacement of traditional agriculture by industrial crops.
examples.zh: …经济作物对传统农业的替代。

words.definition: confusedly
words.translation: 浑沌地；混乱地

words.definition: an area or building that is bathed in light has light shining onto it in a way that makes it look pleasant or attractive; lave; wash oneself, have a bath; swim, ablution
words.translation: 沐浴；洗澡；用水洗；游泳

examples.en: The top of Pea Hill was bathed in brilliant sunshine.
examples.zh: 豌豆山的山顶沐浴在灿烂的阳光中。

words.definition: very frightening; afraid, tremendous, terrible, horrible, awesome
words.translation: 可怕的；害怕的；极大的

examples.en: a fearsome weapon
examples.zh: 可怕的武器

words.definition: If you scour something such as a place or a book, you make a thorough search of it to try to find what you are looking for; mop up, wipe; wash, rub up; swabbing, brushup
words.translation: 四处搜索；洗涤；冲刷；擦；腹泻；擦亮，洗涤；冲洗，清除；擦，冲刷；洗涤剂；（畜类等的）腹泻

examples.en: Rescue crews had scoured an area of 30 square miles.
examples.zh: 救援人员已经搜遍了30平方英里的范围。

words.definition: the study of words and of the way words and languages develop; linguistics, glossology
words.translation: 语言学, 文献学；[语]文献学；语言学

examples.en: I don't know the philology side, I don't know what disables to metaphysical questions.
examples.zh: 我不知道者从语言学上来说对不对，我也不懂从形而上学角度看,有什么问题。

words.definition: a polite word for a man, used especially when talking to or about a man you do not know; sir, don, Mister, Monsieur
words.translation: 阁下, 先生；先生；绅士；有身分的人

examples.en: Could you serve this gentleman please, Miss Bath?
examples.zh: 巴思小姐，请你接待一下这位先生好吗？

examples.en: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen .
examples.zh: 早上好，女士们，先生们。

examples.en: An elderly gentleman was asleep next to the fire.
examples.zh: 一位老先生在火炉旁边睡着了。

words.translation: 不可见的

examples.en: It basically means that you have a theory about the unobservable psychological states that are governing — or causing — other people's behaviors.
examples.zh: 这基本上意味着你能推测到，那些支配或引起他人行为的不可观察的心理状态。

words.definition: dilatorily
words.translation: 缓慢的, 懒惰的；懒怠地；慢吞吞地

examples.en: You may have noticed this when driving: those distant phone poles pass sluggishly while the ones on the road go zooming by.
examples.zh: 你或许会在开车时有这种感觉：远处的电线杆移动的很慢，而路边的电线杆则移动的很快。

examples.en: The economies are coming out of recession, sluggishly, and it's modest growth on the positive side for a foreseeable future.
examples.zh: 经济正从衰退中慢慢地走出来，并且我们在可以预见的未来看到了积极的适度的增长。

words.definition: balm  , or the tree that produces it; cypripedium, lady's-slipper
words.translation: 香液；[林]香脂；凤仙花；[药]香膏；[植]产香脂的树

examples.en: Soon a dark wall of trees—red spruce, balsam fir, beech, hemlock—surrounds you, and there's a sudden stony persistence.
examples.zh: 很快你会被一堵厚厚的树墙包围——红云杉、香脂冷杉、山毛榉和铁杉，这会持续一段时间。

examples.en: The Christmas season has officially arrived at the White House in the form of a six-meter balsam fir tree.
examples.zh: 欢庆圣诞的季节随着一棵6米高的香脂冷杉树的到来已经正式在白宫拉开序幕。

words.definition: heavily, importantly
words.translation: 沉重地, 重要地；重要地；沉重地

words.definition: the scientific study of animals and their behaviour; fauna
words.translation: 动物学, 生态；[动]动物学；动物区系

examples.en: The scholarship money she won helped her attend Cornell University, where she majored in zoology.
examples.zh: 她赢得的奖学金帮助她上康奈尔大学，在那里他主修动物学。

words.definition: If you do something on horseback, you do it while riding a horse; brief, hot-brained
words.translation: 马背, 隆起的条状地带；性急的；草率的；未经充分考虑的

examples.en: In remote mountain areas, voters arrived on horseback.
examples.zh: 在偏远山区，选民们是骑着马来的。

words.definition: to plant again; to transplant, transfer of culture
words.translation: 再植, 改种；改种；移植；移居

examples.en: she replanted the bulbs that the dog had dug up

words.definition: Nonessential means not absolutely necessary; extrinsical, unessential; featherweight
words.translation: 非本质的；不重要的人

examples.en: The crisis has led to the closure of a number of nonessential government services.
examples.zh: 这场危机已导致了一些可有可无政府服务设施的关闭。

examples.en: ...non-essential goods.
examples.zh: ...非必需品。

words.definition: concerning grammar; well-formed
words.translation: 语法的,合乎文法的；文法的；符合语法规则的

examples.en: grammatical rules
examples.zh: 语法规则

words.definition: very interesting, exciting, and surprising; immense, lurid
words.translation: 轰动的, 耸人听闻的；轰动的；耸人听闻的；非常好的；使人感动的

examples.en: a sensational discovery
examples.zh: 引起轰动的发现

examples.en: The show was a sensational success.
examples.zh: 这次演出取得了轰动性的成功。

examples.en: a sensational 6-0 victory
examples.zh: 轰动性的6比0大胜

words.definition: A filmy fabric or substance is very thin and almost transparent; thin, hazy
words.translation: 薄膜的, 朦胧的；朦胧的；薄膜的；薄的

examples.en: ...filmy nightgowns.
examples.zh: ...薄薄的睡衣。

words.definition: pale in colour and shiny, like a pearl; precious, golden
words.translation: 珍珠似的；珍贵的；生产珍珠的；用珍珠装饰的

examples.en: pearly white teeth
examples.zh: 珍珠般洁白的牙齿

examples.en: a pearly grey jacket
examples.zh: 带珍珠光泽的灰色短外套

words.definition: if the police arrest someone, the person is taken to a  police station  because the police think they have done something illegal; absorb, attract, engage, dispute, draw; prison, imprisonment
words.translation: 逮捕, 拘留；[法]逮捕；阻止；吸引；监禁

examples.en: He was arrested and charged with murder.
examples.zh: 他遭到逮捕并被指控谋杀。

examples.en: I got arrested for careless driving.
examples.zh: 我因鲁莽驾驶被捕。

words.definition: by or to everyone in the nation; countrywide
words.translation: 全国性地, 在全国范围内；全国性地；以国民立场地；举国一致地

examples.en: a nationally recognised qualification
examples.zh: 国家认可的资格

examples.en: The programme will be broadcast nationally.
examples.zh: 该节目将在全国播出。

words.definition: feeling tired and not interested in things; languid, downhearted
words.translation: 倦怠的, 冷漠的；倦怠的；无精打采的；百无聊赖的

examples.en: The heat was making me listless.
examples.zh: 炎热的天气使我懒洋洋的。

words.definition: high up in the air; above, overhead; onto, upon, up; superincumbent, pinnacled
words.translation: 在高处, 在上；在空中；在高处；在上面；在…之上；在…顶上；在空中的；在高处的；在上面的

examples.en: But in the stratosphere they can stay aloft for years, spread by fast winds known as jets, meaning the threat is global.
examples.zh: 但在平流层，它们可以在高处停留数年，高速的风对其进行传播，这意味着全球都受到了威胁。

words.definition: a large farm in Spanish-speaking countries; latifundia, estancia
words.translation: 庄园；大庄园

examples.en: ...an old colonial coffee hacienda in the Andes.
examples.zh: ...安第斯山脉中的一个殖民地时代的老咖啡种植园。

words.translation: 含糊的，不明确的

examples.en: Describe project deliverables in the vaguest possible terms so sponsors and reviewers have plenty of leeway to reinvent the project outputs repeatedly as the project unfolds.
examples.zh: 用尽可能模糊的语言描述项目可交付成果，让发起人及审核者随着项目的开展，能有足够的空间不断地重新定义项目成果。

words.definition: equipment, supply, arm, setup; providing, equipping
words.translation: 供给(装备)；供给；装备；服饰；家俱；陈设（furnish的ing形式）

words.definition: a mistake in which you forget something or do not notice something; supervision, surveillance
words.translation: 疏忽,  看管；监督，照管；疏忽

examples.en: I assure you that this was purely an oversight on my part.
examples.zh: 我向你保证，这纯粹是我的一时疏忽。

words.definition: someone who has been a soldier, sailor etc in a war; old moustache, warhorse; seasoned
words.translation: 老兵,老手；经验丰富的；老兵；老手；富有经验的人；老兵的

examples.en: a Vietnam veteran
examples.zh: 越战老兵

words.definition: a person, plant, animal, etc, that stings or hurts; cocktail
words.translation: 刺激者, 讽刺者；讽刺者；好讽刺人的人；有刺的动物；鸡尾酒

words.definition: to cover an area with a large amount of water; flood, flow
words.translation: 淹没；泛滥；浸水；（洪水般的）扑来

examples.en: The tidal wave inundated vast areas of cropland.
examples.zh: 海啸淹没了大片农田。

words.definition: covered with dust
words.translation: 满是灰尘的, 粉状的

examples.en: Adrian cycled along the dusty road.
examples.zh: 阿德里安沿着满是尘土的路骑自行车。

examples.en: Everything’s really dusty.
examples.zh: 所有东西都布满灰尘。

words.definition: to be enough; content, gratify; serve, be in a position
words.translation: 足够；使满足；足够…用；合格；有能力

examples.en: A light lunch will suffice .
examples.zh: 简单的午餐就够了。

words.definition: reflet, shine; lamp, brighten up
words.translation: 光彩, 光泽；[光]光泽；光彩；[光]有光泽；发亮

examples.en: Then it’s really no more than a means of transportation, it too loses its luster.
examples.zh: 然后它就仅仅是一个名符其实的交通工具，失去了它的光彩。

examples.en: College graduates may be losing some of their luster for reasons beyond technology and trade.
examples.zh: 大学毕业生也许会因为技术和贸易之外的原因失去一些光彩。

examples.en: No one knows for sure when the tide started to turn, or the exact moment when American gold started its slow but seemingly irreversible loss of luster.
examples.zh: 无人确切知晓这波潮汐的消退始于何时，也没有人精确的得知美金的光泽从何时起开始缓慢，但不可逆转的褪色。

words.definition: small things used in the home, for example plates, lamps etc, or the department of a large shop that sells these things
words.translation: 家用器皿

examples.en: The houses were left in haste and all the things were abandoned. It is so strange to see pieces of furniture, housewares and numerous photos with no people around.
examples.zh: 匆忙中人们抛下了房子，任何东西都不可以带走。在空无一人的地方看着这些家具、生活用品和照片，感觉是如此诡异。

examples.en: It is so strange to see pieces of furniture housewares and numerous photos with no people around.
examples.zh: 在空无一人的地方看着这些家具、生活用品和照片，感觉是如此诡异。

words.definition: a pipe that carries rainwater away from the roof of a building; watershoot, cesspipe
words.translation: 排水管；瘦裤腿（口语，单复数相同）

examples.en: He evaded police by climbing through a window and shinning down a drainpipe.
examples.zh: 他翻窗从排水管爬下，从而躲过了警察。

words.definition: things that you throw away, such as empty bottles, used papers, food that has gone bad etc; refuse, garbage, waste, junk, rubbish; slough off, reject
words.translation: 垃圾, 废物；垃圾；废物；丢弃；修建树枝

examples.en: Will someone take out the trash (= take it outside the house ) ?
examples.zh: 谁把垃圾拿出去好吗？

examples.en: Just put it in the trash .
examples.zh: 就把它扔到垃圾桶里吧。

words.translation: 黏土制品

words.definition: full of unwanted wild plants; scraggy, emaciated
words.translation: 杂草多的；瘦弱的；似杂草的；尽是杂草的

examples.en: We pulled into the weedy parking lot.
examples.zh: 我们开进了杂草丛生的停车场。

words.definition: in stories, a woman who has a fish’s tail instead of legs and who lives in the sea; sea-maiden
words.translation: 美人鱼；美人鱼（传说中的）；女子游泳健将

examples.en: But the little mermaid had no occasion to do this, for the polypi sprang back in terror when they caught sight of the glittering draught, which shone in her hand like a twinkling star.
examples.zh: 可是小人鱼没有这样做的必要，固为当珊瑚虫一看到这亮晶晶的药水——它在她的手里亮得像一颗闪耀的星星——的时候，它们就在她面前惶恐地缩回去了。

words.definition: a male deer
words.translation: 雄赤鹿

words.definition: a regularly repeated tune, often with many words sung on one note, especially used for religious prayers; spiritual, motet; sing; sing, descant
words.translation: 圣歌；赞美诗；唱；诵扬；唱歌；反覆地唱歌

examples.en: ...a Gregorian chant.
examples.zh: …一首格列高利圣歌。

words.definition: a public square or market place surrounded by buildings, especially in towns in Spanish-speaking countries; exchanges, square
words.translation: 广场，集市；广场；市场，购物中心

examples.en: Across the busy plaza, vendors sell hot dogs and croissant sandwiches.
examples.zh: 忙碌的露天广场对面，小贩们在卖热狗和新月形面包三明治。

words.definition: to kill someone – used especially in newspapers; kill, strike down
words.translation: 杀死，宰杀；杀害，杀死；使禁不住大笑；杀死，杀害；残杀

examples.en: ...the hill where St. George slew the dragon.
examples.zh: …圣乔治屠龙之丘。

words.definition: wrong, in error
words.translation: 虚伪地,  错误地；错误地；虚伪地；不实地

examples.en: She apologized for accusing him falsely.
examples.zh: 她为错误地咒骂他而道歉。

examples.en: One achievement often falsely attributed to Franklin, however, is that he discovered electricity.
examples.zh: 一项被错误地归功于富兰克林的成就，便是他发现了电。

words.definition: urgent, sudden, instant, unexpected
words.translation: 紧急的；浮现的；意外的；自然发生的

examples.en: Discovering these patterns is the key to emergent design.
examples.zh: 发现这些模式是紧急设计的关键。

examples.en: The real trick in emergent design is discovering these patterns.
examples.zh: 紧急设计的真正诀窍就是发现这些模式。

words.definition: property in land
words.translation: 土地所有；土地所有权

examples.en: This may be partly for fear of making a near-reality of private landownership, which would undermine one of the last vestiges of the party’s communist heritage.
examples.zh: 这要部分归结于中共害怕在实际上造成土地私有制之嫌，因为这样会摧毁其共产主义的最后一道防线。

examples.en: In tiptoeing gingerly around one of the last Maoist shibboleths-collective landownership-the party may yet be sowing the seeds of the rural transformation it promises.
examples.zh: 土地集体所有制毛派最后的几个堡垒之一，中共小心翼翼地触到了它，中共兴许能在其承诺的农村转型中有所建树。

words.definition: concerned with the study of metaphysics; transnatural, preternatural
words.translation: 形而上学的, 纯粹哲学的；形而上学的；超自然的；玄学派诗歌的

examples.en: A lot of scientists don’t like discussing metaphysical matters.
examples.zh: 很多科学家不喜欢讨论形而上学的东西。

words.definition: extremely weak; weak, small, thin
words.translation: 虚弱的, 衰弱的；微弱的，无力的；虚弱的；薄弱的

examples.en: His voice sounded feeble and far away.
examples.zh: 他的声音听上去既无力又遥远。

examples.en: She was too feeble to leave her room.
examples.zh: 她身体虚弱，无法走出自己的房间。

words.definition: very happy, or likely to make people very happy; glad, joyful
words.translation: 快乐的, 高兴的；令人高兴的；充满欢乐的（等于joyful）

examples.en: a joyous occasion
examples.zh: 欢乐的场合

examples.en: Our music is a joyous celebration of life.
examples.zh: 我们的音乐是对生活的欢乐颂扬。

words.definition: a forceful person expresses their opinions very strongly and clearly and people are easily persuaded by them; powerful, strong, tough, cogent, steel
words.translation: 有力的, 强烈的；强有力的；有说服力的；坚强的

examples.en: a forceful attack on government policy
examples.zh: 对政府政策的有力抨击

words.definition: when someone is unwilling to do something, or when they do something slowly to show that they are not very willing; magnetic resistance, magnetoresistance
words.translation: 不愿, 勉强；[电磁]磁阻；勉强；不情愿

examples.en: Wells finally agreed, but with reluctance.
examples.zh: 韦尔斯最终同意了，但很勉强。

words.definition: an agreement between two people to marry, or the period of time they are engaged; date, word, contract
words.translation: 约会, 婚约；婚约；约会；交战；诺言

examples.en: Their engagement was announced in the paper.
examples.zh: 他们订婚的消息在报上公布了。

examples.en: Tony was stunned when Lisa suddenly broke off their engagement (= finished it ).
examples.zh: 托尼对莉萨突然解除他俩的婚约感到震惊。

words.definition: to say very strongly that what you are saying is true; plight one's troth, cross my heart; plight one's troth, take an oath; juration, oath
words.translation: 宣誓, 发誓；发誓；咒骂；发誓，宣誓；诅咒；宣誓

examples.en: I never touched your purse, I swear!
examples.zh: 我绝对没有碰过你的钱包，我发誓！

examples.en: I never touched her, I swear to God .
examples.zh: 我从未碰过她，我敢向上帝起誓。

examples.en: I think it was about ten o’clock when we left, but I couldn’t swear to it (= I am not certain ) .
examples.zh: 我想我们离开时大约10点，但我不能肯定。

words.definition: someone’s lover is the person they are having a sexual relationship with but who they are not married to; fan, hon
words.translation: 爱人, 爱好者；爱人，恋人；爱好者

examples.en: He killed his wife’s lover.
examples.zh: 他杀了妻子的情人。

examples.en: Nicola and I were lovers.
examples.zh: 我和尼古拉以前是情人。

examples.en: a pair of young lovers
examples.zh: 一对年轻的情侣

words.definition: soubriquet, sobriquet
words.translation: 绰号, 称号；绰号；浑名

examples.en: But it is impossible to predict the reaction of a man accosted by another with the words "you rat" without referring to the meaning that the man spoken to attaches to the epithet.
examples.zh: 但是，当你不带意识地，说出别人的绰号“老鼠”的时候，你还是无法预测这个人会有怎样的反应。

examples.en: My teen years were marked by the common epithet “Camel Jockey” and the hit AM radio song “Ahab the A-rab.”
examples.zh: “骆驼骑师” （Camel Jockey）和调幅电台的热门歌曲“Ahab the A-rab”是我青少年时代人们通用的绰号。

examples.en: For her part, though, Ono found the epithet less than distressing.
examples.zh: 不过，对于她来说，小野发现这一绰号决不她痛心。

words.definition: something collapsible can be folded so that it uses less space; folding, accordion
words.translation: 可折叠的;可拆卸的；可折叠的；可拆卸的

examples.en: a collapsible chair
examples.zh: 折叠式椅子

words.definition: dirty and untidy; shot, shabby
words.translation: 肮脏的，不洁的；破旧的；肮脏的；不整齐的

examples.en: a scruffy old pair of jeans
examples.zh: 一条不干净的旧牛仔裤

examples.en: scruffy shops
examples.zh: 凌乱的商店

words.definition: showing that you think someone or something is stupid or silly; sardonic, sneering
words.translation: 嘲笑的；嘲笑的，嘲弄的；可付之一笑的

examples.en: derisive laughter
examples.zh: 嘲讽的笑

words.definition: dirty or untidy; tight, scattered, dirty
words.translation: 肮脏的, 凌乱的；凌乱的，散乱的；肮脏的，污秽的；麻烦的

examples.en: a messy room
examples.zh: 凌乱的房间

examples.en: Sorry the place is so messy, I haven’t had time to clear up.
examples.zh: 对不起，这地方又脏又乱，我一直没时间打扫。

words.definition: great suffering that is caused for example by being very poor or very sick; smart, disaster, hurt, evil, grief
words.translation: 痛苦, 苦恼；痛苦，悲惨；不幸；苦恼；穷困

examples.en: What we are witnessing here is human misery on a vast scale.
examples.zh: 我们在这里所目睹的情景是许许多多的人都生活困苦。

examples.en: the misery of unemployment
examples.zh: 失业的痛苦

examples.en: the miseries of war
examples.zh: 战争造成的苦难

words.definition: consisting of many different small parts; incomplete, half
words.translation: 由碎片组成的；碎片的；不完全的；断断续续的

examples.en: a fragmentary account
examples.zh: 零星的叙述

words.translation: 可氧化的

examples.en: Description: Metal lumps or ingots, silver grey with metallic lustre , easily oxidizable in air.
examples.zh: 说明：金属锭或块，银灰色，有金属光泽，在空气中易氧化。

examples.en: The auto- oxidizable reaction of lipid is a complex organic chemistry reaction which do latent harm to humankind.
examples.zh: 脂质自动氧化反应是一个复杂的有机化学反应，同时给人带来潜在的危害。

examples.en: Gas distribution lines for NF3 service should be fabricated from compatible materials and thoroughly cleaned to remove any oxidizable material.
examples.zh: 用于NF3设施的气体分配管道应该采用相容的材料制造，并彻底清洁以去除任何可氧化材料。

words.translation: 二氟化物

examples.en: It reacts violently with oxygen difluoride and barium peroxide .
examples.zh: 一氧化碳同氟化氧、氧化钡会发生剧烈反应。

examples.en: Objective To investigate the feasibility of derivatized polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF) membrane used for solid phase sequencing of proteins and peptides.
examples.zh: 研究衍生聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF） 膜用于蛋白质及肽的固相序列测定的可行性。

words.definition: a greyish-white metallic element, occurring chiefly in zircon, that is exceptionally corrosion-resistant and has low neutron absorption. It is used as a coating in nuclear and chemical plants, as a deoxidizer in steel, and alloyed with niobium in superconductive magnets. Symbol: Zr; atomic no: 40; atomic wt: 91.224; valency: 2, 3, or 4; relative density: 6.506; melting pt: 1855±2°C; boiling pt: 4409°C
words.translation: 锆

examples.en: It has zirconium/hydrogen reaction rate and where it occurred, obviously about the same place. The percentage reaction.
examples.zh: 它有锆或氢的反应速率,它发生的位置，很明显是在同样位置,百分比反应。

examples.en: Gas reactors require enrichments in the order of up to 20%. So we need to fabricate the uranium into pellets which are clad in zirconium tubes which are placed into the reactor core.
examples.zh: 气体反应堆要求充实，以此能,达到20%，所以，我们需要制造出在芯块中的铀,那是锆管道的金属外壳,那被放置入一个反应堆核心里去。

words.definition: When the news media and the public show a lot of interest in something, you can say that it is receiving publicity; advertisement, propaganda, bill, regard, dissemination
words.translation: 公开；宣传，宣扬；广告；注意

examples.en: The case has generated enormous publicity in Brazil.
examples.zh: 这起犯罪事件已在巴西引起了公众的极大关注。

words.definition: a group of animals or plants that exists as a remnant of a formerly widely distributed group in an environment different from that in which it originated; widow lady, scrap
words.translation: 残遗物；寡妇；残余物，[生物]残余体；未亡人

words.definition: lightly, like a cork
words.translation: 毫不费力地, 轻易地；轻松地；毫不费劲地

words.definition: a defensible building or area is easy to protect against attack; vindicable
words.translation: 可防御的；可辩护的；可拥护的

words.definition: believing that you should live according to high standards and principles, even if they cannot really be achieved, or showing this belief; spiritualistic
words.translation: 理想主义的, 空想的；理想主义的；唯心论的；唯心主义者的；空想家的

examples.en: idealistic young doctors
examples.zh: 充满理想主义的年轻医生

examples.en: the idealistic values of the 1960s
examples.zh: 20世纪60年代的理想主义价值观

words.definition: a swelling on your skin containing clear liquid, caused, for example, by a burn or continuous rubbing; bubble, blain; light into, belabour
words.translation: 水泡；[医]水疱；[冶]气泡；砂眼；起泡剂；使起水泡；痛打；猛烈抨击

examples.en: New shoes always give me blisters.
examples.zh: 我穿新鞋脚上总是起泡。

words.definition: a very small statue that can be put on a table or shelf; figurine
words.translation: 小雕像

examples.en: The Prize consists of a statuette - “the Nkosi” - and 100,000 euros, which are to be awarded to a direct aid project in the spirit of the young winner’s efforts.
examples.zh: 奖品是一座价值100，000欧元的“恩科西”小雕像，该奖旨在嘉奖年轻获奖者在直接参与帮助事件上所付出的精神努力。

examples.en: Evidence also arrives in difficult-to-identify forms like a carved statuette, a belt, or a small vial of medicinal powder.
examples.zh: 到这儿的证物有时是种难以辨认的形式，像是刻过的雕像，皮带或是一小瓶药粉。

examples.en: It seems alive, and even this funny statuette seems to have a soul.
examples.zh: 这座城市看起来活力四射，甚至这座有趣的小塑像好像也有灵魂。

words.definition: a featureless place has no interesting parts to notice; indistinctive
words.translation: 无特色的, 平凡的；无特色的

examples.en: featureless plains
examples.zh: 毫无特色的平原

words.definition: a set of beliefs or principles; belief, teaching, doctrine, tenet, credo
words.translation: 信条；信条，教义

examples.en: It has never been weaker as a political creed .
examples.zh: 作为一种政治信条，它从来没有像现在这样衰微过。

examples.en: a religious creed
examples.zh: 宗教信条

examples.en: people of all colours and creeds
examples.zh: 各种肤色和信仰的人

words.definition: scattered, serrate
words.translation: 零乱的, 锯齿状的；凸凹不平的；锯齿状的；散乱的

examples.en: his scraggly gray beard
examples.zh: 他那散乱的灰白胡子

words.definition: eagerness to do something, especially to achieve a particular religious or political aim; passion, flame, fire, warmth, fervor
words.translation: 热心, 热情；热情；热心；热诚

examples.en: ...his zeal for teaching.
examples.zh: …他对教学的热衷。

words.definition: careless and done too quickly; brief, careless
words.translation: 匆促的；草率的；粗心的，马虎的

examples.en: a very slapdash piece of work
examples.zh: 干得非常马虎的工作

words.definition: a small piece of metal, cloth, or plastic with a picture or words on it, worn to show rank, membership of a group, support for a political idea etc; marks, bedge
words.translation: 徽章, 证章；[轻]徽章；证章；标记

examples.en: We were each handed a badge with our name on it.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都拿到一个徽章，上面有我们的名字。

words.definition: A shrubby plant is like a shrub; fruticose
words.translation: 灌木的；灌木繁茂的；灌木一般的

examples.en: ...a shrubby tree.
examples.zh: ...一棵灌木状的树木。

words.definition: very cruel and violent; wild, cruel, inhuman
words.translation: 残忍的, 兽性的；残忍的；野蛮的，不讲理的

examples.en: a brutal man
examples.zh: 一个凶残的男人

words.definition: Something that impinges on you affects you to some extent; knock against, to infringe on; impact, strike
words.translation: 撞击；侵犯

examples.en: ...the cuts in defence spending that have impinged on two of the region's largest employers.
examples.zh: ...已经对该地区两个最大雇主产生重大影响的防御开支消减。

words.translation: 褴褛的,灌木丛生的
[化]黄素, 四羟酮醇

words.definition: the side of a mountain; hillside, brae
words.translation: 山腹, 山腰；山腰；山坡

examples.en: Great rocks rolled down the mountainside.
examples.zh: 巨大的岩石顺着山坡滚落下来。

words.definition: sundried, sun-cured
words.translation: 晒干的；日晒的

examples.en: Even if the air stays bitterly cold, these sunbaked rocks can warm enough to melt whatever tiny patches of snow have escaped the thirsty wind.
examples.zh: 即使空气十分寒冷，这些裸晒的岩石仍然能有足够的热量去融化那些在饥渴的风里逃过一劫的小雪块。

words.definition: a formal statement saying that something is true, especially one a  witness  makes in a court of law; proof, witness
words.translation: 证词, 宣言；[法]证词，证言；证据

examples.en: Barker’s testimony is crucial to the prosecution’s case.
examples.zh: 巴克的证词对控方的指控起到了关键作用。

examples.en: In his testimony, he denied that the company had ignored safety procedures.
examples.zh: 他在证词中否认公司忽视了安全程序。

words.definition: aluminium oxide, AlO
words.translation: [化]氧化铝(亦称矾土)；[无化]氧化铝；矾土

examples.en: Methods outlined in the monograph include: use of crushed clay pots, bone charcoal, contact precipitation, or use of activated alumina (absorptive filter).
examples.zh: 专著中概述的方法包括：使用粗砂壶、骨炭、接触沉淀，或使用活性氧化铝（吸收型过滤器）。

words.definition: nice, slight
words.translation: 毛一般的, 细微的；毛发似的；细微的；细长的

examples.en: In this depiction of the rod-shaped E. coli, two flagella trail from one end while hairlike pili surround a capsule full of tangled nucleoids.
examples.zh: 在创作这个杆状的大肠杆菌时，其表现出的形式为一端甩出两条鞭毛，同时细微的菌毛围绕在布满凌乱菌核的荚膜上。

examples.en: Lungs are more complex than either of these organs, containing several different cell types that form delicate, hairlike capillaries and a maze of branching air sacs.
examples.zh: 但是肺的复杂性要超过这两种器官，肺里有几种不同的细胞，要分别形成细微的、头发丝一样的毛细血管，和迂回曲折的分支状的气囊。

words.definition: Dacromet, paintcoat
words.translation: 被覆, 衣料；[涂料]涂层；包衣；衣料

words.definition: very small – used especially in Scottish English; itty-bitty, teeny; little bit, smitch
words.translation: 很少的, 微小的；极小的；很早的；一点点

examples.en: My wee boy is three.
examples.zh: 我的小儿子三岁。

words.definition: an argument, plan etc that is watertight is made very carefully so that people cannot find any mistakes in it; invulnerable, unexceptionable
words.translation: 不漏水的, 无懈可击的；水密的；[建]不漏水的；无懈可击的

examples.en: Lucky for him, his alibi is watertight.
examples.zh: 算他走运，不在犯罪现场的证据无懈可击。

examples.en: Unless the ban is watertight, EU laws will overturn it.
examples.zh: 这条禁令除非是十分严密，否则会被欧盟法律推翻。

words.definition: the belief that your actions should be based on scientific thinking rather than emotions or religious beliefs
words.translation: 理性主义, 唯理论

examples.en: philosophers who accept scientific rationalism
examples.zh: 接受科学唯理论的哲学家们

words.definition: intended, studied, designed, conscious, minded
words.translation: 任性的, 故意的；有意的；任性的；故意的

examples.en: There is a willful self-destructiveness in the air here as if America has all the time and money in the world for petty politics.
examples.zh: 这里的空气里中弥漫着一种故意自我毁灭的气息，为了狭隘的政治，美国好像在全世界有的是金钱和时间。

examples.en: Even the best ones can be foiled, though, by a sufficiently willful programmer committed to ignoring basic principles of memory management.
examples.zh: 但是，即使最优秀的编程人员也可能会被忽略内存管理基本原则的非常任性的编程人员搅乱。

words.definition: worthy of, claim, correspondence
words.translation: 价值,值得；值得；相当；有价值

examples.en: So we must ask what lends objective worthiness to a life outside the moral realm.
examples.zh: 所以在道德范畴之外，我们必须设问，是什么东西带给人生客观性的值得。

examples.en: Some find popularity and artistic worthiness to be opposites and therefore, reject bands that become successful.
examples.zh: 一些人发现流行程度和艺术价值是对立的，因此否定那些逐步成功的乐队。

examples.en: Barack and Michelle Obama are also a more fully fused political team than ever before, with no other jobs to distract them, no doubts about the worthiness of the pursuit dogging them.
examples.zh: 因为没有其他工作让他们分心，也毫不怀疑他们追求的事业的价值，所以巴拉克和米歇尔·奥巴马比以往任何时候都更加融洽。

words.definition: with very strong beliefs about what is right and wrong, especially when this makes you judge other people’s behaviour; didactic, homiletic
words.translation: 狭隘道德观的, 说教的；说教的；道学的；道德家的；注意道德的

examples.en: It’s difficult to talk to teenagers about drugs without sounding too moralistic.
examples.zh: 跟青少年谈论毒品，又不能有太重的说教味道，这是很难的。

words.definition: careful to do everything that it is your job or duty to do; serious, earnest
words.translation: 认真的，勤勤恳恳的；认真的；尽责的；本着良心的；小心谨慎的

examples.en: A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
examples.zh: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

examples.en: a conscientious and hard-working student
examples.zh: 勤勉刻苦的学生

words.definition: the way words are arranged to form sentences or phrases, or the rules of grammar which control this; grammar, phraseology
words.translation: 语法, 句法；语法；[计][语]句法；有秩序的排列

examples.en: His grammar and syntax, both in oral and written expression, were much better than the average.
examples.zh: 无论在口头还是笔头上，他的语法和句法都非常出众。

words.definition: ideas, opinions, statements etc that are not true or that seem very stupid; bullshit, kibosh; ridiculous, preposterous
words.translation: 胡说, 废话；胡说；废话；荒谬的

examples.en: ‘I’m a prisoner in my own home.’ ‘Nonsense!’
examples.zh: “我在自己家里就像个囚犯。”“胡说！”

examples.en: If you ask me, these modern teaching methods are a load of nonsense (= a lot of nonsense ).
examples.zh: 要我说，这些现代教学方法全是一派胡言。

examples.en: He was talking utter nonsense as usual.
examples.zh: 他像平常一样又在胡说八道了。

words.definition: row, sound
words.translation: 大声, 喧闹；[声]响度；吵闹

words.definition: if something terminates, or if you terminate it, it ends; fulfill, drop, kill; result, drop, determine, pass, set; ended, closing, over, past, concluding
words.translation: 停止, 终止；使终止；使结束；解雇；结束，终止；结果；结束的

examples.en: The court ruled that the contract must be terminated.
examples.zh: 法庭裁决该合同必须终止。

examples.en: a woman’s decision on whether or not to terminate the pregnancy
examples.zh: 女子关于是否终止妊娠的决定

words.definition: very active, happy, and wanting to have fun; jestful, humorous
words.translation: 爱玩耍的；幽默的；开玩笑的；爱嬉戏的

examples.en: a playful little dog
examples.zh: 活泼的小狗

examples.en: Babies are playful and alert when they first wake up.
examples.zh: 宝宝们刚醒来的时候很好动，而且反应敏捷。

words.definition: when a process is not continuous; break, non-sequence
words.translation: 不连续, 中断；[数]不连续；中断；间断性；断绝

examples.en: discontinuity in economic development
examples.zh: 经济发展的间断性

words.definition: boring or ordinary; ordinary, stock, stupid
words.translation: 单调乏味的,平淡的；平凡的，乏味的；散文体的

examples.en: a prosaic writing style
examples.zh: 乏味的写作风格

examples.en: The reality, however, is probably more prosaic.
examples.zh: 然而，事实很可能更平淡无奇。

words.definition: the practice of treating one person or group differently from another in an unfair way; distinction, differentiation
words.translation: 歧视；辨别力；区别，辨别；识别力

words.definition: the state or condition of being central; focus, hub, middle
words.translation: 中心, 中央；中心；中央；向心性

examples.en: Our bodies have no centrality either.
examples.zh: 我们的身体也没有中心。

examples.en: Our bodies have no centrality either.
examples.zh: 我们的身体也同样没有中心。

examples.en: In his own writings Obama stresses the centrality of his father not only to his beliefs and values but to his very identity.
examples.zh: 在自己的著作中，奥巴马强调父亲的中心地位不仅在于其信仰和价值观，还在于对他的极大认同。

words.definition: always wanting more and more of something; sateless, avaricious
words.translation: 不知足的, 贪求无厌的；贪得无厌的；不知足的

examples.en: A section of the reading public has an insatiable appetite for dirty stories about the famous.
examples.zh: 阅读大众中有一部分人对名人的风流韵事的欲望总是无法满足。

words.definition: You use prospective to describe someone who wants to be the thing mentioned or who is likely to be the thing mentioned; expected, due, future; outlook, expectation
words.translation: 预期的；未来的；预期；展望

examples.en: The story should act as a warning to other prospective buyers.
examples.zh: 这篇报道应该可以对其他可能的购买者起到警告作用。

words.definition: to confuse someone; bemuddle, enchant
words.translation: 使迷惑，使难住；使迷惑，使不知所措

examples.en: He was bewildered by his daughter’s reaction.
examples.zh: 他被女儿的反应弄糊涂了。

words.definition: when something blocks a road, passage, tube etc, or the thing that blocks it; intervention, prevention, let, bar, dam
words.translation: 阻塞, 妨碍；障碍；[化学]阻碍；妨碍

examples.en: an operation to remove an obstruction from her throat
examples.zh: 去除她喉咙里阻塞物的手术

examples.en: Police can remove a vehicle that is causing an obstruction.
examples.zh: 警察有权把造成阻塞的车辆移走。

words.definition: to obtain something, especially something that is difficult to get; earn, buy, score, find, result in; bite on, to acquire
words.translation: 获得, 取得；获得，取得；导致；取得

examples.en: It remained very difficult to procure food, fuel, and other daily necessities.
examples.zh: 当时仍然很难获得食品、燃料和其他日用必需品。

words.definition: If something is subsidiary, it is less important than something else with which it is connected; assistant, helping, affiliated, auxiliary; auxiliary, subcompany
words.translation: 辅助的, 补充的；附属的；辅助的；子公司；辅助者

examples.en: The marketing department has always played a subsidiary role to the sales department.
examples.zh: 营销部一直都扮演着销售部的辅助角色。

words.definition: corruption, rottenness
words.translation: 腐败, 腐败物；[生化]腐败；腐败物

examples.en: The time consuming process for making processed meats creates high bacteria counts and putrefaction in the meat which need to be treated with chemicals.
examples.zh: 在加工面粉的时会产生大量细菌，还有腐败的肉制品需要用化学物品来处理。

words.definition: the process of heating beverages, such as milk, beer, wine, or cider, or solid foods, such as cheese or crab meat, to destroy harmful or undesirable microorganisms or to limit the rate of fermentation by the application of controlled heat
words.translation: 加热杀菌法, 巴斯德杀菌法

words.definition: the season when it is summer
words.translation: 夏季

examples.en: It's a very beautiful place in the summertime.
examples.zh: 这里夏季时很美。

words.definition: disaster, fusion, tragedy, calamity
words.translation: 彻底垮台；灾难；熔化；暴跌

words.definition: any salt of chloric acid, containing the monovalent ion ClO3
words.translation: [化]氯酸盐

examples.en: Electricity is the main material for chlorate production.
examples.zh: 电是生产氯酸盐的主要原料。

examples.en: Happened to have some sodium chlorate lying around from a hot tub we just picked up.
examples.zh: 碰巧有一些氯酸钠从热躺在浴缸，我们拿起左右。

examples.en: Sodium chlorate is a kind of mineral salt which has wide use in bleaching, dyeing, etc.
examples.zh: 氯酸钠是一种用途广泛的无机盐，是制备二氧化氯的重要原料。

words.definition: a place where roads, lines etc cross each other, especially where two roads meet; junction, chiasm
words.translation: 交集, 交叉点；交叉；[交]十字路口；交集；交叉点

examples.en: We crossed at a busy intersection.
examples.zh: 我们穿过了一个繁忙的道路交叉口。

words.definition: a person who or animal that steps, esp a horse or a dancer; dancer
words.translation: 行走的人或动物, 跳舞者；跳舞者；花很多时间参加社交活动的学生；以特殊姿态行走的人或动物；分档器

words.definition: something that you think is true, even though you are not certain and cannot prove it; speculation, theory, perhaps, eye, assumption
words.translation: 假定, 想象；假定；推测；想像；见解

examples.en: His version of events is pure supposition .
examples.zh: 他对事情的说法纯属推测。

words.definition: flatness, evenness
words.translation: 平坦， 光滑；平滑；柔滑；平坦

examples.en: Feel the cold, glass-like smoothness and the crevices and lines that make me what I am.
examples.zh: 感觉玻璃般的冰冷与光滑，以及其中的裂缝和刮痕，感受我的存在。

examples.en: Doing this gives the fire more shape and smoothness, as well as giving an indication of heat and movement.
examples.zh: 这样做能让火焰的形状更多变且更平滑，也是热量和动态的象征。

examples.en: The team took into consideration the effects increased smoothness could have on flight stability, he said, and therefore developed a patented technology for adding grooves into the panels of the ball.
examples.zh: 该工程组还把增加平滑度对球的射出稳定性的影响考虑在内，凯恩补充道，因此要开发一个能把槽沟加入球表的新技术才行。

words.definition: perpendicularly
words.translation: 垂直地

examples.en: Well, we cut it into vertically simple pieces.
examples.zh: 我们把它分割为垂直简单的部分。

examples.en: For instance, say your application requires a container that vertically stacks display objects but without any gap in between.
examples.zh: 比方说，您的应用程序要求一个容器能够垂直堆叠显示对象而不在其间留空隙。

examples.en: This will ensure that all of the areas you add to this UI are arranged vertically in one column.
examples.zh: 这将确保向这个 UI 添加的所有区域都将被垂直地组织到一个列内。

words.definition: disruption, fragmentation
words.translation: 两分, 二分法；[生物]二分法；两分；分裂；[植]双歧分枝

examples.en: There is a natural dichotomy between the two sides of one’s personality that is usually displayed between the different types of social groups with which an individual may identify oneself.
examples.zh: 在一个人性格的这两方面之间，存在着一种自然的两分法。 个人的性格一般就体现在这一个人所可能认同的不同社会群体之间。

words.definition: a special tool with two blades, used for cutting small pieces from something; shear, prahu
words.translation: 大剪刀, 快速帆船修剪者；快速帆船；大剪刀；剪削者；理发剪

examples.en: nail clippers
examples.zh: 指甲剪

words.definition: land that is fruitful produces a lot of crops; productive, prolific
words.translation: 果实结得多的, 多产的；富有成效的；多产的；果实结得多的

words.definition: a piece of cloth with a coloured pattern or picture on it that represents a country or organization; fail, decay; emblemize; symbol, seal
words.translation: 旗，旗帜；标记；衰退；枯萎；插旗；标志；旗子

examples.en: Children waving flags greeted the Russian leader.
examples.zh: 孩子们挥舞着旗帜，欢迎俄罗斯领导人。

examples.en: the flag of Kenya
examples.zh: 肯尼亚国旗

examples.en: the Spanish flag
examples.zh: 西班牙国旗

words.definition: aural, auditive
words.translation: 听觉的, 声学的；[声]声学的；听觉的；音响的

examples.en: The ancient Greeks were aware of other acoustical principles, at least empirically.
examples.zh: 至少在实践上，古希腊人也知道其他的声学原理。

examples.en: And, of course, there's this-- another acoustical phenomenon here we've talked about before, what's the relationship within an octave?
examples.zh: 当然,就是这个,我们以前谈论过的,另一种声学现象,八度的内部联系是什么呢

words.definition: pots, pans, and other things used for cooking; cooking utensils, kitchen unit
words.translation: 厨房用具

examples.en: She has a huge amount of Victorian kitchenware.
examples.zh: 她拥有维多利亚时代的大量厨房用具。

words.definition: to frighten or threaten someone into making them do what you want; cow, to menace
words.translation: 胁迫；恐吓，威胁

examples.en: Attempts to intimidate her failed.
examples.zh: 恐吓她的企图失败了。

words.definition: ready or able to be used; useful, be of use
words.translation: 有用地，耐用的；有用的，可供使用的；耐用的

examples.en: Some of these old tools are still serviceable.
examples.zh: 这些旧工具有些仍可使用。

words.definition: similar to chalk or containing chalk
words.translation: 白垩的

examples.en: white chalky soil
examples.zh: 白色的白垩质土壤

examples.en: There were chalky bits in the bottom of the drink.
examples.zh: 饮料底层有粉笔灰一样的东西。

words.translation: 约克郡,约克夏(英国英格兰原郡名)

examples.en: WL: I think, Yorkshire and the New Forest.
examples.zh: 我想，是约克郡和新森林地区。

examples.en: Yorkshire puddings are an accompaniment to Sunday roasts; some would say the best part of the meal.
examples.zh: 约克郡布丁是周日烤肉的必备；有些人会说这是膳食中最好的一部分。

examples.en: Whether or not your Yorkshire puddings rise is the true test of your cooking ability.
examples.zh: 不管怎样，约克郡布丁是真正考验烹饪技能的一道点心。

words.definition: members of a royal family; crown, majesty
words.translation: 皇室, 王权；皇室；[税收]版税；王权；专利税

examples.en: At school the other children treated them like royalty .
examples.zh: 在学校里，其他孩子将他们奉若王族。

words.definition: known and admired by a lot of people, especially for a special skill, achievement, or quality; famous, noted, distinguished, celebrated, famed
words.translation: 有名的, 有声誉的；著名的；有声望的

examples.en: The area is renowned for its Romanesque churches.
examples.zh: 这个地区以其罗马式教堂闻名。

words.definition: deserving respect from people; valuable, matching; out-and-outer, dilly
words.translation: 值得的,有价值的；值得的；有价值的；配得上的，相称的；可尊敬的；应…的；杰出人物；知名人士

examples.en: Leeds United were worthy winners of the competition.
examples.zh: 利兹联队是比赛当之无愧的获胜者。

examples.en: a worthy opponent
examples.zh: 值得钦佩的对手

words.definition: Your kinfolk or kinsfolk are the people who are related to you; folk, family
words.translation: 亲属

examples.en: I sent my other son to the country to stay with kinfolk.
examples.zh: 我把另一个儿子送到乡下和亲戚住在一起。

examples.en: Poor Emily. Her kinsfolk should come to her.
examples.zh: 可怜的埃米莉，她的亲属应该到她这儿来。

words.definition: to help a speaker who pauses, by suggesting how to continue; rapid, fast, fly, forward, ready; facilitate, boost, further; cue, noting; punctually
words.translation: 推动；提示；敏捷的，迅速的；立刻的；[计]提示；促进；激起；（给演员）提白；付款期限；DOS命令：改变DOS系统提示符的风格；准时地

examples.en: ‘I can’t decide,’ said Beatrice. ‘Decide what?’ prompted Marlon.
examples.zh: “我决定不了。”比阿特丽斯说。“决定什么？”马龙追问道。

words.definition: dead, lifeless
words.translation: 无生命的, 非活体的；无生命的；非生物的

examples.en: In 1860 Louis Pasteur performed experiments that eventually disproved “spontaneous generation, ” the idea that life continually arose from nonliving things.
examples.zh: 1860年，路易斯巴斯德做了个实验，最终反驳了“自然发生说”，这一说认为生命源源不断于无生命的物体。

examples.en: But bully life reaches deeper and ties up the entire planet in the web of its network, also roping in the nonliving matrix of rock and gas into its coevolutionary antics.
examples.zh: 然而强悍的生命向更深处扎根，不但用它的网络将整个地球包裹起来，而且将没有生命的岩石和大气也串连进它的共同进化的怪诞行动之中。

examples.en: He could still recognize nonliving objects, like a flashlight, a compass, a kettle or a canoe.
examples.zh: 他可以分辨非生命体，例如：闪光灯、指南针、水壶或者小船。

words.definition: not affected or influenced by something and seeming not to notice it; unaffected, unmoved
words.translation: 不透的；不受影响的；不受影响的，无动于衷的；不能渗透的

examples.en: impervious volcanic rock
examples.zh: 不透水的火山岩

words.definition: something that is deceptive seems to be one thing but is in fact very different; artificial, lost, false
words.translation: 骗人的，造成假象的；欺诈的；迷惑的；虚伪的

examples.en: Some snakes move with deceptive speed (= move faster than you think or expect ) .
examples.zh: 有些蛇的爬行速度出乎意料地快。

examples.en: Gwen’s students may look angelic, but appearances can be deceptive .
examples.zh: 格温的学生也许看起来像天使，不过人不可貌相。

words.definition: a wide pan shaped like a bowl, used in Chinese cooking; hollowware
words.translation: 锅，炒菜锅；锅（源自广东话）；炒菜锅

examples.en: Then Ky-Phuong Luong, the T.A., stirred a wok full of vegetables and soy-marinated crickets, and Dunkel passed a plate of fritters with yellowish wax worms protruding from their centers.
examples.zh: 然后名叫罗芳婉的班主任老师炒了锅菜满是蔬菜和过了酱的蟋蟀，接着邓克尔端上一盘油炸面团，内馅儿是蜡蠕虫，一些淡黄的的蠕虫凸出面团。

words.definition: a statement or opinion judging the worth, value, or condition of something; evaluation, valuation, estimation, computation, assessment, calculation
words.translation: 估计, 评估；评价；[经管]估价（尤指估价财产，以便征税）；[数]估计

examples.en: What is needed in such cases is a calm appraisal of the situation.
examples.zh: 在此类情况下需要的是对形势的冷静估计。

words.definition: used to talk about the only person or thing in a place, or the only person or thing that does something; alone, single
words.translation: 孤独的，寂寞的；单身的；独自的；寂寞的；人迹稀少的

examples.en: A lone figure was standing at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 公交车站上站着一个孤单的身影。

examples.en: He was by no means a lone voice criticizing the government.
examples.zh: 批评政府的绝不止他一个人。

examples.en: a lone gunman
examples.zh: 独行持枪歹徒

words.definition: a person or organization that disagrees with an official decision or accepted opinion; anti, opponent
words.translation: 持异议者；反对者

examples.en: Political dissenters were imprisoned.
examples.zh: 持不同政见者遭到监禁。

words.definition: profit, apply
words.translation: 使习惯于；变得更有利；生效（等于innure）；有益；适用

words.definition: in a way that obeys rules, customs etc; accordance, unity, agreement, identity, consensus
words.translation: 一致, 符合；一致，适合；符合；相似

examples.en: We must act in conformity with local regulations.
examples.zh: 我们必须按当地的法规行事。

words.definition: a state or situation of complete agreement among a group of people; agreement, yes, Ok, leave, Okay
words.translation: 全体一致；同意，全体一致

examples.en: All decisions would require unanimity.
examples.zh: 所有决定都需要全体一致同意。

words.definition: relating to teaching methods or the practice of teaching
words.translation: 教学(法)的

examples.en: The school district provides training to help teachers improve their pedagogical methods.
examples.zh: 该学区提供培训以帮助教师们改进教学方法。

words.definition: ambulatory funnel, hyponome
words.translation: 单足跳者；[建]料斗；漏斗；跳虫

words.definition: to state publicly that something is true; declare, to be certain; recognize, confirm on
words.translation: 断言, 确认；肯定；断言；确认

examples.en: The general affirmed rumors of an attack.
examples.zh: 将军证实了袭击的传闻。

words.definition: systematacially
words.translation: 科学地, 系统地；系统地；合乎科学地；学问上

examples.en: He explained scientifically the most important questions of political economy.
examples.zh: 他科学地阐述了政治经济学中一些最重要的问题。

examples.en: The object of this society is to perfect its members practically and scientifically.
examples.zh: 这个社团的目的是实际地、科学地及充分地指导其成员。

words.definition: way of, manner, method, procedure, mode, approach, system
words.translation: 方法, 形式；方法，方式；程序，样式

examples.en: The problem is, I do not have any technique, process, or modus operandi.
examples.zh: 问题是，我不知道任何技巧、步骤或操作方式。

examples.en: No one could really agree the modus of search engine companies, but only few people express their discontentment.
examples.zh: 恐怕没有人真正会赞同搜索引擎公司的这种方法，但是极少人对它们表示不满。

examples.en: Yet as a blue-blooded politician from a hugely wealthy family, Hatoyama can hardly claim to represent a fresh alternative to Japan's political modus operandi.
examples.zh: 然而，作为一名出身于豪门富户的贵族政客，鸠山由纪夫几乎无法声称自己的胜选能代表着日本政治新的运作方式。

words.translation: 节省劳力的;省力气的

examples.en: The way to make self-sufficiency work on a small scale is to resist the temptation to buy a tractor and other expensive laborsaving devices.
examples.zh: 小范围里实现自给自足的途径是抵制诱惑，不去购置拖拉机和其他昂贵的节省劳力的机械。

words.definition: Spontaneity is spontaneous, natural behaviour; spontaneous generation, abiogenesis
words.translation: 自发性；自然发生

examples.en: He had the spontaneity of a child.
examples.zh: 他有孩子般的自然举动。

words.definition: You can say that something is respectable when you mean that it is good enough or acceptable; venerable, honourable
words.translation: 可敬的；有身价的；值得尊敬的；人格高尚的；相当数量的

examples.en: ...investments that offer respectable and highly attractive rates of return.
examples.zh: …提供不错的、极具吸引力的回报率的投资。

words.definition: A paperback is a book with a thin cardboard or paper cover. Compare .
words.translation: 平装本, 纸面本

examples.en: She said she would buy the book when it comes out in paperback.
examples.zh: 她说等那本书的平装本面市后她会买一本。

words.definition: a narrow band of strong material that is used to fasten, hang, or hold onto something; to fasten something or someone in place with one or more straps; restrict, hold in; belt, band, strip
words.translation: 带, 皮带；用带捆扎；用带捆绑；用皮条抽打；约束；带；[机]皮带；磨刀皮带；鞭打

examples.en: a bra strap
examples.zh: 胸罩肩带

examples.en: The strap of my bag is broken.
examples.zh: 我包上的带子断了。

words.definition: Topical is used to describe something that concerns or relates to events that are happening at the present time; partial, regional, local
words.translation: 有关时事的；局部的；论题的；时事问题的；局部地区的

examples.en: The newscast covers topical events and entertainment.
examples.zh: 该新闻广播涉及时事和娱乐。

words.definition: to say something suddenly and loudly because you are surprised, angry, or excited; bay, shout
words.translation: 呼喊, 惊叫；呼喊，惊叫；大声叫嚷

examples.en: ‘No!’ she exclaimed in shock.
examples.zh: “不！”她惊呼道。

words.definition: a machine part consisting of a wheel or bar with teeth on it, which allows movement in only one direction; rachet; get loose
words.translation: 棘轮, 棘齿；[机]棘轮；棘齿；安装棘轮于；松脱

examples.en: The chair has a ratchet below it to adjust the height.
examples.zh: 这把椅子下面有一个棘轮来调整高度。

words.definition: to make someone feel ashamed or stupid, especially when other people are present; make a chump out of
words.translation: 羞辱, 使丢脸；羞辱；使…丢脸；耻辱

examples.en: Her boss humiliated her in front of all her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她的老板在所有同事面前羞辱了她。

words.definition: the passage of electricity through wires, heat through metal, water through pipes etc
words.translation: 传导

examples.en: Temperature becomes uniform by heat conduction until finally a permanent state is reached.
examples.zh: 通过热传导，温度变得一致，直到最终达到一个恒定状态。

words.definition: without giving clear or exact details; uncertainly, faintly
words.translation: 不确定地；不确定地，无限期地；模糊地，不明确地

examples.en: It can give you the ability to store indefinitely your session data where it can be retrieved not only after a restart, but from any of a number of machines in a cluster.
examples.zh: 它可以给予您无限地存储会话数据的能力，使您的会话数据不仅可以在重新启动后检索，还可以从群集中许多机器中的任意一个检索。

examples.en: Assuming the systems keep operating, like I've said, we can command the vehicle from the ground and operate it fine, and remain on orbit indefinitely.
examples.zh: 假定系统继续运行，我和所说的那样，我们可以很好地从地面指挥和操作飞船，使它无限期地留在轨道上。

words.definition: not being used, or never used; left-off
words.translation: 不用的；未消耗的；从未用过的

examples.en: unused land
examples.zh: 闲置的土地

words.definition: a wing or flat winglike process or structure, such as a part of some bones and cartilages; wing, pennon

examples.zh: 他迷了路，找车站花了几个小时，总之过了午夜才到家。

examples.zh: 如果现在我向下滚动到实际的执行中，这个是可用的还是不可用的呢？

words.definition: able to be used for many different purpose

examples.zh: 轻松的音乐

examples.en: Often, the target is created when the consolidation pattern is first applied so that no access controls preexist and possibly need to be defined.
examples.zh: 通常在首次应用整合模式时创建目标，这样不存在任何访问控制，所以可能需要对其进行定义。

examples.zh: 所以，简化论倾向于忽略可能原先就在更次层物质存在的触发秩序、样式之类的相互作用。

examples.en: The distinction between content and expression is always real, in various ways, but it cannot be said that the terms preexist their double articulation.
examples.zh: 从各种方式看，内涵与表白之间的区别总是真实，但是我们不能因此就说，这些术语存在先于双重表达。

words.definition: starting to happen or exist; earlier, young
words.translation: 初期的,初始的；初期的；[生物]初始的；起初的；发端的

examples.en: a sign of incipient madness
examples.zh: 精神失常的早期征兆

words.definition: metamorphic rock is formed by the continuous effects of pressure, heat, or water; turned, abnormal
words.translation: 变质的,变性的；变质的；变性的；变态的

examples.en: This metamorphic rock has been compressed for millions of years.
examples.zh: 这种变质岩已经过数百万年的压缩。

words.definition: a hard surface or path at the side of a street for people to walk on; pavement, footpath
words.translation: 人行道；[交]人行道

examples.en: A child was toddling along the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 一个小孩正沿着人行道蹒跚行走。

examples.en: The blind man tapped his cane on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 盲人用手杖敲击人行道。

examples.en: Then I noticed he was on the sidewalk behind me.
examples.zh: 然后在人行道上我注意到他在我后面。

words.definition: calumniatory, defamatory
words.translation: 诽谤的,损害名誉的；诽谤的；损害名誉的；用言语中伤他人的

examples.en: An alternative to monetary damages is an injunction prohibiting publication of the allegedly libelous material.
examples.zh: 除经济赔偿之外的另一种做法是颁布禁令，禁止发表被指称诽谤的材料。

examples.en: This borderline-libelous MTV advert produced for World Aids Day highlights how your partner's past conquests may come back to haunt them, and you.
examples.zh: 这则疑似诽谤的MTV广告为世界艾滋病日而作。 它强调了你以往的交往对象们也许会困扰你们。

words.definition: someone who buys and sells things such as  share s  in companies or foreign money for other people; booking agent, middleman
words.translation: 掮客, 经纪人；[经]经纪人，[劳经]掮客

examples.zh: 房地产经纪人

words.translation: /a(美国)华盛顿市(或州)人

words.translation: 追求轰动效应, 感觉论；追求轰动效应；哗众取宠

words.definition: having a strong pleasant smell; sweet, fragrant; scented plants, fragrances
words.translation: 芬芳的；[助剂]芳香的，芬芳的；芳香族的；[植]芳香植物；[助剂]芳香剂
