examples.zh: 芳香油

examples.en: aromatic herbs
examples.zh: 芳香草

words.definition: easy to recognize; obvious, distinct, visible, evident
words.translation: 明显的,不会弄错的；明显的；不会弄错的

examples.en: the unmistakable sound of gunfire
examples.zh: 清清楚楚的枪炮声

words.definition: very strange and unusual, and difficult to understand or explain; magic, mysterious, fantastic; fate, prediction, lot, destiny, fortune
words.translation: 怪异的, 超自然的, 不可思议的；怪异的；不可思议的；超自然的；（苏格兰）命运；预言

examples.en: A really weird thing happened last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚发生了一件非常奇怪的事。

examples.en: He’s a weird bloke.
examples.zh: 他是个古怪的家伙。

examples.en: They sell all sorts of weird and wonderful (= very strange ) products.
examples.zh: 他们出售各种稀奇古怪的产品。

words.definition: to give a flower or plant pollen so that it can produce seeds
words.translation: 对授粉

examples.en: flowers pollinated by bees
examples.zh: 由蜜蜂授粉的花

words.definition: a long specially prepared hard surface like a road on which aircraft land and take off; raceway, lanes
words.translation: 飞机跑道, 斜坡跑道, 河道；[航]跑道；河床；滑道

examples.en: The plane started taxiing down the runway.
examples.zh: 该飞机开始沿跑道滑行。

words.definition: too strong or powerful to be stopped or prevented; knock-down
words.translation: 不可抵抗的,不能压制的；不可抵抗的；不能压制的；极为诱人的

examples.en: I was overcome by an irresistible urge to cry.
examples.zh: 我控制不住想大哭一场。

words.definition: if something bad, such as crime or disease, is rampant, there is a lot of it and it is very difficult to control; angry, rude
words.translation: 猖獗的, 蔓生的；猖獗的；蔓延的；狂暴的；奔放的

examples.en: Pickpocketing is rampant in the downtown area.
examples.zh: 闹市区扒窃活动猖獗。

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["rampant inflation"]}
examples.zh: 失控的通货膨胀

words.definition: an animal or plant that is a mixture of breeds; cross breeding; hybrid, cowson
words.translation: [生物]杂种 v异种交配；杂交繁育；[遗]杂种

words.definition: brilliant, wonderful, excellent, famous, super
words.translation: 华丽的, 灿烂的；华丽的，灿烂的；极好的

examples.en: ‘What do you think of my new flatmate?’ ‘He’s absolutely gorgeous !’
examples.zh: “你觉得我的新室友怎么样？”“他帅极了！”

words.definition: when someone does something, or something happens, that affects your private life or activities in an unwanted way; penetration, effraction
words.translation: 闯入, 侵扰；[地质]侵入；闯入

examples.en: the unwelcome intrusion of the press
examples.zh: 不受欢迎的新闻界的侵扰

words.definition: when you press someone’s skin between your finger and thumb; harry, shear, crop; bit, ounce; save, economize on
words.translation: 捏, 撮 v夹痛,节省；捏；勒索；使苦恼；掐掉某物，修剪；匮乏；少量；夹痛；节省

examples.en: She gave him a playful pinch.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑地捏了他一把。

words.definition: to render inactive; deactivate
words.translation: 使不活泼, 阻止活动；使不活动；使不活泼；阻止活动

words.definition: lower, bemean; sink in the scale, lower down
words.translation: (使)降级, (使)堕落；贬低；使……丢脸；使……降级；使……降解；降级，降低；退化

examples.en: ...the notion that pornography degrades women.
examples.zh: …色情作品贬低妇女的这种看法。

words.translation: 授粉

examples.en: The new research provides early evidence that climate change may be playing a role in driving down pollination.
examples.zh: 这项新的研究提供了初步证据，气候变化可能是促使授粉减少的一个因素。

examples.en: They say there is risk of 'gene pollution' — where the inserted gene of GM plants affects non-target plants of similar kinds via pollination.
examples.zh: 他们说存在“基因污染”的危险——插入基因片段的转基因作物通过授粉途径对类似的非目标作物产生影响。

examples.en: This is sobering because it suggests that pollination is vulnerable even in a relatively pristine environment that is free of pesticides and human disturbance but still subject to climate change.
examples.zh: 这是发人深省的，它表明授粉过程极易被打乱，甚至在一个相对平静安定的环境，没有农药和人为干扰，但仍然受到气候变化的影响。

words.definition: If something can be easily recognized or identified, you can say that it is easily recognizable; identifiable, cognizable
words.translation: 可辨认的,可认识的；可辨认的；可认识的；可承认的

examples.en: The vault was opened and the body found to be well preserved, his features easily recognizable.
examples.zh: 地窖被打开了, 尸体被发现保存完好, 他的面容很容易辨认。

words.definition: reluctantly, grudgingly
words.translation: 不情愿地,勉强地；不情愿地；勉强地

examples.en: Even when I call, he receives unwillingly.
examples.zh: 即使我登门拜访， 他也是很不情愿地接待我。

examples.en: It is well to be reminded that Gandhi started out with the normal ambitions of a young Indian student and only adopted his extremist opinions by degrees and, in some cases, rather unwillingly.
examples.zh: 值得一提的是，甘地起初抱得是印度青年学生的正常的雄心，只是逐渐采用了他的那些偏激的思想，在某些情况下还相当不情愿。

words.definition: fairly, equally
words.translation: 公平地,无私地；公平地；无私地

examples.en: If she gets the nod, Kagan says she will consider every case impartially and with commitment to principle.
examples.zh: Kagan 说如果她能通过，她将公平地处理每个案子并忠于原则办事。

examples.en: In order for the independent director to exercise his rights impartially and equitably, nothing can go without a constraint mechanism in addition to above-mentioned incentive mechanism.
examples.zh: 为了让独立董事更公正与公平地履行他的职责, 除了上述的激励机制外, 一个有效的约束机制也是必不可少的.

words.definition: dosage, potion; take medicine; physic

examples.en: One dose of penicillin can wipe out the infection.
examples.zh: 一剂青霉素即可消除感染。

words.definition: reeducate
words.translation: 重新教育, 再教育；重新教育；再教育

examples.en: One solution is to retrain the long-term unemployed.
examples.zh: 一个解决办法是对长期失业的人进行再培训。

words.definition: unreasonably, preposterously
words.translation: 无理性地,不合理地；无理性地，不合理地

words.definition: You can describe something as a boon when it makes life better or easier for someone; behalf, welfare, sake, benefit, grace; good, bright, generous, handsome, fragrant
words.translation: 恩惠, 福利；恩惠；福利；利益；愉快的；慷慨的

examples.en: It is for this reason that television proves such a boon to so many people.
examples.zh: 正是这个原因电视机成为这么多人的一大福音。

words.definition: a system of government in which every citizen in the country can vote to elect its government officials
words.translation: 民主政治, 民主主义

examples.zh: 16年军人统治后民主制度的恢复

words.definition: inevitably, ineluctably
words.translation: 不可避免地,不得已地；不可避免地；不得已地

examples.zh: 阶级利益的冲突导致了无情的阶级斗争，从而不可避免地导致了最广大的、最受虐待的阶级，即无产阶级的胜利。

words.definition: someone who is not trained in a particular subject or type of work, especially when they are being compared with someone who is; layperson, lay people
words.translation: 外行；门外汉；俗人；一般信徒

examples.en: To the layman (= laymen in general ) all these plants look pretty similar.
examples.zh: 对外行的人来说，这些植物看起来都很相似。

examples.en: If you don’t understand what the doctor says, ask to have it explained in layman’s terms (= in simple language ).
examples.zh: 如果你听不懂医生的话，就请他用通俗易懂的语言来解释一下。

words.definition: a track on which runners or cars race; runway, lanes
words.translation: (主要用于赛马, 赛狗的)跑道；跑道；赛马场

examples.zh: …育马者杯比赛，于10月26日在芝加哥附近的阿灵顿赛马场举行。

examples.zh: 她丈夫个子不高，看上去很随和。

words.translation: 生育高峰中出生的人
月亮女神, 月亮

examples.zh: 这小说是一个奋斗者和探索者的传奇。

examples.en: I suppose every struggler in loneliness can see to it as a doctrine, as well as me.
examples.zh: 我觉得孤独的奋斗者都可以把它当成箴言，就像我这样的人。

words.translation: 光荣的,高贵的；光荣的；可敬的；高贵的

words.translation: 使怀孕, 使受精 a怀孕的, 充满的；[生理]使怀孕；灌输；浸透；充满的；[生理]怀孕的

examples.en: Undercover officers found drug-making equipment used to impregnate paper with LSD.
examples.zh: 卧底警官发现了用于使迷幻药渗入纸张的毒品制造设备。

words.definition: heart and hand, zealously
words.translation: 热心地,满腔热情地；热心地；满腔热情地

examples.en: The others barely glanced at it and went back to their shovels, almost enthusiastically, searching for the French Woman, but I went up to the body and forced myself to look at it closely.
examples.zh: 其他的人几乎连看都没看上一眼，就拿起他们的锹，差不多都很热心地去寻找那个法国女人的尸体，但我凑到那具尸体前，迫使我自己仔细地看看。

words.definition: consecutive numbers or periods of time follow one after the other without any interruptions; connected, coherent
words.translation: 连贯的,连续不断的；连贯的；连续不断的

examples.en: It had rained for four consecutive days.
examples.zh: 雨接连下了四天。

examples.en: Can they win the title for the third consecutive season?
examples.zh: 他们能连续第三个赛季赢得冠军称号吗？

words.definition: having very little food or money; poor, indigent
words.translation: 贫困的, 缺乏生活必需品的；贫困的；贫穷的；生活艰苦的

examples.zh: 贫困家庭

words.translation: 遗产, 遗赠；[法]遗产；遗赠

examples.zh: 五千美元的遗产

words.translation: 无儿女的；无子女的

examples.zh: 故意不要孩子的夫妇

examples.zh: 有关的角质层的其他部分呢？

examples.zh: 有关的角质层的其他部分呢？你应该关注什么？

examples.zh: 当陷阱阀门关闭的时候，植物在阀门周围的特殊角质层上分泌粘液，形成不透水密封垫。

words.definition: Something that is spiky has one or more sharp points; bitter, passionate
words.translation: 大钉似的, 尖刻的；大钉一般的；装有大钉的；尖刻的；易怒的；有穗的

examples.en: Her short spiky hair is damp with sweat.
examples.zh: 她又硬又直的短发被汗浸湿了。

words.definition: like wax, or made of wax; soft, tender, gray, ductile
words.translation: 象蜡的,苍白的, 柔软的,；柔软的；蜡色的；像蜡的；苍白的

examples.en: the waxy blossoms of the water lily
examples.zh: 睡莲那如蜡一般的花朵

examples.en: young men with waxy faces
examples.zh: 面如白蜡的青年男子

words.definition: unpalatable food tastes unpleasant; unsavoury, brackish
words.translation: 味道差的,难吃的；味道差的，难吃的；讨人厌的，使人不快的

examples.en: The unpalatable truth is that the team isn’t getting any better.
examples.zh: 让人难以接受的事实是这个队没有任何进步。

words.definition: the outside layer of your skin; epithelium, scarfskin
words.translation: [生]表皮, 上皮；上皮，[解剖][动]表皮

examples.en: The pigment in the upper layer of skin (epidermis) that gives your skin its normal color is called melanin.
examples.zh: 在浅层皮肤（表皮）中有种色素能让你的皮肤保持其正常的颜色，称为黑色素。

examples.en: Skin color is due to melanin, a pigment produced in the epidermis to protect us from the sun's potentially cancer-causing ultraviolet (UV) rays.
examples.zh: 这是一种产生于表皮的色素，能够保护我们免受来自紫外线的侵袭。 紫外线正是来自太阳的潜在致癌物。

words.definition: to prevent someone or something from moving; fix, nail
words.translation: 固定不动；使固定；使不动；使停止流通

examples.en: The broken limb must be immobilized immediately.
examples.zh: 断肢必须立即加以固定。

examples.en: She was immobilized with a broken leg.
examples.zh: 她的腿断了，不能行走。

words.definition: something that makes someone less likely to do something, by making them realize it will be difficult or have bad results; restraining, suppressing; preventer
words.translation: 威慑 a遏制的；遏制的，威慑的；制止的；威慑；妨碍物；挽留的事物

examples.en: The small fines for this type of crime do not act as much of a deterrent .
examples.zh: 对于这种罪行，小额罚金起不到多大的威慑作用。

examples.en: the deterrent effect of prison sentences
examples.zh: 监禁的威慑作用

words.definition: if insects, rats etc infest a place, there are a lot of them and they usually cause damage; harry, ply with

examples.zh: …像蚜虫那样大肆侵害谷类作物的害虫。

words.translation: 大牧场(或大农场)工人住的棚屋；牧场上工人的棚屋；牧场

words.definition: a serious disagreement between people, groups, or countries; separation, gap, violation, infringement; destroy, violate
words.translation: 破坏, 裂口 vt打破, 突破；违背，违反；缺口；违反，破坏；打破

examples.en: She wanted to help heal the breach between them.
examples.zh: 她想帮助他们修复破裂的关系。

words.definition: a stick of coloured  wax  or  chalk  that children use to draw pictures; pastels
words.translation: 有色粉笔, 蜡笔；[轻]蜡笔，有色粉笔

examples.en: He coloured the picture with crayon.
examples.zh: 他用蜡笔给画上色。

examples.en: They send letters — one time in crayon — detailing their rights and how I am violating some maritime treaty from the 1700s.
examples.zh: 他们寄信，有一次甚至是蜡笔写的，详细的描述了他们的权利和我如何违反了某些1700年代的海上条约。

words.definition: not knowing about possible problems or dangers, and therefore easily harmed or deceived; careless, sloppy
words.translation: 粗心的, 不警惕的；粗心的；不警惕的；不谨慎的

examples.zh: 毫无戒备的旅行者

words.translation: （拉）现代人的

examples.zh: 现代人是最值得注意的一个例外，致使一些科学家认为父道在培养孩子富有人情味方面起着重要作用。

examples.en: The human brain began much more activity in neural circuitry in the first year of life, which may have helped early homo sapiens survive in the process of natural selection, the study said.
examples.zh: 这份研究报告说，现代人的大脑在出生后第一年内开始发展较多的神经系统，这可能帮助早期的现代人度过物竞天择的淘汰过程。

examples.en: But only Homo sapiens has turned lying into an art.
examples.zh: 但只有智人将撒谎的艺术发挥到了极致。

words.definition: any extinct elephant-like proboscidean mammal of the genus Mammut (or Mastodon), common in Pliocene times; monolith, leviathan; huge, enormous, tremendous, massive, macro
words.translation: [古生]乳齿象, 庞然大物；[古生]乳齿象；庞然大物；巨大的；庞大的

words.definition: doubt, challenge; dispute, wonder, question, suspect of, to doubt
words.translation: 猜疑, 怀疑；怀疑；嫌疑；疑心；一点儿

examples.en: His conduct roused the suspicion of the police.
examples.zh: 他的举动引起了警察的怀疑。

words.definition: remarkable, excellent, prominent, ranking
words.translation: 卓越的；超群的

examples.en: Bombastic boasts—"We are positioned to become the preeminent provider of XYZ"—do not constitute a position.
examples.zh: 言过其实的自夸——“我们定位于成为XYZ的卓越供应商”——并不能构建其地位。

examples.en: And there is every reason to think America will once again regain its preeminent role as an American powerhouse.
examples.zh: 我们也完全有理由相信，美国将再次赢得美利坚强国的卓越地位。

words.definition: philosophically, sagely
words.translation: 贤明地,有才能地；贤明地；有才能地

words.definition: dispirit, discourage
words.translation: 沮丧；使气馁，使畏缩；威吓

words.definition: (of light or other electromagnetic radiation) having only one wavelength; unicolor, homochromous
words.translation: 单色的；[物]单色的

examples.en: However, if you want to wear a print, choose a print that's low in contrast and monochromatic in color.
examples.zh: 然而，假如你实在想穿喷绘衣服，那就选择一件单色、低对比度的。

examples.en: This hologram, if later illuminated with the same wavelength of laser light, reproduced a 3D (but monochromatic) image of the object.
examples.zh: 这幅全息图，如果用（与拍摄时）相同波长的激光照明，会再现出物体的3D图象（不过是单色的）。

words.definition: able to learn or be educated; trainable
words.translation: 可教育的, 可培养的；可教育的

examples.en: At that time, deaf children were not considered educable.
examples.zh: 当时认为失聪的儿童无法教育。

words.definition: a tame animal or bird is not wild any longer, because it has been trained to live with people; stupid, docile; domesticate, bring under
words.translation: (指动物)驯服的,平淡的 v驯养, 驯服；驯服的；平淡的；乏味的；顺从的；驯养；使变得平淡；制服

examples.en: tame elephants
examples.zh: 驯养的大象

words.definition: able to learn and understand things quickly; intelligent, experienced, wise, skilled, smart
words.translation: 机灵的, 聪明的；聪明的；机灵的；熟练的

examples.en: a clever man
examples.zh: 聪明的人

words.definition: a clever but dishonest way to get money; relation, story, scheme, fraud, yarn; rip off, illude; rip off, pettifog
words.translation: 诡计 v诓骗；骗局，诡计；故事；欺诈；诓骗

examples.en: He got involved in a credit card scam.
examples.zh: 他卷入了一桩信用卡诈骗事件。

words.definition: a thin piece of metal used to fasten things together, especially broken bones; needle, plug; nail up, transfix
words.translation: 钉, 栓 vt钉住, 牵制；大头针，针；栓；琐碎物；钉住；压住；将……用针别住

examples.en: ...a box of needles and pins.
examples.zh: …一盒缝衣针和别针。

words.definition: able to understand situations or behaviour very well and very quickly, especially so that you can get an advantage for yourself; designing, knowing, subtle
words.translation: 机敏的, 狡猾的；机敏的；狡猾的，诡计多端的

examples.en: an astute politician
examples.zh: 机敏的政治家

examples.en: astute investments
examples.zh: 精明的投资

words.definition: an occasion when someone runs somewhere very quickly in order to get away from something or someone, or in order to reach them; jerking motion; discomfit; knock against, impinge on
words.translation: 冲撞, 破折号 v猛掷, 冲撞；破折号；冲撞；使…破灭；猛撞；泼溅；猛冲；撞击

examples.en: ...a 160-mile dash to the hospital.
examples.zh: …飞奔160英里赶向医院。

words.definition: paint, hang
words.translation: 饰以浮饰, 使浮雕出来；使凸出；在……上作浮雕图案；装饰

words.definition: the yellow part in the centre of an egg; vitellus, yelk
words.translation: 蛋黄, [生物] 卵黄；蛋黄；[胚]卵黄；[纺]羊毛脂

examples.en: Only the yolk contains cholesterol.
examples.zh: 只有蛋黄含胆固醇。

words.definition: to make something more beautiful by adding decorations to it; paint, hang, modify
words.translation: 修饰；装饰；润色

examples.en: The boat was embellished with carvings in red and blue.
examples.zh: 这艘船饰有红、蓝雕刻。

words.definition: someone who is learning to do something; novice, beginner
words.translation: 学习者, 初学者；初学者，学习者

examples.en: the needs of slow learners
examples.zh: 学习迟缓者的需要

examples.en: attractive grammar books for adult learners
examples.zh: 针对成年学生的精美语法书

words.definition: an act of stealing something; ripoff, robbery
words.translation: 偷, 行窃；[法]盗窃；偷；赃物

examples.en: There have been a number of thefts in the area.
examples.zh: 该地区发生了几宗偷窃案。

words.definition: unlettered
words.translation: 没有人看的, 无学问的；未经阅读的；无学问的，读书不多的
重新解释

examples.en: This new perspective -- that a certain unremitting flux is the norm -- has illuminated past data for reinterpretation.
examples.zh: 这个新观点——即某种不停的流动是常态——阐明了用于重新解释的历史数据。

examples.en: The Solar Tree is just a streetlamp but actually some of the small things which can have a big impact on our life are all open for reinterpretation.
examples.zh: ‘太阳树’仅仅是种街灯，但是事实上能给我们的生活带来大影响的小事物，从来都可以被重新阐释。

examples.en: While they pay respect to the environment by utilizing passive energy, they are also a new architectural reinterpretation of the traditional tower expressed in a solemn manner unique to the school.
examples.zh: 它们不但利用被动式能源来保护环境，还以校园内独有的严肃态度在建筑上对传统塔楼进行了重新诠释。

words.definition: the part of a stair that you put your foot on; step, sole; trample down, ride down; step, set foot
words.translation: 踏, 步态 v踏,  跳；踏；胎面；步态；鞋底；[建]踏板；梯级；踩；践踏；跳；踩出；行走；交尾

words.definition: if you postdate a cheque, you write it with a date that is later than the actual date, so that it will not become effective until that time
words.translation: 填迟的日期 n事后日期

words.definition: a strong desire for something or interest in something, especially one that affects a lot of people at the same time; abandon, fanaticism
words.translation: [医]颠狂, 狂躁, 癖好, 狂热；狂热；狂躁；热衷

examples.en: The mania for dinosaurs began in the late 1800s.
examples.zh: 恐龙热兴起于19世纪晚期。

words.definition: a room or area in a building that is under the level of the ground; undercroft, souterrain
words.translation: 地下室, 墙脚；[建]地下室；地窖

examples.en: They bought an old schoolhouse to live in and built a workshop in the basement.
examples.zh: 他们买了座旧校舍居住，还在地下室建了个作坊。

words.definition: to take something or someone illegally from one country to another
words.translation: 走私, 偷带

examples.en: My message is "If you try to smuggle drugs you are stupid."
examples.zh: 我的讯息是，“你若企图走私毒品，那是犯傻。”

words.definition: to store something secretly or safely somewhere; store, deposit; put out of sight, trust with
words.translation: 存放 n隐藏处；存放；贮藏；藏起来

examples.en: We went for the bottle of whisky that we had stashed behind the bookcase.
examples.zh: 我们去取那瓶我们藏在书柜后面的威士忌。

words.definition: someone who is quarrelsome quarrels a lot with people; disputative, litigious
words.translation: 喜欢吵架的,好争论的；喜欢吵架的；好争论的

examples.en: He became quarrelsome after drinking too much.
examples.zh: 他喝多了就爱找人吵架。

words.definition: happening or done quickly or without delay; quick, rapid, fast, forward, ready
words.translation: 快的, 迅速的；快的；迅速的；敏捷的

examples.en: a speedy recovery from injury
examples.zh: 受伤后的迅速康复

words.definition: to pay for something before you need it or use it; pay in advance
words.translation: 预付；提前缴纳

examples.en: Participation in the program would be voluntary and participants could prepay the government loan at any time.
examples.zh: 参加这以项目是自愿的，参与者可以在任何时间将贷款预付给政府。

examples.en: This time, thanks to the card, I had managed to prove knowledge of where I was going and was spared the hassle of having to pick and prepay for a state-operated hotel at the airport.
examples.zh: 多亏了这张卡片，这一次，我在机场清楚了自己该往哪儿走，省下了挑选、预付国有宾馆的麻烦。

examples.en: In their previous hosting service they had to prepay for a month at a time
examples.zh: 在之前的托管服务上，我们必须要预付一个月的费用。

words.definition: very unpleasant or cruel; abominable
words.translation: 讨厌的；令人憎恶的；令人呕吐的

examples.en: that loathsome little man
examples.zh: 那个讨厌的小男人

words.definition: Counterfeit is also a noun; simulate, doctor, come; act, put on; stumour, shoddy; artificial, false
words.translation: 赝品  a伪造的 v伪造；[法]伪造，仿造；假装，伪装；仿造；假装；赝品；冒牌货；[法]伪造品；假冒的，[法]伪造的；虚伪的

examples.en: Levi Strauss says counterfeits of the company's jeans are flooding Europe.
examples.zh: 利瓦伊·斯特劳斯说该公司牛仔裤的仿冒品充斥着欧洲市场。

words.definition: the person who sent a particular letter, package, message etc; transmitter, communicator
words.translation: 寄件人,发送人；[邮]寄件人；[贸易][通信]发送人；[电讯]发报机

examples.en: a package marked ‘ return to sender ’
examples.zh: 标有“退回寄件人”字样的包裹

words.definition: paste on; appendix, annexment
words.translation: 使附于, 粘贴 n[语]词缀；粘上；署名；将罪责加之于；[语]词缀；附加物

words.definition: possess, spell
words.translation: 迷住, 使困扰；迷住，缠住；使…着迷；使…困扰

examples.en: A string of scandals is obsessing America.
examples.zh: 一系列丑闻在困扰着美国。

words.definition: to prove that an idea or opinion is completely wrong; destroy, undermine
words.translation: 毁坏, 推翻, 粉碎；拆除；破坏；毁坏；推翻；驳倒

examples.en: He demolished my argument in minutes.
examples.zh: 他几分钟内就把我的论点驳倒了。

words.definition: a game in which the players hit a small white ball into holes in the ground with a set of golf clubs, using as few hits as possible
words.translation: 高尔夫球 vi打高尔夫球

examples.en: He plays golf on Sundays.
examples.zh: 他星期天都去打高尔夫球。

examples.en: a round of golf
examples.zh: 一场高尔夫球赛

words.definition: to cover or become covered with glaciers or masses of ice
words.translation: 使结冰, 以冰(或冰河)覆盖

words.definition: the qualities and character of a particular place and the way these make you feel; atmosphere, mood, set
words.translation: 周围环境, 气氛；气氛，布景；周围环境

examples.en: The overall ambience of the room is cosy.
examples.zh: 这个房间的整体氛围是舒适的。

words.definition: a taxi; taxi, wheelhouse
words.translation: 出租汽车；[车辆]驾驶室；出租马车

examples.en: New York’s yellow cabs
examples.zh: 纽约的黄色出租车

examples.en: Ralph tried to hail a cab (= wave to get a cab to stop for you ) .
examples.zh: 拉尔夫招手想叫一辆出租车。

words.definition: a state of great anxiety or excitement, in which you cannot control your behaviour; fury, turbulence; dement, derange

examples.en: Doreen had worked herself into a frenzy .
examples.zh: 多琳一阵狂怒。

words.definition: a story or play in which very exciting or terrible things happen, and in which the characters and the emotions they show seem too strong to be real; actioner, farce
words.translation: 情节剧；音乐剧；耸人听闻的事件，闹剧

examples.en: He was behaving like a character in a Victorian melodrama.
examples.zh: 他表现得就像维多利亚时代情节剧里的角色。

words.definition: a group of valuable things such as gold, silver, jewels etc; wealth, estate, money, fortune, property; cherish, enshrine
words.translation: 财宝, 财富 vt珍爱；财富，财产；财宝；珍品；珍爱；珍藏

examples.en: The Book of Kells is Trinity College’s greatest treasure.
examples.zh: 《凯尔经》是三一学院的镇院之宝。

words.translation: 辛辛那提（美国俄亥俄州西南部城市）

examples.en: We never went back. Instead, we moved to a house near Cincinnati, far from the river.
examples.zh: 我们再也没有回去，而是举家迁往离河很远的辛辛那提附近的另一幢房子。

examples.en: In 1830, only a few miles away from what is now the great city of Cincinnati, lay an immense and almost unbroken forest.
examples.zh: 1830年，距离今天的大城市辛辛那提几英里远的地方，有一片几乎没有遭受过破坏的大森林。

examples.en: In 2005, Charlie received his doctorate in Adult Sexuality Education from the Union Institute and University in Cincinnati, Ohio.
examples.zh: 在2005年，查理获得了俄亥俄州辛辛那提联合大学的成人性教育学的博士学位。

words.translation: 被发现的东西, 收藏的东西

examples.en: But at the stern of the ship, divers found a trove of gold and silver and high-grade ceramics whose significance is more mysterious.
examples.zh: 但是潜水人员在船尾部发现了一个由金、银以及高级陶瓷打造的收藏品，这件收藏品的意义更加神秘。

words.definition: a word made up from the first letters of the name of something such as an organization. For example, NATO is an acronym for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization.; initialism
words.translation: 只取首字母的缩写词；[语]首字母缩略词

words.definition: an agreement to risk money on the result of a race, game etc or on something happening, or the money that you risk; stake; make sure, be sure of; lay, stake
words.translation: 赌, 打赌 v赌, 赌钱；打赌，赌注；被打赌的事物；打赌；敢断定，确信

examples.en: a £50 bet
examples.zh: 50英镑的赌注

examples.en: Bookmakers are already taking bets on the outcome.
examples.zh: 马票商已经开始接受对比赛结果的下注了。

words.definition: a roof or ceiling that consists of several arches that are joined together, especially in a church; basement, undercroft; jump, dance
words.translation: 拱顶 v做成弧形；拱顶；撑竿跳；地下室；跳跃；成穹状弯曲

words.definition: a large network of paths or passages which cross each other, making it very difficult to find your way; maze, mavericks
words.translation: 迷路, 迷宫, 难解的事物；迷宫；[解剖]迷路；难解的事物

examples.en: ...the labyrinth of corridors.
examples.zh: …迷宫般的走廊。

words.definition: broken stones or bricks from a building or wall that has been destroyed; crushed stone, rockfill
words.translation: 碎石；碎石，碎砖；[建]粗石堆

examples.en: Brick rubble is useful as the base for paths and patios.
examples.zh: 碎砖可用作道路和天井的基石。

words.definition: If you say that something is a recipe for a particular situation, you mean that it is likely to result in that situation; secret, tips
words.translation: 处方；食谱；[临床]处方；秘诀

examples.en: Large-scale inflation is a recipe for disaster.
examples.zh: 大规模的通货膨胀有可能导致灾难。

words.translation: 人工降雨装置,喷灌装置

words.definition: You use yesteryear to refer to the past, often a period in the past with a set of values or a way of life that no longer exists; past year
words.translation: 去年 ad过去不久的岁月；不久以前；去年

examples.en: The modern-day sex symbol has now taken the place of the old-fashioned hero of yesteryear.
examples.zh: 当今的性感偶像已经取代了往昔过时的英雄形象。

words.definition: knowledge or information about a subject, for example nature or magic, that is not written down but is passed from person to person; information, knowledge of, learning, cognition, study
words.translation: 学问,（动物的）眼光知识；知识；学问；全部传说；（动物的）眼光知识

examples.en: According to local lore, a ghost still haunts the castle.
examples.zh: 根据当地人的传说，城堡里至今仍然闹鬼。

words.definition: a room, building, or piece of land that adjoins something is next to it and connected to it; abut upon, abut against; abut upon, neighbor
words.translation: 邻接, 毗连；毗连，邻接

examples.en: A vacant plot of land adjoins his house.
examples.zh: 有一块空地紧挨着他家。

words.definition: a heavy gun that fires bombs or  shell s  in a high curve; minnie, plaister
words.translation: 灰泥,迫击炮 vt用灰泥结合；[军]迫击炮；臼，研钵；灰泥

examples.en: A cameraman was killed when his vehicle came under mortar fire .
examples.zh: 一名摄影师因所乘坐的汽车遭到迫击炮袭击而丧生。

examples.en: a mortar attack
examples.zh: 迫击炮轰击

words.definition: the fact that something is strange, unusual, or unsuitable in a particular situation; variance, disparity
words.translation: 不调和的, 不适宜的；不协调；不一致；不适宜

examples.en: The incongruity of her situation struck Gina with unpleasant force.
examples.zh: 吉娜猛然意识到自己处境尴尬，心里很不舒服。

words.definition: a large area of high flat land; meseta, altiplano
words.translation: 高原；[地理]高原；台地

examples.en: The northwestern tableland area has a continental plateau climate with long and chilly winter and cool humid summer.
examples.zh: 西北高原地区是大陆高原气候，有漫长而寒冷的冬季，凉爽而湿润的夏季。

examples.en: Few of tropical Africa's rivers are navigable from the ocean, dropping as they do from interior tableland to coastal plains by a series of falls and rapids.
examples.zh: 酷热的非洲，几乎没有适于航海的河流，这些河流从内陆高原到海岸平原一路穿瀑布、过险滩，倾流而下。

words.definition: the state of being perfect; finish, fare-thee-well
words.translation: 尽善尽美, 完美, 完成；完善；完美

examples.en: My father expected perfection from all of us.
examples.zh: 父亲期望我们都尽善尽美。

examples.en: the search for technical perfection
examples.zh: 对技术的精益求精

words.definition: the quality of being large and round in an attractive way; abundance, plenty, maturity, pregnancy, good and
words.translation: 满, 丰富, 成熟；充满；丰富；完全；成熟

examples.en: Use a red gloss on your bottom lip to give it fullness.
examples.zh: 下唇使用红色唇彩让它显得丰盈饱满。

words.definition: Recoil is also a noun; rebound, shrink back from; reaction, backwardness
words.translation: 畏缩, 弹回 vi退却, 畏缩；畏缩；弹回；报应；反作用

examples.en: ...his small body jerking in recoil from the volume of his shouting.
examples.zh: …他小小身体在他大声的叫喊中畏缩地抽搐着。

words.translation: 音乐学者

examples.en: Rakae Jamil, a musicologist with the Sanjan Nagar Institute of Philosophy and Arts in Lahore, says there is no doubt that Michael Jackson influenced the pop scene in Pakistan.
examples.zh: 拉齐.贾米尔是拉合尔的桑贾恩.纳加尔哲学和艺术研究所的音乐理论家。 他说，迈克尔.杰克逊影响了巴基斯坦的流行歌坛，这点是毫无疑问的。

examples.en: But the joke would be lost on some: the Canadian-American musicologist Colin McPhee, who spent several years on Bali in the 1930s, recalls a young boy who showed great talent for dancing.
examples.zh: 但是在一些语言中就失去了它的幽默效果：加拿大裔美国的音乐学家，柯林.麦柯菲曾于20世纪30年代在巴里度过几年的时光，提到了在那里一位对舞蹈有极高天分的少年。

examples.en: Authority as a critic and as a musicologist was fully recognized.
examples.zh: 权威评论家和音乐学家的充分承认。

words.definition: to be something that you do well or are skilled at; strength, excellence; loudly, ringingly
words.translation: 长处；特长；响亮地

examples.en: He found that running long distances was not his forte .
examples.zh: 他发现长跑并不是他的强项。

examples.en: As a writer, her forte is comedy.
examples.zh: 作为作家，她的专长是写喜剧。

words.definition: Percussive sounds are like the sound of drums; impactive
words.translation: 冲击的,叩诊的；冲击的；叩诊的，敲击的

examples.en: ...using all manner of percussive effects.
examples.zh: ...运用各种打击乐效果。

words.translation: 多层的,有多层楼的

examples.en: The abbey was a maze of multistory wings, each added in a differing century, the architecture conspiring to create a jumbled complex that now housed four hundred brothers.
examples.zh: 修道院的结构是迷宫似的多层侧翼，每个侧翼都在不同的世纪里被添上，那建筑拼成一混乱的复合体，里面现在住着四百多个圣殿武士。

examples.en: One-story homes that are "tied together" -- with the roof bolted to the walls and the walls to the foundation -- tend to survive earthquakes and windstorms better than multistory homes that aren't.

examples.en: Instead of eating hunched pleasurably over a book, I look out of the window and chew every mouthful thoroughly, aware of every single oat and nut and dried bit of apple as it goes down.
examples.zh: 送孩子们去学校后，我不再放松地边吃早饭边看书，而是盯着窗外，仔细地嚼着嘴里的食物：每一粒燕麦、每一颗坚果、每一片苹果干。

examples.zh: 她们会很快做出回应，陷进去……伦理上最重要的是，我们尊重妇女，我们尊重她们的决断能力。

examples.en: Is it technically/ethically feasible to define a hierarchy of criteria that should guide our action, i.e. food security first or environment first?

examples.zh: 残酷的现实和抒情诗般的美并存贯穿于帕克的故事之中。

examples.zh: 它的存在是因为读者欣赏使人耳目一新的刺激，毫不客气地提醒他们活在一个思相陈腐、道德低廉、哲学荒谬的世界里。

words.definition: to tell other people your ideas about right and wrong behaviour, especially when they have not asked for your opinion; to teach, humanize; preachify, sermonize

examples.zh: 就人们的性行为进行说教的政客们

examples.zh: 他失礼的幽默感

examples.zh: ...沿着从波士顿到华盛顿的东海岸连绵不断、人口稠密的特大城市带。

examples.zh: 她受伤后奇迹般地康复了。

examples.zh: 他们的车冲入河里，而他们却奇迹般地逃生了。

words.definition: A grainy photograph looks as if it is made up of lots of spots, which make the lines or shapes in it difficult to see; granular

examples.zh: 不过，在洋流的顶端还出现一个逆时针方向旋转的水流（紫色部分），而且温度较低。

examples.zh: …一个总统很可能不想要的军事政治纠葛。

examples.zh: 从地面斜对角向金星的右上方，可以看到我们的银河系的光带。

examples.zh: 不锈钢制品因为能防锈，所以很受欢迎。

examples.zh: 普通进口龙头都有10个微米以上的镀层，目的是防锈、美观、保证使用期限。

examples.zh: 介绍了云母氧化铁与彩色云母氧化铁分别作为防锈颜料和珠光颜料的性能及合成方法，探讨了彩色云母氧化铁的应用前景。

words.definition: an area surrounded by a wall or fence, and used for a particular purpose; attachment, attached sheet

examples.zh: 乔木或灌木叶具叶柄，全缘的或有锯齿在边缘。

examples.zh: 花萼裂片边缘具小齿或有锯齿，至少一旦近先端。

examples.zh: 单叶，无托叶， 互生，很少对生，全缘的或有锯齿在边缘。

words.translation: 水上的,  水运的

examples.zh: 这组科学家说，他们的方法还可以用于检测其他水传播疾病的风险，例如由志贺氏菌、沙门氏菌和埃希氏大肠杆菌引发的疾病。

examples.zh: 她跳起来，将茶壶向他掷去。

examples.zh: 曾有一次，他把茶壶嘴用东西堵住，然后把茶壶放在火炉上。

examples.zh: 听起来蛮有趣的。我刚好想买个茶壶。

examples.zh: 这些螺栓符合所有的工程设计规格。

examples.zh: 企图立即改变社会的制度而引发的大规模革命使得所有人都不能理性的计划，包括那些革命者的。

examples.zh: 日本是美国牛肉的最大进口国。

examples.zh: 这个插件无疑是系统化归档的重要插件之一。

examples.zh: 好言劝说了几句后，黛比就同意让我们进去了。

examples.zh: 她使尽浑身解数，才劝服蒂莉应该那么做。

examples.zh: 禁止乱扔垃圾。 违者罚款500美元。

examples.zh: 提前支取这笔钱将被处以10%的罚金。

words.definition: a decorated container, especially one that is used for holding the ashes of a dead body; tomb, grave
words.translation: 瓮, 缸；瓮；缸；茶水壶；坟墓；骨灰瓮

examples.en: ...a funeral urn.
examples.zh: …一个骨灰瓮。

words.definition: cowardliness, timorousness
words.translation: 胆怯；胆怯，胆小；羞怯

examples.en: They mocked at my timidity.
examples.zh: 他们耻笑我胆小。

examples.en: In this, the politicians display not only their own timidity but also the mood of many voters.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上，政要们不仅展现他们的胆小，还有许多民众的不满情绪。

examples.en: Anyone who does otherwise, either out of timidity or because of bad advice, is always obliged to keep his knife in his hand.
examples.zh: 任何不这样做的人，或出于胆怯，或由于接受了拙劣的建议，总是被迫一直把屠刀提在手中。

words.definition: someone whose job is cutting stone into pieces to be used in buildings; jadder, masonry
words.translation: 石匠；石工；石工锤

examples.en: One thinks of Amos the sheepherder, Socrates the stonemason, Omar the tentmaker .
examples.zh: 想想牧羊人阿摩司，石匠苏格拉底，帐蓬制造人奥马尔。

examples.en: The son of a stonemason, born around 469BC, Socrates was famously odd.
examples.zh: 他是一名石像雕刻师的儿子，大约出生于公元前469年，苏格拉底因他的古怪而出名。

words.definition: fraud, sharp
words.translation: 咬人的动物, 骗子；咬人的动物；骗子

examples.en: The kids already know that biting hurts, so after removing the biter from the situation, focus all your concern on the victim.
examples.zh: 孩子是知道咬会伤人的，因此把咬人的孩子抱离后，集中关心一下被咬的孩子。

words.definition: spite, hardship
words.translation: 苦味, 辛酸；苦味；苦难；怨恨

examples.en: ON WHY THE POOR SHOULD BE HAPPY: “Nobody has the excuse of ‘lack of money’ for not being at peace and living in integrity,” writes one survey respondent of his family, with a touch of bitterness.
examples.zh: 关于为什么穷人应该是快乐的：“没有人会因为没有钱这个借口而过的不平和和不完整，”某个调查对象在说到关于他的家庭的时候，带着一点痛苦的意味。

words.definition: saying exactly what you think, especially in a way that people think is honest rather than rude; outspoken
words.translation: 老实说的,直言的；老实说的；直言不讳的；说话直率的

examples.en: a straightforward, plainspoken man
examples.zh: 一个性格坦率、有话直说的男人

words.definition: pulverize, mull; coarse sand, arenes
words.translation: 粗砂 v研磨；研磨；在…上铺砂砾；[岩][地质]粗砂，砂砾

words.definition: flying, aviatic
words.translation: 航空的,  飞行的；航空的；[航]飞机的；飞行的

examples.en: Boeing's research in India will break new ground in aero structures, aerodynamics and electronic networks with a team of senior researchers, scientists and engineers.
examples.zh: 在印度，波音公司将与资深研究人员、科学家和工程师一起开创印度航空构造学、空气动力学以及电子网络的新天地。

words.definition: lower, bemean; cut down the price, cut rate
words.translation: 减价, 跌价；减去…的价格；贬低；减价；跌价

words.definition: a thorny bush, plant etc has thorns; painful, bitter, hurt
words.translation: 多刺的, 痛苦的；多刺的；痛苦的；令人苦恼的

examples.en: ...thorny hawthorn trees.
examples.zh: …带刺的山楂树。

words.definition: cankerworm, spanworm, loopworm
words.translation: [昆] 尺蠖；[植保]尺蠖

examples.en: The adorable inchworm is really the caterpillar of the geometer moth.
examples.zh: 可爱的尺蠖就是尺蠖毛虫。

examples.en: If you have ever experienced the childlike delight of discovering an inchworm, you know how fun they are to watch.
examples.zh: 如果你有过看到尺蠖露出孩子般灿烂笑脸的经历，你就知道观察尺蠖是多么有趣。

examples.en: And with the inchworm, he flew to where other birds needed to be measured.
examples.zh: 知更鸟带著尺蠖飞到其他鸟需要被测量的地方。

words.definition: a set of moving stairs that take people to different levels in a building
words.translation: 电动扶梯

examples.en: Take the escalator to the third floor and it's the last office on the left.
examples.zh: 乘电梯到4楼，左边最后的那个办公室就是。

words.definition: electrical force measured in volts; electric tension, electrical pressure
words.translation: [电工]电压, 伏特数；[电]电压

examples.en: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
examples.zh: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

words.definition: to hit something with a lot of force; strike, beat upon; strike, hit; hit, beating
words.translation: 重击；打；毁灭；侵袭；使神魂颠倒

examples.en: The heroic leader charged into battle, ready to smite the enemy.
examples.zh: 英勇的军官冲上战场，准备重击敌人。

words.definition: someone who believes in a particular system of ideas, or who supports a leader who teaches these ideas; Christian, old faithful
words.translation: 追随者, 信徒；追随者；信徒；属下

examples.en: Marx and his followers were convinced that capitalism would destroy itself.
examples.zh: 马克思及其支持者确信资本主义将自我毁灭。

words.definition: lack of interest or concern; nonchalance, dryness
words.translation: 不关心；漠不关心；冷淡；不重视；中立

examples.en: Whether you stay or leave is a matter of total indifference to me (= I do not care ).
examples.zh: 你是留是走我根本无所谓。

words.definition: a piece of skin that covers your eye when it is closed; palpebrae, lid
words.translation: 眼皮, 眼睑；[解剖]眼睑；眼皮

examples.en: His eyelids began to droop (= close, because he was sleepy ).
examples.zh: 他的眼皮开始往下垂。

examples.en: The room spun. Her eyelids fluttered (= moved up and down quickly ) and she fainted.
examples.zh: 房间快速旋转起来。她的眼皮上下翻动，然后便昏了过去。

words.definition: in a way that makes you feel physically relaxed, without any pain, or without being too hot, cold etc; copiously, cozily
words.translation: 舒适地；舒服地；安乐地；充裕地

examples.en: The hotel is modern and comfortably furnished .
examples.zh: 这家宾馆很现代化，家具很舒适。

examples.en: his comfortably baggy jeans
examples.zh: 他那宽松舒适的牛仔裤

words.definition: a small axe with a short handle; kill, snuff out
words.translation: 短柄斧；用短柄小斧砍伐；扼杀

examples.en: Would I feel better if I took a hatchet to her, just to end this nightmare?
examples.zh: 如果我向她举起一把短柄斧，结束这场噩梦，我会感觉好一些吗？

words.definition: a tool with a heavy metal blade on the end of a long handle, used to cut down trees or split pieces of wood; cut to the bone, cut down to
words.translation: 斧, (经费的)大削减；削减；用斧砍

words.definition: able to use either hand equally well
words.translation: 十分灵巧的

words.definition: likely to have been caused by something
words.translation: 可归因于的

examples.en: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
examples.zh: 每年1万个慢性肺病患者的死亡可能是由于吸烟导致的。

words.definition: If there is a predominance of one type of person or thing, there are many more of that type than of any other type; superiority, advantage, edge, dominance
words.translation: 优势；卓越

examples.en: ...the predominance of women in the industry.
examples.zh: ...该产业妇女在数量上拥有的优势。

words.translation: 石化,吓呆

words.definition: the state of having either a positive or negative electric charge; antagonism, opponency
words.translation: 极性；[物]极性；两极；对立

examples.en: Whether you want to call it magnetism, polarity,electricity, thought, intelligence or charisma, it's still attraction, and it invests everything—animal, vegetable or mineral.
examples.zh: 不论你管它叫磁性、极性、活力、体贴、智慧还是魅力，它们都是吸引力，而且它适用于一切------动物、蔬菜或矿物。

examples.en: Several people have asked me about the origins of the polarity concept I began exploring last year.
examples.zh: 有几个人曾问我有关极性概念的由来，极性概念是我去年开始研究的。

words.definition: cut to the bone, cut down to; oxe
words.translation: 斧头 vt削减；削减；用斧修整；解雇；斧头
铁磁的

examples.en: When they gradually increased the repulsive forces between the atoms, they observed several features indicating that the gas had become ferromagnetic.
examples.zh: 他们利用红外线激光束捕获超冷锂原子气团，将其冷却到仅比绝对零度高亿分之十五开尔文。 当逐渐增加原子间斥力时，研究人员观察到的几个现象表明气体已经变得具有强磁性。

examples.en: It is suggested that wearers of cardiac pacemakers, ferromagnetic implants and implanted electronic devices should avoid locations where the field exceeds 0.5 mT.
examples.zh: 建议植有心脏起搏器、铁磁植入器和植入电子器件的人回避超过0.5 mT的静电磁场。

examples.en: We're still just beginning to exploit atomic-scale effects in revolutionary new materials —semiconductors (processing power), ferromagnetic compounds (storage), and fiber optics (bandwidth).
examples.zh: 我们对量子效应的初步开发，正始于那些革命性的新材料——半导体(处理器)、铁磁混合物（存储器）以及光纤材料（带宽）。

words.definition: If you do something or if something happens afterward, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned; since, subsequently
words.translation: 然后, 后来；以后，后来

examples.en: Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
examples.zh: 之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。

words.definition: someone who lives in a house, room etc; dweller, inhabitant
words.translation: 占有者, 居住者；居住者；[法]占有者

examples.en: The furniture had been left by the previous occupants.
examples.zh: 家具是先前的住户留下的。

words.definition: inflexible rules, arrangements etc are impossible to change; resistant, stubborn
words.translation: 不可弯曲的, 僵硬的；顽固的；不可弯曲的；不屈挠的；不能转变的

examples.en: This approach is too inflexible and too costly.
examples.zh: 这个方法太死板，而且花费也太高。

words.definition: a white or pink flower that grows on the surface of lakes in Asia and Africa, or the shape of this flower used in decorations; padma
words.translation: [植] 莲(花)；贪图安乐的；莲花；[建]荷花；莲饰

examples.en: The soul unfolds itself, like a lotus of countless petals.
examples.zh: 灵魂伸展绽放，就像一朵有无数花瓣的莲花。

examples.en: For me, the lotus and blue cedar dominate, but they work well together.
examples.zh: 她的芬香以莲花和蓝色雪松为主，几种香味完美融合。

words.definition: too unusual or strange to be explained or understood; unexplainable, incomprehensible
words.translation: 无法解释的，难理解的；费解的；无法说明的；不能解释的

examples.en: inexplicable behaviour
examples.zh: 费解的行为

examples.en: For some inexplicable reason, he felt depressed.
examples.zh: 他无端地感到很沮丧。

words.definition: the number 19
words.translation: 十九

examples.en: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
examples.zh: 当时是7点19分。

examples.en: I was only nineteen (= 19 years old ).
examples.zh: 我当时只有19岁。

words.definition: relating to the treatment or cure of an illness; healthy, treated, medicinal, remedial
words.translation: 治疗的, 治疗学的 n治疗剂, 治疗学家；治疗的；治疗学的；有益于健康的

examples.en: Some claim that the herb has therapeutic value for treating pain.
examples.zh: 有些人称这种草药具有止痛的疗效。

words.definition: something that is restrictive stops people doing what they want to do; limiting, confining
words.translation: 限制性的；限制的；约束的

examples.en: Many members thought the rules were too restrictive.
examples.zh: 很多会员认为这些规定限制条件太多。

examples.en: a restrictive policy on admission to the college
examples.zh: 大学入学的限制性政策

words.definition: harry, trouble; fall sick, take sick; misery, agony
words.translation: 生病，使苦恼；使苦恼，使烦恼；生病；病痛，苦恼

examples.en: A full-scale debate is under way on what ails the industry.
examples.zh: 就困扰工业发展的弊端所展开的一次全面讨论正在进行中。

words.definition: If you unbind something or someone, you take off a piece of cloth, string, or rope that has been tied around them; unriddle, unlash
words.translation: 解开, 解放；解开；解放

examples.en: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
examples.zh: 她解开头绳，让头发在风里自由地飘。

words.definition: from ancient Greece, or having a style or appearance that is considered typical of ancient Greece
words.translation: 希腊的, 希腊式的 n希腊学家

examples.en: a Grecian urn
examples.zh: 希腊古瓮

words.definition: someone who defends a particular idea, belief, person etc; champion, supporter
words.translation: 防卫者, 拥护者；防卫者，守卫者；[法]辩护者；拥护者；卫冕者

examples.en: He presented himself as a defender of democracy.
examples.zh: 他以民主捍卫者的姿态出现。

words.definition: those processes collectively that result in the formation of volcanoes and their products
words.translation: 火山作用

examples.en: His study of eruptions over the past 300 years with Ben Mason of the University of Cambridge and colleagues reveals that volcanism varies with the seasons.
examples.zh: 他和剑桥大学的本.梅森及其同事研究了过去300年来发生的火山喷发，研究显示火山活动随季节变化而不同。

examples.en: Both kinds of plate boundary are associated with fault systems, earthquakes and volcanism, but the kinds of geologic activity observed at the two boundaries are quite different.
examples.zh: 两种板块边界均与地层系统、地震以及火山活动有关，但在两种边界处观察到的诸般地质活动 却迥然不同。

words.definition: elimination, subtraction
words.translation: [地]潜没(指地壳的板块沉到另一板块之下)；俯冲；除去；减法

examples.en: In the past 300 years, no earthquake nearly that large — nothing larger than magnitude-eight — had struck in the Japan subduction zone.
examples.zh: 在过去的300年里，在日本俯冲地区，从没发生过一个如此巨大的地震-没有一次比八级还大。

words.definition: if similar things diverge, they develop in different ways and so are no longer similar; stray from, deviate from; deviate
words.translation: 分歧；偏离；分叉；离题；使偏离；使分叉

examples.en: The two species diverged millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 这两个物种从数百万年前开始朝不同方向演变。

examples.en: Global growth rates are diverging markedly.
examples.zh: 世界各地的增长率在发生明显的分化。

words.definition: an ecg2; cardiogram
words.translation: [医]心电图；[内科]心电图

examples.en: A disposable electrocardiogram machine the size of a Band-Aid monitors a heart patient.
examples.zh: 一个邦迪大小的一次性心电图仪器监视着一个心脏病人。

examples.en: Some countries, such as Italy and Japan, screen young people with the use of an electrocardiogram (ECG, or EKG), which records the electrical signals present in the heart.
examples.zh: 一些其他的国家，比如意大利和日本，人们用心电图（ECG或EKG）给年轻人做检查，心电图记录了心脏发出的电信号。

words.definition: to try to find something that you cannot see by feeling with your hands; explore, feel about; feel about, fish for; feel, floccillation
words.translation: / n摸索；摸索；探索；触摸

examples.en: With his left hand he groped for the knob, turned it, and pulled the door open.
examples.zh: 他用左手摸索到门把手，转动把手，把门拉开。

words.definition: vacillate, stand at; stand at, hang back
words.translation: 犹豫, 踌躇；踌躇，犹豫；不愿；有疑虑，不愿意

examples.en: Some parents hesitate to take these steps because they suspect that their child is exaggerating.
examples.zh: 一些家长迟迟不肯采取这些措施，因为他们怀疑自己的孩子在夸大其词。

words.definition: an eeg2
words.translation: [医]脑电图

examples.en: The brain, too, sends out brain waves of electricity, which can be recorded in an electroencephalogram.
examples.zh: 大脑也是一样，会发出脑电波，而脑电波可以在脑电图中记录。

examples.en: The researchers tracked various bits of data about a dreamer, like rapid eye movement electroencephalogram (EEG) readings. They then fed this data into the robot.
examples.zh: 研究人员跟踪有关睡梦者的各种数据位，如快速眼动脑电图描记器读数，然后把这些数据输入机器人。

examples.en: He found that the number of pulses, known as sleep spindles, generated by this organ and measured by an electroencephalogram, which records electrical activity in the brain, varied among the sleepers.
examples.zh: 他通过一种用于记录大脑电活动的脑电图设备测量了丘脑产生的脑电脉冲； 并且他发现，这个器官产生的脑电脉冲——也被称为睡眠纺锤波——的数量在不同志愿者身上存在差异。

words.definition: a period of darkness caused by a failure of the electricity supply; dimout
words.translation: 灯火管制，断电；灯火管制；灯火熄灭；暂时的意识丧失

examples.en: ...blackout curtains.
examples.zh: …灯火管制时用的窗帘。

words.definition: to move suddenly and roughly, or to make someone or something move in this way; shock, surge; rock, roll; shock, roll
words.translation: (使)颠簸；震动；使颠簸；使震惊；使摇动；摇晃；颠簸而行；颠簸；震惊；严重挫折

examples.en: We jolted along rough wet roads through an endless banana plantation.
examples.zh: 我们沿崎岖潮湿的公路颠簸着驶过无边无际的香蕉种植园。

words.definition: someone who  conduct s  a band, especially a dance or  jazz  band
words.translation: 伴舞乐队的指挥

examples.en: Their father was a bandleader and their mother taught harmony singing.
examples.zh: 他们的父亲是伴舞乐队的指挥，他们的母亲教授合唱。

words.definition: a very large room used for dancing on formal occasions; dancery, palais
words.translation: 舞厅, 跳舞场；舞厅；跳舞场

words.definition: a  memo; note, minute
words.translation: 备忘录, 便笺；备忘录；便笺

examples.en: ...a memorandum from the Department of Defense on its role.
examples.zh: …一份来自国防部的有关其角色的备忘录。

words.definition: a name given to someone, especially by their friends or family, that is not their real name and is often connected with what they look like or something they have done; sobriquet, agname
words.translation: 绰号, 昵称；绰号；昵称

examples.en: Stephen earned himself the nickname Hawkeye.
examples.zh: 斯蒂芬得了个“鹰眼”的绰号。

words.definition: a powder that is used to add a hot taste to food; peper, capsicum; besprinkle
words.translation: 胡椒粉；[食品][植]胡椒；[园艺]辣椒；[食品]加胡椒粉于；使布满

examples.en: salt and pepper
examples.zh: 盐和胡椒粉

words.definition: a statement saying that someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something wrong; charge, incrimination
words.translation: 谴责, [律]指控；[法]控告，指控；谴责

examples.en: The main accusation levelled against him was that he tried to avoid military service.
examples.zh: 对他提出的主要指控是他想逃避兵役。

examples.en: Burton’s enemies had made false accusations against him.
examples.zh: 伯顿的敌人对他提出不实的指责。

examples.en: She’s made all sorts of wild accusations against me in the past.
examples.zh: 她过去对我妄加指责，说了种种不是。

words.definition: to make someone have to do something, because it is the law, their duty, or the right thing to do; force, enforce; responsible, required, bound, necessary, liable
words.translation: 使负义务 a有责任的；使负义务；强使，强迫；对…施以恩惠；有责任的，有义务的；必需的

examples.en: The ruling obligates airlines to release information about their flight delays.
examples.zh: 这一裁决迫使航空公司公布航班晚点信息。

words.definition: the quality of being patient, able to control your emotions, and willing to forgive someone who has upset you; tolerance, possession, charity, mercy
words.translation: 自制，忍耐；宽容

examples.en: There is too much torment, renunciation, and anxiety in this love for it to be anything but infinite forbearance.
examples.zh: 这爱中有太多的折磨、太多的自制、与太多的焦虑，除了无穷无尽的忍耐，这些就成了它的一切。

examples.en: But forbearance alone cannot be a long-term answer to the problem of Pakistan.
examples.zh: 但是仅仅是忍耐不能做为巴基斯坦问题的一个长期答案。

examples.en: The second principle is forbearance.

examples.zh: …安赫尔瀑布，世界上最高的瀑布。

words.definition: winter sleep, torpidness
words.translation: 过冬, 冬眠, 避寒；[动]冬眠；过冬；避寒

examples.en: Heart rate tracking for three of the Alaska bears showed a drop from 55 beats per minute on average before hibernation to 14 erratic ones per minute in winter.
examples.zh: 对三头阿拉斯加的黑熊的心率追踪显示出它们在冬眠前的平均每分钟 55 下降低到了冬天里每分钟飘忽不定的 14 下。

words.definition: equality, average, uniformity
words.translation: 平均, 平等, 平坦；均匀性；平坦；平均；平等

words.definition: ectotherm, cold blooded animal
words.translation: [动]变温动物,冷血动物；[动]变温动物；冷血动物

examples.en: Fish are poikilotherm whose body temperature changes as the ambient water temperature changes.
examples.zh: 鱼类是变温动物，其体温随环境的水温变化而变化。

words.definition: to remove a load from a vehicle, ship etc; to get rid of work or responsibility by giving it to someone else; debark; discharge of goods, load off
words.translation: 卸货；摆脱之负担；卸；摆脱…之负担；倾销；退子弹

examples.en: Unload everything from the boat and clean it thoroughly.
examples.zh: 从小船上卸下所有的货物并彻底地清洗。

words.definition: someone who puts money in a bank or other financial organization
words.translation: 寄托者, 存款人

examples.en: Notice that the St. Louis memo tiptoes around the question of telling a depositor that he has a demand deposit while telling the rest of the country that he has a time deposit.
examples.zh: 请注意，圣路易斯储备银行的备忘录一直在一个问题上遮遮掩掩，那就是把存款人的活期存款说成定期存款，欺骗国人。

words.definition: with beautiful language or music; feverishly, crazily
words.translation: 抒情地,  狂热地；抒情地；诗意地；狂热地

examples.en: He lyrically described the countryside around his home.
examples.zh: 他以抒情的笔调描绘了住宅周围的乡村景致。

words.translation: 戏剧化地

examples.en: He theatrically turned his head to watch a butterfly flutter by.
examples.zh: 他戏剧化的转头看飞过的蝴蝶。

words.definition: a small sharp piece of wood, glass, or metal, that has broken off a larger piece; if something such as wood splinters, or if you splinter it, it breaks into thin sharp pieces; debris, chip; to split, split up; tear, disrupt
words.translation: 尖片, 碎片；分裂；碎片；微小的东西；极瘦的人；裂成碎片；使分裂；使裂成碎片

examples.en: I’ve got a splinter in my finger.
examples.zh: 我的手指扎了一根刺。

words.definition: the size of a ship or the amount of goods it can carry, shown in  tonnes; displacement, dead weight capacity
words.translation: 登记吨位, 排水量；[船]吨位，载重量；船舶总吨数，排水量

examples.en: A huge tonnage of bombs has already been dropped on the area.
examples.zh: 巨大吨数的炸弹已被投到该地区。

words.definition: built to travel on the sea; navigation, sailing
words.translation: 适于远航的,出海的；航海

examples.en: a seagoing ship
examples.zh: 远洋轮

words.definition: a short light coat; jerkin, lammy
words.translation: 夹克,护封；给穿夹克；夹克；[服装]短上衣

examples.en: ...a black leather jacket.
examples.zh: …一件黑色皮夹克。

words.definition: someone who catches fish as a sport or as a job; peterman
words.translation: 渔民, 渔夫；渔夫；渔人

examples.en: The Algarve is a paradise for fishermen whether river anglers or deep-sea fishermen.
examples.zh: 阿尔加维对河边的垂钓者或深海的渔民都是一个天堂。

words.definition: the line used to control the angle of the mainsail to the wind
words.translation: 主桅帆操纵索

words.definition: If you are oblivious to something or oblivious of it, you are not aware of it; amnesic, forgetful
words.translation: 没注意到, 健忘的；遗忘的；健忘的；不注意的；不知道的

examples.en: She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain.
examples.zh: 她一动不动地躺在原地，感觉不到疼痛。

words.definition: a raised frame around the cockpit or hatchway of a vessel for keeping out water; sapwood, alburnum
words.translation: 舱口栏板, 边材；天窗围坎；边材；[船]舱口栏板

examples.en: The acetic acid is corrosive. Please put them in both sides of No. 5 deck, leaving a passage between the hatch coaming and the cargo.
examples.zh: 醋酸（乙酸）有腐蚀性，请把其装在五舱甲板两边，在货物和舱口围板间留一条通道。

examples.en: The frame number marks, made of steel plate shall be welded and painted on the hatch coaming and bulwark at the place of every 10 frame-space and at every bulkhead.
examples.zh: 每隔10档肋位和每一舱壁处要用钢板割的肋位标记焊接到舱口围和舷墙上。

words.definition: a boy or young man; apple, customer, egg, guy, bird
words.translation: 少年, 青年男子；少年，小伙子；家伙

examples.en: a young lad
examples.zh: 小伙子

examples.en: Things were different when I was a lad.
examples.zh: 我年轻的时候，情况可不大相同。

words.definition: to move a part of your body, especially your head or chin, upwards or to the side; pitch, slope, lean; slope, lean; slope, pitch, clino
words.translation: (使)倾斜, 以言词或文字抨击；[航][气象]倾斜；翘起；以言词或文字抨击；[航][气象]使倾斜；使翘起

examples.en: My mother tilted her head and smiled.
examples.zh: 我妈妈歪着头笑了。

examples.en: Ned’s mouth tilted upwards slightly at the corners.
examples.zh: 内德的嘴角微微翘起。

words.definition: choppy water has a lot of waves and is not smooth to sail on; surfy, surgy
words.translation: （海等）波浪起伏的, (指风)不断改变方向的；波涛汹涌的；波浪起伏的；不断改变方向的

examples.en: The small boat bobbed about on the choppy water.
examples.zh: 小船在波浪起伏的水面上颠簸。

words.definition: someone who draws pictures, especially for books; elucidator, expositor
words.translation: 插图画家,说明者；插图画家；说明者；图解者

examples.en: Called up for military service, Mr. Marokvia spent the war as an illustrator for the Wehrmacht, applying brush and pencil in Ukraine, Italy, Finland and Yugoslavia.
examples.zh: 玛洛克维亚先生被征召入伍，他作为一名德国国防军的插图画家，在乌克兰、意大利、芬兰和南斯拉夫留下了自己的墨迹。

words.translation: 变温动物

examples.en: Determination of death in ectothermic animals may be more difficult due to differences in their physiology.
examples.zh: 断定因安乐死死亡的动物可能更为困难因为不同的动物有不同的生理情况。

words.definition: (of all animals except birds and mammals) having a body temperature that varies with the temperature of the surroundings; hematocryal, fish-blooded
words.translation: [动]变温的, 冷血动物的；[动]变温的；冷血的；冷血动物的

examples.en: Unlike most terrestrial animals, aquatic animal species used for human consumption are poikilothermic, meaning their body temperatures vary according to ambient temperatures.
examples.zh: 与大多数陆地动物不同，供人类消费的水生动物为冷血品种，也就是说它们的体温会根据环境温度而变化。

examples.en: These indeed have new comparative features in terms of the tolerance, comparing with the organisms that do not need to maintain homeostasis, such as poikilothermic organisms.
examples.zh: 这与那些不需要保持内稳态的生物如变温生物相比，的确在耐受性方面存在新的比较特点。

examples.en: Amphibians and reptiles are poikilothermic and quite sensitive to the change of ambient temperature. They adapt to environmental temperature by means of self- thermoregulation .
examples.zh: 两栖类和爬行类属于变温脊椎动物，它对外界环境温度的变化非常敏感，借助自身体温调节以适应或抵抗这种变化。

words.definition: put, to shift
words.translation: 移动, 行动；移动；行动

examples.en: Since plants cannot locomote , the sensation of experiencing pain would be superfluous. Thus, plants differ completely physiologically from mammals.
examples.zh: 由于植物无法移动，它们不太需要具备感知痛苦的能力，因此，植物与哺乳动物在生理上全然不同。

examples.en: In simulation, millions of robotic modules assemble to form a large cube robot able to locomote in many types of environments.
examples.zh: 在仿真方面，数以千计的机器人模块编译成一个可以在多种环境中移动的机器人。

words.definition: improperly, inappropriately
words.translation: 不够地,  不够好；不适当地；不够好地

words.definition: former, long-ago; beforetime, ever before
words.translation: 从前的,  一度的；从前；从前的；一度的；一度

examples.en: The onetime heir apparent had played an instrumental role this year in propping up his father's rule and his crackdown against the rebellion that ultimately ended his 42-year grip on power.
examples.zh: 曾一度作为卡扎菲继承人的赛义夫今年在巩固其父亲的统治并帮助镇压反抗武装一事中起到积极作用。 这场反抗活动最终结束了卡扎菲对利比亚42年的统治。

words.definition: a formal statement or piece of writing publicly praising someone’s actions or achievements; citing, quotation
words.translation: 引用,表扬；引用，引证；[法]传票；褒扬

examples.en: ...a 50-minute manifesto with citations from the Koran.
examples.zh: …一段长达50分钟、带有《古兰经》引文的宣言。

words.definition: rest, quiescency
words.translation: 静止, 沉静；静止；沉静

examples.en: This is your true nature, one of effortless peace and stillness.
examples.zh: 这就是你的本质，一个完全不需费力的平静和静止。

examples.en: As it is, I enjoy with something of sadness remembering that this melodious silence is but the prelude of that deeper stillness which waits to enfold us all.
examples.zh: 实际上，我带着几分悲伤喜欢回忆起这种悦耳的沉默只是比较深层的寂静的前奏，它等待着要把我们所有的人笼罩起来。

words.definition: your ability to see; vision, sight, eye, seeing
words.translation: 视力, 目力；视力；目力

examples.en: He had a problem with his eyesight.
examples.zh: 他的视力有问题。

words.definition: behaviour or situations that are comical are funny in a strange or unexpected way; funny, humouristic
words.translation: 好笑的, 滑稽的；滑稽的，好笑的

examples.en: The note of pure panic in his voice was almost comical.
examples.zh: 他那种十分慌张的口气几乎有点滑稽。

words.translation: [动]软体动物

examples.en: Atype of mollusk, the lined chiton has colorful lines on its valves andwhite or yellow spots or bands on its girdle.
examples.zh: 条纹石鳖是一种软体动物，瓣膜上有彩色条纹，条带上有白色或黄色斑点或环状物。

examples.en: "To my eye, it's pretty clearly modified by human hands, though it may originally have originated as a fossil cavity of some ancient mollusk, " Rundkvist wrote.
examples.zh: 伦德奎斯特写道，“ 按我的观点，这东西很清楚是用人手修改过的。 尽管它原来可能只是某些古代软体动物化石中空的型腔。”

examples.en: Measuring more than 16 inches (407 millimeters), this giant mollusk is the biggest ever found in its subclass--Caudofoveata.
examples.zh: 超过16英寸（407毫米）的长度，使这种大型的软体动物成为尾腔亚纲中迄今为止发现的最大的物种。

words.definition: If you rediscover something good or valuable that you had forgotten or lost, you become aware of it again or find it again
words.translation: 重新发现

examples.en: ...a one-time rebel who had rediscovered his faith.
examples.zh: ...重新发现了自己信仰的一个曾经的反叛者。

words.definition: an eminent person is famous, important, and respected; outstanding, excellent, obvious, prominent, brilliant
words.translation: 著名的,  卓越的；杰出的；有名的；明显的

examples.en: an eminent lawyer
examples.zh: 杰出的律师

words.definition: cold and without any pleasant or comfortable features; raw, wild, flat, frozen, blank
words.translation: 寒冷的,荒凉的, 黯淡的；阴冷的；荒凉的，无遮蔽的；黯淡的，无希望的；冷酷的；单调的

examples.en: a bleak January afternoon
examples.zh: 一月里一个阴冷的下午

examples.en: The landscape was bleak.
examples.zh: 景色一片凄凉。

words.definition: complete absence of sound or noise; to make someone stop talking, or stop something making a noise; still, quiescence; becalm, extinguish
words.translation: 寂静, 沉默；使沉默；沉默；寂静；缄默；不谈；无声状态；使安静；压制；消除噪音

examples.en: There was a brief silence before anyone answered.
examples.zh: 沉默了片刻才有人回答。

words.definition: to sequestrate; seclude, expropriate
words.translation: 使隐退, 扣押, 没收；使隔绝；使隐退；没收，扣押

words.definition: any multicellular animal of the group Metazoa: includes all animals except sponges; multicellular animals
words.translation: [动]后生动物(的)；后生动物；多细胞动物

examples.en: As the scientists conclude: "Our results expand the known metazoan bio-sphere and demonstrate that deep ecosystems are more complex than previously accepted.
examples.zh: 科学家总结道：“我们的研究结果扩展了已知的后生生物圈的范围，并揭示出，深层生态系统比我们之前想象的要复杂。

examples.en: Since the Middle Proterozoic, metazoan trace fossils must have undergone an irreversible evolution from simple to complicated, and from lower to higher in quality.
examples.zh: 中元古代以来后生动物遗迹的演化过程在质上经历了由简单到复杂， 由低级到高级的发展、演变过程。

words.definition: to walk, ride etc next to each other, all facing the same way; jugate, neck-and-neck
words.translation: 并肩地, 并排地；并排的；肩并肩的

examples.en: As the car drew abreast of him, Jack suddenly recognised the driver.
examples.zh: 那辆车追上来与杰克并行时，他一下子就认出了驾车的人。

words.definition: a liquid containing substances that fight infection or poison, that is put into a sick person’s blood; sera, lymph
words.translation: 浆液, 血清；[免疫]血清；浆液；免疫血清；乳清；树液

examples.en: ...painful injections of anti-cancer serum.
examples.zh: …令人痛苦的抗癌血清注射。

words.definition: epinephrine
words.translation: 肾上腺素(使激动兴奋等)；[生化]肾上腺素

examples.en: But for some people merely imagining this scene creates an adrenaline surge.
examples.zh: 但是对于某些人但是想象这一幕就会肾上腺素激增。

examples.en: Take all of the energy and adrenaline circulating through your body due to that event and use it to your advantage.
examples.zh: 利用由于那些事情而产生的能量和在你体内循环的肾上腺素做一些对你有利的事。

examples.en: It releases adrenaline and can interfere with sleep, increase tension, and decrease the immune systems ability to protect the body.
examples.zh: 它会释放肾上腺素，可以干扰睡眠，增强紧张感和降低免疫系统保护人体的能力。

words.definition: the things and people that surround you and influence the way you live and think; context, circumstance, setting, surrounding, condition
words.translation: 周围, 环境；环境；周围；出身背景

examples.en: Proust’s work reflected his own social and cultural milieu.
examples.zh: 普鲁斯特的作品反映了其所在的社会和文化背景。

examples.en: She never felt happy in a student milieu.
examples.zh: 在学生中间她从不觉得快乐。

words.definition: compensatory payments are paid to someone who has been harmed or hurt in some way; saving, indemnificatory
words.translation: 赔偿的, 补偿的；补偿的，赔偿的

examples.en: She was awarded a large sum in compensatory damages .
examples.zh: 她得到了一大笔损失赔偿金。

words.definition: If you describe a person or their attitude or behaviour as unconventional, you mean that they do not behave in the same way as most other people in their society; unorthodoxy, nontraditional
words.translation: 非传统的, 不合惯例的；非常规的；非传统的；不依惯例的

examples.en: Linus Pauling is an unconventional genius.
examples.zh: 莱纳斯·鲍林是个奇才。

examples.en: He was known for his unconventional behaviour.
examples.zh: 他曾因另类行为而出名。

words.definition: laugh at, make a mockery of; jeer at, laugh at
words.translation: 嘲笑,讥笑；嘲笑；愚弄；嘲弄

examples.en: “Please don’t gibe me,” Lydia said.
examples.zh: “请不要嘲笑我，”利迪娅说。

words.definition: operator, building owner
words.translation: 所有者, 经营者；[工经]业主；[经]所有者；经营者

examples.en: For example, many states require a sole proprietor to use their own name for the business name unless they formally file another name as a trade name, or fictitious name.
examples.zh: 举例来说，许多国家要求独资经营者使用自己的名称为业务名称，除非他们正式文件中有另一个名字作为商标名或化名。

words.definition: if there is a mess somewhere or a place is a mess, things there are dirty or not neatly arranged; to make something look untidy or dirty; difficulty, disorder, chaos, confusion, corner; destroy, soil, mud, spot, damage; play fast and loose, toy with
words.translation: 混乱, 脏乱；弄乱；混乱；食堂，伙食团；困境；脏乱的东西；弄乱，弄脏；毁坏；使就餐；把事情弄糟；制造脏乱；玩弄

examples.en: What a mess!
examples.zh: 太乱了！

examples.en: Sorry – the place is a bit of a mess .
examples.zh: 对不起——这里有些乱。

examples.en: When I got home, the house was a complete mess .
examples.zh: 我回到家时，屋子里一片狼藉。

words.definition: not sensible, or showing bad judgment; foolish, stupid, mad, doltish, insipient; stupid, fool, donkey, gump, aleck
words.translation: 愚蠢的, 可笑的；愚蠢的；傻瓜

examples.en: Stop asking silly questions.
examples.zh: 别再问傻问题了。

examples.en: You made a lot of silly mistakes .
examples.zh: 你犯了许多愚蠢的错误。

examples.en: I left my keys at home, which was a pretty silly thing to do .
examples.zh: 我干了件傻事，把钥匙落在家里了。

words.definition: using or connected with the  metric system  of weights and measures
words.translation: 米制的, 公制的

examples.en: a metric tonne
examples.zh: 一公吨

examples.en: The parts all come in metric sizes now.
examples.zh: 现在配件都采用公制规格。

words.definition: a piece of stone or wood across the top of a window or door, forming part of the frame; bressummer
words.translation: [建]楣, 过梁；[建]过梁（等于linto）

words.definition: an untapped supply, market, or talent is available but has not yet been used; undeveloped, unexploited
words.translation: 塞子未开的, 未使用的；未开发的；未使用的；塞子未开的

examples.en: Older people are an untapped resource in the employment market.
examples.zh: 年龄较大的人是就业市场中有待利用的资源。

examples.en: We believe there is untapped potential.
examples.zh: 我们相信还有潜力没有挖掘出来。

words.definition: enigmatically, uncannily
words.translation: 神秘地,  故弄玄虚地；神秘地；故弄玄虚地；难以理解地

words.definition: a fairly small enclosed area where cattle, horses etc can be kept temporarily, especially in North America; to make animals move into a corral; stall, poundage; lockon
words.translation: 畜栏；关进畜栏；环形车阵；把…关进畜栏；捕捉；把…布成车阵

examples.en: They corralled the cattle before loading them onto the truck.
examples.zh: 他们在把牛装上车以前，先把牛赶入了畜栏。

words.definition: when something bad is stopped from happening; intervention, violation, check
words.translation: 预防, 防止；预防；阻止；妨碍

examples.en: a fire prevention officer
examples.zh: 消防官员

examples.en: You know what they say, prevention is better than cure (= it is better to stop something bad from happening than to remove the problem once it has happened ) .
examples.zh: 正所谓预防胜于治疗。

words.definition: someone who writes plays; dramatist
words.translation: 剧作家

examples.en: The playwright does something remarkable in this scene, but without any impression of straining after an effect.
examples.zh: 剧作家在这场中有许多惊人妙笔，但并不给人留下竭力追求表面效果的印象。

examples.en: His plays have been translated into every major living language and are performed more often than those of any other playwright.
examples.zh: 他的剧本被翻译成所有主要使用着的语言，并且表演次数远远超过其他任何剧作家。

examples.en: His plays have been translated into every major living language and are performed more often than those of any other playwright.
examples.zh: 他的剧本被翻译成世界上多种主要语言，并且表演次数远远超过其他任何剧作家。

words.definition: A Cuban is a Cuban citizen, or a person of Cuban origin; Cuban means belonging or relating to Cuba, or to its people or culture
words.translation: 古巴人；古巴(人)的

examples.en: But he says pressure for broad reform on the next Cuban leader, from inside Cuba and outside, will grow.
examples.zh: 可是他说，来自古巴境内和境外要求古巴下任领导人进行广泛改革的压力将会增加。

examples.en: As the news spread that I was on my way out, my Cuban neighbours congratulated me on what they saw as a promotion.
