examples.zh: 某一类食品

words.definition: a group in an army with special duties and responsibilities; cohorts, legion
words.translation: 军团， 兵团；特种部队；一群人， 一组人；军团；兵种；兵队；（德国大学的）学生联合会

examples.en: the medical corps
examples.zh: 医疗部队

examples.en: the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
examples.zh: 美国陆军工程兵部队

words.definition: to stop speaking or doing something for a short time before starting again; hang, moratorium; stop, time out
words.translation: 中止， 暂停；暂停；间歇；暂停，停顿，中止；踌躇

examples.en: There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.
examples.zh: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

words.definition: a powder or liquid, such as salt or  ketchup  , that you use to give a special taste to food; seasoning, dressing
words.translation: 调味品；[食品]调味品；佐料

examples.en: Friendship is not only the condiment but also the anodyne of life.
examples.zh: 友谊是人生的调味品，也是人生的止痛药。

words.definition: the state of being or feeling certain about something; assurance, conviction
words.translation: 确定， 确信；必然性；确信；确实

words.definition: the science of numbers and of shapes, including  algebra  ,  geometry  , and  arithmetic; arith
words.translation: 数学；[数]数学；数学运算

examples.en: ...a professor of mathematics at Boston College.
examples.zh: …一位波士顿大学的数学教授。

words.definition: a  nuclear reactor
words.translation: 反应堆

examples.en: Where do you all live? Do you live near a reactor?
examples.zh: 你们都住在哪，你们接近一个反应堆吗？

examples.en: Then you have, in terms of the barrier integrity, reactor cooling systems activity, cladding failure.
examples.zh: 然后你们会有，在屏障完整性，反应堆冷却系统行为，覆盖层失效。

examples.en: For almost three years, AECL went through its calculations, but nothing changed: if its model of how the reactor functioned was correct, the PCR should be negative.
examples.zh: 在将近三年中，AECL仔细检查了枫叶的计算过程，但结果仍然如此：如果它的反应堆运行模式无误，那么PCR就应该是负值。

words.definition: a party or occasion when a meal is cooked and eaten outdoors
words.translation: 野外烧烤宴会

examples.en: a cookout on the beach
examples.zh: 海滩上的露天烧烤

words.definition: to arrange for something to happen at a different time from the one that was previously planned; replan
words.translation: 重新计划， 重订…的时间表；重新排定日程；重订时间表；重新计划

examples.en: Since I'll be away, I'd like to reschedule the meeting.
examples.zh: 既然我将要离开，我想重新安排一下这次会议的时间。

words.definition: severe, blue, dark, lowering
words.translation: 昏暗的；忧郁的；严峻的；阴天的

examples.en: In the somber archives of a sedate museum a large archaic volume is somewhat conspicuously displayed.
examples.zh: 在一个平静的博物馆中昏暗的档案室里，一本厚厚的古书被摆在了很显著的位置。

examples.en: Her 71-year-old husband, looking somber and composed, was brought into the church in a wheelchair and did not speak at the service.
examples.zh: 凯西71岁高龄的丈夫被人用轮椅推进教堂，看起来沉默忧郁，在葬礼仪式上也没有发言。

examples.en: Don't ignore it because it makes you laugh — director Paul Feig's 2011 hit deserves as much respect as any somber, wintry, subtitled drama.
examples.zh: 不要因为它让你开怀大笑而忽略了它——总监保罗·法伊格在2011年引起的这场轩然大波与其他任何忧郁、寒冷、次要的戏剧一样值得尊重。

words.definition: to refuse to buy something, use something, or take part in something as a way of protesting
words.translation: 联合抵制， 拒绝购买

examples.en: We boycott all products tested on animals.
examples.zh: 我们抵制所有拿动物做试验的产品。

words.definition: a part of every living cell that is shaped like a thread and contains the  gene s  that control the size, shape etc that a plant or animal has; monosomy, karyosome
words.translation: 染色体；[染料][遗][细胞]染色体（形容词chromosomal，副词chromosomally）

examples.en: Do we have a chromosome like that?
examples.zh: 那么我们真的有那么一条染色体么？

examples.en: She is part of the chromosome of Kolkata.
examples.zh: 她就是加尔各答染色体的一部分。

examples.en: The distances are additive along the length of the chromosome .
examples.zh: 其距离值就是沿着染色体长度方向的累加。

words.definition: a statement that you have done something wrong, illegal, or embarras-sing, especially a formal statement; shrift, peccavi
words.translation: 供认， 招供， 坦白；供词；承认；忏悔，告解；供认

examples.en: Sanchez’s confession was read out to the court.
examples.zh: 桑切斯的供词在法庭上宣读了出来。

examples.en: At 3 a.m. Higgins broke down and made a full confession .
examples.zh: 凌晨三点，希金斯崩溃了，交代了一切。

examples.en: I have a confession – I like Britney Spears’ music.
examples.zh: 我得承认，我喜欢布兰妮•斯皮尔斯的音乐。

words.definition: one of the imaginary lines from the North Pole to the South Pole, drawn on a map of the Earth; height, sky, summit, peak, crown
words.translation: 子午线， 经线；子午线，[天]经线；顶点

examples.en: Yes this is the…is the prime meridian if you like.
examples.zh: 是的，这就是本初子午线，它把地球分为东半球和西半球。

examples.en: The prime meridian of longitude is in greenwich south london.
examples.zh: 经度的本初子午线在伦敦南部的格林威治。

words.definition: If you stack a number of things, you arrange them in neat piles; a neat pile of things; pile, bing; pile, heap up
words.translation: 堆积， 堆放；堆；堆叠；堆积，堆叠

examples.en: Mrs. Cathiard was stacking the clean bottles in crates.
examples.zh: 卡提亚夫人当时正在把干净的瓶子堆放到板条箱里。

words.definition: becoming angry or excited very quickly; passionate, hotter
words.translation: 似火的；易怒的， 暴躁的；热烈的，炽烈的；暴躁的；燃烧般的

examples.en: He has a fiery temper .
examples.zh: 他脾气火爆。

words.definition: something that is ambiguous is unclear, confusing, or not certain, especially because it can be understood in more than one way; blurred
words.translation: 不明确的， 模棱两可的；模糊不清的；[数]引起歧义的

examples.en: The language in the Minister’s statement is highly ambiguous.
examples.zh: 部长的声明措辞很含糊。

examples.en: His role in the affair is ambiguous.
examples.zh: 他在这起事件中的角色并不明确。

words.definition: If you say that someone dotes on a person or a thing, you mean that they love or care about them very much and ignore any faults they may have; overindulge; overprotect, spoil
words.translation: 溺爱；昏聩

examples.en: He dotes on his nine-year-old son.
examples.zh: 他对自己9岁的儿子十分溺爱。

words.definition: to have an important or noticeable effect on someone or something; the effect or influence that an event, situation etc has on someone or something; affect, influence, reach, work on, strike; charge at; effect, impression, influence, infection, affection
words.translation: 影响；冲击， 撞击；[力]撞击；冲突；压紧；[力]冲击；产生影响；效果；[物]碰撞；[力]冲击力

examples.en: Such schemes mean little unless they impact people.
examples.zh: 除非能对人们造成影响，否则这样的计划意义不大。

words.definition: to block something or become blocked; choke with, plug up; obstacle, let, bar, dam, stop
words.translation: 堵塞，阻塞；障碍；阻塞；木底鞋

examples.en: tourists whose cars clog the roads each summer
examples.zh: 每年夏天开着汽车堵塞道路的游客

words.definition: if a hollow part of your body dilates or if something dilates it, it becomes wider; extend, fill; expand, exaggerate
words.translation: 膨胀， 扩大；详述；扩大；膨胀；使扩大；使膨胀

examples.en: dilated pupils
examples.zh: 扩大的瞳孔

words.definition: to officially arrange for someone to have something that you own after your death; will, hand down
words.translation: 遗赠；流传；把…遗赠给；把…传下去

examples.en: He bequeathed all his silver to his children.
examples.zh: 他把所有的银币都留给了他的孩子们。

words.definition: to talk too proudly about what you have done, what you own etc – used to show disapproval; fanfaronade, blague; boast of, hot air; hot air, talk horse
words.translation: 吹嘘， 自夸， 自吹自擂；吹牛，自夸；吹牛，吹嘘

examples.en: ‘I came out top in the test,’ he bragged.
examples.zh: “我测验得了最高分。”他吹嘘道。

words.definition: slightly angry; peeved, irritated; hassled
words.translation: 生气的；恼怒的；烦闷的；使烦恼；打扰（annoy的过去分词）

examples.en: I’ll be annoyed if we don’t finish by eight.
examples.zh: 如果我们8点还未完成，我会生气的。

words.definition: a word or expression with a particular meaning, especially one that is used for a specific subject or type of language; to use a particular word or expression to name or describe something; technology, item, session, provision, article
words.translation: 学期；期限，期间；条件，条款；术语；把…称为；期限；条款

examples.en: Teachers often feel overworked in term time (= during the term ) .
examples.zh: 教师在学期内经常觉得工作担子过重。

words.definition: a date or time by which you have to do or complete something
words.translation: 最后期限， 截止时间

examples.en: I’m always working under pressure to meet deadlines (= finish something on time ) .
examples.zh: 我总是在赶工期的压力下工作。

words.definition: used to describe someone or something that has been given a name that you think is wrong; alleged
words.translation: 所谓的；号称的

examples.en: The so-called experts couldn’t tell us what was wrong.
examples.zh: 那些所谓的专家说不出问题出在哪里。

words.definition: if an activity or situation involves something, that thing is part of it or a result of it; contain, comprise
words.translation: 包含；牵涉， 牵连；使参加；牵涉；使陷于；潜心于

examples.en: What will the job involve?
examples.zh: 这份工作包括什么？

examples.en: I didn’t realize putting on a play involved so much work.
examples.zh: 我没想到上演一出戏剧需要做这么多的工作。

words.definition: difficult to understand or deal with, because many parts or details are involved; involved, detailed, sophisticated, elusive
words.translation: 难懂的， 复杂的；难懂的，复杂的

examples.en: a complicated voting system
examples.zh: 复杂的选举制度

examples.en: For young children, getting dressed is a complicated business.
examples.zh: 对幼童来说，穿衣服是件复杂的事。

words.definition: a plan that states exactly what students at a school or college should learn in a particular subject; abstract, brief, summary, resume
words.translation: 教学大纲， 课程提纲；教学大纲，摘要；课程表

examples.en: The course syllabus consisted mainly of novels by African-American authors, male and female.
examples.zh: 该课程的教学大纲主要包括了非裔美国男女作家的小说。

words.definition: having a pleasant smell; sweet, good, bright, aromatic
words.translation: 芬芳的， 香的；芳香的；愉快的

examples.en: fragrant flowers
examples.zh: 芳香的花朵

words.definition: if something impels you to do something, it makes you feel very strongly that you must do it; drive, stimulate, force, power, impulse
words.translation: 驱使， 促使；推动；驱使；激励

examples.en: ...the courage and competitiveness which impels him to take risks.
examples.zh: ...驱策他冒险的勇气和竞争精神。

words.definition: determined not to change your opinion or a decision that you have made; fixed, strong, persistent, tough, steel; solid rock
words.translation: 坚定不移的， 坚决的；固执的；固执的，坚强的；坚定不移的；坚硬无比的；坚硬的东西；坚石

examples.en: She begged me to change my mind, but I remained adamant .
examples.zh: 她求我改变主意，但我坚决不肯。

words.definition: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people; thoughtful, wary
words.translation: 考虑周到的， 体贴的， 体谅的；体贴的；体谅的；考虑周到的

examples.en: I think he's the most charming, most considerate man I've ever known.
examples.zh: 我觉得他是我所认识的最有魅力、最体贴的男士。

words.definition: molten metal or rock has been made into a liquid by being heated to a very high temperature; fusional, fused
words.translation: 熔化的， 熔融的；熔化的；铸造的；炽热的

examples.en: molten iron
examples.zh: 熔铁

words.definition: to move away from the place you should be; a stray animal, such as a dog or cat, is lost or has no home; lose oneself, vagabondize; astray; Vagabonds, Nads
words.translation: 迷路；分心，走神；离题；迷路的；流浪；偏离；[动]离群的；偶遇的；走失的家畜；流浪者

examples.en: Tourists often get lost and stray into dangerous areas.
examples.zh: 旅游者们经常迷路走进一些危险区域。

words.definition: consisting of or including many different kinds of things or people, especially in a way that seems interesting; shot, polytropical; changed
words.translation: 各式各样的；多变的；杂色的；改变；使多样化（vary的过去式和过去分词形式）

examples.en: a varied diet
examples.zh: 丰富多样的饮食

examples.en: The responsibilities of government are many, and they are varied.
examples.zh: 政府有很多职责，而且各不相同。

words.definition: something that is intriguing is very interesting because it is strange, mysterious, or unexpected; colorful, funny, killing, taking; brewing
words.translation: 引起兴趣的， 吸引人的；有趣的；迷人的；引起…的兴趣；策划阴谋；私通（intrigue的ing形式）

examples.en: The magazine carries an intriguing mixture of high fashion, gossip and racing.
examples.zh: 这本杂志内容丰富有趣，有关时尚、花边新闻和赛马的内容都有。

words.definition: a drawing that uses a line or lines to show how two or more sets of measurements are related to each other; chart, diagram
words.translation: 图表；曲线图

examples.en: Martin showed me a graph of their recent sales.
examples.zh: 马丁给我看了他们最近销售情况的图表。

words.definition: to eat a lot of a particular food with great enjoyment; a large meal where a lot of people celebrate a special occasion; enjoy, guest; festival, holiday; banquet
words.translation: 尽情享用；节日；盛宴，宴会；享受；款待，宴请；筵席，宴会；参加宴会

examples.en: We feasted on chicken and roast potatoes.
examples.zh: 我们饱餐了一顿鸡肉和烤土豆。

words.definition: done in order to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening; preventing, mindful
words.translation: 预防的；留心的；预先警戒的

examples.en: More troops were sent to the area as a precautionary measure .
examples.zh: 为谨慎起见，更多的军队被派往该地区。

words.definition: to try to deal with a difficult problem; an attempt to stop an opponent by forcing them to the ground, especially in American football or  rugby; equipment, tool, arm, setup; grasp, root, cope with
words.translation: 对付，处理；阻截；抢球；拦截；用具；[机]滑车；装备；扭倒；处理；抓住；固定；与…交涉

examples.en: There is more than one way to tackle the problem.
examples.zh: 解决这个问题不止一个办法。

examples.en: It took twelve fire engines to tackle the blaze .
examples.zh: 出动了12辆消防车来扑救那场大火。

words.definition: having enough money to pay your debts; a chemical that is used to  dissolve  another substance; resolvent; impregnant, menstruum
words.translation: 有溶解力的；有偿付能力的；溶剂；[化学]有溶解力的；[化学]溶剂；解决方法

examples.en: They're going to have to show that the company is now solvent.
examples.zh: 他们将不得不证明公司现在是具备偿债能力的。

words.definition: not wearing any clothes; naked, austere; birthday suit, altogether
words.translation: 裸体的；裸的，裸体的；无装饰的；与生俱有的；裸体；裸体画

examples.en: I did some work as a nude model when I was in college.
examples.zh: 我上大学的时候当过裸体模特。

examples.en: Have you ever posed nude (= been photographed or painted while nude )?
examples.zh: 你拍过裸体照吗？

words.definition: the  roof (= top inside part )  of your mouth; interest, gustation
words.translation: 上腭；味觉， 品尝力；味觉；上颚；趣味

examples.en: It tasted very strange, at least to my untrained palate.
examples.zh: 这东西尝起来怪怪的，至少对于我这未经训练的味觉来说是如此。

words.definition: an infectious disease that is like a very bad cold; grippe, feveret
words.translation: 流行性感冒；[中医][内科]流行性感冒（简写flu）；家畜流行性感冒

examples.en: All the medical workers in the region helped to put down the influenza epidemic.
examples.zh: 这个地区的所有医务工作者参加了消灭流行性感冒的工作。

examples.en: People should therefore continue to seek seasonal influenza vaccination like any other year.
examples.zh: 因此，人们应当像以往一样继续接种季节性流感疫苗。

words.definition: to hit your open hands together, to show that you have enjoyed a play, concert, speaker etc; go along with, be favorable to; cheer for, give it up
words.translation: 鼓掌， 喝彩；称赞；赞同；向…喝采；喝彩；鼓掌欢迎

examples.en: The audience applauded loudly.
examples.zh: 观众掌声雷动。

examples.en: A crowd of 300 supporters warmly applauded her speech.
examples.zh: 300名支持者为她的演讲热烈鼓掌。

words.definition: behaving in an unpleasant or rude way because you think you are more important than other people; haughty, cocky
words.translation: 傲慢的， 自大的；自大的，傲慢的

examples.en: He was unbearably arrogant.
examples.zh: 他的傲慢让人无法忍受。

examples.en: an arrogant attitude
examples.zh: 傲慢的态度

words.definition: if the police apprehend a criminal, they catch him or her; see, absorb, read, seize; worry, cotton on
words.translation: 逮捕；领会， 理解；理解；忧虑；担心

examples.en: The police have failed to apprehend the culprits.
examples.zh: 警方未能拘捕罪犯。

words.definition: causing so much damage or harm that something no longer works or is no longer effective; weakening
words.translation: 令人震惊的；严重损害身体的；极其有害的；削弱（cripple的ing形式）；使受损

examples.en: the crippling effects of war on the economy
examples.zh: 战争给经济造成的毁灭性影响

words.definition: to get back an amount of money you have lost or spent; replace, restore, repair, tender, withdraw
words.translation: 收回， 弥补；收回；恢复；偿还；扣除

examples.en: The movie will have to be a huge hit to recoup its cost.
examples.zh: 这部电影必须大获成功才能收回成本。

examples.en: He was desperate to try and recoup his losses.
examples.zh: 他不顾一切地试图挽回损失。

words.definition: to add something to a piece of writing; attach, annex
words.translation: 附加， 增补；附加；贴上；盖章

examples.en: She appended a note at the end of the letter.
examples.zh: 她在信件尾部附加了一个说明。

words.definition: a short written report of news about a club, organization etc that is sent regularly to people who are interested
words.translation: 时事通讯

examples.en: The society publishes a newsletter twice a year.
examples.zh: 该社团一年出版两次简报。

words.translation: 副驾驶员

examples.en: That's me, the copilot, and one of the air stewardesses.
examples.zh: 那是我、副驾驶员还有我们的一名女乘务员。

examples.en: That's me, the copilot, and one of the air stewardesses is a recording.
examples.zh: 那是我、 副驾驶员还有我们的一名女乘务员。

words.definition: A bellows is or bellows are a device used for blowing air into a fire in order to make it burn more fiercely; corrugated pipe, corrugated tube
words.translation: 风箱；[机]波纹管；皮老虎

examples.en: Music bellows from his insides.
examples.zh: 来自他的肚子的音乐风箱。

examples.en: Yawning helps keep the brain cool, and the sinuses play a role in that process by acting as bellows, a new report suggests.
examples.zh: 一份新的报道显示，哈欠能够帮助大脑保持凉爽，鼻窦在这个过程中所起的作用就像是风箱。

examples.en: Or every bellows burst, be happy Still.
examples.zh: 每一只风箱爆炸，她也能开颜。

words.definition: a reduction in the usual price of something; to reduce the price of something; agio, rabato; water sth. down, preach down
words.translation: 折扣；把…打折扣；不全信， 漠视， 低估；[贸易]折扣；[金融]贴现率；[贸易]打折扣；将…贴现；贬损

examples.en: They are often available at a discount.
examples.zh: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

words.definition: a natural ability to attract and interest other people and make them admire you; grace, fascination
words.translation: 超凡魅力；感召力；号召力；魅力；神授的能力；非凡的领导力

examples.en: He lacks charisma.
examples.zh: 他缺乏个人魅力。

words.translation: 家长的， 族长的；德高望重的

words.definition: a large amount of water moving very quickly and strongly in a particular direction; transfusion, decantation
words.translation: 洪流， 急流；爆发， 迸发；奔流；倾注；迸发；连续不断

examples.en: After five days of heavy rain the Telle river was a raging torrent (= a very violent torrent ) .
examples.zh: 下了五天的大雨之后，泰勒河急流汹涌。

words.definition: to make beer; a drink that is brewed, especially tea; vint, vinify; impend; beer, texture
words.translation: 酿造；冲泡；酝酿，行将发生；冲泡的饮料；啤酒；酝酿；酿酒；被冲泡；即将发生；质地

examples.en: Every beer on the menu was brewed locally.
examples.zh: 酒单上的所有啤酒都是本地酿造的。

words.definition: behaving in a very honest and moral way; straight, square, just
words.translation: 有道德的， 品行端正的， 品德高的；〈贬〉自命清高的， 自以为是的；善良的；有道德的；贞洁的；正直的；有效力的

examples.en: a virtuous man
examples.zh: 品行端正的男子

examples.en: Sue considered herself very virtuous because she neither drank nor smoked.
examples.zh: 休认为自己品行非常端正，因为她既不喝酒也不抽烟。

words.definition: a contract, ticket, claim etc that is invalid is not legally or officially acceptable; someone who cannot look after themselves because of illness, old age, or injury; useless, disabled, ineffective; sick, patient
words.translation: 无效的；无可靠根据的， 站不住脚的；病弱者， 残疾者；有病的；残废的；病人；[医]残废者

examples.en: Without the right date stamped on it, your ticket will be invalid.
examples.zh: 票上若没有加盖正确日期就是废票。

words.definition: when you are famous and a lot of people admire you for a special skill, achievement, or quality; prestige, fame
words.translation: 名望， 声誉；声誉；名望

examples.en: He achieved some renown as a football player.
examples.zh: 作为足球运动员，他小有名气。

words.definition: relating to the meanings of words
words.translation: 语义的

examples.en: He did not want to enter into a semantic debate.
examples.zh: 他不想卷入一场关于语义的争论。

words.definition: to remove something from the surface of a liquid, especially floating fat, solids, or oil; conceal, hold back; page, brush; nonfat, defatted
words.translation: 撇去；掠过， 擦过；浏览， 略读；略读；撇去…的浮物；从…表面飞掠而过；去除；（为逃税而）隐瞒（部分收入）；浏览；掠过；脱脂的；撇去浮沫的；表层的

examples.en: Julie skimmed the sports page.
examples.zh: 朱莉浏览了体育版。

words.definition: to not do something that you usually do or that you should do; a skipping movement; dance, to leap; jump, clear; jump, spring
words.translation: 跳；跳过，略过，漏过；不出席；跳过；跳跃；跳绳；遗漏；跳读

examples.en: She skipped lunch in order to go shopping.
examples.zh: 为了去购物，她没有吃午饭。

examples.en: Williams skipped the game to be with his wife in the hospital.
examples.zh: 威廉斯为了在医院里陪他妻子而放弃了这场比赛。

words.definition: to become liquid, or make something become liquid; solve, resolve
words.translation: 溶解， 液化；液化；溶解

examples.en: A process that is used to liquefy nitrogen.
examples.zh: 用来使氮液化的过程。

examples.en: You can liquefy the carbon dioxide to separate it from the other constituents.
examples.zh: 可以将二氧化碳液化，以便和其他成分分开。

examples.en: The alternative is to liquefy the hydrogen at great expense and transport it in road tankers refrigerated with liquid nitrogen.
examples.zh: 唯一的代替方法是花大价钱用液氮作为冷却剂液化氢气，用罐车从公路上运输。

words.definition: If there is an exodus of people from a place, a lot of people leave that place at the same time
words.translation: 大批离去， 成群外出

examples.en: The medical system is facing collapse because of an exodus of doctors.
examples.zh: 由于医生大批离去，该医疗体系正面临崩溃。

words.definition: to talk or write about something or someone, usually quickly and without saying very much or giving details; indicate to, make reference to; reference, allusion
words.translation: 提及， 说起；提到，谈到；提及，论及；说起；提及，说起

examples.en: Was my name mentioned at all?
examples.zh: 我的名字被提到过吗？

examples.en: Some of the problems were mentioned in his report.
examples.zh: 其中的一些问题在他的报告里提到了。

examples.en: (= it is important enough to mention ) that they only studied a very small number of cases.
examples.zh: 必须说明的是他们仅研究了几个个案。

words.definition: off the point, irrelevance
words.translation: 离题， 扯到枝节上；题外话， 枝节内容；离题；脱轨

words.definition: to do or give something very unwillingly; a feeling of dislike for someone because you cannot forget that they harmed you in the past; spare, begrudge; spite, hatred
words.translation: 勉强做；不情愿地给；怨恨，积怨；怀恨；吝惜；妒忌；不情愿做；怨恨；恶意

examples.en: Mr Gillis was not normally a man to bear grudges .
examples.zh: 吉利斯先生通常不是那种会积怨的人。

examples.en: I’m not harbouring some secret grudge against you.
examples.zh: 我没有对你暗地里怀恨在心。

examples.en: It could be the work of someone with a grudge against the company.
examples.zh: 这事可能是某些对公司怀有怨愤的人干的。

words.definition: a union of two or more political parties that allows them to form a government or fight an election together; combination, alliance, combined with, unity, union, association, marriage
words.translation: 联盟， 同盟；结合， 联合；联合；结合，合并

examples.en: the centre-right coalition government
examples.zh: 政治上中间偏右的联合政府

examples.en: an emergency meeting of the three coalition parties
examples.zh: 三个联盟政党召开的一次紧急会议

words.definition: a natural dark brown colour in human skin, hair, and eyes
words.translation: 黑色素

examples.en: If cure is undeserved, activationed its melanin cell, sequential meeting is more serious ah.
examples.zh: 假如治疗不当，激活了它的黑色素细胞，后果会更严重的啊。

examples.en: This caused them to lose their ongoing ability to make new melanin, the pigment that gives color to hair and skin.
examples.zh: 这将致使其失去现有制造新黑色素的功能，而正是由于这种色素，毛发和皮肤才有颜色。

examples.en: Galanin, cocaine and amphetamine regulated transcript peptide (CART) and melanin concentrating hormone (MCH), etc. , which were related to the regulation of appetite, were expressed in pituitary.
examples.zh: 垂体表达甘丙肽、可卡因和安非他明调节的转录肽（CART）及黑色素浓集激素（MCH）等与食欲调节有关的激素。

words.definition: to completely understand and begin to use new ideas, information etc; absorb, drink in; drink in, suck up
words.translation: 透彻理解， 吸收， 消化；同化；吸收；使同化；把…比作；使相似

examples.en: It will take time to assimilate all these facts.
examples.zh: 充分掌握所有这些情况需要时间。

words.definition: morally good or correct; moral; prescription medicine, prescription drugs
words.translation: 道德的；伦理的；凭处方出售的；处方药

examples.en: I don’t think it’s ethical for you to accept a job you know you can’t do.
examples.zh: 我觉得接受一份自知无法胜任的工作是不道德的。

examples.en: ethical investment policies (= investing only in businesses that are considered morally acceptable )
examples.zh: 合乎道德的投资策略

words.definition: food used to attract fish, animals, or birds so that you can catch them; If you bait a hook or trap, you put bait on it or in it; harry, worry, trouble, tear, induce; gentle, lure
words.translation: 鱼饵，诱饵；下诱饵；激怒；引诱；在…中放诱饵；折磨；饵；诱饵

examples.en: We used worms as bait.
examples.zh: 我们用小虫子作诱饵。

examples.en: The fish wouldn’t take the bait .
examples.zh: 鱼儿不上钩。

examples.en: He baited his hook with pie.
examples.zh: 他把馅饼放在钓钩上作饵。

words.definition: to make a sudden strong movement towards someone or something, especially to attack them; thorn, thrust; stick, pink; run through, poke
words.translation: 猛冲， 猛扑；刺；跃进；刺进；套马索；戳；使前冲；突进

examples.en: He lunged at me, grabbing me violently.
examples.zh: 他向我猛冲过来，狠狠地抓住了我。

words.definition: intended to deceive people in an illegal way, in order to gain money, power etc; crank-sided, knavish
words.translation: 欺诈的， 欺骗性的；欺骗性的；不正的

examples.en: a fraudulent insurance claim
examples.zh: 欺诈性保险索赔

examples.en: a fraudulent statement
examples.zh: 骗人的声明

words.definition: a number, amount etc that is not exact, but is almost correct; neighborhood, proximity
words.translation: 接近；近似值；[数]近似法

examples.en: That is a fair approximation of the way in which the next boss is being chosen.
examples.zh: 那是一个挑选下任老板的大体近似方式。

words.definition: to make someone feel slightly confused, embarrassed, or worried; destroy, undermine
words.translation: 使惊慌， 使不安；使困惑；使仓皇失措；破坏

examples.en: His compliments disconcerted her a little.
examples.zh: 他的恭维让她有点儿尴尬。

words.definition: to act in a play with too much emotion or movement – used to show disapproval; ham
words.translation: 把表演得过火；表现做作；夸张表演；表演过火

examples.en: Sometimes he had overacted in his role as Prince.
examples.zh: 有时，他把王子的角色过度演绎了。

words.definition: to stop someone or something from getting or achieving what they want; error, mistake, obstacle, let, bar; stem, block, dispute, lose, prohibit; daiker, hang back
words.translation: 畏缩；阻止；妨碍；障碍；错误；推诿；错过；犹豫；突然止步不前

examples.en: Even biology undergraduates may balk at animal experiments.
examples.zh: 即使是生物专业的大学生都可能会反对动物实验。

words.definition: a small piece of metal or a wire that is used to send electricity through a system or through a person’s body; electric pole, terminal post
words.translation: 电极；[电]电极；电焊条

examples.en: The monkeys have electrodes implanted into the brain to measure their brain activity.
examples.zh: 这些猴子的脑中植入了电极，以监测其大脑活动。

words.definition: to sleep for longer than you intended; sleep in
words.translation: 睡过头；睡得过久

examples.en: Sorry I'm late. I overslept.
examples.zh: 很抱歉我迟到了，我睡过头了。

words.definition: having little or no hair on your head; flat, blank, naked
words.translation: 光秃的， 秃头的；简单的， 单调的；[地理]秃顶的；光秃的；单调的；无装饰的

examples.en: a bald man
examples.zh: 一名秃顶男子

examples.en: his shiny bald head
examples.zh: 他那亮闪闪的光头

examples.en: Dad started going bald when he was in his thirties.
examples.zh: 爸爸在三十多岁的时候开始谢顶。

words.definition: a long piece of music in which a large group of people sing; cantata
words.translation: 清唱剧， 宗教剧；清唱剧；宗教剧

examples.en: Its peaks are the symphony and the oratorio.
examples.zh: 其顶峰为交响乐和清唱剧。

examples.en: Haydn wrote his oratorio The Creation and another equally splendid work for voices, The Seasons.
examples.zh: 海顿写了清唱剧《创世纪》和另一首也同样很出色的声乐作品《四季》。

examples.en: In an oratorio, soloists take the roles of characters in a loosely constructed story while the chorus adds detail and responds to the action.
examples.zh: 在清唱剧中，独奏者们在松散的构建故事中扮演了角色并对此做了反应。

words.definition: a beam of radiation1 that can go through solid objects and is used for photographing the inside of the body
words.translation: X射线， X光；X光照片

examples.en: The X-ray showed that her leg was not broken.
examples.zh: X光片显示她的腿没有骨折。

words.definition: related to someone’s body rather than their mind or emotions; a thorough examination of someone’s body by a doctor, in order to discover whether they are healthy or have any illnesses or medical problems; personal, material, natural; medical examination, check-up
words.translation: 物理的；物质的，有形的；身体的，肉体的；体检；[物]物理的；身体的；物质的；体格检查

examples.en: She was in constant physical pain.
examples.zh: 她一直感到身上疼痛。

examples.en: the physical and emotional needs of young adults
examples.zh: 青年人的身心需求

examples.en: people with severe physical disabilities
examples.zh: 身体重度残疾的人

words.definition: two ideas that are opposed to each other are completely different from each other; contrary, adverse, counter, cross; negatived
words.translation: 反对的；截然不同的；相反的；敌对的；反对（oppose的过去分词）；使对立

examples.en: The principles of capitalism and socialism are diametrically opposed (= completely opposite ).
examples.zh: 资本主义的原则与社会主义的原则截然相反。

words.definition: to learn about something so that you understand it, or to teach someone else about something so that they understand it; acquaint sb. with
words.translation: 使熟悉

examples.en: Employees must familiarize themselves with the health and safety manual.
examples.zh: 雇员必须熟悉健康和安全手册。

words.definition: the act of apportioning; allocation, distribution, assignment
words.translation: 分派， 分摊， 分配；分摊；分配；分派

words.definition: registration, entry
words.translation: 登记， 注册；入学；登记；入伍

words.definition: to become ripe or to make something ripe; age, mellow; age, mature, flower
words.translation: 成熟；使成熟

examples.en: The apples were ripening on the trees.
examples.zh: 树上的苹果都熟了。

words.definition: a type of white stone with changing colours in it, often used in jewellery; cat's-eye
words.translation: 蛋白石；猫眼石，[矿物]蛋白石；乳白玻璃

words.definition: If your hair curls or if you curl it, it is full of curls; a piece of hair that hangs in a curved shape; crisp; wave, wavy hair
words.translation: 卷曲，蜷缩；卷发；卷曲状；卷曲物；[纸]卷曲；盘绕；螺旋状物

examples.en: She has hair that refuses to curl.
examples.zh: 她的头发怎么也不卷。

examples.en: Maria had curled her hair for the event.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚为这次活动卷了头发。

words.definition: a situation in which there are very few of something that people want or need; shortage, deficiency, short of, need, drought
words.translation: 缺乏， 短缺；缺乏；饥馑；粮食不足

examples.en: EXCEPT as Pearl, in the dearth of human playmates, was thrown more upon the visionary throng which she created.
examples.zh: 只不过是由于缺乏玩伴，她同自己创造出来的幻想中的人群更加接近而己。

examples.en: So for now, this dearth of data means that scientists must rely on climate models to estimate the effects of large-scale burning by aborigines.
examples.zh: 所以现在数据的缺乏也就意味着科学家必须依靠气候模型来估计土著大规模焚烧对于气候的影响。

examples.en: See there is no dearth of knowledge and entrepreneurial skills in we Indians. The only question is that shall we be considered while opting for technology from abroad?
examples.zh: 看到没有，我们印度人并不缺乏知识与创业技能。唯一的问题在于我们在追求外国技术的同时有没有考虑去挖掘自身的能力。

words.definition: feeling or showing scorn; sniffish, contemptuous
words.translation: 轻蔑的， 鄙视的；轻蔑的

examples.en: a scornful look
examples.zh: 轻蔑的表情

words.definition: a chemical substance found in your blood. Too much cholesterol in your body may cause heart disease.
words.translation: 胆固醇

examples.en: So why would you want to lower your cholesterol?
examples.zh: 那么为什么你想降低你的胆固醇呢？

examples.en: If it does, you should discuss with your physician other approaches to cholesterol control.
examples.zh: 若确实如此，您应该与您的医生讨论其他控制胆固醇方法。

examples.en: "In order to prevent this oxidation of cholesterol, we need to consume antioxidants, preferably natural antioxidants that you get from fruits and vegetables, " he said in an interview.
examples.zh: “为了防止这种胆固醇氧化，我们需要消耗抗氧化剂，最好是从水果和蔬菜得到的天然抗氧化剂， ”他在接受采访时说道。

words.definition: helping people, or resulting in something good; eleemosynary
words.translation: 有益的；行善的， 慈善的；慈善的；善行的

examples.en: the beneficent properties of natural remedies
examples.zh: 自然疗法的益处

words.definition: Gilding is a layer of gold or gold paint that is put on something; gold plated, gilt
words.translation: 镀金；贴金层， 镀金层；金色涂层；[化工]镀金；虚饰的外观

examples.en: A thin layer of gold or something simulating gold that is applied in gilding.
examples.zh: 镀金，包金一层薄的涂金层或其适用于镀金的仿金物。

words.definition: an oily liquid with a strong pleasant smell that you rub into your skin, often to reduce pain; sesame oil
words.translation: 香脂油， 药膏；镇痛剂， 安慰剂；香油；镇痛软膏；香峰草，[树脂][药]香树膏

examples.en: lip balm
examples.zh: 润唇膏

words.definition: not drunk; to become more serious in behaviour or attitude, or to make someone become more serious; cool, philosophical; disenchant
words.translation: 清醒的，未醉的；持重的，冷静的；素净的；清醒；变得冷静；冷静的，清醒的；未醉的；使严肃；使醒酒，使清醒

examples.en: He’s a nice guy when he’s sober.
examples.zh: 他没喝醉时是个不错的家伙。

words.definition: to officially force someone to leave a school or organization; remove, oust
words.translation: 开除；驱逐；排出

examples.en: More than five-thousand high school students have been expelled for cheating.
examples.zh: 五千多名中学生因考试作弊而被开除。

words.definition: the state or condition of being external; configuration, profile, shell
words.translation: 外部性， 外界效应；外在性；外形；外部事物

words.definition: to increase the value, amount, effectiveness etc of something; improve, gain, accelerate, make, grow in; enhance, boost, jack, mount, hot; enhancement, increase, gain, rise, accession
words.translation: 增加， 提高；增加；增大

examples.en: Any surplus was sold to augment their income.
examples.zh: 所有多余的东西被售卖一空来增加他们的收入。

words.definition: a straight line that touches the outside of a curve but does not cut across it; contiguous, excursive
words.translation: 切线的， 相切的；切线；正切；[数]切线的，相切的；接触的；离题的

examples.en: Both of approaching and returning movements are along the tangent of the circle.
examples.zh: 绕转之后移动方向为自南向北，也是沿圆周的切线运动。

examples.en: The setting of road shape instruction along highway in mountain area was discussed using tangent offset method in road survey.
examples.zh: 运用公路测量学上的切线支距法对线形诱导标在山区高速公路的设置进行了探讨。

examples.en: Of a dielectric the product of dielectric constant and the tangent of its dielectric loss angle; a measure of the heating effect which occurs in dielectrics.
examples.zh: 对于电介质来说，它是介电常数和介质损耗角的正切的乘积，这是对出现在电介质中的热效应的量度。

words.definition: to give a decision in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a crime; conduct oneself, represent, bear oneself
words.translation: 宣告无罪；表现；无罪释放；脱卸义务和责任；清偿

examples.en: All the defendants were acquitted.
examples.zh: 所有被告都被判无罪。

words.definition: a severe snowstorm; snowstorm, bizzard
words.translation: 暴风雪， 大风雪；暴风雪，大风雪；大打击

examples.en: We got stuck in a blizzard.
examples.zh: 我们被暴风雪困住了。

words.definition: a complicated official system that is annoying or confusing because it has a lot of rules, processes etc
words.translation: 官僚主义， 官僚作风；政府机构， 官僚机构

examples.en: the reduction of unnecessary bureaucracy
examples.zh: 消除不必要的官僚体制

words.definition: the study in  mathematics  of the angles and shapes formed by the relationships of lines, surfaces, and solid objects in space
words.translation: 几何， 几何学

examples.en: ...the very ordered way in which mathematics and geometry describe nature.
examples.zh: …数学和几何学描述自然的条理性。

words.definition: extremely unlikely to be true or to happen; strained
words.translation: 牵强的；牵强附会的

examples.en: All this may sound a bit far-fetched, but companies are already developing ‘intelligent’ homes.
examples.zh: 这一切听起来也许有点难以置信，但的确有一些公司已经在开发“智能”房屋了。

words.definition: someone who is very skilled at a particular  craft; workman, artisan
words.translation: 能工巧匠， 手艺人， 工艺师；[劳经]工匠；手艺人；技工

examples.en: The table in the kitchen was made by a local craftsman.
examples.zh: 厨房里的桌子是当地一名工匠做的。

words.definition: not usual or normal; novel, variable, exceptional, exquisite
words.translation: 越轨的；异常的；畸变的；脱离常轨的；迷乱的

examples.en: aberrant behaviour
examples.zh: 异常行为

words.definition: to run easily with long steps
words.translation: 轻松地大步跑；轻快的步伐

examples.en: He was loping across the sand toward Nancy.
examples.zh: 他正穿过沙滩轻快地向南希跑去。

words.definition: a curved shape like a circle, but with two slightly longer and flatter sides; elliptical shape, elipse
words.translation: 椭圆， 椭圆形；[数]椭圆形，椭圆

examples.en: The Earth orbits in an ellipse.
examples.zh: 地球沿椭圆形轨道运动。

words.definition: a large case with a handle, used for carrying clothes and possessions when you travel; carrying case, hold-all
words.translation: 手提箱， 衣箱；[轻]手提箱；衣箱

examples.en: It did not take Andrew long to pack a suitcase.
examples.zh: 安德鲁没有用多长时间就整理好了手提箱。

words.definition: to put something in the opposite position to the one it was in before, especially by turning it upside down (= the bottom is on the top and the top is on the bottom ); coup
words.translation: 使倒转， 使倒置， 使颠倒；使…转化；使…颠倒；使…反转；使…前后倒置

examples.en: Invert the cake onto a serving plate.
examples.zh: 把蛋糕倒扣过来放到一个盘子上。

words.definition: to deliberately end a  pregnancy  when the baby is still too young to live; miscarry, come to an untimely end; discontinue
words.translation: 夭折， 中止；使流产；流产；堕胎；夭折；发育不全；使中止

examples.en: The rescue mission had to be aborted.
examples.zh: 救援任务不得不停止。

words.definition: the number by which an unknown quantity is multiplied; parameter, rate, modulus; cooperative, collaborative
words.translation: 系数；[数]系数；率；协同因素；合作的；共同作用的

examples.en: In 8pq, the coefficient of pq is 8.
examples.zh: 在8pq中pq的系数为8。

words.definition: a piece of equipment, especially electrical equipment, such as a  cooker  or  washing machine  , used in people’s homes; device, apparatus, installation, unit, tool
words.translation: 用具， 器具；装置；器具；器械；[机]装置

examples.en: He could also learn to use the vacuum cleaner, the washing machine and other household appliances.
examples.zh: 他还能学习使用吸尘器、洗衣机和其他家用电器。

words.definition: to delay something until a later date; delay, to postpone; respite
words.translation: 推迟， 延期；推迟；延期；服从；使推迟；使延期

examples.en: The committee deferred their decision .
examples.zh: 委员会延期作出决定。

words.definition: tired and almost asleep; slumbrous, hypnogenetic
words.translation: 昏昏欲睡的；催眠的；沉寂的

examples.en: The drug can make you drowsy.
examples.zh: 这种药会让人昏昏欲睡。

words.definition: involving or intended for a very large number of people; all the ordinary people in society who do not have power or influence; piece, block, lots of, wealth, ocean, sea; concentrated, intensive, wholesale; concentrate, collect, crowd
words.translation: 大量的；质量；块，团；众多；群众，平民百姓；群众，民众；大量，众多；群众的，民众的；大规模的，集中的；聚集起来，聚集

examples.en: a mass protest
examples.zh: 大规模的抗议

examples.en: weapons of mass destruction
examples.zh: 大规模杀伤性武器

examples.en: the problem of mass unemployment
examples.zh: 大批人失业的问题

words.definition: muggy weather is unpleasantly warm and the air seems wet; wet, stuffy
words.translation: 闷热的；潮湿的

examples.en: It was muggy and overcast.
examples.zh: 那天天气闷热又潮湿，阴沉沉的。

words.definition: to officially state that a law, decision, or agreement is no longer effective; recall, unsay
words.translation: 撤销， 撤回；取消， 废除；撤回，取消；废除

examples.en: Their work permits have been revoked.
examples.zh: 他们的工作许可证被吊销了。

words.definition: to use a particular amount of time for something, or give a particular share of money, space etc to someone or something; portion, part
words.translation: 分配， 配给， 拨给；分配；拨给；分派

examples.en: The seats are allotted to the candidates who have won the most votes.
examples.zh: 这些席位被分配给了赢得了最多选票的候选人。

words.definition: if you have an interest in something or someone, you want to know or learn more about them; to make someone want to pay attention to something and find out more about it; like, fond of
words.translation: 兴趣，关注；业余爱好；利息；利害关系；使感兴趣， 引起…关注；兴趣，爱好；[金融]利息；趣味；同行

examples.en: I watched the first few episodes, but soon lost interest.
examples.zh: 我看了前几集，但很快就失去了兴趣。

examples.en: The last round of bidding aroused considerable interest.
examples.zh: 最后一轮竞价引起人们相当大的兴趣。

examples.en: Our survey reveals a disturbing lack of interest in teacher training.
examples.zh: 我们的调查显示人们对教师培训失去了兴趣，这很令人不安。

words.definition: decentralization, excretion
words.translation: 撤离；[军]疏散；排泄

examples.en: I ordered the evacuation of all Americans and sent troops to guarantee their safety.
examples.zh: 我下令撤离所有的美国人，并派部队去保证他们的安全。

examples.en: The impact of evacuation and relocation on those with health or functional impairments can be tremendous .
examples.zh: 撤离和重新安置对这些健康状况欠佳或身体残疾的人影响极大。

words.definition: the action of bringing an aircraft down to the ground after being in the air; pier, disembarkation; disembarking
words.translation: 登陆；着陆， 降落；[军]登陆；码头；楼梯平台；[军]登陆（land的ing形式）

examples.en: take-off and landing procedures
examples.zh: 起降程序

examples.en: the Apollo Moon landings
examples.zh: 阿波罗宇宙飞船登月

words.definition: not having good moral principles; to have your main place of work, business etc in a particular place; basis, elements, foundation, bed, bottom; poor, mean, dirty
words.translation: 卑鄙的， 不道德的；把设在；基础；底部；垒；卑鄙的；低劣的

examples.en: base attitudes and desires
examples.zh: 卑鄙的态度和欲望

words.definition: in a less important position than someone else; to put someone or something in a less important position; someone who has a lower position and less authority than someone else in an organization; inferior, underling; dependent, secondary, supporting, minor, peripheral
words.translation: 次要的；下级的；使处于次要地位， 使从属于；部属， 下属；下属，下级；部属，属下；从属的

examples.en: a subordinate officer
examples.zh: 下级官员

words.definition: remaining after all the rest has been used, taken, or eaten; remain, residuum; remanent, vestigial
words.translation: 剩余的；残留物；吃剩的饭菜；剩余物；残余的；吃剩的

examples.en: leftover vegetables
examples.zh: 吃剩的蔬菜

examples.en: a few pieces of leftover carpet
examples.zh: 剩余的几块地毯

words.definition: to officially charge someone with a criminal offence; law, sue for
words.translation: 控诉， 起诉， 控告；控告，起诉；[法]揭发

examples.en: He was later indicted on corruption charges.
examples.zh: 他后来被控贪污。

words.definition: A courier is a person who is paid to take letters and packages direct from one place to another; ciceroni, gaid
words.translation: 送急件的人， 信使；旅游服务员；导游；情报员，通讯员；送快信的人

examples.en: ...a motorcycle courier.
examples.zh: …一名骑摩托车的信使。

words.definition: to be made frightened or worried so that you do something too quickly, without thinking enough about it; when a group of large animals or people suddenly start running in the same direction because they are frightened or excited
words.translation: 狂奔，涌向；使仓促行事；逃窜， 狂奔；热潮， 风尚

examples.en: a herd of stampeding buffalo
examples.zh: 一群狂奔的水牛

words.definition: If you gorge on something or gorge yourself on it, you eat lots of it in a very greedy way; a deep narrow valley with steep sides; stomach, barrier, block, canyon, bottleneck; swallow down, get sth down; gobble up, bolt down
words.translation: 狼吞虎咽；山峡， 峡谷；[地理]峡谷；胃；暴食；[机]咽喉；障碍物；使吃饱；吞下；使扩张；拚命吃

examples.en: I could spend each day gorging on chocolate.
examples.zh: 我可以将每一天都花在狂吃巧克力上。

words.definition: Someone's mannerisms are the gestures or ways of speaking that are very characteristic of them, and which they often use; preciosity, peculiarity
words.translation: 怪癖， 癖性；过分的独特风格；特殊习惯；矫揉造作；怪癖

examples.en: His mannerisms are more those of a preoccupied maths professor.
examples.zh: 他的言谈举止更像是一个全神贯注的数学教授。

words.definition: an idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something about life or the world, especially an idea that has not yet been proved to be true; mechanism, element, speculation, doctrine, guess
words.translation: 理论， 原理；学说；见解， 看法；理论；原理；推测

examples.en: Freudian theory has had a great influence on psychology.
examples.zh: 弗洛伊德理论对心理学产生过巨大影响。

words.definition: to remove or get rid of something, especially by cutting it out; resect, abscise; consumption tax, goods tax
words.translation: 切除；删去；收税；[税收]消费税；货物税

examples.en: The tumour was excised.
examples.zh: 肿瘤被切除了。

words.definition: a legal arrangement by which you borrow money from a bank or similar organization in order to buy a house, and pay back the money over a period of years; if you mortgage your home, land, or property, you borrow money, usually from a bank, and if you cannot pay back the money within a particular period of time, the bank has the right to sell your property in order to get the money you owe it; hold in pledge, hypothecate; hypothecation, pledge
words.translation: 抵押贷款，按揭；抵押证书；用…作抵押；[经]抵押

examples.en: Your building society or bank will help arrange a mortgage.
examples.zh: 你加入的购房互助协会或银行将会给你安排抵押贷款。

examples.en: They’ve taken out a 30 year mortgage (= they will pay for their house over a period of 30 years ) .
examples.zh: 他们办理了一笔30年期的抵押贷款。

examples.en: We decided to use Fred’s redundancy money to pay off the mortgage (= pay back all the money we borrowed for a mortgage ) .
examples.zh: 我们决定用弗雷德的遣散费来偿清抵押贷款。

words.definition: a game played on grass by two teams of 11 players, with sticks and a ball; puck
words.translation: 曲棍球；冰球

examples.en: ...a new hockey arena.
examples.zh: …一个新的冰球场。

words.definition: prequisite, franchise
words.translation: 津贴， 利益；特权；额外补贴；临时津贴

words.definition: to become worse; morally unacceptable; go ill, exasperate; go to seed, retrogress; fallen, degraded; lost souls
words.translation: 退化， 衰退；堕落的；退化的；[数][生物]使退化；恶化；[数][生物]退化；堕落；[数][生物]退化的；堕落的人

examples.en: Inactivity can make your joints stiff, and the bones may begin to degenerate.
examples.zh: 不活动会使关节僵硬，骨骼因此可能会开始退化。

words.definition: a place where  monk s  live; monk, Grazie
words.translation: 男修道院， 寺院；修道院；僧侣

examples.en: They found an icon in the monastery.
examples.zh: 他们在修道院中发现了一个圣像。

examples.en: The monastery is in a remote mountain pass.
examples.zh: 那个修道院在一个偏远的山口中。

examples.en: You know, my dear child, in peace, in the work is not found, it is not in joy, nor in the world or the monastery, it exists only in the human soul.
examples.zh: 你知道，我亲爱的孩子，安宁，在工作中是找不到的，它也不在欢乐中，也不在这个世界上或者这所修道院中，它仅仅存在于人的灵魂里。

words.definition: someone who is devout has a very strong belief in a religion; religious, good
words.translation: 虔敬的；诚恳的；虔诚的；衷心的

examples.en: a devout Catholic
examples.zh: 虔诚的天主徒

words.definition: someone whose job is to examine books, films, letters etc and remove anything considered to be offensive, morally harmful, or politically dangerous; to examine books, films, letters etc to remove anything that is considered offensive, morally harmful, or politically dangerous etc; examine, review, inspect; supervisor, inspector
words.translation: 审查员；审查， 检查；审查，检查；检查员；[心理]潜意识压抑力；信件检查员

examples.en: The report was cleared by the American military censors.
examples.zh: 这篇报道被美国军方审查员删掉了。

words.definition: the imaginary line around which a large round object, such as the Earth, turns; sheft, spindle
words.translation: 轴；轴线， 中心线；轴线；轴心国

examples.en: The Earth rotates on an axis between the north and south poles.
examples.zh: 地球绕着南北两极之间的地轴自转。

words.definition: a specially designed system of paths, often in a park or public garden, which is difficult to find your way through; labyrinth, delusion; cloud, confuse
words.translation: 迷宫；复杂难懂的细节；困惑，迷惘；使混乱；使困惑， 迷惑；迷惑；糊涂；迷失；使困惑

examples.en: We got completely lost in the maze.
examples.zh: 我们在迷宫中彻底迷了路。

examples.en: the famous Hampton Court maze
examples.zh: 著名的汉普顿宫迷宫

words.definition: not taking enough care over something that you are responsible for, with the result that serious mistakes are made; inadvertent, inattentive
words.translation: 忽略的；疏忽的；粗心大意的

examples.en: Mr Brown was found guilty of negligent driving.
examples.zh: 布朗先生被判疏忽驾驶罪。

words.definition: to avoid talking about something, especially because you are trying to hide something; get out of, elude; escape, get out of
words.translation: 逃避， 回避；躲开， 避开；逃避；规避；逃脱

examples.en: I could tell that he was trying to evade the issue.
examples.zh: 我看得出他在极力回避这个问题。

examples.en: The minister evaded the question.
examples.zh: 部长回避了那个问题。

words.definition: reminding you of something else; linked, combined, joint
words.translation: 联想的；结合的；关联的；联合的；组合的

examples.en: the brain’s ability to form associative links between different things
examples.zh: 大脑通过联想把不同事物联系起来的能力

words.definition: a way of hitting the ball in tennis and some other games, in which the back of your hand is turned in the direction of the ball when you hit it
words.translation: 反手击球

examples.en: She practised her backhand.
examples.zh: 她练习反拍。

words.definition: when a law or a system is officially ended; destoolment, abrogation
words.translation: 废除， 废止；废奴运动；[法]废除；废止

examples.en: The abolition of slavery in Brazil and the Caribbean closely followed the pattern of the United States.
examples.zh: 巴西和加勒比海地区对奴隶制的废除很大程度上遵循了美国的模式。

words.definition: happening fairly often, but not regularly; scattered, dispersive
words.translation: 偶发的， 间或出现的， 零星的；零星的；分散的；不定时发生的

examples.en: There has been sporadic violence downtown.
examples.zh: 市中心时有暴力事件发生。

words.definition: the number of people who vote in an election; crop, output, cleaning, yield, harvest
words.translation: 出席人数；产量， 产额；[经]产量；出席者；出动；清除；[公路]岔道

examples.en: I was disappointed by the turn-out for our home match.
examples.zh: 我对我们主场比赛的观众到场人数感到失望。

words.definition: to write or print a libel against someone; when someone writes or prints untrue statements about someone so that other people could have a bad opinion of them; denigration, traducement; law, traduce
words.translation: 诽谤；诽谤性文字；诽谤罪；诋毁；毁坏名誉的东西；控诉书；中伤；控告；对…进行诽谤

examples.en: The newspaper which libelled him had already offered compensation.
examples.zh: 那家诽谤他的报纸已经提出赔偿。

words.definition: a set of fixed limits that control the way that something should be done; coefficient, arguments, modulus
words.translation: 参量， 参数；界限， 范围；参数；系数；[数]参量

examples.en: The inquiry has to stay within the parameters laid down by Congress.
examples.zh: 调查必须局限于国会设定的范围之内。

words.definition: an abortive action is not successful; losing, failing
words.translation: 落空的， 失败的；失败的；[妇产]流产的；堕胎的

examples.en: an abortive military coup
examples.zh: 一场未遂的军事政变

words.definition: to cut or try to cut something violently with a knife, sword etc; a line (/) used in writing to separate words, numbers, or letters; hide, whip up; pick apart, pick to pieces; cut, curtailment
words.translation: 砍；大幅削减；砍痕， 伤痕；斜线号；猛砍；鞭打；严厉批评；大幅度裁减或削减；削减；斜线；砍痕；沼泽低地

examples.en: Someone had slashed the tires.
examples.zh: 有人把轮胎割破了。

words.definition: existing or accepted in a particular place or at a particular time; popular, general, fashionable, going, common; winning
words.translation: 普遍的；流行的；一地常刮的， 盛行的；一般的，最普通的；占优势的；盛行很广的；盛行，流行（prevail的现在分词形式）；获胜

examples.en: The prevailing mood of public opinion remained hostile.
examples.zh: 公众仍普遍持敌对情绪。

examples.en: the prevailing economic conditions in Northern Ireland
examples.zh: 北爱尔兰普遍的经济状况

words.definition: useful; sharp, quick, smart, keen, fly
words.translation: 可用的；易使用的， 便利的；手巧的；便利的；手边的，就近的；[水运]容易取得的；敏捷的

examples.en: It’s quite a handy little tool.
examples.zh: 这件小工具非常有用。

examples.en: It’s very handy having a light above your desk.
examples.zh: 书桌上方有盏灯很有用。

examples.en: Take your swimming trunks with you – they might come in handy (= be useful ).
examples.zh: 带上你的游泳裤，可能会派上用场的。

words.definition: mental or physical suffering caused by extreme pain or worry; smart, hurt; agonize
words.translation: 极度痛苦；痛苦；苦恼；使极度痛苦

examples.en: And we know of your anguish.
examples.zh: 我们了解你们的痛苦。

examples.en: She suffered the anguish of despair.
examples.zh: 她忍受着绝望的痛苦。

examples.en: And in their anguish, they both forgot the nearness of my bedroom.
examples.zh: 极度的痛苦让他们忘记我的卧室就在附近。

words.translation: 折射

examples.en: The sonobuoy permits recording a refraction profile with only one ship.
examples.zh: 声纳浮标允许只以一艘船来记录折射剖面。

examples.en: We did work in thermonuclear energy, laser beam refraction, hydrogen molecule development, and heavy - water computer data.
examples.zh: 我们从事过热核能、 激光束折射， 氛分子发展和电脑重水数据的研究工作。

examples.en: With all that reflection and refraction, modernism creates the illusion that there is an illusion when in fact it is a straightforward statement of money and power.
examples.zh: 通过反射和折射，现代主义创造了一个幻觉存在的假象，而实际上它是对金钱和权力不加掩饰的声明。

words.definition: a very active type of physical exercise done to music, usually in a class
words.translation: 有氧运动

examples.en: Yoga has become the new aerobics and some people are getting it out of a book or video.
examples.zh: 瑜珈已经成为一种新型有氧运动，有些人从书本或录像中学习瑜珈。

examples.en: She teaches swimming, lifesaving and water aerobics.
examples.zh: 她教授游泳、救生术和水中有氧运动。

words.definition: something that is inviting is very attractive and makes you want to be near it, try it, taste it etc; attractive, catching
words.translation: 动人的， 诱人的；引人注目的；诱人的；有魅力的

examples.en: The log fire looked warm and inviting.
examples.zh: 篝火看上去温暖诱人。

words.definition: pleasant; pleasant, adaptive, lovely, calculated, grateful
words.translation: 使人愉快的；欣然同意的；令人愉快的；适合的；和蔼可亲的

examples.en: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
examples.zh: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

examples.en: an agreeable young man
examples.zh: 一个讨人喜欢的年轻人

words.definition: the people who live in the same area, town etc; village, organization, body, group
words.translation: 社会；社团；群落；共同体；社区；[生态]群落；团体

examples.en: The new arts centre will serve the whole community.
examples.zh: 这座新的艺术中心将为整个社区服务。

words.definition: an illness that is not very serious; tension, unrest
words.translation: 小病；不安

examples.en: minor ailments
examples.zh: 小恙

words.definition: having charisma
words.translation: 蒙受神恩的；有超凡魅力的

examples.en: Martin Luther King was a very charismatic speaker.
examples.zh: 马丁•路德•金是个很有感召力的演说家。

words.definition: giving strong loyal support to another person, organization, belief etc; committed, loving, firm, confirmed, devoted; rein in, rein up
words.translation: 坚定的， 忠诚的；坚定的；忠诚的；坚固的；止住；止血

examples.en: a staunch conservative
examples.zh: 忠实的保守党党员

words.definition: a particular group of people within a society and their behaviour, beliefs, and activities – often used to show disapproval
words.translation: 亚文化行为观念， 次文化

examples.en: the drug subculture of the inner city
examples.zh: 旧城区的吸毒亚文化群

words.definition: believing that good things will happen in the future; rose-colored, rosy
words.translation: 乐观的；乐观主义的

examples.en: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
examples.zh: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

words.definition: not having enough money to pay what you owe; bankrupt; broke, bankrupt
words.translation: 财力不足的， 破产的；[经]破产者；无力偿还者；[经]破产的；无力偿还的

examples.en: The company was later declared insolvent (= officially said to be insolvent ).
examples.zh: 公司随后被宣布破产。

words.definition: the belief in basing your ideas on practical experience; experimentalism
words.translation: 经验论， 经验主义；经验主义；经验论

examples.en: A basic principle of empiricism is to insist that all knowledge comes from experience.
examples.zh: 坚持一切知识都来自于经验，这是经验论的基本原则。

words.definition: Annotation is the activity of annotating something; commentary, exegesis
words.translation: 注释， 注解；[计]注释；注解；释文

examples.en: She retained a number of copies for further annotation.
examples.zh: 她为进一步解释保留了好多复印件。

words.definition: Mechanics is the part of physics that deals with the natural forces that act on moving or stationary objects; dynamics, technology, configuration, science, framework, skill, texture
words.translation: 机械学， 力学；技巧， 方法；[力]力学（用作单数）；结构；技术；[机]机械学（用作单数）

examples.en: He has not studied mechanics or engineering.
examples.zh: 他没有学习过力学或者工程学。

words.definition: having a part resembling a toe
words.translation: 有趾的

examples.en: They then found the same virus lurking in the genome of the three-toed sloth .
examples.zh: 然后他们发现同样的病毒也潜伏在三趾树懒基因组里。

examples.en: Women should go for close-toed heels, and if they wear a dress suit, the skirt should fall at or below the knee.
examples.zh: 女士则应穿不露脚趾的高跟鞋，如穿着裙装套装，那么裙子要及膝或到膝盖以下。

words.definition: a type of high-speed train that runs on magnets supported by a magnetic field generated around the track
words.translation: 磁力悬浮火车

examples.en: The engine for maglev trains is rather in noticeable.
examples.zh: 磁悬浮列车的车头是相当值得注意的。

examples.en: A good example of how transportation is changing is the new maglev train, which is environmentally friendly, energy-saving and travels at an amazing 430 km/h.
examples.zh: 新型的磁悬浮列车就是交通运输变化的一个很好的例子。它既环保，又节约能源，还能以430公里的惊人时速行驶。

words.definition: to show that something exists or is true; facts or signs that show clearly that something exists or is true; authentication, certification, demonstration, proof, breath; demonstrate, prove, argue, bear witness to
words.translation: 证明；证据；迹象；根据；[法]证据，证明；明显

examples.en: The volcano is still active, as evidenced by the recent eruption.
examples.zh: 最近的喷发证明，这座火山依然活跃。

words.definition: a short journey in order to do something for someone, for example delivering or collecting something for them; mission, message
words.translation: 差事， 差使；使命；差事；差使

examples.en: I seemed to spend my life running errands for people.
examples.zh: 我好像一辈子都在为别人跑腿。

examples.en: She was always sending me on errands.
examples.zh: 她老是支使我。

examples.en: He quickly set out on his errand of mercy (= journey to help someone in danger ).
examples.zh: 他迅速启程参加救援行动。

words.definition: In a polygamous society, people can be legally married to more than one person at the same time. A polygamous person, especially a man, is married to more than one person.
words.translation: 一夫多妻的， 一妻多夫的

examples.en: Less than 1 percent of the men in any Muslim country are polygamous.
examples.zh: 任何一个穆斯林国家都有不到1%的男子是有多位妻子的。

words.definition: a feeling of excitement or anxiety when you do not know what will happen next; anxiety, solicitude
words.translation: 担心， 焦虑；悬念， 不确定；悬念；悬疑；焦虑；悬而不决

examples.en: Come on then, tell me what happened; the suspense is killing me (= I feel very excited or anxious because I do not know what will happen next ) .
examples.zh: 快来，告诉我发生了什么事。急死我了。

examples.en: She couldn’t bear the suspense a moment longer.
examples.zh: 这样提心吊胆，她再也受不了了。

words.definition: A gemstone is a jewel or stone used in jewellery; gem, precious stones
words.translation: 经雕琢的宝石；（经雕琢的）[宝]宝石

examples.en: Blue turquoise is valued as a gemstone.
examples.zh: 蓝色的绿松石被视为宝石。

examples.en: Ruby, the common name for the mineral corundum in its red form, is a precious gemstone.
examples.zh: 红宝石是对红色矿物刚玉的俗称，它是一种珍贵的宝石。

examples.en: In particular, we carefully selected for you 12 beautiful gemstone pendants in the hope it can help you resist following illness.
examples.zh: 我们特别为您精心挑选了12种漂亮的宝石垂饰，希望它能助您抵抗以下病痛。

words.definition: when you are healthy and strong enough to do hard work or play sports; health, adaptability, relevance, wellness
words.translation: 健康， 健壮；适合；健康；适当；适合性

examples.en: an exercise programme to improve your fitness
examples.zh: 增进健康的锻炼计划

examples.en: Running marathons requires a high level of physical fitness .
examples.zh: 跑马拉松需要身体十分强健。

words.definition: a small thin piece that is torn or cut roughly from something; to cut or tear something into small thin pieces; debris, chip; rip up, tear to pieces
words.translation: 碎片，细条；些许，少量；切碎， 撕碎；碎片；少量剩余；最少量；破布；撕碎

examples.en: Cut the cabbage into fine long shreds.
examples.zh: 把这棵卷心菜切成细长条。

words.definition: if you kindle a fire, or if it kindles, it starts to burn; lamp, emblaze; lamp, brighten up
words.translation: 点燃， 开始燃烧；激起；点燃；照亮；发亮；着火；激动起来

examples.en: The Second World War kindled his enthusiasm for politics.
examples.zh: 第二次世界大战激发了他的政治热情。

words.definition: a type of large tree with broad leaves, or the wood from this tree; elmwood
words.translation: 榆树；[林]榆树；榆木

examples.en: It was a good table too, sturdily constructed of elm.
examples.zh: 这也是一张好桌子，榆木做的，很结实。

words.definition: astonished, amazed
words.translation: 交错的， 错开的；震惊的；错列的；吃惊的

examples.en: I was absolutely staggered when I saw the bill.
examples.zh: 看到账单时，我大吃一惊。

words.definition: to do business with someone; trade, traffic, exchange; to handle, cope with
words.translation: 交易；执行， 处理；谈判；办理；处理

examples.en: Most deals are transacted over the phone.
examples.zh: 大多数生意都是在电话里成交的。

words.definition: angry and surprised because you feel insulted or unfairly treated; aggrieved
words.translation: 愤慨的， 恼怒的；愤愤不平的；义愤的

examples.en: an indignant reply
examples.zh: 愤慨的回复

words.definition: a decimal system is based on the number 10; a  fraction (= a number less than 1 )  that is shown as a  full stop  followed by the number of  tenth s  ,  hundredth s  etc. The numbers 0.5, 0.175, and 0.661 are decimals.; fractional; small number, haet
words.translation: 十进位的，小数的；小数；小数的；[数]十进位的；[数]小数

examples.en: changing to a decimal system
examples.zh: 改为十进制

examples.en: calculations accurate to three decimal places
examples.zh: 精确到小数点后三位的计算

words.definition: strong enough, well enough planned etc to continue for a very long time; eternal, continued, permanent, sustained; maintaining
words.translation: 持久的， 永久的；持久的；永恒的；持续；维持（last的ing形式）

examples.en: The reforms will bring lasting benefits.
examples.zh: 改革将带来长久的利益。

examples.en: Their generosity made a lasting impression on me.
examples.zh: 他们的慷慨给我留下了难忘的印象。

examples.en: a solution that would bring lasting peace
examples.zh: 将带来持久和平的解决方案

words.definition: unwilling to believe that people have good, honest, or sincere reasons for doing something
words.translation: 愤世嫉俗的， 冷嘲热讽的

examples.en: a cynical view of human nature
examples.zh: 认为人性本恶的一种观点

words.definition: a tortuous path, stream, road etc has a lot of bends in it and is therefore difficult to travel along; curve, twisted
words.translation: 折磨人的， 令人痛苦的；曲折的， 蜿蜒的；含混不清的， 拐弯抹角的；扭曲的，弯曲的；啰嗦的

examples.en: a tortuous path over the mountains to Kandahar
examples.zh: 翻山越岭通往坎大哈的一条蜿蜒小径

words.definition: a situation in which there is a lot of damage or a lack of order, especially so that it is difficult for something to continue in the normal way; ravage; damage
words.translation: 混乱， 大破坏；大破坏；浩劫；蹂躏；损毁

examples.en: policies that would wreak havoc on the country’s economy
examples.zh: 会危害该国经济的政策

examples.en: Rain has continued to play havoc with sporting events.
examples.zh: 下雨一直影响着体育比赛的进行。

words.definition: someone who has no home or work, especially someone who begs; ragamuffinly, wandering; cad, vag
words.translation: 漂泊的；无业游民，流浪者；流浪的；游荡的；游民；流浪者；无赖；漂泊者

examples.en: He lived on the street as a vagrant.
examples.zh: 他作为一个流浪者露宿街头。

words.definition: extremely full of people; steeped, fraught
words.translation: 拥挤的；压紧的；（常用来构成复合词）充满…的，塞满了…的

examples.en: a packed courtroom
examples.zh: 挤满人的法庭

words.definition: abandon, mental derangement
words.translation: 精神错乱， 神志失常；精神错乱；发狂，狂热；说谵语状态

examples.en: Before she died she had fits of delirium.
examples.zh: 去世前她一阵阵地胡言乱语。

words.definition: to make a serious promise to yourself or someone else; a serious promise; oath, pledge; plight one's troth, cross my heart
words.translation: 发誓；誓约；誓言；许愿；郑重宣告

examples.en: While many models vow to go back to college, few do.
examples.zh: 很多模特儿发誓要重返大学，但几乎无人做到。

words.definition: a system of secret writing; password, signal, nothing; figure, cast; cast, figure
words.translation: 密码， 暗号；[计][通信]密码；暗号；[数]零；使用密码；计算；做算术；将…译成密码

examples.en: an expert in ciphers
examples.zh: 密码专家

examples.en: messages written in cipher
examples.zh: 用密码写的信息

words.definition: well known or famous, especially because of some special quality or ability; famous, obvious, prominent, marked, outstanding
words.translation: 著名的；显著的；附有乐谱的

examples.en: a noted author
examples.zh: 著名作家

words.definition: a feeling that someone or something is not important and deserves no respect; despite, defiance
words.translation: 轻视， 鄙视， 轻蔑；轻视，蔑视；耻辱

examples.en: The public is treated with contempt by broadcasters.
examples.zh: 公众受到了节目主持人的轻蔑对待。

examples.en: How could she have loved a man who so clearly held her in contempt ?
examples.zh: 她怎么会爱上一个明显看不起她的男人呢？

words.definition: an important job, piece of work, or activity that you are responsible for; career, enterprise, assurance, certification, commitment; holding, promising, agreeing, granting
words.translation: 任务， 项目；事业， 企业；承诺， 保证；事业；企业；保证；殡仪业；同意；担任；许诺（undertake的ing形式）

examples.en: Starting a new business can be a risky undertaking.
examples.zh: 创办新企业有时是一件有风险的事情。

words.definition: to gradually become slower, weaker, less active etc, or to make something do this; slack off, keep a slack hand; relax
words.translation: 松弛， 放松；减缓， 放慢；松劲，懈怠；变松弛；变缓慢；使缓慢；使松弛

examples.en: The heavy rain showed no signs of slackening off.
examples.zh: 大雨没有减弱的迹象。

words.definition: an abiding feeling or belief continues for a long time and is not likely to change; permanent, continued, lasting, constant, sustained; keeping, observing
words.translation: 持久的， 永久的；持久的，永久的；不变的；遵守；容忍；继续存在（abide的现在分词）

examples.en: Phil has a deep and abiding love for his family.
examples.zh: 菲尔对家人怀有深厚不渝的爱。

words.definition: a reduction in the size, number, or amount of something; reduction, loss, decrease
words.translation: 减少， 缩减；减少，降低；缩小

examples.en: ...despite a slight diminution in asset value.
examples.zh: ...尽管资产价值略有减少。

words.definition: a short sleep, especially during the day; beauty sleep, lie-down; caulk off, neglect of
words.translation: 小睡， 打盹；小睡，打盹儿；细毛；孤注一掷；小睡；疏忽

examples.en: an afternoon nap
examples.zh: 午睡

words.definition: almost the same; alike, like; analog
words.translation: 相似的， 类似的；相似的；类似物

examples.en: We have similar tastes in music.
examples.zh: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

examples.en: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
examples.zh: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

examples.en: A number of his friends had been affected in a similar way .
examples.zh: 他的一些朋友也受到了类似的影响。

words.definition: to put information into a digital form
words.translation: 数字化

examples.en: The picture is digitized by a scanner.
examples.zh: 该图通过扫描仪被数字化。

words.definition: the form that something has, for example round, square,  triangular  etc; to make something have a particular shape, especially by pressing it; matrix, form, model; mold, make, model; to come into being, to form
words.translation: 形状，外形，样子；体形，身材；形式；幻象；情况，状况；使成为…形状， 塑造；决定…的形成；形状；模型；身材；具体化；形成；塑造，使成形；使符合；成形；成长

examples.en: What shape is the table?
examples.zh: 那张桌子是什么形状的？

examples.en: You can recognize a tree by the shape of its leaves.
examples.zh: 可以根据树叶的形状辨认出是什么树。

examples.en: His battered old hat had completely lost its shape.
examples.zh: 他那顶破旧的帽子已经完全变形了。

words.definition: loyalty to a leader, country, belief etc; loyalty, devotion
words.translation: 忠诚， 效忠， 拥戴；效忠，忠诚；忠贞

examples.en: an oath of allegiance
examples.zh: 效忠宣誓

examples.en: The people here have strong political allegiances .
examples.zh: 这里的民众政治忠诚度很高。

words.definition: feel like, desire, mean, intend, Wanna Be
words.translation: 想要；想要（等于want to）

examples.en: I wanna be with you.
examples.zh: 我想要和你在一起。

examples.en: I wanna save you, save you, save you tonight.
examples.zh: 我想要拯救你，拯救你，拯救你就在今晚。

examples.en: Am I the one you wanna place in your heart – why me ?
examples.zh: 我是你想要放在心上的人吗？为什么是我？

words.definition: when someone becomes ill or weak because they have not eaten enough good food; dystrophy, nutritional deficiency
words.translation: 营养不良；营养失调，[医]营养不良

examples.en: refugees suffering from malnutrition
examples.zh: 营养不良的难民

words.definition: a tall African animal with a very long neck and legs and dark spots on its yellow-brown fur
words.translation: 长颈鹿

examples.en: I/ you/ we/ they like giraffe.
examples.zh: 我/你/我们/他们喜欢长颈鹿。

examples.en: So they sent me a … giraffe!
examples.zh: 于是他们又送我一只…长颈鹿。

examples.en: Can I get the mommy giraffe for Christmas?
examples.zh: 我在圣诞节能得到一个长颈鹿妈妈吗？

words.definition: when no one wants to do anything to change a situation; nonreactivity, inaction
words.translation: 惯性；惰性；[力]惯性；[化学]惰性，迟钝；不活动

examples.en: political inertia
examples.zh: 政治上的保守

words.definition: abstract, brief
words.translation: 成为…的缩影；摘要， 概括， 缩写；摘要；概括

examples.en: This building epitomizes the spirit of the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 这栋建筑体现了19世纪的时代精神。

words.definition: cold or typical of winter; cold, chilly
words.translation: 冬天的；寒冷的；冷淡的；寒冷的，冬天的

examples.en: a wintry day
examples.zh: 一个冬日

examples.en: wintry showers
examples.zh: 冬季的阵雪

words.definition: the difference between the amount of something that you have and the higher amount that you need; red ink
words.translation: 不足额；赤字， 逆差；[财政]赤字

examples.en: the country’s widening budget deficit
examples.zh: 这个国家日益严重的预算赤字

examples.en: the US’s foreign trade deficit
examples.zh: 美国的对外贸易逆差

words.definition: if ideas, arguments, beliefs, statements etc cohere, they are connected in a clear and reasonable way; adhere, identify, cotton, square
words.translation: 连贯， 一致；黏合；齐心协力， 团结一致；凝聚；连贯；粘着；一致

examples.en: All the details are there and are correct but they don’t cohere.
examples.zh: 所有的细节都摆在那里，而且都正确，但是它们并不一致。

words.definition: to make something go away, especially a belief, idea, or feeling; eliminate, avoid
words.translation: 驱散， 驱逐；消除；驱散，驱逐；消除（烦恼等）

examples.en: We want to dispel the myth that you cannot eat well in Britain.
examples.zh: 我们要消除在英国吃不好的误解。

examples.en: Light poured into the hall, dispelling the shadows.
examples.zh: 阳光洒进大厅，驱散了阴影。

words.translation: 缓泻剂

words.definition: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other; category, variety, manner, nature, kind
words.translation: 种类， 类群；[生物]物种；种类

examples.en: Pandas are an endangered species.
examples.zh: 大熊猫是一种濒危物种。

words.definition: a type of powder or seed, taken from plants, that you put into food you are cooking to give it a special taste; to add interest or excitement to something; flavor, little, touch
words.translation: 香料，调味品；趣味，情趣；加香料于；给…增添趣味；香料；情趣；[食品]调味品；少许

examples.en: herbs and spices
examples.zh: 香草和香料

words.definition: from a plane; a piece of equipment for receiving or sending radio or television signals, usually consisting of a piece of metal or wire; romantic, fantastic; antenna, Arial
words.translation: 空中的，地表以上的；从飞行器上的；天线；[昆][生物][航]空中的，航空的；空气的；空想的；[电讯]天线

examples.en: an aerial attack
examples.zh: 空袭

examples.en: aerial photographs
examples.zh: 在空中拍摄的照片

examples.en: an aerial view of the Three Gorges Dam project
examples.zh: 一张三峡大坝工程鸟瞰图

words.definition: the degree to which something has been mixed into something else; percolation, soakage
words.translation: 饱和；饱和度；[经][物][化学]饱和；[光]色饱和度；浸透；磁化饱和

examples.en: Keep saturation below 80%.
examples.zh: 把饱和度保持在 80% 以下。

words.definition: to improve the way that something is done or used so that it is as effective as possible
words.translation: 使最优化；充分利用

examples.en: They need to optimize the use of available resources.
examples.zh: 他们需要充分利用手上的资源。

words.definition: to make something work much better or become much better again; renew, reinstate; be cured of, pull round
words.translation: 使年轻；使恢复活力；使更新；使恢复精神；使复原；复原；变年轻

examples.en: plans to rejuvenate the inner city areas
examples.zh: 旧城区复兴计划

words.definition: an article in a newspaper about the life of someone who has just died; deceased.; necrology
words.translation: 讣闻， 讣告；讣告的；死亡的；讣告

examples.en: His obituary was published in one edition of his own newspaper before it was discovered that he was alive.
examples.zh: 他的讣文刊登在他自己的报纸版面上之后，才发现他还活着。

words.definition: To dignify something means to make it impressive
words.translation: 使有尊严， 使高贵；美化

examples.en: Tragic literature dignifies sorrow and disaster.
examples.zh: 悲剧性文学使悲伤和灾难显得尊贵。

words.definition: huff and puff, bark; gnar, huff and puff; bluff
words.translation: 虚张声势地恫吓；猛刮；咆哮；狂吹；夸口；威吓；气势汹汹地说；恫吓；怒号；吓唬

words.definition: an impending event or situation, especially an unpleasant one, is going to happen very soon; pressing, stringent; threatening
words.translation: 即将发生的， 迫近的；即将发生的；迫切的；悬挂的；迫近；悬空（impend的现在分词）

examples.en: On the morning of the expedition, I awoke with a feeling of impending disaster.
examples.zh: 远征出发的那天早上，我醒来就有一种大难临头的感觉。

words.definition: careful, thorough, and exact; strict, rigid, precise, severe, tight
words.translation: 缜密的， 谨慎的；严格的， 严厉的；严格的，严厉的；严密的；严酷的

examples.en: a rigorous analysis of defence needs
examples.zh: 对国防需求的缜密分析

examples.en: the rigorous standards required by the college
examples.zh: 大学规定的严格标准

words.definition: the feeling you have when you feel guilty and embarrassed because you, or someone who is close to you, have done something wrong; to make someone feel ashamed; abashment; discountenance, abash
words.translation: 羞耻，羞愧，耻辱；可耻的人；使羞愧；玷辱；羞耻，羞愧；憾事，带来耻辱的人；使丢脸，使羞愧

examples.en: He felt a deep sense of shame.
examples.zh: 他深深地感到羞愧。

examples.en: Maria blushed with shame.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚羞得脸都红了。

examples.en: (= it made her feel ashamed ) , she gained back all the weight she’d lost.
